English: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nimesikia kilio cha huzuni cha Waisraeli ambao Wamisri wamewatia utumwani, nami nimelikumbuka Agano langu.
Ekegusii: Na bono naigure okwerera kw’Abaisraeli abwo Abamisiri babegete inse y’obosomba, naende ning’inyorete okobwatana koria kwane.

English: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.
Kiswahili: Mitume wakaamua kwamba kila mtu, kulingana na uwezo alio nao, atoe msaada kwa ajili ya ndugu wanaoishi Uyahudi.
Ekegusii: Na aborokigwa baria, kera oyomo koreng’ana buna okonyara kwaye, bakang’ea gotoma ogokonywa ase abamwabo abamenyete Boyahudi.

English: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained. Citizenship in Heaven
Kiswahili: Lakini na tushike sana lile ambalo tumekwisha kulifikia.
Ekegusii: Korende togenderere ase ayio ayio twaigete konyora.

English: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu ukaonekana wafaa kwa mfalme na kusanyiko lote.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio oyio okaba omooronge ase omorwoti na ase omosangererekano bwonsi.

English: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi: Sadaka ya dhambi itachinjiwa mbele za Bwana mahali sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: “Moe Aroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y'ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe: Agwo ase ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa gekonyeenyerwa nao agwo eki'ebibe keranyenyerwe, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekeng'wanso ekio negechenu mono.

English: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu ni Mungu mwenye huruma, hatawaacha au kuwaangamiza wala kusahau Agano alilofanya na baba zenu, alilowathibitishia kwa kiapo.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, takobatiga, ekiagera ere n'oyo bw'amaabera. Takobasiria, gose takweba okobwatana kwaye kw'ogotianania akorete ne'chisokoro chiaino.

English: Sarah, my master's wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
Kiswahili: Sara mkewe bwana wangu amemzalia mwana katika uzee wake, naye amempa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
Ekegusii: Omonene one akamboria ntiane, aganteabia: “Torigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b'Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase ense yabo;

English: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
Kiswahili: Mtumwa awapo mfalme, mpumbavu ashibapo chakula,
Ekegusii: Ekero omosomba akoba omorwoti, na omonto omoriri akoigota endagera,

English: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
Kiswahili: Afadhali maskini ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama kuliko tajiri ambaye njia zake ni potovu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka okobwatia oboronge nigo are omuya kobua omonda ore omokorekanu.

English: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh's word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu, kuanzia mwaka wa kumi na tatu wa utawala wa Yosia mwana wa Amoni mfalme wa Yuda, hadi siku hii ya leo, neno la Bwana limekuwa likinijia, nami nimesema nanyi mara kwa mara, lakini hamkusikiliza.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y'emiaka emerongo ebere na etato, gochakera omwaka o ikomi na gatato bw'okogamba kwa Yosia mosinto bw'Amoni, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, goika rituko ria reero, ring'ana ri'Omonene riabeire rigochicha ase 'nde, na inche nabeire nkoribateebia inwe ntari gotiga, korende inwe mwabeire mokwanga koriigwera.

English: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Nikanunua watumwa wa kiume na wa kike na watumwa wengine walizaliwa nyumbani mwangu. Pia nilikuwa na makundi ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mbuzi kuliko mtu yeyote aliyewahi kuishi Yerusalemu kabla yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkagora abasomba, abasacha na abakungu; abwo bakanyiborera abasomba bande ase enka yane; nigo nabwate amaicho amange e chiombe, ne chimbori, ne ching'ondi, nkabua abwo bonsi bantang'anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu.

English: Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.
Kiswahili: Sasa, Ee Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, acha neno lako lile ulilomwahidi mtumishi wako Daudi baba yangu litimie.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, tiga ring'ana riao riria gwatebeetie omosomba oo Daudi ribe eri'ekeene.

English: Pharaoh's daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child's mother.
Kiswahili: Binti Farao akamjibu, “Ndiyo, nenda.” Yule msichana akaenda akamleta mama wa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda!” Erio akagenda, akarangeria ng'ina omwana oria.

English: Moreover, your skirts are stained with the blood of the innocent poor, though you did not find them breaking in. But in spite of all these things
Kiswahili: Katika nguo zako watu huona damu ya uhai ya maskini wasio na hatia, ingawa hukuwakamata wakivunja nyumba. Lakini katika haya yote
Ekegusii: Chianga chiano nigo chibwate ebimoa bi’amanyinga ’abaanto abataka batari nokomocha. Ekero mwabaitete timwabanyorete bakobochora chinyomba chiaino, korende nase okogania kwaino mwabaitete.

English: It can't be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
Kiswahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi kuliko zote, wala thamani yake haiwezi kupimwa kwa fedha.
Ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitaabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.

English: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
Kiswahili: Unatujibu kwa matendo ya kushangaza ya haki, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, tumaini la miisho yote ya duniani na la bahari zilizo mbali sana,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase ogokora kw’ogokumia ogotoigwa ase oboronge bwao; naye ore ogosemeria kw’abaanto bamenyete ase ense, nonya ngoika chinsinyo chi’ense, na ase chinyancha chi’aare.

English: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
Kiswahili: Wewe huwaokoa wanyenyekevu, lakini macho yako ni juu ya wenye kiburi ili uwashushe.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende amaiso ao nigo arigereretie abare abaenenu ase okobairania inse.

English: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.
Kiswahili: Nimeona jambo lililo chungu kuliko mauti, mwanamke ambaye ni mtego, ambaye moyo wake ni wavu wa kutegea na mikono yake ni minyororo. Mtu ampendezaye Mungu atamkwepa, bali mwenye dhambi atanaswa naye.
Ekegusii: Erio nkanyora egento ekeroro kebuete amakweri. Egento ekio nakio omokungu enkoro yaye yarenge omotego, naende amaboko aye are chingataare. Omonto ogogetie Nyasae tari kobwatwa nomokuungu oyio, korende omonyabibe ere nigo akobwatwa.

English: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
Kiswahili: Yuda akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani na kwa maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, akazungumza nao jinsi ambavyo angeweza kumsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Akagenda agakwana nabakuani abanene na abatang'ani b'abarendi buna aranyare komobeeka ase amaboko abo.

English: Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.”
Kiswahili: Inawezekana kwamba Bwana ataona dhiki yangu na kunilipa mema kwa ajili ya laana ninayopokea leo.”
Ekegusii: Ande Omonene ororire amabe anyoorete, nere ang’akane amaya ribaga ri’okoragererigwa okwo kwanyoorire reero.”

English: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaenda na kumfikia huyo mtu wa Mungu katika Mlima Karmeli. Alipomwona kwa mbali, huyo mtu wa Mungu akamwambia mtumishi wake Gehazi, “Tazama, yule Mshunami!
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agachaaka orogendo, agaika ase omonto oria o Nyasae, agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli. Ekero omonto oria o Nyasae aroche omokungu oria ogocha, agateebia Gehasi, omosomba oye “Rigereria gochia aaria, Omosunemu oria ogocha!

English: Yahweh's eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
Kiswahili: Macho ya Bwana yako kila mahali, yakiwaangalia waovu na wema.
Ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie kera ase, nigo arooche ababe amo n'abaya.

English: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji wa makimbilio) na Gezeri,
Ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie bw’obotamero ase ense y’Efraimu na Geseri,

English: Then in the language of his ancestors he raised the battle cry joined with hymns. Then he rushed against Gorgias' troops when they were not expecting it, and put them to flight.
Kiswahili: Kisha kwa lugha ya mababu zake akapaza sauti ya vita iliyoambatana na nyimbo za shangwe. Kisha akakimbilia dhidi ya vikosi vya Gorgia wakati hawakuwa wakitarajia, na kuwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda agachaaka goteera amatera y'esegi ase omonwa bw'echisokoro chiaye, Abayahudi bakaboera Gorgia n'abanto baye barabwo bagatama.

English: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will be stationed in the presence of kings; he will not stand before obscure men.
Kiswahili: Je, unamwona mtu stadi katika kazi yake? Atahudumu mbele ya wafalme; hatahudumu mbele ya watu duni.
Ekegusii: Oise korora omonto omanyete emeremo yaye buya, oyio natenene ase amasio y’abarwoti, tagokorera abanto bande emeremo.

English: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the battle and never repeat it!
Kiswahili: Kama ukiweka mkono wako juu yake, utavikumbuka hivyo vita na kamwe hutarudia tena!
Ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao oyebwate, erio oteeme gokora esegi nero. Tokoiranera eria kabere.

English: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”
Kiswahili: Usiku ule Mungu akamtokea Solomoni na kumwambia, “Omba lolote utakalo nikupe.”
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria Nyasae akaorokera Sulemani, akamoteebia, “Mboria aya oganetie nkoe!”

English: After Absalom had fled and gone to Geshur, he stayed there three years.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Absalomu kukimbia na kwenda Geshuri, akakaa huko miaka mitatu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu atamete, akageenda akamenya Gesuri ase engaki y’emiaka etato.

English: Therefore it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its branches multiplied, and its boughs grew long as it spread them out because of the abundant waters.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ukarefuka kupita miti yote ya shambani; vitawi vyake viliongezeka na matawi yake yakawa marefu, yakitanda kwa sababu ya wingi wa maji.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio omocharake oria ogakiina, Ogatambea ogaetania emete yonsi ye rinani, chinsagia chiaye chikamentekana, na ebisagia biaye bigatambea, ase engencho y’amaache amaange arengeo akayokinia.

English: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh's house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.
Kiswahili: Pia akawaweka mabawabu kwenye malango ya Hekalu la Bwana ili kwamba kwa vyovyote asije akaingia mtu yeyote aliye najisi.
Ekegusii: Akabeka abarendi bakorenda ebiita bi'enyomba y'Omonene na gotanga omonto onde bwensi otachenegete tasoa ime.

English: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
Kiswahili: “Kama mnanipenda, mtazishika amri zangu.
Ekegusii: “Komoranyanche namobwate amachiiko aane.

English: The flesh of your saints and their blood was shed all around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
Kiswahili: Miili ya watakatifu wako na damu yao ilimwagwa pande zote za Yerusalemu, wala hapakuwa na mtu wa kuwazika.
Ekegusii: “Amanyinga ya abegenwa bao agaiterwa, emebere yaaboegatugutwa aa na aaria Yerusalemu; tatigarete oyo orenge gotindeka ebitondo.”

English: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk'?
Kiswahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kumwambia huyu aliyepooza, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,' au kusema, ‘Inuka, uchukue mkeka wako, uende'?
Ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteebia oyore rigata: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende?

English: Then Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akaota ndoto, naye alipowaeleza ndugu zake, wakamchukia zaidi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaroota chindoto, na ekero ateebetie abamwabo chindoto echio, barabwo bakamenta mono komogecha.

English: Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Solomoni alikuwa Rehoboamu, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Abiya, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yehoshafati, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Asa,
Ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Sulemani narwo oro: Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya; Abiya akaibora Asa, na Asa akaibora Yehosafati;

English: There are different gifts, but the same Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kuna aina mbalimbali za karama, lakini Roho ni yule yule.
Ekegusii: Bono mbireo ebiegwa ao ao, korende Omoika noro oria oyomo.

English: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision. No strength remained in me; my face grew deathly pale, and I was powerless.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo niliachwa peke yangu, nikikodolea macho maono hayo makubwa; sikubakiwa na nguvu, na rangi ya uso wangu ikabadilika kama aliyekufa, nikakosa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ngatigara inche bweka ndigereretie okorora koria, ne chinguru chikang’erera, ekieni kiane gekaonchoka gekarachoka, ne chinguru chionsi chikarua asende.

English: “In that day,” declares the Lord GOD, “the songs of the temple will turn to wailing. Many will be the corpses, strewn in silence everywhere!”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenyezi asema, “Katika siku ile, nyimbo katika Hekalu zitageuka kuwa maombolezo. Miili mingi, mingi sana: itatupwa kila mahali! Kimya!”
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio amatera agoterwa ase chie Hekalu naonchoke abe okorera gw’okweumia. Emebere y’ abanto bakwete nigo erabe emenge aande onsi; abanto nigo barabe bakoyetuguta bakirete‐kiri.” Okogambigwa kw’Abaisraeli

English: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
Kiswahili: Nao watawatenda haya kwa sababu hawamjui Baba wala mimi.
Ekegusii: Naende ayio nabaabakorere, ekiagera tibamomanyeti Tata, nonya ninche.

English: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
Kiswahili: Tangu nilipomwendea Farao kuzungumza naye kwa jina lako, amewaletea taabu watu hawa, nawe kamwe hujawakomboa watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Naki korwa riria nagendete ase Farao gokwana amang'ana ao omentire gokorera abanto bao bobe mono, na aye torakora kende ase okobatooria.”

English: Then He had a little child stand among them. Taking the child in His arms, He said to them,
Kiswahili: Kisha akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha katikati yao. Akamkumbatia, akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Akabogoria omwana, akamotenenia gati‐gati yaabo, akamoagata, akabateebia,

English: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”
Kiswahili: Nahashi yule Mwamoni, akakwea kuuzunguka kwa jeshi mji wa Yabeshi-Gileadi. Watu wote wa Yabeshi wakamwambia, “Fanya mkataba na sisi, na tutakuwa chini yako.”
Ekegusii: Nahasi Omoamoni akagenda, agaetanana Yabesi ase ense ya Gileadi koyorwania esegi. Abanto bonsi ba Yabesi bakamoteebia: “Kora okobwatana naintwe, erio tobe inse asore togokorere.”

English: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ona jinsi kila mkuu wa Israeli aliyeko ndani yako anavyotumia nguvu zake kumwaga damu.
Ekegusii: Rora, abagaambi b'Abaisraeli bamenyete ime yao, kera oyomo nigo asemeretie chinguru chiaye omonyene ase ogoitera amanyinga.

English: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. And they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth-jair.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na wana thelathini waliopanda punda thelathini. Nao walikuwa na miji thelathini iliyoko Gileadi, inayoitwa Hawoth-Yairi mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, baare koriina chitigere emerongo etato. Boigo bakaba bakogambera emechie emerongo etato agwo ase ense ya Gileadi. Emechie eyio nigo ekorokwa Hawoti‐Yairi (Emechie ya Yairi) nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God's house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
Kiswahili: nalo jiwe hili nililolisimamisha kama nguzo litakuwa nyumba ya Mungu na katika yote utakayonipa nitakutolea wewe sehemu ya kumi.”
Ekegusii: ne rigena eri natenenia aa buna esiiro nigo rirabe enyomba yao, Nyasae. Na kende gionsi orang'e inche, amaene tinkomocha gokoa ensemo ya ikomi.”

English: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
Kiswahili: Andaa mahali pa kuwachinjia wanawe kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba zao, wasije wakainuka ili kuirithi nchi na kuijaza dunia kwa miji yao.
Ekegusii: Beka abanto ang'e, baite abamura b'omorwoti oyio; abana abwo nigo baraitwe ase engencho y'okomocha gwa chisokoro chiabo, tibaabaisa koimokerera igoro baire ense na koyeichoria nemechie.”

English: And I will hand these things over as plunder to foreigners and loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile them.
Kiswahili: Nitavitia vyote mikononi mwa wageni kuwa nyara na kuwa vitu vilivyotekwa mikononi mwa watu waovu wa dunia, nao watavinajisi.
Ekegusii: “Inche nindete abanto abaao basakore ebinto ebio, na abakori amabe b’ense mbabiegwe, babikore bibe ebitachenegeti.

English: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Utaipepeta, nao upepo utaichukua, dhoruba itaipeperushia mbali. Bali wewe utajifurahisha katika Bwana na katika utukufu wa yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Mobisiare, na omwaga obirurukie gochia aare, erio ekembugu‐mbugu kebisiarere. Inwe abanyene mogoke ase Omonene na komwetogeria oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli.

English: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu amenitegea sikio lake, nitamwita siku zote za maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Ere ontegereire onyiguure, ase ayio, ekero ’nde moyo nimbe ’nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.

English: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, na mkutano ukakusanyika kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete, na ekero omoganda bwonsi osangererekanete ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano,

English: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Kiswahili: Adui zangu wote wataaibika na kufadhaika, watarudi nyuma kwa aibu ya ghafula.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono kegima, mbairane gochia magega bwango bare nobosooku.

English: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
Kiswahili: juu sana kuliko falme zote na mamlaka, enzi na milki, na juu ya kila jina litajwalo, si katika ulimwengu huu tu, bali katika ule ujao pia.
Ekegusii: igoro mono kobua okogaamba gwonsi, na okobua, ne chinguru, na oborwoti, na igoro ya kera erieta rigwatorwa, tari ase ense eye yoka, korende neria egochia‐gocha boigo.

English: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache watoto washibe kwanza, kwa maana si vyema kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang'ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y'abana, gotugutera chisese.”

English: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akijifungua, mmoja akatoa mkono wake nje, kwa hiyo mkunga akachukua uzi mwekundu na kuufunga mkononi mwa yule mtoto, akasema, “Huyu ametoka kwanza.”
Ekegusii: Ekero areenge koibora, omwana oyomo agatang'ania okoboko isiko, na omoiboria akamosibera okoboko okwo eusi embariri, agateeba: “Oyo nere otanga gosoka isiko.”

English: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akasimama nyuma ya miguu ya Yesu akilia. Akailowanisha miguu yake kwa machozi yake, kisha akaifuta kwa nywele zake, akaibusu na kuimiminia manukato.
Ekegusii: agatenena korwa magega, ang'e namagoro aye, okorera. Agachaaka komoiyereria amariga aye ase amagoro aye, na koyatinyia netukia y'omotwe oye, okonyunyunta amagoro aye, na koyaaka amaguta aria.

English: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wa wale makerubi alikuwa na nyuso nne: Uso mmoja ulikuwa kama vile wa kerubi, uso wa pili ulikuwa wa mwanadamu, uso wa tatu ulikuwa wa simba na uso wa nne ulikuwa wa tai.
Ekegusii: Kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba nigo kebwate amasio ane; obosio bw’eritang’ani nigo bwarenge buna obw’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, na obwa kabere buna obwa Mwanyabaanto, na obwa gatato buna obw’endo, na obwa kane buna obw’ebiongo.

English: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
Kiswahili: Farasi wao ni wepesi kuliko chui, na wakali kuliko mbwa mwitu wakati wa machweo. Askari wapanda farasi wao huenda mbio; waendesha farasi wao wanatoka mbali. Wanaruka kasi kama tai ili kurarua;
Ekegusii: “Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikominyoka bwango kobua chingo, nigo chire chintindi kobua chisese chi’orosana chigotwara mogoroba; abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bagochararacharara. Ee, abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bakorwa aare, nigo bakoiruruka buna ekeongo kegochia kobwata eke gekoria.

English: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
Kiswahili: Wewe, hata hivyo utakwenda kwa baba zako kwa amani na kuzikwa katika uzee mwema.
Ekegusii: Korende aye nogende ase chisokoro chiao ase omorembe. Igo oratindekwe ase obogotu obuya.

English: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya kila juma, kila mmoja wenu atenge kiasi cha fedha, kulingana na mapato yake na fedha hizo aziweke akiba, ili nitakapokuja pasiwe na lazima ya kufanya mchango.
Ekegusii: Ase kera rituko rie ritang'ani ri'echuma, kera oyomo ase more abe okogaacha mwaye ensemo ase eki anyorire, koreng'ana buna aranyare, erinde ebiegwa tibisangererigwa ekero nachire.

English: So the king and Haman went to dine with Esther the queen,
Kiswahili: Basi mfalme na Hamani wakaenda kula chakula pamoja na Malkia Esta.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, omorwoti na Hamani bakagenda koria endagera amo n’Esiteri eting’ana.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh's hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Je, mkono wa Bwana ni mfupi sana? Sasa utaona kama jambo nililolisema litatimizwa kwa ajili yako au la.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Inee! Nigo orooche ng'a okoboko kwane nokweng'e? Bono norore gose amang'ana ane naikeranigwe ase ore, gose yaaya.”

English: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.' So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”
Kiswahili: Yeye aliomba, ‘Tafadhali niruhusu niokote na kukusanya miongoni mwa miganda nyuma ya wavunaji.' Naye ameshinda shambani tangu asubuhi pasipo kupumzika, isipokuwa kwa muda mfupi kivulini.”
Ekegusii: Nigo aboria ribaga ri'ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y'abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”

English: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikaona mbingu mpya na nchi mpya, kwa maana mbingu za kwanza na nchi ya kwanza vimekwisha kupita, wala hapakuwepo na bahari tena.
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora igoro aayia na ense enyia, naki igoro ye ritang'ani na ense ye ritang'ani biaetire, nonya nenyancha teri naende.

English: Then he crossed over against them first, and all the people after him; and all the Gentiles were defeated before his face, and threw away their weapons, and fled to the temple at Carnaim.
Kiswahili: Kisha akavuka dhidi yao kwanza, na watu wote wakamfuata; na Mataifa yote wakashindwa mbele yake, wakatupa silaha zao, wakakimbilia hekaluni huko Karnaimu.
Ekegusii: Erio ere akaba omonto bw'eritang'ani kwamboka orooche. Abanto baye bonsi bakamobwatia. Ababisa bagaitwa bobe erio bagatuguta ebirwanero biabo inse na gotama gochia Hekalu yarenge ase omochie o Karinaumu.

English: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na wana thelathini waliopanda punda thelathini. Nao walikuwa na miji thelathini iliyoko Gileadi, inayoitwa Hawoth-Yairi mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, baare koriina chitigere emerongo etato. Boigo bakaba bakogambera emechie emerongo etato agwo ase ense ya Gileadi. Emechie eyio nigo ekorokwa Hawoti‐Yairi (Emechie ya Yairi) nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yohanani mwana wa Karea akamwambia Gedalia kwa siri huko Mispa, “Acha niende nikamuue Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, wala hakuna atakayejua. Kwa nini akuue na kusababisha Wayahudi wote waliokuzunguka watawanyike, na mabaki wa Yuda waangamie?”
Ekegusii: Erio Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, agakwana na Gedalia bobisi agwo Misipa, akamoteebia, “Ing'a ribaga ngende ing'ite Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, na omonto onde tari oramanye amang'ana ayio. Nase ki ere aragoite, erinde Abayahudi bonsi bachire asore baserebekane, na abatigari b'Abayuda basire?”

English: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.
Kiswahili: katika mwaka wa kwanza wa utawala wake, mimi Danieli nilielewa kutokana na Maandiko, kulingana na neno la Bwana alilopewa nabii Yeremia, kwamba ukiwa wa Yerusalemu ungetimizwa kwa miaka sabini.
Ekegusii: ee, ase omwaka bw'eritang'ani bw'okogaamba kwaye, inche Danieli nkamanya korwa ase Amariiko Amachenu igoro y'omobaro bw'emiaka eria ring'ana ri'Omonene riatebeetie Yeremia omobani, ng'a emiaka emerongo etano na ebere nigo yarenge gocha koera, Yerusalemu ogendererete koba rituuri.

English: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?'
Kiswahili: “Lakini mzabibu ukaijibu, ‘Je, niache kutoa divai yangu inayofurahisha miungu na wanadamu ili nikawe juu ya miti?'
Ekegusii: Korende omosabibu okairaneria: Nigo 'ngotiga okorua edivai yane, eria ekogokia chinyasae na Mwanyabaanto, erinde 'ngambere emete ende?

English: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
Kiswahili: Waovu na waanguke kwenye nyavu zao wenyewe, wakati mimi ninapita salama.
Ekegusii: Tiga abakori amabe abwo bagwe ase ebichanga biabo abanyene, korende inche ’ntooreke.

English: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
Kiswahili: pamoja na koo za waandishi zilizoishi katika mji wa Yabesi: yaani Watirathi, Washimeathi na Wasukathi. Hawa ndio Wakeni waliotokana na Hamathi, baba wa nyumba ya Rekabu.
Ekegusii: amo ne chiamate chi'abariki baria bamenyete agwo Yabesi, nabwo Abatirati, na Abasimeati, na Abasukati. Aba nabwo Abakeni abarwete ase Hamati, ise abanto b'enyomba ya Rekabu.

English: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
Kiswahili: “Mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.
Ekegusii: “Orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki'Eema y'omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.

English: Yahweh's word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
Kiswahili: Hili ni neno la Bwana lililomjia nabii Yeremia kuhusu mataifa:
Ekegusii: Ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia omobani igoro y'ebisaku.

English: Yahweh's angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
Kiswahili: Yule malaika wa Bwana akaja tena mara ya pili, akamgusa akamwambia, “Inuka na ule, kwa kuwa safari ni ndefu kwako.”
Ekegusii: Naende omomalaika oria bw'Omonene agacha eria kabere, akamokuna, akamoteebia: “Imoka orie, ekiagera orogendo norotambe okogenda.”

English: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
Kiswahili: Pete hizo ziliwekwa karibu na ukingo ule ili kuishikilia ile mipiko iliyotumika kuibebea hiyo meza.
Ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chikabekwa ang’e norosingo, na emiaro eria egasoigwa imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

English: It will be manifest to all nations and kings that they are no gods, but the works of men's hands, and that there is no work of God in them.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa dhahiri kwa mataifa yote na wafalme kwamba wao si miungu, bali ni kazi za mikono ya wanadamu, na kwamba hakuna kazi ya Mungu ndani yao.
Ekegusii: n'onde bwensi naganeirie komanya buna emegwekano eye teri nyasae.

English: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakakimbia mbele ya Yuda, naye Mungu akawatia Israeli mikononi mwao.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abayuda, na Nyasae akababeeka ase amaboko 'Abayuda.

English: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu wakati wote wa maisha ya Abiya.
Ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu ase obogima bwonsi bwa Rehoboamu.

English: Her husband is known at the city gate, where he sits among the elders of the land.
Kiswahili: Mume wake anaheshimiwa kwenye lango la mji, aketipo miongoni mwa wazee wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Omosacha bw’omokuungu oyio nigo amanyekanete ase ebiita bi’omochie, agwo ase agoikaransa ogaamba ebiina amo nabagaaka b’ense eyio.

English: They took their stand against King Uzziah and said, “Uzziah, you have no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully; you will not receive honor from the LORD God.”
Kiswahili: Wakamkabili na kumwambia, “Siyo sawa kwako, Uzia, kumfukizia Bwana uvumba. Hiyo ni kazi ya makuhani, wazao wa Aroni, ambao wamewekwa wakfu ili kufukiza uvumba. Ondoka mahali patakatifu, kwa kuwa umekosa uaminifu nawe hutaheshimiwa na Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagakania Usia omorwoti, bakamoteebia, “Usia, aye tochikiri gosamba ubani ase Omonene, korende abakuani ab’ororeria rwa Aroni nabwo baatananetwe gosamba ubani. Aye soka korwa aiga Aase Aachenu, kwamochire. Omonene Nyasae tagokoa ogosikwa ekiagera gwakorire ayio.”

English: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.’
Kiswahili: Basi wazee wetu na wale wote wanaoishi katika nchi yetu walituambia, ‘Chukueni chakula cha safari; nendeni mkakutane na watu hao na kuwaambia, “Sisi tu watumishi wenu, fanyeni mapatano nasi.” ’
Ekegusii: Abagaaka baito, na abanyene bonsi b’ense yaito, bagatoteebia ng’a tobogorie endagera togochia koria inchera, na kogenda koumerana nainwe, na kobateebia ng’a ntorigetie koba abasomba baino, naende tobaborie mokore okobwatana naintwe.

English: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the desire of the faithless is violence.
Kiswahili: Kutoka tunda la midomo yake mtu hufurahia mambo mema, bali wasio waaminifu wanatamani sana jeuri.
Ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya, korende okogania kw’abatari abegenwa nigo gokorigia obotindi.

English: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh's commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ya Israeli ikaondoka kutoka Jangwa la Sini, ikisafiri kutoka sehemu moja hadi nyingine kama Bwana alivyoagiza. Wakapiga kambi huko Refidimu, lakini hapakuwa na maji ya watu kunywa.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli okaimoka korwa erooro ya Sinai. Barabwo bakabwatia orogendo rwabo, bakana‐gotoora buna Omonene abachiigete, Bagaika Refidimu, bagatoora aroro, korende mache tarengeo abanto baare konyara konywa.

English: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo Bwana alikuwa na shauku na baba zako, akawapenda na akawachagua ninyi, wazao wao, kuliko mataifa yote, kama ilivyo leo.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo ang'usegete ne'chisokoro chiaino na gochiancha, na magega yabo akabachoora inwe, ororeeria rwabo, ase egati y'ebisaku binde. Naboigo more abaaye goika reero iga.

English: by which they passed over with all their army, these who were covered with your hand, having seen strange marvels.
Kiswahili: ambayo walivuka na jeshi lao lote, hawa ambao walikuwa wamefunikwa na mkono wako, wameona maajabu ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bao bagatamboka bakoragwa n'okoboko kwao magega kobarorire ebikone ebio kwabakorerete.

English: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maombi yangu: kwamba upendo wenu uongezeke zaidi na zaidi katika maarifa na ufahamu wote,
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosaba kwane, ng’a obwanchani bwaino bomenteke, bobe obonge mono ase okomanya kw’ogwatanana gwonsi,

English: And after striking them with many blows, they threw them into prison and ordered the jailer to guard them securely.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwachapa sana, wakawatupa gerezani na kumwagiza mkuu wa gereza awalinde kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Kobabaakire amaakwa amange, bakabaruta echela ime, bagachiika omorendi bw’echela abarende mono.

English: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi wapeni chakula.” Nao wakajibu, “Hatuna zaidi ya mikate mitano na samaki wawili. Labda twende tukanunue chakula cha kuwatosha watu hawa wote.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakaboora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”

English: They set up kings, but not by Me. They make princes, but without My approval. With their silver and gold they make themselves idols, to their own destruction.
Kiswahili: Wanaweka wafalme bila idhini yangu, wamechagua wakuu bila kibali changu. Kwa fedha zao na dhahabu wamejitengenezea sanamu kwa ajili ya maangamizi yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Abaisraeli bebeekeire abarwoti, batamboreti, bebeekeire abagaambi abwo ntamanyeti, na korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu chiabo beroiseirie emegwekano bagosasiima; ayio nigo arabarentere ogosirigwa.

English: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
Kiswahili: Wanachonilipa badala ya urafiki wangu ni kunishtaki, lakini mimi ninawaombea.
Ekegusii: Nonya inche ’mbanchete, barabwo nigo bangeechete, ee, nonya ngendererete kobasabera ebisio.

English: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Njooni, nanyi mtapaona!” Hivyo wakaenda na kupaona mahali alipokuwa anaishi, wakakaa naye siku ile, kwa kuwa ilikuwa yapata saa kumi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo morore.” Bagaacha, bakarora aase amenyete, bakaba nere rituko riria; nigo chiarenge ang'e chinsa ikomi.

English: Better is he who labors and abounds in all things, than he who boasts and lacks bread.
Kiswahili: Afadhali afanyaye kazi na kuzidi katika mambo yote, kuliko ajisifuye na kupungukiwa na mkate.
Ekegusii: Nigo are buya oyore n'omokia ase emeremo, oyio nigo abwate kera eki aganetie, kobua omonto okona goetaanana erio ochaka kweng'ereria ase abande ng'a tari n'endagera.

English: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro na Yohana wakaweka mikono yao juu ya wale waliobatizwa, nao wakapokea Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Erio Petero na Yohana bakababeekera amaboko abo, na barabwo bakanyora Omoika Omochenu.

English: A lying witness will perish, but the man who listens to truth will speak forever.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa uongo ataangamia, bali maneno ya mwenye kusikia yatadumu.
Ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo nasire, korende omotegereri omuya nageenderere gokwana.

English: We can't reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
Kiswahili: Yeye Mwenyezi hatuwezi kumfikia, naye ametukuzwa katika uweza; katika hukumu zake na haki yake kuu, hataonea.
Ekegusii: Oyio Omobui, intwe titokonyara komoorora buna are; nigo abwate okobua okonene, naende nigo are omonyene ekeene, ere nigo are omonyene oboronge mono, takorega onde.

English: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their scheme and that God had frustrated it, each of us returned to his own work on the wall.
Kiswahili: Adui zetu waliposikia kwamba tumetambua hila yao, na kwamba Mungu amevuruga shauri lao, sote tulirudi kwenye ukuta, kila mmoja kwenye kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baito baigwete ng’a twamanyire emeroberio yabo, naende ng’a Nyasae oyesaririe, tokairana twensi ase okoagacha, na kera omonto agakora emeremo aetwe gokora.

English: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo alivyoagiza Bwana: ‘Chukueni pishi ya mana na kuhifadhi kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo ili vione mikate niliyowapa mle jangwani nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri.’ ”
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Omonene otochikiire togache endagera eye inke ya Mana ase engencho ye chinderia chiaito, erinde banyare gocha korora endagera eye Omonene atoete torie ase erooro, ekero atorusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: to transfer the kingdom from Saul's house, and to set up David's throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”
Kiswahili: na kuuhamisha ufalme kutoka kwenye nyumba ya Sauli na kuimarisha kiti cha ufalme cha Daudi juu ya Israeli na Yuda kuanzia Dani mpaka Beer-Sheba.”
Ekegusii: Arusie oborwoti korwa ase enyomba ya Saulo, abobeeke ase Daudi, na Daudi abe omorwoti, agaambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.”

English: Now the cistern into which Ishmael had thrown all the bodies of the men he had struck down along with Gedaliah was a large one that King Asa had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.
Kiswahili: Basi kile kisima ambacho alitupa zile maiti za watu aliowaua pamoja na Gedalia kilikuwa ni kile kisima ambacho Mfalme Asa alikifanya sehemu ya ulinzi wake dhidi ya Baasha mfalme wa Israeli. Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akakijaza kisima hicho kwa maiti.
Ekegusii: Engoro eria ase Isumaeli atugutete emebere yonsi y’abanto baria aitete, nigo yarenge eria Asa omorwoti akunyete gotanga Baasa, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, tarwania omochie; korende bono Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, akayeichoria nemebere y’abanto baitetwe.

English: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile nitaisimamisha hema ya Daudi iliyoanguka. Nitakarabati mahali palipobomoka na kujenga upya magofu yake, na kuijenga kama ilivyokuwa awali,
Ekegusii: “Rituko ngochicha rire ekero ndatenenie esaiga eria ya Daudi yagwete, ning'agache naende aase agwo atagogete, ngororokie amatombe aye; ninyeagache naende, ebe buna yarenge agwo kare.

English: Moreover I have sent Menelaus also, that he may encourage you.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo nimemtuma Menelao pia, ili awatie moyo.
Ekegusii: Natomire Menelao kobabeeka chinguru.

English: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
Kiswahili: Basi Hanuni akawakamata watu wa Daudi, akawanyoa kila mmoja ndevu zake nusu, akakata mavazi yao nyuma katikati kwenye matako, akawaacha waende zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba abwo ba Daudi, akagingira chinderu chiabo ensemo eyemo, na akanacha chianga chiabo agachiikia ebinema, akabaseria bagende.

English: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
Kiswahili: Waraka wa Paulo na Timotheo, watumishi wa Kristo Yesu: Kwa watakatifu wote katika Kristo Yesu walioko Filipi, pamoja na waangalizi na mashemasi:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase inche Paulo na Timotheo, abasomba ba Kristo Yeso, gochia ase abanto bonsi ba Nyasae abamomenyete Filipi aba mwabwatanigwe na Kristo Yeso, amo nabatang’ani na abakoonyi ase ekanisa.

English: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini afadhali mshike njia kuwaendea kondoo wa nyumba ya Israeli waliopotea.
Ekegusii: korende mbuya mochiere ching'ondi chinsiru chi'enyomba ya Israeli.

English: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God's Kingdom has come upon you.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa Roho wa Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umekuja juu yenu.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Omoika o Nyasae, igo oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.

English: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn't I see you in the garden with him?”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa watumishi wa kuhani mkuu, ndugu yake yule mtu ambaye Petro alikuwa amemkata sikio, akamuuliza, “Je, mimi sikukuona kule bustanini ukiwa na Yesu?”
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw'abasomba b'Omokuani Omonene, omoamate bw'oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakorooche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”

English: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Kiswahili: Mwili na moyo wangu vyaweza kushindwa, bali Mungu ni nguvu ya moyo wangu na fungu langu milele.
Ekegusii: Omobere one na enkoro yane nabo biranyare koborwa chinguru, korende aye Nyasae, naye ore egetare gi’enkoro yane, naende naye egetare kiane goika kare na kare.

English: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,
Kiswahili: Mose akaiambia jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli, “Hili ndilo Bwana aliloamuru:
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli, “Aya nar'Omonene achiikire:

English: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
Kiswahili: Serugi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Nahori.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Serugi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30) akaibora Nahori.

English: The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass. He fashions it in the likeness of man, like man in all his glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.
Kiswahili: Seremala hupima kwa kutumia kamba na huuchora mstari kwa kalamu; huchonga kwa patasi na kutia alama kwa bikari. Huifanyiza katika umbo la binadamu, la mwanadamu katika utukufu wake wote, ili iweze kukaa katika sehemu yake ya ibada ya miungu.
Ekegusii: Omosenia chibao nigo akorambora ekerengo, bwata omong’ororia nekaramu ase ebao. Erio oyesenia neranda, oyeng’ororia ekeringerera, naende oyebaacha yaba omogwekano bw’omonto omonyakieni, oyobeeka nyomba ime.

English: Therefore he assured him by an oath that the nations would be blessed through his offspring, that he would multiply him like the dust of the earth, exalt his offspring like the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates River to the utmost parts of the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akamhakikishia kwa kiapo kwamba mataifa yatabarikiwa kupitia uzao wake, kwamba atamzidisha kama mavumbi ya dunia, na kuwainua wazao wake kama nyota, na kuwarithi kutoka bahari hadi bahari, na kutoka Mto Frati hadi miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamoriera chiira ogoteeba buna ebisaku bionsi inabisesenigwe goetera ase oroiboro rwaye; buna oroiboro rwaye inarobe nobonge buna oyo orotu rwense. Buna inababe abange buna ching'enang'eni na omwando obo buna orwaro oromo rwe enyaancha goika oronde, gochaakera ase orooche rw'Eufarati goika chinsinyo chi'ense.

English: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, angalia kwa macho yako na usikie kwa masikio yako nawe uzingatie kitu nitakachokuonyesha, kwa kuwa ndiyo sababu umeletwa hapa. Iambie nyumba ya Israeli kila kitu utakachoona.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, rigereria orore namaiso ao, na otegerere oigwe namato ao, naende orengererie mono igoro y'aya onsi ngochia gokworokia, ekiagera aye nigo kwarentirwe aase aiga, erinde nkworokie amang'ana ayio. Amang'ana ayio onsi orarore, oyateebie Abaisraeli.”

English: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don't know where they have laid him.”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza Maria, “Mwanamke, mbona unalia?” Akawaambia, “Nalia kwa kuwa wamemchukua Bwana wangu na sijui walikomweka.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria, “Omokungu, inki okorera?” Akabairaneria, “Nekiagera barusirie Omonene one, na timanyeti aase bamobeka.”

English: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
Kiswahili: Watu wote walipoona hivyo, wakaanza kunungʼunika wakisema, “Amekwenda kuwa mgeni wa ‘mtu mwenye dhambi.' ”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachia korora aya, bakemurungania bonsi, bakobora, “Osoire koba omogeni bw'omonyene ebibe.”

English: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
Kiswahili: Ukayachukua mavazi yako niliyokupa yaliyotariziwa na ukazivalisha hizo sanamu, ukatoa mbele ya hizo sanamu mafuta yangu na uvumba wangu.
Ekegusii: Naende okaira chianga chiao chiare n'ebieni ao ao, ogatuba emegwekano eria, na okabeka amaguta ane na ubani y'ane ase amasio abo.

English: In the four corners of the outer court there were enclosed courts, each forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide. Each of the four corner areas had the same dimensions.
Kiswahili: Katika pembe nne za huo ukumbi wa nje kulikuwa na kumbi nyingine, zenye urefu wa dhiraa arobaini na upana wake dhiraa thelathini, ambapo hizo kumbi kwenye hizo pembe nne zilikuwa na vipimo vilivyo sawa.
Ekegusii: Ebiooreri ebio bine biare ase chikoona chi’eraaro nigo biagiteire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ene, na obogare amaboko emerongo etato, bionsi nigo biareng’aine.

English: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
Kiswahili: Nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Mungu atawaleta hukumuni wote wawili wenye haki na waovu, kwa maana kutakuwako na wakati kwa ajili ya kila jambo, wakati kwa ajili ya kila tendo.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba ase enkoro yane ime ng'a Nyasae nanachere abanyaboronge ekiina, na abanyabibe boigo, ekiagera obeekire engaki ase kera ring'ana, na ase kera emeremo.

English: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
Kiswahili: (kwa sababu yale matendo mapotovu aliyoyaona na kuyasikia huyo mtu mwenye haki alipoishi miongoni mwao yalimhuzunisha siku baada ya siku):
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo omonyene oboronge, oyomenyete ase egati yabo, nigo arenge gwechanda ase omoyo oye omooronge rituko ase rituko ase aya onsi arenge korora na koigwa ase ogokora kwabo kw’ogosaria amachiiko.

English: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
Kiswahili: Pia ninyi mmeona na kusikia jinsi ambavyo si huku Efeso peke yake lakini ni karibu Asia yote, huyu Paulo amewashawishi na kuvuta idadi kubwa ya watu kwa kusema kuwa miungu iliyotengenezwa na watu si miungu.
Ekegusii: Naende mwarorire na koigwa ng'a Paulo, oyio oebereirie abanto na kobaonchora, tari ase Efeso oka, korende nonya nase Asia yonsi pi, okobateebia ng'a chinyasae chigokorwa namaboko tari chirochio chinyasae.

English: To Machir I gave Gilead,
Kiswahili: Nikampa Makiri nchi ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: “Nkaa abanto b’eamate ya Makiri, orogongo rwa Gileadi,

English: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atachukua kuni za mti wa mwerezi, hisopo na sufu nyekundu, na kuvitupa kwenye huyo mtamba anayeungua.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani abogorie oroko rw'emecharake na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi embariri, erio abirute as'omorero oria ogosamba eng'ombe eria.

English: When a man presents a peace offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without blemish or defect to be acceptable.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote aletapo sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana kutoka kundi la ngʼombe au mbuzi ili kutimiza nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya hiari, lazima sadaka hiyo isiwe na dosari au waa ili ikubalike.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase ’nde, ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, goika ebe eng’iti eng’ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.

English: After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nyingi kupita, Wayahudi wakafanya shauri kumuua Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko amange aetire, Abayahudi bakamogamba, erinde banyare komoita,

English: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
Kiswahili: Miklothi akamzaa Shimeamu. Wao pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Mikiloti nere orenge ise Simeamu. Aba boigo nigo bamenyete bakabebekana nabamwabo agwo Yerusalemu.

English: If a man encounters a virgin who is not pledged in marriage, and he seizes her and lies with her, and they are discovered,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa itatokea mwanaume akutane na bikira ambaye hajaposwa na kumbaka nao wakakutwa,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaumerane n’omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, na komobwata ne chinguru, abe nere, nabarabwo babere banyorwe,

English: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye haendi katika shauri la watu waovu, wala hasimami katika njia ya wenye dhambi, au kuketi katika baraza la wenye mizaha.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto otari gotunyana chingencho chi’abakori amabe, n’otari kobwatia chinchera chi’abanyabibe, gose otari gosanga amo nabwo bagochecheria.

English: “The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! He knows, and may Israel also know. If this was in rebellion or breach of faith against the LORD, do not spare us today.
Kiswahili: “Yeye Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana! Yeye Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana! Yeye anajua! Israeli na wajue! Kama huu umekuwa ni uasi au kukosa utii kwa Bwana, msituache hai siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: “Omobui nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene! Omobui nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene. Ere namanyete aya twakorire, nainwe Abaisraeli boigo moyamanye. Onye aya twakorire akorirwe mamincha y’Omonene, gose onye titwarenge nobwegenwa asare, rirorio timogototooria reero.

English: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
Kiswahili: Kama vile ayala aoneavyo shauku vijito vya maji, ndivyo nafsi yangu ikuoneavyo shauku, Ee Mungu.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana engabi ekogania amaache a rooche, naboigo omoyo one okoganetie aye Nyasae.

English: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
Kiswahili: Lakini ili kuepuka zinaa, kila mwanaume na awe na mke wake mwenyewe na kila mwanamke awe na mume wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y'amateemwa ay'ogokora obotomani kera omosacha abe na mokaye omonyene, na kera omokungu abe nomosaacha oye omonyene.

English: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtumishi wa Mungu na mtume wa Yesu Kristo kwa ajili ya imani ya wateule wa Mungu na kuijua kweli iletayo utauwa:
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo nomosomba o Nyasae, na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo. Inche nigo narangeretigwe naboigo gotomwa ogokonya okwegena kw'abachoore ba Nyasae, erinde baike ase ayare ay'ekeene, ayio akworokererigwa ase okwegena gwaito,

English: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.
Kiswahili: Kama vile vidole vyake vya miguu vilikuwa kwa sehemu chuma na sehemu udongo wa mfinyanzi, hivyo ufalme huo kwa sehemu utakuwa na nguvu na kwa sehemu udhaifu.
Ekegusii: Na buna ebiara bi'amagoro biarenge ekeng'ese ki'ebioma na ekeng'ese ki'amaroba, naboigo oborwoti boria borabe obokong'u ensemo eyemo, na ensemo ende obworo.

English: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
Kiswahili: Hapo wakampa Yesu divai iliyochanganywa na nyongo ili anywe; lakini alipoionja, akakataa kuinywa.
Ekegusii: bakamoa edivai esang’anirie egento ekeroro, anywe; Agachia koyeigwa, tancha konywa.

English: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife's voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,' the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
Kiswahili: Kwa Adamu akasema, “Kwa sababu umemsikiliza mke wako na ukala kutoka kwenye mti niliokuamuru, ‘Msile tunda lake,' “Ardhi imelaaniwa kwa sababu yako, kwa kazi ngumu utakula chakula kitokacho humo siku zote za maisha yako.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Omosacha oria, “Ekiagera kwaigwerete mokao na okaria amatunda 'omote oria nagokanetie ng'a toria, riroba riaragererigwe ase engencho yao. Ase ogwechanda kwao norie okwama kwaeriroba amatuko onsi ay'obogima bwao.

English: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.
Kiswahili: “Nitairudisha ile miji ambayo baba yangu aliiteka kutoka kwa baba yako. Unaweza kuweka maeneo yako ya soko katika Dameski, kama baba yangu alivyofanya huko Samaria.” Ahabu akasema, “Katika misingi ya mkataba, nitakuachilia huru.” Kwa hiyo akaweka mkataba naye, akamruhusu aende zake.
Ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi akamoteebia: “Emechie tata airete korwa ase iso ninkoyeiranerie; naye bweroiserie chinchera chi'oboonchoreria agwo Damesiki, buna tata akorete agwo Samaria.” Ahabu akamoiraneria: “Ase amang'ana ayio ningotige ogende.” Erio Ahabu agakora okobwatana kw'ogotianania nere, akamotiga agende.

English: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atakutana kimwili na mke wa mwanawe, lazima wote wawili wauawe. Walichokifanya ni upotovu; damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto okoraara na moka momura oye, abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe; bakorire okogechia. Okomocha kw'ogoiteka kw'amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.

English: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi ni mashahidi wangu,” asema Bwana, “na mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, ili mpate kunijua na kuniamini, na kutambua kwamba Mimi ndiye. Kabla yangu hakuna mungu aliyefanyizwa, wala hatakuwepo mwingine baada yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe nigo more birori baane, abasomba baane nachorire, erinde monyare komanya inche na konyegena, naende momanye ng'a inche ninche Ere. Enyasae ende teri yantang'anerete, ende teri erabombwe magega yane.

English: But if he doesn't wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.'”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hakufua nguo zake na kuoga, atakuwa na hatia kwa kosa hilo.' ”
Ekegusii: Korende onye tagosibia chianga chiaye na gwesibia omobere, rirorio nabogorie obobe bwaye.”

English: Again the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “What do you see?” “I see a boiling pot,” I replied, “and it is tilting toward us from the north.”
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia tena, “Unaona nini?” Nikajibu, “Naona chungu kinachochemka, kikiwa kimeinama kutoka kaskazini.”
Ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde eria kabere, rikamboria: “Ngento ki orooche?” Nkairaneria, “Nigo ndonche enyongo egotogota; omonwa oye nigo orochie gocha aa korwa sugusu.”

English: They took possession of the strong cities in the land of Egypt, and he took the spoils of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Walimiliki miji yenye ngome katika nchi ya Misri, naye akachukua nyara za Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio Antioko akanyara koyeira ense yonsi n'emechie yagiteire chinyasi ekabwatwa n'ense ya Misiri.

English: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Kiswahili: Je, mimi hula nyama ya mafahali au kunywa damu ya mbuzi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inche ne chinyama chie chieri nkoria? Gose namanyinga e chimbori nkonywa?

English: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika aliyezungumza nami akarudi na kuniamsha, kama mtu aamshwavyo kutoka usingizi wake.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche ritang'ani agacha naende, agantura buna omonto oraire agoturwa korwa ase chitoro.

English: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, haya yote yatakuja juu ya kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie ng'a amang'ana aya onsi naache igoro ase ekegori eke.

English: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
Kiswahili: Wakati Balaki mwana wa Sipori, mfalme wa Moabu, alipojiandaa kupigana dhidi ya Israeli, alimwita Balaamu mwana wa Beori apate kuwalaani.
Ekegusii: Erio Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, mosinto o Sipori, akaimoka kobarwania inwe Abaisraeli. Akarangeria Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, achiche kobaragereria,

English: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akaona kuwa mbele yake na nyuma yake kumepangwa vita; kwa hiyo akachagua baadhi ya vikosi vilivyo bora sana katika Israeli akavipanga dhidi ya Waaramu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu arooche ng'a esegi nigo ere bosio bwaye na magega, agachoora abanto abakong'u abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n'Abasiiria.

English: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unauficha uso wako na kusahau taabu na mateso yetu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase tore? Nase ki aye kwebire emechando yaito na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito?

English: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa hawakupata sababu yoyote ya kumhukumu kifo, walimwomba Pilato aamuru auawe.
Ekegusii: Nonya tibanyorete engencho y’okomoita, bagasaba Pilato aitwe.

English: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.'”
Kiswahili: bali ulirudi na ukala mkate na kunywa maji mahali ambapo alikuambia usile wala usinywe. Kwa hiyo maiti yako haitazikwa katika kaburi la baba zako.' ”
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri'ayio kwairanire, naende kwarire endagera na kwanyure amaache aase aiga. Ay'Omonene agokanetie ng'a tokora igo. Ekiagera gwakorire igo, omobere oo gokwete tokonyara kobekwa ase chimbeera chie chisokoro chiao.”

English: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
Kiswahili: Nitakuja hekaluni mwako na sadaka za kuteketezwa na kukutimizia nadhiri zangu:
Ekegusii: Ninchiche ase enyomba yao, indetane ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Ning’ikeranie chiira nakorierete ase ogotiana,

English: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kusema haya, alitazama kuelekea mbinguni akawaombea na kusema: “Baba, saa imewadia. Umtukuze Mwanao, ili Mwanao apate kukutukuza wewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akwanete amang’ana ayio akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Tata, ensa yaikire. Mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye,

English: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kufanya hivi kwa siku nyingi, lakini Paulo akiwa ameudhika sana, akageuka na kumwambia yule pepo mchafu, “Ninakuamuru katika jina la Yesu Kristo, umtoke!” Yule pepo mchafu akamtoka saa ile ile.
Ekegusii: Akana‐gokora ayio amatuko amange. Korende Paulo agakoona, akeonchora, agateebia ekerecha keria: “Nagochikiire ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Karue ase omoiseke oyo!” Gekamorua ensa eria eria.

English: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don't let me be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Nimengʼangʼania sheria zako, Ee Bwana, usiniache niaibishwe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nabwatereire oborori bwao, tobaisa gontiga 'nsookigwe.

English: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
Kiswahili: Vunja mkono wa mtu mwovu na mbaya, mwite atoe hesabu ya maovu yake ambayo yasingejulikana.
Ekegusii: Saria chinguru chi'abakori amabe na abanyabibe, obae egesusuro ase amabe onsi bagokora goika toyarora naende.

English: all the cities of the plateau, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og.
Kiswahili: Tuliteka miji yote kwenye uwanda wa juu, Gileadi yote, Bashani yote mpaka kufika Saleka na Edrei, miji ya utawala wa Ogu huko Bashani.
Ekegusii: Tokaira orogongo rwonsi orwo rwarenge inse y’omorwoti Ogi o Basani: emechie yonsi yarenge ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro na Gileadi yonsi, na Basani yonsi, goikera Saleka na Edirei.”

English: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
Kiswahili: Lakini nyumba ya Israeli haitakusikiliza kwa kuwa hawako radhi kunisikiliza mimi, kwa kuwa nyumba yote ya Israeli ni wenye vipaji vya nyuso vigumu na mioyo ya ukaidi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibagokoigwera aye, ekiagera tibari konyigwera inche; Abaisraeli bonsi banyiririe amasio abo, ne chinkoro chiabo boigo.

English: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;
Kiswahili: Yefta akarudisha wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Waamoni,
Ekegusii: Naende Yefta agatoma abanto eria kabere ase omorwoti bw'Abaamoni,

English: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
Kiswahili: Wakatuma wanafunzi wao kwake pamoja na Maherode. Nao wakasema, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu na unafundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli bila kuyumbishwa na mtu wala kuonyesha upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma aborokigwa babo ase are, amo n’Abaherode, bakaboora, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, na enchera ya Nyasae nigo okoyiorokereria ase ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto; ekiagera torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto.

English: The foundation was built by him to the height of the double walls, the lofty retaining walls of the temple enclosure.
Kiswahili: Msingi ulijengwa naye hadi urefu wa kuta mbili, kuta ndefu za kushikilia za ua wa hekalu.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka chinyasi ibere chi'orobago rwe Hekalu.

English: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
Kiswahili: “Ni ninyi tu niliowachagua kati ya jamaa zote za dunia; kwa hiyo nitawaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu zote.”
Ekegusii: “Ninwe mweka namanyete na korenda ase chiamate chionsi chi’ense. Ase ayio nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino bionsi.” Emeremo y’omobani

English: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ even though I have not spoken?
Kiswahili: Je, hamjaona maono ya uongo na kusema ubashiri wa udanganyifu hapo msemapo, “ Bwana asema,” lakini Mimi sijasema?
Ekegusii: Inee! Tari amaroro y’obong’ainereria barorire, naende nigo bakoringoria oboringoria bw’oborimo, ekero bagokwana ng’a Omonene oteebire bo, na inche Omonene tinkwaneti ayio?

English: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.'
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nilikuambia mambo haya tangu zamani, kabla hayajatokea nilikutangazia ili usije ukasema, ‘Sanamu zangu zilifanya hayo; kinyago changu cha mti na mungu wangu wa chuma aliyaamuru.'
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inabaraareretie amang'ana ayio kare konya ataraba, ekero konya ataraikerana nkabayateebia; nigo nakorete bo, erinde timobaisa gocha goteeba: Emegwekano yaito togosasiima, eyebaachire, gose eyebombire, nero yarenta ayio.

English: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
Kiswahili: Hawanywi tena mvinyo pamoja na wimbo, kileo ni kichungu kwa wanywaji wake.
Ekegusii: Bono abanto tibagenderereti goteera ekero bakonywa edivai; ebinyugwa bigotindia biabeire ebiroro ase abwo bakobinywa.

English: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Basi Mfalme wa milele, asiye na mwisho, asiyeonekana, aliye Mungu pekee, apewe heshima na utukufu milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Ase Omorwoti o kare na kare, oyotakonyorekana nogosareka, oyotakororekana, nere Nyasae bweka, ase are ere ogosika na obonene kare na kare. Amina.

English: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”'
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wao kula nyama ya wana wao na binti zao; kila mmoja atakula nyama ya mwenzake wakati wa dhiki ya kuzungukwa na jeshi lililowekwa juu yao na adui wanaotafuta uhai wao.'
Ekegusii: Nintige abanto barie emebere y'abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, ee, kera omonto narie omobere bw'omogisangio oye ase engaki eyio y'emechando eria ababisa babo na abanto baria bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo baraarente ase bare.”

English: They thirsted, and they called upon you, and water was given to them out of the flinty rock, and healing of their thirst out of the hard stone.
Kiswahili: Waliona kiu, wakakuita, wakapewa maji kutoka kwenye mwamba mgumu, na kuponywa kiu yao kutoka kwenye jiwe gumu.
Ekegusii: Ekero erang'o yabariete nigo bakoreerete, aye okobaa amache korwa ase egetare bakanywa erango yabo egasira.

English: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; for all this time I have been praying out of the depth of my anguish and grief.”
Kiswahili: Usimdhanie mtumishi wako kuwa mwanamke mwovu; nimekuwa nikiomba hapa katika wingi wa uchungu mkuu na huzuni.”
Ekegusii: Tokaga ng’a inche, omosomba oo, nomokuungu otagwenereti, inaki ase engaki eye yonsi nabeire ngokwana ase engencho y’emechando yane na ogoichana kwane.”

English: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.'
Kiswahili: Nami nikakumbuka neno la Bwana alivyosema, ‘Yohana alibatiza kwa maji, lakini ninyi mtabatizwa katika Roho Mtakatifu.'
Ekegusii: Nkainyora ring'ana riria ri'Omonene, buna ateebete: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amaache, korende inwe inamobatiswe ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: Some were saying, “We and our sons and daughters are numerous. We must get grain in order to eat and stay alive.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao walikuwa wakisema, “Sisi na wana wetu na binti zetu tuko wengi. Ili tuweze kula na kuishi, ni lazima tupate nafaka.”
Ekegusii: Abande bagateeba, “Intwe amo nabana baito, abamura na abaiseke, nigo tore abange, ntoganetie tonyore endagera torie, erinde togenderere koba moyo.”

English: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko Elisha akakwea kwenda Betheli. Ikawa alipokuwa akitembea barabarani, baadhi ya vijana wakatoka mjini na kumfanyia mzaha. Wakasema, “Paa, wewe mwenye upaa! Paa, wewe mwenye upaa!”
Ekegusii: Elisha akarua, akagenda Beteli. Na ekero arenge ase orogendo rwaye, abana abamura abake bakarua ase omochie, bakamosekereria, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Tiira gocha aa, aye nyaisio! Tiira gocha aa, aye nyaisio!”

English: This will be the punishment of Egypt and of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
Kiswahili: Hii itakuwa adhabu ya Misri na adhabu ya mataifa yote yale ambayo hayatakwenda Yerusalemu kuadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
Ekegusii: Ekio nakio kerabe egesusuro ase Abamisiri na ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo baraange gotiira gochia korenda Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.

English: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
Kiswahili: bali kwa damu ya thamani ya Kristo, yule Mwana-Kondoo asiye na dosari wala doa.
Ekegusii: korende ase amanyinga e rigori rinene, buna ay'emanwa y'eng'ondi etari na komocha, gose na kemoa, engencho yaye amanyinga a Kristo.

English: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
Kiswahili: “Wafu wako katika maumivu makuu, wale walio chini ya maji na wale waishio ndani yake.
Ekegusii: “Emeika y'abanto bakwete nigo ekoiguswa; boigo namaache na ebimenyete imeo.

English: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn't this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite's wife?”
Kiswahili: naye Daudi akatuma mtu mmoja kuuliza habari za huyo mwanamke. Huyo mtu akamwambia Daudi, “Je, huyu si Bathsheba binti Eliamu, naye ni mke wa Uria, Mhiti?”
Ekegusii: Erio agatoma omonto amanye ng'a omokungu oyo noyong'o. Agateebigwa ng'a, “Oria Batiseba nomosubati bw'Eliamu, moka Uria Omohiti.”

English: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
Kiswahili: Namtuma kwako, yeye aliye moyo wangu hasa.
Ekegusii: Ere namotomire gocha ase ore, na nigo enga buna nigo abogoretie enkoro yane.

English: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi kila mmoja wetu atatoa habari zake mwenyewe kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto ore ase egati yaito naache gwekwanera ere omonyene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: “Isn't my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
Kiswahili: “Je, neno langu si kama moto,” asema Bwana, “na kama nyundo ivunjayo mwamba vipande vipande?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ring'ana riane tiriri buna omorero, naende buna enyundo egwatia ebitare? Nab'Omonene atebiire.

English: Man doesn't know its price, and it isn't found in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu hatambui thamani yake; haiwezi kupatikana katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto tamanyeti rigori ri'obong'aini; borobwo tibori konyorekana ase ense emenyire nabare moyo.

English: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
Kiswahili: Kifuko hicho kilikuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, nacho kilikunjwa mara mbili.
Ekegusii: Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng'aine.

English: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, tega kitendawili, ukawaambie nyumba ya Israeli fumbo.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwana omobayeeno, oteebie Abaisraeli omoreng'anio.

English: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
Kiswahili: Nikauliza, “Hawa wanakuja kufanya nini?” Akanijibu, “Hizi ndizo pembe zilizowatawanya Yuda ili asiwepo atakayeweza kuinua kichwa chake, lakini mafundi wamekuja kuzitia hofu na kuzitupa chini hizi pembe za mataifa ambayo yaliinua pembe zao dhidi ya nchi ya Yuda na kuwatawanya watu wake.”
Ekegusii: Naende nkaboria, “Abanto aba, ninki bacha gokora aa?” Ere akairaneria, aganteebia, “Ching'unchara chiria chiasiarerete Abayuda gochia aaria na aaria, goika monto onde tanyarete koimokia omotwe oye igoro. Bono abanto aba bachire gochiondokia na kobutora ching'unchara chi'abaanto b'ebisaku, baria baimokereretie ching'unchara chiabo igoro y'ense y'Abayuda, chigasiarera abamenyeteo.”

English: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
Kiswahili: Umewafanya watu kama samaki baharini, kama viumbe wa bahari wasio na mtawala.
Ekegusii: Aye gwakorire abanto babe buna chinswe chi’enyancha, na buna ebitongwa bikwagura bitabwati omogambi obo.

English: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won't be in the latter time as it was in the former.
Kiswahili: “Wakati ulioamriwa, atavamia tena Kusini, lakini wakati huu matokeo yake yatakuwa tofauti na yale ya wakati wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Naende ase engaki echiikire nairane gochia ase ense ya Irianyi, korende ase engaki eyio amang'ana takoba buna ayio yeritang'ani.

English: So Zadok and Abiathar returned the ark of God to Jerusalem and stayed there. David Weeps at the Mount of Olives (Psalms 63:1–11)
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Sadoki na Abiathari wakarudisha Sanduku la Mungu mpaka Yerusalemu na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Zadoki na Abiatari bakabogoria Esanduki ya Nyasae; bakayeirania Yerusalemu, nabarabwo bakabeera aroro.

English: “I beset all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Niliwapa njaa kwenye kila mji, na ukosefu wa chakula katika kila mji, hata hivyo bado hamjanirudia mimi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Inche tinabaete gento kende mogotakuna ase emechie yaino yonsi, na endagera ekabora aase aino onsi. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nab’Omonene ateebire.

English: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
Kiswahili: Si ninyi mlionichagua, bali mimi ndiye niliyewachagua ninyi na kuwaweka mwende mkazae matunda, na matunda yenu yapate kudumu. Ili nalo lolote mtakalomwomba Baba katika Jina langu, awape ninyi.
Ekegusii: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae. Ense na Omoika bw’ekeene

English: Then go inside, shut the door behind you and your sons, and pour oil into all these jars, setting the full ones aside.”
Kiswahili: Kisha ingia ndani na ujifungie mlango, wewe na wanao. Mimina mafuta kwenye vyombo vyote, na kila kimoja kinapojaa, kiweke kando.”
Ekegusii: Erio osoe nyomba mwao amo nabana bao, osieke egesieri, oumore amaguta ase ebibekerero ebio. Kera ekemo kogiaichoire okebeke ensemo.”

English: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,
Kiswahili: Usioane nao. Usimtoe binti yako kuolewa na mwanawe, au kumchukua binti yake aolewe na mwanao.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo; timorua abana baino abaiseke ase abamura babo, gose timonyuomeria abana baino abamura ase abaiseke babo,

English: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.” The LORD Renews the Covenant (2 Corinthians 3:7–18)
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Ee Bwana, kama nimepata kibali mbele zako, basi Bwana uende pamoja nasi. Ingawa watu hawa ni wenye shingo ngumu, samehe uovu wetu na dhambi yetu, tuchukue kuwa urithi wako.” Kufanya Agano Upya (Kutoka 23:14-19; Kumbukumbu 7:1-5; 16:1-17)
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene, onye bono nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire ogende amo naintwe.
