Naki abanto aba nabanyabigoti bikong’u, korende otwabere ogosaria gwaito na ebibe biaito, otwanchere tobe abanto bao.” Okobwatana kw’ogotianania kogokorwa naende (Okong’ 23:14-19; Okoir 7:1-5; 16:1-17)

English: Can two walk together without agreeing where to go?
Kiswahili: Je, watu wawili hutembea pamoja wasipokubaliana kufanya hivyo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abanto babere mbataarere amo onye tibabwataini?

English: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Bwana alitutokea wakati uliopita, akisema: “Nimekupenda kwa upendo wa milele, nimekuvuta kwa wema.
Ekegusii: inche Omonene nkabaorokera korwa aare. Nabeire mbanchete nobwanchani bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio obuya bwane bwa botambe bwabang'usire.

English: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
Kiswahili: Hakika ghadhabu yako dhidi ya wanadamu inakuletea sifa, na masalia ya ghadhabu yako unajifunga mshipi.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto nenyare kogera aye otogigwe; eyeratigare noyieboyie buna orokini.

English: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
Kiswahili: “Yule mtunza shamba akamjibu, ‘Bwana, uache tena kwa mwaka mmoja zaidi, nami nitaupalilia na kuuwekea mbolea.
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Omonene, yotige omwaka oyo naende, goika nyoburugere na koyobekera obwoyo.

English: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh's assembly.
Kiswahili: Asiingie mtu yeyote aliyehasiwa kwa kupondwa makende au kwa kukatwa uume wake katika kusanyiko la Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Omosacha ogombairie, gose ekiimo kiaye ki'obosacha kebutogete, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano Omonene.

English: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
Kiswahili: Nitamsifu Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitamwimbia Mungu wangu sifa wakati wote niishipo.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ngotogia Omonene kongendererete koba moyo, ninterere Nyasae one ase okomotogia kondagenderere kobao.

English: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
Kiswahili: “Nyamazeni kimya nipate kusema; kisha na yanipate yatakayonipata.
Ekegusii: Inwe kira‐kiri, montige nkwane, na kende gionsi kegochia konyora, tiga kenyore.

English: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kateni miti mjenge boma kuzunguka Yerusalemu. Mji huu ni lazima uadhibiwe, umejazwa na uonevu.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Gecha emete, agacha eburi, moboere Yerusalemu. Omochie oyio goika oegwe egesusuro, ekiagera nomochie omobe, ogendererete gochanda abanto bareo.

English: So you are to prophesy all these words against them and say to them: ‘The LORD will roar from on high; He will raise His voice from His holy habitation. He will roar loudly over His pasture; like those who tread the grapes, He will call out with a shout against all the inhabitants of the earth.
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa toa unabii kwa maneno haya yote dhidi yao, uwaambie: “ ‘ Bwana atanguruma kutoka juu; atatoa sauti ya ngurumo kutoka makao yake matakatifu na kunguruma kwa nguvu sana dhidi ya nchi yake. Atapiga kelele kama wao wakanyagao zabibu, atapiga kelele dhidi ya wote waishio duniani.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, obaane amang’ana aya onsi igoro ase bare, obateebie: Omonene narume korwa igoro, naake eriogi riaye korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu. Narume ne chinguru igoro ye riicho riaye; naake eriogi buna eri’abaanto bakomita amasabibu. Naake eriogi buna eri’ebanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.

English: You will do as I have done. You won't cover your lips or eat mourner's bread.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtafanya kama nilivyofanya. Hamtafunika sehemu ya chini ya nyuso zenu wala hamtakula vyakula vya kawaida vya waombolezaji.
Ekegusii: Nainwe nabo morakore buna inche nakorire. Timobaisa gotuba chinderu na emenwa, gose timoria endagera y'ebirero.

English: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
Kiswahili: “Baada yako, ufalme mwingine utainuka, ulio dhaifu kuliko wako. Baadaye utafuata ufalme wa tatu, ule wa shaba, nao utatawala juu ya dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Korwa magega yao oborwoti bonde bore oboke ase obwao mbooroke, na magega y'oborwoti obwo, obonde bwa gatato bore obw'etai mbooroke, na borobwo mbogambere ense yonsi.

English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don't doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,' it would be done.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, kama mkiwa na imani wala msiwe na shaka, si kwamba mtaweza kufanya tu yale yaliyofanyika kwa huu mtini, bali hata mkiuambia huu mlima, ‘Ngʼoka, ukatupwe baharini,' litafanyika.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene nabateebirie; Komorabe nokwegena motabeti na tangutangu chinde, tari erio ri'omoko rioka morakore, korende 'namoteebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime, na rikoreke.

English: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’ ”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mwabudu Bwana Mungu wako na umtumikie yeye peke yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neriikire: Mosasiime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”

English: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
Kiswahili: Jengeni miji kwa ajili ya wanawake na watoto wenu, na mazizi kwa ajili ya mbuzi na kondoo zenu, lakini fanyeni yale mliyoahidi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha emechie ase abana baino baramenye na ameri ase ching'ondi chiaino, erio mokore buna mwariire chiira chiaino.”

English: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
Kiswahili: Nanyi msiape kwa vichwa vyenu, kwa kuwa hamwezi kuufanya hata unywele mmoja kuwa mweupe au mweusi.
Ekegusii: Na totiana ase omotwe oo, ekiagera tokonyara gokora agatukia akamo kabe akarabu gose akamwamu.

English: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Bwana, ninalitunza, nalinyweshea maji mfululizo. Ninalichunga usiku na mchana ili mtu yeyote asije akalidhuru.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene, ninche inde omorendi bw'omogondo bw'emesabibu, nigo nkoyoitororera amaache kera engaki; nigo inyorendete obotuko na omobaso, erinde onde tabaisa koyosaria.

English: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari wa jeshi akawaambia, “Mwambieni Hezekia: “ ‘Hili ndilo asemalo mfalme mkuu, mfalme wa Ashuru: Ni wapi unapoweka hili tumaini lako?
Ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake akabateebia ng'a bateebie Hezekia. “Aya naro omorwoti omonene, oria bw'Abaasuri, agokwana: Niigoro ya gento ki obegete ogosemeria kwao?

English: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Kila pando ambalo Baba yangu wa mbinguni hakulipanda, litangʼolewa.
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Kera ekemeri getasimekiri na Tata one ore igoro ngesimorwe.

English: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu watakatifu, mnaoshiriki mwito wa mbinguni, mtafakarini Yesu, mtume na Kuhani Mkuu wa ukiri wetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto abachenu, ababwatani b’okorangerigwa gokorwa igoro, morengererie mono Yeso omotomwa na Omokuani Omonene bw’okoorokia gwaito.

English: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let's go into Judea again.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Haya, turudi Uyahudi.”
Ekegusii: Erio magega ase aya agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Togende Boyahudi naende.”

English: Has a nation ever changed its gods, though they are no gods at all? Yet My people have exchanged their Glory for useless idols.
Kiswahili: Je, taifa limebadili miungu yake wakati wowote? (Hata ingawa hao si miungu kamwe.) Lakini watu wangu wamebadili Utukufu wao kwa sanamu zisizofaa kitu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Gesaku kende kiana koonchoreria chinyasae chiaye, nonya tichiri echi’ekeene? Korende abanto baane bang’onchoreirie inche inde obonene bwabo, banchire egento getari kobakonya.

English: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, tumesikia kwa masikio yetu, baba zetu wametueleza yale uliyotenda katika siku zao, siku za kale.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, intwe tweigwereire namato aito, chisokoro chiaito nchiatotebetie amang’ana gwakorete ase amatuko a kare.

English: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo unao wale wayashikayo mafundisho ya Wanikolai.
Ekegusii: Naboigo naye nore nabaanto babwatete okworokereria kw’Abanikolaiti.

English: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David's city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Kisha Solomoni akalala pamoja na baba zake, naye akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi baba yake. Naye Rehoboamu mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiaraarete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omwana oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
Kiswahili: Sasa ninarudi kwa watu wangu. Lakini njoo, nikuonye kuhusu kile watu hawa watakachowatenda watu wako siku zijazo.”
Ekegusii: “Bono 'nkoirana inde gochia ase abanto bane. Inchuo 'nkomanyie egento Abaisraeli barakore ase abanto bao ase amatuko agochia goocha.”

English: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akatoa amri ifuatayo kwa Waisraeli: “Kile wazao wa kabila la Yosefu wanachosema ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarua ogochika ase Musa ogoteeba; ayio nekeene abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu bagokwana.

English: They took the things from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites, and spread them out before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Wakavichukua vile vitu toka mle hemani, wakamletea Yoshua pamoja na Waisraeli wote, na wakavitandaza mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Bakarusia ebinto biria korwa ase eema, bakabiira ase Yoshua na Abaisraeli, bakabibeka ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Command that I be released from the earth, and that I no longer hear reproach.
Kiswahili: Amri kwamba niachiliwe kutoka duniani, na kwamba nisisikie tena lawama.
Ekegusii: Aye bono karwe ogochika erio inche indwe ase ense erio tinyigwa okoramwa oko naende.

English: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Siku zinakuja, nitakapomwinulia Daudi Tawi lenye haki, Mfalme atakayetawala kwa hekima, na kutenda lililo haki na sawa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero ndasebokie oyomo ore Omoseboka omooronge o Daudi. Oyio nabe omorwoti, oragambe nobong’aini na konacha ebiina bi’ekeene na ebi’oboronge ase ense.

English: Then the men of Ephraim assembled and crossed the Jordan to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, “Why have you crossed over to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We will burn your house down with you inside!”
Kiswahili: Watu wa Efraimu wakaita majeshi yao, wakavuka kwenda Zafoni, wakamwambia Yefta, “Kwa nini mmekwenda kupigana na Waamoni bila kutuita ili twende pamoja nawe? Basi tutaichoma moto nyumba yako, pamoja nawe ukiwa ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Efraimu bagasangererekana amo, bakaamboka gochia Safoni, bagakwana na Yefta, bakamoteebia, “Nase ki kwagendete korwania Abaamoni, ko tigwatorangeria togende komo? Bono ntorigetie gosamba enyomba yao, naye boigo togosambereo.”

English: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns. And since he was a lover of the soil, he had farmers and vinedressers in the hill country and in the fertile fields.
Kiswahili: Akajenga pia minara jangwani na kuchimba visima vingi vya maji, kwa sababu alikuwa na mifugo mingi chini ya vilimani na kwenye nchi tambarare. Alikuwa na watu wanaofanya kazi katika mashamba yake na kwenye mashamba yake ya mizabibu huko vilimani na katika ardhi zenye rutuba, kwa kuwa aliupenda udongo.
Ekegusii: Naende akaagacha emerobiri ase erooro, na agakunya chinsoko chinyinge, ekiagera nigo abwate amaicho amange agwo ase ense omweya na ase ense eimokererete igoro eraire. Boigo nabwate abaremi abange, na abakori emeremo b’emegondo y’emesabibu agwo ase chinse chi’ebigoro na ase chinse chintobu, ekiagera nigo anchete oboremi.

English: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yoshua akapanda kutoka Egloni kwenda Hebroni akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote na kuushambulia.
Ekegusii: Korwa Egiloni Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira, bagaika Heburoni bayorwanie.

English: Can you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
Kiswahili: Je, wewe hutuma umeme wa radi kwenye njia zake? Je, hutoa taarifa kwako kukuambia, ‘Sisi tuko hapa’?
Ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigoteebie: Ee, nao tore aa?

English: I advanced in the Jews' religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
Kiswahili: Nami niliendelea sana katika dini ya Kiyahudi kuliko Wayahudi wengi wa rika yangu maana nilijitahidi sana katika desturi za baba zangu.
Ekegusii: Na inche kobua abange abarenge b'ekiare kiane ase egesaku kiane natang'anete ase edini y'Abayahudi, ngakora omokia mono ase okobwata chingencho chie chisokoro chiane.

English: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Si haki kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana na koyerutera chisese.”

English: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
Kiswahili: katika maombi yangu siku zote, nami ninaomba kwamba hatimaye sasa kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, njia ipate kufunguliwa kwa ajili yangu ili nije kwenu.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo ngosaba ng'a Nyasae karanche konyigorera enchera engiya, inchiche ase more.

English: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
Kiswahili: Ninakusifu kwa sababu nimeumbwa kwa namna ya ajabu na ya kutisha; kazi zako ni za ajabu, ninajua hayo kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogotogia, ekiagera natongetwe ase enchera y’ogokumia, na ey’ogoichania. Ogokora kwao nigo kore okuya kw’ogokumia! Igo nimanyete amang’ana ayio buya ase omoyo one.

English: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”
Kiswahili: na kwamba walipaswa kutangaza neno hili na kulieneza katika miji yao na katika Yerusalemu wakisema: “Enendeni katika nchi ya mlima na kuleta matawi kutoka miti ya mizeituni, mizeituni mwitu, mihadasi, mitende na miti ya kivuli, ili kutengeneza vibanda,” kama ilivyoandikwa.
Ekegusii: naende ng'a ase engaki eyio goika bararie ase emechie yabo yonsi, na ase Yerusalemu, bateebie abanto bagende ase ebigoro barente chinsagia chi'emezeituni, ere ase emegondo na eyere ase orosana, na echi'emeadasi, na echi'emekendo, na echi'emete ende ere namato amange, erio baagachere ebigutu buna eriikire.

English: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
Kiswahili: nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatua juu ya Mlima Sinai. Kwa muda wa siku sita wingu lilifunika mlima, na siku ya saba Bwana akamwita Mose kutoka katikati ya lile wingu.
Ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene bogaacha bokabeera igoro y’egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire gati.

English: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe ataikomboa Israeli kutoka dhambi zao zote.
Ekegusii: Ere naboorie Abaisraeli korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.

English: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity. Honoring True Widows (Ruth 1:1–5)
Kiswahili: nao wanawake wazee uwatendee kama mama zako, na wanawake vijana kama dada zako, katika usafi wote.
Ekegusii: abakungu abagotu buna abaanyoko, na abakungu abasubati buna basubati bamino, ase obochenu bwonsi.

English: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Naye Elizabeti aliposikia salamu ya Maria, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake akaruka. Elizabeti akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu,

English: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” when I really mean “No, no”?
Kiswahili: Nilipopanga jambo hili, je, nilikuwa kigeugeu? Au ninafanya mipango yangu kwa hali ya mwili, ili niseme, “Ndiyo, ndiyo” na “Siyo, siyo” wakati huo huo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ekero narengereretie gokora aya, inarenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u koroisia emeroberio yane? Gose nigo nayeroisetie buna omonto bw’ense ore ang’e goteeba, “Ee, ee”, na, “Yaya, Yaya” ase chingaki echimo?

English: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”
Kiswahili: Sasa tupo mikononi mwako. Tufanyieni lolote mnaloona kuwa jema na haki kwako.”
Ekegusii: Intwe bono nao tore ase amaboko ao, otokorere aya orooche are amaya na amaronge.”

English: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
Kiswahili: Mwombeni Bwana mvua wakati wa vuli; ndiye Bwana atengenezaye mawingu ya tufani. Huwapa watu manyunyu ya mvua, pia mimea ya shambani kwa ajili ya kila mtu.
Ekegusii: Inwe saba Omonene abatwerie embura y’okwamia endagera ase engaki yaye. Omonene natonge amare akomesa, na atwerie abanto embura na koa kera oyomo endagera korwa mogondo.

English: So the LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah, and the Cushites fled.
Kiswahili: Bwana akawapiga Wakushi mbele ya Asa na Yuda. Wakushi wakakimbia,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akabua Abaetiopia ase obosio bwa Asa, na ase obosio bw’Abayuda; na Abaetiopia bagatama.

English: He who is thankless will fail him who delivered him.
Kiswahili: Asiye na shukrani atamkosa yule aliyemkomboa.
Ekegusii: Okobeka egento 'ntenenera gwaitire abanto abatenenku abange, na kwabanyegeirie buna omwaga omorito.

English: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
Kiswahili: Muda wake wa kuhudumu Hekaluni ulipomalizika, akarudi nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye y'ogokora emeremo aerete, ere akagenda bwoye.

English: They prepare a table, they lay out a carpet, they eat, they drink! Rise up, O princes, oil the shields!
Kiswahili: Wanaandaa meza, wanatandaza mazulia, wanakula, wanakunywa! Amkeni, enyi maafisa, zitieni ngao mafuta!
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwarigania endagera bayebeeka ase emesa, babeeka abarendi bakorenda, naende baria na konywa. Bono inwe abagaambi, imoka, moake chinguba chiaino ebitinya.

English: his fourth was Adonijah, the son of Haggith; his fifth was Shephatiah, the son of Abital;
Kiswahili: wa nne, Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi; wa tano, Shefatia mwana wa Abitali;
Ekegusii: Oyo o kane Adonia o Hagiti, na oyo o gatano Sefatia bw’Abitali;

English: Along with his peace offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of leavened bread.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na sadaka hii ya amani ya shukrani ataleta sadaka ya maandazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa chachu.
Ekegusii: Amo n’ekengwanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, arente emegati ebekire ememera.

English: And I will set My jealous rage against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and ears, and your survivors will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
Kiswahili: Nitaelekeza wivu wa hasira yangu dhidi yako, nao watakushughulikia kwa hasira kali. Watakatilia mbali pua yako na masikio yako, na wale watakaosalia miongoni mwako watauawa kwa upanga. Watachukua wana wako na binti zako, na wale watakaosalia miongoni mwenu watateketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Nimbe nekeririanda ase ore, ng’ee barabwo ribaga babe abatindi mono ase ore. Mbakobutore chimioro na amato, na abatigari babo mbakenywe nemioro. Abanto abwo mbaire abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, na abatigari bao ’mbasambwe nomorero.

English: Then the LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana Mungu akasema, “Sasa mtu huyu amekuwa kama mmoja wetu, kwa kujua mema na mabaya. Sharti asiruhusiwe kunyoosha mkono wake na kuchuma pia kutoka mti wa uzima akala, naye akaishi milele.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agateeba: “Rora, omonto oyo obeire buna oyomo oito ase okomanya amaya na amabe. Tabaisa gwancherwa gochia korambora okoboko kwaye atwe amatunda ’omote bw’obogima arie, erinde abe moyo kare na kare.”

English: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
Kiswahili: Lakini kusudieni mioyoni mwenu msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema mbele ya mashtaka.
Ekegusii: Manya gaki ase emioyo yaino, ng'a timorengereria ritang'ani eki morairanerie,

English: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh's servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hakuna silaha itakayofanyizwa dhidi yako itakayofanikiwa, nawe utauthibitisha kuwa mwongo kila ulimi utakaokushtaki. Huu ndio urithi wa watumishi wa Bwana na hii ndiyo haki yao itokayo kwangu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ebirwanero biaroisigwe ase ogokorwania, tibikonyora okobua, kera oromeme rorakoimokere kogosoera, aye norobue ase ekiina. Oyo noro omwando bw'abasomba baane inche Omonene, na oboronge bwabo obokorwa ase 'nde.” Nab'Omonene atebiire.

English: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
Kiswahili: “Yeyote ampigaye mtu na kumuua ni lazima auawe hakika.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi oraake omonto na amoite akwe, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren't worthy.
Kiswahili: “Kisha akawaambia watumishi wake, ‘Karamu ya arusi imeshakuwa tayari, lakini wale niliowaalika hawakustahili kuja.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia abasomba baye: Ekeene enyangi yabeire ang'e, korende abaariganetigwe tibagwenereti.

English: Like a slave he longs for shade; like a hireling he waits for his wages.
Kiswahili: Kama mtumwa anavyovionea shauku vivuli vya jioni, au mtu aliyeajiriwa anavyoungojea mshahara wake,
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omosomba akogania anyore aase agokenderera, na buna koreng’ana omonto orikire emeremo akogania aegwe eng’eria yaye,

English: I also arranged for contributions of wood at the appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, with favor.
Kiswahili: Pia nilihakikisha kwamba matoleo ya kuni yaliletwa kwa wakati unaopaswa, na malimbuko kwa wakati wake. Ee Mungu wangu, unikumbuke, unitendee mema.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaroberia ng’a chinko chi’ogosambera ebing’wanso chirentwe ase chingaki chichikiire, na amatunda ’okwama kw’eritang’ani arentwe. Aye Nyasae one, ing’inyore ase amang’ana aya, inkorere amaya.

English: By his counsel, he has calmed the deep and planted islands in it.
Kiswahili: Kwa ushauri wake, ametuliza vilindi vya bahari na kupanda visiwa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ase obong'aini bwaye nigo agotoereria enyancha enene na kobeeka ebisinka aroro.

English: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
Kiswahili: Kuhusu mwanadamu, siku zake ni kama majani, anachanua kama ua la shambani;
Ekegusii: Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;

English: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son-in-law. Before the deadline,
Kiswahili: Watumishi walipomwambia Daudi mambo haya, ikampendeza kuwa mkwewe mfalme. Basi kabla siku iliyopangwa haijafika,
Ekegusii: Ekero abasomba baria bateebeetie Daudi amang'ana aria Saulo ateebete, Daudi akagokigwa naro ng'a omorwoti abe ise biara. Ekero engaki eria konya etaraika,

English: Therefore Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon, and said to him, “Do not execute the wise men of Babylon! Bring me before the king, and I will give him the interpretation.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Danieli akamwendea Arioko, ambaye mfalme alikuwa amemteua kuwaua wenye hekima wa Babeli, akamwambia, “Usiwaue wenye hekima wa Babeli. Nipeleke kwa mfalme, nami nitamfasiria ndoto yake.”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Danieli akagenda ase Arioki, oria omorwoti achorete ng’a aite abanto abang’aini ba Babiloni, akamoteebia, “Tobaisa goita abang’aini ba Babiloni; ng’ire ase obosio bw’omorwoti, imoteebie engencho ye chindoto chiria.”

English: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
Kiswahili: Walimu wa sheria walioteremka kutoka Yerusalemu walisema, “Amepagawa na Beelzebuli! Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa kutumia mkuu wa pepo wachafu!”
Ekegusii: Na aborokia b'amariiko, abarwete Yerusalemu, bakaboora, “Nabwatire na Beelizebuli, naende agoseria ebirecha ase okobua kw'omonene bw'ebirecha.”

English: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akatoa agizo hili kwa watu wake wote: “Kila mtoto wa kiume atakayezaliwa kwa Waebrania lazima atupwe katika Mto Naili, bali kila mtoto wa kike aachwe aishi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agachiika abanto baye bonsi, akabateebia, “Kera omwana omoisia oraiborwe ase Abaiberania, momotugute ase orooche rwa Naeli, korende kera omwana omoiseke momotige abe moyo.”

English: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
Kiswahili: Wewe pia utalewa; utakwenda mafichoni na kutafuta kimbilio kutoka kwa adui.
Ekegusii: Ninawi, aye boigo nogwe gochia ase ogosundoka kw'ogotindu! Aye boigo norigie gotama korwa ase ababisa bao.

English: and instructed, ‘Take these articles, put them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.’
Kiswahili: naye akamwambia, ‘Chukua vyombo hivi uende ukaviweke ndani ya Hekalu huko Yerusalemu. Nawe uijenge upya nyumba ya Mungu mahali pake.’
Ekegusii: akamoteebia ng’a arente ebikorero ebio, abibeke ime ase Hekalu ere aiga Yerusalemu, naende atige enyomba ya Nyasae eagachwe aase yarenge.

English: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
Kiswahili: Nina ufahamu zaidi kuliko wazee, kwa kuwa ninayatii mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’manyete amange kobua abanto abagotu, ekiagera ’mbwatete amachiiko ao.

English: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God's Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu walipomwamini Filipo alipohubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu na jina la Yesu Kristo, wakabatizwa wanaume na wanawake.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia kwegena Filipo, gakorandia amang'ana amaya igoro y'oborwoti bwa Nyasae na erieta ria Yeso Kristo, bakabatiswa, abasacha na abakungu.

English: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Wakohathi hawaruhusiwi kuingia ndani ili kuangalia vitu vitakatifu, hata kwa kitambo kidogo, la sivyo watakufa.”
Ekegusii: Korende Abakohati baise gosoa na korora ebinto biria ebichenu, nonya netagika ensinini, nigo barakwe.”

English: They brought him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
Kiswahili: Wakamletea sadaka ya kuteketezwa kipande kwa kipande, pamoja na kichwa, naye akaviteketeza juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Abamura baye bakamorentera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, egetari ase egetari, amo nomotwe, na ere akabisaambera ase egesasiimero.

English: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umeniokoa toka kwenye mauti na miguu yangu kwenye kujikwaa, ili niweze kuenenda mbele za Mungu katika nuru ya uzima.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw'abwo bare moyo.

English: The famine was severe in the land.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu njaa ilikuwa bado ni kali mno katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Enchara ekaba enene ase ense.

English: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
Kiswahili: Wale Wayahudi hawakuamini ya kuwa mtu huyo alikuwa kipofu, akapata kuona, mpaka walipowaita wazazi wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi tibeegena amang’ana aye, ng’a nigo arenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakarangeria abaibori baye oria onyorete okorora,

English: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
Kiswahili: Kuna vitu sita anavyovichukia Bwana, naam, viko saba vilivyo chukizo kwake:
Ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitano nakemo Omonene ageechete, ee, mbire bitan'abibere bire okogeecha ase are, nabio ebi:

English: So Esther called for her chamberlain Hathach, who waited upon her; and she sent to learn the truth from Mordecai.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Esta akamwita Hathaki, mlinzi wake wa nyumba, ambaye alimhudumia; naye akatuma ujumbe ili apate kujua ukweli kutoka kwa Mordekai.
Ekegusii: Erio Esiteri akarangeria Hataki, oyo omorwoti achorete koba omokoreri bw'Esiteri, akamotoma agende ase Modekai amoborerie engencho y'amang'ana ayio, naende ninki kiagerire achandegete igo.

English: If any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa yeyote miongoni mwa watumishi wako atapatikana nacho, auawe, na sisi wengine tutakuwa watumwa wa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Oyoranyorekane ore negekombe ekio ase egati yaito intwe abasomba bao, oyio akwe, naintwe boigo rirorio tobe abasomba bao, Omonene oito.”

English: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari yao, mungu wa dunia hii amepofusha akili za wasioamini, ili wasione nuru ya Injili ya utukufu wa Kristo, aliye sura ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio enyasae y’ense eye yaukoirie ebirengererio bi’abwo bategeneti, erinde omobaso bw’enchiri y’obonene bwa Kristo, oyore ekieni kia Nyasae, tobaikera.

English: The Gibeonites said to him, “We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us.” “Whatever you ask, I will do for you,” he replied.
Kiswahili: Wagibeoni wakamjibu, “Hatuna haki ya kudai fedha wala dhahabu kutoka kwa Sauli au jamaa yake, wala hatuna haki ya kumuua mtu yeyote katika Israeli.” Daudi akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafanyie nini?”
Ekegusii: Abagibeoni bakamoiraneria, “Titorigeti chifeta gose chitaabu korwa ase Saulo, gose korwa ase eamate yaye; intwe titorigeti goita omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli.” Daudi akababoria, “Ninki rende ’nkobakorera?”

English: All the gold that the commanders of thousands and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu yote kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia ambavyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari walimletea Bwana kama zawadi ilikuwa shekeli 16,750
Ekegusii: Chitaabu chionsi chiaruetwe ase Omonene, chiria abatang’ani baria b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana barentete, nigo chiarenge chi’oborito koreng’ana ne chikiro amagana abere.

English: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
Kiswahili: Basi Isaki alikuwa ametoka Beer-Lahai-Roi, kwa kuwa alikuwa anaishi nchi ya Negebu.
Ekegusii: Isaka nigo achiete mogondo ekero kia mogoroba, akaba ore nebirengererio. Agwo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora chingamia chigocha.

English: Together with their relatives, who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD, they numbered 288.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na ndugu zao wote walikuwa wamefundishwa na kuwa stadi wa uimbaji kwa Bwana. Idadi yao walikuwa 288.
Ekegusii: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).

English: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh's head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli akaupeleka mkono wake wa kuume, akauweka juu ya kichwa cha Efraimu, ingawa alikuwa ndiye mdogo, na mkono wake wa kushoto akaukatisha, akauweka juu ya kichwa cha Manase, ingawa Manase alikuwa ndiye mzaliwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Israeli akarambora okoboko kwaye gw'okorio, agakobeeka igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, nonya ere orenge omoke; agakorekania amaboko aye na kobeeka okoboko kwaye gw'okobee igoro ase omotwe o Manase, nere orenge omotangi.

English: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimewachagua Walawi wenzenu kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli kama zawadi kwenu, waliowekwa wakfu kwa Bwana ili kufanya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Ninche nachorire Abalawi bamino korwa ase Abaisraeli, babe ekeegwa ase more. Barabwo baatananirwe ase 'nde inche Omonene, bakore emeremo ase Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
Kiswahili: Tangu saa sita hadi saa tisa giza liliifunika nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Bono korwa chinsa isano nemo omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.

English: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Abramu, akamuuliza, “Umenifanyia nini? Kwa nini hukuniambia ni mke wako?
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Aburamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwankoreire iga, otaare gonteebia ng’a oyo Sarai mokao?

English: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko la watu na likuzunguke. Watawale kutoka juu.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ebisaku bionsi tiga basangererekane bagoetanane; obagambere korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki'obonene aaria igoro.

English: And after he had become the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Shela baada ya kumzaa Eberi, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Eberi, Sela agaika emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), erio akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
Kiswahili: kuendelea hadi Zifroni, na kuishia Hasar-Enani. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa kaskazini.
Ekegusii: naende rogenderere gochia Sifuroni, na korwa aroro roike Hasari‐Enani. Oro narwo orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu.

English: And it shall be like people, like priest. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
Kiswahili: Hata itakuwa: Kama walivyo watu, ndivyo walivyo makuhani. Nitawaadhibu wote wawili kwa ajili ya njia zao na kuwalipa kwa matendo yao.
Ekegusii: Buna eraabe ase abanto, naboigo eraabe nase Omokuani. Nindue egesusuro ase bare bonsi ase engencho ye chinchera chiabo, nimbaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.

English: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mpango uliokusudiwa kwa ajili ya ulimwengu wote, huu ni mkono ulionyooshwa juu ya mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Aya naro achikirwe igoro y'ense yonsi, na oko nakwo okoboko koramboire igoro ase abanto b'ebisaku bionsi.

English: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakafika mahali ambapo bahari mbili zinakutana, wakaipweleza meli ufuoni, omo ikakwama sana, ikawa haiwezi kuondolewa, lakini sehemu ya shetri ikavunjika vipande vipande kwa kule kupiga kwa mawimbi yenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Bagaika aase chinsanganio chie chinyancha ibere, bakaroria emeeri aroro goika ekarateera; obosio bw'emeeri bogasensema omokenye, ekabwatwa kegima, korende korwa magega egatagorwa ne chinguru chi'emerindo.

English: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
Kiswahili: Huko Misri, Asenathi binti wa Potifera, aliyekuwa kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alimzalia Yosefu wana wawili, Manase na Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw'Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.

English: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child's life are dead.”
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Ondoka, mchukue mtoto na mama yake mwende, mrudi katika nchi ya Israeli kwa sababu wale waliokuwa wanatafuta uhai wa mtoto wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng'ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.

English: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
Kiswahili: Naye akanichukua katika Roho hadi kwenye mlima mkubwa na mrefu, akanionyesha ule Mji Mtakatifu, Yerusalemu, ukishuka kutoka mbinguni kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabogoretigwe n'Omoika, na omomalaika oria akang'ira gochia ase ekerogo ekenene, akanyorokia omochie oria omochenu, Yerusalemu, ogoika korwa igoro korwa ase Nyasae.

English: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari wakafika mahali palipokuwa na maji, yule towashi akamuuliza Filipo, “Tazama, hapa kuna maji. Kitu gani kitanizuia nisibatizwe?”
Ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete inchera, bagaika aase amaache arenge. Oria omogomba akabora: “Rora amaache aya! Inki kegontanga timbatiswa?”

English: For you always have the poor with you, but you don't always have me.
Kiswahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
Ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.

English: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
Kiswahili: Kisha makundi ya mataifa yote yale yapiganayo dhidi ya Arieli, yale yanayomshambulia yeye na ngome zake, na kumzunguka kwa jeshi, watakuwa kama ilivyo ndoto, kama maono wakati wa usiku:
Ekegusii: Abanto abange b'ebisaku bionsi abwo bakorwania Arieli, ee, bonsi abakorwania omochie oyio, na gotagora chiburi chiaye, na koyorentera emechando, nigo barasirigwe, beebwe buna okorota gokwebwa, ee, buna okorora kwa botuko gokwebwa.

English: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: You have seen all the disaster that I brought against Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah; and behold, they lie today in ruins and desolation
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: Mliona maangamizi makubwa niliyoyaleta juu ya Yerusalemu na juu ya miji yote ya Yuda. Leo imeachwa ukiwa na magofu
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Inwe mwarorire amabe onsi narentete ase Yerusalemu, na ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda. Nonya ngoika reero emechie eyio nigo esaregete, na onde tamenyeti aroro,

English: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established. The Execution of Adonijah
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Solomoni akaketi katika kiti cha ufalme cha baba yake Daudi, nao utawala wake ukaimarika sana. Kiti Cha Ufalme Cha Solomoni Chaimarishwa
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Sulemani agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti gia Daudi ise, na oborwoti bwaye bokaba ne chinguru chinene mono. Ogokwa kw’Adonia

English: For the creation, ministering to you, its maker, strains its force against the unrighteous for punishment and in kindness, slackens it on behalf of those who trust in you.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana uumbaji, ukikuhudumia wewe, muumba wake, unazidisha nguvu zake dhidi ya wasio haki kwa ajili ya adhabu na kwa wema, unaupunguza kwa niaba ya wale wanaokutumaini.
Ekegusii: Ense nigo yatongetwe inse y'erichiiko riao, na ebitongwa bionsi nigo bikogenda ase chinguru chiao na koa abanyabibe egesusuro; korende biabisa chinguru chiabo erio kobaisanekia baria bagosemeretie.

English: A bondservant doesn't live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
Kiswahili: Mtumwa hakai nyumbani anakotumika siku zote, lakini mwana hukaa nyumbani daima.
Ekegusii: naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.

English: If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
Kiswahili: Kama nina hatia, ole wangu! Hata kama ningekuwa sina hatia, siwezi kukiinua kichwa changu, kwa kuwa nimejawa na aibu, na kuzama katika mateso yangu.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwane onye inde omokori amabe; na onye inde omonyaboronge tinkonyara gwetogia; nigo ing’ichire nobosooku, ase ayio aye origererie emechando yane.

English: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Midomo yangu na ibubujike sifa, kwa kuwa unanifundisha maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Nimbe 'nkona‐kogotogia nebikoba biane, ekiagera aye kwanyorokereirie 'manye emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: And when he had with these words filled them with courage and made them ready to die for the laws and their country, he divided his army into four parts.
Kiswahili: Na alipokwisha kuwapa ujasiri kwa maneno haya na kuwaweka tayari kufa kwa ajili ya sheria na nchi yao, aligawanya jeshi lake katika sehemu nne.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana a Yuda akabeka abanto baye chinguru mono na barabwo bakerwa gokwa ase engencho y'edini yabo n'ense yabo. Erio akabaga abarwani esegi baye ase ebiombe bine

English: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Sara akacheka kimoyomoyo alipokuwa akiwaza, “Baada ya mimi kuwa mkongwe hivi na bwana wangu amezeeka, je, nitaweza kufurahia jambo hili?”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Sara agaseka ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba: “Buna inde omogotu iga, na omosacha one nere ogotire, naki eranyarekane inyore omogooko oyio?”

English: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
Kiswahili: Kama kweli mnaitimiza ile sheria ya kifalme inayopatikana katika Maandiko isemayo, “Mpende jirani yako kama unavyoipenda nafsi yako,” mnafanya vyema.
Ekegusii: Komoraikeranie ogochika gokorwa ase oborwoti buna koriikire ase amariiko, “Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete”.

English: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.
Kiswahili: Juu ya milango miwili ya mbao za mzeituni alinakshi makerubi, miti ya mitende pamoja na maua yaliyochanua na kufunika makerubi na miti ya mitende kwa dhahabu iliyofuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bionsi bibere bi'emezeituni bigachaberwa nemegwekano y'ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey'emekendo, na ey'ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Akaooma bionsi netaabu; boigo agasiarera ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba amo ne chibao chi'emekendo netaabu.

English: Glorify the Lord and exalt him as much as you can! For even yet, he will surpass that. When you exalt him, summon your full strength. Don't be weary, because you can't praise him enough.
Kiswahili: Mtukuze Bwana na umtukuze kadiri uwezavyo! Kwa maana hata hivyo, atazidi hilo. Unapomtukuza, tumia nguvu zako zote. Usichoke, kwa sababu huwezi kumsifu vya kutosha.
Ekegusii: Ekero aye okomotogia Omonene, motogie buna okonyaara, ekiagera ere nigo aetanetie ayio moimokereria igoro, moimokererie igoro ase okobua kwao gwonsi. Aye tobaisa korosa ekiagera tokonyaara komotogia buna egwenerete okore.

English: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.
Kiswahili: Urithi wa Wasimeoni ulitolewa kutoka fungu la Yuda, kwa kuwa fungu la Yuda lilikuwa kubwa kuliko walivyohitaji. Hivyo kabila la Simeoni lilipewa urithi wao ndani ya eneo la Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omwando bw'egesaku gia Simioni nigo orenge ensemo y'oyio bw'egesaku kia Yuda, ekiagera ensemo y'egesaku kia Yuda nigo yarenge enene mono ase bare. Ayio naro agerete egesaku gia Simioni gekaegwa omwando obo korwa ase omwando bw'egesaku kia Yuda.

English: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Daudi akamwambia Sauli, “Mimi ni nani, nayo jamaa yangu ni nini au ukoo wa baba yangu katika Israeli, kwamba mimi niwe mkwewe mfalme?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Saulo: “Inche ninki ng'isaine na obogima bwane ninki boisaine, gose eamate ya tata inki eisaine ase egati y'Abaisraeli, erinde aye omorwoti obe tata biara?”

English: So that place was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Beer-Sheba, kwa sababu watu wawili waliapiana hapo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaaroka ase agwo Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera barabwo babere mbariereranete emuma aroro.

English: Don't harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
Kiswahili: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya kule Meriba, kama mlivyofanya siku ile kule Masa jangwani,
Ekegusii: Timokong'ia chinkoro chiaino, buna abakoro bakorete aaria Meriba; na buna bakorete ase rituko riria aaria Masa agwo ase erooro.

English: to prepare for me timber in abundance, because the temple I am building will be great and wonderful.
Kiswahili: ili wanipatie mbao kwa wingi kwa sababu Hekalu nitakalojenga lazima liwe kubwa na zuri kabisa.
Ekegusii: ase okondoiseria chibao chinyinge, ekiagera enyomba ngochia koagacha nigo erabe enene mono, naende ey’ogokumia.

English: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu alikwenda ngʼambo ya Bahari ya Galilaya, ambayo pia huitwa Bahari ya Tiberia.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akagenda ng’umbu y’enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia.

English: Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana aliposikia lile mlilosema, alikasirika, akaapa, akasema:
Ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa okwemurungania kwaino, akaba n'endamwamu, agatiana na goteeba:

English: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
Kiswahili: Midomo yao isemayo uongo na inyamazishwe, kwa maana kwa kiburi na dharau wao husema kwa majivuno dhidi ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Kiria emenwa yabwo bagokwana amang’ana ’oborimo, abwo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro y’oyore omooronge, na gokwana amang’ana yoboenenu na ay’ogochaaya.

English: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
Kiswahili: Yeye na wakweze wawili wakaondoka pale walipokuwa wakiishi na kushika njia kurudi nchi ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagatiga aase aaria bamenyete, bagachaaka orogendo koirana gochia ase ense y'Abayuda,

English: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hawatavuka pamoja nanyi wakiwa wamevaa silaha za vita, lazima wakubali kupokea milki yao pamoja nanyi katika nchi ya Kanaani.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye tibakobogoria ebirwanero bi'eseegi bamboke gochia ng'umbu ya Yorodani, rirorio nigo baranyore orogongo rwabo amo nainwe agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.”

English: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti wakamkamata, wakamngʼoa macho yake, wakamchukua wakamteremsha mpaka Gaza. Wakiwa wamemfunga kwa pingu za shaba, wakamweka ili asage ngano huko gerezani.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakamobwata, bakamokonora amaiso, naende bakamoira gochia Gasa, bakamosiba ne chingataare chie chitaai. Bakamobeeka gosia obosie agwo ase enyomba y'obosibwa.

English: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or more feet; for such creatures are detestable.
Kiswahili: Msile kiumbe chochote kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, kiwe kitambaacho kwa tumbo lake, au kitambaacho kwa miguu minne au kwa miguu mingi; ni chukizo.
Ekegusii: Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.

English: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mnyama akakamatwa pamoja na huyo nabii wa uongo ambaye alikuwa amefanya ishara kwa niaba ya huyo mnyama, ambaye kwa ishara hizi aliwadanganya wale waliopokea chapa ya huyo mnyama na kuiabudu sanamu yake. Hawa wawili wakatupwa wakiwa hai ndani ya ziwa la moto liwakalo kwa kiberiti.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekabwatwa amo nomobani oria bw’oborimo, ere oyokorete ebikone ase obosio bwaye. Ase ebikone ebio nigo are kong’aina abanto baria baetwe ekemanyererio ki’engiti eria na gosasiima omogwekano oye. Abwo babere bakarutwa bare moyo ase enyancha y’omorero egwoka ekebiriti.

English: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
Kiswahili: Uzi akamzaa Zerahia, Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi,
Ekegusii: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

English: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
Kiswahili: Kisha Maria akachukua chupa ya painti moja yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa, akayamimina miguuni mwa Yesu na kuifuta kwa nywele zake. Nyumba nzima ikajaa harufu nzuri ya manukato.
Ekegusii: Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.

English: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.
Kiswahili: Wakatoa kwa ajili ya kazi ya Hekalu la Mungu talanta 5,000 na darkoni 10,000 za dhahabu, talanta 10,000 za fedha, talanta 18,000 za shaba na talanta 100,000 za chuma.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae chitaabu chitalanta chilifu isano ne chidarikoni chilifu ikomi, ne chifeta chitalanta chilifu ikomi, ne chitaai chitalanta chilifu ikomi na isano na isato, na ebioma chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo.

English: I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. The Friends Eat, O friends, and drink; drink freely, O beloved. The Bride
Kiswahili: Nimekuja kwenye bustani yangu, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu; nimekusanya manemane yangu pamoja na kikolezo changu. Nimekula sega langu la asali na asali yangu; nimekunywa divai yangu na maziwa yangu. Marafiki Kuleni, enyi marafiki, mnywe; kunyweni ya kutosha, ee wapenzi. Shairi La Nne Mpendwa
Ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, nasoire ase omogondo one, ngosangereria inde manemane amo nebinsari biane bigotioka buya; nkoria inde eriana amo nobooke bwane, nkonywa inde edivai yane amo namabeere aane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu) Inwe abasani, ragera na monywe! Inwe abanchani, kanywe mono goika moichorwe nobwanchani! Ogoteera Gwa Kane (Omoriakari)

English: Tyre has built herself a fortress; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
Kiswahili: Tiro amejijengea ngome imara, amelundika fedha kama mavumbi na dhahabu kama taka za mitaani.
Ekegusii: Turo bweagacheire chiburi chinkong’u, naende osangereirie chindwenyi chi’echifeta chinyinge buna orotu, ne chitaabu chinyinge buna eubi ere ase chinchera.

English: Jonathan and Simon took Judas their brother, and buried him in the tomb of his ancestors at Modin.
Kiswahili: Yonathani na Simoni walimchukua Yuda ndugu yao, wakamzika katika kaburi la mababu zake huko Modin.
Ekegusii: Yonathani na Simioni bakabogoria omobere oye na koyotindeka ase chimbeera chi'echisokoro chiabo agwo Modeini.

English: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.
Kiswahili: Ingawa yule mwanamke aliendelea kumshawishi Yosefu siku baada ya siku, Yosefu alikataa kukutana naye kimwili wala kukaa karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Akaba okonagokwana na Yusufu rituko ase rituko, korende Yusufu tamwanchera baraare komo, gose koba amo.

English: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I am honored through Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen.”
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri watajua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana nitakapojipatia utukufu kupitia Farao, magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.”
Ekegusii: Na Abamisiri nabamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ekero nkwenyorera ogotogigwa ase okomobua Farao amo ne chigari chiaye na abariini chibarasi chiaye.”

English: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire has consumed their excess.’
Kiswahili: ‘Hakika adui zetu wameangamizwa, nao moto umeteketeza mali zao.’
Ekegusii: bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.

English: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Farao akawauliza, “Je tunaweza kumpata yeyote kama mtu huyu, ambaye Roho wa Mungu yumo ndani yake?”
Ekegusii: Farao akabooria abasomba baye: “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”

English: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
Kiswahili: Lakini upinde wake ulibaki imara, mikono yake ikatiwa nguvu, na mkono wa Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo, kwa sababu ya Mchungaji, Mwamba wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko 'Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.

English: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akipita, akamwona mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.

English: After Joshua had spoken to the people, seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the horns, and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yoshua kuzungumza na watu, wale makuhani saba wenye kuzibeba zile baragumu saba mbele za Bwana, wakatangulia mbele, wakipiga baragumu zao na Sanduku la Agano la Bwana likawafuata.
Ekegusii: Erio, buna Yoshua abachigete, abakuani batano na babere bakagenda bosio bw’Esanduki y’Omonene bakobugia ebitureeri biria bi’omochengo, na Esanduki y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene ebogoirie korwa magega.

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Nitakomesha makundi ya wajeuri ya Misri kwa mkono wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Ninsirie obotenenku bwa Misiri goetera ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni.

English: The spirit of a man can endure his sickness, but who can survive a broken spirit?
Kiswahili: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning’o orayoremererie omoika ore n’omoichano?

English: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaambia mara nyingi kabla, nami sasa nasema tena hata kwa machozi, watu wengi wanaishi kama adui wa msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b'omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang'ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobateebia aya ase amariga.

English: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard about Hezekiah’s illness and recovery.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Merodaki-Baladani, mwana wa Baladani mfalme wa Babeli, akamtumia Hezekia barua na zawadi, kwa sababu alikuwa amesikia habari za kuugua na kupona kwake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omorwoti o Babiloni Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira riruube na ebiegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabeete omorwaire, naende ng’a konya ogwenire.

English: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
Kiswahili: bali watasema, ‘Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, aliyewatoa wana wa Israeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na nchi zote alizokuwa amewafukuzia.’ Maana nitawarudisha katika nchi niliyowapa baba zao.
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio nigo barakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na korwa ase chinse chionsi, agwo ase abaseretie gochia”. Ayio nakoreke, ekiagera inche nimbairanie, mbarente ase ense yabo abanyene, eyio naete chisokoro chiabo. Ebisusuro bikorentwa

English: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Washiloni waliorudi ni: Asaya mzaliwa wa kwanza na wanawe.
Ekegusii: na korwa Silo Asaia, omwana omotangi amo nabana baye abamura.

English: A man's spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
Kiswahili: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
Ekegusii: Omoika bw'oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning'o orayoremererie omoika ore n'omoichano?

English: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kusema, “Rabi.” Akambusu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi aigete akagenda bwango, goika ase Yeso, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.

English: And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.” The Parable of the Wicked Tenants (Matthew 21:33–46; Mark 12:1–12)
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.” Mfano Wa Wapangaji Waovu (Mathayo 21:33-46; Marko 12:1-12)
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.” Omoreng’anio bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu (Mat 21:33-46; Mar 12:1-12)

English: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wakati njaa ilipokuwa imeenea katika nchi yote, Yosefu akafungua ghala za vyakula na kuwauzia Wamisri nafaka, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali mno katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabeete endito ase ense ya Misiri.

English: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
Kiswahili: Bali kwenu ninyi mnaoliheshimu Jina langu, jua la haki litawazukia, lenye kuponya katika mabawa yake. Nanyi mtatoka nje na kurukaruka kama ndama aliyeachiwa kutoka zizini.
Ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe abamoirogete erieta riane, erioba ri’oboronge ’ndioroke rire nokogwenia inse ye chimbaaba chiaye. Inwe inamosoke mobe mogotiratiria buna chimori ekero chigosokigwa korwa ase obweri.

English: Anyone who was found with any a book of the covenant, and if any consented to the law, the king's sentence delivered him to death.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote aliyepatikana na kitabu cha agano, na yeyote aliyekubali sheria, hukumu ya mfalme ilimhukumu kifo.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kwomorwoti, onde bwensi orenge konyoorwa negetabu giokobwatana gose gotunyana amachiiko agaitwa.

English: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
Kiswahili: Viumbe wale waliposogea nilisikia sauti ya mabawa yao, kama ngurumo ya maji yaendayo kasi, kama sauti ya Mwenyezi, kama makelele ya jeshi. Waliposimama kimya walishusha mabawa yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa ebio biarenge kogenda, okoeera gwe chimbaaba chiabo nigo kwarenge ase amato ane buna okw'amaache amaange, buna eriogi ri'Omonguru, ee, nigo kwarenge buna okwoga kw'emeganda y'eseegi. Ekero biarenge gotenena, nigo biarenge kwororobia chimbaaba chiabo gochia inse.

English: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
Kiswahili: Lakini watamwitaje yeye ambaye hawajamwamini? Nao watawezaje kumwamini yeye ambaye hawajamsikia? Tena watamsikiaje bila mtu kuwahubiria?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inaki baramorangerie ere bataramwegena? Naende inaki baramwegene oyo batana koigwa amang'ana igoro yaye? Naende inaki baraigwe batari nomorandia?

English: So Moses declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: ‘Panapo usiku wa manane Mimi nitapita katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Farao, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Botuko gati ninche ng’ete egati y’Abamisiri.

English: A man will seize his brother within his father’s house: “You have a cloak—you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of rubble.”
Kiswahili: Mtu atamkamata mmoja wa ndugu zake katika nyumba ya baba yake na kusema, “Unalo joho, sasa uwe kiongozi wetu, tawala lundo hili la magofu!”
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio omonto nabwate oyomwabo baiboire komo amoteebie, “Aye nobwate chianga okobeeka, ase ayio kabe omogambi oito, otenenere obogaambi obo bwanyegerigwe.”

English: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo mnapowapa wahitaji, msipige panda mbele yenu kama wafanyavyo wanafiki katika masinagogi na mitaani, ili wasifiwe na watu. Amin nawaambia wao wamekwisha kupokea thawabu yao.
Ekegusii: Gaki gokorua ebiegwa, tobugia engoma, buna baria abang'ainereria bagokora ase chisinagogi na ase chinchera chinene chi'emechie, erinde batogigwe n'abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng'a barabwo banyorire eng'eria yabo.

English: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.
Kiswahili: “Sasa nitakufanya uwe mdogo miongoni mwa mataifa, aliyedharauliwa miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Naki ningokore obe omoke ase egati y'ebisaku. Abanto bonsi nabagochaye.

English: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo sijanyamazishwa na giza, wala kwa giza nene linalofunika uso wangu.
Ekegusii: ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.

English: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ukawatia mikononi mwa adui zao, ambao waliwatesa. Lakini walipoteswa, wakakulilia wewe. Kutoka mbinguni uliwasikia, nawe kwa huruma zako kuu ukawapa waokozi, waliowaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio okababeka ase amaboko 'ababisa babo, na barabwo bakabachanda. Ekero barenge ase emechando yabo, bakarera asore; aye okabaigwa agwo igoro; na ase engencho y'amaabera ao amange, okabaa abatooria abwo bakabatooria korwa ase amaboko 'ababisa babo.

English: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
Kiswahili: Kukazuka mabishano miongoni mwa wanafunzi kuhusu ni nani miongoni mwao atakayekuwa mkuu kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Okoengererania kogatuboka ase egati yabo ng’a ning’o ase bare ore omonene kobua abande.

English: I will lay waste Pathros, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgment on Thebes.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya Pathrosi kuwa ukiwa na kuitia moto Soani, nami nitaipiga kwa adhabu Thebesi
Ekegusii: Ninsarie ense ya Patirosi esire ebe bosa, ninsambe Soani nomorero, na inachere omochie okorokwa No ekiina.

English: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na tatu Delaya, ya ishirini na nne Maazia.
Ekegusii: obwa emerongo ebere na gatato bokagwera Delaya, na obwa emerongo ebere na kane Maasia.

English: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Siku zinakuja,’ asema Bwana, ‘wakati nitakapotimiza ahadi yangu ya rehema niliyoifanya kwa nyumba ya Israeli na kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, “Naama! Amatuko ngocha are ndaikeranie eira narierete chiamate chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abayuda.

English: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu wenyewe. Msikilizeni yeye.
Ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abamino, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche. Oyio nere moraigwere.

English: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Zabuloni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Sabuloni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
Kiswahili: Walipomwomba akae nao kwa muda mrefu zaidi hakukubali.
Ekegusii: Ekero bamoboretie amente amatuko ande komenya amo nabarabwo, akaanga.

English: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
Kiswahili: Lakini saa yaja, tena ipo, ambapo wale waabuduo halisi, watamwabudu Baba katika roho na kweli. Watu wanaoabudu namna hii, ndio Baba anawatafuta.
Ekegusii: Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasiimi b'ekeene barasasiime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.

English: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.
Kiswahili: basi na usikie kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako, ukafanye lolote ambalo mgeni huyo anakuomba, ili mataifa yote ya dunia wapate kujua jina lako na wakuogope kama wafanyavyo watu wako Israeli nao wapate pia kujua kwamba nyumba hii niliyoijenga imeitwa kwa Jina lako.
Ekegusii: oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi akoboria, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense bamanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na bakoirogete, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.

English: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
Kiswahili: Zebuli aliyekuwa mtawala wa mji aliposikia aliyosema Gaali mwana wa Ebedi, akakasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Sebuli, omogambi bw’omochie oria, aigwete amang’ana a Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, akaba n’endamwamu enene.

English: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies.'” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “Mwambieni Daudi, ‘Mfalme hataki zawadi nyingine kuwa mahari isipokuwa magovi 100 ya Wafilisti, ili kulipiza kisasi juu ya adui zake.' ” Mawazo ya Sauli yalikuwa Daudi akaanguke mikononi mwa Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: na Saulo akabachika bateebie Daudi ng'a, “Omorwoti taganeti omoe enibo ende yonsi ase okomonyuomera omoiseke oye, otatiga aganetie omorentere amasankwa a isiko ay'ebiimo bi'obosaacha bi'Abafilisti rigana erimo bakwete, na igo omoruserie egesiomba ase ababisa baye.” Ase enchera eyio Saulo nigo areengereretie ng'a Daudi agwe ase amaboko y'Abafilisti.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hiyo pamoja na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Naftali, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi'egesaku kia Nafutali.

English: He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
Kiswahili: Yeye atailinda miguu ya watakatifu wake, lakini waovu watanyamazishwa kwenye giza. “Si kwa nguvu mtu hushinda;
Ekegusii: “Narende amagoro yabegenwa baye, korende abakori amabe nigo barasirigwe ase omosunte, onde tari orabue ase chinguru chiaye ere omonyene.

English: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Ulamu alikuwa: Bedani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase.
Ekegusii: Ulamu nabwate omwana omomura orenge korokwa Bedani. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri o Manase.

English: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akarudi mpaka Galilaya, akiwa amejaa nguvu za Roho Mtakatifu, nazo habari zake zikaenea katika sehemu zote za nchi za kandokando.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi'Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi'ense eria.

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ndipo Wamisri watasikia juu ya jambo hili! Kwa uweza wako uliwapandisha watu hawa kutoka miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwarusetie abanto aba korwa ase ense ya Misiri ne chinguru chinene. Ekero Abamisiri bonsi baraigwe aya gwakorire ase abanto aba,

English: And he added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”
Kiswahili: Akaongeza kumwambia, “Taja ujira wako nami nitakulipa.”
Ekegusii: Bono nteebia eng’eria yao ey’oganetie, na inche ninkoyee.”

English: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, unakwenda wapi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakokwenda huwezi kunifuata sasa, lakini utanifuata baadaye.”
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane magega.”

English: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall and twelve cubits in circumference; each was hollow, four fingers thick.
Kiswahili: Kila nguzo ilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na nane, kimo chake na mzunguko dhiraa kumi na mbili, na unene wa nyanda nne, na zote zilikuwa wazi ndani.
Ekegusii: Kera eyemo ye chisiiro chiria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na atano na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere ekayeetanana. Nigo yaroisetigwe buna omobirangwa na obonetu bw’etai yaroisetie omobirangwa oria nigo bwarenge obogare bw’ebiara bine.

English: Does anyone harbor anger against another and expect healing from the Lord?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna mtu yeyote anayemkasirikia mwingine na kutarajia uponyaji kutoka kwa Bwana?
Ekegusii: Onye omonto okomenya nekeririanda ase oyomwabo, inaki ere araganie Omonene amwabere amororere amaabera?

English: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.'”
Kiswahili: na kusema, ‘Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye ameruhusu macho yangu kuona mrithi juu ya kiti changu cha ufalme leo hii.' ”
Ekegusii: agateeba: Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyo oeire oyomo ase oroiboro rwane ribaga goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane ki'oborwoti rituko ria reero, nainche neroreire ayio namaiso aane.”

English: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
Kiswahili: Hakika umesikia yale ambayo wafalme wa Ashuru wametenda kwa nchi zote, wakiwaangamiza kabisa. Je, wewe utaokolewa?
Ekegusii: Aye kwaigure aya abarwoti b’Abaasuri bakoreire chinse chionsi, bachisaririe kegima. Inee! Aye bono notooreke?

English: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
Kiswahili: Mara mfalme akatuma askari mmojawapo wa walinzi wake kukileta kichwa cha Yohana. Akaenda na kumkata Yohana kichwa humo gerezani,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima omorwoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachiika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,

English: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: na jinsi ambavyo tangu utoto umeyajua Maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukuhekimisha upate wokovu kwa njia ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Inaki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariiko amaachenu, ayaraanyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, sikia maombi yangu, usikilize maneno ya kinywa changu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, igwa ogosaba kwane; tegerera oigwe amang'ana aane ngokwana.

English: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, “Nitaingia vitani nikiwa nimejibadilisha, lakini wewe uvae majoho yako ya kifalme.” Kwa hiyo mfalme wa Israeli akajibadilisha na kwenda vitani.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli agateebia Yehosafati, “Inche nigo ngwekona ase ogwetuba timanyekana, erio ngende ase esegi, korende aye obeke chianga chiao chi’oborwoti.” Na omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli agekona ase ogwetuba tamanyekana, akagenda ase esegi.

English: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya amri aliyotoa Mfalme Dario, Tatenai mtawala wa Ngʼambo ya Mto Frati na Shethar-Bozenai na wenzao wakaitekeleza kwa bidii na kwa makini.
Ekegusii: Bono Tatenai, omogabana bw'orogongo rore bosongo y'orooche roria, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abarenge kogamba komo, bagakora ase okwerwa amang'ana ayio onsi Dario omorwoti konya achiikire.

English: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Huko Yerusalemu Daudi akaoa wake wengine zaidi na akawa baba wa wana na mabinti wengi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akanyuoma abakungu bande agwo Yerusalemu, na abwo bakamoiborera abana abange, abamura na abaiseke.

English: They spoke against the God of Jerusalem as they had spoken against the gods of the peoples of the earth—the work of human hands. Jerusalem Delivered from the Assyrians (2 Kings 19:35–37; Isaiah 37:36–38)
Kiswahili: Wakanena juu ya Mungu wa Yerusalemu kama vile walivyonena juu ya miungu ya mataifa mengine ya dunia ambayo ni kazi ya mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Bagakwana igoro ya Nyasae o Yerusalemu, buna bakwanete igoro ye chinyasae chi’abaanto b’ebisaku b’ense eye, chiria chiaroisetigwe namaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

English: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
Kiswahili: Yuda na Sila, ambao wenyewe walikuwa manabii, wakanena maneno mengi ya kuwatia moyo na kuwajenga katika imani wale ndugu walioamini.
Ekegusii: Yuda na Sila, ekiagera nababani barenge, bakaremia emioyo y'abaminto ase amang'ana amange, bakababeeka chinguru.

English: Or don't you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu (sasa ninasema na wale wanaoijua sheria), je, hamjui ya kwamba sheria ina mamlaka tu juu ya mtu wakati akiwa hai?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti, baminto (inche nigo ngokwana nabwo bamanyete amachiiko) ng'a amachiiko nigo akogaambera omonto ekero are moyo?

English: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.
Kiswahili: Nimesikia kwamba roho ya miungu iko ndani yako, na kwamba una ufahamu, akili na hekima ya pekee.
