Ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogeenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase are; na omomalaika Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tageenda.

English: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
Kiswahili: Mose akamkata yule kondoo dume vipande vipande na kukiteketeza kichwa, vile vipande na yale mafuta.
Ekegusii: Akanachana chinyama chi'emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi'enda na ebirenge namaache. Erio agasamba omotwe, na ebitari biria, n'ebitinya, ne chinyama chionsi chi'emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng'wanso kegosaambwa n'omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa nne kwa mwezi wa nne alikuwa Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, mwanawe Zebadia ndiye aliingia mahali pake kwenye uongozi. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera magega yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na vita vinavyoendelea kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
Ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

English: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mara waliposikia sauti ya baragumu, filimbi, kinubi, zeze, kinanda na aina zote za ala za uimbaji, watu wa kabila zote, mataifa na watu wa kila lugha wakaanguka chini na kuiabudu ile sanamu ya dhahabu ambayo Mfalme Nebukadneza alikuwa ameisimamisha.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ekero abanto b'ebisaku bionsi na ab'emenwa yonsi baigwete eriogi ri'ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amariogi a kera egento ki'amatera, bonsi bakaba bagatung'ama na gosasiima omogwekano bw'etaabu, oria omorwoti konya atenenetie.

English: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.
Kiswahili: Ishmaeli akawaua pia Wayahudi wote waliokuwa na Gedalia huko Mispa, pamoja na askari wa Kikaldayo waliokuwa huko.
Ekegusii: Naende Isumaeli agaita Abayahudi bonsi barenge amo na Gedalia agwo Misipa, agaita nabasikari b'Abakalidayo abwo banyorekanete bare aase agwo.

English: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu mpaka leo makuhani wa Dagoni wala wengine waingiao katika hekalu la Dagoni huko Ashdodi hawakanyagi kizingiti.
Ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
Kiswahili: Nikatazama tena: na hapo mbele yangu kulikuwa na kitabu kilichoruka!
Ekegusii: Nkaimokia amaiso aane naende, nkarora egetabu eringanirie ekoiruruka.

English: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asiyedumu katika mafundisho ya Kristo, bali akayaacha, yeye hana Mungu. Yeyote anayedumu katika mafundisho ana Baba na Mwana pia.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oragenderere goetania, na tari gotenena ase okworokereria gwa Kristo, oyio tari na Nyasae. Ere oyogotenena ase okworokereria okwo, oyio nigo are nabwo babere, Ise na Omwana.

English: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye “ ‘jiwe ambalo ninyi wajenzi mlilikataa, ambalo limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.’
Ekegusii: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.

English: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kuhani akampa ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, kwa kuwa hapakuwepo mikate mingine isipokuwa hiyo ya Wonyesho iliyokuwa imeondolewa hapo mbele za Bwana na kubadilishwa na mingine yenye moto siku ile ilipoondolewa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omokuani akaa Daudi emegati eria emechenu, ekiagera mogati onde torengeo otatiga eria konya yarusigwe korwa ase obosio bw'Omonene, erinde eyere iberera ebekweo ase rituko erio.

English: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests. The Death of Joash (2 Chronicles 24:23–27)
Kiswahili: Fedha zilizopatikana kutokana na sadaka za hatia na sadaka za dhambi hazikuletwa katika Hekalu la Bwana; zilikuwa mali ya makuhani.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chiarenge koruegwa ase okorongeyia okomocha, na echio chiarenge koruegwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe tichiarentetwe ase enyomba y’Omonene; echio nigo chiabeete echi’abakuani.

English: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”
Kiswahili: Mkumbuke Muumba wako siku za ujana wako, kabla hazijaja siku za taabu, wala haijakaribia miaka utakaposema, “Mimi sifurahii hiyo”:
Ekegusii: Moinyore Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang'e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogooko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”

English: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
Kiswahili: Ndiye aliwashinda Waedomu elfu kumi katika Bonde la Chumvi, na akauteka Sela katika vita, naye akauita Yoktheeli, jina ambalo mji huo unalo hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Amasia agaita Abaedomu chilifu ikomi agwo ase Riranya ri'enyancha y'omonyoo; akaira omochie o Sela ase okorwana esegi, akayoroka Yokiteli; naboigo okorokwa goika reero iga.

English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Lawi kufuatana na orodha zao.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.

English: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu jeraha lake halitibiki; limekuja Yuda. Limefika hasa kwenye lango la watu wangu, hata Yerusalemu kwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Amaote a Samaria takonyara kobwenigwa nabo igo Yuda yabereiri ange gochandeka enchera eyio eyio; ogotagorwa gwaikire ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu enyene agwo ase abanto bane bamenyete.”

English: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
Kiswahili: Usisumbuke kwa ajili ya watendao maovu, wala usiwaonee wivu watendao mabaya,
Ekegusii: Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.

English: He fills His hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.
Kiswahili: Huujaza mkono wake kwa umeme wa radi, na kuuagiza kulenga shabaha yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.

English: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.
Kiswahili: Sasa, Ee Mungu wa Israeli, acha neno lako lile ulilomwahidi mtumishi wako Daudi baba yangu litimie.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, tiga ring'ana riao riria gwatebeetie omosomba oo Daudi tata riikeranigwe.

English: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”
Kiswahili: Sitaifanya tena miguu ya Waisraeli iondoke tena katika nchi niliyowapa baba zenu, ikiwa watakuwa waangalifu kufanya kila kitu nilichowaamuru kuhusu sheria zote, maagizo na amri zilizotolewa kwa mkono wa Mose.”
Ekegusii: Onye Abaisraeli bagochia korenda na gokora onsi aya nabachigete, na babwate amachiiko onsi na emeroberio yonsi echiikire goetera ase Musa, rirorio tingotiga Abaisraeli barue ase ense eye naete chisokoro chiabo.”

English: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: nao Anasi na Kayafa wakiwa makuhani wakuu, neno la Mungu likamjia Yohana, mwana wa Zekaria huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: ekero ki'obokuani obonene bw'Anasi na Kayafa, ring'ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.

English: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding in every kind of literature and wisdom. And Daniel had insight into all kinds of visions and dreams.
Kiswahili: Mungu akawapa hawa vijana wanne maarifa na ufahamu wa kila aina ya maandiko na elimu. Naye Danieli aliweza kufahamu maono na aina zote za ndoto.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaa abamura baria baane chiseemi na obomanyi bw’okomanya amariiko ao ao, na obong’aini bwonsi; naende akaa Danieli obong’aini bw’okomanya engencho y’amaroro ne chindoto.

English: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli walipoona kuwa hali yao ni ya hatari na kuwa jeshi lao limesongwa sana, wakajificha katika mapango na katika vichaka, katikati ya miamba, kwenye mashimo na kwenye mahandaki.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagachia korora ng'a bamigirwe nobokong'u, bagatang'ang'a na kwebisa ase amabwago, na ase chinsana na ebitare ime, nonya nase chingoro na ase amakuruma.

English: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Hebu wajue kwamba wewe, ambaye jina lako ni Bwana, kwamba wewe peke yako ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana ya dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga bamanye ng'a naye bweka okorokwa Omonene, nigo ore Oyore Igoro Mono igoro y'ense yonsi.

English: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
Kiswahili: Malaika wale wawili wakafika Sodoma wakati wa jioni, naye Loti alikuwa ameketi kwenye lango la mji. Wakati alipowaona, aliondoka kwenda kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi chini.
Ekegusii: Abamalaika baria babere bakagenda, bagaika Sodomu mogoroba, na Loti nigo areenge oikaransete geita gia Sodomu. Ekero Loti abarooche, akaimoka kobarotota, agatugama inse, akaumama,

English: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
Kiswahili: “Je, waweza kumvua Lewiathani kwa ndoano ya samaki, au kufunga ulimi wake kwa kamba?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nonyare kong'usa Leviatani, eng'iti enene y'okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?

English: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile kwa kutokutii kwa yule mtu mmoja wengi walifanywa wenye dhambi, vivyo hivyo kwa kutii kwa mtu mmoja wengi watafanywa wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Inaki buna ase ogotaigwera kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakorwa koba abanyene ebibe, naboigo ase okogwa kw’omonto oyomo abange nabakorwe koba abanyene oboronge.

English: Hezron was the father of Ram, Ram was the father of Amminadab,
Kiswahili: Hesroni akamzaa Ramu, Ramu akamzaa Aminadabu,
Ekegusii: Hezironi akaibora Ramu, na Ramu akaibora Aminadabu;

English: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king's gate.
Kiswahili: Basi Hathaki alitoka nje kumwendea Mordekai kwenye uwanja ulio wazi wa mji mbele ya lango la mfalme.
Ekegusii: Hataki akagenda ase Moredekai agwo ase eraaro y'omochie, bosio bw'egeita ki'enyomba y'omorwoti.

English: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
Kiswahili: Wanapotoka sokoni hawawezi kula pasipo kunawa. Pia kuna desturi nyingine nyingi wanazofuata kama vile jinsi ya kuosha vikombe, vyungu na vyombo vya shaba.)
Ekegusii: Naende kobakorwa echiiro, tibakoria batesibetie. Naende nchire chingencho chinde babwate buna ogosibia ebikombe ne chinyongo, na ebinto bie chitaai.)

English: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then Yahweh said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Amosi, unaona nini?” Nikajibu, “Kikapu chenye matunda yaliyoiva.” Ndipo Bwana akaniambia, “Wakati umewadia kwa watu wangu Israeli; sitawahurumia zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Amos, ngento ki eke orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Negetonga kere namatunda amatobu.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Omoerio ocheire abanto bane Abaisraeli. Tinkobaetania nonya ng'ake.”

English: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
Kiswahili: Wale wote waliopokea ujumbe wa Petro kwa furaha wakabatizwa na siku ile waliongezeka watu wapatao 3,000.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo abanchete ring'ana riaye bakabatiswa, ne rituko riria bakamentekana abanto koreng'ana chilifu isato.

English: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Bwana, tazama hapa kuna panga mbili.” Akawajibu, “Inatosha.”
Ekegusii: Bagateeba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabateebia, “Nabo aisanire.”

English: until there arose a different king who didn't know Joseph.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme mwingine ambaye hakujua lolote kuhusu Yosefu akatawala Misri.
Ekegusii: goika omorwoti onde akabeekwa Misiri, oyotamomanyete Yusufu.

English: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
Kiswahili: Esau akamwambia Yakobo, “Haraka, nipe huo mchuzi mwekundu! Nina njaa kali sana!” (Hii ndiyo sababu pia aliitwa Edomu.)
Ekegusii: Na Esau agasaba Yakobo: “Koranche, ong'e omosori oyio omobariri inywe, ekiagera n akuure enchara.” Ase ayio bakamoroka Edomu (engencho yaye, omobariri).

English: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon. Rehoboam’s Family
Kiswahili: Wakaimarisha ufalme wa Yuda na kumuunga mkono Rehoboamu mwana wa Solomoni miaka mitatu, wakienenda katika njia za Daudi na Solomoni katika wakati huu. Jamaa Ya Rehoboamu
Ekegusii: Bagakora oborwoti bw’Abayuda bokaba obokong’u, na ase engaki y’emiaka etato bakabeeka Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, chinguru, ekiagera babwatetie chinchera chia Daudi na Sulemani ase emiaka eria etato. Abakungu na abana ba Rehoboamu

English: Judah, your brothers shall praise you. Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down to you.
Kiswahili: “Yuda, ndugu zako watakusifu; mkono wako utakuwa shingoni mwa adui zako; wana wa baba yako watakusujudia.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti biababisa bao; abamura ba iso ng’a batugame bosio bwao na amasikani.

English: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mzuri na unavyopendeza, ee pendo, kwa uzuri wako!
Ekegusii: Naki aye ore omoseera naende oyo bw'okogokia mono! Aye omwanchi bw'okogokia!

English: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
Kiswahili: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na mmoja.
Ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu.

English: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
Kiswahili: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.
Ekegusii: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man's wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
Kiswahili: “Nena na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Ikiwa mke wa mtu amepotoka na si mwaminifu kwa mumewe,
Ekegusii: Teebia Abaisraeli: Ebaise koba ng'a omokungu bw'omonto obeire otari omwegenwa' ase are.

English: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn't yet come, the time for Yahweh's house to be built.'”
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Hawa watu husema, ‘Wakati haujawadia wa kujenga nyumba ya Bwana.' ”
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: “Abanto aba nigo bagokwana ng'a engaki teraika ekero enyomba y'Omonene egwenerete koagachwa naende.”

English: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Elifazi walikuwa: Temani, Omari, Sefo, Gatamu na Kenazi; Elifazi kwa Timna akamzaa Amaleki.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, Sefo na Gatamu, Kenasi ase Timuna, na Amaleki.

English: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
Kiswahili: akusamehe dhambi zako zote, akuponya magonjwa yako yote,
Ekegusii: Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.

English: Now therefore let's make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.
Kiswahili: Sasa na tufanye agano mbele za Mungu wetu kuwafukuza hawa wanawake wote pamoja na watoto wao, kulingana na maonyo ya bwana wangu pamoja na wale ambao wanaogopa amri za Mungu wetu. Hili na lifanyike sawasawa na hii Sheria.
Ekegusii: Bono tokore okobwatana kw'ogotianania na Nyasae oito, erinde toserie abakungu abwo bonsi amo nabana babo. Tokore igo ase okobwatia ogosemia kwao, aye omonene one, na okw'abaanto abwo babeire nobwoba na koiguswa ase engencho y'amachiiko a Nyasae oito. Tiga ring'ana erio rikorwe koreng'ana namachiiko.

English: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
Kiswahili: Macho yako ni safi mno hata yasiweze kuutazama uovu, wala huwezi kuvumilia makosa. Kwa nini basi unawavumilia wadanganyifu? Kwa nini unakuwa kimya wakati waovu wanawameza wale wenye haki kuliko wao wenyewe?
Ekegusii: Aye ore namaiso amaachenu mono atari korigereria amabe na aya atari ay’oboronge, naki orakore oremererie korora abanto batari abegenwa, na okire‐kiri ekero abakori amabe bagosiria abare abanyaboronge kobabua?

English: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Eli, “Mimi nimetoka vitani sasa hivi, nimekimbia kutoka huko leo hii.” Eli akamuuliza, “Je, mwanangu, ni nini kimetokea huko?”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agateebia Eli: “Ninche narua ase esegi, natama korwao ase rituko ria reero.” Erio Eli akamobooria: “Omwana one, naki esegi yagenderera?”

English: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mwanaume akikutana kimwili na mwanaume mwenzake kama vile mwanaume afanyavyo na mwanamke, wanaume hao wawili wamefanya lililo chukizo sana. Lazima wauawe; nayo damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Onye omosacha okoraara nomosaacha onde buna akoraara n’omokuungu, abwo bonsi babere bakorire okogechia okobe; goika baitwe bakwe, na okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.

English: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
Kiswahili: Huparapara bila woga, akizifurahia nguvu zake, husonga mbele kukabiliana na silaha.
Ekegusii: Nigo egokura‐kura riroba ase ense omweya, yagokera chinguru chiaye. Erio yaminyoka koumerana nabare nebirwanero bi'esegi.

English: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
Kiswahili: Ameyakusanya maji ya bahari kama kwenye chungu; vilindi vya bahari ameviweka katika ghala.
Ekegusii: Igo agosangereria amaache yenyancha, buna amaache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.

English: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Akaweka wimbo mpya kinywani mwangu, wimbo wa sifa kwa Mungu wetu. Wengi wataona na kuogopa na kuweka tumaini lao kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Akanyorokereria oteera ogoteera okoyia, ogoteera gw'okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.

English: You are to divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Mtagawanya nchi hii miongoni mwenu kufuatana na makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Naboigo moraaterane ense eyio koreng’ana buna inwe ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli more.

English: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you've made us to swear.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa utatoa habari ya shughuli yetu tunayofanya, tutakuwa tumefunguliwa kutoka kwenye kiapo hiki ulichotufanya tuape.”
Ekegusii: Korararie amang'ana aito na otosigaane, erio natosiborwe korwa ase eira twatianire.”

English: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
Kiswahili: Mlihesabu majengo katika Yerusalemu nanyi mkabomoa nyumba ili kuimarisha ukuta.
Ekegusii: Mokabara chinyomba chia Yerusalemu, na mogachitagora ase okoroisia orwaki robe orokong'u.

English: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Benyamini: Salu mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Yoedi, mwana wa Pedaya, mwana wa Kolaya, mwana wa Maaseya, mwana wa Ithieli, mwana wa Yeshaya
Ekegusii: Ab'ororeria rwa Benjamini nabwo aba: Salu, mosinto o Mesulamu, o Yoedi, o Pedaya, o Kolaya, o Maaseya, o Itieli, o Yesaia.

English: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
Kiswahili: Ninajua ya kuwa wewe hunisikia siku zote, lakini nimesema haya kwa ajili ya umati huu uliosimama hapa, ili wapate kuamini ya kuwa wewe umenituma.”
Ekegusii: Na inche nimanyete ng’a nigo okonyigwa amatuko onsi; korende ase engencho y’omoganda oyo ong’etanaine konya nakwanire aya, banyare gwancha ng’a naye gwantomete.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, leo hii utakuwa pamoja nami Paradiso.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero nobe amo nainche Paradiso.”

English: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”
Kiswahili: wakamwambia Mose, “Tumekuwa najisi kwa sababu tumegusa maiti, lakini kwa nini tuzuiliwe kumtolea Bwana sadaka yake pamoja na Waisraeli wengine katika wakati ulioamriwa?”
Ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Intwe nigo twabeire abatachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo. Inee! Ninki kiagera twatangirwe titorua okoruegwa ase Omonene ase engaki Abaisraeli bachiikire komoruera okoruegwa kwabo?”

English: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mnapoomba, semeni: “ ‘Baba yetu (uliye mbinguni), jina lako litukuzwe, ufalme wako uje. (Mapenzi yako yafanyike hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.)
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, Komogosaba, teba iga: Tata, Erieta riao risikwe, Oborwoti bwao boche,

English: Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel. No king of Judah was like him, either before him or after him.
Kiswahili: Hezekia aliweka tumaini lake kwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli. Hapakuwepo na mfalme mwingine wa kufanana naye miongoni mwa wafalme wa Yuda, kabla yake au baada yake.
Ekegusii: Hezekia akaba ogosemeri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Onde tabeete buna ere ase egati y’abarwoti bonsi b’Abayuda baria bamobwatetie gose baria bamotang’anerete.

English: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
Kiswahili: akaharibu mizabibu yao na miti ya tini, na akaangamiza miti ya nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Agasaria emesabibu na emeko yabo, emete y'ense eria ekabunwa.

English: A voice of one calling: “Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya mtu aliaye: “Itengenezeni jangwani njia ya Bwana, nyoosheni njia kuu nyikani kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ogoteeba: “Roisia enchera y’Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.

English: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba atafanya nini? Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, kisha atawapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Bono inki rende omonene oria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu arakore? Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.

English: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
Kiswahili: Wengine wanatumaini magari ya vita, na wengine farasi, bali sisi tutalitumainia jina la Bwana, Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo basemeretie chigari chi'esegi, na abande chibarasi chi'esegi, korende intwe nigo tosemeretie erieta ri'Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: Yahweh was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na watu wa Yuda. Wakaimiliki nchi ya vilima, lakini hawakuweza kuwafukuza watu waliokaa katika hiyo tambarare, kwa sababu walikuwa na magari ya chuma.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo n'Abayuda, na barabwo bakayeira ense y'ebitunwa, korende tibanyaarete goseeria abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babwate chigari chi'ebioma.

English: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akalileta shauri lao mbele za Bwana,
Ekegusii: Musa akaira amang'ana abo ase obosio bw'Omonene,

English: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe, n'ebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko ri'ekiina kobua ase more.

English: Don't associate with a woman who is a singer, lest perhaps you be caught by her tricks.
Kiswahili: Usishirikiane na mwanamke ambaye ni mwimbaji, usije ukakamatwa na hila zake.
Ekegusii: Totwara oboamate n'omokuungu omoteeri, ekiagera nigo arabaisa kobwatwa ase n'obong'aini bwaye.

English: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hands and place it before the altar of the LORD your God,
Kiswahili: Kuhani atapokea lile kapu mikononi mwako na kuliweka chini mbele ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: “Erio Omokuani arusie egetonga keria korwa ase okoboko kwao akebeeke bosio bw’egesasiimero kia Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be My people.
Kiswahili: Maskani yangu yatakuwa pamoja nao, nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu wangu.
Ekegusii: Obomenyo bwane mbobe amo nabarabwo, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto bane.

English: For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Tazama! Tai anashuka chini, akitanda mabawa yake juu ya Moabu.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Egesaku gete nkeiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y'Abamoabu.

English: Then you are to sound the horn far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement. You shall sound it throughout your land.
Kiswahili: Ndipo tarumbeta itapigwa kila mahali katika siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa saba. Katika Siku ya Upatanisho, piga tarumbeta katika nchi yako yote.
Ekegusii: Erio ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa, egetureeri kebugigwe ase ense yaino yonsi.

English: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaileta mifupa ya Sauli na ya mwanawe Yonathani kutoka huko, pia mifupa ya wale waliokuwa wameuawa na kutupwa ilikusanywa.
Ekegusii: Daudi akarenta amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo; boigo agasangereria amauga y'abanto baria batano na babere konya batongirwe.

English: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.
Kiswahili: Nabii Yeremia akatunga maombolezo kwa ajili ya kifo chake, nao waimbaji wote, wanaume kwa wanawake, hufanya ukumbusho wa Yosia katika maombolezo hadi leo. Haya yakafanywa desturi katika Israeli, nayo yameandikwa katika Maombolezo.
Ekegusii: Yeremia akaroisia ogoteera kw'amagombo igoro ya Yosia, na abateri bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, babeire bagwatora Yosia ase amatera abo ay'amagombo nonya ngoika reero iga. Ayio akaba engencho Abaisraeli benaretie. Ogoteera okwo nigo korikire ase Egetabu ki'Amatera 'Amagombo.

English: Then he must sacrifice the turtledoves or young pigeons, whichever he can afford,
Kiswahili: Kisha atatoa dhabihu wale hua ama yale makinda ya njiwa ambayo mtu ataweza kuwapata,
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria arue riruma gose riige rie riruma, koreng’ana buna aranyare koyanyora.

English: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anayeamini kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo amezaliwa na Mungu, na yeyote ampendaye Baba humpenda pia mtoto aliyezaliwa naye.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oyobwegenete ng’a Yeso nere Kristo oiboirwe na Nyasae, na kera oyoramwanche omoibori, omwanchire na oyoiboirwe nere.

English: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
Kiswahili: Lolote mfanyalo, ikiwa ni kwa neno au kwa tendo, fanyeni yote katika jina la Bwana Yesu, mkimshukuru Mungu Baba katika yeye.
Ekegusii: Na kera eki mogokora, ase amang'ana gose ase ogokora, mokore kera egento ase erieta ri'Omonene Yeso, mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng'a mbuya mono goetera asare.

English: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
Kiswahili: nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.’
Ekegusii: ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chire igoro nachitengechigwe.

English: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair at its head and covered it with clothes.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mikali akachukua kinyago, akakilaza kitandani, akakifunika kwa vazi na kukiwekea singa za mbuzi kichwani.
Ekegusii: Mikali akaimokia omogwekano bw'ogosasimwa orenge nyomba ime, akaywareria borere, akabeeka amanya e chimbori asisire ase omotwe bw'omogwekano oria, erio akayobisia egetambaa.

English: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa Mungu ameilegeza kamba ya upinde wangu na kunitesa, wamekuwa huru kunitendea waonavyo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ong’urire chinguru, naende onkorire koba omoitongo, na abanto abwo babeire abaremu ase ogonkorera bobe.

English: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
Kiswahili: Naye atakapokuja, atauthibitishia ulimwengu kuhusu dhambi, haki na hukumu.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero arache ere, naenekerie ense ase amang'ana 'ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekiina;

English: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
Kiswahili: Je, mmesahau uovu uliotendwa na baba zenu, na wafalme na malkia wa Yuda, na uovu uliofanywa na ninyi na wake zenu katika nchi ya Yuda na barabara za Yerusalemu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mwebire obobe bwe chisokoro chiaino na obw'abarwoti b'Abayuda, na obw'abakungu babo, na obwaino, na obw'abakungu baino, obwo bwakoretwe ase ense y'Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu?

English: The Lord plucked up the roots of nations and planted the lowly in their place.
Kiswahili: Bwana aling'oa mizizi ya mataifa na kuwapanda wanyonge mahali pao.
Ekegusii: Nyasae obasebareranirie aberori korwa ase oboroso bwabo; nase ribaga riabo oikaransirie abaitongo.

English: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya mtu aliaye: “Itengenezeni jangwani njia ya Bwana, nyoosheni njia kuu nyikani kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri'oyogoaka egeturi ogoteeba: “Roisia enchera y'Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.

English: you must do to him as he intended to do to his brother. So you must purge the evil from among you.
Kiswahili: basi mtende kama alivyotaka kumtendea ndugu yake. Ni lazima mwondoe uovu miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Komoranyore ng’a n’oborimo, erio mokorere kirori oria amang’ana aria aria ere arengereretie gokorera oyomwabo. Naboigo morusie obobe borue ase more.

English: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.
Kiswahili: Yonathani akafanya agano na Daudi kwa sababu alimpenda kama nafsi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Yonathani agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Daudi, ekiagera nigo amwanchete buna eanchete ere omonyene.

English: he especially took advantage of the nights for such assaults. His courage was loudly talked of everywhere.
Kiswahili: Alitumia vyema usiku kwa mashambulizi kama hayo. Ujasiri wake ulizungumziwa kila mahali.
Ekegusii: Chinsa chia botuko nigo chiare komobera buya mono ase okoboera okwo. Kera ase abanto nigo bare gokwana igoro y'obobui bwaye.

English: And you have shown this day how well you have dealt with me; for when the LORD delivered me into your hand, you did not kill me.
Kiswahili: Sasa umeniambia juu ya mema uliyonitendea. Bwana alinitia mikononi mwako, lakini wewe hukuniua.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria reero kwaorokirie buna gwakorire amaya ase ’nde, ekiagera otang’ita ekero Omonene ambeeka ase okoboko kwao.

English: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usimdhulumu wala kumwibia jirani yako. “ ‘Usishikilie mshahara wa kibarua usiku kucha hadi asubuhi.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa korianania omogisangio oo, gose komourereria. Tobaisa gotanga eng'eria y'omonto origete okogokorera emeremo, tebeera ase ore goika mambia.

English: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples.
Kiswahili: basi nitakatilia mbali Israeli kutoka nchi niliyowapa, nami nitalikataa Hekalu hili nililolitakasa kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Ndipo Israeli itakuwa kitu cha kudharauliwa na watu na kuwa kitu cha kudhihakiwa miongoni mwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: rirorio ninsirie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense eria nabaeire, na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetige, tinkoyerigereria namaiso aane. Abaisraeli nababe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wakamjia Yesu na kumjaribu kwa kumwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Abafarisai na Abasadukai bagaacha ase ogoteema Yeso, bakamosaba aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.

English: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, naja upesi! Thawabu yangu i mkononi mwangu, nami nitampa kila mtu sawasawa na alivyotenda.
Ekegusii: “Rigereria, ninchiche bwango, ndetane eng'eria yane amo nainche, ning'ee kera omonto buna ogokora kwaye kore.

English: “‘If by these things you won't be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa pamoja na mambo haya hamtakubali maonyo yangu lakini mkaendelea kuweka uadui nami,
Ekegusii: “Komoraabe mwanyorire egesusuro ekio gionsi timong'iranera, korende mogenderere koba mamincha yane,

English: choosing therefore that this nation also should be free from disturbance, we determine that their temple is to be restored to them, and that they live according to the customs that were in the days of their ancestors.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, tukichagua kwamba taifa hili nalo liwe huru kutokana na usumbufu, tunaamua kwamba hekalu lao lirudishwe kwao, na kwamba waishi kulingana na desturi zilizokuwako siku za baba zao.
Ekegusii: Bono ase engencho 'ntagete bamenye batabwati bwoba buna ebisaku binde ase oborwoti bwane, bono narure ogochika buna bairanerigwe Hekalu yabo, nagotigwa bamenye kobwatekana n'echingencho chi'echisokoro chiabo.

English: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don't be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn't answer, neither did she regard it.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akifa, wanawake waliokuwa wanamhudumia wakamwambia, “Usikate tamaa, umemzaa mwana.” Lakini hakujibu wala kuweka maanani.
Ekegusii: Ekero areenge ang'e nogokwa, abakungu abaarenge komokoonya ase okomoiboria bakamoteebia: “Toiroka, ekiagera kwaiboire omwana omomura.” Korende omokungu oria tabairaneria gento, gose tategerera amang'ana abo.

English: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, unaona shida na huzuni, umekubali kuyapokea mkononi mwako. Mhanga anajisalimisha kwako, wewe ni msaada wa yatima.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okorora abachandeku na komanya okwerera kwabo, amang’ana ayio nigo oyabegete ase amaboko ao. Omonto otari na gokonywa konde nigo akwerua asore, ekiagera naye botambe ogokonya chintakana.

English: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
Kiswahili: Kama watoto wachanga, waliozaliwa sasa, yatamanini maziwa ya kiroho yasiyochanganywa na kitu kingine chochote, ili kwa hayo mpate kukua katika wokovu,
Ekegusii: Buna abana ebing’werere baiborwa reero iga, moganie amabeere ’ekeene ay’omoika, erinde monyare gokina ase aro, na goikera ogotooreka,

English: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
Kiswahili: Wanatangatanga wakitafuta chakula, wasipotosheka hubweka kama mbwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakoong’anya korigia endagera, batayenyoreti nigo bakogeesa bokia.

English: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.
Kiswahili: Wachungaji hawatakuwa na mahali pa kukimbilia, viongozi wa kundi hawatapata mahali pa kutorokea.
Ekegusii: Abarisia tibakonyora ase baratamere; abanene be riicho tibagotooreka.

English: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
Kiswahili: ambaye hatalipwa mara mia katika ulimwengu huu: nyumba, ndugu wa kiume na wa kike, mama na baba na watoto, mashamba pamoja na mateso, kisha uzima wa milele katika ulimwengu ujao.
Ekegusii: ere naegwe ebinge ase chingaki echi chia bono, na ase ense egochi-gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: the angel who has redeemed me from all harm— may He bless these boys. And may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
Kiswahili: Malaika ambaye aliniokoa kutoka madhara yote, yeye na awabariki vijana hawa. Na waitwe kwa jina langu na kwa majina ya baba zangu Abrahamu na Isaki, wao na waongezeke kwa wingi katika dunia.”
Ekegusii: omomalaika oria ontooretie korwa ase amabe onsi, asesenie abamura aba. Abana aba babe bagwatorwa ase erieta riane, na ase erieta ria sokoro yane Aburaamu, na eria Isaka tata; tiga bakine babe abanto abange ase ense.”

English: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.” Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!” Worship before the Ark
Kiswahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Nao watu wote wakasema, “Amen,” na “Msifuni Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, korwa kare na kare, na gochia kare na kare! Erio abanto bonsi bagateeba, “Amina!” Na bakamotogia Omonene. Ogosasiima ase Yerusalemu na Gibeoni

English: He said to them, “Let's go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Twendeni mahali pengine kwenye vijiji jirani, ili niweze kuhubiri huko pia, kwa sababu hicho ndicho nilichokuja kukifanya.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Togende aase aande goika ebinyoro bire ang'e, ninyare korandia na aroro boigo, ekiagera ase ayio naro nachicheire.”

English: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for Yahweh's house, were of burnished bronze.
Kiswahili: masufuria, masepetu na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia. Vyombo hivi vyote ambavyo Huramu alimtengenezea Mfalme Solomoni kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana vilikuwa vya shaba iliyongʼarishwa.
Ekegusii: ne chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Ebinto ebio bionsi biaatoire nigo biare ebibekerero bi'enyomba y'Omonene, Hiramu aroiseretie omorwoti Sulemani. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaai chisibirie buya.

English: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana hatawafurahia vijana, wala hatawahurumia yatima na wajane, kwa kuwa kila mmoja wao hamchi Mungu, nao ni waovu, na kila kinywa kinanena upotovu. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene tari nomogooko ase abasae babo, na tari namaabera ase chintakana na ababoraka babo, ekiagera kera omonto nomosaria ase Nyasae, na omokori amabe, na kera oyomo nigo agokwana ay'oboriri. Ase engencho y'ayio onsi Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.

English: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed him in his palace.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Amoni wakafanya fitina juu yake, nao wakamuulia kwake nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baye bagakora omooroberio bw’okomoita na bakamoitera ase enyomba yaye ime.

English: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
Kiswahili: “Sema na kusanyiko lote la Israeli na uwaambie: ‘Kuweni watakatifu, kwa kuwa mimi, Bwana Mungu wenu, ni mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Teebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli: Mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo inde omochenu,

English: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.
Kiswahili: Mabaharia wote waliogopa na kila mmoja akamlilia mungu wake mwenyewe. Nao wakatupa mizigo baharini ili meli ipungue uzito. Lakini Yona alikuwa ameteremkia chumba cha ndani ya meli, mahali ambapo alilala na kupatwa na usingizi mzito.
Ekegusii: Erio abagendia b'emeeri bakaondoka, na kera oyomo akarangeria enyasae yaye ng'a emokonye. Abanto abwo bakaimokia chigurube chiarenge ase emeeri ime, bagachituguta gochia ase enyancha ime, ng'a nario emeeri eragusue. Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y'emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.

English: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Hadadi alipofariki, Samla kutoka Masreka akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Hadadi akwete, Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Whoever doesn't do according to the word of the king, he shall die.
Kiswahili: Yeyote asiyefanya kulingana na neno la mfalme, atakufa.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi orenge koamererania nogochika kwomorwoti akanacherwa ogokwa.

English: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
Kiswahili: (Lakini Geshuri na Aramu wakateka miji ya Hawoth-Yairi, pamoja na Kenathi na viunga vyake; jumla ilikuwa miji sitini.) Wote hawa walikuwa wazao wa Makiri babaye Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Korende Abagesuri na Abaaramu bakaira korwa asare emechie etano nomo (6), emechie ya Yairi na Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo. Abanto bonsi bamenyeteo nigo barenge b’ororeria rwa Makiri ise Gileadi,

English: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
Kiswahili: Baadaye Mungu akamjaribu Abrahamu. Akamwambia, “Abrahamu!” Abrahamu akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y'amang'ana ayio, Nyasae akabeekera Aburaamu ogoteemwa. Akamorangeria: “Aburaamu!” Na Aburaamu akamoitabeera. “Nao inde aa.”

English: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa, “Naomi, aliyerudi hapa kutoka nchi ya Moabu, anauza sehemu ya ardhi iliyokuwa mali ya ndugu yetu Elimeleki.
Ekegusii: Erio Boazi agateebia omonyamwando oria, “Naomi, oria oirana korwa ense y'Abamoabu, nkoonia are oboremo boria bwarenge omwando bw'Elimeleki ominto.

English: His young ones feast on blood; and where the slain are, there he is.”
Kiswahili: Makinda yake hujilisha damu, na pale palipo na machinjo, ndipo yeye alipo.”
Ekegusii: Amage aye nigo akonywa amanyinga, na aase emebere ekwete ere, nao ekeongo kere.”

English: And all men are from the ground. Adam was created from dust.
Kiswahili: Na wanadamu wote wametoka ardhini. Adamu aliumbwa kwa mavumbi.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo barwete ase riroba na Adamu nigo atongetwe korwa ime y'orotu.

English: But now listen, O Jacob My servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa sikiliza, ee Yakobo, mtumishi wangu, Israeli, niliyemchagua.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Israeli nagochorire, bono igwa!

English: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda Waamoni wakafanya vita na Israeli,
Ekegusii: Engaki egaika, ekero Abaamoni bachaagete korwania Abaisraeli.

English: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu, akijua makusudi yao mabaya, akawaambia, “Enyi wanafiki, kwa nini mnajaribu kunitega?
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire obong'ainereria bwabo, akabora, “Inaki mogonteema, inwe abang'ainereria?

English: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
Kiswahili: Kwa mkewe Hodeshi, akawazaa wana saba: Yobabu, Sibia, Mesha, Malkamu,
Ekegusii: Hodesi mokaye akamoiborera abana abamura, nabwo aba: Yobabu na Zibia, na Mesa, na Malikamu,

English: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,
Kiswahili: “Lakini mara walipokuwa na raha, wakafanya maovu tena machoni pako. Kisha ukawaacha mikononi mwa adui zao, nao wakawatawala. Walipokulilia tena, ukasikia kutoka mbinguni, na kwa huruma zako ukawaokoa kila mara.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya banyorire obotoereru, bagakora ebibe asore naende; aye ogatiga ababisa babo bakababua na kobagambera. Nonya naboigo, ekero barenge gokoiranera na korera asore, nigo kwarenge kobaigwa korwa agwo igoro, na ase engencho y'amaabera ao amange nigo kwabeete gokobatooria ase chingaki chinyinge.

English: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off Ahab's house.
Kiswahili: Mungu alikuwa ameamuru kwamba kuanguka kwa Ahazia kungetokea atakapokwenda kumwona Yoramu. Ahazia alipowasili, wakatoka pamoja na Yoramu ili kwenda kukutana na Yehu mwana wa Nimshi, ambaye Bwana alikuwa amemtia mafuta kuangamiza nyumba ya Ahabu.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya nigo achigetwe na Nyasae ng'a okogwa kw'Ahasia kobe ase okogenda kwaye korora Yoramu. Ekero Ahasia aigete aroro, nigo agendete amo na Yoramu koumerana na Yehu, mosinto o Nimusi, ori'Omonene aagete amaguta, erinde asirie enyomba y'Ahabu.

English: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi kama pasipo kukusudia umeshindwa kushika mojawapo katika amri hizi ambazo Bwana alimpa Mose,
Ekegusii: “Korende nenyare koba ng’a mwamochire kobwatia amachiiko ande onsi Omonene achiikire Musa,

English: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
Kiswahili: “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa nami kwa muda wa siku tatu na hawana chakula.
Ekegusii: “Naroreire abanto aba amaabera, ekiagera barabwo babeire amatuko atato baikaransete amo nainche batari na gento bakoria;

English: Menelaus left his own brother Lysimachus for his deputy in the high priesthood; and Sostratus left Crates, who was over the Cyprians.
Kiswahili: Menelao alimwacha kaka yake Lysimako kama naibu wake katika ukuhani mkuu; na Sostrato alimwacha Crates, ambaye alikuwa mkuu wa Wakipro.
Ekegusii: Menelao agachora momura omwabo ore korokwa Lisimako koba omokonyi oye na Sostrato agachora Krate koba omoteneneri omonene bw'abarwani esegi ba Kuporo.

English: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
Kiswahili: Ninawi ni kama dimbwi, nayo maji yake yanakauka. Wanalia, “Simama! Simama!” Lakini hakuna anayegeuka nyuma.
Ekegusii: Buna amache akorwa korwa ase ritibo riatekire, abanto baayareire korwa Ninawi!. “Tenena! Tenena!” Nigo bakorera korende onde tari okorigereria magega.

English: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life, righteousness, and honor.
Kiswahili: Yeye afuatiaye haki na upendo hupata uzima, mafanikio na heshima.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorigia oboronge na obwororo, oyio ’nanyore obogima, na amasikani, na oboronge.

English: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Yuko wapi?” Siba akajibu, “Yuko nyumbani kwa Makiri mwana wa Amieli huko Lo-Debari.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Ng'ai akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Nigo akare o Makiri, mosinto bw'Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.”

English: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikaangalia wakati Mwana-Kondoo akivunja ile lakiri ya kwanza miongoni mwa zile saba. Ndipo nikasikia mmoja wa wale viumbe wanne wenye uhai akisema kwa sauti kama ya radi: “Njoo!”
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora Emanwa y'Eng'ondi ogosansora ekemanyererio ekemo kia bitano na bibere, nkaigwa eyemo ye ching'iti chiria chire moyo egokwana neriogi buna eri'enkoba, egoteeba, “Inchuo!”

English: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
Kiswahili: Wakafika mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore),

English: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn't know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipoona, wakaambiana, “Hiki ni nini?” Kwa kuwa hawakujua kilikuwa kitu gani. Mose akawaambia, “Huu ndio mkate ambao Bwana amewapa mle.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy'Omonene abaeire morie.

English: Then a second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
Kiswahili: Malaika wa pili akafuata akisema, “Umeanguka! Umeanguka Babeli Mkuu, ule uliyafanya mataifa yote kulewa kwa mvinyo wa ghadhabu ya uasherati wake.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika onde, oyo o kabere, akamotunyana, ogoteeba, “Babiloni ogure! Babiloni, omochie oria omonene, ogure, oyo onyoisirie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi edivai y’endamwamu y’obotomani bwaye!”

English: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
Kiswahili: Adamu akamwita mkewe Eva, kwa kuwa atakuwa mama wa wote walio hai.
Ekegusii: Adamu akaaroka mokaye Hawa, ekiagera ere nere ng'ina bw'abare moyo bonsi.

English: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn't worship the image of the beast to be killed.
Kiswahili: Akapewa uwezo wa kuipa pumzi ile sanamu ya yule mnyama wa kwanza, ili iweze kusema na kuwasababisha wale wote waliokataa kuiabudu hiyo sanamu kuuawa.
Ekegusii: Ekaegwa ribaga kobekera omogwekano bw'eng'iti eria omoika, goika omogwekano oria okwane, na ogere abanto bonsi abatasasimete omogwekano oria bw'eng'iti baitwe.

English: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nawaambia ninyi, kama hawa wakinyamaza, mawe yatapiga kelele.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabatebirie: Aba nabaisa gokira, amagena aya naake eriogi.”

English: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa watumishi wa kuhani mkuu, ndugu yake yule mtu ambaye Petro alikuwa amemkata sikio, akamuuliza, “Je, mimi sikukuona kule bustanini ukiwa na Yesu?”
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba b’Omokuani Omonene, omoamate bw’oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakorooche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”

English: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliyasema haya akionyesha ni kifo gani atakachokufa.
Ekegusii: Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.

English: And Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
Kiswahili: Bethueli akamzaa Rebeka. Milka alimzalia Nahori nduguye Abrahamu hao wana wanane.
Ekegusii: Betueli nere omoiborete omoiseke ore korokwa Rebeka. Abwo batano na batato nabwo Milka aiborerete Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.

English: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.
Kiswahili: (Basi Yuda alinunua shamba kwa zile fedha za uovu alizopata; akiwa huko shambani akaanguka, akapasuka na matumbo yote yakatoka nje.
Ekegusii: (Naboigo, goetera ase engeria eria aakanetwe ase egekoro kiaye ki'obobe, ere Yudasi akagora omogondo agwo ase agwete goika agakwa; akoreka, erio amara aye onsi agasoka.

English: The prince, the judge, and the mighty man will be honored. There is not one of them greater than he who fears the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mkuu, mwamuzi, na mtu hodari wataheshimiwa. Hakuna hata mmoja wao aliye mkuu kuliko yeye amchaye Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omogambi, na omonachi ebina oyio obwate ekerogo oyio nigo agosikwa, korende oyo omoirogete Nyasae n'omonene kegima kobua bonsi abwo.

English: At his appearing, the mountains will be shaken. At his will, the south wind will blow.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuonekana kwake, milima itatikisika, na kwa mapenzi yake, upepo wa kusini utavuma.
Ekegusii: Ekero akororekana, ebigoro nigo bigotengecha, ase okogania kwaye omwaga o Irianyi nigo okogusa.

English: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama urithi hupatikana kwa sheria, basi hautegemei tena ahadi, lakini Mungu kwa neema yake alimpa Abrahamu urithi kwa njia ya ahadi. Kusudi La Sheria
Ekegusii: Naki omwando korabe ase amachiiko, tokoba naende ase eira; korende Nyasae akayoa Aburaamu ase eira.

English: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field. When he brought them to his mother, Rachel begged Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna ngano, Reubeni akaenda shambani akakuta tunguja, ambazo alizileta kwa Lea mama yake. Raheli akamwambia Lea, “Tafadhali nakuomba unipe baadhi ya tunguja za mwanao.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki ye rigesa ri’engano Rubeni akagenda akanyora amasooni ng’ombe getii, akayatwa, akayarentera Lea ng’ina.

English: Then Jehoshaphat bowed facedown, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down before the LORD to worship Him.
Kiswahili: Yehoshafati akainamisha uso wake chini, nao watu wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu wakaanguka chini ili kuabudu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Yehosafati na Abayuda bonsi, amo nabaanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, bagatung’ama bakaumama ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakamosasiima.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Shalumu, na mauaji aliyoyafanya, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana onsi igoro ya Salumu, na omooroberio oria bw'ogoita akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'ogokora kw'Abarwoti b'Abaisraeli.

English: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
Kiswahili: Lakini huyo mwanamke akapewa mabawa mawili ya tai mkubwa, kusudi aweze kuruka mpaka mahali palipotayarishwa kwa ajili yake huko jangwani, ambako atatunzwa kwa wakati na nyakati na nusu, ya wakati ambako yule joka hawezi kufika.
Ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akaegwa chimbaaba ibere buna echi’ekeongo enene, anyare koiruruka korwa ase eng’iti eria gochia ase erooro aase agochia korendwa ase engaki y’emiaka etato na ekeng’ese.

English: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn't open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.
Kiswahili: Wakangoja hata wakawa na fadhaa, basi wakati hakufungua milango ya chumba, wakachukua funguo na kuifungua. Tazama wakaona bwana wao amelala sakafuni, amekufa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaganya egeka goika bakaganyora. Nonya naboigo, omorwoti taigora egesieri ki'enyomba eyio. Ase igo bakaimokia ekeigorero, bakaigora ebisieri, na Ani! Omonene obo nigo arambereretie inse okwete.

English: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
Kiswahili: kutoka Yuda, ni Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.

English: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.
Kiswahili: Wakati Daudi alipokuwa ameketi kati ya lango la ndani na la nje, mlinzi akapanda juu ya paa la lango kupitia ukutani. Alipotazama nje, akaona mtu mmoja akikimbia peke yake.
Ekegusii: Bono Daudi nigo aikaransete egati y'ebiita bibere bi'omochie, egia isiko na ekia ime. Omorendi akariina gochia kerama igoro y'ebiita, ang'e norwaki. Na ekero arigereretie akarora omonto oyomo okominyoka goocha ore bweka.

English: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Kiswahili: Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wanafiki, mahali ambako kutakuwa ni kulia na kusaga meno.
Ekegusii: ere namonachane abe ebing’ese namobeeke amo nabang’ainereria. Aroro abanto ’mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.

English: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
Kiswahili: Yeye apataye hekima huipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, yeye ahifadhiye ufahamu hustawi.
Ekegusii: Omonto okonyora obong'aini, oyio nere obwanchire obogima bwaye, na oyo okorenda obomanyi bwaye nanyore amaya.

English: For the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites and commanded them, “Do not worship other gods or bow down to them; do not serve them or sacrifice to them.
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana alipofanya Agano na Waisraeli, aliwaamuru akisema: “Msiiabudu miungu mingine yoyote wala kuisujudia, wala kuitumikia wala kuitolea dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, akabachika, “Timobaisa koiroka chinyasae ching’ao, gose gotung’ama gochisasiima; timochikorera gose timochiruera ebing’wanso.

English: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
Kiswahili: Niliwatesa watu wa Njia hii hadi kufa, nikiwakamata waume kwa wake na kuwatupa gerezani,
Ekegusii: Ngachanda abanto b’Enchera eye goika nkabaita bagakwa, ngasiba abasacha na abakungu na kobabeeka echela ime,

English: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Kiswahili: jihadhari usije ukamwacha Bwana, aliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.
Ekegusii: Komoraikeo mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase mwarenge abasomba.

English: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda wa kama saa moja hivi, mtu mwingine akazidi kusisitiza, “Kwa hakika huyu mtu naye alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, kwa maana yeye pia ni Mgalilaya.”
Ekegusii: Na magega y’ensa eyemo, omonto onde akabetereria mono, akabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge amo nere, ekiagera nere n’Omogalili.”

English: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote kuanzia umri wa miaka thelathini hadi hamsini ambao walikuja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania,
Ekegusii: Bakariika abasacha bonsi abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile viziwi watasikia maneno ya kitabu, na katika utusitusi na giza macho ya kipofu yataona.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emetino neebe ekoigwa amang'ana ariikire ase egetabu, na emeuko yarenge ekorora buna rikongori na omosunte, nerore buya namaiso abo.

English: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
Kiswahili: Pia niliweka Agano langu nao kuwapa nchi ya Kanaani, ambako waliishi kama wageni.
Ekegusii: Naende ninche nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ng’a nimbae ense ya Kaanani, ense eria barenge buna abamenyi.

English: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
Kiswahili: Waovu huzuiliwa nuru yao, nao mkono wao ulioinuliwa huvunjwa.
Ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bogotangwa korwa ase abakori amabe, ne chinguru chiabo chi'okweenenia nigo chikobunwa chiasirigwa.

English: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Anathothi na Almoni, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.
Ekegusii: na Anatoti, na Alamoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sheria ya Mose na Kitabu cha Manabii kusomwa, viongozi wa sinagogi wakawatumia ujumbe wakisema, “Ndugu, kama mna neno la kuwafariji watu hawa, tafadhali lisemeni.”
Ekegusii: Magega kabasomire amachiiko na egetabu y'ababani, abatang'ani b'esinagogi bagatoma amang'ana ase bare kobateebia: “Abaminto, onye more ne ring'ana ri'okoremia, rikwane!”

English: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka kwenye milima ya Abarimu na kupiga kambi kwenye tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Bakarua ebitunwa bi'Abarimu, bakageenda bagaika ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang'e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, bagatoora aroro.

English: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Amasa alipokwenda kuwaita Yuda, alichukua muda mrefu zaidi ya ule mfalme aliokuwa amemwekea.
Ekegusii: Amasa akageenda kobarangeria, korende agateebana, tairana ase engaki eria omorwoti, amobeekerete.

English: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na moja Yakini, ya ishirini na mbili Gamuli,
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo bokagwera Yakini, na obwa emerongo ebere na kabere Gamuli;

English: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Fanyeni hukumu za haki, onyesheni rehema na huruma ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: “Omonene bw'Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Monache ebiina bia boronge, na kera omonto abe nobwanchani na amaabera ase oyomwabo.

English: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapita katika Galilaya yote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge kona goetanana ase ense engima ya Galili, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya y’oborwoti, okogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi obwarenge ase abanto.

English: Let's not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don't give up.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, tusichoke katika kutenda mema, kwa kuwa tutavuna kwa wakati wake tusipokata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Titorosa gokora amaya, ekiagera natogese ekero engaki eraike, totakweti emioyo.

English: At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold with which he had plated the doors and doorposts of the temple of the LORD, and he gave it to the king of Assyria. Sennacherib Threatens Jerusalem (2 Chronicles 32:9–19; Isaiah 36:1–22)
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda akabandua dhahabu yote iliyokuwa imefunika milango na miimo ya Hekalu la Bwana, akampa mfalme wa Ashuru. Senakeribu Anaitishia Yerusalemu (2 Nyakati 32:1-19; Isaya 36:1-22)
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Hezekia akaomora chitaabu korwa ase ebisieri bie Hekalu y’Omonene, na korwa ase emetobwa y’ebisieri eria ere omonyene aoomete, agachia omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
Kiswahili: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.
Ekegusii: Tokoonye, torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokoonywa gokorwa ase Mwanyabaanto mbosa.

English: One of Joab's young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa watu wa Yoabu akasimama kando ya Amasa, akasema, “Yeyote ampendaye Yoabu na yeyote aliye upande wa Daudi, na amfuate Yoabu!”
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw'abasomba ba Yoabu agatenena ang'e nomobere bw'Amasa akabora, “Oyo omwanchete Yoabu na oyore oyo'Daudi, tiga atuny'ane Yoabu.”

English: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn't take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;
Kiswahili: kusema: “Hili ndilo asemalo Yefta, Israeli hawakuchukua nchi ya Moabu wala ya Waamoni.
Ekegusii: bamoteebie “Oko nokoiraneria kwa Yefta: Abaisraeli tibaireti rogongo rw'Abamoabu, gose rw'Abaamoni,

English: Its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico had the same measurements as the others. Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
Kiswahili: Vyumba vyake, kuta zake na baraza yake vilikuwa na vipimo vilivyo sawa na vile vingine. Lile lango pamoja na baraza yake vilikuwa na madirisha pande zote. Urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa hamsini na upana wake dhiraa ishirini na tano.
Ekegusii: Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Boigo ebibao mbiarengeo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, na ase egesona. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye bw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.

English: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
Kiswahili: Mpaka utaelekea kusini kuanzia Shefamu hadi Ribla upande wa mashariki wa Aini, na kuendelea kwenye miteremko mashariki mwa Bahari ya Kinerethi.
Ekegusii: naende rotirimboke gochia Ribula, moocha y'Aini, rotirimboke gochia moocha y'engegu y'enyancha ya Galili.

English: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.
Kiswahili: “Kutoka juu alipeleka moto, akaushusha katika mifupa yangu. Aliitandia wavu miguu yangu na akanirudisha nyuma. Akanifanya mkiwa, na mdhaifu mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba ase amagoro aane; ong'iranirie magega; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru nde n'obororo omobaso boira.

English: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
Kiswahili: wa sita Osemu, na wa saba Daudi.
Ekegusii: Osemu oyo o gatano na rimo, na Daudi oyo o gatano na kabere.

English: They have ears, but they can't hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Kiswahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, wala hakuna pumzi katika vinywa vyao.
Ekegusii: nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, gose tebwati omoika bw'okoeyana.

English: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Isakari walipokea Kedeshi, Daberathi,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kedesi na Daberati,

English: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
Kiswahili: katika utauwa, upendano wa ndugu; na katika upendano wa ndugu, upendo.
Ekegusii: na ase chingencho chi'obonyasae obwanchani bw'obomino, na ase obwanchani bw'obomino mwanche bonsi.

English: Nevertheless, they will become his servants, so that they may learn the difference between serving Me and serving the kings of other lands.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, watamtumikia Shishaki ili wapate kujifunza tofauti kati ya kunitumikia mimi na kuwatumikia wafalme wa nchi nyingine.”
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, nimbakore babe abasomba baye, erio nario baranyare komanya ogwatananekana kore egati ase ogonkorera inche na ogokorera abarwoti b’echinse.”

English: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Delaya, Tobia na Nekoda 652
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chia Delaya, na Tobia, na Nekoda, bonsi namagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano na babere (652).

English: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,
Kiswahili: katika safari za mara kwa mara. Nimekabiliwa na hatari za kwenye mito, hatari za wanyangʼanyi, hatari kutoka kwa watu wangu mwenyewe, hatari kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa; hatari mijini, hatari nyikani, hatari baharini; na hatari kutoka kwa ndugu wa uongo.
Ekegusii: nkaba ase orogendo ekero ase ekero, ase emechando ye chindooche, ase ogochandwa nabauri, ase ogochandwa neamate yane, ase ogochandwa nabaanto b’Ebisaku, ase emechando emechie ime, ase emechando y’erooro, ase emechando y’enyancha, ase ogochandwa nabaminto b’oborimo;

English: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.
Kiswahili: hata hivyo baba yenu amenidanganya kwa kubadilisha ujira wangu mara kumi. Hata hivyo, Mungu hakumruhusu kunidhuru.
Ekegusii: nonya nabo, iso obeire okong’ainereria, na koonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi, korende Nyasae tamoete ribaga gonkorera bobe.

English: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu husikiliza kilio chake, shida zimjiapo?
Ekegusii: Inee, ekero emechando eramochere Nyasae, namoigwe gose?

English: To whose wickedness a smoking waste still witnesses, and plants bearing fair fruit that doesn't ripen, a disbelieving soul has a memorial: a standing pillar of salt.
Kiswahili: Ambao uovu wake unashuhudiwa na takataka za kuvuta sigara, na mimea inayozaa matunda mazuri ambayo hayajaiva, roho isiyoamini ina ukumbusho: nguzo ya chumvi iliyosimama.
Ekegusii: Nonya ngoika reero iga oboene bw'ogosaria kwabo nigo gokororekana: ense eyio nigo ere erooro na nigo ekorwa erioki; emete y'aroro nigo ekwama amatunda korende takoba rinde, rigena ri'omonyo nao riteneine gotoinyoria igoro y'omonto otegenete.

English: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hakikisha kwamba nuru iliyoko ndani yako isiwe giza.
Ekegusii: Gaki renda, oborabu obwo bore ime yao tibocha koba omosunte.

English: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
Kiswahili: Ole wao walio mashujaa kwa kunywa mvinyo, nao walio hodari katika kuchanganya vileo,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bare chituoni ase okonywa edivai, naende bare abaremu ase ogwochogania amo ebinyugwa bigotindia,

English: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Sedekia akatoa maagizo Yeremia awekwe katika ua wa walinzi, na apewe mkate kutoka mitaa ya waokaji kila siku mpaka mikate yote katika mji itakapokwisha. Kwa hiyo Yeremia akabaki katika ua wa walinzi.
Ekegusii: Erio Zedekia omorwoti agachiika ng'a Yeremia abekwe ase egoora y'abarendi, naende agachiika ng'a kera rituko Yeremia aegwe omogati orenge koroisigwa agwo ase Enchera y'Abaroisia Emegati. Nigo agendererete koegwa omogati goika ekero emegati yonsi yaerete ase omochie. Ase ayio Yeremia akagenderera kobeera ase egoora eria y'abarendi.

English: “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by,” they told him.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Yesu wa Nazareti anapita.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso o Nazareti ogoeta.”

English: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
Kiswahili: Ninawaonea wivu, wivu wa Kimungu, kwa kuwa mimi niliwaposea mume mmoja, ili niwalete kwa Kristo kama mabikira safi.
Ekegusii: Naki nabaroreire ribero, na eri neribero ria Nyasae; naki nabariereire boko ase omosacha oyomo, erinde nyare kobarenta buna omoiseke omwekungi omochenu ase Kristo.

English: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:
Kiswahili: na ndugu wote walio pamoja nami: Kwa makanisa ya Galatia:
Ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi abare amo nainche aiga, twabakwanirie inwe abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia:

English: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
Kiswahili: Namlilia Bwana kwa sauti, nainua sauti yangu kwa Bwana anihurumie.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorera neriogi ase ogokorangeri’Omonene, naaka eriogi ase okomosaba amaabera.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akaniambia, “Mtupie mfinyanzi,” hiyo bei nzuri waliyonithaminia! Kwa hiyo nikachukua hivyo vipande thelathini vya fedha na kumtupia huyo mfinyanzi katika nyumba ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia “Chirute ase omokori chinyongo.” (Rigori eri rinene nakoreretwe nabaanto baria.) Erio nkaimokia chitaabu chiria chi'echifeta emerongo etato, ngachiruta ase enyomba y'Omonene, ase omokori chinyongo oria.

English: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, Bwana ahadi uliyoweka kuhusu mtumishi wako na nyumba yake na uithibitishe milele. Fanya kama ulivyoahidi,
Ekegusii: Na bono aye Omonene, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwateebete ng’a noyakore,

English: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
Kiswahili: Katika hili mnafurahi sana, ingawa sasa kwa kitambo kidogo mmehuzunishwa kwa majaribu ya namna nyingi.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio monyare kogoka mono, nonya mbono ase ekero egeke inamochandeke ase amateemwa a kera engencho, onye egwenerete.

English: As for the deeds of men— by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu matendo ya wanadamu: kwa neno la midomo yako, nimejiepusha na njia za wenye jeuri.
Ekegusii: Mang’ana ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng’ana namang’ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi’abasaria.

English: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken. The Futility of Power
Kiswahili: Ingawa mtu mmoja aweza kushindwa, watu wawili wanaweza kumkabili adui na kumshinda. Kamba ya nyuzi tatu haikatiki kwa urahisi. Maendeleo Ni Ubatili
Ekegusii: Omonto aise korwania oyomo ore bweka, namobue, korende onye bare babere, takobabua. Engori esisire nemegoye etato teri kobutoka bwango.

English: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, “It is done!”
