Kiswahili: Malaika wa saba akamimina bakuli lake angani na sauti kubwa ikatoka mle hekaluni katika kile kiti cha enzi, ikisema, “Imekwisha kuwa!”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na kabere agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase embeo bosa, na eriogi rinene rikarua ase Hekalu korwa ase ekerogo keria ki’obonene, rigoteeba, “Aikire gokoreka!”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitakujia katika wingu zito, ili watu wanisikie nikinena nawe na kila mara waweke tumaini lao kwako.” Kisha Mose akamwambia Bwana yale ambayo watu walikuwa wamesema.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agateebia Omonene amang'ana abanto bairaneretie.

English: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, ulipowatangulia watu wako, ulipopita nyikani,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero gwatang'anete abanto bao na ogotaara ase erooro,

English: Outside the veil of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps continually before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come.
Kiswahili: Nje ya pazia la Ushuhuda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, Aroni ataziwasha taa mbele za Bwana kuanzia jioni hadi asubuhi bila kuzima. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Agwo isiko y’etoto eye ekengete chibao chiriikire oborori chibeekire ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Aroni abe okorenda chitaaya korwa mogoroba goika mambia ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Okwo nogochika ase more koragenderere ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: A faithful man will abound with blessings, but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwaminifu atabarikiwa sana, bali yeye atamaniye kupata utajiri kwa haraka hataacha kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n’enkoro endonge ’nanyore ogosesenigwa okonge, korende oyo okoayerera ase okoba omonda takomocha konyora egesusuro.

English: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika Jangwa la Sinai,
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, Omonene agakwana nere, akamoteebia,

English: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn't give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
Kiswahili: Hata vitu visivyo na uhai vitoapo sauti, kama vile filimbi au kinubi, mtu atajuaje ni wimbo gani unaoimbwa kusipokuwa na tofauti ya upigaji?
Ekegusii: Nonya n'ebinto bitari nobogima, buna ekeroria, gose obokano, onye tibikorua eriogi rire nogwatananekana, naki eramanyekane ngotera ki gokobugigwa ase ekeroria gose obokano?

English: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
Kiswahili: Ingawa unauchunguza moyo wangu na kunikagua usiku, ingawa umenijaribu, hutaona chochote. Nimeamua kwamba kinywa changu hakitatenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna-unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.

English: You will be driven away from mankind to live with the beasts of the field, and you will feed on grass like an ox. And seven times will pass you by, until you acknowledge that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom He wishes.”
Kiswahili: Utafukuzwa mbali na wanadamu, ukaishi pamoja na wanyama pori, na utakula manyasi kama ngʼombe. Nyakati saba zitapita juu yako, mpaka utakapokubali kuwa Yeye Aliye Juu Sana ndiye anayetawala juu ya falme za wanadamu, naye humtawaza yeyote amtakaye.”
Ekegusii: aye noserigwe korwa ase Mwanyabaanto, omenye amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana, n’obe gokorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe. Okoore ebiro bitano na bibere goika ekero oramanye ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oborwoti bwa Mwanyabaanto, na nere okoa oborwoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche.”

English: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
Kiswahili: Kisha hesabu yao ilipungua, na walinyenyekeshwa kwa kuonewa, maafa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakeetigwe na kworoba ase engencho y'ogokorerwa bobe na gochaandwa,

English: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
Kiswahili: hamna budi kujua kwamba yeyote amrejezaye mwenye dhambi kutoka upotovu wake, ataiokoa roho ya huyo mwenye dhambi kutoka mauti na kusitiri wingi wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: tiga ere amanye ng'a oyokoirania omonyene ebibe korwa ase enchera y'ogosira, ere natoorie omoyo oye korwa ase amakweri na atube obonge bw'ebibe.

English: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Arfaksadi kumzaa Shela, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y'okoiborwa gwa Sela, Arifakisadi nigo kakoorete emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), akamanya akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
Kiswahili: Kisha Rebeka akachukua nguo nzuri za Esau mwanawe wa kwanza, alizokuwa nazo nyumbani, akamvika Yakobo mwanawe mdogo.
Ekegusii: Erio Rebeka akabogoria eanga eria engiya mono ya Esau, omwana oye omotangi; eye nigo yagachire nyomba mwaye, akayebekera Yakobo, omwana oye omoke.

English: You were taken up in a tempest of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses.
Kiswahili: Ulichukuliwa juu katika dhoruba ya moto, katika gari la farasi wa moto.
Ekegusii: Aye kwairetwe igoro ase ekembugu-mbugu ki'omorero, ime ase agari y'ebarasi y'omorero

English: “If you will return, O Israel, return to Me,” declares the LORD. “If you will remove your detestable idols from My sight and no longer waver,
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa utataka kurudi, ee Israeli, nirudie mimi,” asema Bwana. “Ikiwa utaondoa sanamu zako za kuchukiza mbele ya macho yangu na usiendelee kutangatanga,
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire iga: “Inwe Abaisraeli, onye morigetie koirana ase ’nde, ing’iranere. Motugute emegwekano yaino mogosasiima ere okogechia ase obosio bwane, motari nechitang’u‐tang’u.

English: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
Kiswahili: Ukaendelea hadi Abdoni, Rehobu, Hamoni na Kana, na kufika Sidoni Kuu.
Ekegusii: na Eburoni, na Rehobu, na Hamoni, na Kana, rogaika Sidoni, Omochie omonene.

English: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwepo mwanadamu aliye peke yake, hakuwa na mwana wala ndugu. Hapakuwa na mwisho wa kazi yake, hata hivyo macho yake hayakutosheka na utajiri wake. Aliuliza, “Ninajitaabisha hivi kwa ajili ya nani, nami kwa nini ninajinyima kufurahia?” Hili pia ni ubatili, ni shughuli yenye taabu!
Ekegusii: Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong'u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning'o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogooko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogooko.

English: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
Kiswahili: Basi Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akawatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi, wakiwa na magogo ya mierezi, waashi na maseremala ili kumjengea jumba la kifalme.
Ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abatomwa ase Daudi, akamotomera ebingese bi'emete y'emecharake na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, erinde baagachere Daudi enyomba.

English: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, Mose alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’
Ekegusii: Inaki Musa nigo ateebete: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.

English: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Mfanyie mtumishi wako kulingana na upendo wako na unifundishe maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Nkorere amaya inche omosomba oo koreng'ana nobwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, naende onyorokererie 'manye emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
Kiswahili: Walichukua utajiri wao wote pamoja na wanawake na watoto wao, wakachukua nyara kila kitu ndani ya nyumba zao.
Ekegusii: Bagasakora enibo yabo yonsi, na abana babo, na abakungu babo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase chinyomba bakabiira.

English: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
Kiswahili: Hili ni lango la Bwana ambalo wenye haki wanaweza kuliingia.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio egeita kia Omonene, agwo nao abanyene oboronge barasoere.

English: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet. Two Victories over the Philistines (2 Samuel 5:17–25)
Kiswahili: Elishama, Beeliada na Elifeleti. Daudi Awashinda Wafilisti (2 Samweli 5:17-25)
Ekegusii: Elisama na Beliada, na Elifeleti. Abafirisiti bakobugwa (2 Sam 5:17-25)

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yehoahazi yote aliyoyafanya na mafanikio yake, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoahasi, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'ogokora kw'Abarwoti b'Abaisraeli.

English: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
Kiswahili: Kwa upendo wako usiokoma, nyamazisha adui zangu; waangamize watesi wangu wote, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, siria ababisa baane; basirie kegima bonsi abagochaanda omoyo one, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo.

English: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mtu akaniongoza kuelekea kaskazini mpaka kwenye ua wa nje na kunileta mpaka kwenye vyumba vinavyoelekeana na ua wa Hekalu na kuelekeana na ukuta wa nje upande wa kaskazini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akang'ira ase eraaro ya isiko erochie sugusu, na akang'ira ase enyomba rirondo yanachanire ebinyomba yarenge gati y'aase atigire ataagachire na oboagacho bwa sugusu.

English: I foretold the former things long ago; they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
Kiswahili: Nilitoa unabii mambo ya kwanza tangu zamani, kinywa changu kiliyatangaza na kuyafanya yajulikane; kisha ghafula nikayatenda, nayo yakatokea.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana akorekanete agwo kare, inche konya nayararirie ritang’ani; amang’ana ayio nigo aruete ase omonwa one nkabayamanyia. Erio mobosokano nkayakora na koyaikerania.

English: Then the king said to Abiathar the priest, “Go back to your fields in Anathoth. Even though you deserve to die, I will not put you to death at this time, since you carried the ark of the Lord GOD before my father David, and you suffered through all that my father suffered.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamwambia kuhani Abiathari, “Nenda huko Anathothi katika mashamba yako. Wewe unastahili kufa, lakini sitakuua sasa, kwa sababu ulilichukua Sanduku la Bwana Mwenyezi mbele ya Daudi baba yangu na ulishiriki taabu zote za baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agateebia Abiatari Omokuani, “Genda Anatoti ase oboremo bwao: aye igo ogwenerete okwe, korende inche tinkogoita ase engaki eye, ekiagera aye nkwabogoretie Esanduki y’Omonene bosio bwa Daudi tata, naende ngwachandegete amo na tata ase emechando yaye yonsi.”

English: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh's right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
Kiswahili: Utajazwa na aibu badala ya utukufu. Sasa ni zamu yako! Kunywa na ujifunue! Kikombe kutoka kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Bwana kinakujia, na aibu itafunika utukufu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaichoirwe nobosooku ribaga ri'ogosikwa. Aye kanywe, obe omonto otarogeti! Egekombe ki'egesusuro kere ase okoboko gw'okorio kw'Omonene nakegochere; na oboosoku mbotube obonene bwao.

English: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
Kiswahili: Kamba za kuzimu zilinizunguka, mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.
Ekegusii: Obobe bw'amakweri nigo bwang'etananete, emeeto y'amakweri egantega na kombwata.

English: They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, “Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, your enemy who sought your life. Today the LORD has granted vengeance to my lord the king against Saul and his offspring.” The Execution of Rechab and Baanah
Kiswahili: Wakamletea Daudi kichwa cha Ish-Boshethi huko Hebroni, wakamwambia mfalme, “Hiki hapa kichwa cha Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli, adui yako, aliyejaribu kuondoa uhai wako. Siku hii ya leo Bwana amemlipia kisasi mfalme bwana wangu dhidi ya Sauli na mzao wake.”
Ekegusii: Bakaira omotwe oyio o Isi‐Boseti ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, bakamotebia, “Rora, oyo nomotwe o Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, omobisa oo, oyo orenge korigia obogima bwao. Rero Omonene okoruseirie aye, Omonene oito, egesiomba igoro ya Saulo na igoro y’ororeria rw’aye.”

English: He banished the male shrine prostitutes from the land and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
Kiswahili: Akawafukuza mahanithi wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu kutoka nchi na kuondoa sanamu zote ambazo baba zake walikuwa wametengeneza.
Ekegusii: Agasiria korwa ase ense eria abasacha baria abanyaka baarenge korigania ase obosooku, naende akarusia aroro emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, eria chisokoro chiaye chiaroisetie.

English: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
Kiswahili: Manabii wake ni wenye kiburi, ni wadanganyifu. Makuhani wake hunajisi patakatifu na kuihalifu sheria.
Ekegusii: Abaabani baye nigo bagwetogia ase amang'ana abo abanyene; nigo bare abanto abang'ainereria; abakuani baye bakorire ekere egechenu koba egetachenegeti, na basaririe amachiiko.

English: When they had entered Samaria, Elisha said, “O LORD, open the eyes of these men that they may see.” Then the LORD opened their eyes, and they looked around and discovered that they were in Samaria.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuingia mjini, Elisha akasema, “ Bwana, yafungue macho ya watu hawa ili wapate kuona.” Ndipo Bwana akayafungua macho yao, na walipotazama, kumbe hapo ndipo walipojikuta, ndani ya Samaria.
Ekegusii: Ase obwango boria basoete Samaria, Elisha akabora: “Aye Omonene, ramokia amaiso ’abaanto aba, erinde banyare korora.” Omonene akaramokia amaiso abo, nabarabwo bakarora, bakenyora ng’a ngati‐gati ya Samaria baare.

English: God saw the Israelites and took notice.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawaangalia Waisraeli na kuwahurumia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarigereria ogochandeka kw’Abaisraeli ase obosomba erio akabainyora.

English: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wao hunena maneno makuu mno ya kiburi cha bure, na kwa kuvutia tamaa mbaya za asili ya mwili, huwashawishi watu ambao ndipo tu wamejiondoa miongoni mwa wale wanaoishi katika ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana oboenenu atari nengencho, na ase okogania okobe kw’omobere na obonyaka bakogenka abwo bachakire gotama baria bagendererete gochia gosira.

English: For the worship of idols that may not be named is a beginning and cause and end of every evil.
Kiswahili: Kwani kuabudu sanamu ambazo haziwezi kutajwa ni mwanzo na chanzo na mwisho wa kila uovu.
Ekegusii: Gosasiima emegwekano eyio nonya n'amarieta abo atari gwatorwa, nakio omochakano, na engencho ya kera obobe.

English: When you have finished the purification, you are to present a young, unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.
Kiswahili: Utakapokuwa umemaliza kazi ya kuitakasa, utamtoa fahali mchanga pamoja na kondoo dume toka kwenye kundi, wote wawe hawana dosari.
Ekegusii: Ekero gwakoorire kogechena igo, orente eeri ensae na emingichi korwa ase riicho, chionsi ibere chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand, but he didn't find her.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Yuda akamtuma rafiki yake Mwadulami apeleke yule mwana-mbuzi ili arudishiwe amana yake kutoka kwa yule mwanamke, lakini yule rafiki yake hakumkuta yule mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Yuda akaa omosani oye Omoadulamu emaanwa egoree airere omokungu oria, erinde ere airanie ebinto biria amoete bibe intenenera, korende tamonyora.

English: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Delila akamwambia Samsoni, “Umenifanyia mzaha na kuniambia uongo. Tafadhali niambie waweza kufungwa kwa kitu gani?”
Ekegusii: Delila agateebia Samusoni, “Rora, gwankoreire echeche, naende gwanteebirie oborimo. Koranche onteebie buna oranyaare gosibwa.”

English: So the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, wakamsahau Bwana Mungu wao na kutumikia Mabaali na Maashera.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, bakamweba Omonene obo, na bagasasiima chinyasae echio Baali n’Asera.

English: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli akawaambia watumishi wake, “Mtafuteni mtu apigaye kinubi vizuri mkamlete kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Saulo akabateebia: “Mbuya, mondigerie omonto omanyete kobugia obokano buya momondetere aiga ase 'nde.”

English: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
Kiswahili: Walisema mioyoni mwao, “Tutawaponda kabisa!” Walichoma kila mahali ambapo Mungu aliabudiwa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateeba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.

English: Listen, my son, and receive my words, and the years of your life will be many.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza mwanangu, kubali ninachokuambia, nayo miaka ya maisha yako itakuwa mingi.
Ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa amang’ana ane, oyaanche, igo nario emiaka y’obogima bwao er’abe emenge.

English: Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wale ndugu kumi wa Yosefu, wakateremka huko Misri kununua nafaka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, bamura bamwabo Yusufu ikomi bagatirimboka gochia Misiri kogora endagera.

English: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything. Ananias Baptizes Saul
Kiswahili: Naye kwa muda wa siku tatu alikuwa kipofu naye hakula wala kunywa chochote.
Ekegusii: Akaba omouko amatuko atato, atari koria, nonya nkonywa. Saulo ase omochie o Damesiki

English: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
Kiswahili: Alipomwona Petro akiota moto, akamtazama sana, akamwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”
Ekegusii: akarora Petero ogwota omorero, akamorigereria, agateeba, “Aye naye kwarenge amo noria Omonazareti, Yeso.”

English: Then the LORD said to me, “They have spoken well.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia: “Wanachosema ni vyema.
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Amang’ana ayio bakwanire nayekeene.

English: came to King Demetrius in about the one hundred fifty-first year, presenting to him a crown of gold and a palm, and beside these some of the festal olive boughs of the temple. For that day, he held his peace;
Kiswahili: alikuja kwa Mfalme Demetrio yapata mwaka 151, akimpa taji ya dhahabu na mtende, na kando yake baadhi ya matawi ya mizeituni ya sherehe ya hekalu. Kwa siku hiyo, alinyamaza;
Ekegusii: agachiera omorwoti Demeturio ase omwaka 151. Ase chingaki echio akaa omorwoti ebiegwa ebi bikobwatia: egutwa y'etaabu, amato y'emekendo, na amato y'emesaituni ayio arusetigwe ase hekalu. Korende tatebete kende igoro y'emeroberio yaye.

English: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mtakapojua kwamba Mimi, Bwana Mungu wenu, nakaa Sayuni, mlima wangu mtakatifu. Yerusalemu utakuwa mtakatifu; kamwe wageni hawatavamia tena.
Ekegusii: “Erio namomanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, imenyete Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu. Yerusalemu nobe omochie omochenu, na abanto b'ebisaku ebigeni tibagosoa aroro nonya ng'ake.

English: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni jinsi nilivyowagawia kama urithi kwa makabila yenu yote nchi ya mataifa yaliyobaki, yaani mataifa niliyowashinda, kati ya Mto Yordani na Bahari kuu upande wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: Rora, ase ogoaka obomera naatananeire ebisaku biaino ense y'abanto aba batigarete amo ney'abwo konya nasiririe, ebe omwando oino, ense yonsi korwa orooche rwa Yorodani goika Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.

English: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
Kiswahili: ninyi mtakuwa kwangu ufalme wa makuhani na taifa takatifu.’ Haya ndiyo maneno utakayosema kwa wana wa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Inwe inamobe oborwoti bwane, abanto bagonkorera buna abakuani, egesaku kiane egechenu. Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli.”

English: They are coming from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens— the LORD and the weapons of His wrath— to destroy the whole country.
Kiswahili: Wanakuja kutoka nchi za mbali sana, kutoka miisho ya mbingu, Bwana na silaha za ghadhabu yake, kuangamiza nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene ngocha are amo nebirwanero bi’endamwamu yaye korwa ense y’aare, ase chinsinyo chia igoro, erinde asirie ense yonsi.

English: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
Kiswahili: Tena Daudi akakusanya watu 30,000 wa Israeli waliochaguliwa.
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi abachooretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

English: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name's sake.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, utusaidie, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa jina lako; tuokoe na kutusamehe dhambi zetu kwa ajili ya jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase engencho y'obonene bw'erieta riao, tokonye; naende ase engencho y'erieta riao otoboorie, otwabere ebibe biaito!

English: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don't know you, and on the families that don't call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
Kiswahili: Umwage ghadhabu yako juu ya mataifa wasiokujua wewe, juu ya mataifa wasioliitia jina lako. Kwa kuwa wamemwangamiza Yakobo; wamemwangamiza kabisa na kuiharibu nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Itera endamwamu yao ase ebisaku bitakomanyeti na ase abanto batari korangeria erieta riao bakonywe. Barabwo basiririe abanto ba Yakobo, ee, baabamerire kegima na kobasiria, basaririe obomenyo bwabo bwabeire bosa.

English: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Reu kumzaa Serugi, aliishi miaka 207, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y'okoiborwa gwa Serugi, Reu gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na etano na ebere (207), akaibora abana abamura na abaiseke.

English: At this, all the guests of Adonijah arose in terror and scattered.
Kiswahili: Katika hili, wageni wote wa Adoniya wakainuka kwa mshtuko wa hofu na kutawanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio abageni bonsi b’Adonia bakaiguswa ase omoondoko, bakaimoka, na kera omonto akagenda enchera yaye.

English: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wote wa mataifa wamelala kwa heshima kila mmoja katika kaburi lake.
Ekegusii: “Abarwoti bonsi b’ebisaku nigo baraire nobonene bwabo, kera oyomo ase embeera yaye,

English: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
Kiswahili: Talanta hizo 100 za fedha zilitumika kusubu vile vitako mia moja kwa ajili ya mahali patakatifu na pazia: vitako mia moja kwa talanta mia, yaani, talanta moja kwa kila kitako.
Ekegusii: Chikiro chilifu isano chi'echifeta chiria nigo chiakoretwe ase okoroisia chinterekerero chi'Obomenyo Obochenu ne chi'etoto eria; chikiro chilifu isano ase chinterekerero rigana erimo, chikiro emerongo etano ase kera enterekerero.

English: As you watched, a stone was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay, and crushed them.
Kiswahili: Ulipokuwa unaangalia, jiwe lilikatwa, lakini si kwa mikono ya mwanadamu. Lile jiwe liliipiga ile sanamu kwenye nyayo zake za chuma na udongo wa mfinyanzi, na kuivunja.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwarigereretie okarora rigena rigotegoka ritakuniri namaboko a Mwanyabaanto, rigaaka amagoro y’omogwekano oria arenge ay’ebioma na amaroba, rikayasamunyora akaba ebisamunye.

English: At this, the crowd seized Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the judgment seat. But none of this was of concern to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch
Kiswahili: Ndipo wote wakamkamata Sosthene kiongozi wa sinagogi, wakampiga mbele ya mahakama, lakini Galio hakujali kitendo chao hata kidogo. Paulo Arudi Antiokia
Ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakabwata Sostene, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, bakamoaka ase obosio bw’ekegambero. Korende Galio tarora ng’a amang’ana ayio gose ngento. Paulo okoirana Siiria

English: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atakayemtangaza kuwa safi atahitaji kumkabidhi mgonjwa aliyepona pamoja na sadaka zake zote mbele za Bwana katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Omokuani otenenerete arente omonto oria ogochia gochenwa amo nokoruegwa okwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Nitawaondoa miongoni mwenu wale wanaohalifu na wale wanaoasi dhidi yangu. Ingawa nitawatoa katika nchi wanazoishi, hawataingia katika nchi ya Israeli. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninyatanane korwa ase more abatari koigwera, na abasaririe asende. Nimbarusie korwa ase ense eria bare abamenyi, korende barabwo tibagosoa ase ense y'Abaisraeli. Erio nario moramanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene.

English: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!'
Kiswahili: “Wakamwambia, ‘Bwana, mbona; tayari anayo mafungu kumi!'
Ekegusii: (Bakamoteebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Wimbo. Mungu na ainuke, watesi wake watawanyike, adui zake na wakimbie mbele zake.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Tiga Nyasae aimokerere igoro, na ababisa baye basiarerwe, abanto abwo bamogechete, tiga batame barue asare.

English: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
Kiswahili: Umempa haja ya moyo wake na hukumzuilia maombi ya midomo yake.
Ekegusii: Kwamoeire okogania gw'enkoro yaye; na totangeti aya aboretie korwa asore.

English: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and showed them his decrees.
Kiswahili: Alifanya nao agano la milele, akawaonyesha amri zake.
Ekegusii: Erio akabakora nabarabwo babe n'egetebanio gia kare na kare, na kobamaanorera ebirengererio biaye.

English: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”
Kiswahili: “Nenda, kusanya pamoja Wayahudi wote walioko Shushani, nanyi mfunge kwa ajili yangu. Msile wala kunywa kwa siku tatu, usiku na mchana. Mimi na wajakazi wangu tutafunga kama mnavyofanya. Baada ya kufanyika hili, nitakwenda kwa mfalme, hata ingawa ni kinyume cha sheria. Ikiwa ni kuangamia na niangamie.”
Ekegusii: “Genda osangererie Abayahudi bonsi bare aa Susa, mweng'ate ase engencho yane. Timoria gose konywa ase amatuko atato, omobaso na obotuko. Inche amo nabasomba baane abaiseke ntweng'ate boigo. Nyuma y'ayio ningende ase omorwoti mamincha y'amachiiko; onye ngochia gosirigwa, insirigwe.”

English: Didn't Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
Kiswahili: Je, Mose hakuwapa ninyi sheria? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu anayeishika hiyo sheria. Kwa nini mnataka kuniua?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Musa tabaete amachiiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong'ita?”

English: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
Kiswahili: Kwa macho yenu wenyewe mliona yale majaribu makubwa, ishara zile za miujiza na maajabu makubwa.
Ekegusii: Boigo 'mwarooche n'amaiso aino amaakwa aria amanene, na ebikone, n'amakumia amanene;

English: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
Kiswahili: Kwa kinywa chake mtu asiyemwamini Mungu humwangamiza jirani yake, bali kwa maarifa mwenye haki huokolewa.
Ekegusii: Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande n'amang'ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong'aini abanyene oboronge 'mbatoorigwe.

English: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa watu wangu wamepondwa, nami nimepondeka pia; ninaomboleza, nayo hofu kuu imenishika.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'emechando y'abanto baane enkoro yane yachandekire. Nigo nkorera na kweumia, ekiagera naichoirwe nomoondoko.

English: And now, as surely as the LORD lives—the One who established me, who set me on the throne of my father David, and who founded for me a dynasty as He promised—surely Adonijah shall be put to death today!”
Kiswahili: Basi sasa, hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, yeye ambaye ameniimarisha salama kwenye kiti cha ufalme cha Daudi baba yangu, naye amenipa ufalme wa kudumu kama alivyoahidi, Adoniya atauawa leo!”
Ekegusii: Omonene ombekire ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti gia Daudi tata, na gonkong’ia, naende ong’eire oroiboro buna ariete eira, natianire ase erieta ri’Omonene ore moyo Adonia goika aitwe ase rituko ria reero.”

English: showed kindness and graciously received Maccabaeus, left Hegemonides governor from Ptolemais even to the Gerrenians,
Kiswahili: alionyesha wema na akampokea Maccabaeus kwa neema, akaacha Hegemonides kuwa gavana kuanzia Ptolemai hata Wagerreni,
Ekegusii: akabwatana na Yuda Makabi ase amasikani. Magega yayio omorwoti agachora Hegemonide koba omogabana bw'ense yonsi gati y'omochie Tolemai na Gerari,

English: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh's covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required;
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwacha Asafu na wenzake mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Bwana ili wahudumu humo mara kwa mara, kulingana na mahitaji ya kila siku.
Ekegusii: Obedi‐Edomu na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano na batato (68). Ere Obedi‐Edomu mosinto o Yedutuni, na Hosea, bakabeekwa bakaba abarendi b'egeita.

English: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
Kiswahili: Kutoka vilele vya miamba ninawaona, kutoka mahali palipoinuka ninawatazama. Ninaliona taifa ambalo wanaishi peke yao, nao hawahesabiwi kama mojawapo ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Korwa aiga ase ebitare igoro nimbarooche, na korwa aiga ase ebitunwa nimbarigereretie. Abwo n'abanto bamenyete boka, beatananire korwa ase abanto b'ebisaku.

English: Then Joab said, “I'm not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom's heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akasema, “Mimi sitapoteza muda hapa pamoja nawe.” Hivyo akachukua mikuki mitatu mkononi mwake, akamchoma Absalomu nayo moyoni alipokuwa angali hai akiningʼinia katika ule mwaloni.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoabu akabora, “Tinkoora gosaria chingaki gokwana naye boire.” Akaimokia amatimo atato, akabeta Abisalomu egekuba igoro, agachia konacha enkoro, ekero Abisalomu asung'unanete ase omoaluni igoro ore moyo.

English: Some composed musical tunes, and set forth verses in writing,
Kiswahili: Baadhi walitunga nyimbo za muziki, na kuandika mistari,
Ekegusii: Nigo baroisetie chingeero ase obong'aini bwabo, bakaroisia emeino na koyeriika.

English: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry out, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger and malicious talk,
Kiswahili: Ndipo utaita, naye Bwana atajibu, utalia kuomba msaada, naye atasema: Mimi hapa. “Kama ukiiondoa nira ya udhalimu, na kunyoosha kidole na kuzungumza maovu,
Ekegusii: Erio norangerie, n’Omonene nakoiranerie, norere, nere nateebe iga: Nao inde aa. Koratige kobekera abande amakorogoto, na kobaraga nekiara, na kobakwana bobe;

English: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
Kiswahili: Naye amempa Mwanawe mamlaka ya kuhukumu kwa kuwa yeye ni Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Omoeire okobua kw'ogokora ekiina, ekiagera ere n'Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

English: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa imetoka kwa Mungu, hamtaweza kuwazuia watu hawa. Badala yake mtajikuta mnapigana na Mungu.”
Ekegusii: korende onye neya Nyasae, timokonyaara koyesaria nonya ng’ake; mobaise kororekana ng’a Nyasae mokorwania!”

English: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hela walikuwa: Serethi, Sohari, Ethnani,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.

English: Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
Kiswahili: Bwana tusaidie, kwa kuwa wacha Mungu wametoweka; waaminifu wametoweka miongoni mwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ayerera totoorie! Abakoirogete aye Nyasae baerire, abegenwa tibari konyorekana ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil.
Kiswahili: Iwapo sadaka yako ya nafaka imeandaliwa kwenye kikaango, itakuwa ni ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, bila chachu.
Ekegusii: “Onye okoruegwa kwao kw’endagera n’emegati esaambeire orogio, ebe eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke amo namaguta, korende ebe etabeekiri memera.

English: which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. Grace be with you all.
Kiswahili: ambayo wengine kwa kujidai kuwa nayo wameiacha imani. Neema iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Inaki abaande babwatirie ayio, na basirire korwa ase okwegena. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: As for his strength and valour, and the wealth and glory of his kingdom, behold, they are written in the book of the Persians and Medes for a memorial.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu nguvu zake na ushujaa wake, utajiri na utukufu wa ufalme wake, tazama, vimeandikwa katika kitabu cha Waajemi na Wamedi kwa ukumbusho.
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana onsi igoro y'ogokora kwaye gwonsi, na okobua kwaye, amo n'amang'ana onsi buna aimokereretie Modekai igoro, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'ogokora kw'abarwoti b'Abamedia na ab'Abaayemi.

English: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
Kiswahili: Rafiki yetu mpenzi Luka yule tabibu, pamoja na Dema, wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Luka, oria omogwenia omwanchwa, na Dema babakwanirie.

English: It will become fine dust over all the land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on man and beast throughout the land.”
Kiswahili: Yatakuwa vumbi jepesi juu ya nchi yote ya Misri, pia yatatokea majipu yenye kufura juu ya watu na wanyama katika nchi yote.”
Ekegusii: Narirorio rionchoke ribe orotu, roirurukigwe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, rorente amagumba na amaote amabe, ase Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo.”

English: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
Kiswahili: Kwa jinsi ambavyo mimi nimechunguza, wale walimao ubaya na wale hupanda uovu, huvuna hayo hayo hayo.
Ekegusii: Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.

English: And a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media, with the following written on it: Memorandum:
Kiswahili: Karatasi moja ndefu ya maandishi ilipatikana huko Ekbatana katika jimbo la Umedi. Haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa yameandikwa humo: Kumbukumbu:
Ekegusii: Na agwo Ekibatana, omochie omonene ase orogongo rw’Abamedia, egetabu ekanyorekana eriikire amang’ana aya.

English: He says: “It is not enough for You to be My Servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the protected ones of Israel. I will also make You a light for the nations, to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth.”
Kiswahili: yeye asema: “Je, ni jambo dogo sana wewe kuwa mtumishi wangu ili kurejeza makabila ya Yakobo, na kuwarudisha wale Waisraeli niliowahifadhi? Pia nitakufanya uwe nuru kwa ajili ya watu wa Mataifa, ili upate kuleta wokovu wangu hata miisho ya dunia.”
Ekegusii: Nigo agoteeba iga: “Ayio tagoisana asore obe omosomba one ase okoiraneria ab’ebisaku bia Yakobo amaya abo, na koirania abatigari b’Abaisraeli boka. Boigo ningokore obe omobaso bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende goike ase chinsinyo chi’ense.”

English: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa nitawaagiza wavuvi wengi,” asema Bwana, “nao watawavua. Baada ya hilo, nitawaagizia wawindaji wengi, nao watawawinda kwenye kila mlima na kilima, na katika nyufa za miamba.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Nindangerie abarubi abange bachiche, barube abanto aba; magega y'ayio nindangerie abatwari abange bachiche batware abanto korwa ase kera egetunwa, na kera ekegoro, na korwa ase amakuruma 'ebitare.

English: They pleaded with Samuel, “Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakamwambia Samweli, “Mwombe Bwana Mungu wako kwa ajili ya watumishi wako, ili tusije tukafa, kwa kuwa tumeongeza uovu juu ya dhambi zetu nyingine kwa kuomba mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Bagateebia Samweli, “Tosabere intwe, abasomba bao, ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, erinde titokwa. Twarorire ng’a amo nebibe biaito bionsi twamentire ebibe binde ebiaao bi’okoboria ng’a toegwe omorwoti.”

English: Judah has broken faith; an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem. For Judah has profaned the LORD’s beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.
Kiswahili: Yuda amevunja uaminifu. Jambo la kuchukiza limetendeka katika Israeli na katika Yerusalemu: Yuda amepanajisi mahali patakatifu apendapo Bwana, kwa kuoa binti wa mungu mgeni.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa, na ay’okogechia akorirwe ase egati y’Abaisraeli, na ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera Abayuda baturutumbire Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, banyuomire abaiseke b’ abanto bagosasiima enyasae engeni.

English: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned. Final Remarks and Greetings
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa unajua kwamba mtu kama huyo amepotoka na tena ni mwenye dhambi. Yeye amejihukumu mwenyewe. Maneno Ya Mwisho Na Kumtamkia Baraka
Ekegusii: Nomanyete buna omonto onga buna oyio nomosareku, naende ebibe biaye biamwatananire, nere omonyene bwegaambirie. Ogotebereria ase y’ogokoorera

English: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
Kiswahili: Watu wengine wamepotoka kutoka haya na kugeukia majadiliano yasiyo na maana kwa kuwa,
Ekegusii: Abande bamochete ayio, batantanire na koonchokera ogokwana kwa bosa.

English: Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will dwell among them forever.
Kiswahili: Basi sasa na waweke mbali nami ukahaba wao na sanamu za wafalme wao zisizo na uhai, nami nitakaa miongoni mwao milele.
Ekegusii: Tiga barusie korwa asende obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasiima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abarwoti babo, erio nario ndamenye ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.

English: When Yahweh's angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana alipomaliza kusema mambo haya kwa Waisraeli wote, watu wakalia kwa sauti kuu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika bw'Omonene abateebetie Abaisraeli bonsi amang'ana ayio, barabwo bakaimokereria amariogi abo igoro bakarera na kweumia.

English: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
Kiswahili: Yeye aletaye taabu kwa jamaa yake atarithi tu upepo, naye mpumbavu atakuwa mtumishi wa wenye hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw'omonto omong'aini.

English: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa utafuatana nasi, tutashirikiana nawe mema yoyote tutakayopewa na Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Naende koragende amo naintwe, amaya ari'Omonene agochia gotokorera, ayio naro naintwe toragokorere.”

English: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
Kiswahili: Sasa mnaye mfalme kama kiongozi wenu. Lakini kwa habari yangu mimi ni mzee na nina mvi, nao wanangu wapo hapa pamoja nanyi. Nimekuwa kiongozi wenu tangu ujana wangu mpaka siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: Bono omorwoti oino oyio orabaraae. Inche bono nagotire, namerire chimbuche; abamura baane nigo bare amo nainwe. Inche nabeire nkobaraa korwa obosae bwane goika reero iga.

English: How lonely lies the city, once so full of people! She who was great among the nations has become a widow. The princess of the provinces has become a slave.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi mji ulivyoachwa ukiwa, mji ambao zamani ulikuwa umejaa watu! Jinsi ambavyo umekuwa kama mama mjane, ambaye wakati fulani alikuwa maarufu miongoni mwa mataifa! Yule ambaye alikuwa malkia miongoni mwa majimbo sasa amekuwa mtumwa.
Ekegusii: Naki omochie oyo otigaire bosa, oyio orenge oichire n’abanto! Naki otigaire buna omokungu omotakanwa oyio orenge omonene ase egati y’ebisaku! Oyio orenge buna eting’ana ase egati-gati y’emechie, bono obeire omosomba ase emechie ende.

English: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
Kiswahili: Msifuni yeye, enyi mbingu zilizo juu sana, na ninyi maji juu ya anga.
Ekegusii: Inwe igoro ya igoro chionsi, motogie Nainwe amaache are igoro ya igoro, motogie!

English: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
Kiswahili: Esta akasema, “Mtesi na adui ni huyu mwovu Hamani.” Hamani alifadhaika mbele ya mfalme na malkia.
Ekegusii: Esiteri akairaneria, akamoteebia “Omochandi na omobisa oito omonene, nere oyo Hamani, omonto omobe kegima.” Erio Hamani agasogwa nomoondoko ase obosio bw'omorwoti na obw'eting'ana.

English: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitaitia Misri mikononi mwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, naye atachukua utajiri wa Misri. Atateka mateka na kuchukua nyara mali za Misri kama ujira kwa ajili ya jeshi lake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nimbeke ense ya Misiri ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni; ere naire obotenenku bwa Misiri, nayesakore na koira ebinto bire aroro. Ebinto ebio mbibe eng'eria y'abarwani baye b'esegi.

English: So in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes, he went up to Jerusalem with some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and temple servants.
Kiswahili: Pia baadhi ya Waisraeli, wakiwemo makuhani, Walawi, waimbaji, mabawabu na watumishi wa Hekalu, nao walikuja Yerusalemu mwaka wa saba wa utawala wa Mfalme Artashasta.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita omorwoti, abande b’Abaisraeli, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

English: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
Kiswahili: Alisimama, akaitikisa dunia; alitazama, na kuyafanya mataifa yatetemeke. Milima ya zamani iligeuka mavumbi na vilima vilivyozeeka vikaanguka. Njia zake ni za milele.
Ekegusii: Ekero agotenena, ense nigo agotengechigwa, na ekero akorigereria, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakonyegerigwa. Ebitunwa biarengeo korwa kare nigo bikorimera gochia inse. Ere nigo agotaara ase chinchera chiaye chia kare.

English: As the men got up to go out, Joshua commanded them to map out the land, saying, “Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Watu hao walipokuwa wanaondoka kwenda kuandika vizuri kuhusu hiyo nchi, Yoshua akawaagiza, “Nendeni mkakague hiyo nchi na mwandike maelezo kuihusu. Kisha mrudi kwangu, nami nitawapigia kura hapa Shilo mbele za Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda gwata ense buna Yoshua abachiigete na kobateebereria, “Genda motaare ase ense engima, mworokie ase okorika buna ense eyio ere. Erio moirane ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene aiga Silo.”

English: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
Kiswahili: bali wewe unatupa ushindi juu ya adui zetu, unawaaibisha watesi wetu.
Ekegusii: Korende naye gwatoete obobui igoro y’ababisa baito, abwo batogechete nigo kwabasoogetie.

English: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
Kiswahili: Na walisifu jina lake kwa kucheza na wampigie muziki kwa matari na kinubi.
Ekegusii: Batogie erieta riaye ase ogotenga, babe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano.

English: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.
Kiswahili: Eberi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na minne, akamzaa Pelegi.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Eberi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ene (34), akaibora Pelegi.

English: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
Kiswahili: ili niweze kutangaza sifa zako katika malango ya Binti Sayuni na huko niushangilie wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: erinde intenene ase abanto ba Sayoni, ase ebiita biabo nimbatebie amang'ana onsi agerire nkogotogia; ningokere ogotooreka kwao.

English: If this is not so, then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing?”
Kiswahili: “Kama hili sivyo, ni nani awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwongo, na kuyafanya maneno yangu kuwa si kitu?”
Ekegusii: Onye amang’ana ayio tari bo, ning’o oranyare kong’enekia ng’a nomorimo inde, naende aorokie ng’a amang’ana nakwanire nigo are bosa.

English: So they returned from the tent, and went to their stations.
Kiswahili: Basi wakarudi kutoka kwenye hema, wakaenda mahali pao.
Ekegusii: Bakarua ase ekegutu kiarenge egetangora igoro bakairana gochia sobo.

English: And Mordecai sent letters with words of peace and truth to all the Jews in the 127 provinces of the kingdom of Xerxes,
Kiswahili: Naye Mordekai akatuma barua kwa Wayahudi wote katika majimbo 127 ya ufalme wa Ahasuero, barua zenye maneno ya amani na matumaini,
Ekegusii: Amarube arenge namang’ana ’omorembe, boigo noboredi, agatomwa ase Abayahudi bonsi barenge ase chingongo chionsi rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na isano na ibere 127, ase oborwoti bw’Ahaswero.

English: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mtu mwenye hamaki utafahamu na kuelewa, nao ulimi wenye kigugumizi utanena kwa ufasaha.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo batarenge ne chinkoro chi'oboremereria mbabe nebirengererio bi'okomanya, na abwo baarenge gotutura mbamanye gokwana buya na koigugwa buya.

English: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Bwana hawaachi waadilifu kukaa njaa, lakini hupinga tamaa ya mtu mwovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene tari gotiga omonyene oboronge abe nenchara; korende nigo akwanga okogania kw’abakori amabe.

English: Peter began to say to Him, “Look, we have left everything and followed You.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha kila kitu na kukufuata wewe!”
Ekegusii: Petero agachaaka komoteebia, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire.”

English: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
Kiswahili: Je, tunaanza tena kujisifu wenyewe? Au tunahitaji kupata barua za utambulisho kwenu au kutoka kwenu, kama watu wengine?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ntwachakire naende gwetogia intwe abanyene? Gose intwe ntogwenerete, buna abande, konyora amarube are nogotogigwa gocha ase more, gose ayakorwa ase more?

English: My children, follow instruction in peace. But wisdom that is hidden and a treasure that is not seen, what benefit is in them both?
Kiswahili: Wanangu, fuata mafundisho kwa amani. Lakini hekima iliyofichwa na hazina isiyoonekana, zote mbili zina faida gani?
Ekegusii: Abana baane, tegerera amorokererio aane momenye nomorembe. Obong'aini bobisegete na emonga etari kororekana, inee ebio ninki bibwate?

English: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
Kiswahili: Frigia, Pamfilia, Misri na pande za Libya karibu na Kirene na wageni kutoka Rumi,
Ekegusii: Furugia na Pamfulia, Misiri ne chinsemo chia Libia ya Kurene, amo nabageni korwa Rumi,

English: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
Kiswahili: “Ndipo hawa watakapoingia kwenye adhabu ya milele, lakini wale wenye haki wataingia katika uzima wa milele.”
Ekegusii: Na abanto aba nabagende ase egesusuro gia kare na kare, korende abanyene oboronge inabagende ase obogima bwa kare na kare.”

English: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Yoshua akafanya agano kwa ajili ya watu na hapo Shekemu ndipo alipowaandikia amri na sheria.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yoshua agakora okobwatana kw'ogotianania nabaanto abwo, na agwo Sekemu akabaa amachiiko na emeroberio barabwatie.

English: Who are you who judge another's servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni nani hata umhukumu mtumishi wa mtu mwingine? Kwa bwana wake tu anasimama au kuanguka. Naye atasimama kwa sababu Bwana anaweza kumsimamisha.
Ekegusii: Aye naye ning'o okogaambia omosomba bw'omonto onde? Ase omonene oye omonyene nigo ateneine gose nigo akogwa. Ee, natenene, ekiagera Omonene nere ore n'okobua gw'okomotenenia.

English: over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah; over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah;
Kiswahili: kwa Waefraimu: Hoshea mwana wa Azazia; kwa nusu ya kabila la Manase: Yoeli mwana wa Pedaya;
Ekegusii: Hosea, mosinto bw’Asasia, ase Abaefraimu; Yoel, mosinto o Pedaya, ase ekeng’ese kende ki’egesaku kia Manase;

English: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
Kiswahili: Mwambieni mwenye nyumba ile atakayoingia, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba changu cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’
Ekegusii: na aande onsi arasoe moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia oteebire: Ng’ai ere enyomba y’abageni ndiere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?

English: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
Kiswahili: Nyuma ya pazia la pili, palikuwa na sehemu iliyoitwa Patakatifu pa Patakatifu,
Ekegusii: Na moino y'etoto eria ya kabere yarengeo eema ende yare korokwa Aase Aachenu Mono.

English: You know that I have served your father with all my strength.
Kiswahili: Mnajua kwamba nimemtumikia baba yenu kwa nguvu zangu zote,
Ekegusii: Inwe ’momanyete ng’a nabeire ngokorera iso ne chinguru chiane chionsi;

English: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwacha kuhani Sadoki pamoja na makuhani wenzake mbele ya hema ya ibada ya Bwana katika mahali pa juu pa kuabudia huko Gibeoni
Ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka Zadoki Omokuani amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, babe bagokorera Omonene ase Eema yaye agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aaria Gibeoni.

English: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
Kiswahili: Mtatajirishwa kwa kila namna ili mpate kuwa wakarimu kila wakati, na kupitia kwetu, ukarimu wenu utamletea Mungu shukrani.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera mwatenenkigwe ase ebinto bionsi monyare koba nokorua gwonsi gokogera Nyasae aakerwe ng'a mbuya mono goetera ase emeremo yaito.

English: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.
Kiswahili: Baada yake, Nehemia mwana wa Azbuki, mtawala wa nusu ya wilaya ya Beth-Suri, alikarabati kufikia mkabala na makaburi ya Daudi, mpaka kwenye bwawa lililotengenezwa, na kufikia Nyumba ya Mashujaa.
Ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, Nehemia, mosinto bw'Asubuki, omogambi bw'ekeng'ese ki'orogongo rwa Beti-Suri, akaagacha orwaki goikera ensemo yarochie chimbeera chia Daudi chiarenge ase ritibo riaremetwe, na goikera ase enyomba y'abanto abarenge nokobua.

English: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them. The Rich Young Man (Matthew 19:16–30; Luke 18:18–30)
Kiswahili: Akawachukua watoto mikononi mwake, akawakumbatia, akaweka mikono yake juu yao, akawabariki. Kijana Tajiri (Mathayo 19:16-30; Luka 18:18-30)
Ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaagata ase amaboko aye, akabasesenia, okobeeka amaboko aye igoro ase bare. Omomura omonda (Mat 19:16-22; Luk 18:18-23)

English: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mkikaa ndani yangu na maneno yangu yakikaa ndani yenu, ombeni lolote mtakalo, nanyi mtatendewa.
Ekegusii: Komoramenye ime yane, na amang’ana aane karabe ime yaino, saba kera ekemoganetie na inwe namokorerwe.

English: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Waisraeli wote wakamkaribia, naye akawapa amri zote Bwana alizompa katika Mlima wa Sinai.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase Musa, na ere akabaa amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene konya amoeire ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
Kiswahili: Kama mtawala akisikiliza uongo, maafisa wake wote huwa waovu.
Ekegusii: Omogambi aise gwancha amang'ana y'oborimo, abasomba baye bonsi nigo barabe abakori amabe.

English: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba Tito amekubali tu ombi letu, bali anakuja kwenu akiwa na shauku kuliko wakati mwingine, tena kwa hiari yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki igo abwatete ogosorora gwaito; kobua ayio, ere akamenta koba nomokia gocha ase more ase ogwancha kwaye omonyene.

English: if his heart hasn't blessed me, if he hasn't been warmed with my sheep's fleece;
Kiswahili: ambaye wala moyo wake haukunibariki kwa kumpatia joto kwa mavazi ya manyoya ya kondoo zangu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi'amarionya e ching'ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.

English: Yahweh's trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
Kiswahili: Miti ya Bwana inanyeshewa vizuri, mierezi ya Lebanoni aliyoipanda.
Ekegusii: Emete y'Omonene nigo egoisaneka namaache, ee, emecharake ya Lebanoni, eyi'Omonene asimegete.

English: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
Kiswahili: Hayo yatakuwa taji la maua la neema kichwani pako, na mkufu wa kuipamba shingo yako.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe buna egetinti gechabeire ase omotwe oo, na buna chisonoi chingiya chire ase rigoti ria'o.

English: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.” The Report of the Guards
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Msiogope. Nendeni mkawaambie ndugu zangu waende Galilaya, ndiko watakakoniona.” Taarifa Ya Walinzi
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timoiroka! Genda moteebie abaminto bagende Galili, nao barandore.” Amang’ana y’abarendi boboina

English: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.
Kiswahili: Basi wakafanya hivyo. Wakachukua ngʼombe wawili wa aina hiyo, wakawafungia hilo gari la kukokotwa, nao ndama wao wakawekwa zizini.
Ekegusii: Erio Abanto abwo bagakora boigo. Bakaimokia chiombe ibere chigokamwa, bagachisibera egari, bagasiekera chimori nka.

English: But you are to take your holy things and your vow offerings and go to the place the LORD will choose.
Kiswahili: Lakini vichukueni vitu vyenu vilivyowekwa wakfu pamoja na vile mlivyoweka nadhiri, mwende mahali pale Bwana atakapopachagua.
Ekegusii: Ebinto biaino moraatanane bibe ebichenu amo nebi mwariete chiira ng’a ’mobirue, mobiire aase agwo Omonene arachoore.

English: He placed Alcimus in charge of the country and left with him a force to aid him. Then Bacchides went away to the king.
Kiswahili: Alimweka Alkimo kuwa msimamizi wa nchi na kumwachia jeshi la kumsaidia. Kisha Bakide akaenda kwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio ere akamotigera Alikimo oborai bw'ense eyio. Akamotigera ebiombe bia abarwani be esegi bamokonye, ere akairana gochia ase omorwoti.

English: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
Kiswahili: Hivyo umaarufu wa Daudi ukaenea katika kila nchi, naye Bwana akayafanya mataifa yote kumwogopa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chia Daudi chigasarera ase chinse chionsi; n'Omonene akarentera abanto b'ebisaku bionsi obwoba, bakamoiroka.

English: He who didn't spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Mungu hakumhurumia Mwanawe, bali alimtoa kwa ajili yetu sote, atakosaje basi kutupatia vitu vyote kwa ukarimu pamoja naye?
Ekegusii: Ere otarorerete Omwana oye amaabera, korende akamorua ase engencho yaito intwe twensi, inaki aramoche gotoa ebinto bionsi amo nere?

English: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
Kiswahili: Naye Lawi akaacha kila kitu, akaondoka, akamfuata.
Ekegusii: Agatiga bionsi, akaimoka, akamotunyana.

English: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako”:
Ekegusii: nigo yachaagete buna eriikire ase egetabu y’omobani Isaya. “Nyasae agateeba,” rora, natomire omotomwa one agotang’anere, oyo oraroisie enchera yao;

English: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo maana pakaitwa Babeli, kwa sababu hapo ndipo Bwana alipoivuruga lugha ya dunia nzima. Kutoka hapo Bwana akawatawanya katika uso wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Aase ayio baare koagacha akarokwa Babiloni, ekiagera Omonene atantanetie omonwa bw'abaanto b'ense yonsi, na korwa agwo Omonene akabaserebania erio bagende ense yonsi, bayemenye.

English: Then he said to Korah and all his followers, “Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring that person near to Himself. The one He chooses, He will bring near to Himself.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia Kora na wafuasi wake wote: “Asubuhi Bwana ataonyesha ni nani aliye wake na ni nani aliye mtakatifu, tena atamtaka mtu huyo aje kwake. Mtu yule ambaye atamchagua atamfanya kuja karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Erio agakwana na Kora na abanto bonsi b’ekeombe kiaye, akabateebia, “Ankio mambia Omonene nache aorokie ng’a ning’o ore oyoye, naende ning’o ore omochenu na ning’o arae ribaga amoike ang’e. Nache arente omonto oyio achorire amoike ang’e.

English: And the Israelites inquired of the LORD. (In those days the ark of the covenant of God was there,
Kiswahili: Nao Waisraeli wakauliza kwa Bwana. (Katika siku hizo Sanduku la Agano la Mungu lilikuwa huko
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarigia ogoseemia korwa ase Omonene. (Esanduki eria ere ne’chibao chiriikire okobwatana kwa Nyasae nao yarenge ase amatuko aria,

English: They answered Jesus, “We don't know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, “Hatujui.” Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakairaneria Yeso, “Titomanyeti.” Na Yeso akabateebia “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”

English: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
Kiswahili: Mche Bwana Mungu wako na umtumikie yeye. Shikamana naye kwa uthabiti na kuapa kwa jina lake.
Ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene Nyasae oino, momokorere ere bweka. Momobwaterere mono, naende mobe mogotiana ase erieta riaye rioka.

English: As soon as the king heard this, he was deeply distressed and set his mind on delivering Daniel, and he labored until sundown to rescue him.
Kiswahili: Wakati mfalme aliposikia hili, akahuzunika mno. Akakusudia kumwokoa Danieli, hivyo akafanya kila jitihada ya kumwokoa hadi jua likatua.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti aigwete amang’ana aria, agachandeka mono, akarigia enchera y’ogotooria Danieli. Goika ekero erioba korikogwa akaba ogendererete korigia enchera y’okomotooria.

English: So Gaal went out before the leaders of Shechem and fought against Abimelech,
Kiswahili: Basi Gaali akatoka akawaongoza watu wa Shekemu kupigana na Abimeleki.
Ekegusii: Gaali agatang’ana abanto ba Sekemu, na barabwo bakageenda bakarwania Abimeleki.

English: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu kwa jinsi iyo hiyo. Msiwatishe, kwa kuwa mnajua ya kwamba yeye aliye Bwana wenu na Bwana wao yuko mbinguni, naye hana upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Na inwe abanene, bakorere ayio ayio, motige kobairokia. Momanye ng'a ere oyore Omonene obo, nere oyoino ore igoro, na ase are gwanchereria tikoiyo.

English: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.
Kiswahili: Bela mwana wa Beori alikuwa mfalme wa Edomu. Mji wake uliitwa Dinhaba.
Ekegusii: Bela, mosinto o Beori, akaba okogaamba ase ense y’Edomu, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Dinihaba.

English: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipotazama, wakaona lile jiwe, ambalo lilikuwa kubwa sana, limekwisha kuvingirishwa kutoka pale penye ingilio la kaburi.
Ekegusii: Goika bagachia korigereria bakarora ng'a rigena riria riatigerigwe, na rirorio nigo riarenge rinene mono.

English: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
Kiswahili: Iwapo mtu jina lake halikuonekana katika kile kitabu cha uzima, alitupwa ndani ya lile ziwa la moto.
Ekegusii: Na onye omonto tarorekaneti orikire ase egetabu y’obogima akarutwa ase enyancha y’omorero.

English: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
Kiswahili: Walisema mioyoni mwao, “Tutawaponda kabisa!” Walichoma kila mahali ambapo Mungu aliabudiwa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateeba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.

English: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: kuhani ataamua thamani yake hadi Mwaka wa Yubile, naye huyo mtu atalazimika kulipa thamani yake siku hiyo kama kitu kitakatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokuani akore rigori ri'oboremo boria koreng'ana n'emiaka etigarete goika Omwaka bw'Omochengo. Ase rituko riria kegima, omonto oria aakane rigori riria ribekire, ne chitaabu echi chibe chiatananirwe ase Omonene.

English: This is an easy thing in Yahweh's sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
Kiswahili: Hili ni jambo rahisi machoni pa Bwana. Pia ataitia Moabu mikononi mwenu.
Ekegusii: Eke negento egeke ase Omonene; boigo nabeeke Abamoabu ase amaboko aino.

English: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
Kiswahili: Maana mnajua kwamba tuliwatendea kila mmoja wenu kama vile baba awatendeavyo watoto wake.
Ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buna tware gosemia kera oyomo oino buna ise agosemia abana baye, na tokabaremia, na kobasorora, na kobakuurera,

English: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
Kiswahili: Waheshimuni sana katika upendo kwa ajili ya kazi zao. Ishini kwa amani ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Mobasike mono ase obwanchani, ase engencho y ’emeremo yabo. Mobe nomorembe inwe ase inwe.

English: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Arfaksadi, Shemu aliishi miaka 500, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Arifakisadi, Shemu naende akamenya emiaka amagana atano (500), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
Kiswahili: Lakini ile karama iliyotolewa haikuwa kama lile kosa. Kwa maana ikiwa watu wengi walikufa kwa sababu ya kosa la mtu mmoja, zaidi sana neema ya Mungu na ile karama iliyokuja kwa neema ya mtu mmoja, yaani, Yesu Kristo, imezidi kuwa nyingi kwa ajili ya wengi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria koria. Inaki ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakwa, korende amaabera a Nyasae na ekeegwa eke ki’amaabera biamentekire kobua mono ase abange ase omonto oyomo Yeso Kristo.

English: and said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Look, David intends to harm you’?
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Sauli, “Kwa nini unasikiliza wakati watu wanapokuambia, ‘Daudi amenuia kukudhuru’?
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabooria Saulo: “Nase ki okoigwera amang’ana ya’baanto bagoteeba ng’a inche Daudi ngokorigia inde ngokore bobe?

English: as the reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests the ears with his arm, as one gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa kama mvunaji akusanyavyo nafaka na kuvuna nafaka kwa mikono yake, kama wakati mtu aokotapo masazo ya masuke katika Bonde la Warefai.
Ekegusii: Nigo eraabe buna ekero omogesi akogesa namaboko aye ebigara bi’endagera eteneine, na buna ekero omonto agochora ebigara bi’endagera ase ense omweremu y’Abarefai.

English: They all together praised the merciful God, and were yet more strengthened in heart, being ready to assail not only men but the wildest animals and walls of iron,
Kiswahili: Wote kwa pamoja walimsifu Mungu mwenye rehema, na wakaimarika zaidi mioyoni mwao, wakiwa tayari kuwashambulia si wanadamu tu bali wanyama wakali na kuta za chuma,
Ekegusii: Erio bonsi bagaakera Nyasae mbuya mono ase okobarorera amaabera; konya obabekire chinguru chisaine koboera nonya n'echingiti chiria chintindi nonya n'echinyasi chi'echichuma.

English: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews' language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakawaita kwa Kiebrania watu wa Yerusalemu waliokuwa juu ya ukuta ili kuwatisha na kuwatia hofu ili waweze kuuteka mji.
Ekegusii: Abaasuri bagaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw'Ekeyuda ase abanto ba Yerusalemu abarenge igoro ase orwaki ase okobagosa na koboboyia, erinde baire omochie oria.

English: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hupata umaskini na aibu, bali yeye anayekubali maonyo huheshimiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwanga koigwera amorokererio akomoorongeyia, obotaka na obosooku nigo biramonyore, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nanyore amasikani.

English: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “Yahweh is able to give you much more than this.”
Kiswahili: Amazia akamuuliza yule mtu wa Mungu, “Lakini itakuwaje kwa zile talanta 100 za fedha nilizolipa kwa ajili ya haya majeshi ya Israeli?” Yule mtu wa Mungu akajibu, “Bwana aweza kukupa zaidi sana ya hizo.”
Ekegusii: Amasia akaboria omonto oria o Nyasae, “Ngento ki togokora ase chitalanta chiria rigana erimo naakanire abasikari b'Abaisraeli?” Omonto oria o Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Omonene nabwate okobua gokoa chinyinge mono goetania echio.”

English: I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.
Kiswahili: Ningelikuongoza na kukuleta katika nyumba ya mama yangu, yeye ambaye amenifundisha. Ningelikupa divai iliyokolezwa unywe, asali ya maua ya mikomamanga yangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nanga nakorentete mwa baba, obe gokonyorokereria. Nigo nare gocha gokoa onywe edivai yochoganirie ebinsari, naende nkoe amaache amitire korwa ase amakomomanga aane.

English: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
Kiswahili: Mungu hataizuia hasira yake; hata jeshi kubwa la Rahabu lenye nguvu linajikunyata miguuni pake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, nigo bagotung'ama inse asare baumama.

English: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
Kiswahili: Je, ninyi mnamzidi nani kwa uzuri? Shukeni chini! Nanyi mkalazwe pamoja na hao wasiotahiriwa!
Ekegusii: “Aye Misiri, ning'o obuete ase obosiani? Tirimboka ogende inse otimoke amo nabatarogeti?

English: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
Kiswahili: akisema, “Laiti ungalijua hata wewe leo yale ambayo yangeleta amani, lakini sasa yamefichika machoni pako.
Ekegusii: okobora, “Onye nkwamanya reero ayare korenta omorembe! Korende bono abisekire ase amaiso ao!

English: and set them in two rows—six per row—on the table of pure gold before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Iweke katika mistari miwili, kila mstari mikate sita, uiweke mbele za Bwana juu ya meza iliyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Oroberie emegati eyio ase chindwaro ibere, etano nomo ase kera orwaro, igoro ase emesa eoomire netaabu echenire, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.

English: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
Kiswahili: mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake. Leteni sadaka na mje katika nyua zake; mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b'ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense nigo eteneine bokong'u, tekonyegerigwa.

English: “Call her,” said Elisha. So Gehazi called her, and she stood in the doorway.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Elisha akasema, “Mwite huyo mwanamke.” Kwa hiyo akamwita, naye akaja akasimama mlangoni.
Ekegusii: Elisha agateebia Gehasi: “Morangerie!” Na ekero arangeretie omokungu oria, nere agatenena gesieri.

English: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
Kiswahili: akapaza sauti kwa nguvu akasema, “Umebarikiwa wewe miongoni mwa wanawake, naye mtoto utakayemzaa amebarikiwa.
Ekegusii: agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, agakwana, “Gwaseseniigwe aye ase abakungu, na oroiboro rw’enda yao rwasesenigwe.

English: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo ndugu zake wakaja na kujitupa chini mbele yake. Wakasema, “Sisi ni watumwa wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bagacha, bagatung'ama inse ase obosio bwaye, bakaboora: “Intwe iga nabasomba bao tore.”

English: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Aroni kuhani wataweka moto juu ya madhabahu na kupanga kuni juu ya huo moto.
Ekegusii: na abamura ba Aroni Omokuani baute omorero ase egesasiimero, bachooke chinko ase omorero oyio.

English: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
Kiswahili: Ingawa kujikweza kwake hufikia mbinguni na kichwa chake hugusa mawingu,
Ekegusii: Ere naisa koba nobonene boigete igoro, na omotwe oye oike ase amare,

English: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
Kiswahili: kwa kufahamu mithali na mifano, misemo na vitendawili vya wenye hekima.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase emebayeno eyio abanto 'mbanyaare kweorokereria emebayeno na eki egoteeba; boigo 'mbamanye amang'ana y'abanto abang'aini na emebayeno yabo.

English: Thus Solomon finished Yahweh's house and the king's house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon's heart to make in Yahweh's house and in his own house.
Kiswahili: Solomoni alipomaliza kujenga Hekalu la Bwana na jumba la kifalme, naye akiwa amefanikiwa kutenda yale yote aliyokuwa nayo moyoni mwake kufanya katika Hekalu la Bwana na katika jumba lake mwenyewe la kifalme,
Ekegusii: Sulemani agakoora koagacha enyomba y'Omonene, na enyomba y'omorwoti, na ebio bionsi Sulemani aroberetie gokora ase enyomba y'Omonene na ase enyomba yaye omonyene; akabiikerania na kobikoora buya.

English: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Huyo alikuwa pamoja na Daudi huko Pas-Damimu, wakati Wafilisti walikusanyika huko kwa ajili ya vita. Huko ambapo kulikuwa na shamba lililokuwa limejaa shayiri, vikosi vya Israeli vikawakimbia Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge amo na Daudi agwo Pasi‐Damimu ekero Abafirisiti basangererekanete amo, barwane esegi aase omogondo bw'esairi orenge. Ekero abanto batamete korwa ase Abafirisiti,

English: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
Kiswahili: Aliniokoa kutoka adui wangu mwenye nguvu nyingi, kutoka adui zangu waliokuwa na nguvu nyingi kuliko mimi.
Ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase ababisa bane bare ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo bareenge ne chinguru kombua.

English: The special portion you set apart to the LORD shall be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.
Kiswahili: “Hiyo sehemu maalum mtakayotoa kwa Bwana itakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa 25,000 na upana wa dhiraa 10,000
Ekegusii: Orogongo orwo morotige robe orwa Omonene; obotambe bwaye nigo borabe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000).

English: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane; ekerero kiane tiga geike asore.

English: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kile kilichokuwa kinafifia kilikuja kwa utukufu, je, si zaidi utukufu wa kile kinachodumu?
Ekegusii: Ekiagera onye boria bwaetete bwarenge nobonene bwaye, boria boreo botambe mbore nobonene kobua mono.

English: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ulishangilia wakati urithi wa nyumba ya Israeli ulipofanyika ukiwa, hivyo ndivyo nitakavyokutendea. Utakuwa ukiwa, ee mlima Seiri, wewe na Edomu yote. Kisha ndipo watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.' ”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kwagokerete ogosarigwa kw'omwando bw'Abaisraeli, ningosarie aye obe bosa. Ee, ningosarie aye egetunwa gia Edomu obe bosa, aye Edomu engima. Erio nario abanto baramanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene.

English: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
Kiswahili: Mara kwa mara huyo pepo mchafu amekuwa akimwangusha kwenye moto au kwenye maji ili kumwangamiza. Lakini kama unaweza kufanya jambo lolote, tafadhali tuhurumie utusaidie.”
Ekegusii: Ara aange kemoruta ase omorero na ase amaache, erinde kemosirie, korende koranyare gokora ring’ana, tororere amaabera, otokonye.”

English: Afterward, David’s conscience was stricken because he had cut off the corner of Saul’s robe.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hilo, dhamiri ya Daudi ikataabika kwa kukata upindo wa joho la Sauli.
Ekegusii: Korende magega y’ayio enkoro ya Daudi egachaka komogambia, ekiagera konya abutoire omokoba bw’eanga ya Saulo.

English: On the seventh day, the child died. David's servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn't listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”
