Kiswahili: Kunako siku ya saba yule mtoto akafa. Watumishi wa Daudi wakaogopa kumwambia kuwa mtoto amekufa, kwa maana walifikiri, “Wakati mtoto alipokuwa angali hai, tulizungumza na Daudi lakini hakutusikiliza. Tutawezaje kumwambia kwamba mtoto amekufa? Anaweza kufanya kitu cha kujidhuru.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omwana oria agakwa. Abasomba ba Daudi bakoboa komoteebia ng'a omwana okuure, inaki nigo bateebete, “Ekero omwana arenge moyo, togachia gokwana nere, korende tanchete gotoigwa. Inaki rende toranyare komoteebia ng'a omwana okuure? Nigo arabaise gwekorera bobe.”

English: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa amani atamponda Shetani chini ya miguu yenu upesi. Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw'omorembe namionogorere Saitani inse y'amagoro aino bwango. Obuya bw'Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

English: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
Kiswahili: Malaika wa pili akaipiga tarumbeta yake na kitu kama mlima mkubwa unaowaka moto kikatupwa baharini. Theluthi ya bahari ikawa damu,
Ekegusii: Omomalaika o kabere akabugia egetureeri kiaye. Erio egento keng’ana ekegoro ekenene kegwoka omorero gekarutwa ase enyancha.

English: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to Joseph, “I too had a dream: There were three baskets of white bread on my head.
Kiswahili: Yule mwokaji mkuu alipoona kuwa Yosefu amefasiri ikiwa na maana nzuri, akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi pia niliota ndoto: Kichwani mwangu kulikuwepo vikapu vitatu vya mikate.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati arooche ng’a okoonchora okwo nigo kwabeete okuya, agateebia Yusufu: “Nainche boigo nigo narootete. Nkarora ng’a inyetwegete chinteru isato chire nemegati emerabu ase omotwe one.

English: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Behold, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do because of the daughter of My people?
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Tazama, nitawasafisha na kuwajaribu, kwani ni nini kingine niwezacho kufanya kwa sababu ya dhambi ya watu wangu?
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Nimbanyititore ase okobachena na kobateema. Ngento ki rende ndanyare gokorera abanto baane?

English: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
Kiswahili: Gileadi ni mji wenye watu waovu, umetiwa madoa kwa nyayo za damu.
Ekegusii: Omochie o Gileadi nigo oichire nabaanto abakori amabe, chimbaratero chiabo nigo chiichire amanyinga.

English: For my people and I have been sold out to destruction, death, and annihilation. If we had merely been sold as menservants and maidservants, I would have remained silent, because no such distress would justify burdening the king.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mimi na watu wangu tumeuzwa kwa kuangamizwa, kuchinjwa na kuharibiwa. Kama tungalikuwa tumeuzwa tu kuwa watumwa wa kiume na wa kike, ningalinyamaza kimya, kwa sababu shida kama hii isingalitosha kumsumbua mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Inche na abanto baane twaoonigwe, tosirigwe kegima ase ogoitwa. Onye nigo twaoonigwa tochie koba abasomba, abasacha na abakungu, nanga nigo nakira tinkwana, ekiagera amang’ana ayio tare goisana gochanda omorwoti.”

English: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn't yet glorified.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposema haya alimaanisha Roho Mtakatifu ambaye wote waliomwamini wangempokea, kwani mpaka wakati huo, Roho alikuwa hajatolewa, kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa bado hajatukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Ring'ana eri nigo arikwanete igoro y'Omoika, ekiagera baria bamwegenire nabayonyore magega, ekiagera Omoika Omochenu konya toraruegwa, ekiagera Yeso konya taraegwa obonene.

English: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
Kiswahili: Akaweka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, akaweka maji ndani yake kwa ajili ya kunawia,
Ekegusii: Akabeeka egetuba ase egati y'Eema y'omosangererekano na egesasiimero, akabeeka amaache ogwesibia imeo.

English: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch in the middle between every two tails.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Samsoni akatoka akawakamata mbweha 300 na kuwafunga wawili wawili kwa mikia yao kila mmoja kwa mwingine. Kisha akafungia mwenge wa moto, kwenye mikia ya kila jozi moja ya mbweha aliyokuwa ameifunga,
Ekegusii: Akageenda akabwata ebibwe amagana atato, akabisiberania bibere bibere ase ebimincha biabo, erio agasiberania ebieri bi'omorero ase egati y'ebimincha biria bibere.

English: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya Martha alikwenda, akamwita Maria dada yake faraghani na kumwambia, “Mwalimu yuko hapa anakuita.”
Ekegusii: Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akarangeria Mariamu mosubati omwabo, agakwana ng’ora igo, “Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeria are.”

English: These are the words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: In the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,
Kiswahili: Maneno ya Nehemia mwana wa Hakalia: Katika mwezi wa Kisleu katika mwaka wa ishirini, wakati nilikuwa ngomeni katika jumba la kifalme la Shushani,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana a Nehemia, mosinto o Hakalia. Ase omotienyi o Kisilevu, omwaka bw’emerengo ebere, ekero narenge ase eburi agwo Susa, omochie omonene,

English: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn't destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn't stir up all his wrath.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo alikuwa na huruma, alisamehe maovu yao na hakuwaangamiza. Mara kwa mara alizuia hasira yake, wala hakuchochea ghadhabu yake yote.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo arenge namaabera, akaba okwabera ebibe biabo tabasiria; ase chingaki chinyinge nigo arenge gotanga endamwamu yaye, gose tarenge gotiga ekeririanda kiaye gioke mono.

English: Don't be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
Kiswahili: Msifungiwe nira pamoja na watu wasioamini, kwa jinsi isivyo sawasawa, kwa maana pana uhusiano gani kati ya haki na uovu? Au kuna ushirika gani kati ya nuru na giza?
Ekegusii: Timosiberanigwa rikorogoto amo nabategeneti. Naki nkobwatana ki kore ase egati y'oboronge na ogosaria? Gose ngosanga ki kore ase egati y'omobaso na omosunte?

English: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
Kiswahili: Kura ya pili ikaangukia kabila la Simeoni, ukoo kwa ukoo. Urithi wao ulikuwa ndani ya eneo la Yuda.
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa kabere bokagwera chiamate chi'egesaku gia Simioni. Omwando obo nigo orenge gati‐gati y'omwando bw'egesaku kia Yuda.

English: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
Kiswahili: Nitaimba juu ya upendo wako na haki yako; kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nitaimba sifa.
Ekegusii: Nintere igoro y’amaabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.

English: Then Elijah took the child, brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. “Look, your son is alive,” Elijah declared.
Kiswahili: Eliya akamtwaa kijana na kumbeba kutoka chumbani mwake akamshusha kumpeleka kwenye nyumba. Akampa mama yake na kusema, “Tazama, mwanao yu hai!”
Ekegusii: Elija akabogoria omwana oria, agatirimboka nere korwa ase akanyomba ka irongo, akamorenta enyomba ya inse, erio akamomoa ng’ina, akamoteebia: “Rora omwana oo moyo are.”

English: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
Kiswahili: Je, nilijipatia faida kwa kumtumia mtu yeyote niliyemtuma kwenu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabaurete gento goetera ase onde bwensi natomete ase more?

English: For wickedness, condemned by a witness within, is a coward thing, and, being pressed hard by conscience, always has added forecasts of the worst.
Kiswahili: Kwani uovu, unaohukumiwa na shahidi ndani, ni jambo la woga, na, ukishinikizwa sana na dhamiri, daima umeongeza utabiri wa mabaya zaidi.
Ekegusii: Omochakano bw'obwoba n'okoiroka, na nigo bogweonchora bwoka obonyene. Onde bwensi okorire okomocha nigo akorora mono aria amabe goetania amaya.

English: But I—how can I help you?
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi—ninawezaje kukusaidia?
Ekegusii: Abana bane abwo bare ase obosomba, kende tikeiyo ndakore erio mbakonye.

English: Ozias sent to Betomasthaim, Bebai, Chobai, and Chola, and to every border of Israel, to tell about the things that had been accomplished, and that all should rush upon their enemies to destroy them.
Kiswahili: Uzia akatuma ujumbe Betomasthaimu, Bebai, Kobai, na Kola, na katika mipaka yote ya Israeli, kutangaza mambo yaliyotendeka, na kwamba kila mtu awakimbilie adui zake ili kuwaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Uzia agatoma amang'ana gochia ase abanto ba Bethomesthaimu, Bebai, Koba, Kola na ense engima ya Israeli, erio kobamanyia Abaisraeli aria akoregete naboigo kobasegeta kobwatana na abamwabo kobaromeng'ana ababisa erio babasirie.

English: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninakungojea wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, utajibu.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene, naye nsemereretie. Omonene, Nyasae one, naye oranyare koiraneria.

English: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
Kiswahili: Hekalu hilo Mfalme Solomoni alilojenga kwa ajili ya Bwana lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa sitini, upana wa dhiraa ishirini na kimo cha dhiraa thelathini kwenda juu.
Ekegusii: Enyomba eria omorwoti Sulemani aagacherete Omonene nigo yareenge iga: Obotambe bwaye nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.

English: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith. Final Warnings and Blessings
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kadiri tupatavyo nafasi na tuwatendee watu wote mema, hasa wale wa jamaa ya waaminio. Si Kutahiriwa Bali Kuwa Kiumbe Kipya
Ekegusii: Nabo gatorabe ne ribaga tokorere abanto bonsi amaya, korende kobua mono abwo bare ab’okwegena. Ogokuurera na ogosesenigwa

English: Then Elijah ordered them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let a single one escape.” So they seized them, and Elijah brought them down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered them there. The LORD Sends Rain
Kiswahili: Kisha Eliya akawaamuru, “Wakamateni hao manabii wa Baali. Msimwache hata mmoja atoroke!” Wakawakamata, naye Eliya akawaleta mpaka Bonde la Kishoni na kuwachinja huko.
Ekegusii: Erio Elija agateebia abanto: “Bwata ababani aba ba Baali, timotiga nonya noyomo atame.” Na abanto bakababwata, na Elija akabatirimbokia gochia ase akarooche ga Kisoni, akabaitera aroro agwo. Eguru‐gura ekoera

English: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
Kiswahili: Watu walipoelekea upande wa mashariki, wakafika kwenye tambarare katika nchi ya Shinari nao wakaishi huko.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimoka kogenda orogendo gochia ensemo ya moocha, bakanyora ense omweya ase ense ya Shinari, bagachaaka komenya aroro.

English: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
Kiswahili: Bali ufanyapo karamu, waalike maskini, vilema na vipofu,
Ekegusii: Korende kogokora omoyega, barangerie abataka, na ebirema, na amagata, na emeuko;

English: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
Kiswahili: Aweza akawaacha wakapumzika wakijihisi salama, lakini macho yake yanaona njia zao.
Ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae akomorenda buya na komokonya, na nigo akoba origereretie mono chinchera chiaye.

English: Will You never look away from me, or leave me alone to swallow my spittle?
Kiswahili: Je, hutaacha kamwe kunitazama, au kuniacha japo kwa kitambo kidogo tu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nengaki eng’ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?

English: Now the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Leo nitaanza kukutukuza machoni pa Israeli yote, ili wapate kujua kuwa niko pamoja nawe kama nilivyokuwa pamoja na Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rituko ria reero ngochaka inde gokoimokererie igoro, ase amasio a ’baisraeli, nabarabwo mbamanye ng’a buna narenge amo na Musa, nabo ndabe amo naye boigo.

English: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia. Malaika watakuja na kuwatenganisha watu waovu na watu wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Naboigo eraache koba ase omoerio bw'ense. Abamalaika nabaoroke bache gwatanana baria ababe korwa ase abanyene oboronge,

English: Then David said, “O Yahweh, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, mtumishi wako amesikia kwa hakika kwamba Sauli anapanga kuja Keila na kuangamiza mji kwa ajili yangu.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabora: “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, inche, omosomba oo, naigure ng'a Saulo ngocha are aiga Keila gosaria omochie ase engencho yane.

English: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.
Kiswahili: Niliyafanya mataifa yatetemeke kwa kishindo cha kuanguka kwake wakati nilipoushusha chini kaburini pamoja na wale washukao shimoni. Ndipo miti yote ya Edeni, miti iliyo bora kuliko yote na iliyo mizuri sana ya Lebanoni, miti yote ile iliyokunywa maji vizuri, ilifarijika hapa duniani.
Ekegusii: Nigo natengechetie ebisaku ase okogwa kwaye, ekero nayogechete nkayotuguta gochia aase abakuure, ase abwo bagendete ase chimbeera. Erio emete yonsi ya Edeni, na eyechorire ere emiya mono ya Lebanoni, yonsi eye ekonywa amaache, ekaba ekweremia emenyene agwo inse ye riroba.

English: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can't do anything to oppose you.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Sedekia akajibu, “Yeye yuko mikononi mwenu! Mfalme hawezi kufanya lolote kuwapinga ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Zedekia omorwoti agateebia abagaambi baria, “Rora nigo are ase amaboko aino, ekiagera inche omorwoti tinkonyara gokora amang'ana are mamincha yaino.”

English: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,
Kiswahili: Waarvadi, Wasemari na Wahamathi. Baadaye koo za Wakanaani zilitawanyika,
Ekegusii: na Abaarivadi, na Abaseremari, na Abahamati. Erio magega y’ayio eamate ya Kaanani egesiarera.

English: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa kweli huokoa maisha, bali shahidi wa uongo ni mdanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Kirori ogokwana ekeene nigo agotooria obogima, korende oy'ogokwana oborimo nigo akorwa abande.

English: Far be it from You to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”
Kiswahili: Hilo na liwe mbali nawe, kufanya jambo kama hilo, kuwaua wenye haki pamoja na waovu, kuwatendea wenye haki sawasawa na waovu. Iwe mbali nawe! Je, Mwamuzi wa dunia yote hatafanya lililo sawa?”
Ekegusii: Yaya gaki teeba boigo, ekeene, nosirie abanyene oboronge nabakori amabe amo? Omonyene oboronge tagokorerwa buna abakori amabe! Inee! Aye Omogambi omonene bw’ense engima notige gokora ayare y’oboronge!”

English: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don't give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.'
Kiswahili: Kisha, utakapokwenda kwenye ukoo wangu, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu hata kama wakikataa kukupa huyo binti, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu.'
Ekegusii: “Inche igo nacha reero ase ensoko, nasaba iga: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw'omonene one Aburaamu, koranche onsesenie bono ase orogendo rwane nkogenda.

English: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
Kiswahili: Mose akawachagua watu wenye uwezo kutoka Israeli yote, akawafanya kuwa viongozi wa watu, maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.
Ekegusii: Agachora abanto b'Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeeka babe abaraai b'Abaisraeli, b'emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

English: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”
Kiswahili: Akamwita jina lake Noa, akasema, “Yeye ndiye atakayetufariji katika kazi na maumivu makali ya mikono yetu yaliyosababishwa na ardhi iliyolaaniwa na Bwana.”
Ekegusii: akamoroka Nuhu agateeba: “Oyo nere oratoremie intwe ase emeremo yaito, na obokong'u bwaito, ase riroba eri Omonene aragereretie.”

English: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
Kiswahili: Nitapiga kambi pande zote dhidi yako, nitakuzunguka kwa minara na kupanga mazingirwa yangu dhidi yako.
Ekegusii: Nintoore asore ngoetanane, ng'agache chiburi chi'okoboera na gokorwania.

English: But in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, this Passover was observed to the LORD in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wa Mfalme Yosia, Pasaka hii iliadhimishwa kwa Bwana huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogaamba kwa Yosia, Rituko erio Rinene ri’Epasaka rikainyorwa na korendwa ase Omonene, agwo Yerusalemu. Okoonchoreria konde kogokorwa na Yosia

English: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu kwangu; umeniokoa kutoka kwenye vilindi vya kaburi.
Ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obonene ase ’nde; aye kwabooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure.

English: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ni yupi basi wakili mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake atamfanya msimamizi juu ya watumishi wake wote, ili awape watumishi wengine chakula chao wakati unaofaa?
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, omonene oye arabeeke igoro ase enyomba yaye yonsi, ae abanto endagera ekerengo kiabo ase ekero kegwenerete?

English: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mambo haya yote yalifanywa na watu walioishi katika nchi hii kabla yenu, na nchi ikawa najisi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase ense eria ritang'ani riaino nigo bakorete okogechia okwo gwonsi, na igo ense eria ekaba etachenegeti.

English: from the Shihor east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory)—that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as well as that of the Avvites;
Kiswahili: kutoka Mto Shihori ulioko mashariki mwa Misri, kuelekea kaskazini kwenye eneo la Ekroni, ambayo yote ilihesabika kama ya Wakanaani (maeneo yale matano ya watawala wa Kifilisti, ambayo ni Gaza, Ashdodi, Ashkeloni, Gathi na Ekroni: ndiyo nchi ya Waavi);
Ekegusii: (Ense yonsi gochakeera orooche rwa Sihori, moocha ya Misiri, goikera orobebe rw’Ekironi aria sugusu nigo ebarire ng’a ney’Abakanaani. Abagaambi batano b’Abafilisti nigo bamenyete Gasa, na Asidodi, na Asikeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.) Naende nero ense y’Abaavi,

English: Surely deception comes from the hills, and commotion from the mountains. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
Kiswahili: Hakika zile ghasia za kuabudu sanamu kwenye vilima na milimani ni udanganyifu; hakika katika Bwana, Mungu wetu, uko wokovu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amaene nigo ere bosa koba nogosemeria ase ebigoro na ase chigosori chimbe chire aroro. Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere ore ogotooreka kw’Abaisraeli.

English: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako akuletapo katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki, na awafukuzapo mbele yako mataifa mengi, yaani Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, mataifa saba makubwa tena yenye nguvu kuliko wewe,
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaikie ase ense eria, mogochia koira ebe eyaino, na aseerie ebisaku ebinge birue ase amasio aino, ebisaku bitano bibere bire ebinene, naende bire nechinguru kobabua. Ebisaku ebio nabio ebi: Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.

English: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wamisri walituonea na kututaabisha, wakitufanyisha kazi ngumu.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri bagatokorera bobe, bakaba bagotochaanda na gotokoria emeremo emekong'u.

English: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakainuka wakasema, kama mtu mmoja, “Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayekwenda nyumbani. Wala hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayerudi nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakaimoka, bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagakwana, “Onde tarua ase tore agende mwaye, ase eema yaye gose nyomba mwaye.

English: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
Kiswahili: Bila kuuliza huwapondaponda wenye nguvu nyingi na kuwaweka wengine mahali pao.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agosenyenta abare nokobua atari kona‐kouna‐unia, erio abeeke abande aase abo.

English: But he answered, “I wasn't sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Nimetumwa tu kwa ajili ya kondoo wa Israeli waliopotea.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nigo natometwe ase ching'ondi chinsiru chi'enyomba ya Israeli chioka.”

English: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa vikosi vya mamia wakafanya kama vile kuhani Yehoyada aliagiza. Kila mmoja akawachukua watu wake, wale waliokuwa wakiingia zamu siku ya Sabato na wale waliokuwa wakienda mapumziko, nao wakaja kwa kuhani Yehoyada.
Ekegusii: Abatang'ani baria b'abarendi amagana bagakora onsi koreng'ana buna Yehoyada Omokuani abachiigete. Kera oyomo akarenta abanto baye, baria baarenge gokora emeremo ase rituko ri'Esabato na baria baarenge korua ase emeremo ase rituko erio. Igo bakagenda ase Yehoyada Omokuani.

English: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”
Kiswahili: Wengine walikuwa wakisema, “Tunaweka rehani mashamba yetu, mashamba ya mizabibu, na nyumba zetu ili tupate nafaka wakati wa njaa.”
Ekegusii: Boigo abande bagateeba, “Intwe nkobeeka tore amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y'emesabibu, ne chinyomba chiaito, bionsi bibe intenenera; bono otoe endagera, ekiagera tore nenchara.”

English: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king's wrath was pacified.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamtundika Hamani mahali alipokuwa ameandaa kwa ajili ya Mordekai. Ndipo ghadhabu ya mfalme ikatulia.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hamani agatongwa ase orobambo roria asimiseretie Moredekai. Erio endamwamu y'omorwoti egakenda.

English: When they buried Abner in Hebron, the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb, and all the people wept.
Kiswahili: Wakamzika Abneri huko Hebroni, naye mfalme akalia kwa sauti kwenye kaburi la Abneri. Pia watu wote wakalia.
Ekegusii: Erio bagatindeka Abineri agwo Heburoni. Omorwoti akarera neriogi rinene agwo ase oboina bw’Abineri; na abanto bonsi bakarera.

English: from the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;
Kiswahili: wa wazao wa Bani, alikuwa Shelomithi mwana wa Yosifia na wanaume 160 pamoja naye;
Ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bani, Selomiti, mosinto o Yosifia, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo (160);

English: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money and overthrew their tables.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza mjeledi kutokana na kamba, akawafukuza wote kutoka kwenye eneo la Hekalu, pamoja na kondoo na ngʼombe. Akazipindua meza za wale wabadili fedha na kuzimwaga fedha zao.
Ekegusii: Agakora omocharichi bwe chingori, akabasokia bonsi korwa ase Hekalu, ne ching'ondi, ne chiombe; agaitera chitaabu chiabo abaare koonchora chitaabu, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo.

English: Announce in Judah, proclaim in Jerusalem, and say: “Blow the ram’s horn throughout the land. Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves and let us flee to the fortified cities.’
Kiswahili: “Tangaza katika Yuda na upige mbiu katika Yerusalemu na kusema: ‘Piga tarumbeta katika nchi yote!’ Piga kelele na kusema: ‘Kusanyikeni pamoja! Tukimbilie katika miji yenye maboma!’
Ekegusii: Teebia Abayuda, na morarie ase Yerusalemu: “Bugia egetureeri ase ense eye yonsi, moake eriogi rinene, motebe: Sangererekana amo, togende ase emechie egiteire chindwaki.

English: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work. The Cloud and the Glory (Numbers 9:15–23)
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akafanya ua kuizunguka Maskani ya Mungu na madhabahu, pia akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la huo ua. Hivyo Mose akaikamilisha kazi. Utukufu Wa Bwana (Hesabu 9:15-23)
Ekegusii: Agatenenia orosenge rw’eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasiimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi. Riire igoro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano (Omob 9:15-23)

English: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako na unifundishe amri zako.
Ekegusii: Mbarerie inche omosomba oo obosio bwao, na onyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na dada wa mama yako, kwa sababu ni ndugu wa mama yako wa karibu.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo nyoko.

English: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can't leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.'
Kiswahili: Nasi tukamwambia bwana wangu, ‘Kijana hawezi kumwacha baba yake; akimwacha, baba yake atakufa.'
Ekegusii: Na intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one, ng'a omosae oyo takonyara gotiga ise; aise komotiga, ise nigo arakwe.

English: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, baraza la wazee wa watu, yaani viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, wakakutana pamoja, naye Yesu akaletwa mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b'abaanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b'amariiko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakoboora,

English: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
Kiswahili: Basi wakachukua matawi ya mitende, wakatoka kwenda kumlaki, huku wakipaza sauti wakisema, “Hosana!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amebarikiwa Mfalme wa Israeli!”
Ekegusii: bakabogoria chinsagia chi’emekendo, bagasoka isiko kogenda komoorotota, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”

English: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
Kiswahili: Inakuwaje mnashindwa kuelewa kwamba nilikuwa sisemi nanyi habari za mikate? Jilindeni na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.”
Ekegusii: Inaki inwe motari komanya ng’a tindi gokwana igoro y’emegati? Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

English: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini nijiweke mwenyewe kwenye hatari na kuyaweka maisha yangu mikononi mwangu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki ndabeeke enyama y'omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting'egerereti obogima bwane.

English: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out with your son Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct that feeds the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Isaya, “Toka uende, wewe na mwanao Shear-Yashubu, mkutane na Ahazi huko mwisho wa mfereji wa Bwawa la Juu, kwenye barabara iendayo Shamba la Dobi.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Isaya: “Genda amo na Seari‐Yasuba, momura oo, morotote Ahasi agwo ase omotaro bw’amaache e ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda egetii ki’omosibia ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga,

English: But because of your fame, you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot. You lavished your favors on everyone who passed by, and your beauty was theirs for the asking.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini ulitumainia uzuri wako na kutumia umaarufu wako kuwa kahaba. Ulifanya uzinzi kwa kila mtu aliyepita, uzuri wako ukawa kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: “Korende aye nigo gwasemeretie oboseera bwao, erio ogekora omotaayayi, ekiagera kwamanyekanete mono, ogekaayayia ase abaeti bonsi, ogechwara ase onde bwensi.

English: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
Kiswahili: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa aase egetare kere, aase amaroba are amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.

English: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they are all oblivious; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they are dreamers lying around, loving to slumber.
Kiswahili: Walinzi wa Israeli ni vipofu, wote wamepungukiwa na maarifa; wote ni mbwa walio bubu, hawawezi kubweka; hulala na kuota ndoto, hupenda kulala.
Ekegusii: Abarendi b’abaanto aba nigo bare emeuko, bonsi pi tibari nokomanya, bonsi nigo bare chisese chinkubu chitanyare gokoga; nigo chiraire inse chikorota, chianchete obogondereria.

English: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Shauli alipofariki, Baal-Hanani mwana wa Akbori akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akwete, Baali Hanani, mosinto bw'Akibori, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: (Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda, alifanya kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Mose,
Ekegusii: Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda, agakora onsi ay’Omonene achigete Musa.

English: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Hakika nitakurudia tena majira kama haya mwakani na Sara mkeo atakuwa ana mwana.” Sara alikuwa akiwasikiliza kwenye ingilio la hema, lililokuwa nyuma yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Amaene, inche ning'irane asore omwaka ogocha engaki enga buna eye, na ninyore ng'a Sara mokao onyorire omwana omoisia.” Ko erio Sara nigo ategererete gesieri ki'eema yareenge magega y'Omonene.

English: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
Kiswahili: Kila kitu chenye uhai kiendacho kitakuwa chakula chenu. Kama vile nilivyowapa mimea mbalimbali, sasa nawapa kila kitu.
Ekegusii: Kera egetongwa kere moyo na gekwagura inakebe endagera yaino; buna nabaete chinyeni na ebimeri binde bigokina, naboigo nabaeire nebio bionsi.

English: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu hutembea katika kambi yenu ili kuwalinda na kuwaweka adui zenu mikononi mwenu. Kambi yenu ni lazima iwe takatifu, ili asione kitu chochote miongoni mwenu kilicho kichafu akageuka na kuwaacha.
Ekegusii: Ebitwori biaino goika bibe ebichenu, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo agotaara ase ebitwori biaino, erinde abakoonye, n'abeeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino. Omonene tabaisa korora obonyinyeru ase more; aise koborora, nigo arabatige.

English: During the night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule Yakobo akaamka akawachukua wake zake wawili, watumishi wake wawili wa kike na wanawe kumi na mmoja na akavuka kivuko cha Yaboki.
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Yakobo akaimoka, akaira abakungu baye babere, na abasomba baye babere abakungu, na abana baye ikomi nomo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yaboki.

English: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
Kiswahili: Bali dhabihu za Mungu ni roho iliyovunjika, moyo uliovunjika wenye toba, Ee Mungu, hutaudharau.
Ekegusii: Ebing’wanso biancheire na Nyasae omoyo omokanyeku na bw’okweitia; enkoro yasionokire na gwekeyia, aye Nyasae, tokoyechaya.

English: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Daudi. Ee Mungu, uniweke salama, kwa maana kwako nimekimbilia.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, gaki ondende, ekiagera naye ngotamera.

English: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
Kiswahili: kuwaelekeza wakuu wa mfalme apendavyo na kuwafundisha wazee wake hekima.
Ekegusii: erinde abe ogotebereria abanene b'oborwoti boria buna anchete, na kworokereria abagaaka baye b'oborwoti chisemi.

English: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, kukainuka dhoruba kali baharini hata mashua ikaanza kufunikwa na mawimbi, lakini Yesu alikuwa amelala usingizi.
Ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omonene okaimoka ase enyancha, goika obwato bogatubwa nemerindo; korende ere konya oraarire.

English: Therefore let's also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let's run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, kwa kuwa tumezungukwa na wingu kubwa namna hii la mashahidi, basi na tuweke kando kila kitu kinachotuzuia na ile dhambi inayotuzinga kwa urahisi, nasi tupige mbio kwa saburi katika yale mashindano yaliyowekwa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera intwe tore nabarori abange buna igo, batoetanaine buna riire, totugute are kera egurube, na ebibe biria bitobwatete. Tominyoke noboremereria ase okoamererania koria kobekire bosio bwaito,

English: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘When someone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the value of persons,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Kama mtu yeyote ataweka nadhiri maalum ili kuweka watu wakfu kwa Bwana, kwa kutoa kiasi cha thamani inayolingana,
Ekegusii: “oteebie Abaisraeli: Onye eira yarietwe ng’a omonto aruegwe ase ogokorera Omonene, na omonto oyio karaboorigwe arueo, goika akorerwe rigori buna iga:

English: Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
Kiswahili: Naye mlinzi alipaza sauti, “Mchana baada ya mchana, bwana wangu, ninasimama katika mnara wa ulinzi, kila usiku ninakaa mahali pangu nilipoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio ontengerete akarangeria neriogi buna eri’endo, “Aye Omonene, nigo ngotenena igoro ase egetengero omobaso boira; nigo inde ase emeremo yane ase obotuko bwonsi.

English: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Wote walikuwa koo za Washuhamu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,400.
Ekegusii: Abarwete ase chiamate chi'Abasuhamu nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, na amagana ane (64,400).

English: Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akaghairi. Bwana Mwenyezi akasema, “Hili nalo halitatokea.”
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateeba, “Naya boigo takoba bo.”

English: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.
Kiswahili: Akapigana kishujaa na kuwashinda Waamaleki, akiikomboa Israeli kutoka mikono ya wale waliokuwa wamewateka nyara.
Ekegusii: Akarwana noboremu, akabua nonya n'Abaameleki, na agatooria Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko abwo konya baabasakoire.

English: who will go out and come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.” Joshua to Succeed Moses (Deuteronomy 31:1–8)
Kiswahili: ili atoke na kuingia mbele yao, atakayewaongoza katika kutoka kwao na kuingia kwao, ili watu wa Bwana wasiwe kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji.”
Ekegusii: omonto oranyare gotang’ana abanto kobagosoka na kobakoirana, erinde omoganda bw’ abanto ba Omonene tobaisa koba buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.”

English: For you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mwachukuliana na wajinga kwa sababu mna hekima sana!
Ekegusii: Inwe, ekiagera more nobong’aini, nigo mokoremereria nabariri ase omogooko.

English: There are nine things that I have thought of, and in my heart counted happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: a man who has joy with his children, and a man who lives and sees the fall of his enemies.
Kiswahili: Kuna mambo tisa ambayo nimeyafikiria, na moyoni mwangu nimeyaona kuwa ya heri, na la kumi nitalitamka kwa ulimi wangu: mtu anayefurahi pamoja na watoto wake, na mtu anayeishi na kuona kuanguka kwa adui zake.
Ekegusii: Inche nimbateebie amang'ana kianda ayio angogetie ase omoyo one, ee nerinde ria ikomi boigo nimbariteebie: omonto ogogete ase engencho ya abana baye, omonto oyio okomenya goika orora ababisa baye bagochandeka na gosira,

English: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu kama chakula, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: na omonto oyio goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw'embori eyio, erio ayenyeenyere agwo bosio bw'Eema y'Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Aroni basiarere amanyinga aye ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote agusaye maiti ya mtu yeyote atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase amatuko atan'abere.

English: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara nyingine Wafilisti wakavamia lile bonde;
Ekegusii: Naende Abafirisiti bakagenda aroro eria kabere bagasakora.

English: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
Kiswahili: Wakati mfalme alipokuwa mezani pake, manukato yangu yalisambaza harufu yake nzuri.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.

English: “Why are you doing these things?” Eli said to his sons. “I hear about your wicked deeds from all these people.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaambia, “Kwa nini mmefanya mambo kama haya? Nimesikia kutoka kwa watu wote juu ya haya matendo yenu maovu.
Ekegusii: Erio akabateebia: “Nase ki mogokora amang’ana buna ayio? Abanto bonsi banteebirie amabe aino mogokora.

English: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn't bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.
Kiswahili: Wakati Hamani alipoona kuwa Mordekai hampigii magoti wala kumpa heshima alighadhibika.
Ekegusii: Hamani akaba nendamwamu enene mono ekero aroche ng'a Moredekai tarenge gotung'ama ase okomosasiima,

English: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Kiswahili: Upendo wako usiokoma ni wa thamani mno! Watu wakuu na wadogo hujificha uvulini wa mbawa zako.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, naki obwanchani bwao bwa botambe bore obonene! Mwanyabaanto nigo bagotamera ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.

English: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
Kiswahili: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, ukasamehe dhambi ya watu wako Israeli na kuwarudisha katika nchi uliyowapa baba zao.
Ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi'abaanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.

English: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
Kiswahili: lakini jambo hilo likitokea wakati jua limechomoza, huyo mtu atakuwa na hatia ya kumwaga damu. “Mwizi huyo sharti alipe, lakini kama hana kitu, lazima auzwe ili alipe kwa ajili ya wizi wake.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kararisie etugo yaye ase omogondo bw'endagera, gose oyo bw'emesabibu, na gotiga riicho riaye ririe endagera y'omonto onde, nere goika aakane endagera enoru korwa ase omogondo oye, gose eyere engiya korwa ase emesabibu yaye.

English: and in her friendship is good delight, and in the labors of her hands is wealth that doesn't fail, and understanding is in her companionship, and great renown in having fellowship with her words, I went about seeking how to take her to myself.
Kiswahili: na katika urafiki wake kuna furaha njema, na katika kazi za mikono yake kuna utajiri usioisha, na ufahamu uko katika ushirika wake, na sifa kubwa katika kuwa na ushirika na maneno yake, nilizunguka-zunguka nikitafuta jinsi ya kumchukua kwangu.
Ekegusii: buna baria banchete obongaini nigo bakonyora omogooko botambe, na baria bagokora emeremo yaye nigo bakonyora enibo etari koera, na baria bagokwana naborobwo nigo bakoba abang'aini, na baria bakobwatia amang'ana aye nigo bakonyora amasikani; bono nigo natarire goeta nkorigia obongaini obo.

English: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote atakayeikimbia hiyo hofu kuu ataanguka ndani ya shimo, yeyote atakayepanda kutoka shimoni, atanaswa katika mtego, kwa sababu nitaletea Moabu mwaka wa adhabu yake,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oratame ase engencho y'omoondoko nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima nabwatwe nomoeto. Nindete ayio igoro y'Abamoabu ase omwaka ndabae egesusuro kiabo. Nab'Omonene atebiire.

English: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
Kiswahili: Kama kukiwa na jambo lolote la kutia moyo katika kuunganishwa na Kristo, kukiwa faraja yoyote katika upendo wake, kukiwa na ushirika wowote na Roho, kukiwa na wema wowote na huruma,
Ekegusii: Obogima bwaino ime ya Kristo nigo bokobaa chinguru, n’obwanchani bwaye bwabaremia. Okobwatana kw’Omoika, karabe amaabera ande onsi na amabeebe,

English: On seeing this, Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, got up from the assembly, took a spear in his hand,
Kiswahili: Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, alipoona jambo hili, akaondoka kwenye kusanyiko, akachukua mkuki mkononi mwake,
Ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, akaimoka korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akabogoria ritimo,

English: So there were four tables inside the gateway and four outside—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were to be slaughtered.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kulikuwa na meza nne upande mmoja wa lango na nyingine nne upande mwingine, zote zilikuwa meza nane, ambapo dhabihu zilichinjiwa.
Ekegusii: Chimesa echio chionsi ase ebing’wanso biarenge konyenyerwa nigo chiarenge isano na isato, inye nigo chiarenge ase rikere erimo ri’oboagacho, na inye ase rikere rinde.

English: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kama huyo mwanamke ataolewa na mwanaume mwingine wakati mumewe akiwa bado yuko hai, ataitwa mzinzi. Lakini kama mumewe akifa, mwanamke huyo hafungwi tena na sheria ya ndoa, naye akiolewa na mtu mwingine haitwi mzinzi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha oye are moyo, aise koba nomosaacha onde nigo akorokwa omotomani; korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko ayio. Naisa konyuomwa nomosaacha onde, takorokwa omotomani.

English: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
Kiswahili: Petro akawaonya kwa maneno mengine mengi na kuwasihi akisema, “Jiepusheni na kizazi hiki kilichopotoka.”
Ekegusii: Petero akabaorokeria ase amang'ana ande amange na kobakuurera, ogoteeba: “Etoorie korwa ase ekegori eke getari ekeronge.”

English: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
Kiswahili: Chochote nchi itoacho katika mwaka wa Sabato kitakuwa chakula chenu wenyewe, watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa, na mkazi wa muda anayeishi miongoni mwenu,
Ekegusii: Echio chiremerie ase omwaka bw'ogotimoka gw'ense eria, nachio chiraabe chindagera chibaisaine, aye omonyene, na abasomba bao, abamura na abaiseke, na omokori emeremo oo orikire, na omomenyi omenyete bwoo.

English: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
Kiswahili: “Kama ninyi mnaufahamu, sikieni hili; sikilizeni hili nisemalo.
Ekegusii: “Onye more nokomanya, igwa aya; tegerera moigwe aya ngoteeba:

English: And now you think you can resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army, and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made for you as gods.
Kiswahili: “Hata sasa unapanga kupingana na ufalme wa Bwana ambao uko mikononi mwa wazao wa Daudi. Kweli ninyi ni jeshi kubwa nanyi mnazo ndama za dhahabu Yeroboamu alizozitengeneza kuwa miungu yenu.
Ekegusii: Bono inwe igo morengereretie korwania oborwoti bw’Omonene bore ase amaboko ’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Daudi, ekiagera more omoganda omonene, naende ekiagera mobwate emegwekano ye chimori ye chitaabu eria Yeroboamu abaroiseirie ekaba chinyasae chiaino.

English: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
Kiswahili: nami nitaizidisha idadi ya watu kwenu, naam, nyumba yote ya Israeli. Miji itakaliwa na watu na magofu yatajengwa upya.
Ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto abange bache ase more bamenyeo, ee, Abaisraeli bonsi; emechie yaino nemenywe naende, na amatombe naro naagachwe naende.

English: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don't observe your word.
Kiswahili: Ninawatazama wasioamini kwa chuki, kwa kuwa hawalitii neno lako.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria abatari abegenwa nigo nkogeechigwa nabarabwo, ekiagera tibabwateti ring'ana riao.

English: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom away from him. I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.” Hadad’s Return
Kiswahili: Lakini pia sitaurarua ufalme wote kutoka kwake, bali nitampa kabila moja kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wangu na kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu, ambao nimeuchagua.” Adui Za Solomoni
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, tinkorusia oborwoti bwonsi korwa ase omwana oo, nimoe egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, naende ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete.” Ababisa ba Sulemani

English: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.
Kiswahili: “Waambie hivi: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Hakika kama niishivyo, wale waliobaki katika magofu wataanguka kwa upanga, wale walio nje mashambani nitawatoa wararuliwe na wanyama pori, nao wale walio katika ngome na kwenye mapango watakufa kwa tauni.
Ekegusii: “Aye goika obateebie ng'a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteeba: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, abanto abwo bamenyete ase amaturi mbakenywe nemioro, na abare isiko nintome ching'iti chi'orosana chibarie; abwo bamenyete ase ebitare na ime ase amakuruma, amarwaire amabe nabaite.

English: They took their spoils, and Judas took Apollonius' sword, and he fought with it all his days.
Kiswahili: Walichukua nyara zao, na Yuda akachukua upanga wa Apolonio, na akapigana nao siku zake zote.
Ekegusii: Ase egati yebisakorwa biatogete, Yuda akaira omoro bwa Apolonio, oyio akorerete emeremo ase amatuko onsi yobogima bwaye.

English: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
Kiswahili: kwamba mtu mwovu huepushwa kutoka siku ya maafa, kwamba huokolewa kutoka siku ya ghadhabu?
Ekegusii: ng'a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri'endamwamu?

English: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
Kiswahili: wakati ngʼombe saba, wazuri na wanono, walitokea mtoni wakajilisha kwenye matete.
Ekegusii: Akarora chiombe isano na ibere, chingiya mono chinoru, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka.

English: Our help is in Yahweh's name, who made heaven and earth.
Kiswahili: Msaada wetu ni katika jina la Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Ogokonywa gwaito nigo gokorwa ase erieta ri'Omonene, oyio otongete igoro na ense.

English: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens, and as officers for your tribes.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo niliwachukua wanaume viongozi wa makabila yenu, wenye hekima na wanaoheshimika, nami nikawateua wawe na mamlaka juu yenu kama majemadari wa maelfu, wa mamia, wa hamsini, na wa makumi, na kama maafisa wa makabila.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabeeka abanto baria abang’aini na bamanyekanete buya, abwo mwachorete korwa ase ebisaku biaino nkababeeka koba abaraai baino. Abande ase chilifu, na abande ase amagana, na abande ase emerongo etano, na abande ase ikomi. Naboigo nkababeeka abateneneri bande b’ebisaku biaino bionsi.

English: He was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. For although Judas was one of the Twelve, he was later to betray Jesus.
Kiswahili: (Hapa alikuwa anasema juu ya Yuda, mwana wa Simoni Iskariote. Ingawa alikuwa mmoja wa wale kumi na wawili, ndiye ambaye baadaye angemsaliti Yesu.)
Ekegusii: Nigo akwanete igoro ya Yudasi, omwana o Simioni Iskariota, ekiagera oyo nere orache komorua; na ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.

English: That is why I have often been hindered from coming to you. Paul’s Travel Plans (1 Corinthians 16:5–9)
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nimezuiliwa mara nyingi nisiweze kuja kwenu. Paulo Apanga Kwenda Rumi
Ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete ingatangwa ebiro ebinge tinaacha ase more.

English: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akatoa amri kuhusu wao kwa kuhani Eleazari, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa jamaa za makabila ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ abanto abwo, Musa agachiika Eleazari Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abaraai be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli,

English: A worthless person, a wicked man, walks with a perverse mouth,
Kiswahili: Mtu mbaya sana na mlaghai, ambaye huzungukazunguka na maneno ya upotovu,
Ekegusii: Omonto otagwenereti kende ore omokori amabe nigo agoeta‐eta, ogokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye.

English: Their appearance is like that of horses, and they gallop like swift steeds.
Kiswahili: Wanaonekana kama farasi; wanakwenda mbio kama askari wapanda farasi.
Ekegusii: Okororekana kwabo nigo konga buna ogwe chibarasi; nigo chikominyoka buna chibarasi chi’okorwana esegi.

English: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
Kiswahili: Aliyekuwa amekikalia alikuwa anaonekana kama yaspi na akiki. Kukizunguka kile kiti cha enzi palikuwa na upinde wa mvua ulioonekana kama zumaridi.
Ekegusii: Ere oyoikaranseteo nigo agwekaine rigena rie rigori ria yasipi na ria saridio, na ekerogo keria ki’obonene nigo giaetananire nomokubinyongo bw’embura, okororekana buna rigena ria sumaridi.

English: In the days of Enemessar, I did many alms deeds to my kindred: I gave my bread to the hungry,
Kiswahili: Katika siku za Enemessar, niliwatendea jamaa zangu matendo mengi ya ukarimu: Niliwapa wenye njaa mkate wangu,
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chiria Shalimanesa arenge omorwoti nigo nabete ngokorera abanto baminto Abayahudi abwo barenge abataka amaya.

English: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear,
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akaweka nadhiri, akisema, “Kama Mungu akiwa pamoja nami na kunilinda katika safari niendayo, akinipa chakula nile na nguo nivae
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaria eira, okobora: “Nyasae karabe amo nainche, andende ase orogendo rwane na kong’a endagera nkoria, ne chianga nkobeeka,

English: They overcame him because of the Lamb's blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn't love their life, even to death.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamshinda kwa damu ya Mwana-Kondoo na kwa neno la ushuhuda wao. Wala wao hawakuyapenda maisha yao hata kufa.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamobua ase chinguru chi'amanyinga 'Emanwa y'Eng'ondi, na ase amang'ana 'oborori bwabo; tibancha obogima bwabo nonya ngoika ogokwa.

English: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus 28:15–30)
Kiswahili: Kisha akavifungia kwenye vipande vya mabega ya kisibau kuwa vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Kifuko Cha Kifuani (Kutoka 28:15-30)
Ekegusii: Bakayabeeka ase ebitwanga bi’amareko ase egesibao ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Egesembe ki’obokuani gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 28:15-30)

English: After Ibzan, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel ten years.
Kiswahili: Baada yake Eloni, Mzabuloni, akawa mwamuzi wa Israeli, naye akawaamua kwa muda wa miaka kumi.
Ekegusii: Magega ya Ibasani, Eloni, omoSabuloni, akagaambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi.

English: I also will write to them words of encouragement and of honor and of gifts, that they may be with me to aid me.”
Kiswahili: Pia nitawaandikia maneno ya kutia moyo na ya heshima na ya zawadi, ili wawe pamoja nami kunisaidia.
Ekegusii: Bona nainche nigo nkobariikera Abayahudi riruube riobosani. Nimbariere chiira chiokobaa oborai ao ao, erio barabwo bang'e ogokoonya ebiro binde bionsi erabetererie.”

English: Now King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known, and people were saying, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Herode akasikia habari hizi, kwa maana jina la Yesu lilikuwa limejulikana sana. Watu wengine walikuwa wakisema, “Yohana Mbatizaji amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, ndiyo sababu nguvu za kutenda miujiza zinafanya kazi ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Herode akaigwa amang’ana, ekiagera erieta ria Yeso konya riakumire kera ase. Abanto bande bakaboora, “Yohana Omobatisi obokire korwa ase abakuure, nakio gekogera chinguru echi chigokora emeremo ime asare.”

English: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.'”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu nitakulipa vizuri sana na kufanya lolote usemalo. Njoo unilaanie watu hawa.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo 'ngochia kogokorera aya arakorentere amasikani amanene, naende kende gionsi oramborie, ekio ningokorere; aye inchwo ondagererie abanto aba.”

English: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”
Kiswahili: Kisha mpaka utashuka kuelekea Mto Yordani na kuishia katika Bahari ya Chumvi. “ ‘Hii itakuwa nchi yenu, ikiwa na mipaka yake kila upande.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio rotirimboke robwatie orooche rwa Yorodani rotwomere Enyancha y’omonyoo. Eye nero erabe ense yaino, ne chimbebe chiaye chietanaineo.”

English: By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii, Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa anaonyesha kwamba, maadamu ile hema ya kwanza ilikuwa bado imesimama, njia ya kuingia Patakatifu pa Patakafifu ilikuwa bado haijafunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu nigo okworokereria ring’ana eri, ng’a enchera y’ogosoa Aase Aachenu konya teraorokigwa ekero Eema ye ritang’ani ereo eteneine.

English: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.
Kiswahili: Pendekezo lao likawa jema kwa Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana abo akagwenera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu.

English: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife there, commanding him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,”
Kiswahili: Sasa Esau akajua kuwa Isaki amembariki Yakobo na kumtuma kwenda Padan-Aramu ili achukue mke huko na kwamba alipombariki alimwamuru akisema, “Usioe mke katika binti za Wakanaani,”
Ekegusii: Bono Esau akarora buna Isaka asesenirie Yakobo na komotoma agende Padan‐Aramu anyuome omokungu korwa aroro, ekiagera ekero amosesenetie, akamokania tabaisa konyuoma moiseke onde bwensi bw’Abakaanani!

English: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu si Myahudi kwa vile alivyo kwa nje, wala tohara ya kweli si kitu cha nje au cha kimwili.
Ekegusii: Inaki ere oyore Omoyahudi ase isiko oka, tari Omoyahudi bw'ekeene, gose okwaroka koria gokorire isiko ase omobere, tikori okwaroka gw'ekeene.

English: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
Kiswahili: Chuma hupatikana ardhini, nayo shaba huyeyushwa kutoka mawe ya madini.
Ekegusii: Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena 'ebitare anyititorwa.

English: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet are to anoint him king over Israel. You are to blow the ram’s horn and declare, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
Kiswahili: Huko kuhani Sadoki na nabii Nathani wamtie mafuta awe mfalme juu ya Israeli. Pigeni tarumbeta na mpaze sauti, ‘Mfalme Solomoni aishi maisha marefu!’
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo Zadoki Omokuani na Nathani omobani bamoake amaguta ase okomwatanana abe omorwoti okogaambera Abaisraeli. Erio mobugie ebitureeri bi’omochengo, motebe: Sulemani omorwoti ochie kare!

English: So Samuel told him everything and did not hide a thing from him. “He is the LORD,” replied Eli. “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Samweli akamwambia kila kitu, bila kumficha chochote. Ndipo Eli akasema, “Yeye ni Bwana; na afanye lile lililo jema machoni pake!”
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamoteebia kera ring’ana, tamobisa rinde rionsi. Eli akabora, “Nere Omonene; tiga akore eri rikomogwenera.”

English: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, Yoshua alikuwa amevaa nguo chafu alipokuwa amesimama mbele ya malaika.
Ekegusii: Bono Yoshua nigo ateneine ase obosio bw'omomalaika, obegete chianga chire ne riko.

English: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight. He didn't depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.
Kiswahili: Alifanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, na hakuacha dhambi yoyote kati ya zile za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati ambazo alikuwa amesababisha Israeli kuzitenda, bali aliendelea kuzitenda.
Ekegusii: Nere agakora amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, teatananete korwa ase ekemo ki'ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, korende akagenderera kobikora.

English: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe, kwa sababu ya damu ya Agano langu nawe, nitawaacha huru wafungwa wako watoke kwenye shimo lisilo na maji.
Ekegusii: “Ase engencho y'amanyinga 'okobwatana okwo nakorire naye ninsibore abasibwa bao, mbarusie ase engoro etari namaache.

English: The king said, “What honor or favor have we done for Mordecai?” The king's servants said, “You haven't done anything for him.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akasema, “Tumemtendea Mordekai heshima au upendeleo gani?” Watumishi wa mfalme wakasema, “Hamjamtendea chochote.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaboria, “Inee! Ngosika ki, gose masikani ki Modekai akoreirwe ase engencho y'ayio?” Abanto b'omorwoti abarenge komokorera, bakamoiraneria, “Tana gokorerwa kende.”

English: If a fire breaks out and spreads to thornbushes so that it consumes stacked or standing grain, or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make full restitution.
Kiswahili: “Kama moto ukiwaka na kuenea kwenye vichaka vya miiba na kuteketeza miganda ya nafaka au nafaka ambayo haijavunwa, au kuteketeza shamba lote, mtu yule aliyewasha moto lazima alipe.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogosamba omorero, na omorero oyio bwesiarere gochia ase amagwa, na emesaima y’endagera ere ase omogondo eyie, omonto oria goika aakane yonsi pi.

English: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
Kiswahili: Yale malango kumi na mbili yalikuwa ni lulu kumi na mbili, kila lango lilikuwa limetengenezwa kwa lulu moja. Barabara kuu ya mji huo ilikuwa ya dhahabu safi ingʼaayo kama kioo.
Ekegusii: Ebiita biria ikomi na bibere nechiruru ikomi na ibere, kera egeita neruru eyemo. Na enchera y'omochie netaabu engiya ere buna ekerore getagotanga omobaso.

English: Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
Kiswahili: Zitakaseni Sabato zangu ili ziwe ishara kati yangu nanyi. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane chibe chinchenu, erinde chibe ekemanyererio ase egati y’ane nainwe; erio nario moranyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
Kiswahili: Miji yote waliyopewa koo za Wamerari, waliokuwa mabaki ya Walawi, ilikuwa ni kumi na miwili.
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto b'eamate ya Merari, abatigarete ase chiamate chi'Abalawi, baetwe emechie ikomi na ebere, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: I adorned you with jewelry, and I put bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck.
Kiswahili: Nikakupamba kwa vito: nikakuvika bangili mikononi mwako na mkufu shingoni mwako,
Ekegusii: Nkagochabera n’ebinto bi’obwari, na ase amaboko ao ngakobekera chibangiri, ne chisonoi ase rigoti ria’o.

English: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
Kiswahili: Je basi, Mungu atakulipa kwa masharti yako, wakati wewe umekataa kutubu? Yakupasa wewe uamue, wala si mimi; sasa niambie lile ulijualo.
Ekegusii: Nigo okagete ng'a Nyasae nigo aragoakane buna oranche, ekiagera gwakanire ande onsi? Aye goika ochore, gose tari inche; ase ayio, kwana aya omanyete.

English: “Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to these your cities.
Kiswahili: “Weka alama za barabara, weka vibao vya kuelekeza. Zingatia vyema njia kuu, barabara ile unayoipita. Rudi, ee Bikira Israeli, rudi kwenye miji yako.
Ekegusii: “Ebekere ebimanyererio ase enchera yao, beka ekiorokererio kegokoraa ase ogoetera. Rengereria mono igoro y'enchera enene, enchera eyio gwaeterete. Irana inwe Abaisraeli abamore buna omoiseke omwekungi, irana ase emechie yaino.

English: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
Kiswahili: Hodia, Bani na Beninu.
Ekegusii: Hodia, na Bani, na Beninu.

English: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba wakati u karibu, hata malangoni.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorarore aya aorokire, momanye ng’a obeire ang’e na gesieri.

English: Furthermore, I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there is wickedness, and in the place of righteousness there is wickedness.
Kiswahili: Pia nikaona kitu kingine tena chini ya jua: Mahali pa kutolea hukumu, uovu ulikuwepo, mahali pa kupatia haki, uovu ulikuwepo.
Ekegusii: Naende nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a aase ekeene na oboronge bigwenerete koba, nao obobe bore.

English: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
Kiswahili: Basi, nyenyekeeni chini ya mkono wa Mungu ulio hodari, ili awakweze kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekeyie inse y’okoboko kwa Nyasae okore nokobua, erinde ere abaimokererie igoro ase ekero kiaye.

English: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and take them for your inheritance, as from the beginning.
Kiswahili: Kusanya makabila yote ya Yakobo pamoja, na kuyatwaa yawe urithi wako, kama mwanzo.
Ekegusii: Tiga onde bwensi oyio oraminchorie asambwe nekeririanda kiao ekenene, na baria bakobachaanda abanto bao banyoore ogoitwa.

English: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana huzalisha ayala, na huuacha msitu wazi. Hekaluni mwake wote wasema, “Utukufu!”
Ekegusii: Eriogi erio ri’Omonene nigo rikorekeria chingabi, nigo rigosabora emete y’amanani yaba bosa. Ase Hekalu yaye ebitongwa bionsi biatogia obonene bwaye.

English: and I brought them into the house of the LORD, to a chamber occupied by the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was near the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
Kiswahili: Nikawaleta katika nyumba ya Bwana, ndani ya chumba cha wana wa Hanani mwana wa Igdalia mtu wa Mungu. Kilikuwa karibu na chumba cha maafisa, ambacho kilikuwa juu ya kile cha Maaseya mwana wa Shalumu, aliyekuwa bawabu.
Ekegusii: Nkabarenta ase enyomba y’Omonene ase eero y’abana ba Hanani, mosinto o Igidalia, omonto o Nyasae. Eero eyio nigo yarenge ang’e neria y’abanene b’obogambi eyarenge irongo y’eria ya Maaseya mosinto o Salumu, omorendi bw’egesieri.

English: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
Kiswahili: Sasa nisikilize mimi, nitakupa shauri, naye Mungu na awe pamoja nawe. Yapasa wewe uwe mwakilishi wa watu mbele za Mungu na ulete mashauri yao kwake.
Ekegusii: Bono ntegerera, ngoteebie chisemi chingiya orakore, na Nyasae nabe amo naye. Aye kabe oyo ogotenenera abanto ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na komoirera amang'ana abo.

English: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Maria Magdalene akaenda kuwatangazia wanafunzi wa Yesu, akisema, “Nimemwona Bwana!” Naye akawaambia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemweleza mambo hayo yote.
Ekegusii: Mariamu Magidalena akagenda, agateebia aborokigwa amang'ana ng'a, “Narorire Omonene”, naende ng'a omotebirie aya.

English: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli wakaitwa kutoka Naftali, Asheri na Manase, wakawafuatia Wamidiani.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli korwa eamate ya Nafutali na egi'Aseri, amo nekia Manase gionsi bakarangerigwa goocha amo kobwatia Abamidiani.

English: Boldly and freely he proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Akahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kufundisha mambo yale yaliyomhusu Bwana Yesu Kristo, kwa ujasiri wote na bila kizuizi chochote.
Ekegusii: okorandia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na kworokereria abanto amang’ana igoro y’Omonene Yeso Kristo noboremu obonge, takanigwa na monto.

English: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.
Kiswahili: “Sasa, Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, ambaye uliwatoa watu wako Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu, na ambaye umejifanyia Jina linalodumu mpaka leo, tumetenda dhambi, tumefanya mabaya.
Ekegusii: “Na bono aye Omonene Nyasae oito, aye kwarusetie abanto bao korwa ase ense ya Misiri n'okoboko kwao kore nokobua, na kwemanyekanirie goika rituko ria reero. Intwe twakorire ebibe na ayare amabe.

English: Antiochus son of Demetrius the king sent a letter from the islands of the sea to Simon the priest and governor of the Jews, and to all the nation.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Antioko, mwana wa Demetrio, alituma barua kutoka visiwa vya bahari kwa Simoni kuhani na liwali wa Wayahudi, na kwa taifa lote.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ebisinga bi'enyancha, Antioko omwana bw'omorwoti Demeturio, akariika riruube rikobwatia ase Simioni, Omokuani omonene na omorai bwa Abayahudi, naboigo ase egesaku gionsi:

English: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
Kiswahili: Kama upepo utokao mashariki, nitawatawanya mbele ya adui zao; nitawapa kisogo wala sio uso, katika siku ya maafa yao.”
Ekegusii: Nimbaserebanie ase obosio bw'ababisa babo, buna omwaga o moocha ogoserebania. Ning'onchoke imbae omogongo, gose tinkoborokia obosio bwane ase rituko ri'emechando yabo.”

English: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem. The Return to Nazareth (Matthew 2:19–23)
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, Ana alikuja akaanza kusifu, akimshukuru Mungu na kusema habari za huyo mtoto kwa watu wote waliokuwa wakitarajia ukombozi wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agateebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang’ana igoro y’Omwana oria. Koirana gochia Nazareti

English: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, and he will be unable to conceal himself. His descendants will be destroyed along with his relatives and neighbors, and he will be no more.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitamvua Esau nguo abaki uchi, nitayafunua maficho yake, ili asiweze kujificha. Watoto wake, jamaa na majirani wataangamia, naye hatakuwepo tena.
Ekegusii: Nachoboire abanto b’Esau na kobatiga bosa; nasioririe aase bakwebisa, bono tibakonyora aase bakwebisa. Abanto b’ororeria rwabo na abamwabo basirigwe, boigo nabaanto bamenyete ang’e, bonsi basirigwe gose nonya noyomo tatigareti.

English: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
Kiswahili: Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili kuanzia juu hadi chini.
Ekegusii: Egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatondoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere.

English: For I have trusted in the Everlasting, that he will save you; and joy has come to me from the Holy One, because of the mercy that will soon come to you from your Everlasting Savior.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimemtumainia Yeye wa Milele, kwamba atakuokoa; na furaha imenijia kutoka kwa Mtakatifu, kwa sababu ya rehema itakayokujia hivi karibuni kutoka kwa Mwokozi wako wa Milele.
Ekegusii: Ninde n'ogosemeria buna Nyasae o kare na kare nabasibore bwango iga. Omochenu, omotoria oino o kare na kare nandetere omogoko ekero arabarorere amabera.

English: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Kisha Eloni akafa, akazikwa katika Aiyaloni, katika nchi ya Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Ayaloni, ase orogongo rwa Sabuloni.

English: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
Kiswahili: Kama ukimrudia Mwenyezi, utarudishwa upya: Kama ukiuondoa uovu uwe mbali na hema lako,
Ekegusii: Korairanere Omobui, noiranerigwe amaya ao; korende oserie obobe korwa ase obomenyo bwao.

English: They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to return them to their bondage in Egypt. But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.
Kiswahili: Wakakataa kusikiliza na kushindwa kukumbuka miujiza uliyoifanya miongoni mwao. Wakawa na shingo ngumu, na katika uasi wao wakamchagua kiongozi ili warudi kwenye utumwa wao. Lakini wewe ni Mungu mwenye kusamehe, mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, ni mwingi wa upendo. Kwa hiyo hukuwaacha,
Ekegusii: Bakaanga koigwera, gose tibarengereretie na koinyora amakumia gwakorete ase egati yabo; bagakong’ia ebigoti, bagachora omoraai abatang’ane koirana gochia Misiri ase obosomba. Korende aye naye Nyasae bw’okwabera, nigo ore omuya, naende omonyene amaabera, tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, aye nigo ore nobwanchani obonge botari koera, gose tikwabatigete.

English: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Filipo akakimbilia lile gari na kumsikia yule mtu anasoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya. Filipo akamuuliza, “Je, unaelewa hayo usomayo?”
Ekegusii: Filipo akaminyoka gochia asare, akamoigwa ogosoma egetabu y'omobani Isaya, akamobooria: “Inee! Kwamanyire buya aya ogosoma?”

English: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
Kiswahili: Basi, “Ikiwa ni vigumu kwa mwenye haki kuokoka, itakuwaje kwa mtu asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Na, buna eriikire, “Onye ekoba aakong'u omonyene oboronge gotooreka, oria otamoirogeti Nyasae na omonyene ebibe, naki rende kerabe asare?”

English: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
Kiswahili: “Juu ya meza ya mikate ya Wonyesho watatandaza kitambaa cha buluu na waweke sahani juu yake, masinia, bakuli na magudulia kwa ajili ya sadaka za kinywaji; mkate ule ambao upo hapa daima utabaki juu yake.
Ekegusii: “Igoro ase emesa yemegati ekoruegwa ase Omonene baare egetambaa kere buru kegima, naende babeekeo chinteru, ne chisani ase ubani, amo n’ebitaabo n’ebitoono, ase ebio bagochia koumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa. Emegati ekoruegwa botambe ase Omonene ebekweo boigo.

English: Behold, I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’” Sennacherib’s Blasphemous Letter (Isaiah 37:8–13)
Kiswahili: Sikiliza! Nitatia roho fulani ndani yake ili atakaposikia taarifa fulani, atarudi nchi yake mwenyewe, nami huko nitafanya auawe kwa upanga.’ ”
Ekegusii: Rora nimbeeke omoika gete ime yaye, erio ekero araigwe chinkuma airoke, airane gochia ase ense yaye; nimoiyerie aitwe n’omoro agwo ase ense yaye omonyene.” Abaasuri bagotoma ogotianera konde (Isaya 37:8-20)

English: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances—for the man who does these things will live by them.
Kiswahili: Nikawapa amri zangu na kuwajulisha sheria zangu, kwa kuwa mtu anayezitii ataishi kwa hizo.
Ekegusii: Agwo ’nkabaa emeroberio y’ane echiikire, na nkaborokereria amachiiko ane, na omonto orayabwate nabe moyo goetera asaro.

English: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel; the LORD of Hosts is His name.
Kiswahili: ninyi mnaojiita raiya wa mji mtakatifu, na kumtegemea Mungu wa Israeli, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake:
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokweroka ng’a nab’omochie omochenu more, naende ng’a nigo mosemeretie Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyokorokwa Omonene bw’Emeganda.

English: “Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the holy place? For it is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the congregation by making atonement for them before the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini hamkula sadaka ya dhambi katika eneo la mahali patakatifu? Ni takatifu sana. Mlipewa ninyi ili kuondoa hatia ya jumuiya kwa ajili ya kuwafanyia upatanisho mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Nase ki motarierete ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe agwo aase are aachenu? Ekio negento egechenu mono mwaeirwe, erinde moruserie omoganda ebibe biabo, na gokora okobwatanigwa ase bare ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: He took a member of the royal family and made a covenant with him, putting him under oath. Then he carried away the leading men of the land,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamchukua mmoja wa jamaa ya mfalme na kufanya mapatano naye, akamfanya aape. Akawachukua pia viongozi wa nchi,
Ekegusii: Ere akaimokia omoiborwa bw’enyomba y’omorwoti, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, na akamoteebia arie eira y’ogwetiania, (Abanto b’ense eria baare nokobua akabaira

English: Then he set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the south and one on the north. The pillar on the south he named Jachin, and the pillar on the north he named Boaz.
Kiswahili: Akazisimamisha hizo nguzo mbele ya Hekalu, moja upande wa kusini na nyingine upande wa kaskazini. Ile moja ya upande wa kusini akaiita Yakini, na ya upande wa kaskazini akaiita Boazi.
Ekegusii: Agatenenia chisiiro chiria bosio bwe Hekalu, eyemo ensemo ya Irianyi na eyende ensemo ya sugusu. Eria yarenge ensemo ya Irianyi akayeroka Yakini, na eria yarenge ensemo ya sugusu akayeroka Boazi.

English: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mko tayari kukubali hilo, yeye ndiye yule Eliya ambaye manabii walikuwa wamesema angekuja.
Ekegusii: Na inwe onye morigetie gwancha, ere nere Elija otebetwe ore gocha.

English: And Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran, and set out for the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan,
