Kiswahili: Abramu akamchukua Sarai mkewe pamoja na Loti mwana wa ndugu yake, mali zote walizokuwa nazo pamoja na watu aliokuwa amewapata huko Harani, wakasafiri mpaka nchi ya Kanaani, wakafika huko.
Ekegusii: Aburamu akaira Sarai mokaye, na Loti, omwana omomura omwabo, na ebinto bionsi ebi babwate, ebio konya benyoreire abanyene, na abasomba babo bonsi babwate agwo Harani, bakaimoka, bakagenda ense ya Kaanani.

English: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Rudisha upanga wako mahali pake, kwa maana wote watumiao upanga watakufa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Irania omoyio oo o birende aase aye, ekiagera bonsi abakoimokia omoyio o birende inabasire ase omoyio o birende.

English: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Nitatikisa mataifa yote, nacho kile kinachotamaniwa na mataifa yote kitakuja, nami nitaujaza utukufu katika nyumba hii,' asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw'Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Boigo nintengechie ebisaku bionsi, erinde ayaganeirie nabaanto b'ebisaku bionsi aoroke, na inche ing'ichorie enyomba yane nobonene.

English: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo si wawili tena, bali mwili mmoja. Kwa hiyo alichokiunganisha Mungu, mwanadamu asikitenganishe.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo. Naboigo, ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”

English: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.” Habakkuk’s Second Complaint (Psalms 11:1–7)
Kiswahili: Kisha wanapita kasi kama upepo na kusonga mbele: watu wenye hatia, ambao nguvu zao ndio mungu wao.” Lalamiko La Pili La Habakuki
Ekegusii: Erio baeta bwango buna omwaga, bagenderera gochia bosio; abanto abwo bare abamochi, ne chinguru chiabo nachio enyasae yabo.” Habakuki okorera ase Omonene naende

English: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.
Kiswahili: Kama akija peke yake, atakwenda huru peke yake, lakini kama akija na mke, ataondoka pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokuungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.

English: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
Kiswahili: Kila mtu aangukaye juu ya jiwe hilo atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oragwe igoro ase rigena erio nabunanekane, na ere oyo riragwere narimosenyente.

English: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. There were twelve cities, along with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji mingine iliyojumuishwa ni Katathi, Nahalali, Shimroni, Idala na Bethlehemu. Kulikuwa na miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: Amo neyio orogongo rwabo rokabwaterania Katati, na Nahalali, na Simuroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

English: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ana kidonda chenye wekundu na weupe kwenye kichwa chake chenye upaa, au kwenye paji la uso, ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza unaojitokeza kichwani au kwenye paji lake la uso.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ase risio ri'omotwe oye, magega gose bosio, obwate egesambo kere nobobariri na oborabu, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokeire ase risio.

English: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.
Kiswahili: kufuatana na walivyozaliwa: majina sita katika kito kimoja, na mengine sita katika kito kingine.
Ekegusii: amarieta atano na rimo ase rigena erimo, na atano na rimo ase rigena rinde, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo.

English: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?' So its name is called Bamah to this day.”'
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikawaambia: Ni nini maana yake hapa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu mnapopaendea?' ” (Basi jina la mahali pale panaitwa Bama hata hivi leo.)
Ekegusii: Erio nkababoria: Aase agwo aimokererete igoro ase mogochia naaki? Ase ayio, aase buna agwo nigo akorokwa Aase Aimokererete Igoro Agosasiimerwa, nabo akorokwa goika reero iga.

English: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
Kiswahili: Lakini niliponyamaza kimya na kutulia, hata pasipo kusema lolote jema, uchungu wangu uliongezeka.
Ekegusii: Igo narenge nkirete‐kiri, tinare gokwana, tinaba na koremigwa konde, obororo bwane bokamenteka mono,

English: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
Kiswahili: Wana simba wenye nguvu hutindikiwa na kuona njaa, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana hawatakosa kitu chochote kilicho chema.
Ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.

English: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
Kiswahili: utu wangu wa ndani utafurahi, wakati midomo yako itakapozungumza lililo sawa.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebikoba biao birakwane amang'ana amaronge, nigo ndabe nomogooko ime y'ane.

English: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, the keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the Second District.
Kiswahili: Hilkia kuhani, Ahikamu, Akbori, Shafani na Asaya wakaenda kuongea na nabii mke Hulda, ambaye alikuwa mke wa Shalumu mwana wa Tikwa, mwana wa Harhasi mtunzaji wa chumba cha mavazi. Hulda aliishi Yerusalemu katika Mtaa wa Pili.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hilikia Omokuani, na Ahikamu, na Akibori, na Safani, na Asaia bakagenda koboria Hulda, omobani omokungu, mokaa Salumu, mosinto o Tikiwa, o Harasi. Salumu oyio nigo arenge omorendi bwe rigachero rie chianga. Ase ekero ekio Hulda nigo amenyete agwo Yerusalemu ase ensemo enyia.

English: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.
Kiswahili: Kisha Memukani akajibu mbele ya mfalme na wakuu, “Malkia Vashti si kwamba amemkosea mfalme tu bali pia amewakosea wakuu wote na watu wa himaya yote ya Mfalme Ahasuero.
Ekegusii: Erio Memukani agateebia omorwoti na abanene bonsi, “Vasti eting'ana tari ng'a nomorwoti bweka amocheire, korende omocheire abanene bonsi, na abanto bonsi bare ase chingongo chionsi echio aye omorwoti Ahaswero okogambera.

English: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. So do whatever God has told you.”
Kiswahili: Hakika utajiri wote ambao Mungu ameuchukua kutoka kwa baba yetu ni mali yetu na watoto wetu. Hivyo fanya lolote lile Mungu alilokuambia.”
Ekegusii: Naki enibo eyio yonsi Nyasae arusirie korwa ase tata nigo etotungetie intwe na abana baito. Ase igo, ayio onsi Nyasae agoteebirie, yakore.”

English: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
Kiswahili: Adhimisheni sikukuu ya vibanda kwa siku saba baada ya kukusanya mazao yenu ya nafaka na kukamua zabibu.
Ekegusii: “Ekero mwaoorire chindagera chiaino naende mwamitire amasabibu aino inamobe n’amatuko amanene y’Ebigutu ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.

English: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
Kiswahili: Kwa aibu inanipasa niseme kwamba sisi tulikuwa dhaifu sana kwa jambo hilo! Lakini chochote ambacho mtu mwingine yeyote angethubutu kujisifia, nanena kama mjinga, nami nathubutu kujisifu juu ya hilo.
Ekegusii: Ase obosooku bwane nigo ngokwana ng'a nigo twarenge abareu ase ogokora amang'ana aya. Korende onye omonto ore noboremu bw'ogwetogia ase rinde rionsi (nakwanire ase oboriri), na inche ninde noboremu boigo bw'ogwetogia.

English: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn't call any man unholy or unclean.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mnajua kabisa kwamba ni kinyume cha sheria yetu Myahudi kuchangamana na mtu wa Mataifa au kumtembelea. Lakini Mungu amenionyesha kwamba nisimwite mtu yeyote kuwa najisi au asiye safi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Mwamanyire ng'a tari boronge omonto Omoyahudi abwatane nomonto ore bw'egesaku ekeao, nonya nokomochiera, korende Nyasae onyorokirie ng'a timoroka onde bwensi ng'a tari omochenu, gose tachenegeti.

English: He who listens to her will judge the nations. He who heeds her will dwell securely.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayesikiliza atawahukumu mataifa, na yeye anayesikiliza atakaa salama.
Ekegusii: Oyokomoigwera chisemi, oyio nanachere chinse ekiina, n'oyokomotegerera chisemi namenye n'omorembe.

English: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren't also led astray, are you?
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakajibu, “Je, nanyi pia mmedanganyika?
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, Inee! Nainwe boigo mwatantanigwe?

English: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama sivyo, moto na utoke kwa Abimeleki na uwateketeze, ninyi watu wa Shekemu na Beth-Milo, nao moto utoke kwenu, watu wa Shekemu na Beth-Milo umteketeze Abimeleki!”
Ekegusii: Korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase Abimeleki obasambe inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, obasirie; naende tiga omorero osoke korwa ase more inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, osambe Abimeleki, omosirie.”

English: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa mno wa watu ukakusanyika kumzunguka, hata ikabidi aingie katika chombo na kuketi humo, nao watu wote wakawa wamesimama ukingoni mwa bahari.
Ekegusii: Emeganda emenene ekamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato ime, agaikaransa aroro, na omoganda bwonsi ogatenena ase engegu.

English: This is the burden against the Valley of Vision: What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the rooftops,
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Bonde la Maono: Nini kinachokutaabisha sasa, kwamba ninyi nyote mmepanda juu ya mapaa?
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Mang’ana ki abeire inwe mwensi mwariinire gochia birama igoro?

English: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
Kiswahili: “Watumishi wa yule mwenye shamba wakamjia na kumwambia, ‘Bwana, si tulipanda mbegu nzuri shambani mwako? Basi, magugu yametoka wapi?’
Ekegusii: Erio abasomba b’omonyene enyomba bagaacha, bakamobooria: Omonene, tikwabusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oo? Inaki rende ororekanire namabanchore?

English: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother. Signature and Final Greetings (1 Corinthians 16:19–24; Colossians 4:15–18)
Kiswahili: Lakini msimhesabu kuwa adui, bali mwonyeni kama ndugu. Salamu Za Mwisho
Ekegusii: Timomobara buna omobisa, korende momokuurere buna oyomino. Amang’ana omoerio

English: And they went and stayed in Geruth Chimham, near Bethlehem, in order to proceed into Egypt
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaenda mbele na kutua Geruth-Kimhamu karibu na Bethlehemu wakiwa njiani kwenda Misri
Ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakabeera ase enyomba y’abageni agwo Kimuhamu, ang’e na Bethlehemu, na korwa aroro mbaganetie kogenda ase ense ya Misiri

English: Then David took the crown from the head of their king. It was found to weigh a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
Kiswahili: Daudi akachukua taji kutoka kwa kichwa cha mfalme wao, lililokuwa na uzito wa talanta moja ya dhahabu, nayo ilizungushiwa vito vya thamani. Ikawekwa juu ya kichwa cha Daudi. Alichukua nyara nyingi kutoka mjini huo.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarusia egutwa y’etaabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omorwoti bw’aroro, akanyora ng’a oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye, naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekwa igoro y’omotwe o Daudi. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria.

English: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
Kiswahili: “Wafalme wa dunia waliozini naye na kushiriki anasa zake watakapoona moshi wa kuungua kwake, watamlilia na kumwombolezea.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti b'ense, abwo babwatanire nere ase obotomani na okogania okobe nabamoreere na komweumeria ekero bararore erioki ri'okoyia kwaye.

English: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and Yahweh's glory will be your rear guard.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nuru yako itajitokeza kama mapambazuko na uponyaji wako utatokea upesi; ndipo haki yako itakapokutangulia mbele yako, na utukufu wa Bwana utakuwa mlinzi nyuma yako.
Ekegusii: Korakore igo, omobaso oo nobare buna ensakia ya mambia, na okogwenigwa kwao nkogoikere bwango; oboronge bwao mbogotang'ane, na obonene Omonene nabogotunyane korwa magega, bobe bokorendete.

English: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

English: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli akatuma ujumbe kwa Yese, akisema, “Mruhusu Daudi abaki katika utumishi wangu, kwa kuwa ninapendezwa naye.”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatoma amang'ana ase Yese, akamoteebia: “Tiga Daudi abeere aiga abe ogonkorera, ekiagera namwanchire mono.”

English: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
Kiswahili: Waliporudi kutoka huko kaburini, wakawaeleza wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja pamoja na wengine wote mambo haya yote.
Ekegusii: Bakairana korwa ase oboina, bagateebia baria ikomi nomo na baria abande bonsi amang'ana ayio onsi.

English: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
Kiswahili: Nikatazama, mishipa na nyama vikatokea juu ya mifupa na ngozi ikaifunika, lakini hapakuwepo pumzi ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie, nkarora emekia egacha igoro y'amauga aria, ne chinyama chikaba ase emekia, ne risankwa rikabituba, korende omoika torenge ime yabo.

English: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
Kiswahili: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Bwana, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu,
Ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring'ana riaye; ee, ase okobua kw'Omonene nintogie ring'ana riaye.

English: The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watu wa Beth-Togarma walibadilisha farasi wa mizigo, farasi wa vita na nyumbu kwa mali zako.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Togarima bagakooneria chibarasi chi’emeremo na echi’eseegi, ne chibarasi, naye okabaooneria ebinto biao.

English: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.
Kiswahili: Katika kila jambo la hekima na ufahamu kuhusu kile mfalme alichowauliza, aliwaona bora mara kumi zaidi kuliko waganga na wasihiri wote katika ufalme wake wote.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ande onsi omorwoti ababoretie igoro y’obong’aini na obomanyi, akabanyora ng’a nigo bamanyete ara ikomi goetania abaringoria na abaragori barenge ase oborwoti bwaye bwonsi.

English: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile kusukasuka maziwa hutoa siagi, na pia kule kufinya pua hutoa damu, kadhalika kuchochea hasira hutokeza ugomvi.”
Ekegusii: Amabeere agotundwa nigo akorua amaguta, na okomintontoria emioro, amanyinga nigo akoruerao. Naboigo ogoseegeta na koba nendamwamu, ayio nigo akorenta okorwana.

English: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
Kiswahili: Upande wa mwisho wa mashariki jua linakochomoza, ua pia utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini.
Ekegusii: Obogare bw'ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, bobe obw'ekerengo ki'amaboko emerongo etano.

English: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
Kiswahili: Nitawanyunyizia maji safi, nanyi mtakuwa safi, nitawatakasa kutoka uchafu wenu wote na kutoka sanamu zenu zote.
Ekegusii: Nimbanyororokerie amaache amakenonoku, na inwe mocheneke korwa ase ogotacheneka kwaino gwonsi, na korwa ase emegwekano yaino mogosasiima. Ee, nimbachene.

English: The adversaries heard that Jonathan and his men were ready for battle, and they feared, and trembled in their hearts, and they kindled fires in their camp then withdrew.
Kiswahili: Maadui waliposikia kwamba Yonathani na watu wake walikuwa tayari kwa vita, wakaogopa, wakatetemeka mioyoni mwao, nao wakawasha moto kambini mwao kisha wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baigwete buna Yonathani na abanto baye bebekire ang'e ase esegi, bagasogwa nobwoba obonene, bagatama na gotiga emerero kegwoka ime yekambi.

English: Then the LORD said, “Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Kama vile mtumishi wangu Isaya alivyotembea uchi na bila viatu kwa miaka mitatu, kama ishara na dalili mbaya dhidi ya nchi ya Misri na Kushi,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Buna koreng’ana Isaya, omosomba one, abeire okona‐gotaara goetanana aaria na aaria ase emiaka etato yaetire, ore getirianda na atabegeti bikoroto, obeire ekemanyererio na omogwekano bw’amang’ana arabe ase Abamisiri na ase Abaetiopia,

English: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
Kiswahili: Mlichukua mimba ya makapi, mkazaa mabua, pumzi yenu ni moto uwateketezao.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo morabe barito bw’obonyansi obwomo, moibore amasakwe. Omoika oino bw’okoeyana noro omorero orabasambe moere.

English: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: bali ni sisi tunaomtukuza Bwana, sasa na hata milele. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe ntogenderere gotogia Omonene, korwa bono goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!

English: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Msinywe damu, ili mweze kufanikiwa ninyi pamoja na watoto wenu baada yenu, kwa sababu mtakuwa mkifanya lililo haki machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Mwerende, timoyaria. Ekero morakore ayaare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene nigo er’abe buya ase more n’aase ororeeria rwaino.

English: Queen Esther the daughter of Aminadab and Mordecai the Jew wrote all that they had done, and gave the confirmation of the letter about Purim.
Kiswahili: Malkia Esta, binti Aminadabu, na Mordekai Myahudi, wakaandika yote waliyoyafanya, na kuthibitisha barua kuhusu Purimu.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bagachiika ase barabwo abanyene, na ase chinderia chiabo, na ase abande bonsi babwatanete nabarabwo ng'a babe bakorenda amatuko ayio abere kera omwaka, naende bayabwate koreng'ana buna bachiikire, ne chingaki chichiikire.

English: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko walipomkuta huyo Adoni-Bezeki, nao wakapigana naye na kuwafanya Wakanaani na Waperizi wakimbie.
Ekegusii: Bakababua Abakaanani n'Abaperisi; bakanyora Adoni‐Bezeki agwo, erio bakamorwania.

English: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.
Kiswahili: Wanafunga majeraha ya watu wangu bila uangalifu. Wanasema, “Amani, amani,” wakati hakuna amani.
Ekegusii: Batubire amaote 'abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.

English: Peter replied, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the other disciples said the same thing. Jesus Prays at Gethsemane (Mark 14:32–42; Luke 22:39–46)
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akasisitiza, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wanafunzi wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo. Yesu Anaomba Gethsemane (Marko 14:32-42; Luka 22:39-46)
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateeba boigo. Yeso ogosaba Gethisemane (Mar 14:32-42; Luk 22:39-46)

English: “I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
Kiswahili: “Nimesikia manungʼuniko ya Waisraeli. Waambie, ‘Jioni mtakula nyama, na asubuhi mtashiba mikate. Ndipo mtajua ya kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Naigure okwemurungania kw’Abaisraeli. Kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a engaki ya mogoroba mbaegwe enyama barie, na mambia inabarie omogati. Erio bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”

English: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law,
Kiswahili: Simeoni, akiwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alikwenda Hekaluni. Wazazi walipomleta mtoto Yesu ili kumfanyia kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya Sheria,
Ekegusii: Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiiko,

English: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
Kiswahili: Kalebu mwana wa Yefune alikuwa na wana watatu: Iru, Ela na Naamu. Naye mwana wa Ela alikuwa: Kenazi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, nabwo aba: Iru na Ela, na Naamu; na omwana omomura bw'Ela nere Kenasi.

English: Then I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ ‘Get up and go into Damascus,’ He told me. ‘There you will be told all that you have been appointed to do.’
Kiswahili: “Nikauliza, ‘Nifanye nini Bwana?’ “Naye Bwana akaniambia, ‘Inuka uingie Dameski, huko utaambiwa yote yakupasayo kufanya.’
Ekegusii: Nkaboria: Ninki ndakore Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Imoka ogende goika Damesiki, agwo noteebigwe onsi aya gwachiikirwe oyakore.

English: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mwambie Finehasi ninafanya Agano langu la amani naye.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, moteebie ng'a, 'ngokora inde nere okobwatana kwane kw'omorembe.

English: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
Kiswahili: Elamu wa tano Yehohanani wa sita na Eliehoenai wa saba.
Ekegusii: Elamu oyo o gatano; Yehohanani oyo o gatano na rimo; Eliehoenai oyo o gatano na kabere.

English: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule Bwana hamhesabii dhambi zake.”
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ori'Omonene atabarereti ebibe biaye.”

English: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
Kiswahili: Waambie wanyofu itakuwa heri kwao, kwa kuwa watafurahia tunda la matendo yao.
Ekegusii: Teebia abanyene oboronge ng’a amang’ana nabe amaya ase bare, barabwo mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo.

English: But Amnon refused to listen to her, and being stronger, he violated her and lay with her.
Kiswahili: Lakini Amnoni akakataa kumsikiliza, na kwa kuwa alikuwa na nguvu kuliko Tamari, akamtenda jeuri.
Ekegusii: Korende Amunoni tancha komoigwa. Ere akamobua chinguru, akamokorera obosooku ase okoraara nere.

English: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these the things He does?” Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?
Kiswahili: Je, ingesemwa, ee nyumba ya Yakobo: “Je, Roho wa Bwana amekasirika? Je, yeye hufanya vitu kama hivyo?” “Je, maneno yangu hayamfanyii mema yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu?
Ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria buna Abaisraeli nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa? Nigo Omoika bw’Omonene asirie okoremereria kwaye? Ekeene ere nakore ebinto ebio? Tari gokwana ase obwororo ase baria bagokora ay’ekeene?

English: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
Kiswahili: Kinubi changu kimegeuka kuwa maombolezo, nayo filimbi yangu imekuwa sauti ya kilio.
Ekegusii: Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoirwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.

English: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Aroni akaunyoosha mkono wake juu ya maji ya Misri, nao vyura wakatokea na kuifunika nchi.
Ekegusii: Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y'amaache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.

English: I have not sinned against you, but you have done me wrong by waging war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.”
Kiswahili: Mimi sijakukosea jambo lolote, bali wewe ndiye unayenikosea kwa kufanya vita nami. Basi Bwana, aliye Mwamuzi, leo na aamue ugomvi kati ya Waisraeli na Waamoni.”
Ekegusii: Inche ase ayio tindakora ebibe ase ore; aye nigo ogokora bobe ase ’nde ase ogokora esegi nainche. Omonene nere omogaayani. Ere reero iga nanache ekiina gati y’Abaisraeli n’Abaamoni.”

English: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.
Kiswahili: Basi wakakimbia mbele ya Waisraeli kuelekea nyikani, lakini hawakuweza kukwepa vile vita. Nao watu wa Israeli waliotoka katika ile miji wakawaua huko.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakeonchora, bagatama korwa ase Abaisraeli gochia ensemo y'erooro, korende bakanarigwa nabarwani baria abange, na baria barwete ase omochie, bagaitwa.

English: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mfalme Daudi akamjibu Arauna, “La hasha! Lakini ninasisitiza kwamba nitalipa bei yake kamili. Sitachukua kilicho chako kwa ajili ya Bwana au kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa ambayo hainigharimu chochote.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi agakania Orinani, akamoteebia, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ndabiakanere rigori riikeranu; tinkoira ekere ekiao koa Omonene gose okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa eke ntaakanereti.”

English: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamjibu, “Lakini hapa nyikani tutapata wapi mikate ya kutosha kuwalisha?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Inaki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”

English: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
Kiswahili: Nitakutupia uchafu, nitakufanyia dharau na kukufanya kioja.
Ekegusii: Nikobogorie ase ogochaaya naende ngotube ne eubi. Abanto mbakorigererie n'omondoko.

English: If he continues, he will leave a greater name than a thousand. If he finally rests, it is enough for him.
Kiswahili: Akiendelea, ataacha jina kubwa kuliko elfu. Akipumzika hatimaye, inamtosha.
Ekegusii: Ere namenye obogima obotambe, natige erieta rikumete kobua bonsi; nayio nabe amoisanire ere ekero arakwe.

English: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh's name.
Kiswahili: hapo ambapo alikuwa amejenga madhabahu ya kwanza. Huko Abramu akaliitia jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: agwo nao aase Aburamu aagachete egesasiimero kie ritang'ani kegima na korirangeria erieta ri'Omonene.

English: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”
Kiswahili: Mara tu mwingiapo mjini, mtamkuta kabla hajapanda kwenda mahali pa juu kula. Watu hawataanza kula mpaka atakapofika kwa sababu ni lazima kwanza yeye abariki dhabihu, ndipo wale walioalikwa watakapokula. Pandeni sasa, mtamkuta kwa wakati huu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero mogosoa ase omochie namomonyoore ritang'ani ataratiira gochia ase ekegoro koragera. Abanto tibakoragera ritang'ani ataraikao, ekiagera ere goika asesenie ekeng'wanso keria. Erio baria barangeirie banyare gochaaka koragera. Ase ayio, genda bwango, ekiagera ase engaki eye nero moramonyoore.”

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Maadamu Mungu amekufunulia yote haya, hakuna mwingine yeyote mwenye akili na hekima kama wewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang'ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na obong'aini buna aye.

English: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akienda akakutana na simba njiani, akamuua na maiti yake ikabwagwa barabarani, yule punda wake na simba wakiwa wamesimama karibu yake.
Ekegusii: Na ekero omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda arenge ase orogendo inchera, akaumerana nendo, ero ekamoita agakwa. Omobere oye ogatugutwa ase enchera, na etigere na endo chigatenena mbarabare ase omobere oria.

English: Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitashughulika nao kwa hasira, sitawaonea huruma wala kuwaachilia. Wajapopiga makelele masikioni mwangu, sitawasikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimbakorere amabe inde nendamwamu. Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amaabera. Nabaisa korera baake eriogi rinene ase ’nde, tinkobaigwa.”

English: I saw every work of God, and that a man is unable to comprehend the work that is done under the sun. Despite his efforts to search it out, he cannot find its meaning; even if the wise man claims to know, he is unable to comprehend.
Kiswahili: ndipo nikaona yale yote ambayo Mungu ameyafanya. Hakuna yeyote awezaye kuelewa yale yanayotendeka chini ya jua. Licha ya juhudi zake zote za kutafuta, mtu hawezi kugundua maana yake. Hata ingawa mtu mwenye hekima anadai kuwa anafahamu, kwa hakika hawezi kutambua.
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora ng’a omonto takonyara komanya emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae egokorekana aiga inse y’erioba. Omonto naisa gwechanda mono ase okorigia koyemanya, takonyara koyemanya. Nonya omonto omong’aini ogoteeba ng’a namanyete, takonyara koyemanya.

English: Then I ordered that the rooms be purified, and I had the articles of the house of God restored to them, along with the grain offerings and frankincense. Tithes Restored (Leviticus 27:30–34; Deuteronomy 14:22–29; Deuteronomy 26:1–15)
Kiswahili: Nilitoa amri kutakasa vyumba, kisha nikavirudisha vifaa vya nyumba ya Mungu, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na uvumba.
Ekegusii: Nkarua ogochika, na aase agwo agachenwa, erio nkairaniao ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ubani.

English: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamjia Pilato na kumwomba awafanyie kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake.
Ekegusii: Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.

English: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu akamwangukia baba yake, akalilia juu yake na akambusu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagwera ise ase obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.

English: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
Kiswahili: Maisha yako yatangʼaa kuliko adhuhuri, nalo giza litakuwa kama alfajiri.
Ekegusii: Na obogima bwao nigo borarabe se kobua erioba ria mobaso gati; omosunte oye nigo oraonchoke obe buna ekero bogokia mambia.

English: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtu mmoja akaja akawaambia, “Tazameni watu mliowatia gerezani wako Hekaluni wakiwafundisha watu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo agaacha, akabateebia: “Rora, abanto baria mwabeegete echela ime nigo bateneine ase Hekalu ime kworokereria abanto.”

English: For they are Your people and Your inheritance; You brought them out of Egypt, out of the furnace for iron.
Kiswahili: kwa maana ni watu wako na urithi wako, uliowatoa Misri, kutoka kwenye lile tanuru la kuyeyushia chuma.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabaanto bao, na omwando oo, oria kwarusetie korwa Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko ri’ekebemberi ki’omorero.

English: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo mavazi watakayoshona: kifuko cha kifuani, kisibau, kanzu, joho lililorembwa, kilemba na mshipi. Mavazi haya yatashonwa kwa ajili ya ndugu yako Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki'obokuani, na egesibao ki'obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera emeremo y'obokuani.

English: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliye kipofu isipokuwa mtumishi wangu, na kiziwi kama mjumbe ninayemtuma? Ni nani aliye kipofu kama yeye aliyejitoa kwangu, aliye kipofu kama mtumishi wa Bwana?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ore omouko otatiga omosomba one? Ning’o ore omotino buna omonto one natomire? Ning’o ore omouko buna omwegenwa one, gose buna omosomba one inche Omonene?

English: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo nitaiondoa ile miji iliyo kando ya Moabu, kuanzia miji iliyoko mipakani, yaani: Beth-Yeshimothi, Baal-Meoni na Kiriathaimu, iliyo utukufu wa nchi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ninyasiore ense ya Moabu, agwo ase egetirimboko ase emechie ere, eyio ere obonene bw'ense eria, nero Beti‐Yesimoti, na Baali‐Meoni, na Kiriataimu.

English: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
Kiswahili: Mauti na Uharibifu viko wazi mbele za Bwana: je, si zaidi sana mioyo ya wanadamu!
Ekegusii: Onye aase abakuure ne'chioora chi'obosiru bire maiso marore ase Omonene, inee! Tamanyeti chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto mono kobua?

English: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
Kiswahili: Watakuja dhidi yako wakiwa na silaha, magari ya vita, magari ya kukokota, pamoja na umati mkubwa wa watu. Watakuzingira pande zote kwa ngao na vigao na kofia za chuma. Nitakutia mikononi mwao ili wakuadhibu, nao watakuadhibu sawasawa na sheria zao.
Ekegusii: Mbagochere korua sugusu babwate ebirwanero, ne chigari ao ao, na omoganda omonene bw' abanto babwate chinguba, ne ching'aya, babeegete ebigogwa bi'ebioma, bakoumokere korwa chinsemo chionsi. Inche nimbachiike bakonachere ekiina kobwatekana namachiiko abo.

English: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left. Josiah Destroys Idolatry (1 Kings 13:1–10; 2 Kings 23:4–20)
Kiswahili: Akafanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana na kuenenda katika njia za Daudi baba yake, hakugeuka upande wa kuume wala wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene; akabwatia chinchera chionsi chia Daudi, sokoro yaye; taonchogete gochia aande onsi, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Yosia ogosiria ogosasimwa kw’emegwekano

English: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Tayari nimekwisha kuwaambia, nanyi hamtaki kunisikiliza. Mbona mnataka kusikia tena? Je, ninyi nanyi mnataka kuwa wanafunzi wake?”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia, ko timontegerereti. Naki morigetie koyaigwa eria kabere? Inwe boigo morigetie koba aborokigwa baye?”

English: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.
Kiswahili: Atasimika hema zake za ufalme kati ya bahari na mlima mtakatifu wa kupendeza. Hata hivyo, atafikia mwisho wake, wala hakuna yeyote atakayemsaidia.
Ekegusii: Natenenie eema yaye y’oborwoti ebe ase egati y’enyancha na egetunwa keria egechenu ki’obonene. Korende nonya naboigo naikere omoerio oye, na monto onde tari oramokoonye.

English: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wachungaji wakaja wakawafukuza hao wasichana. Ndipo Mose akainuka, akawasaidia na kunywesha mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Erio abarisia b'aroro bagacha bagaseria abaiseke baria ba Jethiro, korende Musa agatenena agakonya abaiseke baria na kobanyoiseria riicho riabo.

English: young men and maidens, old and young together.
Kiswahili: wanaume vijana na wanawali, wazee na watoto.
Ekegusii: nainwe abamura na abaiseke mwensi, nainwe abanto abagotu na abana.

English: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord's work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu wapenzi, simameni imara, msitikisike, mzidi sana katika kuitenda kazi ya Bwana, kwa maana mnajua ya kuwa, kazi yenu katika Bwana si bure.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, abanchwa, mobe ne chinguru, motari gotengechigwa, momente mono gokora emeremo y'Omonene ase amatuko onsi, momanye ng'a emeremo yaino ase Omonene teri bosa.

English: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
Kiswahili: ili mtu yeyote atakayemuua mtu kwa bahati mbaya na pasipo kukusudia aweze kukimbilia huko na kujiepusha na mlipiza kisasi wa damu.
Ekegusii: Omonto karaite omonto onde mosiabano atancheti, anyare gotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio ase ogwetooria korwa ase oyomwabo oria oitetwe oganetie korusia egesiomba.

English: He will build Yahweh's temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
Kiswahili: Ni yeye atakayejenga Hekalu la Bwana, naye atavikwa utukufu na ataketi kumiliki katika kiti cha enzi naye atakuwa kuhani katika kiti chake cha enzi. Hapo patakuwa amani kati ya hao wawili.'
Ekegusii: Ee, ere naagache Hekalu y'Omonene, abe omorwoti osikire, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki'oborwoti. Naende nere orabe Omokuani ase ekerogo kiaye; na abwo babere mbaigwane babe bakogamba amang'ana ay'omorembe.

English: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki ni mwangalifu katika urafiki, bali njia ya waovu huwapotosha.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo are omoraai omuya bw'omogisangio oye, korende chiinchera chi'abakori amabe nigo chikobatang'ana chiabasiria.

English: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, jinsi matendo yako yalivyo mengi! Kwa hekima ulizifanya zote, dunia imejaa viumbe vyako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki ogokora kwao kore okonene! Okwo gwonsi nigo okogokora nobong’aini, ense nigo eichire nebitongwa biao.

English: Why then did You bring me from the womb? Oh, that I had died, and no eye had seen me!
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini basi ulinitoa tumboni? Ninatamani ningekufa kabla jicho lolote halijaniona.
Ekegusii: “Nase ki kwandusetie ase enda ya baba? Naki anga yare koba buya onye nakwete ekero monto onde atarandora,

English: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliondoka mahali pale, akaenda sehemu za Tiro na Sidoni.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro, akagenda chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni.

English: Therefore don't be partakers with them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, msishirikiane nao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timosaanga nabarabwo.

English: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu yeyote akinipenda atalishika neno langu na Baba yangu atampenda, nasi tutakuja kwake na kufanya makao yetu kwake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.

English: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote atakayemlaani baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraragererie ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.” Amachiiko ase abwo bagoaka abande

English: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
Kiswahili: Basi mwili si kiungo kimoja, bali ni viungo vingi.
Ekegusii: Naki omobere tori nekiimo ekemo, korende nebinge.

English: He reigned over all the kings from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akatawala juu ya wafalme wote kuanzia Mto Frati mpaka kwenye nchi ya Wafilisti na kuendelea hadi mpaka wa Misri.
Ekegusii: Akagambera abarwoti bonsi babegetwe kogamba korwa orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ense y’Abafilisti, na goika orobebe rw’Abamisiri.

English: Moreover, when we have established our kingdom, we will glorify you and your nation and the temple with great glory, so that your glory will be made manifest in all the earth.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, tutakapokuwa tumesimamisha ufalme wetu, tutakutukuza wewe na taifa lako na hekalu kwa utukufu mkuu, ili utukufu wako udhihirike duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima ekero inche ndaabe nasoire ase oborwoti bwane, inche ninkoe aya oborwoti bwao ne Hekalu amasikani amanene goika obonene bwe ense yaino bomanyekane ense yonsi.”

English: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
Kiswahili: “Kwa kawaida hiki ndicho utakachotoa juu ya madhabahu kila siku: wana-kondoo wawili wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja.
Ekegusii: “Na ebing'wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasiimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chi'eching'ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.

English: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
Kiswahili: Arauna akamwambia Daudi, “Uchukue huo uwanja. Mfalme bwana wangu na afanye lolote analopenda. Tazama, nitatoa maksai kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, vifaa vya kupuria kuwa kuni, pamoja na ngano kwa ajili ya dhabihu ya nafaka. Natoa hivi vyote.”
Ekegusii: Erio Orinani agateebia Daudi, “Ira ekeooreri ekio! Aye omonene one omorwoti, kora eki oranche. Rora, narure chiombe chibe ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa na ebikorero ebi bi'okoorera bibe chinko, na engano ebe okoruegwa kw'endagera. Nakobieire bionsi.”

English: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia sasa, kutakuwa na watu watano katika nyumba moja, watatu dhidi ya wawili, na wawili dhidi ya watatu.
Ekegusii: Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.

English: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, to provoke him to anger.
Kiswahili: Ndipo tena nikasujudu mbele za Bwana kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana. Sikula mkate wala sikunywa maji, kwa sababu ya dhambi yote mliyoifanya, mkifanya lile lililo ovu mbele za Bwana na kumkasirisha.
Ekegusii: Erio naende 'nkarara maumama ase obosio bw'Omonene buna agwo ritang'ani, ase engaki y'amatuko emeronge ene, omobaso n'obotuko. Tinabeete 'nkoria kende gose konywa, ase engencho y'ebibe bionsi inwe konya mwakorire, ase ogokora amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, mokamogeechia goika akaba n'endamwamu.

English: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba,
Kiswahili: Kutoka pale akaenda Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.

English: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
Kiswahili: Ningalitorokea mbali sana na kukaa jangwani,
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo nanga nare kogenda aare, imbe ntoorete ase erooro.

English: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don't fear God.
Kiswahili: Mungu anayemiliki milele, atawasikia na kuwaadhibu, watu ambao hawabadilishi njia zao, wala hawana hofu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oyio obeire okogamba korwa kare, nanyigwe inche, erio abue abanto abwo, ekiagera abwo tibari koonchoka na komoiroka Nyasae.

English: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
Kiswahili: Mungu atanyoosha mkono wake dhidi ya kaskazini na kuangamiza Waashuru, akiiacha Ninawi ukiwa na pakame kama jangwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye gochia sugusu asirie Abaasuri; nasirie na Ninawi obe bosa, na ayuomie obe erooro.

English: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni Rufo, mteule katika Bwana, pamoja na mama yake, ambaye amekuwa mama kwangu pia.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Rufo omochorwa Omonene, na ng’ina ore buna baba ase ’nde.

English: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
Kiswahili: “Moabu amestarehe tangu ujana wake, kama divai iliyoachwa kwenye machujo yake, haikumiminwa kutoka chombo kimoja hadi kingine, hajaenda uhamishoni. Kwa hiyo ana ladha ile ile kama aliyokuwa nayo, nayo harufu yake haijabadilika.
Ekegusii: “Abamoabu babeire barendire bamenyete ase obotoereru korwa ase oboke bwabo. Babeire buna edivai etarakenonorwa korwa ase eturubo. Tibana koumorwa korwa ase ekebekerero ekemo gochia ase ekende, gose tibana gwoswa bairwe ase obosomba. Ase ayio rimisu riabo nabo rigendererete koba buna riarenge, na ogotioka kwabo tikwana koonchoka.

English: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
Kiswahili: Urithi wao uligawanywa kwa kura kwa yale makabila tisa na nusu, kama Bwana alivyoamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo achigete Musa ng’a obomera boakwe ekero agwatanana ense ase ebisaku biria kianda, amo na keria kende ekeng’ese.

English: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwema hutoa yaliyo mema kutoka hazina ya mambo mema yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake, naye mtu mwovu hutoa yaliyo maovu kutoka hazina ya mambo maovu yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omuya, ase emonga yaye engiya nigo akorua amaya, na omonto omobe, ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua amabe.

English: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
Kiswahili: na yeyote aishiye na kuniamini hatakufa kabisa hata milele. Je, unasadiki haya?”
Ekegusii: Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng'ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”

English: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akanionyesha Yoshua, kuhani mkuu, akiwa amesimama mbele ya malaika wa Bwana, naye Shetani amesimama upande wake wa kuume ili amshtaki.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akanyorokia Yoshua, Omokuani omonene, oteneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene, na Saitani oteneine ase ensemo ya borio ya Yoshua okomosoera.

English: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu ukaanza kukata tamaa juu ya kazi yangu yote niliyoifanya kwa taabu chini ya jua.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngachaka goichana na gokwa omoyo ase engencho y'emeremo yonsi nechanderete inse y'erioba.

English: No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit, nor plant for others to eat. For as is the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
Kiswahili: Hawatajenga nyumba, nao watu wengine waishi ndani yake, au kupanda mazao na wengine wale. Kwa kuwa kama zilivyo siku za mti, ndivyo zitakavyokuwa siku za watu wangu, wateule wangu watafurahia kwa siku nyingi kazi za mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Tibakoba bakoagacha chinyomba, na abanto abaao bachimenye; tibakoba bagosimeka endagera na abanto abaao bayerie. Buna koreng’ana obogima bw’omote bore, naboigo nobogima bw’abaanto baane borabe, na abachore baane mbabe bakogokera emeremo y’amaboko abo ase engaki entambe.

English: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
Kiswahili: pamoja na Yehoyada, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Aroni, aliyekuwa pamoja na watu 3,700,
Ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw'eamate ya Aroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);

English: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
Kiswahili: lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nimewaonyesha miujiza mingi mikubwa kutoka kwa Baba yangu. Ni ipi katika hiyo mnataka kunipiga mawe?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Naborokirie emeremo emiya emenge erwete ase Tata; nereri ase emeremo eyio mokong’akera amagena?”

English: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
Kiswahili: Wanasema, “Mungu awezaje kujua? Je, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana anayo maarifa?”
Ekegusii: Erio bateeba, “Naki Nyasae arakore amanye? Inee! Ere Oyore Igoro Mono nabwate obong’aini?”

English: All things were known to him before they were created, and also after they were completed.
Kiswahili: Vitu vyote vilijulikana kwake kabla havijaumbwa, na pia baada ya kukamilika.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akomanyete aye konye otaraiborwa goika omoerio ekero ere akoorete gotonga ense.

English: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
Kiswahili: Mlisema, ‘Hapana, tutakimbia kwa farasi.' Kwa hiyo mtakimbia! Mlisema, ‘Tutakimbia kwa farasi waendao kasi.' Kwa hiyo wanaowafukuza watakwenda kasi!
Ekegusii: Nigo mogoteeba ng'a moriine chibarasi chikominyoka mono, motame. Ee, goika motame. Inwe moganetie gotama ne chibarasi chinyango, korende ababisa baino abwo bakobabwatia nigo bare abaminyoki kobabua.

English: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nimewaambia mambo haya, mioyo yenu imejawa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera nabateebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.

English: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliishusha Yuda kwa sababu ya Ahazi mfalme wa Israeli, kwa kuwa alikuwa ameongeza uovu katika Yuda na kumkosea Bwana mno.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aganetie kwororoberia Abayuda ase engencho y'Ahasi, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere arenterete Abayuda obosooku na tarenge omwegenwa ase Omonene.

English: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
Kiswahili: Kuwaogopa watu huwa ni mtego, bali yeyote amtumainiaye Bwana atakuwa salama.
Ekegusii: Okobairoka Mwanyabaanto nigo gokoba omotego, korende omonto omosemeretie Omonene nigo arendire buya.

English: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wangu kuhusu lile lililo bora kwenu juu ya jambo hili ni huu: Mwaka uliopita ninyi mlikuwa wa kwanza si tu kutoa lakini pia mlikuwa na shauku ya kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Na inche ase ring’ana eri nabaeire ay’ogosemia kwane, mbuya ase more mokoore emeremo eyio eyio mwarenge abachaki koyekora omwaka oeta. Timware koyekora rioka, korende boigo mware nokogania gw’okoyekora.

English: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
Kiswahili: Dharau zimenivunja moyo na nimekata tamaa, nimetafuta wa kunihurumia, lakini sikumpata, wa kunituliza, lakini sikumpata.
Ekegusii: Amabe ayio nakoreirwe asionoire enkoro yane, bono nerusirie moyo. Nigo nasemeretie ng’a ndorerwe amabeebe, korende tinayaroreretwe; nigo nasemeretie inyore abaremia, korende tinabanyora.

English: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipokuwa jangwani, mtu mmoja alikutwa akikusanya kuni siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh's temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
Kiswahili: Katika siku za mwisho mlima wa Hekalu la Bwana utaimarishwa kama mlima mkuu miongoni mwa milima yote; utainuliwa juu ya vilima, na watu wa mataifa watamiminika humo.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko 'omoerio ng'a egetunwa ki'enyomba y'Omonene ngekong'igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.

English: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
Kiswahili: Wakamkazia macho, kisha Petro akamwambia, “Tutazame sisi.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamobeta amaiso, amo na Yohana, akabora: “Torigererie intwe!”

English: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Benyamini: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ororeria rwa Benjamini bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: But show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, because they stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
Kiswahili: “Lakini uwaonyeshe wema wana wa Barzilai wa Gileadi na uwaruhusu wawe miongoni mwa wale walao mezani pako. Walisimama nami nilipomkimbia ndugu yako Absalomu.
Ekegusii: “Korende okorere abana ba Barisilai, Omogileadi, amaya, babe ase egati ya baria bakoragera amo naye, ekiagera ase obosani obo obuya, barabwo nabo bankorerete, ekero nareenge gotama korwa ase Abisalomu, momura omino.

English: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
Kiswahili: Lakini Manase hawakuwafukuza watu wa Beth-Shani na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Taanaki na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Dori na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Ibleamu na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Megido na vijiji vyake, lakini Wakanaani waliazimu kuishi katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Manase tibaabang’anyetie abanto bamenyete Beti‐Sehani, na Taanaki, na Dori, na Ibileamu, na Megido, amo n’ebichie biabo. Korende Abakaanani baria ’mbagendererete komenya ase ense eria.

English: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Kiswahili: Mnajisumbua bure kuamka mapema na kuchelewa kulala, mkitaabikia chakula: kwa maana yeye huwapa usingizi wapenzi wake.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa ase more kobooka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong'u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechaandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.

English: He said, “This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint them to his own chariots and horses, to run in front of his chariots.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Hivi ndivyo atakavyowatendea mfalme atakayewatawala. Atawachukua wana wenu na kuwafanya watumike kwa magari yake ya vita na farasi, nao watakimbia mbele ya magari yake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Aya naro omorwoti oyio orabagambere arabakorere: Naire abana baino abamura, ababeeke ase chigari chiaye, na abande ababeeke babe abariini be chibarasi chiaye bamokorere. Abande babetererigwe baminyoke bosio bwe chigari chiaye.

English: just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: kama vile mafuta yanayoondolewa kutoka kwenye maksai aliyetolewa sadaka ya amani. Kisha kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: koreng’ana buna akobirusia korwa ase eng’ombe eria ekonyeenywa ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Erio abisaambere ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso.

English: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
Kiswahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagonchaya na goteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe-kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

English: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won't prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won't delay.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ufunuo huu unasubiri wakati uliokubalika; unazungumzia mambo ya mwisho, na kamwe hautakosea. Iwapo utakawia, wewe usubiri; kwa hakika utakuja na hautachelewa.
Ekegusii: Okorora okwo nigo koganyete engaki yaye eike. Nigo gokoayerera goikerane, tigokomocha goikerana. Nonya gokororekana ng'a gwatebanire, ekeene goika goikerane, tikogoteebana.

English: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.
Kiswahili: Katika kila jambo la hekima na ufahamu kuhusu kile mfalme alichowauliza, aliwaona bora mara kumi zaidi kuliko waganga na wasihiri wote katika ufalme wake wote.
Ekegusii: Ase amang'ana ande onsi omorwoti ababoretie igoro y'obong'aini na obomanyi, akabanyora ng'a nigo bamanyete ara ikomi goetania abaringoria na abaragori barenge ase oborwoti bwaye bwonsi.

English: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, ndugu wapendwa, simameni imara na myashike sana yale mafundisho tuliyowapa ikiwa ni kwa maneno ya kinywa au kwa barua.
Ekegusii: Ase igo baminto, tenena bokong’u, na mobwate chingencho echio twaborokereretie, onye nase amang’ana y’emenwa yaito, gose nase riruube riaito.

English: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
Kiswahili: Kama amejitia unajisi na kukosa uaminifu kwa mumewe, wakati anapotakiwa anywe maji yale yaletayo laana, yatamwingia na kusababisha maumivu makali; tumbo lake litavimba na paja lake litapooza, naye atakuwa amelaaniwa miongoni mwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Onye omokungu oria tabeete omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende bwekorire omosaria, amaache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa akore enda yaye ebimbe, naende egombae. Ase enchera eyio omokungu oyio abe ekiorokererio gi’okoragererigwa kegwatorwa ase egati y’ abanto baye.

English: When they had gathered at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted, and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the LORD.” And Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kukutanika huko Mispa, walichota maji na kuyamimina mbele za Bwana. Siku hiyo walifunga na wakaungama, wakisema, “Tumetenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.” Naye Samweli alikuwa kiongozi wa Israeli huko Mispa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagasangererekana agwo Misipa, bakabuucha amaache, bakayaumora agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata ase rituko erio, bagakwana aroro agwo, “Twakorire ebibe ase Omonene.” Erio Samweli akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli agwo Misipa.

English: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don't hear, because you are not of God.”
Kiswahili: Yeye atokaye kwa Mungu husikia kile Mungu asemacho. Sababu ya ninyi kutosikia ni kwa kuwa hamtokani na Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang'ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”

English: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wazao wa Shuthela: kutoka kwa Erani, ukoo wa Waerani.
Ekegusii: Sutela nigo arenge ise Erani, na korwa ase are nao Abaerani barwete.

English: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Kiswahili: Enyi watu, mtumainini yeye wakati wote, miminieni mioyo yenu kwake, kwa kuwa Mungu ni kimbilio letu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto, mwegene Omonene ase chingaki chionsi, morentere emechando yaino; Nyasae nere obotamero bwaito.

English: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn't sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
Kiswahili: Wote wanayo hatima inayofanana, mwadilifu na mwovu, mwema na mbaya, aliye safi na aliye najisi, wale wanaotoa dhabihu na wale wasiotoa. Kama ilivyo kwa mtu mwema, ndivyo ilivyo kwa mtu mwenye dhambi; kama ilivyo kwa wale wanaoapa, ndivyo ilivyo kwa wale wasioapa.
Ekegusii: Egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi, omonyene oboronge na omonyabibe, oyore omuya na ochenegete na oyo otachenegeti, oyo okorua ebing'wanso na oyo otari kobirua. Buna ekoba ase omonto omuya, naboigo ekoba nase omonyabibe; buna ekoba ase oria okoria eira y'ogotiana, naboigo ekoba nase oria otari koria eira y'ogotiana.

English: These were read before the congregation at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hizi zilisomwa mbele ya kutaniko huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Amariiko ayio akaba kagosomwa ase emesangererekano agwo Yerusalemu.

English: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.
Ekegusii: Buna eriikire ase egetabu y'amang'ana 'omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri'oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y'Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.

English: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyefungua chemchemi na vijito, ulikausha mito ambayo ilikuwa ikitiririka daima.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatubogetie chinsoko ne chindooche; boigo ogasiria amaache ye chindooche chinene, chigakamoka.

English: The Jews put all their enemies to the sword, killing and destroying them, and they did as they pleased to those who hated them.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi waliwaangusha adui zao wote kwa upanga wakiwaua na kuwaangamiza, nao walifanya kile walichotaka kwa wale waliowachukia.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abayahudi bakabua ababisa babo bonsi, bakabaita na kobasiria nemioro; bagakora buna banchete ase abwo baabagechete.

English: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
Kiswahili: Elisha akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, “Nina nini mimi nawe? Nenda kwa manabii wa baba yako na manabii wa mama yako.” Mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, “La hasha, kwa sababu ni Bwana ambaye ametuita pamoja sisi wafalme watatu ili atutie mikononi mwa Moabu.”
Ekegusii: Elisha agateebia omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, “Inki inde naye? Genda aye ase ababani ba iso na abanyoko!” Korende omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli akamoteebia. “Tinkogendao. Omonene nere otobekire intwe abarwoti batato ase amaboko Abamoabu.”

English: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.
Kiswahili: Jua lako halitazama tena, nao mwezi wako hautafifia tena; Bwana atakuwa nuru yako milele, nazo siku zako za huzuni zitakoma.
Ekegusii: Erioba riao tirikorimera nonya ng'ake, gose omotienyi oo togosira, ekiagera Omonene nere orabe omobaso oo o kare na kare, na amatuko ao ay'omoichano naere.

English: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.
Kiswahili: Hamkula mkate na hamkunywa divai wala kileo chochote. Nilifanya hivi ili mpate kujua kuwa mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Timwabeete mokoria omogati, gose konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kende gionsi kegotindia, erio nario moranyaare komanya ng’a ere nere Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache watoto washibe kwanza, kwa maana si vyema kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana, gotugutera chisese.”

English: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
Kiswahili: Kuhani ataagiza vitu vyote vitolewe ndani ya nyumba, kabla hajaenda kuchunguza kama ina ugonjwa huo, ili kitu chochote ndani ya nyumba kisitangazwe kuwa najisi. Baada ya hili, kuhani ataingia ndani na kuikagua hiyo nyumba.
Ekegusii: Omokuani achike ng'a ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba eyio birusigweo ritang'ani atarasoao koborenga. Onye tibagokora bo rirorio ebinto bionsi bire nyomba ime nabibe bitachenegeti. Magega y'ayio Omokuani asoe ase enyomba eyio koyerenga.

English: And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa habari zenu ninyi, ee nyumba ya Israeli, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nendeni mkatumikie sanamu zenu, kila mmoja wenu! Lakini baadaye hakika mtanisikiliza mimi nanyi hamtalinajisi tena Jina langu takatifu, kwa matoleo yenu na sanamu zenu.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene akobateebia inwe Abaisraeli: Kera oyomo oino agenderere gosasiima omogwekano oye! Korende ase engaki eraache ekero morabe mokonyigwera timokora erieta riane richenu ribe eritachenegeti ase okorua ebiegwa biaino na gosasiima emegwekano yaino.

English: Nevertheless you even spared these as men, and you sent hornets as forerunners of your army, to cause them to perish little by little.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo uliwaacha hawa kama wanaume, nawe ukatuma nyigu kama watangulizi wa jeshi lako, ili kuwaangamiza kidogo kidogo.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naba aye nigo kwabarorerete amaabera ase engencho barabwo n'abanto bao. Nigo gwatomete chinchoke chigatangana omoganda bw'abarwani esegi erio chibasirie ngora ngora.

English: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

English: So I did as I was commanded. I brought out my bags for exile by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall by hand. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulder as they watched.
Kiswahili: Basi nikafanya kama nilivyoamriwa. Wakati wa mchana nilitoa vitu vyangu nje vilivyofungwa tayari kwa uhamishoni. Kisha wakati wa jioni nikatoboa ukuta kwa mikono yangu. Nikachukua mizigo yangu nje wakati wa giza la jioni, nikiwa nimeibeba mabegani mwangu huku wakinitazama.
Ekegusii: Inche ngakora buna nachigetwe; mobaso gati ngasokia ebinto biane isiko, nkaba buna nkong’anya inde, na riachia koba mogoroba, nkabochora enyasi namaboko ane. Ekero omosunte ochire, nkabeka ebinto biane ireko, nkagenda ekero abanto barigereretie.

English: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered! What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi nyundo ya dunia yote ilivyovunjika na kuharibika! Tazama jinsi Babeli ilivyokuwa ukiwa miongoni mwa mataifa!
Ekegusii: Naki enturago eria yaagete ense engima yaakirwe na gwateka! Naki Babiloni osirigwe, na abanto baichanigwe ase okoyorora igo!

English: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu akamwondolea uchungu wa mauti, kwa sababu haikuwezekana yeye kushikiliwa na nguvu za mauti.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamobokia ekero ororobirie obororo bw’amakweri, ekiagera tare konyarekana abwatwe naro.

English: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the gifts from the servants and stored them in the house. Then he dismissed the men, and they departed.
Kiswahili: Gehazi alipofika kwenye kilima, akavichukua vile vitu kutoka kwa wale watumishi na kuvificha ndani ya nyumba. Akawaaga wale watu, nao wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete agwo ase ekegoro, Gehasi akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabibeeka nyomba ime. Erio agatiga abanto baria bakagenda.

English: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uliye tumaini la Israeli, wote wakuachao wataaibika. Wale wanaogeukia mbali nawe wataandikwa mavumbini kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana, chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogosemeria kw'Abaisraeli, abanto abwo bagotigire nigo banyorire obosooku; ee, abwo baonchokire na kogotiga nigo barasire buna ririiko ririikire ase riroba, ekiagera bagotigire aye Omonene ore ensoko y'amaache are moyo.

English: And the time that David lived in Philistine territory amounted to a year and four months.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaishi katika nchi ya Wafilisti muda wa mwaka mmoja na miezi minne.
Ekegusii: Daudi akagenderera komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo na emetienyi ene.

English: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
Kiswahili: Akauliza, “Je, tutashambulia kupitia njia gani?” Akajibu, “Kupitia Jangwa la Edomu.”
Ekegusii: Naende akabooria: “Inee! Insemo ki toraetere kogenda?” Yoramu akairaneria: “Igo toraetere enchera y'erooro y'Edomu.”

English: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Kuweni watakatifu, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: amariiko nigo agoteeba, mobe abachenu ekiagera inche nomochenu.

English: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya wosia, ni muhimu kuthibitisha kifo cha yule aliyeutoa,
Ekegusii: Naki aase okoriera kw'omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.

English: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’” So they listened to the word of the LORD and turned back according to the word of the LORD. Jeroboam’s Idolatry
Kiswahili: ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Msipande kupigana dhidi ya ndugu zenu, Waisraeli. Nendeni nyumbani, kila mmoja wenu, kwa kuwa hili nimelitenda mimi.’ ” Kwa hiyo wakalitii neno la Bwana na kurudi nyumbani, kama Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Ndama Wa Dhahabu Huko Betheli Na Dani
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene atebiire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino Abaisraeli. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akoretwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana gochia chinka chiabo, buna abateebeetie. Yeroboamu ogotiga Omonene

English: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
Kiswahili: Wakati Mungu alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, akamkataa Israeli kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche ayio, akaba nekeririanda, agatiga Abaisraeli kegima.

English: So they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the families of Israel. And when they came to Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Wakazunguka katika Yuda yote na kukusanya Walawi na viongozi wa jamaa za Israeli kutoka miji yote. Walipofika Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda, bagasangereria Abalawi korwa ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani kuvukia Yeriko,
Ekegusii: Ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang'e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

English: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
Kiswahili: Adoramu alikuwa kiongozi wa wale waliofanya kazi ya kulazimishwa; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;
Ekegusii: Adorama nigo abegetwe koba omoteneneri bw'emeremo ende yonsi. Yehosafati mosinto bw'Ahiludi, nigo areenge omoriki bw'amang'ana are gokoreka.

English: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
Kiswahili: kwa muda wote nitakaokuwa na uhai ndani yangu, nayo pumzi ya Mungu ikiwa puani mwangu,
Ekegusii: naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,

English: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Noa akafanya kila kitu kama vile Mungu alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Nuhu nabo akorete igo; agakora ayio onsi koreng’ana buna Nyasae amochigeete.

English: This is what the LORD says: ‘I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants; I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, both slave and free.
Kiswahili: ‘Nitaleta maafa juu yako. Nitaangamiza uzao wako na kukatilia mbali kutoka kwa Ahabu kila mzaliwa wa mwisho wa kiume katika Israeli, wa mtumwa au wa mtu huru.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nindete amabe igoro yao; ningosirie kegima orueo, ninsirie korwa asore Ahabu kera omonto omosacha, omosomba na oyotari omosomba.

English: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
Kiswahili: Akaweka wimbo mpya kinywani mwangu, wimbo wa sifa kwa Mungu wetu. Wengi wataona na kuogopa na kuweka tumaini lao kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Akanyorokereria oteera ogoteera okoyia, ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.

English: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, tayarisheni nia zenu kwa kazi; mwe na kiasi, mkitumainia kikamilifu ile neema mtakayopewa Yesu Kristo atakapodhihirishwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie bokong'u ebinema bi'ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria moraarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

English: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akawaita pamoja wazee wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agatoma abanto barangerie abagaaka bonsi b'Abayuda na aba Yerusalemu, bagasangererekana asare.

English: Therefore hear, O nations, and learn, O congregations, what will happen to them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sikilizeni, enyi mataifa, angalieni, enyi mashahidi, lile litakalowatokea.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abanto b’ebisaku, na inwe omoganda bwonsi, tegerera moigwe amang’ana agochia kobanyora abwo bangire.

English: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliye kama Bwana Mungu wetu, Yeye ambaye ameketi juu kwenye kiti cha enzi,
Ekegusii: Ning'o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,

English: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
Kiswahili: Kizazi kimoja kitasifia kazi zako kwa kizazi kingine, watasimulia matendo yako makuu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.

English: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi sitafuti utukufu wangu mwenyewe, bali yuko anayetaka kunitukuza, naye ndiye mwamuzi.
Ekegusii: Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.

English: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.
Kiswahili: Basi Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru akavunja kambi na kuondoka. Akarudi Ninawi na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Senakeribu, omorwoti bw'Abaasuri, akarua agwo, akagenda nka bwoye, akamenya Ninawi.

English: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
Kiswahili: “Sema kwa ajili ya wale wasioweza kujisemea, kwa ajili ya haki za wote walioachwa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, okwanere rimama, orwanerere oboronge bw’abwo batigirwe bachaandegete.

English: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
Kiswahili: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”
Ekegusii: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

English: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
