Kiswahili: Kisha nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Hatima ya mpumbavu itanipata mimi pia. Nitafaidi nini basi kwa kuwa na hekima?” Nikasema moyoni mwangu, “Hili nalo ni ubatili.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkebooria, “Ande, amang'ana akomonyoora omoriri naro aranyore nainche, nase ki rende inche nabeire nobong'aini obonge?” Ase ayio ngeteebia ng'a aya boigo mbosa.

English: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakamjibu, “Tumetumwa na Kornelio yule jemadari. Yeye ni mtu mwema anayemcha Mungu, na anaheshimiwa na Wayahudi wote. Yeye ameagizwa na malaika mtakatifu akukaribishe nyumbani kwake, ili asikilize maneno utakayomwambia.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nigo twatomirwe na Kornelio, omotang'ani bw'abarwani rigana, omonto omooronge, omoirogete Nyasae, oyogokwanwa buya negesaku gionsi ki'Abayahudi. Nateebigwa n'omomalaika omochenu ng'a atome abanto ase ore gokorangeria ogende bwoye, anyare koigwa amang'ana korwa ase ore.”

English: “Amos, what do you see?” He asked. “A basket of summer fruit,” I replied. So the LORD said to me, “The end has come for My people Israel; I will no longer spare them.”
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Amosi, unaona nini?” Nikajibu, “Kikapu chenye matunda yaliyoiva.” Ndipo Bwana akaniambia, “Wakati umewadia kwa watu wangu Israeli; sitawahurumia zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Amos, ngento ki eke orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Negetonga kere namatunda amatobu.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Omoerio ocheire abanto bane Abaisraeli. Tinkobaetania nonya ng’ake.”

English: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.
Kiswahili: Kutoka mbinguni amewasikizisha sauti yake ili kuwaadilisha. Hapa duniani aliwaonyesha moto wake mkubwa, nanyi mlisikia maneno yake kutoka kwenye ule moto.
Ekegusii: Akabakora mokaigwa eriogi riaye riarwete igoro, erinde anyare koborokereria; na ase ense akaborokia omorero omonene, nainwe mokaigwa amang’ana aye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero oria.

English: He also took up Elijah's mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Akaliokota lile vazi lililoanguka kutoka kwa Eliya, kisha akarudi na kusimama ukingoni mwa Yordani.
Ekegusii: na akaimokia egetambaa gi'okwambara ki'Elija keria kiagwete korwa asare, akairana, agatenena ase engegu ya Yorodani.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning, stand before Pharaoh, and tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Amka mapema asubuhi, usimame mbele ya Farao, umwambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili kwamba waweze kuniabudu,
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni, otenene ase obosio bwa Farao, omoteebie: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.

English: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu matendo ya wanadamu: kwa neno la midomo yako, nimejiepusha na njia za wenye jeuri.
Ekegusii: Mang'ana ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng'ana namang'ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi'abasaria.

English: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
Kiswahili: Amamu, Shema, Molada,
Ekegusii: na Amamu, na Sema, na Molada,

English: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”
Kiswahili: Hata sasa shoka limeshawekwa tayari kwenye shina la kila mti. Basi kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.”
Ekegusii: Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.”

English: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don't you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”
Kiswahili: Abneri akamwita Yoabu, akamwambia, “Je, ni lazima upanga uendelee kuangamiza milele? Hutambui kwamba jambo hili litaishia katika uchungu? Utaacha kuwaagiza watu wako waache kuwafuatilia ndugu zao hata lini?”
Ekegusii: Erio Abineri akarangeria Yoabu, akamobooria, “Inee! Nigo oganetie omoro oite abanto kogenderera botambe? Tomanyeti ng'a omoerio nobororo borabe? Nengaki eng'ana inaki oraganye goika omanye gokania abanto bao tibabwatia abamwabo?”

English: Although you say, ‘The message from Yahweh,' therefore Yahweh says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from Yahweh,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from Yahweh,”
Kiswahili: Ingawa unadai, ‘Huu ndio mzigo wa Bwana,' hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Ulitumia maneno, ‘Huu ndio mzigo wa Bwana,' hata ingawa nilikuambia kuwa kamwe usiseme, ‘Huu ni mzigo wa Bwana.'
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng'a inwe moise kogenderera gokwana: Egurube y'Omonene, na kwanga koigwera, korende mogokwana amang'ana ayio Omonene abakanirie ng'a timobaisa gokwana bo,

English: They have built high places to Baal on which to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I never commanded or mentioned, nor did it even enter My mind.
Kiswahili: Wamejenga mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu pa Baali ili kuteketeza wana wao katika moto kama sadaka kwa Baali, kitu ambacho sikukiamuru wala kukitaja, wala hakikuingia akilini mwangu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo baagachire aase aimokererete igoro ase enyasae Baali, erinde bayesambere abana babo abamura babe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa asere, amang’ana inche ntachigete gose kobateebia, gose amang’ana atana koba ase ebirengererio biane.

English: He who gets a wife gets his richest treasure, a help meet for him and a pillar of support.
Kiswahili: Anayepata mke hupata hazina yake tajiri zaidi, msaidizi wake na nguzo ya msaada.
Ekegusii: Buna oromeme rokoigwa obuya bwogwansa gwechindaagera, naboigo nomonto ore nechiseemi akonyaara gwatanana amang'ana yoborimo.

English: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
Kiswahili: watu ambao ulimwengu haukustahili kuwa nao. Walizunguka majangwani na milimani, katika mapango na katika mahandaki ardhini.
Ekegusii: abanto ense etagwenere koba nabarabwo. Barabwo nigo barenge goetanana ase chirooro na ase ebitunwa, ase amabwago na amakuruma.

English: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati kiongozi ametenda dhambi bila kukusudia na kufanya yaliyokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana Mungu wake, ana hatia.
Ekegusii: “Omogambi karakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, na akore amang'ana ande onsi inche Omonene, Nyasae oye, nakaanete ng'a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,

English: In the days of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, nor will it be left to another people. It will shatter all these kingdoms and bring them to an end, but will itself stand forever.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku za wafalme hao, Mungu wa mbinguni atauweka ufalme ambao kamwe hautaangamizwa, wala hautaachiwa taifa jingine. Utaziponda zile falme zote na kuzikomesha, bali wenyewe utadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko y’abarwoti abwo Nyasae ore igoro narente oborwoti botanyare gosarigwa, gose okobua kw’oborwoti obwo tibokoegwa egesaku kende. Obwo mbosenyente amarwoti onsi na koyasiria, na borobwo obonyene mbogenderere kobao goika kare na kare,

English: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
Kiswahili: Tunda langu ni bora kuliko dhahabu safi; kile nitoacho hupita fedha iliyo bora.
Ekegusii: Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu engiya, na ebitoki 'nkorua 'mbibuete efeta enchore.

English: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn't leave any of them.
Kiswahili: Yehu akaagiza, “Wakamateni wakiwa hai!” Kwa hiyo wakawachukua wakiwa hai, watu arobaini na wawili, na kuwachinja kando ya kisima cha Beth-Ekedi. Hakuacha yeyote anusurike.
Ekegusii: Yehu agateebia abanto baye. “Babwate bare moyo!” Na barabwo bakababwata bare moyo, bakabaita na kobaruta ase engoro agwo ang'e na Beti‐Ekedi, abanto emerongo ene, na babere; tatigaretie nonya noyomo.

English: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
Kiswahili: Umeuvika mwaka taji ya baraka, magari yako yanafurika kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Kwabeekeire omwaka egutwa y'obuya bwao, amabarato ao nigo agotonya obonoru.

English: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
Kiswahili: na huko alikuwepo mtu aliyepooza mkono. Wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu, wakamuuliza, “Je, ni halali kuponya siku ya Sabato?”
Ekegusii: Na rora, narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete. Bakaboria Yeso, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri'Esabato?” Nigo bamoboretie igo erio banyare komosoera.

English: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights,
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vile vitako vilivyotengenezwa: Vilikuwa na mbao za pembeni zilizoshikamanishwa na mihimili.
Ekegusii: Ebibekerero biria nigo biakoretwe iga: Chinsingo nchiarenge ase chinsemo chiabo ase egati ye chinsingo chie chikoona.

English: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
Kiswahili: Mefiboshethi akasujudu akasema, “Mimi mtumishi wako ni nini hata uangalie mbwa mfu kama mimi?”
Ekegusii: Mefiboseti agatung'ama inse naende, akabora, “Inche inde buna esese ekwete. Ninki ing'isaine orankorere amaya buna ayio?”

English: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
Kiswahili: Farao akawakasirikia hawa maafisa wake wawili, mnyweshaji mkuu na mwokaji mkuu,
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Farao akabeigwa n'abateneneri abwo babere, omoteneneri bw'ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw'abaroisia emegati.

English: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mkono wako au mguu wako unakusababisha utende dhambi, ukate na uutupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa huna mkono mmoja au mguu mmoja, kuliko kuwa na mikono miwili au miguu miwili, na kutupwa katika moto wa milele.
Ekegusii: Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, gose nokogoro kwao, konache, ogotugute are; mbuya ase ore osoe ase obogima kore omonungu, gose egesegora, kobua koba namaboko abere, na amagoro abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hiyo yakatimizwa yale Maandiko yasemayo, “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki,” naye akaitwa rafiki wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Amariko agaikeranigwa, aria agoteeba, “Aburaamu nigo amwegeenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.” Igo akarokwa omosani o Nyasae.

English: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won't be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu ambaye podo lake limejazwa nao. Hawataaibishwa wanaposhindana na adui zao langoni.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo oichoretie esaaro yaye ne chinsara echio. Oyio takobugwa ekero arabe okogamberana nababisa baye agwo ase ekegambero gia'etureti.

English: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
Kiswahili: Makanisa ya Asia yanawasalimu. Akila na Prisila, pamoja na kanisa lililoko nyumbani kwao wanawasalimu sana katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chikanisa chi’Asia baabakwanirie. Akwila na Priskila baabakwanirie mono ase Omonene, amo n’ekanisa ere ime ase enyomba yabo.

English: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
Kiswahili: Wakatupa heshima nyingi, nasi tulipokuwa tayari kusafiri kwa njia ya bahari, wakapakia melini vitu vyote tulivyokuwa tunavihitaji.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagatosika ase ogosika okonene; naende ekero twachia gosoa emeeri bagatoa ebinto biria twaremeire.

English: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu kitazinena sifa za Bwana. Kila kiumbe na kilisifu jina lake takatifu milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Omonwa one nobe ogokwana ogotogigwa kw'Omonene; tiga ebitongwa bionsi bitogie erieta riaye richenu bono na goika kare na kare.

English: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
Kiswahili: Lakini Maria akayaweka mambo haya yote moyoni mwake na kuyatafakari.
Ekegusii: Korende Mariamu akagacha amang’ana aya onsi, okoyarengereria ase enkoro yaye.

English: Come together and listen, O sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
Kiswahili: “Kusanyikeni na msikilize, enyi wana wa Yakobo, msikilizeni baba yenu Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Inchuo montegerere, inwe abana ba Yakobo; montegerere inche Israeli iso.

English: Their hearts are devious; now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will break down their altars and demolish their sacred pillars.
Kiswahili: Moyo wao ni mdanganyifu, nao sasa lazima wachukue hatia yao. Bwana atabomoa madhabahu zao na kuharibu mawe yao ya ibada.
Ekegusii: Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasiima.

English: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
Kiswahili: Kondoo watajilisha kwenye malisho yao wenyewe, wana-kondoo watajilisha katika magofu ya matajiri.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo nao ching'ondi chirabe chikorisia abe buna oborisia bwabo, na amatuuri atigirwe nabanda nairwe nabarisia bakonakong'anya‐ng'anya.

English: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mitatu hapakuwa na vita kati ya Aramu na Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abasiiria na Abaisraeli bakagenderera ase emiaka etato batarenge nesegi barabwo ase barabwo.

English: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
Kiswahili: “Lakini hawakuzingatia, wakaenda zao: huyu shambani mwake na mwingine kwenye biashara zake.
Ekegusii: Korende bagachaaya amang'ana aya, bakagenda, oyomo ase omogondo oye, na oyonde ase oboonchoreria bwaye;

English: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
Kiswahili: (Kwa kuwa Mafarisayo na Wayahudi wote hawali chakula pasipo kunawa kwa kufuata desturi za wazee wao.
Ekegusii: (Inaki Abafarisai na Abayahudi bonsi tibakoragera ritang'ani bataraisaba amaboko. Igo babwatetie engencho y'abagaaka babo.

English: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
Kiswahili: Utabarikiwa mjini na utabarikiwa mashambani.
Ekegusii: “Imosesenigwe ase emechie yaino na ase emegondo yaino.

English: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakaomboleza kwa ajili ya Mose kwenye tambarare za Moabu kwa siku thelathini, mpaka wakati wa kulia na kuomboleza ulipopita.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoreera ase engaki y'amatuko emerongo etato agwo ase emieya ya Moabu, na magega y'ayio amatuko okomoreera na kobokia amagombo ase engencho yaye akaera.

English: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Palikuwa na tajiri mmoja na msimamizi wake. Ilisemekana kwamba huyo msimamizi alikuwa anatumia vibaya mali ya tajiri yake.
Ekegusii: Naende agateebia aborokigwa baye, Narenge omonto omonda, orenge nomorendi. Oyio agasoerwa asare ng'a osiareire enibo yaye.

English: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akageuka, akawaacha waabudu jeshi lote la mbinguni, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Manabii: “ ‘Je, mliniletea dhabihu na sadaka kwa miaka arobaini kule jangwani, ee nyumba ya Israeli?
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akeonchora korwa ase bare, akabatiga basasiime erioba na omotienyi ne ching'enang'eni chia igoro, buna ariikire ase egetabu y'ababani: Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y'emiaka emerongo ene, eyio mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing'wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?

English: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
Kiswahili: Ndipo macho ya vipofu yatafumbuliwa na masikio ya viziwi yatazibuliwa.
Ekegusii: Erio amaiso 'emeuko aramokigwe, na amato 'emetino atinorwe.

English: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa shukrani, mpigieni Mungu wetu kinubi.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene na komoiraneria ng'a mbuya mono; bugeria Nyasae oito amakano n'amariogi amaya!

English: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
Kiswahili: Amevunja meno yangu kwa changarawe, amenikanyagia mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Obunire amaino aane ase ogontakunia chinche chi'amagena, ontubire neribu.

English: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Nyamaza kimya! Weka mkono wako juu ya kinywa chako na ufuatane nasi, uwe baba yetu na kuhani wetu. Si ni afadhali utumikie kabila na ukoo katika Israeli kama kuhani kuliko kumtumikia mtu mmoja na watu wa nyumbani mwake?”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoteebia, “Kirakiri! Tokwana nonya ne ring'ana erimo! Inchuo amo naintwe, obe ase tore buna tata, obe Omokuani oito! Inee! Inki kere buya kobua ase ore, koba Omokuani ase enyomba y'omonto oyomo, gose ase egesaku ekegima ki'Abaisraeli?”

English: Yahweh said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab's house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Yehu, “Kwa kuwa umefanya vyema kwa kutimiza yaliyo sawa machoni pangu, na umetenda kwa nyumba ya Ahabu yale yote niliyokuwa nimekusudia kutenda, wazao wako wataketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli hadi kizazi cha nne.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yehu: “Ekiagera gwakorire buya ase ogokora ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane, naende gwakoreire enyomba y'Ahabu koreng'ana nebirengererio bi'enkoro yane, abana bao goika ekiaare gia kane mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo ki'oborwoti ki'Abaisraeli.”

English: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Pekahia na yote aliyoyafanya yameandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana ande onsi igoro ya Pekahia, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki'ogokora kw'Abarwoti b'Abaisraeli.

English: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu aliwapenda baba zenu na alichagua wazao wao baada yao, aliwatoa katika nchi ya Misri kwa Uwepo wake na kwa uwezo wake mkuu,
Ekegusii: Agancha chisokoro chiaino, na ase engencho eyio akabachoora inwe, ororeeria rwabo, mobe ribaga riabo, na ere omonyene akabang’anyia korwa Misiri ase okobua kwaye okonene.

English: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:
Kiswahili: Neno alilopokea nabii Habakuki. Lalamiko La Habakuki
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u omobani Habakuki aroche ase okorora. Habakuki okorera, ekiagera oboronge tiboiyo

English: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
Kiswahili: Waambie watumie dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani safi.
Ekegusii: Nabwo abaroisia bachiroisie korwa ase chiusi chi'echitaabu, na echi'amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi'egatani engiya.

English: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
Kiswahili: Nilipomwona, nilianguka miguuni pake kama aliyekufa. Ndipo akauweka mkono wake wa kuume juu yangu na kusema: “Usiogope, Mimi ndiye wa Kwanza na wa Mwisho.
Ekegusii: Ngachia komoorora nkagwa ase amagoro aye, nkaba buna oyokuure. Erio akabeeka okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase ’nde, aganteebia, Toiroka, inche noyo bw’eritang’ani, na oyo bw’omoerio,

English: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
Kiswahili: Mashamba yameharibiwa, ardhi imekauka; nafaka imeharibiwa, mvinyo mpya umekauka, mafuta yamekoma.
Ekegusii: Emegondo yatigaire bosa; riroba nigo rikorera ekiagera endagera yasirigwe, edivai tekobao na amaguta 'emezeituni akeeire kegima.

English: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Hii migawanyo ya mabawabu, kupitia wakuu wao, walikuwa na zamu za kuhudumu hekaluni mwa Bwana kama jamaa zao walivyokuwa nazo.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ebiombe ebio bi'abarendi b'ebiita amo nabatang'ani babo nigo babegetwe gokora emeremo ase enyomba y'Omonene buna Abalawi bamwabo barenge gokora.

English: Then she brought the pan and set it down before him, but he refused to eat. “Send everyone away!” said Amnon. And everyone went out.
Kiswahili: Tamari akaondoa mikate kwenye kikaango ili ampatie Amnoni, lakini akakataa kula. Amnoni akamwambia, “Mtoe nje kila mtu aliyeko hapa.” Kwa hiyo kila mmoja akaondoka.
Ekegusii: Naende akaimokia esani ere n’emagaati eria, akayeterekera Amunoni, korende ere akaanga koria. Amunoni agateeba, “Tiga abanto bonsi barue aa ase ’nde.” Ase igo kera omonto agasoka isiko.

English: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
Kiswahili: Wao si waaminifu kwa Bwana; wamezaa watoto haramu. Sasa sikukuu zao za Mwandamo wa Mwezi zitawaangamiza wao pamoja na mashamba yao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibabete abegenwa ase Omonene. Nigo baiborete abana batari abaye. Ase ayio, emeyega y'Omotienyi Omoyia nebasirie amo nemeganda yabo.

English: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: Kisha Waisraeli wakasafiri katika tambarare za Moabu na kupiga kambi kando ya Mto Yordani, ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera norogeendo rwabo gochia ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

English: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo maafisa wote na watu walioingia katika agano hili wakakubali kwamba watawaacha huru watumwa wao wa kiume na wa kike, na hawatawashikilia tena kama watumwa. Wakakubali na wakawaacha huru.
Ekegusii: Abaanene b'oborwoti amo nabaanto bonsi abakorete okobwatana ng'a kera omonto asibore omosomba oye, omosacha gose omokungu, bakaigwa amang'ana ayio na bakabasibora.

English: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama yule mtumishi atasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu anakawia kurudi,’ kisha akaanza kuwapiga wale watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, na kula na kunywa na kulewa.
Ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha, naende achake goaka abasomba bande, abasacha na abakungu, na koria, na konywa, na gotinda,

English: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
Kiswahili: Bwana alitutokea wakati uliopita, akisema: “Nimekupenda kwa upendo wa milele, nimekuvuta kwa wema.
Ekegusii: inche Omonene nkabaorokera korwa aare. Nabeire mbanchete nobwanchani bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio obuya bwane bwa botambe bwabang’usire.

English: And Judith said, “I can't eat of it, lest there be an occasion of stumbling; but provision will be made for me from the things that have come with me.”
Kiswahili: Yudithi akasema, “Siwezi kula, nisije nikajikwaa; lakini chakula kitatolewa kwa ajili yangu kutokana na vitu vilivyokuja nami.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yuditi agakana akabateebia, “Inche tinkonyaara koria endagera eyio ekiagera nigo ndaabe nabunire ogochika kw'Omonene one. Nigo ndarie endagera eye nachicha nero.” 12:2 rora Esta (ase Ekegiriki) 28

English: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unasema, ee Yakobo, nanyi ee Israeli, kulalamika, “Njia yangu imefichwa Bwana asiione, Mungu wangu hajali shauri langu?”
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki mogoteeba ng'a Omonene taroochi chinchera chiaino, naende ng'a ere Nyasae obarinire oboronge bwaino?

English: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji mingine iliyojumuishwa ni Katathi, Nahalali, Shimroni, Idala na Bethlehemu. Kulikuwa na miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: Amo neyio orogongo rwabo rokabwaterania Katati, na Nahalali, na Simuroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

English: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one steps in to rescue her husband from the one striking him, and she reaches out her hand and grabs his genitals,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na mke wa mmoja wao akaja kumwokoa mumewe na yule anayemshambulia, naye mke huyo akifika na kumkamata sehemu za siri,
Ekegusii: “Ekero abasacha babere bakorwana, na omokungu bw’omosaacha oyomo achiche gokoonya omosacha oye, na omokungu oria arambore okoboko abwate ekiimo ki’obosaacha ki’omonto oria onde,

English: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupitia Makedonia nitakuja kwenu, maana ninakusudia kupitia Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Korende ninchiche ase more, magega konaetire egati ya Makedonia, ekiagera nindengereretie goeta egati ya Makedonia.

English: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo kutakuwepo na njia kuu kutoka Misri hadi Ashuru. Waashuru watakwenda Misri, na Wamisri watakwenda Ashuru. Wamisri na Waashuru wataabudu pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio enchera enene neebeo ekorwa Misiri goika Asuri. Abaasuri mbabe bakogenda Misiri, na Abamisiri babe bakogenda Asuri; Abamisiri na Abaasuri mbabe bagosasimera amo.

English: and a white swelling or a reddish-white spot develops where the boil was, he must present himself to the priest.
Kiswahili: napo mahali palipokuwa na jipu pakatokea uvimbe mweupe, au alama yenye wekundu na weupe, ni lazima akajionyeshe kwa kuhani.
Ekegusii: na aase agwo, ase risankwa riareenge obobimbu oborabu bororekane, gose egesambo gekororekana kere nobobariri na oborabu, omonto oria goika agende ase Omokuani.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yothamu na yale aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yotamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abayuda.

English: Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you, who are indeed a sign. For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Sikiliza, ee Yoshua kuhani mkuu, pamoja na wenzako walioketi mbele yako, ambao ni watu walio ishara ya mambo yatakayokuja: Ninakwenda kumleta mtumishi wangu, Tawi.
Ekegusii: Aye Yoshua, Omokuani omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya, aye amo nabagisangio bao, abwo baikaransete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera abwo nabaanto bare ekemanyererio ki’amang’ana agochi gocha: Naama! Inche nintome omosomba one okorokwa Omoseboko.

English: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uko wapi upendo wako mkuu wa mwanzoni, ambao katika uaminifu wako ulimwapia Daudi?
Ekegusii: Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?

English: Ephraim didn't drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
Kiswahili: Wala Efraimu hawakuwafukuza kabisa Wakanaani walioishi Gezeri, bali Wakanaani waliendelea kuishi humo miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'eamate ya Efraimu tibaabang'anyetie Abakaanani abamenyete ase omochie o Geseri. Ase igo Abakaanani bakagenderera komenya ase egati yabo.

English: He commanded his servants to fill the grave.
Kiswahili: Aliwaamuru watumishi wake kujaza kaburi.
Ekegusii: Erio Ragueli agachiika abakori emeremo baye batube oboina boria magega botarakia.

English: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka hamsini na miwili. Mama yake aliitwa Yekolia wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo ekero achagete kogamba, na akagaamba emiaka emerongo etano, na ebere, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yekolia o Yerusalemu.

English: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
Kiswahili: Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa, na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme. Kutakuwa na njaa na mitetemeko ya ardhi sehemu mbalimbali.
Ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti inaborwane noborwoti bonde; enchara na emetengecho y'ense inabibe ase chinsemo ne chinsemo.

English: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
Kiswahili: Yeyote kati yenu anayependa uzima na kutamani kuziona siku nyingi njema,
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonto bwanchete obogima? Oganetie obe moyo amatuko amange, na korora amaya?

English: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli utaachwa mpaka wakati mwanamke aliye na utungu atakapozaa na ndugu zake wengine warudi kujiunga na Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene natige abanto baye goika engaki eike, ekero oyio okobina araibore; erio nario abanto bamwabo abatigari barairane gocha ase Abaisraeli.

English: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father's house.
Kiswahili: Nitamgongomea kama kigingi kilicho mahali palipo imara, naye atakuwa kiti cha enzi cha heshima kwa ajili ya nyumba ya baba yake.
Ekegusii: Nimokong'ontere akong'e buna omosumari okong'onteire ase enyasi enkong'u, na ere nabe ekerogo ki'amasikani ase enyomba ya ise.

English: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu na wanafunzi wake kufika Kapernaumu, wakusanya kodi ya Hekalu wakamjia Petro na kumuuliza, “Je, Mwalimu wenu halipi kodi ya Hekalu?”
Ekegusii: Kobaikire Kapernaumu, abaare korusia ebango ye Hekalu bagachiera Petero, bakamobooria, “Inee! Omworokia oino nkorua are ebango?”

English: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
Kiswahili: Naye baada ya kuyaangamiza mataifa saba waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, akawapa Waisraeli nchi yao iwe urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Agasiria ebisaku bitano na bibere ase ense ya Kaanani, na ense yabo akabaa ebe omwando obo,

English: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakatoka, wakakimbia kutoka mle kaburini wakiwa na hofu kuu na mshangao. Nao hawakumwambia mtu yeyote neno lolote, kwa sababu waliogopa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua agwo, bagatama korwa ase oboina, ekiagera basoetwe nekeondoko na ogokumia. Tibateebetie monto ing'ana, ekiagera bairogete.

English: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can't hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
Kiswahili: Ee mtima wangu, mtima wangu! Ninagaagaa kwa maumivu. Ee maumivu makuu ya moyo wangu! Moyo wangu umefadhaika ndani yangu, siwezi kunyamaza. Kwa sababu nimesikia sauti ya tarumbeta, nimesikia kelele ya vita.
Ekegusii: Obee! Obee! Obororo bw'enda yane bwabeire obonene. Enkoro yane nigo egontwoma mono, tinkonyara gokira; naigure eriogi ri'egetureeri, ogotaboborwa gw'esegi.

English: All a man’s labor is for his mouth, yet his appetite is never satisfied.
Kiswahili: Juhudi zote za binadamu ni kwa ajili ya kinywa chake, hata hivyo hamu yake kamwe haitoshelezwi.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yonsi omonto akwerosia gokora nokonyora egento akoria, korende nonya naboigo tari koigota.

English: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni yeyote anayeishi katika Israeli anapojitenga nami na kujiwekea sanamu katika moyo wake na kwa hivyo kuweka kitu kiovu cha kukwaza mbele ya macho yake na kisha akamwendea nabii kuuliza shauri kwangu, mimi Bwana nitamjibu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi bw'Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, orataayaye korwa asende na koa emegwekano eyio ribaga ase enkoro yaye, eyio ekoba ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani komboria amang'ana goetera ase are, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie.

English: With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Pamoja na kondoo dume andaa sadaka ya nafaka ya sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na theluthi moja ya hini ya mafuta,
Ekegusii: Ekero okorua emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso, orente amo nero obosie obonuke ebimunu bine, bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera.

English: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
Kiswahili: Je, mvua ina baba? Ni nani baba azaaye matone ya umande?
Ekegusii: Inee! Embura nebwate ise? Gose ning'o okoibora amatoima e riime?

English: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
Kiswahili: Najua kwamba baada yangu kuondoka, mbwa mwitu wakali watakuja katikati yenu ambao hawatalihurumia kundi.
Ekegusii: Namanyire inche ng'a magega ase okoimoka kwane chisese chi'orosana chintindi nachiche ase more, tichirorera riicho amaabera,

English: Jehoshaphat was alarmed and set his face to seek the LORD. And he proclaimed a fast throughout Judah.
Kiswahili: Yehoshafati akaogopa, akaazimu kumtafuta Bwana, na akatangaza kwa Yuda wote kufunga.
Ekegusii: Erio Yehosafati akaba nobwoba, akarigia Omonene; akararia ng’a Abayuda bonsi beng’ate.

English: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
Kiswahili: Mungu aliwabariki, hesabu yao ikaongezeka sana, wala hakuruhusu mifugo yao kupungua.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabasesenia bagasarara mono, tatigete omobaro bwe chitugo chiabo okee.

English: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
Kiswahili: Pia yakazuka mabishano katikati ya wanafunzi kwamba ni nani aliyeonekana kuwa mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Gokaba okoamererania ase egati yabo, gose ning'o ase bare obarirwe koba omonene kobua abande.

English: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to one another.
Kiswahili: Wakaambiana, “Yule mwota ndoto anakuja!
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Omonyandooto oyio ogocha.

English: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikalia, “Ole wangu! Nimeangamia! Kwa kuwa mimi ni mtu mwenye midomo michafu, nami ninaishi katikati ya watu wenye midomo michafu, nayo macho yangu yamemwona Mfalme, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nasirire! Inche nigo mbwate ebikoba bitachenegeti, na nigo imenyete ase egati y'abanto babwate ebikoba bitachenegeti; naende amaiso aane arorire Omorwoti, oyore Omonene bw'Emeganda.”

English: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
Kiswahili: nitayakusanya mataifa yote na kuyaleta katika Bonde la Yehoshafati Hapo nitaingia kwenye hukumu dhidi yao kuhusu urithi wangu, watu wangu Israeli, kwa kuwa waliwatawanya watu wangu miongoni mwa mataifa na kuigawa nchi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, mbatirimbokie gochia ase Rikura ri’ekegambero ria Jehoshaphat; aroro agwo nimbanachere ekiina, ase onsi eria bakorerete abanto bane. Ekiagera mbasiarerete Abaisraeli, gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, naende baatananire ense yane Israeli.

English: And while they were near Micah’s house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they went over and asked him, “Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?”
Kiswahili: Walipofika karibu na nyumba ya Mika, waliitambua sauti ya yule kijana Mlawi; hivyo wakaingia humo na kumuuliza, “Ni nani aliyekuleta hapa? Unafanya nini mahali hapa? Kwa nini uko hapa?”
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge nyomba mwa Mika, bakaigwa na komanya eriogi ri’omosae oria Omolawi, bakamoira ensemo, bakamobooria, “Ning’o okorenta aiga? ’Ngento ki ogokora aa? Emeremo yao nereri?”

English: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
Kiswahili: Wahivi, Waariki, Wasini,
Ekegusii: Abahivi na Abaariki, na Abasini;

English: As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe, kwa sababu ya damu ya Agano langu nawe, nitawaacha huru wafungwa wako watoke kwenye shimo lisilo na maji.
Ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amanyinga ’okobwatana okwo nakorire naye ninsibore abasibwa bao, mbarusie ase engoro etari namaache.

English: Some time later, Ben-hadad king of Aram assembled his entire army and marched up to besiege Samaria.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kitambo kidogo, Ben-Hadadi mfalme wa Aramu akaandaa jeshi lake lote akapanda kwenda kuihusuru Samaria.
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’amang’ana ayio, Beni‐Hadadi, omorwoti bw’Abasiiria, akaroberia abarwani baye b’esegi, akagenda akanaaria omochie o Samaria.

English: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul's place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
Kiswahili: Mimi pia ningeweza kuzungumza kama ninyi, kama mngekuwa katika hali yangu; ningeweza kutoa hotuba nzuri dhidi yenu, na kuwatikisia ninyi kichwa changu.
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwaino bware koba ribaga ri'obwane, nanga nigo nakwana buna inwe; nigo nare gokwana amang'ana amange mamincha yaino na gosingisia omotwe one.

English: Their graves are their eternal homes— their dwellings for endless generations— even though their lands were their namesakes.
Kiswahili: Makaburi yao yatabaki kuwa nyumba zao za milele, makao yao vizazi vyote; ingawa walikuwa na mashamba na kuyaita kwa majina yao.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakorengereria ng’a nigo chirabeo kare na kare, na obomenyo bwabo ebiaare ase ebiaare; nigo bagwatora emegondo yabo ase amarieta abo.

English: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wako itampasa angoje mpaka lini? Ni lini utawaadhibu washtaki wangu?
Ekegusii: Ngoika ririri inche omosomba oo 'ndagenderere koremereria? Ndiriri oranache ekiina ase abachaandi baane?

English: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakatupa nanga zote na kuziacha baharini, na wakati huo huo wakalegeza kamba zilizokuwa zikishikilia usukani wa meli. Kisha wakatweka tanga la mbele lishike upepo na kuisukuma meli kuelekea pwani.
Ekegusii: Bakaruta ebirochi biria, bakabitiga nyancha ime, bakaororobia chingori chi'ebionchori, bagatiiria egetambaa kia bosio embeo ekeguserere, bakaonchora emeeri gochia engegu.

English: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God's house with company.
Kiswahili: ambaye awali tulifurahia ushirika mzuri, tulipokuwa tukienda na umati hekaluni mwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo tware koba tokogamba amo amang'ana amaya ay'ogosemania, naende nigo tware koba togosasiima amo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
Kiswahili: Abramu na Nahori walioa. Mke wa Abramu aliitwa Sarai, na mke wa Nahori aliitwa Milka; Milka na Iska walikuwa watoto wa Harani.
Ekegusii: Aburamu na Nahori bakanyuoma abarugi. Moka Aburamu nigo areenge korokwa Sarai, na moka Nahori Milka, omwana omosubati o Harani; oyio nere orenge ise Milka na Isika.

English: All these days I appeared to you. I didn't eat or drink, but you all saw a vision.
Kiswahili: Siku hizi zote nilionekana kwenu. Sikula wala kunywa, lakini nyote mliona maono.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokagerete buna nigo mwandoche ginkoria endagera, korende nase okororekana tari bo yare.

English: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
Kiswahili: Hapo ndipo kutakapokuwa na dhabihu za haki, sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa za kukupendeza sana, pia mafahali watatolewa madhabahuni mwako.
Ekegusii: Erio nario oragokigwe n’ogosambwa kw’bing’wanso bi’ekeene; erio chieri nchiruegwe igoro ase egesasiimero kiao.

English: Simon ordained that they should keep that day every year with gladness. He made the hill of the temple that was by the citadel stronger than before, and he lived there with his men.
Kiswahili: Simoni aliagiza kwamba waiadhimishe siku hiyo kila mwaka kwa furaha. Aliimarisha kilima cha hekalu kilichokuwa karibu na ngome kuliko hapo awali, naye akaishi huko na watu wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Simioni agachiika buna rituko erio ribe rigochengerwa kera omwaka. Agakong'ia oborendi bw'egetunwa na Hekalu, ensemo erigereranetie neburi, akayoroisia omochie o Yerusalemu oboikaro bwaye ere amo na abanto baye.

English: Afterward, David heard about this and said, “I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
Kiswahili: Baadaye, Daudi aliposikia kuhusu jambo hili, akasema, “Mimi na ufalme wangu kamwe hatuna hatia mbele za Bwana kuhusu damu ya Abneri mwana wa Neri.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akabora, “Omonene namanyete ng’a inche na abanto bane titori na komocha ase obosio bwaye ase ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga y’Abineri, mosinto o Neri.

English: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.
Kiswahili: Yoshua na Waisraeli wote wakaondoka asubuhi na mapema kutoka Shitimu, wakaenda mpaka Mto Yordani, ambako walipiga kambi kabla ya kuvuka.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akaimoka, mambia chuni, amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bakaimoka korwa Sitimu, bakagenda, bagaika orooche rwa Yorodani. Bagatoora bakabeera aroro magega bataraamboka.

English: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
Kiswahili: Anga ikatoweka kama vile karatasi isokotwavyo, na kila mlima na kila kisiwa kikaondolewa mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Igoro ekarusigwa buna egetabu ye risankwa ekoringwa, na kera egetunwa na egesinka gekang’anyigwa korwa aase aye.

English: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
Kiswahili: Mkononi mwake alikuwa ameshika kijitabu kilichokuwa kimefunguliwa. Akauweka mguu wake wa kuume juu ya bahari na mguu wake wa kushoto akauweka juu ya nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Narenge na egetabu egeke kiaigoire ase okoboko kwaye. Akabeka okogoro kwaye gw'okorio igoro ase enyancha na ogw'okobee igoro ase ense enyomo,

English: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
Kiswahili: Kisha watoto wadogo wakaletwa kwa Yesu ili aweke mikono yake juu yao na awaombee. Lakini wanafunzi wake wakawakemea wale waliowaleta.
Ekegusii: Erio abana abake bakarentwa ase Yeso, erinde ababeekere amaboko aye na kobasabera. Aborokigwa baye bagatanga abanto,

English: You must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who approaches the ranks must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.”
Kiswahili: Jipangeni kumzunguka mfalme, kila mtu akiwa na silaha yake mkononi. Yeyote anayesogelea safu zenu lazima auawe. Kaeni karibu na mfalme popote aendapo.”
Ekegusii: Moetanane omorwoti chinsemo chionsi, kera oyomo abwate ebirwanero biaye koboko, na omonto onde bwensi oraike ang’e ase abarendi goika aitwe akwe. Mobe amo nomorwoti aase ande onsi akogenda na koirana.”

English: You must not present anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usitoe kitu chochote chenye dosari kwa sababu hakitakubaliwa kwa niaba yako.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa korua eng’iti ende yonsi ere na kemocho ase omobere oye, naki ase ekeng’wanso buna ekio timogwancherwa.

English: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
Kiswahili: wakati wa kulia na wakati wa kucheka, wakati wa kuomboleza na wakati wa kucheza,
Ekegusii: engaki y’okorera, na ey’ogoseka; engaki y’okobokia amagombo, na ey’ogotenga;

English: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, twaonekana kuwa mashahidi wa uongo kuhusu Mungu, kwa sababu tumeshuhudia kumhusu Mungu kwamba alimfufua Kristo kutoka kwa wafu, lakini hilo haliwezi kuwa kweli kama wafu hawafufuliwi.
Ekegusii: Ee, naintwe rirorio twarorekanire koba birori b’oborimo ba Nyasae, ekiagera twateebete ng’a Nyasae nigo abogetie Kristo, oyo rirorio tamobogetie, onye abakuure tibakobokigwa.

English: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”
Kiswahili: Mungu akamjia Balaamu na kumuuliza, “Watu gani hawa walio pamoja nawe?”
Ekegusii: Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu, akamobooria, “Abanto abamore komo mbarabi?”

English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
Kiswahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Ebing'wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa gwa kera rituko. Morue n'okoruegwa kw'endagera, na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Mambo haya yanaweza kuonekana ya ajabu kwa mabaki ya watu wakati huo, lakini yaweza kuwa ya ajabu kwangu?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Onye amang’ana ayio are ay’ogokumia ase abatigari b’egesaku eke, Inee, nabe ay’ogokumia ase ’nde boigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda?

English: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn't provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kuhusu manabii wanaowapotosha watu wangu, mtu akiwalisha, wanatangaza ‘amani'; kama hakufanya hivyo, wanaandaa kupigana vita dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bane nigo bakong'ainwa n'ababani abwo bakobariera chiira chi'omorembe baria bakobaakana, korende bagosereria baria batari kobaakana egesi. Ase ababani abwo Omonene nigo agoteeba,

English: They didn't understand the saying which he spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa maana ya lile alilowaambia.
Ekegusii: Tibamanya ring'ana riria abateebia.

English: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
Kiswahili: Bali wewe, Ee Bwana, utatukuzwa milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.

English: And you answered me and said, “What you propose to do is good.”
Kiswahili: Mlinijibu, “Shauri ulilolitoa ni zuri.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwancheranete buna ayio namaya na buna moyakore.

English: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
Kiswahili: Dunia itaharibiwa kabisa na kutekwa nyara kabisa. Bwana amesema neno hili.
Ekegusii: Ense nesarigwe kegima ebe bosa, ekiagera n’Omonene oteebire ring’ana erio.

English: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
Kiswahili: Basi nyumba ya Yosefu wakashambulia Betheli, naye Bwana alikuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo n’abanto b’eamate ya Yusufu. Barabwo bakageenda kobarwania abanto b’omochie o Beteli.

English: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
Kiswahili: Wameitupa miungu yao kwenye moto na kuiangamiza, kwa kuwa haikuwa miungu, bali miti na mawe tu iliyotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: batugutire chinyasae chi’abaanto abwo ase omorero, ekiagera chirochio tichiri Nyasae, korende nemeremo y’amaboko ’abaanto, chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena; ase ayio chigasirigwa.

English: The king’s servants replied, “Whatever our lord the king decides, we are your servants.”
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa mfalme wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako tu tayari kufanya lolote mfalme bwana wetu analochagua.”
Ekegusii: Abasomba b’omorwoti bakamoteebia, “Aye omorwoti Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao nigo twebegete ang’e gokora rinde rionsi oratoteebie.”

English: The prophets of old who preceded you and me prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many lands and great kingdoms.
Kiswahili: Tangu mwanzo, manabii waliokutangulia wewe na mimi walitabiri vita, maafa na tauni dhidi ya nchi nyingi na falme kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abaabani abwo bagotang’anerete aye na inche ase chingaki chia kare nigo baabaanete igoro y’esegi, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita, ng’a mbichiche ase chinse chinyinge na ase amarwoti are ne chinguru.

English: He leaves a glistening wake behind him; one would think the deep had white hair!
Kiswahili: Anapopita nyuma yake huacha mkondo unaometameta; mtu angedhani vilindi vilikuwa na mvi.
Ekegusii: Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.

English: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sema nao uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Wakati Mwisraeli yeyote anapoweka sanamu moyoni mwake na kuweka kitu kiovu cha kukwaza mbele ya macho yake na kisha akaenda kwa nabii, Mimi Bwana nitamjibu peke yangu sawasawa na ukubwa wa ibada yake ya sanamu.
Ekegusii: “Ase igo, kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli orae emegwekano yaye agosasiima ribaga ase enkoro yaye, na emegwekano eyio ebe ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie buna agwenerete ase engencho y’emegwekano yaye emenge agosasiima.

English: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
Kiswahili: Goliathi alisimama na kuwapigia kelele majeshi ya Israeli, akisema, “Kwa nini mmetoka kupanga vita? Je, mimi si Mfilisti, na ninyi ni watumishi wa Sauli? Chagueni mtu na anishukie mimi.
Ekegusii: Goliato agacha bosio, agaaka eriogi ase abarwani b'Abaisraeli, akabora: “Nase ki mwachire na korobera ase okorwana esegi? Inee! Inche tindi Omofilisti, nainwe nabasomba ba Saulo? Chora omonto oyomo oino ache aa ase 'nde.

English: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila kitu kilichowekwa nuruni, huonekana,
Ekegusii: Korende onsi ayaorokigwe nomobaso nigo are maiso marore, ekiagera kera egento ekere maiso marore nigo kere omobaso.

English: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaondoa wanawe magotini mwa Israeli naye akasujudu hadi nchi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatugama inse.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Nyoosha mkono wako umkamate mkiani.” Basi Mose akanyoosha mkono akamkamata yule nyoka, naye akabadilika tena kuwa fimbo mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Erio ere akarambora okoboko kwaye, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.

English: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
Kiswahili: hakikisheni kwamba mnatii amri na sheria zote ninazoziweka mbele yenu leo.
Ekegusii: mwerende na mobwate amachiiko na emeroberio yonsi echiikire, aya nayabeekire ase amasio aino rituko ria reero.

English: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
Kiswahili: Wakati Israeli walipotoka Misri, nyumba ya Yakobo kutoka kwa watu wa lugha ngeni,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge konoga omonwa omoao,

English: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
Kiswahili: Hekalu ndani ilikuwa ya mierezi iliyonakshiwa mifano ya maboga na maua yaliyochanua. Kila kitu kilikuwa cha mwerezi, hakuna jiwe ambalo lilionekana.
Ekegusii: Chibao chi'emecharake chiatubete enyomba ime nigo chiareenge nemegwekano y'ebirandi, na ey'ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Yonsi nigo yatubetwe nemecharake, na igena rinde tiriarorekanete.

English: Then Daniel replied, “O king, may you live forever!
Kiswahili: Danieli akajibu, “Ee mfalme, uishi milele!
Ekegusii: Erio Danieli akairaneria omorwoti, “Aye omorwoti, ochie kare!

English: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal glory that is far beyond comparison.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana dhiki yetu nyepesi iliyo ya kitambo inatutayarisha kwa ajili ya utukufu wa milele unaozidi kuwa mwingi kupita kiasi,
Ekegusii: Naki emechando yaito eyere y’ekero egeke gioka nemegusu, egotoroiseria obonene bwa kare na kare obore obonge mono kobua.

English: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
Kiswahili: Msiwe kama wao, kwa sababu Baba yenu anajua kile mnachohitaji kabla hamjamwomba.
Ekegusii: Gaki timoba omogwekano oyomo nabarabwo, ekiagera Iso oino namanyete aya moganetie, ritang’ani motaramosaba. Ogosaba kw’Omonene (Luk 11:2-4)

English: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akijenga juu ya msingi huu kwa kutumia dhahabu, fedha, vito vya thamani, miti, majani au nyasi,
Ekegusii: Korende omonto karaagache igoro ase oboroso obwo netaabu, gose efeta, gose amagena e rigori rinene, gose emete, gose obonyansi, gose chinsiaga,

English: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,
Kiswahili: Lakini mkiingia katika mji, nao hawakuwakaribisha, tokeni mwende katika barabara zake mkaseme:
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi mogosoa omochie, na barabwo batabaariganeti, soka korwa aroro, eta ase chinchera chiaye, motebe:

English: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini, mwezi wa nne, siku ya tano ya mwezi, wakati nilipokuwa miongoni mwa hao waliokuwa uhamishoni kando ya Mto Kebari, mbingu zilifunguka nami nikaona maono ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o kane, omwaka bw'emerongo etato, ekero inche Ezekieli namenyete ang'e norooche rwa Kebari amo nabooswa bande, igoro ekamaanoka, nkarora amaroro akorwa ase Nyasae.

English: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
Kiswahili: Sitasahau mausia yako kamwe, kwa maana kwayo umehifadhi maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche tinkonyaara kweba amachiiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang'eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.

English: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And his son Amon reigned in his place. Amon Reigns in Judah (2 Chronicles 33:21–25)
Kiswahili: Manase akalala pamoja na baba zake na akazikwa katika bustani ya jumba lake la kifalme, katika bustani ya Uza. Naye Amoni mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake. Amoni Mfalme Wa Yuda (2 Nyakati 33:21-25)
Ekegusii: Manase akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase omogondo bw’enyomba yaye oria orenge o Usa; na Amoni, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye. Amoni omorwoti bw’Abayuda (2 Amg 33:21-25)

English: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Naye kila atakayenena neno baya dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyomo orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, naaberwe; korende ere oyorarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa.

English: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
Kiswahili: Wazike wote mavumbini pamoja; wafunge nyuso zao kaburini.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong'u amasio abo ime y'ense inse.

English: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone's heart will melt.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya hili, mikono yote italegea, moyo wa kila mtu utayeyuka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, amaboko 'abaanto bonsi nigo araborwe chinguru, ne chinkoro chiabo chirianyeke ase obwoba.

English: Uzziah had an army ready for battle that went out to war by assigned divisions, as recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officers.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Uzia alikuwa na jeshi lililofunzwa vizuri, lililokuwa tayari kwenda vitani kwa vikosi kufuatana na idadi yao kama walivyokusanywa na Yeieli mwandishi na Maaseya msimamizi chini ya maelekezo ya Hanania, mmojawapo wa maafisa wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Naende Usia nabwate omoganda bw’abasikari bamanyete korwana. Barabwo bakagenda korwana esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe, koreng’ana buna baabaretwe na korikwa na Yeieli omoriki, na Maaseya omoteneneri, inse y’obochiki bwa Hanania, omochiki bw’abarwani b’omorwoti.

English: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, wala hakuna Mungu ila wewe, kama vile tulivyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng'ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

English: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
Kiswahili: Nitapaza sauti yangu nikisema, “Ni nani aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Wewe huwaokoa maskini kutokana na wale walio na nguvu kuliko wao, maskini na mhitaji kutokana na wanaowanyangʼanya!”
Ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay'omobere one nateebe, “Aye Omonene, ning'o onga buna aye? Aye Omonene, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”

English: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them
Kiswahili: Uwasamehe watu wako, waliotenda dhambi dhidi yako; uwasamehe makosa yote waliyoyatenda dhidi yako, ukawafanye wale waliowashinda kuwaonea huruma;
Ekegusii: Bwabere abanto bao bakorire ebibe asore. Bwabere ogosaria kwabo gwonsi bakorire asore; okore ababisa babo, abwo baboosire baabarorere amabeebe.

English: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?'”
Kiswahili: Wewe unasema moyoni mwako kwamba umemshinda Edomu, nawe sasa unajigamba na kujivuna. Lakini kaa nyumbani kwako! Kwa nini utafute matatizo na kujiletea anguko lako mwenyewe na la Yuda pia?”
Ekegusii: Na bono aye nigo ogokwana iga: Rora, inche naitire Abaedomu; ase igo kweimokereirie igoro ase enkoro yao ime na kweenenia. Korende aye, beera agwo nka bwoo! Nase ki okorangeria emechando, erinde ogwe, aye amo n'Abayuda?”

English: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
Kiswahili: Unaniongoza kwa shauri lako, hatimaye utaniingiza katika utukufu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na magega y'ayio noche kong'ira onsoyie ase obonene.

English: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
Kiswahili: Kando ya mito ya Babeli tuliketi, tukaomboleza tulipokumbuka Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babiloni, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.

English: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme wa Israeli akaagiza, “Mchukueni na mkamrudishe kwa Amoni mtawala wa mji na kwa Yoashi mwana wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli agateeba, “Bwata Mikaya momoiranie ase Amoni, omogabana bw'omochie, na ase Yoashi, omomura bw'omorwoti,

English: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na ndugu saba miongoni mwetu. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa, na kwa kuwa hakuwa na watoto, akamwachia nduguye yule mjane.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise oyomo batano na babere egati yaito. Oyo bw'eritang'ani akanyuoma, erio agakwa, na ekiagera atarenge nabana, agatigera momura omwabo mok'aye.

English: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambieni ya kuwa hakuna mtu anayeongozwa na Roho wa Mungu anayeweza kusema, “Yesu na alaaniwe.” Pia hakuna mtu awezaye kusema, “Yesu ni Bwana,” isipokuwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigetie kobamanyia, ng’a monto onde tari oyogokwana ase Omoika o Nyasae ogoteeba ng’a, “Yeso oragererigwe!” Gose onde takonyara goteeba, “Yeso n’Omonene”, otatiga ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: I will arise now and go about the city, through the streets and squares. I will seek the one I love. So I sought him but did not find him.
Kiswahili: Sasa nitaondoka na kuzunguka mjini, katika barabara zake na viwanja; nitamtafuta yule moyo wangu umpendaye. Kwa hiyo nilimtafuta lakini sikumpata.
Ekegusii: “Erio nkaimoka nkagenda ase omochie, ng’aeta ase chinchera chiaye na ase ebiooreri biaye, nkarigia omwanchi bw’omoyo one.” Nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.

English: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, mashemasi nao wawe watu wanaostahili heshima, wasiwe wenye kauli mbili au wenye kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo, wala wanaotamani faida isiyo halali.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakoonyi b'ekanisa babe abanto bateneneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, batari nemenwa ebere, abanto batari konywa edivai enyinge, abanto batari gwancha okonyora kw'oborianania.

English: Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him. The Sadducees and the Resurrection (Matthew 22:23–33; Luke 20:27–40)
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.” Nao wakamstaajabia sana. Ndoa Wakati Wa Ufufuo (Mathayo 22:23-33; Luka 20:27-40)
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mat 22:23-33; Luk 20:27-40)

English: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa ni sauti ya mabawa ya wale viumbe hai yakisuguana moja kwa jingine, sauti kama ya ngurumo.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa na eriogi rie chimbaaba chi'ebitongwa biria bire moyo chigokunana, na eriogi ri'amagoro aria arenge mbarabare yabo riarenge buna eri'ogoaka gw'enkoba.

English: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
Kiswahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, na kwa roho yako yote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.
Ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oo, n’enkoro yao yonsi, n’omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.

English: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
Kiswahili: Matendo mabaya ya mtu mwovu humnasa yeye mwenyewe; kamba za dhambi yake humkamata kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ebibe bi'omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.

English: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao aliyeitwa Kayafa, ambaye alikuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, akasema, “Ninyi hamjui kitu chochote!
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase bare, Kayafa, oyorenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabateebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.

English: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale maserafi akaruka kunijia akiwa na kaa la moto linalowaka mkononi mwake, ambalo alikuwa amelichukua kwa koleo kutoka madhabahuni.
Ekegusii: Erio omoserafi oyomo akairuruka gocha ase ’nde, obogoretie ase okoboko kwaye rikara rire nomorero, erio arusetie ne rigami korwa ase egesasiimero.

English: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he laid its bases, positioned its frames, inserted its crossbars, and set up its posts.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoweka wakfu Maskani ya Mungu, aliweka vitako mahali pake, akasimamisha mihimili, akatia mataruma na kusimamisha nguzo.
Ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.

English: And every man of Israel cried to God with great earnestness, and with great earnestness they humbled their souls.
Kiswahili: Na kila mtu wa Israeli alimlilia Mungu kwa bidii kubwa, na kwa bidii kubwa walinyenyekeza roho zao.
Ekegusii: Abasacha bonsi ba Israeli bakamoreera Omonene Nyasae obo ase ogwekeia nokweng'ata.

English: “The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished.”
Kiswahili: “ ‘ Bwana amethibitisha haki yetu; njooni, tutangaze katika Sayuni kitu ambacho Bwana Mungu wetu amefanya.’
Ekegusii: “Omonene otorenteire oboronge bwaito. Inchuo torarie ase Sayoni emeremo y’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: For she is a reflection of everlasting light, an unspotted mirror of the working of God, and an image of his goodness.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye ni mng'ao wa nuru ya milele, kioo kisicho na doa cha utendaji wa Mungu, na taswira ya wema wake.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini n'oborabu bwa Nyasae bwa kare na kare, ekerore ekerabu ki'ogokora kwa Nyasae na omobwekano bw'obuya bwaye.

English: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
Kiswahili: Unasema, “Ninachagua wakati maalum; ni mimi nihukumuye kwa haki.
Ekegusii: “Ekero engaki nachigete eraike, inche Nyasae ninache ekiina kia boronge.

English: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”
Kiswahili: Akaangalia, na tazama alikuwako mfalme, akiwa amesimama karibu na nguzo, kama ilivyokuwa desturi. Maafisa na wapiga tarumbeta walikuwa pembeni mwa mfalme, nao watu wote wa nchi walikuwa wakifurahi na kupiga tarumbeta. Ndipo Athalia akararua mavazi yake na kulia, “Uhaini! Uhaini!”
Ekegusii: Atalia akarora omorwoti oteneine ang'e nesiiro buna engencho yarenge. Abatang'ani na abanto abaarenge kobugia ebitureeri bateneine mbarabare y'omorwoti, na abanto bonsi b'ense eria nigo baarenge nomochengo, bakobugia ebitureeri. Atalia agatandora chianga chiaye, akarera, “Oko nokoregwa! Nokoregwa!”

English: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher. “Everything is futile!” The Whole Duty of Man
Kiswahili: Mhubiri asema, “Ubatili! Ubatili! Kila kitu ni ubatili!” Hitimisho La Mambo
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omorandia nigo agoteeba. Aya mbosa, bosa; onsi mbosa kegima. Okobeekwa amo kw’amang’ana

English: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
Kiswahili: Baadaye wakawatuma baadhi ya Mafarisayo na Maherode ili kwenda kumtega Yesu katika yale anayosema.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma asare abande b'Abafarisai na Abaherodia, erinde bamotege ase amang'ana.

English: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn't drink the river water.
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri wote wakachimba kandokando ya Mto Naili kupata maji ya kunywa, kwa sababu hawakuweza kunywa maji ya mto.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y'orooche ase okorigia amaache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amaache a rooche.

English: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
Kiswahili: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng’ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

English: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawatuma vijana wanaume wa Kiisraeli, nao wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu za mafahali wachanga kuwa sadaka za amani kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, bakanyenyera Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

English: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
Kiswahili: “Wale niwapendao, ninawakemea na kuwaadibisha. Hivyo uwe na bidii ukatubu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobaa egesusuro bonsi abanyanchete, na kobagambera; gaki kabe nomokia na koonchoka.

English: My master made me swear an oath and said, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,
Kiswahili: Naye bwana wangu ameniapisha na akasema, ‘Kamwe usimtwalie mwanangu mke katika binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi katika nchi yao,
Ekegusii: Omonene one akamboria ntiane, aganteabia: “Torigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase ense yabo;

English: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”
Kiswahili: Mlinzi akasema, “Ninaona kuwa yule wa kwanza anakimbia kama Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki.” Mfalme akasema, “Yeye ni mtu mwema. Analeta habari njema.”
Ekegusii: Omorendi agateeba, “Nigo 'ndoche ng'a omominyoki oria bw'eritang'ani nigo anga buna Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki.” Erio omorwoti agateeba, “Ere nomonto omuya, nigo akorenta amang'ana amaya.”

English: The priest shall set its value, whether high or low; as the priest values it, the price will be set.
Kiswahili: ambaye ataamua ubora wa mnyama huyo, kama ni mzuri au mbaya. Thamani yoyote atakayoweka kuhani, hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa.
Ekegusii: na ere akore rigori ri’eng’iti eria koreng’ana buna ere engiya gose embe. Rigori Omokuani arakore, nario erio riraabe.

English: And Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” And he gave it to Shaphan.
Kiswahili: Hilkia akamwambia Shafani mwandishi, “Nimekipata Kitabu cha Sheria ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana.” Akampa Shafani kile Kitabu.
Ekegusii: Erio Hilikia agateebia Safani omoriki, “Nanyorire Egetabu y’Amachiko ime ase enyomba y’Omonene,” akaa Safani egetabu eria.

English: Yet none of this satisfies me as long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”
Kiswahili: Lakini haya yote hayanipi kuridhika iwapo ninaendelea kumwona yule Myahudi Mordekai akiketi kwenye lango la mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ayio onsi tabwati engencho ase inde ekero nkorora Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, oikaransete ase egeita ki’omorwoti.”

English: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msiishi kwa kufuata desturi za mataifa nitakayoyafukuza mbele yenu. Kwa sababu walifanya mambo haya yote, nami nikachukizwa sana nao.
Ekegusii: Timochia kobwatia chingencho chi’abaanto b’egesaku keria ngochia goseria kerue ase amasio aino; barabwo nigo bakorete amang’ana ayio onsi, na ase engencho y’ayio nkagechigwa nabarabwo.

English: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.'
Kiswahili: Majembe yenu yafueni yawe panga na miundu yenu ya kukatia iwe mikuki. Aliye dhaifu na aseme, “Mimi nina nguvu!”
Ekegusii: Tura amakombe aino abe emioro, na emeyio yaino chinkuro ebe amatimo! Tiga oyore omworo atebe, “Nainche nigo inde etuoni.”

English: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo na kesho yanatupwa motoni, je, hatawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba?
Ekegusii: Korende onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe, abamore nokwegena ogoke?

English: Heliodorus went on to execute that which had been decreed.
Kiswahili: Heliodorus aliendelea kutekeleza kile kilichokuwa kimeamriwa.
Ekegusii: Heliodoro ere akagenderera n'omoroberio oye.

English: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni Alfa na Omega,” asema Bwana Mungu, “aliyeko, aliyekuwako na atakayekuja, Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: “Inche n'Alifa na Omega,” Omonene oteebire, oyoreo, na oyorengeo, na oyorache kobao.

English: and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
Kiswahili: na useme: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ee Gogu, mimi ni kinyume nawe, mtawala mkuu wa Roshi, Mesheki na Tubali.
Ekegusii: omoteebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Aye Gogi, omogambi omonene bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, inche nigo inde mamincha yao.

English: It came to pass, when King Alexander heard these things, he honored Jonathan even more.
Kiswahili: Ikawa, Mfalme Aleksanda aliposikia mambo haya, alimheshimu Yonathani zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Alekisanda anyoorete amang'ana ayio, akamoa Yonathani esiko enene kobua.

English: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Kiswahili: Hukunikabidhi kwa adui yangu bali umeiweka miguu yangu mahali penye nafasi.
Ekegusii: Tombegeti ase amaboko 'omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.

English: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
Kiswahili: “Kisha tengeneza taa zake saba na uziweke juu ya kinara hicho ili ziangaze mbele yake.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie chitaaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.

English: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
Kiswahili: Wakati mfalme alipokuwa mezani pake, manukato yangu yalisambaza harufu yake nzuri.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.

English: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
Kiswahili: Mfalme akawajibu watu kwa ukatili. Akikataa shauri alilopewa na wazee,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akairaneria abanto baria amang'ana ase obotindi, akaanga ogosemia kw'abagaaka baria.

English: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not bow down or pay him homage, he was filled with rage.
Kiswahili: Wakati Hamani alipoona kuwa Mordekai hampigii magoti wala kumpa heshima alighadhibika.
Ekegusii: Hamani akaba nendamwamu enene mono ekero aroche ng’a Moredekai tarenge gotung’ama ase okomosasiima,

English: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
Kiswahili: mama yako ataaibika mno, yeye aliyekuzaa atatahayari. Atakuwa mdogo kuliko mataifa mengine yote, atakuwa nyika, nchi kame na jangwa.
