Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng'a naye Nyasae.”

English: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
Kiswahili: Ulisema, “Nimefanya agano na mteule wangu, nimemwapia mtumishi wangu Daudi,
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwateebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y’ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.

English: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
Kiswahili: Lakini mnakataa kuja kwangu ili mpate uzima.
Ekegusii: ko mwangire gocha ase 'nde monyare koba nobogima.

English: Yahweh said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, Je, utawahukumu Ohola na Oholiba? Basi wakabili kwa ajili ya matendo yao ya machukizo,
Ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Inee, nonachere Ohola na Oholiba ekiina? Onye nabo, obateebie ogokora kwabo gw'okogechia.

English: At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.
Kiswahili: Mara moja Yesu akatambua rohoni mwake kile walichokuwa wanawaza mioyoni mwao, naye akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso namanyete ase omoika oye ime buna baare korengereria ase chinkoro chiabo, akabateebia, “Inaki mokorengereria iga ase chinkoro chiaino?

English: But now many nations have assembled against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa mataifa mengi yamekusanyika dhidi yako. Wanasema, “Mwache anajisiwe, macho yetu na yatazame Sayuni kwa furaha!”
Ekegusii: Bono abanto b’ebisaku ebinge basangererekanire amo baabarwanie esegi, bagoteeba: “Tiga omochie oyio okorwe obe oyotachenegeti, naintwe tobe torigereretie Sayoni.”

English: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawafuatia kwa bidii Sauli na wanawe, wakawaua Yonathani, Abinadabu na Malki-Shua.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakabwatia Saulo mono, na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Aminadabu, na Maliki‐Sua, abamura ba Saulo.

English: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, wake zao wawe wanawake wanaostahili heshima, wasio wasingiziaji, bali wawe na kiasi na waaminifu katika kila jambo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakungu babo bateneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, tari abang'achi, babe aberiiti na abegenwa ase amang'ana onsi.

English: Tobit went toward the door and stumbled; but his son ran to him,
Kiswahili: Tobiti alielekea mlangoni na kujikwaa; lakini mwanawe alimkimbilia,
Ekegusii: Erio Tobiti nere akaimoka agaeta korwa ase omorangwa omagega.

English: So the LORD said to Moses,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Musa akamoteebia,

English: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
Kiswahili: “Naftali ni kulungu jike aliyeachiwa huru azaaye watoto wazuri.
Ekegusii: “Nafutali nengabi esiboire ekominyoka mono, nigo ekobiara chimanwa chingiya.

English: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Andika katika kitabu maneno yote niliyonena na wewe.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Amang’ana onsi nagotebetie, yarike ase egetabu,

English: Sovereignty is transferred from nation to nation because of injustice, violence, and greed for money.
Kiswahili: Utawala huhamishwa kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa haki, vurugu, na uchoyo wa pesa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'aya atari aboronge, nakwo ogoteeba, obwerori na gwancha enibo, obogambi bw'ense eyemo 'na boirwe n'ense ende.

English: The angel appeared to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you. ”
Kiswahili: Naye malaika akaja kwake akamwambia: “Salamu, wewe uliyebarikiwa, Bwana yu pamoja nawe!”
Ekegusii: Agacha asare, akabora, “Mbuya ore aye, oyobwanchererie. Omonene nigo are amo naye.”

English: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’
Kiswahili: Kisha watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapokuwa nimeifanya nchi kuwa ukiwa na utupu kwa sababu ya mambo yote ya machukizo waliyotenda.’
Ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe nasaririe kegima ense eyio yabo ebe bosa, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi bi’okogechia bakorire, erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Ay’abete magega Ezekieli kabanire

English: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.
Kiswahili: Walipofika mahali paitwapo Fuvu la Kichwa, hapo ndipo walipomsulubisha Yesu pamoja na hao wahalifu, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wake wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Ekeore, bakamobamba aroro, na baria abasaria, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko gw’okobee.

English: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
Kiswahili: Kama milima inavyozunguka Yerusalemu, ndivyo Bwana anavyowazunguka watu wake sasa na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo Omonene abaetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

English: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”
Kiswahili: Basi sasa kwa kuwa hujaamini maneno yangu ambayo yatatimizwa kwa wakati wake, utakuwa bubu hadi siku ile mambo haya yatakapotukia.”
Ekegusii: Korende bono aye ekiagera otegena amang’ana aane ayio agochia kooroka chingaki chiaye rora aye nobe rimama, tonyara gokwana goika rituko riria ayio agocha kooroka.”

English: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
Kiswahili: “Mawazo yanayonisumbua yananisukuma kujibu, kwa sababu nimehangaika sana.
Ekegusii: “Bono ebirengererio bire ime yane bianchandire, ase ayio biagerire imbe omwango koiraneria.

English: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold. The Altar of Incense (Exodus 30:1–10)
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kinara hicho cha taa pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote kutumia talanta moja ya dhahabu safi. Madhabahu Ya Kufukizia Uvumba (Kutoka 30:1-5)
Ekegusii: Ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase chitaabu chichenire chi’ekerengo gie chikiro emerongo etano. Egesasiimero ase ubani erasamberwe gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:1-5)

English: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hekima ya ulimwengu huu ni upuzi mbele za Mungu. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mungu huwanasa wenye hekima katika hila yao,”
Ekegusii: Naki obong’aini bw’ense eye noboriri ase Nyasae, ekiagera neriikire, “Nyasae nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo”,

English: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
Kiswahili: Bwana hakawii kuitimiza ahadi yake, kama watu wengine wanavyokudhani kukawia. Badala yake, yeye anawavumilia ninyi, maana hataki mtu yeyote aangamie, bali kila mtu afikilie toba.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagoteebana goikerania, eira yaye, buna abande bakagete ng’a otebanire, korende nigo aremereretie ase engencho yaino, tancheti monto onde bwensi asire, korende bonsi baikere okoonchoka.

English: Falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
Kiswahili: Kisha akapiga magoti, akalia kwa sauti kubwa akasema, “Bwana usiwahesabie dhambi hii.” Baada ya kusema hayo, akalala.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.

English: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Atayaondoa mafuta yote, kama vile mafuta yaondolewavyo kwenye sadaka ya amani, naye kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi'embori eyio buna ebitinya bi'eng'iti y'ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe bikorusigwa, na Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ebio ase egesasiimero bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: “Hannah, why are you crying?” her husband Elkanah asked. “Why won’t you eat? Why is your heart so grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?” Hannah Prays for a Son
Kiswahili: Elikana mumewe akawa anamwambia, “Hana, kwa nini unalia? Kwa nini huli? Kwa nini kuvunjika moyo? Je, mimi si bora zaidi kwako kuliko watoto kumi?”
Ekegusii: Erio Elikana akamobooria: “Nase ki okona‐korera iga? Naki otari koria endagera? Naende oichaanete iga? Inee! Inche tingoisaini goetania abana abamura ikomi?” Ana na Eli

English: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
Kiswahili: “Basi jifunzeni somo hili kutokana na mtini: Matawi yake yanapoanza kuchipua na kutoa majani, mnatambua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
Ekegusii: Eorokererie omobayeeno oyo korwa ase omoko: Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

English: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
Kiswahili: Tafuteni mema, wala si mabaya, ili mpate kuishi. Ndipo Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa pamoja nanyi, kama msemavyo yupo nanyi.
Ekegusii: Rigia ayare amaya, na tari ayare amabe, erio nario morabe moyo. Komorakore bo, Omonene, Nyasae bw'Emeganda, nabe amo nainwe, buna inwe mwatebiire.

English: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, remove his sandal, spit in his face, and declare, “This is what is done to the man who will not maintain his brother’s line.”
Kiswahili: mjane wa nduguye atamwendea mbele ya wazee, atamvua kiatu kimoja na kumtemea mate usoni, na kusema, “Hivi ndivyo ambavyo hufanywa kwa mtu ambaye atakataa kuendeleza jamaa ya ndugu yake.”
Ekegusii: erio omokungu oria omoboraka aike ang’e ase omomura oria omwabo omosacha oye, asomore egekooroto korwa ase okogoro kw’omonto oria agwo ase amasio y’abagaaka, naende amotwere amate ase obosio bwaye, akwane: Nabo arakorwe omonto onde bwensi okwanga goteneneria omomura omwabo egesaku.

English: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnahukumu kwa kufuata vipimo vya kibinadamu, mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogambia ase okobwatia amang’ana a Mwanyabaanto; inche tindi kogambia omonto.

English: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Je, taa huwashwa na kufunikwa chini ya kikapu au mvunguni mwa kitanda? Je, haiwashwi na kuwekwa juu ya kinara chake?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Etaya nigo ekorentwa erinde yamumekwa negetonga gose yabekwa nyaro y’oborere? Teri kobekwa igoro ase ekebekerero?

English: and reported to him according to the laws what it was proper to do to queen Vashti, because she had not done the things commanded by the king through the chamberlains.
Kiswahili: naye akamweleza kulingana na sheria jinsi ilivyofaa kumtendea malkia Vashti, kwa sababu hakufanya yale yaliyoamriwa na mfalme kupitia wasimamizi.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akarika amang'ana aya ase egetabu gi'okoinyora, nabo igo na Modekai nere akarika amang'ana ayio.

English: Now I will do to you as you have written, but meet me at Ptolemais, that we may see one another; and I will join with you, even as you have said.”
Kiswahili: Sasa nitakutendea kama ulivyoandika, lakini nikutane nawe huko Tolemai, ili tuweze kuonana; nami nitaungana nawe, kama ulivyosema.
Ekegusii: Inche nancheranire nokoboria kwao, korende tiga ritang'ani tororane inche amo naye ase omochie o Tolemai, agwo inatoigwane nainche ninkonywomerie omoiseke one.”

English: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha sita kwa mwezi wa sita alikuwa Ira, mwana wa Ikeshi Mtekoa. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na rimo, Ira, mosinto o Ikesi Omotekoa akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye mambo haya yanasemwa alikuwa wa kabila lingine, na hakuna mtu wa kabila hilo aliyewahi kuhudumu katika madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Naki omonene oito, amang'ana aya akwanetwe igoro yaye, nigo arenge bw'ororeria ronde oroao, na onde tarenge korwa ase ororeria orwo ore gokorera ase egesasiimero.

English: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
Kiswahili: Tufani inapopita, waovu hutoweka, lakini wenye haki husimama imara milele.
Ekegusii: Ekero omwaga ekembugu‐mbugu ogoeta, omokori amabe nigo agosirigwa, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agotenena bokong’u kare na kare.

English: A man's steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Kiswahili: Kama Bwana akipendezwa na njia ya mtu, yeye huimarisha hatua zake,
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeka orogendo rw'omonto omooronge chinguru, na kogokigwa nabarabwo.

English: After two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus. And wishing to do the Jews a favor, Felix left Paul in prison.
Kiswahili: Baada ya miaka miwili kupita, Porkio Festo akaingia kwenye utawala mahali pa Feliksi, lakini kwa kuwa Feliksi alitaka kuwapendeza Wayahudi, akamwacha Paulo gerezani.
Ekegusii: Korende emiaka ebere koyaerire, Porikio Festo agasoa obogambi ribaga ria Feliki; na Feliki akarigia gwekora omuya ase Abayahudi, agatiga Paulo osibire.

English: as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah. And they renamed the cities they rebuilt.
Kiswahili: pia Nebo na Baal-Meoni (majina ya hiyo miji yalibadilishwa) na Sibma. Miji waliyoijenga upya waliipa majina.
Ekegusii: Nebo, na Baali‐Meoni (amarieta abo akaonchorwa), na Sibuma. Boigo bakaroka emechie eyio baagachete ase amarieta ande amayia.

English: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
Kiswahili: Watu wengi wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani, na wengine wakatandaza matawi waliyokuwa wamekata mashambani.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete na gochiara inchera.

English: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kuna watu waliojipenyeza kwa siri katikati yenu, watu walioandikiwa tangu zamani hukumu hii, waovu, wapotoshao neema ya Mungu wetu kuwa ufisadi wakimkana yeye aliye Bwana wetu wa pekee, Bwana Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki mbare abanto besoirie bobisi, abwo barikeretwe kare okogambigwa oko, abanto batari ne chingencho chi'obonyasae. Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana obuya bwa Nyasae oito ase okobiserera ogokora kwabo kw'obonyaka, naende bagokana Omonene oito ore bweka, oyore Omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Korwa agwo kare amariiko nabanete okoragererigwa konya banyorire.

English: just as the LORD commanded him through Moses. This was to be a reminder to the Israelites that no outsider who is not a descendant of Aaron should approach to offer incense before the LORD, lest he become like Korah and his followers. Murmuring and Plague (1 Corinthians 10:1–13)
Kiswahili: kama vile Bwana alivyomwelekeza kupitia Mose. Hili lilikuwa kuwakumbusha Waisraeli kwamba hakuna mtu hata mmoja, isipokuwa mzao wa Aroni, awezaye kuja kufukiza uvumba mbele za Bwana, la sivyo, angekuwa kama Kora na wafuasi wake.
Ekegusii: Ekio gekaba ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera Abaisraeli, ng’a nonya noyomo otari Omokuani, otari bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, tabaisa goika ang’e gosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aise gokora bo, nasire buna Kora amo n’abanto baria bamobwatetie basirete. Aya onsi nigo akoretwe buna Omonene konya achiikire Eleazari goetera ase Musa. Aroni Ogotooria Abanto

English: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yehoshafati pia akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, “Kwanza tafuta shauri la Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Naende akamoteebia, “Ritang’ani tiga toboorie Omonene igoro y’amang’ana ayio.”

English: You are to be My holy people. You must not eat the meat of a mauled animal found in the field; you are to throw it to the dogs.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi mtakuwa watu wangu watakatifu. Kwa hiyo msile nyama ya mnyama aliyeraruliwa na wanyama pori; mtupieni mbwa.
Ekegusii: “Mobe abanto baane abachenu; timobaisa koria eng’iti ende yonsi eyaitirwe nenyang’au ase orosana, motugutere chisese chinyama echio.”

English: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.
Kiswahili: Hapa ndipo penye hekima. Yeye aliye na ufahamu na ahesabu tarakimu za huyo mnyama, kwa maana ni tarakimu za kibinadamu. Tarakimu zake ni 666.
Ekegusii: Aiga nao obong'aini boganeirie. Ere oyore ne chisemi tiga abare chinamba chi'eng'iti eyio, naki echi nechinamba chia Mwanyabaanto, ne chinamba chiaye namagana atano na rimo na emerongo etano nomo na isano nemo (666).

English: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wa Hoshea mwana wa Ela mfalme wa Israeli, Hezekia mwana wa Ahazi mfalme wa Yuda alianza kutawala.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw'okogaamba kwa Hosea, mosinto o Ela, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, Hezekia, mosinto bw'Ahasi, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, agachaaka kogamba.

English: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
Kiswahili: Bwana na amjalie kupata rehema zake siku ile! Nawe unajua vyema jinsi alivyonisaidia huko Efeso.
Ekegusii: Omonene namwanchere anyoore amaabera korwa ase Omonene Rituko riria. Aye kwamanyire buya buna are gokora emeremo emenge aria Efeso.

English: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David's enemy continually.
Kiswahili: Sauli akazidi kumwogopa Daudi, naye Sauli akabaki kuwa adui yake siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo akoboa Daudi mono kobua, naende akaba omobisa oye kogenderera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way, and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.
Kiswahili: Haki yangu inakaribia mbio, wokovu wangu unakuja, nao mkono wangu utaleta hukumu kwa mataifa. Visiwa vitanitegemea na kungojea mkono wangu kwa matumaini.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwane nigo bore ang’e, ogotooreka kwane ngocha kore, amaboko aane nagambie abanto bonsi ekiina kia boronge; abanto bamenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nigo bang’anyete, basemerie okoboko kwane.

English: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle's boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
Kiswahili: Huu ndio wajibu wao wanapofanya huduma katika Hema la Kukutania: kubeba miimo ya Maskani, mataruma yake, nguzo na vitako,
Ekegusii: Emeremo yabo ase Eema eria ebe ey'okobogoria ebinto ebi: Chibao chi'Obomenyo Obochenu, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,

English: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akampungia mkono yule mwanafunzi, akamwambia, “Muulize anamaanisha nani.”
Ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero akamoraga, akamobooria, “Moborie ning'o atora?”

English: So David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How can I make amends so that you may bless the inheritance of the LORD?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akawauliza Wagibeoni, “Niwatendee nini? Nitawaridhishaje ili mbariki urithi wa Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Abagibeoni, “Ninki ’nkobakorera? Nindigetie gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe mwakoreretwe, erinde mosesenie abanto ba Omonene.”

English: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
Kiswahili: Watu hulala kando ya kila madhabahu juu ya nguo zilizowekwa rehani. Katika nyumba ya mungu wao hunywa mvinyo ulionunuliwa kwa fedha walizotozwa watu.
Ekegusii: Mbarabare ase kera egesasiimero barabwo nigo bakorara inse igoro ye chianga chikobekwa kebwaterero. Ase enyomba y'enyasae yabo banywa edivai y'abwo bagambetigwe bakarusigwa chitaabu.

English: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mwana akiwaweka huru mtakuwa huru kweli kweli.
Ekegusii: Gaki Omwana karabasibore, namobe abasibore kegima.

English: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti.
Ekegusii: Ekero bambokire, bagaika ense ya Genesareti.

English: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
Kiswahili: (Kwa maana Masadukayo wanasema kwamba hakuna ufufuo, wala hakuna malaika au roho, lakini Mafarisayo wanaamini haya yote.)
Ekegusii: Naki Abasadukai nigo bagokana ng'a kobokigwa tikori, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nemeika, korende Abafarisai nigo bagwancha onsi.

English: David said to him, “Don't be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father's sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia, “Usiogope, kwa maana hakika nitakutendea wema kwa ajili ya baba yako Yonathani. Nitakurudishia ardhi yote iliyokuwa mali ya Sauli baba yako, nawe daima utakula chakula mezani pangu.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akamoteebia, “Toondoka, ekiagera ningokorere amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani iso. Ninkoiranerie emegondo yonsi ya Saulo, sokoro yao, naye n'obe gokoragera ase emesa y'ane botambe.”

English: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.
Kiswahili: Efa na bathi viwe sawa, bathi iwe sehemu ya kumi ya homeri na efa iwe sehemu ya kumi ya homeri, homeri itakuwa ndicho kiwango cha kukubalika kwa vyote viwili.
Ekegusii: Ekerengero gia efa (gose egetonga) na ekia bati (gose ensiongo) bibe ekerengo ekemo. Kera ekemo getware ensemo eyemo ya ikomi y'ekerengero gekorokwa homeri. Ekerengero kiaino ekenene mokorengera kebe ekie homeri.

English: He asked if they were well, and then he asked, “How is your elderly father you told me about? Is he still alive?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza kuhusu hali yao, kisha akawaambia, “Yule baba yenu mzee mliyeniambia habari zake, yu hali gani? Je, bado yu hai?”
Ekegusii: Akabakwania, akababooria: “Inee! Iso mbuya are, omogaka oria mwanteebia? Moyo are?”

English: For your songs, proverbs, parables, and interpretations, the countries marveled at you.
Kiswahili: Kwa nyimbo zako, methali, mafumbo, na tafsiri, nchi zilikustaajabia.
Ekegusii: Ase amateera, emegwekano, emereng'anio na amorokererio aye, chinse chionsi chigatengechigwa na goichana.

English: For she is a treasure for men that doesn't fail, and those who use it obtain friendship with God, commended by the gifts which they present through discipline.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye ni hazina kwa wanaume ambayo haishindwi, na wale wanaoitumia hupata urafiki na Mungu, wakipongezwa na zawadi wanazotoa kupitia nidhamu.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini n'eniibo etari koera ase abanto; baria bakwenyorera obongaini nigo bakoba abasani ba Nyasae; ere nigo akoenekia onsi aria bakwegera korwa ase are.

English: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.
Kiswahili: Kama simba ataacha pango lake, nchi yao itakuwa ukiwa kwa sababu ya upanga wa mdhalimu, na kwa sababu ya hasira kali ya Bwana Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonene otigire abanto baye, buna endo egotiga riraro riaye. Ense yabo yasarigwe na gotigwa bosa, ase engencho y'obotindi bw'abachandi, na ase engencho y'endamwamu entindi y'Omonene.”

English: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh's words.
Kiswahili: Kisha Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme, Shebna katibu, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu, mwandishi wakamwendea Hezekia, nguo zao zikiwa zimeraruliwa, na kumwambia yale jemadari wa jeshi aliyoyasema.
Ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, oria orenge omoteneneri bw'enyomba y'omorwoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa, mosinto bw'Asafu, omoriki bw'amang'ana are gokoreka, bagacha ase Hezekia ne chianga chiabo chitandogete, bakamoteebia amang'ana onsi omochiki oria omonene akwanete.

English: Now Samuel didn't yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh's word yet revealed to him.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Samweli alikuwa bado hajamjua Bwana. Neno la Bwana lilikuwa bado halijafunuliwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Bono Samweli konya taramanyereria eriogi ri'Omonene, ne ring'ana ri'Omonene konya tiriraorokigwa asaare.

English: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Siku moja binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Baba yetu ni mzee na hakuna mwanaume mahali hapa atakayekutana na sisi kimwili, kama ilivyo desturi ya mahali pote duniani.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oye omotangi agateebia oyomwabo omoke: “Tata ogotire, gose monto onde tari ase ense oyorache gotonyuoma buna engencho y’ense yonsi ere.

English: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu atakomboa uhai wangu na kaburi, hakika atanichukua kwake.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae naboorie omoyo one, ayorusie korwa ase okobua gw'aase abakuure erinde ang'ire imenye asare.

English: About five hundred men of Nicanor's army fell, and the rest fled into the city of David.
Kiswahili: Karibu watu mia tano wa jeshi la Nikanori waliuawa, na wengine wakakimbilia mjini mwa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Abanto koreng'ana 500 ase abarwani be esegi ba Nikanori bagaitwa, na baria baminchoretie bagatama gochia ase orwaki rwa Daudi.

English: Then he measured the room adjacent to the inner sanctuary to be twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. And he said to me, “This is the Most Holy Place. ” Outside the Temple
Kiswahili: Naye akapima urefu wa sehemu takatifu ndani, nao ulikuwa dhiraa ishirini, na upana wake ulikuwa dhiraa ishirini hadi mwisho wa sehemu ya nje ya sehemu takatifu. Akaniambia, “Hapa ndipo Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Akarengia obotambe bw’akanyomba karia kaare moino ya Aase Aachenu, bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye bokaba amaboko emerongo ebere boigo. Omonto oria agantebia, “Aiga nao Aase Aachenu Mono.” Oboagacho bwachomeire ase chinyasi chie Hekalu

English: O death, how bitter is the memory of you to a man who is at peace in his possessions, to the man who has nothing to distract him and has prosperity in all things, and who still has strength to enjoy food!
Kiswahili: Ee kifo, kumbukumbu yako ni chungu kiasi gani kwa mtu ambaye ana amani katika mali zake, kwa mtu ambaye hana kitu cha kumkengeusha na ana mafanikio katika mambo yote, na ambaye bado ana nguvu ya kufurahia chakula!
Ekegusii: Aye amakweri! Ogokoinyora nobororo obonene, ase omonto ore moyo oyio omenyete nomorembe ase enibo yaye; ase omonto otari kwegosa, oyio okonyaara kera ring'ana, boigo ere oria ore nechinguru chi'okwegokeria endagera yaye.

English: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Nitawatia Wamisri mikononi mwa bwana mkatili na mfalme mkali atatawala juu yao,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke Abamisiri ase amaboko 'omonene ore omotindi; omorwoti bw'okobaondokia nabagambere.” Nab'Omonene, oyore Omonene bw'Emeganda, atebiire.

English: “Very well,” he answered, “I will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Vema sana, nitalikubali hili ombi pia, sitauangamiza mji ulioutaja.
Ekegusii: Ere akamoteebia: “Rora, nagwancheire ase ring’ana erio boigo. Tingosaria omochie oyio gwateeba.

English: it shall be that, if the king's wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn't you know that they would shoot from the wall?
Kiswahili: hasira ya mfalme yaweza kuwaka, naye aweza kukuuliza, ‘Kwa nini mlisogea karibu hivyo na mji kupigana? Hamkujua kuwa wangeweza kuwapiga mishale kutoka ukutani?
Ekegusii: ande nabo araabe nendamwamu, akoborie: Inaki mwakorete mokageenda ang'e nomochie? Inee! Timwamanyete ng'a abanto nigo bakoruta chinsara korwa ase orwaki?

English: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many; but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo atauelekeza uso wake kwenye visiwa, na kuviteka vingi; lakini mkuu mmoja ataikomesha aibu yake; naam, zaidi ya hayo, atamrudishia aibu yake.
Ekegusii: Nyuma y'ayio naonchokere korwania ebisinka ne chinse chire ang'e nenyancha, nabue ebisinka ebinge ne chinse boigo. Korende omochiki oyomo bw'abarwani b'esegi namobue asirie ogochaaya kwaye, ee, namoiranerie ogochaaya okwo.

English: From one man He made every nation of men, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and He determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their lands.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa mtu mmoja, yeye aliumba mataifa yote ya wanadamu ili waikalie dunia yote, naye akaweka nyakati za kuishi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase omonto oyomo nere otongete kera egesaku kia Mwanyabaanto kemenye ase ense engima, akababeekera chingaki ne chimbebe chi’Obomenyo bwabo,

English: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: Waamaleki wanaishi Negebu; Wahiti, Wayebusi na Waamori wanaishi katika nchi ya vilima; nao Wakanaani wanaishi karibu na bahari na kando ya Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Abaameleki nigo bamenyete ase ense ya Negebu, ensemo ya Irianyi y'ense eria; Abahiti, na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, nigo bamenyete ase ense y'ebitunwa. Abakaanani barabwo nigo bamenyete ase enyancha enene mbarabare, ang'e norooche rwa Yorodani.”

English: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required,
Kiswahili: Aliwapa Wagershoni magari mawili ya kukokotwa na maksai wanne, kama walivyohitaji kwa kazi yao,
Ekegusii: Akaa Abagerisoni chigaari ibere ne chiombe inye, buna emeremo yabo yarenge.

English: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kamwe wasioe wanawake waliojinajisi kwa ukahaba, au waliopewa talaka na waume wao, kwa sababu makuhani ni watakatifu kwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Omokuani tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omotayayi, gose oyotari omwekuungi, gose oyobatiganire nomosaacha oye, ekiagera Omokuani nigo achenegete ase Omonene oye.

English: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ninawaambia Waisraeli, “Hakuna hata mmoja wenu anayeruhusiwa kunywa damu, wala mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu haruhusiwi kunywa damu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio natebirie Abaisraeli ng'a monto onde bwensi obo, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, tabaisa koria amanyinga ande onsi.

English: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
Kiswahili: “Nilipokuwa njiani kuelekea Dameski, yapata saa sita mchana, ghafula nuru kubwa kutoka mbinguni ikanimulika kotekote.
Ekegusii: “Erio ekero nare kogenda, konaikire ang'e na Damesiki, ekero kia mobaso gati mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro akambarera chinsemo chionsi.

English: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-three.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Besai 323
Ekegusii: aba orwa Besai: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere, na batato (323);

English: And Joseph made the sons of Israel take an oath and said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”
Kiswahili: Naye Yosefu akawaapisha wana wa Israeli na kuwaambia, “Hakika Mungu atawasaidia, nanyi ni lazima mhakikishe mmepandisha mifupa yangu kutoka mahali hapa.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agatiania abana ba Israeli agwo, akabora: “Bono, ekero Nyasae arabachere abakoonye, goika moire amauga aane; mogende naro.”

English: His heart is ashes. His hope is of less value than earth. His life is of less honor than clay,
Kiswahili: Moyo wake ni majivu. Tumaini lake halina thamani kama udongo. Maisha yake hayana heshima kama udongo,
Ekegusii: Enkoro yaye nigo ere ribu na ogosemeria kwaye nigo kore okoreu mono kobua ebuse. Obogima bwaye tibori bw'erigori kobua riroba;

English: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don't listen to me.
Kiswahili: ‘Lakini ninyi mmetenda uovu zaidi kuliko baba zenu. Tazama jinsi ambavyo kila mmoja wenu anafuata ukaidi wa moyo wake mbaya, badala ya kunitii mimi.
Ekegusii: Nainwe mwakorire amabe kobua chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera kera oyomo oino nigo akobwatia obomwenu bw'enkoro yaye embe, bwanga konyigwera.

English: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man's heart was continually only evil.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaona jinsi uovu wa mwanadamu ulivyokuwa mkubwa duniani, na ya kuwa kila mwelekeo wa mawazo ya moyo wake wakati wote ulikuwa mbaya tu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarora ng'a obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto bwabeire obonge ase ense, na kera okoroberia na okorengereria gwe chinkoro chiabo nokobe botambe.

English: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,” declares the LORD, “because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo kura yako, fungu nililokuamuria,” asema Bwana, “kwa sababu umenisahau mimi na kuamini miungu ya uongo.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Eke nakio kerabe egetari kiaino ndabae, ekiagera mwanyebire na mwasemeirie amang’ana ’oborimo.

English: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini na manabii wa uongo, wanaowajia wakiwa wamevaa mavazi ya kondoo, lakini ndani ni mbwa mwitu wakali.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende nababani b’oborimo abwo bagocha ase more beboyetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi, na ime yabo nigo bare chisese chi’orosana chintindi mono.

English: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya nane mtakuwa na kusanyiko, na msifanye kazi ya kawaida.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

English: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.” A New Song of Praise (Psalms 98:1–9; Psalms 149:1–9)
Kiswahili: Tazama, mambo ya kwanza yametokea, nami natangaza mambo mapya; kabla hayajatokea nawatangazia habari zake.” Wimbo Wa Kumsifu Bwana
Ekegusii: Rora, amang’ana nateebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobaraareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.” Ogoteera kw’ogotogia

English: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment. The Power of Faith (Luke 17:5–10)
Kiswahili: Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akamtoka yule kijana, naye akapona saa ile ile.
Ekegusii: Yeso agatogonyera ekerecha, na kerokio kegatiga omwana oria na ere akagwenigwa ekero keria.

English: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
Kiswahili: Atoapo sauti yake, maji yaliyo katika mbingu hunguruma; huyafanya mawingu yainuke kutoka miisho ya dunia. Hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua, naye huuleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.
Ekegusii: Ase eriogi riaye amaache are igoro chionsi akoeera neriogi, nigo akorenta ritaturi korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.

English: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo mkiendelea kufanya uovu, ninyi na mfalme wenu mtafutiliwa mbali!”
Ekegusii: Korende onye mokogenderera gokora ebibe, rirorio nigo morasirigwe amo nomorwoti oino.”

English: The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
Kiswahili: Mtu aliyekuwa karibu kufa alinibariki, nami niliufanya moyo wa mjane kuimba.
Ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’omonto konya obeire ang’e gosira nigo gwanchicherete, nkagera ababoraka bagateera nechinkoro chire nomogooko.

English: When the young woman would go to the king, she was given whatever she requested to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
Kiswahili: Basi hivi ndivyo ambavyo msichana angeingia kwa mfalme: Kila kitu alichohitaji aliruhusiwa kuchukua kutoka nyumba ya wanawake na kwenda navyo katika jumba la mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoiseke arenge gochia ase obosio bw’omorwoti, nigo arenge koegwa korwa ase enyomba y’abaiseke baria egento kende gionsi arenge kogania koira.

English: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.
Kiswahili: Kisha akasema, “Chukua mishale,” naye mfalme akaichukua. Elisha akamwambia, “Piga ardhi kwa hiyo mishale.” Akaipiga mara tatu, halafu akaacha.
Ekegusii: Erio Elisha agateebia omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli: “Imokia emegwe!” Nere akayeimokia. Naende akamoteebia: “Rasa inse ase riroba!” Nere akarasa inse ase riroba ara gatato, agatiga.

English: Behold, Yahweh's word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana lilipomjia: “Mtu huyu hatakuwa mrithi wako, bali mwana atakayetoka katika viuno vyako mwenyewe ndiye atakayekuwa mrithi wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio ring'ana ri'Omonene rikamochiera Aburamu naende, rigateeba: “Omonto oyio, tari ere oraire omwando oo, otatiga omwana oo bori, orarwe ase enda yao, nere oraire omwando oo.”

English: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle's boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
Kiswahili: Wamerari waliwekwa kutunza miimo ya Maskani, mataruma yake, nguzo, vitako na vifaa vyake vyote na kila kitu kilichohusika na matumizi yake,
Ekegusii: Abamerari nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: chibao chi'Obomenyo Obochenu, n'emeriibo, ne chisiiro, ne chinterekerero, amo nebikorero biabo bionsi. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

English: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, waliomwamini Bwana wakazidi kuongezeka, wanaume na wanawake.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abange bakamentwa ase abegeeni omoganda omonene bw’abasacha na’abakuungu abwo begenete omonene.

English: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
Kiswahili: “Kwa malaika wa kanisa lililoko Sardi andika: “Haya ndiyo maneno ya aliye na zile Roho saba za Mungu na zile nyota saba. Nayajua matendo yako, kwamba una sifa ya kuwa hai, lakini umekufa.
Ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Saridi riika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyobwate emeika eria etano na ebere ya Nyasae, ne ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere. “Namanyire ogokora kwao. Nore nerieta ng’a moyo ore, korende nigo okwete.

English: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
Kiswahili: Aliona kuwa hakuwepo hata mtu mmoja, akashangaa kwamba hakuwepo hata mmoja wa kuingilia kati; hivyo mkono wake mwenyewe ndio uliomfanyia wokovu, nayo haki yake mwenyewe ndiyo iliyomtegemeza.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarora ng'a monto onde tarenge aande, agakumia ng'a onde tarenge gwesoyia gokonya. Erio okoboko kwaye omonyene gokamorentera ogotooreka, na oboronge bwaye bokamokonya.

English: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn't worthy, let your peace return to you.
Kiswahili: Kama nyumba hiyo inastahili, amani yenu na iwe juu yake. La sivyo, amani yenu na iwarudie ninyi.
Ekegusii: Onye enyomba eria egwenerete, tiga omorembe oino oyeikere; ko onye tegwenereti, omorembe oino nobairanere inwe.

English: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
Kiswahili: Labani akasema, “Ninakubali na iwe kama ulivyosema.”
Ekegusii: Labani agancha amang'ana ayio, agateeba: “Tiga abe buna gwateebire.”

English: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food. The Year of Jubilee
Kiswahili: vilevile malisho ya mifugo yenu na wanyama pori katika nchi yenu. Chochote nchi itakachozalisha kinaweza kuliwa. Mwaka Wa Yubile
Ekegusii: Boigo ching’iti chitugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chire ase ense eyio nachirie okwama okwo kwemeretie. Omwaka bw’Omochengo

English: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.
Kiswahili: Lakini moyo wake ulipokuwa na majivuno na kuwa mgumu kwa kiburi, aliondolewa kutoka kwa kiti chake cha ufalme na kuvuliwa utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero enkoro yaye yeimokereretie igoro, na omoika oye okong'ete na koenena, nigo aseretigwe korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki'oborwoti, akaurwa obonene bwaye.

English: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
Kiswahili: Watakula wadogo wa mifugo yako na mazao ya nchi yako mpaka umeangamia. Hawatakuachia nafaka, divai mpya au mafuta, wala ndama wowote wa kundi lako au wana-kondoo wa kundi lako mpaka umekuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbarie chimoori chi’echiombe chiaino, na okwama kwe riroba riaino, goika mosirigwe kegima. Tibakobatigareria endagera yaino, gose edivai, gose amaguta, gose chimoori chi’echiombe chiaino, gose chimanwa chi’eching’ondi n’echie chimbori chiaino; ’nabagere mosire kegima.

English: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.
Kiswahili: Naye atakuwa amani yao. Ukombozi Na Uharibifu Wakati Mwashuru atakapovamia nchi yetu na kupita katika ngome zetu, tutawainua wachungaji saba dhidi yake, hata viongozi wanane wa watu.
Ekegusii: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ogotooreka na egesusuro Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagaambi batano na batato, baabatange.

English: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
Kiswahili: “Miongoni mwa manabii wa Samaria nililiona jambo la kuchukiza: Walitabiri kwa Baali na kuwapotosha Israeli watu wangu.
Ekegusii: “Naroche oboriri ase ababani ba Samaria, nigo barenge kobana ase erieta ri'enyasae Baali, na gotantania abanto baane Abaisraeli.

English: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
Kiswahili: Katika kila mwanzo wa barabara ulijenga mahali pa fahari pa ibada za miungu na kuaibisha uzuri wako, ukiutoa mwili wako kwa kuzidisha uzinzi kwa kila apitaye.
Ekegusii: Ase kera amatabekania ye chinchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasiimera, kwanyakairie oboseera bwao, gwechwarire ase onde bwensi ogoeta, na gwakorire obonyaka obonge.

English: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.
Kiswahili: Sakafu za kupuria nafaka na mashinikizo ya kukamulia divai havitalisha watu, divai mpya itawapungukia.
Ekegusii: Korende ebiooreri bi’okoorera na ebimitero bi’edivai tibigoisanekia abanto, na edivai enyia tekonyorekana ase bare.

English: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:
Kiswahili: “Lakini yawezekana mwana huyo ana mwana aonaye dhambi hizi zote anazofanya baba yake, naye ingawa anaziona, yeye hafanyi mabaya kama haya:
Ekegusii: Ande omonto oyio nabe ng’a oiboire omwana omomura, ere arore ebibe bionsi ise akorete, korende airoke na takora amang’ana buna ayio.

English: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
Kiswahili: Fahamuni kuwa Bwana amewapa ninyi Sabato, ndiyo sababu katika siku ya sita amewapa mikate ya siku mbili. Kila mmoja inampasa kukaa pale alipo katika siku ya saba. Hata mmoja haruhusiwi kutoka.”
Ekegusii: Inyora ng'a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y'amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”

English: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”
Kiswahili: Kisha asubuhi wakati wa kuchomoza jua, amka mapema na ujipange dhidi ya huo mji. Wakati yeye na jeshi lililo pamoja naye watakapotoka kukabiliana nanyi, mwaweza kuwatendea kwa kadiri mnavyoweza.”
Ekegusii: Ankio mambia, ekero erioba rigosoka, moimoke bwango, moumokere omochie. Erio ekero Gaali n'abanto baria bare komo bakobaachera kobarwania, mobakorere buna amaboko aino aranyare ekero ekio!”

English: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu na Ishmaeli mwanawe walitahiriwa siku ile ile,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Aburaamu akarokigwa amo na omwana oye Isumaeli.

English: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa ameotesha bustani upande wa mashariki, katika Edeni, huko akamweka huyo mtu aliyemuumba.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene Nyasae agasimeka ebimeri ase omogondo aaria Edeni, ensemo ya moocha, erio akabeeka omonto aroro, oria abombete na koroisia.

English: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wote waliokuwa wamejificha katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu waliposikia kuwa Wafilisti wamekimbia, wakajiunga vitani na kuwafuata kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Boigo Abaisraeli bande, abwo konya bebisire ase ebitunwa bi'ense ya Efraimu, ekero baigwete ng'a Abafirisiti batamire, nabarabwo bakababwatia nomokia gochia kobarwania.

English: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
Kiswahili: yeye hufanya maangamizo kwenye ngome na kufanya mji uliozungushiwa ngome kuwa ukiwa),
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta ogosiria kwa mobosokano ase abwo bare ne chinguru, boigo nagere ogosareka gochere chiburi chinkong’u.

English: and say to them, Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn't hear the words of this covenant,
Kiswahili: Waambie kwamba hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Amelaaniwa mtu ambaye hatayatii maneno ya agano hili,
Ekegusii: obateebie: Aya nar'Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Aragererigwe omonto otari koigwera amang'ana 'okobwatana oko

English: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, presuming he was dead.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaja baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Antiokia na Ikonio wakawashawishi wale watu, wakampiga Paulo kwa mawe, wakamburuta hadi nje ya mji, wakidhani amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okuure,

English: Esther replied, “If it pleases the king, may the Jews in Susa also have tomorrow to carry out today’s edict, and may the bodies of Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”
Kiswahili: Esta akajibu, “Ikimpendeza mfalme, uwape ruhusa Wayahudi walioko Shushani warudie amri ya leo kesho pia, na wana wa Hamani kumi wanyongwe mahali pa kunyongea watu.”
Ekegusii: Esiteri akamoiraneria, “Omorwoti korarore mbuya, Abayahudi aba bare agwo Susa baegwe ribaga ankio boigo bakore koreng’ana nogochika kwa reero; tiga abamura ba Hamani ikomi batongwe ase chimbambo igoro.”

English: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
Kiswahili: Pia walipiga kura kama vile ndugu zao wazao wa Aroni walivyofanya, mbele ya Mfalme Daudi, Sadoki, Ahimeleki na mbele ya viongozi wa jamaa ya makuhani na ya Walawi. Jamaa za ndugu wakubwa zilitendewa sawasawa na zile za ndugu wadogo.
Ekegusii: Abateneneri abwo be chiamate chiabo, abatang’ani amo nabamwabo abake, bagaaka obomera buna abamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, ekero Daudi omorwoti, na Zadoki, na Ahimeleki, na abatang’ani be chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Oyorenge omonene ase eamate ogaakerwa obomera koreng’ana buna oyorenge omoke.

English: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
Kiswahili: Mbele ya kila chumba cha kupumzikia kulikuwepo ukuta uliokuwa na kimo cha dhiraa moja kwenda juu, navyo hivyo vyumba vilikuwa dhiraa sita mraba.
Ekegusii: Orosenge ndwarenge bosio bw'ebinyomba biria bi'oborendi, na obogare bw'egesona keria nigo bwarenge obw'okoboko okomo. Ebisona bi'ebinyomba ebio bie chinsemo chionsi ibere nigo biareng'aine. Kera akanyomba nigo karenge nobogare bw'ekerengo ki'amaboko atano na rimo, na obotambe bwaye boigo.

English: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo mfalme: Msikubali Hezekia awadanganye. Hawezi kuwaokoa!
Ekegusii: Aya naro omorwoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria.

English: Don't talk much with a foolish man, and don't go to one who has no understanding. Beware of him, lest you have trouble and be defiled in his onslaught. Turn away from him, and you will find rest, and you won't be wearied in his madness.
Kiswahili: Usiseme sana na mpumbavu, wala usimwendee mtu asiye na ufahamu. Jihadhari naye, usije ukapata shida na kujitia unajisi katika mashambulizi yake. Mgeukie, nawe utapata raha, wala hutachoka katika wazimu wake.
Ekegusii: Moreere oyo kure ekiage ere tari goikeera borabu bonde; naende moreere omonto omoriri ekiagera tari na semi. Tobaisa komoreera moono omonto okuure ekigera ere otimokire; korende moreere omonto omoriri, ekiagera obogima bwaye n'obobe kobwa amakweri.

English: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
Kiswahili: Basi wewe fundisha mambo haya. Onya na kukaripia kwa mamlaka yote. Mtu yeyote asikudharau.
Ekegusii: Kwana amang'ana aya, ase okobua gwonsi ore nakwo, kuurera, na gotogonyera abategereri bao. Tibwanchera omonto onde bwensi agochaaye.

English: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron's sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Atamchinja yule fahali mchanga mbele za Bwana, kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani wataleta damu na kuinyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu yaliyo penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria onyeenyete eeri eria ensae agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, barente amanyinga bayasiarere chinsemo chionsi chi'egesasiimero kere agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

English: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.” Witnessing to All Nations (Matthew 24:9–14; Mark 13:9–13)
Kiswahili: Lakini msikiapo habari za vita na machafuko, msiogope. Kwa maana hayo ni lazima yatokee kwanza, ila ule mwisho hautakuja wakati huo.”
Ekegusii: Na inwe ekero moraigwe amang’ana y’esegi na eburu‐buru, timogoswa, ekiagera aya bori nache kooroka ritang’ani, korende omoerio toraba ang’e.”

English: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
Kiswahili: Chagueni baadhi ya watu wenye hekima, wenye ufahamu na wanaoheshimika kutoka kila kabila lenu, nami nitawaweka juu yenu.”
Ekegusii: chora abanto abang’aini, abare abamanyi, abanto bamanyekanete buya korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbabeeke babe abataang’ani baino.

English: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who spoke to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Lakini Barnaba akamchukua, akampeleka kwa wale mitume. Akawaeleza jinsi Sauli akiwa njiani alivyomwona Bwana, jinsi Bwana alivyosema naye na jinsi alivyohubiri kwa ujasiri kwa jina la Yesu huko Dameski.
Ekegusii: Korende Barnaba akamobwata okoboko, akamoira ase abatomwa, akabateebereria buna Saulo aroche Omonene nchera, naende ng’a Omonene nakwanete nere, na buna arandetie noboremu ase Damesiki ase erieta ria Yeso.

English: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
Kiswahili: Nitatega sikio langu nisikilize mithali, nitafafanua kitendawili kwa zeze:
Ekegusii: Nintegerere amang’ana agokwanwa ase omoreng’anio, ning’orokie engencho yaye ’gokobugia obokano.

English: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath. And he too saved Israel, striking down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Ehudi akaja Shamgari mwana wa Anathi, aliyewapiga Wafilisti 600 kwa fimbo iliyochongoka ya kuongozea ngʼombe. Naye pia akawaokoa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Oyomobwatetie Ehudi ase obogaambi, nere Samugari, mosinto bw’Anati. Ere agaita Abafirisiti amagana atano na rimo n’enyimbo are gotemera chieri. Nere boigo akabatooria Abaisraeli.

English: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?
Kiswahili: “Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Je, ewe ndiwe wa kunijengea mimi nyumba ili nikae ndani yake?
Ekegusii: “Geenda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng'a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Inee! Nong'agaachere enyomba ndamenye imeo?

English: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home. The Death of Jesus (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:45–56; Mark 15:33–41; Luke 23:44–49)
Kiswahili: kisha akamwambia yule mwanafunzi, “Nawe huyo hapo ndiye mama yako.” Tangu wakati huo yule mwanafunzi akamchukua mama yake Yesu nyumbani kwake. Kifo Cha Yesu (Mathayo 27:45-56; Marko 15:33-41; Luka 23:44-49)
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio agateebia omworokigwa oria, “Rora nyoko!” Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye.

English: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, “What have we done? We have released Israel from serving us.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Misri alipoambiwa kuwa Waisraeli wamekimbia, Farao na maafisa wake wakabadili nia zao kuhusu Waisraeli, wakasema, “Tumefanya nini? Tumewaachia Waisraeli waende zao na tumeukosa utumishi wao!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ateebetigwe ng’a Abaisraeli batamire, ere amo nabasomba baye bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora, “Inki eke twakora? Tokaa Abaisraeli ribaga korua aa ase barenge gotokorera.”

English: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
Kiswahili: Siku za adhabu zinakuja, siku za malipo zimewadia. Israeli na afahamu hili. Kwa sababu dhambi zenu ni nyingi sana na uadui wenu ni mkubwa sana, nabii anadhaniwa ni mpumbavu, mtu aliyeongozwa na Mungu anaonekana mwendawazimu.
Ekegusii: Amatuko 'egesusuro aikire, ee, amatuko ay'ogoakanera ogokora kw'abaanto aikire. Abaisraeli mbamanye ayio. Omobani obeire omoriri, na omonto ore n'Omoika obeire ebarimo, ekiagera obobe bwaino bwabeire obonge, na okogecha kwaino kwabeire okonene.

English: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus. Doxology (Jude 1:24–25)
Kiswahili: Gayo, ambaye ni mwenyeji wangu na wa kanisa lote, anawasalimu. Erasto, mweka hazina wa mji huu, pamoja na Kwarto ndugu yetu pia wanawasalimu. [
Ekegusii: Gayo, oyokondoisia inche na ekanisa engima, baabakwanirie. Erasto, omogachi bwe chitaabu, chi’omochie, na Kwarito oyominto, baabakwanirie.

English: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
Kiswahili: Lakini niliwaambia ninyi, “Mtaimiliki nchi yao; nitawapa ninyi kuwa urithi, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali.” Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, ambaye amewatenga kutoka mataifa.
Ekegusii: Korende inabarierete inwe eira ng’a nimbae ense yabo ebe omwando oino, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaatananire inwe korwa ase ebisaku binde.

English: So Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
Kiswahili: Basi Isaki akawaandalia karamu, nao wakala na kunywa.
Ekegusii: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

English: And that is just what happened to him. The people trampled him in the gateway, and he died.
Kiswahili: Ndivyo hasa ilivyotokea kwake, kwa kuwa watu walimkanyaga langoni, naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Ayio agakoreka asare, na abanto igo bamotindacherete agwo ase egeita, agakwa.

English: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Moto ulio juu ya madhabahu lazima uwe unaendelea kuwaka, kamwe usizimike. Kila asubuhi kuhani ataongeza kuni na kupanga sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya moto, na kuteketeza mafuta ya sadaka za amani juu yake.
Ekegusii: Omorero ore ase egesasiimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka, torima. Kera emambia Omokuani ameente chinko ase omorero oyio, naende achooke buya ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa igoro ase chinko echio na asaambe ebitinya bi'ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe.

English: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka ya dhambi na kumchinjia mahali pa kuteketezea sadaka.
Ekegusii: Erio abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw'embori eria ekoruegwa ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na ayenyeenyere agwo ase ebing'wanso bi'ogosaambwa bikonyeenyerwa.

English: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Behold, I overheard your father saying to your brother Esau,
Kiswahili: Rebeka akamwambia Yakobo mwanawe, “Tazama, nimemsikia baba yako akimwambia ndugu yako Esau,
Ekegusii: Rebeka agateebia Yakobo, omwana oye: “Naigure iso ogoteebia momura omino Esau:

English: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na vita vinavyoendelea kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
Ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

English: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel and Judah, from Dan to Beersheba.”
Kiswahili: na kuuhamisha ufalme kutoka kwenye nyumba ya Sauli na kuimarisha kiti cha ufalme cha Daudi juu ya Israeli na Yuda kuanzia Dani mpaka Beer-Sheba.”
Ekegusii: Arusie oborwoti korwa ase enyomba ya Saulo, abobeeke ase Daudi, na Daudi abe omorwoti, agaambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.”

English: In Jerusalem, then, Jeremiah the prophet relayed all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah
Kiswahili: Ndipo nabii Yeremia akamwambia Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda mambo haya yote huko Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Erio Yeremia omobani agateebia Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda amang’ana ayio onsi agwo Yerusalemu,

English: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa unaandika mambo machungu dhidi yangu na kunifanya nizirithi dhambi za ujana wangu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang'ana 'obororo, naende kwang'akanire amabe 'obosae bwane.

English: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;
Kiswahili: Unao wafanyakazi wengi: Wachonga mawe, waashi na maseremala, pamoja na watu walio na ustadi katika kila kazi
Ekegusii: Nigo obwate abakori emeremo abange: abaabaachi amagena, na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, na abanto bamanyete gokora emeremo ende yonsi

English: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”
Kiswahili: na baada ya kuangamizwa mbele yenu, mwe waangalifu msijiingize katika tanzi kwa kuuliza habari za miungu yao, mkisema, “Je, mataifa haya hutumikiaje miungu yao? Nasi tutafanya vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: mwerende timobaisa gotegwa n'emeeto na kobwatia chingeencho chiabo banarete gokora. Timorigia komanya igoro ye'chinyasae chiabo na koboria: Naki ebisaku ebi biarenge gosasiima chinyasae chiabo? Naboigo naintwe tochisasiime.

English: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu yuko mbinguni, naye hufanya lolote limpendezalo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oito niigoro are, naende nigo agokora rinde rionsi aganetie.

English: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels.
Kiswahili: Sahani kumi na mbili za dhahabu zilizojazwa uvumba zilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli kumi kila moja, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu. Kwa jumla, sahani za dhahabu zilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli 120.
Ekegusii: Na ebitaabo biria ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu biichire na ubani, nigo biarenge kera ekemo n’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi koreng’ana nekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Oborito bwe chitaabu chi’ebinto ebio bionsi nigo bwarenge chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo ebere.

English: The king took the ring which he had taken away from Haman and gave it to Mordecai. Esther appointed Mordecai over all that had been Haman's.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akatwaa pete aliyoivua Hamani, akampa Mordekai. Esta akamweka Mordekai juu ya mali yote ya Hamani.
Ekegusii: Bono omorwoti akarusia ebonyi eria amoete Hamani, akayea Modekai, na Esiteri akabeeka Modekai atenenere enyomba eria yarenge ya Hamani.

English: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”'
Kiswahili: Ulisema, ‘Ole wangu! Bwana ameongeza huzuni juu ya maumivu yangu, nimechoka kwa kulia kwa uchungu wala sipati pumziko.' ”
Ekegusii: Nigo gwakwanete ng'a obobe nobwao, ekiagera Omonene omentire omoichano ase obororo bwao, naende ng'a kwarosire ase ogochandeka kwao, gose tori nogotimoka.

English: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
Kiswahili: Sauli alipofika Yerusalemu akajaribu kujiunga na wanafunzi lakini wote walimwogopa, kwa maana hawakuamini kwamba kweli naye alikuwa mwanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goika Yerusalemu agateema kobwatana naborokigwa; na barabwo bonsi bakamoiroka, ekiagera tibanchete ng’a ere nomworokigwa arenge.

English: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni neno hili, ninyi ngʼombe wa Bashani mlioko juu ya Mlima Samaria, ninyi wanawake mnaowaonea maskini, na kuwagandamiza wahitaji, na kuwaambia wanaume wenu, “Tuleteeni vinywaji!”
Ekegusii: Igwa ring'ana eri inwe chiombe chia Basani, inwe abamomenyete ase Egetunwa gia Samaria, inwe abamochandete abataka na gokorera abaremeire bobe, inwe abamogotebia abasacha baino: “Torentere egento tonywe!”

English: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwomba Mungu kwa ajili ya mtoto. Akafunga na akaingia ndani ya nyumba yake akawa siku zote analala sakafuni usiku kucha.
Ekegusii: Agwo Daudi agasaba Nyasae ng'a omwana agwene, akeng'ata, akageenda nyomba akaraara inse ase obotuko obogima.

English: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake Wafilisti walipokuja kuwavua maiti silaha, walimkuta Sauli na wanawe wameanguka katika Mlima Gilboa.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero Abafirisiti bachete konuura ebinto korwa ase emebere y'abanto bakwete, bakanyora Saulo amo nabamura baye bakwete agwo ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.

English: When Esther’s maidens and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, the queen was overcome with distress. She sent clothes for Mordecai to wear instead of his sackcloth, but he would not accept them.
Kiswahili: Wajakazi wa Esta na matowashi walipokuja na kumwambia kuhusu Mordekai, alipatwa na huzuni kuu. Alimtumia nguo avae badala ya nguo za magunia, lakini Mordekai hakuzikubali.
Ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke abasomba b’Esiteri na abakoreri b’enyomba yaye bamotebeetie amang’ana igoro ya Moredekai, eke agendererete gokora, Esiteri agaichana akaba nobororo obonge; agatomera Moredekai chianga ng’a arusie chigunia abeeke chianga chiria, korende ere agachiaanga.

English: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa pamoja nawe popote ulipokwenda, nami nimekuondolea mbali adui zako wote mbele yako. Basi nitalifanya jina lako kuwa kuu kama majina ya watu walio wakuu sana duniani.
Ekegusii: Nigo n'are kogeenda amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogeenda na kobaseeria gochia aare ababisa bao korwa ase obosio bwao. Ninkore erieta ria'o ribe rinene, buna amarieta y'abanto bande bare abanene ase ense.

English: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Basi siku hiyo Yesu alipotengeneza tope na kuyafungua macho ya huyo mtu ilikuwa Sabato.
Ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Esabato ekero Yeso akorete etintira na komoramokia amaiso.

English: Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliwasikia wakati mlipozungumza nami, na Bwana akaniambia, “Nimesikia kile hawa watu walichokuambia. Kila kitu walichokisema ni kizuri.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo aigwete amang'ana aino ekero keria mware gokwana nainche, erio aganteebia: Naiguure amang'ana abanto abwo bakwanire naye. Ayio onsi bagoteebirie, mbuya bakwanire.

English: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia maneno haya, alishangazwa naye sana. Akaugeukia ule umati wa watu uliokuwa unamfuata, akawaambia, “Sijaona imani kubwa namna hii hata katika Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, agakumia asare, akeonchorera omoganda orenge komotunyana, akabora, “Nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.”

English: “Good,” said Saul to his servant. “Come, let us go.” So they set out for the city where the man of God was.
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Vyema, njoo na twende.” Basi wakaenda mjini alipokuwepo huyo mtu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Saulo agateebia omosomba oye: “gwateebire buya; inchwo togende.” Ase igo bakagenda ase omochie ase omonto oyio o Nyasae areenge.

English: And all the women of Israel ran together to see her; and they blessed her, and made a dance among them for her. She took branches in her hand, and distributed them to the women who were with her.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wote wa Israeli wakakimbia pamoja ili kumwona; wakambariki, wakamchezea. Akachukua matawi mkononi mwake, akawagawia wanawake waliokuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Abakungu ba Israeli bonsi bagaacha komorora Yuditi; bakamoteerera amateera yokomotogia na abande bakamobugeria chikonu. Erio Yuditi akaimokia amato na kobagabera bonsi abamobwatetie.

English: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akatoka nje kuwalaki na akawaambia, “Kama mmekuja kwangu kwa amani, kunisaidia, mimi niko tayari kuwaruhusu ninyi kuungana nami. Lakini kama mmekuja ili kunisaliti kwa adui zangu wakati mimi mikono yangu haina hatia, basi Mungu wa baba zetu aone na awahukumu.”
Ekegusii: Daudi agasoka kobarotota akabateebia, “Onye igo mwachire buna abasani baane monkonye, rirorio enkoro yane nebwatane nainwe, korende onye nigo mwachire monsigane na kondua ase ababisa baane, nonya amaboko aane takorete okomocha konde gwonsi, rirorio Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito arore amang'ana ayio abae egesusuro.”

English: Then the Spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be transformed into a different person.
Kiswahili: Roho wa Bwana atakuja juu yako kwa nguvu, nawe utatoa unabii pamoja nao; nawe utageuzwa kuwa mtu wa tofauti.
Ekegusii: Erio Omoika bw’Omonene noche igoro yao ne chinguru; naye nobaane amo nabarabwo, na oonchorwe obe kore ne chingencho ching’ao.

English: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
Kiswahili: Ulisema, “Nimefanya agano na mteule wangu, nimemwapia mtumishi wangu Daudi,
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwateebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y'ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.

English: Yahweh's hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh's Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yangu, naye akanitoa nje kwa Roho wa Bwana na kuniweka katikati ya bonde lililokuwa limejaa mifupa tele.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw'Omonene kogaacha igoro y'ane, na Omoika bw'Omonene akang'ira akambeka ase egati ye rikura riaichire amauga.

English: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Adoni-Bezeki akasema, “Nimewatendea wafalme sabini kama nilivyotendewa na kuwalisha makombo ya chakula chini ya meza yangu. Sasa Mungu amenilipa haya, kama yale niliyowatendea.” Wakamleta Yerusalemu, naye akafa huko.
Ekegusii: Erio Adon‐Bezeki agateeba, “'Nababerete Abarwoti emerongo etano n'ebere, abwo ebiara biabo ebinene bi'amaboko n'ebi'amagoro bianachetwe, barenge gochoora amatori korwa nyaaro y'emesa yane. Na bono Nyasae ong'iraneirie egesiomba buna inche nabakorerete barabwo.” Erio akarentwa Yerusalemu, agakwera aroro.

English: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
Kiswahili: Samweli akawaeleza watu madaraka ya ufalme. Akayaandika kwenye kitabu na kuweka mbele za Bwana. Kisha Samweli akawaruhusu watu, kila mmoja aende nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli agateebia Abanto buna oborwoti bogwenerete kogaambwa, na akariika emeroberio eyio ase egetabu akayebeeka ase obosio bw'Omonene. Magega yayio Samweli akaa Abanto ribaga, kera oyomo agende inka bwoye.

English: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
Kiswahili: Ninyi vipofu wapumbavu! Ni kipi kilicho kikuu zaidi: ni ile dhahabu, au ni lile Hekalu linaloifanya hiyo dhahabu kuwa takatifu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkereki kere ekenene kobua: netaabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etaabu ebe enchenu?

English: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwako kuna msamaha, kwa hiyo wewe unaogopwa.
Ekegusii: Korende aye nigo ore omwaberi, erinde onyaare koirokwa.

English: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
Kiswahili: Nao wakawa wameogopa sana, wakaulizana, “Ni nani huyu ambaye hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii?”
Ekegusii: Bagasogwa nomoondoko omonene, bagateebania, “Oyo ning’o rende, goika nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”

English: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
Kiswahili: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita, na haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.
Ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, na amarieta abo naro aya: Asirikamu, na Bokeru, na Isumaeli, na Searia, na Obadia, na Hanani. Aba nabwo abana abamura b’Aseli.

English: And everyone whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its services, and for the holy garments.
Kiswahili: na kila mmoja aliyependa na ambaye moyo wake ulimsukuma alikuja na kuleta sadaka kwa Bwana, kwa ajili ya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania, kwa ajili ya huduma yake yote na kwa ajili ya mavazi matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naende bakairana kera oyomo buna enkoro yaye yamosugetie, na buna anchete ere omonyene, bakarentera Omonene ebiegwa biabo ase okoroisia Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebinto bionsi ebiaganeirie, ase emeremo eria na ase chianga chiria chinchenu.

English: And he turned away from them and wept. When he turned back and spoke to them, he took Simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes. Joseph’s Brothers Return to Canaan
Kiswahili: Yosefu akajitenga nao akaanza kulia, kisha akawarudia na kuzungumza nao tena. Akataka Simeoni akamatwe na kufungwa mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Erio akarua ase bare, akagenda ensemo, akarera amariga; naende akairana, agakwana nabarabwo. Akarusia Simioni korwa ase bare, akamosiba korwa ase amasio abo.

English: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD, he must not go near a dead body.
Kiswahili: Kwa kipindi chochote cha kujitenga kwa ajili ya Bwana hatakaribia maiti.
Ekegusii: Tageenda aike ang’e negetondo ase amatuko ayio onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa Omonene.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Reubeni ilikuwa watu 46,500.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano nemo, n'amagana atano (46,500).

English: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
Kiswahili: Akipiga chafya mwanga humetameta; macho yake ni kama mionzi ya mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Ekero egwasimora, chinsase nigo chigosoka chiamoreka, amaiso aye nigo anga buna amasase agosakia mambia.

English: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.
Kiswahili: Mara mfalme aliporudi kutoka bustani ya jumba la kifalme na kuja kwenye ukumbi wa karamu, Hamani alikuwa akijitupa juu ya kiti mahali ambapo Esta alikuwa akiegemea. Mfalme akasema kwa nguvu, “Je, atamdhalilisha malkia hata huku nyumbani akiwa pamoja nami!” Mara neno lilipotoka kinywani mwa mfalme, walifunika uso wa Hamani.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti airanete korwa ase egeticha aria isiko gochia ase enyomba eria ase barenge konywera edivai, Hamani nigo araire inse oumaime ase egeikaransero gi'Esiteri. Omorwoti akaboria, “Inee! Nigo aganetie gokorera eting'ana obonyaka ase obosio bwane aa nyomba mwane ime?” Na ekero ring'ana riasogete korwa ase omonwa bw'omorwoti, abasomba bagatuba Hamani obosio.

English: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
Kiswahili: Mbingu na dunia zimsifu, bahari na vyote viendavyo ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Tiga igoro na ense chitogie Omonene, naboigo na enyancha, na ebitongwa bionsi bire imeo.

English: A poor man toils in lack of substance. When he rests, he becomes needy.
Kiswahili: Maskini hujitahidi kwa kukosa vitu vya kimwili. Anapopumzika, anakuwa mhitaji.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka boigo nigo agokora emeremo n'ebigeri korende ebitoki biaye biagenderera gokea, ekero ere agotimoka, onyora tabwati kende agwetogeria.

English: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nchi ikawa na amani kwa muda wa miaka arobaini, mpaka Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi alipofariki.
Ekegusii: Bono ense eria ekaba n'omorembe ase engaki y'emiaka emerongo ene. Erio Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, agakwa.

English: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
Kiswahili: Miguu yao ilikuwa imenyooka, nyayo za miguu yao zilikuwa kama kwato za miguu ya ndama, nazo zilimetameta kama shaba iliyosuguliwa.
Ekegusii: Amagoro abo nigo arongeete, na ebisanyi bi’amagoro abo nigo biagwekaine ebi’emori. Ebitongwa ebio nigo biarenge komeka‐meka buna etai ekomeka‐meka.
