English: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Yefta akawa mwamuzi wa Waisraeli kwa muda wa miaka sita. Basi Yefta akafa, akazikwa katika mmojawapo wa miji ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Yefta akagaambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y'emiaka etano nomo. Erio Yefta, Omogileadi, agakwa, agatindekwa ase omochie oye agwo Gileadi.

English: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Ikiwa utakwenda katika njia zangu na kushika masharti yangu, basi utaitawala nyumba yangu na kuwa na amri juu ya nyua zangu, nami nitakupa nafasi miongoni mwa hawa wasimamao hapa.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, na obwate aya nagochikeire, rirorio nogambere enyomba yane, na orende chiraaro chiane. Ninkoe ribaga ogochera ase 'nde amo nabwo bagonkorera aiga.

English: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn't be caused to stumble.
Kiswahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya yote ili msije mkaiacha imani.
Ekegusii: “Amang'ana aya nabateebirie timocha kogochwa.

English: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa yawekeni mbali nanyi mambo kama haya yote: yaani hasira, ghadhabu, uovu, masingizio na lugha chafu kutoka midomoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende bono mobeke aare aya onsi: endamwamu, okobea, obobe, okorama, na ogokwana okobe gokorwa ase emenwa yaino.

English: Then Hezekiah humbled the pride of his heart—he and the people of Jerusalem—so that the wrath of the LORD did not come upon them during the days of Hezekiah.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Hezekia akatubu kwa ajili ya kiburi cha moyo wake, kama walivyofanya watu wa Yerusalemu, kwa hiyo ghadhabu ya Bwana haikuja juu yao katika siku za Hezekia.
Ekegusii: Hezekia agekeyia, ageitia ase engencho y’oboenenu bw’enkoro yaye, na abanto ba Yerusalemu nabarabwo bagekeyia. Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene tiyacha igoro ase bare ase amatuko a Hezekia. Obotenenku bwa Hezekia na obonene bwaye

English: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akajibu: “Andika ufunuo huu, na ukaufanye wazi juu ya vibao, ili mpiga mbiu akimbie nao.
Ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, aganteebia, “Riika okorora okwo ase ebao namariko amaya, erinde oyo okoyasoma ayasome buya.

English: for he knew that troubles had come upon him all at once, and that his forces had deserted him.
Kiswahili: kwani alijua kwamba matatizo yalikuwa yamempata mara moja, na kwamba majeshi yake yalikuwa yamemwacha.
Ekegusii: Ere konye omanyire buna amang'ana amobereire bobe, ase engencho abasikari baye bonsi konye bamotigire.

English: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa wingu lilikaa juu ya Maskani kwa siku mbili au mwezi au mwaka, Waisraeli wangebaki wamepiga kambi na hawakuondoka; lakini lilipoinuka, wangeondoka.
Ekegusii: Onye riire riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko abere, gose omotienyi oyomo, gose engaki entambe, Abaisraeli nigo barenge kobeera ase egetwori, tibarenge komanora kogeenda, korende ekero riire riaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo.

English: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mkate wa Mungu ni yule ashukaye kutoka mbinguni na kuupa ulimwengu uzima.”
Ekegusii: Naki omogati o Nyasae noria ogoika korwa igoro na koa ense obogima.”

English: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
Kiswahili: Wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyeokwa,
Ekegusii: Bakamoa egesamunye gi'enswe gesambire na obooke boke.

English: Then I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy with its terms and conditions, as well as the open copy—
Kiswahili: Nikachukua ile hati ya kununulia, nakala iliyotiwa muhuri yenye makubaliano na masharti, pia pamoja na ile nakala isiyo na muhuri,
Ekegusii: Nkabogoria okobwatana koria gw’okogora omogondo komumekire, korikire emeroberio na amang’ana achiikire, amo nokonde kogwekaine koria, korende gotamumekeirie.

English: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
Kiswahili: kama unajua mapenzi ya Mungu na kukubali lililo bora kwa sababu umefundishwa na hiyo sheria,
Ekegusii: Kwamanyire ogwancha kwaye, naende nomanyete buya amang'ana ayare amaya, ekiagera kworokererigwe amachiiko.

English: Don't move the ancient boundary stone. Don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
Kiswahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani wala kunyemelea kwenye mashamba ya yatima,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro, gose totumana osoe ase emegondo ye chintakana,

English: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
Kiswahili: Lakini neno hili la Mungu likamjia Shemaya mtu wa Mungu:
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rigacha ase Semaya, omonto o Nyasae,

English: “Do not be afraid,” Elisha answered, “for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
Kiswahili: Nabii akajibu, “Usiogope. Wale walio pamoja nasi ni wengi zaidi kuliko wale walio pamoja nao.”
Ekegusii: Elisha agateebia omosomba oye: “Tibwoboa, ekiagera abwo bare amo naintwe nigo bare abange goetania baria bare nabarabwo.”

English: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
Kiswahili: fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja na mwana-kondoo dume mmoja wa mwaka mmoja, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa;
Ekegusii: Boigo akarua eeri ensae, emingichi eyemo, na emanwa emingichi eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo, chikaba ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa,

English: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Hammoth-dor, and Kartan—three cities, together with their pasturelands.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Naftali walipewa, Kedeshi katika Galilaya (mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa mauaji), Hamoth-Dori na Kartani, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji mitano.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi o Galili, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Hamoti‐Dori, na Karitani, emechie etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba mtu yeyote asiweze kununua wala kuuza isipokuwa amekuwa na hiyo chapa, ambayo ni jina la huyo mnyama au tarakimu za jina lake.
Ekegusii: erinde monto onde bwensi tagora gose koonia otatiga ere oyore nekemanyererio keria, engencho yaye erieta ri'eng'iti eria gose chinamba chi'erieta riaye.

English: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
Kiswahili: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuvitaka, lakini umefungua masikio yangu; sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za dhambi hukuzihitaji.
Ekegusii: Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tobiganeti, korende amato aane kwayatinoire. Ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe tobiganeti.

English: So all who resolve to go to Egypt to reside there will die by sword and famine and plague. Not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring upon them.’
Kiswahili: Naam, wote waliokusudia kwenda kuishi Misri watakufa kwa upanga, njaa na tauni; hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayenusurika au kuokoka maafa nitakayoyaleta juu yao.’
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abwo bamanoire kogenda Misiri komenya aroro goika baitwe nemioro na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita. Onde tari oranyare gotigara tanyorwa nobobe obwo inche ngochia korenta igoro ase bare.”

English: It is good to conceal the secret of a king, but to reveal gloriously the works of God. Do good, and evil won't find you.
Kiswahili: Ni vizuri kuficha siri ya mfalme, lakini kufichua kwa utukufu kazi za Mungu. Tenda mema, na uovu hautakupata.
Ekegusii: Negwenerete korenda obobisi bw' omorwoti, korende amakorwa a Nyasae goika ararigwe kera ase buna egwenerete. Kora amaya nainwe timokonyora bobe bonde.

English: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila roho ambayo haimkubali Yesu haitoki kwa Mungu. Hii ndiyo roho ya mpinga Kristo, ambayo mmesikia kwamba inakuja na sasa tayari iko ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: korende kera omoika otakoorokia Yeso igo, oyio tori oyo o Nyasae. Oyio noro omoika bw’omobisa o Kristo; oyio mwaigure ng’a ngocha are, na bono oikire gocha ase ense ime.

English: But if my father intends to bring evil on you, then may the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if I do not tell you and send you on your way in safety. May the LORD be with you, just as He has been with my father.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa baba yangu amenuia kukudhuru, Bwana na anishughulikie kwa ukali, iwapo sitakufahamisha na kukuaga uende salama. Bwana na awe pamoja nawe kama alivyokuwa pamoja na baba yangu.
Ekegusii: Konye tata bwerure kogokorera bobe, rirori’Omonene ang’e inche Yonathani egesusuro onye tinkogoteebia okogania gwa tata, na ngotige otame na bwetoorie. Omonene abe amo naye buna arenge na tata

English: “What is this you have done to us?” asked Abimelech. “One of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abimeleki akamjibu, “Ni nini hiki ulichotufanyia? Ingewezekana mtu yeyote akawa amekutana kimwili na mke wako, nawe ungeleta hatia juu yetu.”
Ekegusii: Abimeleki akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Aande monto onde oito areenge gochia araare na mokao, na aye anga nigo gwatobeka ase okomocha.”

English: Did not Hezekiah himself remove His high places and His altars and say to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before one altar, and on it you shall burn sacrifices’?
Kiswahili: Je, si Hezekia mwenyewe aliyeondoa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu pamoja na madhabahu zake, akiwaambia Yuda wa Yerusalemu, ‘Ni lazima mwabudu mbele ya madhabahu moja na kuteketeza dhabihu juu yake’?
Ekegusii: Inee! Hezekia oyo tari ere oria osaririe aase aimokererete igoro agwo ase Omonene agosasimerwa, amo nebisasimero biaye? Naende ere agachiika Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, ogoteeba: Bosio bw’egesasiimero ekemo nao morasasimere, na igoro ase kerokio mobe mokorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa.

English: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
Kiswahili: “Mji wowote au kijiji chochote mtakapoingia, tafuteni humo mtu anayestahili, nanyi kaeni kwake mpaka mtakapoondoka.
Ekegusii: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na ase ekenyoro gionsi, morigie ning'o ogwenerete aroro, mobeere nere goika moruo.

English: Then Daniel laughed, and said, “O king, don't be deceived; for this is just clay inside, and brass outside, and never ate or drank anything.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Danieli akacheka, akasema, "Ee mfalme, usidanganyike; maana hii ni udongo tu ndani, na shaba nje, wala haijawahi kula wala kunywa chochote."
Ekegusii: Danieli agaseka erio akamoiraneria omorwoti: “Tong'aineka; ime yomogwekano oyio namaroba oka na isiko nechuma, ere tanakoria gose konywa gento kende gionsi.”

English: “This month is the beginning of months for you; it shall be the first month of your year.
Kiswahili: “Mwezi huu utakuwa mwanzo wa miezi kwenu, yaani mwezi wa kwanza wa mwaka wenu.
Ekegusii: “Omotienyi oyo nobe oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, oyo bw’ogochaka emetienyi yo omwaka.

English: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
Kiswahili: “Akawajibu, ‘Nawaambia kwamba kila aliye na kitu, ataongezewa. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie: Kera oyore negento naegwe, korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.

English: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
Kiswahili: Basi Obadia akaenda kukutana na Ahabu na kumwambia, naye Ahabu akaenda kukutana na Eliya.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Obadia akagenda, agateebia Ahabu amang'ana ayio; erio Ahabu akagenda korotota Elija.

English: Mordecai went out robed in royal apparel, wearing a golden crown and a diadem of fine purple linen. The people in Susa saw it and rejoiced.
Kiswahili: Mordekai alitoka nje akiwa amevaa mavazi ya kifalme, amevaa taji ya dhahabu na taji ya kitani safi ya zambarau. Watu wa Susa waliona hayo wakafurahi.
Ekegusii: Tibaisanegeti n'egesururo korwa ase enkoro ya mwanyabaanto, korende nigo bakogokigwa n'abanto abwo bagwakanwa ase amaya, batamanyeti ng'a onsi nigo are ase amaiso a Nyasae, nigo bakagerete ng'a mbetange korwa ase endamwamu yaye y'ogokumia gochia ase abanyabibe.

English: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
Kiswahili: Mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa baba yake na uchungu kwa yeye aliyemzaa.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo agoichania ise, naende nigo akorenta obororo ase ng'ina oy'omoiborete.

English: I will instruct you in the power of God. I will not conceal the ways of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Nitawafundisha juu ya uweza wa Mungu; njia za Mwenyezi sitazificha.
Ekegusii: Nimborokererie igoro y’okobua kwa Nyasae; amang’ana onsi igoro y’Omonguru tinkoyabisa.

English: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
Kiswahili: Hakika uovu huwaka kama moto; huteketeza michongoma na miiba, huwasha moto vichaka vya msituni, hujiviringisha kuelekea juu kama nguzo ya moshi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nigo bogosamba buna omorero; noro nigo ogosamba amageri na amagwa, nigo ogosamba rinani rinoru, riaerera ase erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.

English: and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayegusa kitanda chake ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakune ebiraarero bi’omokuungu oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: Keep a strict watch over a headstrong daughter, lest she make you a laughingstock to your enemies, a byword in the city and notorious among the people, and shame you in public.
Kiswahili: Mlinde sana binti mkaidi, asije akakufanya kuwa kichekesho kwa adui zako, dharau mjini na sifa mbaya miongoni mwa watu, na kukuaibisha hadharani.
Ekegusii: Omorende mono omoiseke omoenenu, onye taribo ere nagere osekererwe na ababisa bao, aye obe gokogambwa na oyore nerieta ribe ase abanto, akorentere obosooku ase risango riabaanto.

English: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
Kiswahili: Hata leo Sheria ya Mose inaposomwa, utaji hufunika mioyo yao.
Ekegusii: Nonya ndero ekero amachiiko a Musa agosomwa, egietubo keria ngetubete ase chinkoro chiabo.

English: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
Kiswahili: “Nao watatoka nje na kuona maiti za wale walioniasi mimi. Funza wao hawatakufa, wala moto wao hautazimika, nao watakuwa kitu cha kuchukiza sana kwa wanadamu wote.”
Ekegusii: Ekero barasoke isiko mbarore emebere ekwete y’abanto abwo basaretie korwa ase ’nde inche Omonene. Amakonde arabe akoria emebere yabo tagokwa, na omorero orabe okobasamba tokorima. Abwo bakwete mbabe okogechia okobe ase abanto bonsi.”

English: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
Kiswahili: yeye ambaye huumba mioyo yao wote, ambaye huangalia kila kitu wanachokitenda.
Ekegusii: Nere otongete chinkoro chi'abaanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.

English: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
Kiswahili: Petro akamshika mkono akamwinua, ndipo akawaita wale watakatifu na wajane akamkabidhi kwao akiwa hai.
Ekegusii: Petero akamoa okoboko kwaye, akamoimokia. Erio akarangeria abachenu baria na ababoraka, akamorenta ase bare ore moyo.

English: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka ishirini na tisa. Mama yake aliitwa Abiya binti Zekaria.
Ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagaamba emiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng'ina nigo arenge korokwa Abia, mosubati o Zakaria.

English: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msile nyama yao wala kugusa mizoga yao; wao ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Timoria chinyama chie ching'iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.

English: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
Kiswahili: Wataiadhimisha wakati wa kuzama jua siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa pili. Watamla mwana-kondoo, pamoja na mkate usiotiwa chachu, na mboga chungu.
Ekegusii: nigo ararirende ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, chinsa chia mogoroba ase omotienyi o kabere. Narie emanwa y'eng'ondi y'Epasaka amo n'emagaati etabekiri ememera, ne chinyeni chindoro.

English: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
Kiswahili: dhambi hii itakuwa kwenu kama ukuta mrefu, wenye ufa na wenye kubetuka, ambao unaanguka ghafula, mara moja.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, okomocha oko kw'ebibe nkobe ase more buna obotandoku bore ase orwaki orotambe rwekumbire, rore ang'e kogwa, na okogwa kwaye nigo korache bwango mobosokano.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo Israeli hawakuwa na mfalme, kila mmoja akafanya kama alivyoona vyema machoni pake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria omorwoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi arooche kere ekeronge aase okorora kwaye ere omonyene.

English: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
Kiswahili: Je, Abrahamu baba yetu hakuhesabiwa haki kwa kile alichotenda, alipomtoa mwanawe Isaki madhabahuni?
Ekegusii: Inee! Sokoro yaito Aburaamu taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aruete Isaka, omwana oye, igoro ase egesasiimero?

English: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
Kiswahili: Utakuwa na wana na binti lakini hawatakuwa nawe, kwa sababu watachukuliwa mateka.
Ekegusii: Nigo moraibore abana, abamura na abaiseke, korende tibakoba abaino, mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.

English: It is I who made the earth and created man upon it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndiye niliyeumba dunia na kumuumba mwanadamu juu yake. Mikono yangu mwenyewe ndiyo iliyozitanda mbingu, nikayapanga majeshi yake yote ya angani.
Ekegusii: Ninche natongete ense, ngatonga na abanto, nkababeeka aroro; amaboko aane naro aramborete igoro, erio ngachiika erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, kera ekemo kebeere aase aye.

English: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu ni mwenye rehema na anayesamehe, hata ingawa tumefanya uasi dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae oito, nigo obwate amaabera, naende nigo ogotwabera, nonya twasaririe ase ore.

English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, lakini wale walio wagonjwa ndio wanaohitaji tabibu.
Ekegusii: Agachia koyaigwa, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.

English: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
Kiswahili: basi adui anifuatie na kunipata, auponde uhai wangu ardhini na kunilaza mavumbini.
Ekegusii: rirorio tiga omobisa one ambwatie na kombwata, erio antiringere inse egere asirie obogima bwane, erio ansarerie amasikani.

English: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa tano akaipiga tarumbeta yake, nami nikaona nyota iliyokuwa imeanguka toka angani hadi ardhini. Nyota hiyo ilipewa ufunguo wa lile Shimo.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano akabugia egetureeri kiaye. Erio nkarora eng’enang’eni konya yagure korwa igoro gocha ase ense. Eng’enang’eni eria ekaegwa ekeigorero gi’ekeronga ki’eora y’abakuure.

English: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
Kiswahili: Siutumaini upinde wangu, upanga wangu hauniletei ushindi;
Ekegusii: Inche tinsemeretie obota bwane; gose omoro one tong’a obobui.

English: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, sasa toboa kwenye ukuta huu.” Ndipo nikatoboa ule ukuta, nikaona hapo pana mlango.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bochora enyasi eyio.” Ekero nabochorete gochia ime, 'nkarora egesieri.

English: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka penye miamba, nazo zilipoota, hiyo mimea ikakauka kwa kukosa unyevu.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikooma ase okomocha amaache.

English: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?
Kiswahili: Ni nani atengenezaye mungu na kusubu sanamu, ambayo haiwezi kumfaidia kitu chochote?
Ekegusii: Ning'o okwebaachera enyasae na kwebombera ogosasimwa bitari gokonya nonyang'ake?

English: After a long time, in the third year of the drought, the word of the LORD came to Elijah: “Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the face of the earth.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda mrefu, katika mwaka wa tatu, neno la Bwana likamjia Eliya kusema, “Nenda ukajionyeshe kwa Ahabu na mimi nitanyesha mvua juu ya nchi.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amange kaerire, ase omwaka o gatato, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija rikamoteebia: “Genda bweorokie ase Ahabu, na inche nintome embura etwe igoro ase ense.”

English: including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh. But the troops did not know that Jonathan had left.
Kiswahili: miongoni mwao alikuwepo Ahiya, ambaye alikuwa amevaa kisibau. Alikuwa mwana wa Ikabodi, nduguye Ahitubu mwana wa Finehasi, mwana wa Eli, kuhani wa Bwana huko Shilo. Hakuna yeyote aliyekuwa na habari kwamba Yonathani alikuwa ameondoka.
Ekegusii: Oyo orenge kobogoria egesibao ki’obokuani nere Ahia, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, momura omwabo Ikabodi. Ahitubu nere orenge mosinto o Finehasi o Eli, Omokuani Omonene agwo Silo. Abanto tibamanyete ng’a Yonathani konya ochiire.

English: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
Kiswahili: Nimesulubiwa pamoja na Kristo, wala si mimi tena ninayeishi, bali Kristo ndiye aishiye ndani yangu. Uhai nilio nao sasa katika mwili, ninaishi kwa imani ya Mwana wa Mungu, aliyenipenda na kujitoa kwa ajili yangu.
Ekegusii: gose bono tari inche inde moyo, korende Kristo nigo are moyo ime ase 'nde; na obogima inde naborobwo bono ase omobere, nigo inde naborobwo ase okomwegena Omwana o Nyasae, oyonyanchete, naende bweruete omonyene ase engencho yane.

English: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly. Sharing among Believers (Acts 2:42–47)
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuomba, mahali walipokuwa wamekutanika pakatikiswa, wote wakajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakanena neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri. Walioamini Washirikiana Mali Zao
Ekegusii: Ekero barabwo bakorete gosaba ase agwo barabwo basangerekanete agatengechigwa. Barobwo bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu na boigo bagachaaka gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae noboremu. Abegeeni bagosanga ebire ebiabo

English: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
Kiswahili: zikiwa na ndimi mbili zilizo sambamba kila mmoja na mwingine. Tengeneza mihimili yote ya maskani jinsi hii.
Ekegusii: Okore chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwatanerigwe. Naboigo oranyare koroisia chibao chionsi chi’Obomenyo.

English: But the people pleaded, “You must not go out! For if we have to flee, they will pay no attention to us. Even if half of us die, they will not care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It is better for now if you support us from the city.”
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wakasema, “Haikupasi kwenda, ikiwa sisi tutalazimika kukimbia, wao hawatatujali. Hata kama nusu yetu tukifa hawatajali, lakini wewe una thamani ya watu kama sisi kumi elfu. Ingekuwa bora zaidi kwako basi kutupatia msaada kutoka mjini.”
Ekegusii: Korende abanto bakamoiraneria, “Aye tobaisa kogeenda amo naintwe. Inaki gatoratame, barabwo tibagotoraara. Nonya abanto baito nabaisa goitwa ekeng’ese ki’omobaro, tibagotoraara. Aye nigo ore bw’engeencho enene ase tore kobua abanto baito chilifu ikomi. Ase ayio nigo erabe buya obeere ase omochie na gotokoonya korwa aroro.”

English: Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants?
Kiswahili: Je, wafanyabiashara watabadilishana bidhaa kwa ajili yake? Watamgawanya miongoni mwa wafanyao biashara?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeonerania?

English: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akashuka katika wingu na kunena na Mose, naye akachukua sehemu ya Roho iliyokuwa juu ya Mose na kuiweka juu ya wale wazee sabini. Roho aliposhuka juu yao, wakatoa unabii, lakini hawakufanya hivyo tena.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore riire ime, agakwana na Musa, na akaa abagaaka baria emerongo etan'ebere korwa ase omoika oria oria orenge ime ase Musa. Ekero omoika oria obete igoro ase bare barabwo bakabana, korende tibagenderera gokora igo naende nonya ndinde.

English: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo utakavyoitengeneza: Safina iwe na urefu wa dhiraa 300, upana wake dhiraa hamsini na kimo chake dhiraa thelathini.
Ekegusii: Obwato obwo nigo oraboroisie iga: Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obw'ebirengo bi'amaboko amagana atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.

English: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus. A House Divided (Matthew 12:22–30; Luke 11:14–23)
Kiswahili: na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu. Yesu Na Beelzebuli (Mathayo 12:22-32; Luka 11:14-23; 12:10)
Ekegusii: na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyomoruete. Yeso na Beelizebuli (Mat 12:22-37; Luk 11:14-23; 12:10) Erio agasoa nyomba.

English: On the day you go out and cross the Kidron Valley, know for sure that you will die; your blood will be on your own head.”
Kiswahili: Siku utakayoondoka kuvuka Bonde la Kidroni, uwe na hakika utakufa; damu yako itakuwa juu ya kichwa chako mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero kende gionsi orasoke korwa aroro, bwamboke akarooche ga Kidironi, omanye ng’a goika okwe; okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao nigo korabe okwao.”

English: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and been driven by the demon into solitary places.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu alikuwa amemwamuru yule pepo mchafu amtoke huyo mtu. Mara nyingi huyo pepo mchafu alimpagaa, na hata alipofungwa kwa minyororo mikono na miguu na kuwekwa chini ya ulinzi, alikata hiyo minyororo na kupelekwa na huyo pepo mchafu kwenda nyikani.
Ekegusii: Naki konya ochikiire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)

English: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote wa kukutetea shauri lako, hakuna dawa ya kidonda chako, wewe hutapona.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari orabarwanerere. Eriogo ri'amaote aino tiriri, okogwenigwa tikori ase more.

English: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukawakemea na kuwaambia wanyamaze, lakini wao wakazidi kupaza sauti, wakisema, “Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie.”
Ekegusii: Omoganda oria okabatogonyera ng’a banyare gokira, korende bakamenta kwoga mono, bakaboora, “Omonene, tororere amaabera, aye Omwana o Daudi.”

English: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull's blood, and some of the goat's blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
Kiswahili: “Kisha atatoka aje kwenye madhabahu yaliyo mbele za Bwana na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake. Atachukua sehemu ya damu ya fahali na sehemu ya damu ya mbuzi, na kuiweka kwenye pembe za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio asoke agende ase egesasiimero kere agwo ase obosio bwane, agekorere okobwatanigwa, naende aimokie amanyinga make ay'eeri gose ey'embori eyio, ayagindie ase emegwekano yonsi ye ching'unchara ere ase chikoona chi'egesasiimero ekio,

English: for he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.
Kiswahili: Alipeleka barua katika sehemu zote za ufalme wake, kwa kila jimbo kwa maandishi yake mwenyewe na kwa kila watu katika lugha yao wenyewe, akitangaza kwa msemo wa kila watu kwamba inampasa kila mwanaume kuwa mtawala wa nyumba yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio agatoma amarube gochia ase chingongo chionsi chi'obogambi bwaye. Amarube ayio akarikwa ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw'engencho y'amariko abo, ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo, goteeba ng'a kera omosacha abe okogamba ase enka yaye, naende abe ogokwana nabaanto baye ase omonwa bw'egesaku kiaye.

English: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitakushughulikia kama unavyostahili, kwa kuwa umedharau kiapo changu kwa kuvunja Agano.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ningokorere koreng'ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachaayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw'ogotianania.

English: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
Kiswahili: Kadiri makuhani walivyoongezeka, ndivyo walivyozidi kutenda dhambi dhidi yangu, walibadilisha utukufu wao kwa kitu cha aibu.
Ekegusii: “Buna abakuani bagendererete kobucha, naboigo bagendererete gokora ebibe ase ’nde. Ase ayio ning’onchore obonene bwabo bobe obosooku.

English: If adversity meets you, you will find him there before you. Pretending to help you, he will trip you.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa shida itakupata, utamkuta hapo mbele yako. Akijifanya kukusaidia, atakukwaza.
Ekegusii: Oise konyorwa n'obokong'u, nagwo okomonyora okoganyete, okwebonia ng'a nkogokonya are, na anii, nigo aroberetie kogokoora kegima.

English: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
Kiswahili: Majani yake yalikuwa ya kupendeza, matunda yake yalikuwa mengi, na juu yake kulikuwa na chakula kwa ajili ya wote. Chini ya kivuli chake wanyama wa kondeni walipata hifadhi, na ndege wa angani waliishi katika matawi yake. Kila kiumbe kililishwa kutokana na mti huo.
Ekegusii: Amato aye nigo arenge amaya, na amatunda aye nigo arenge amaange; ase omote oria endagera nao yarenge goisanekia abanto bonsi. Ching'iti chi'orosana nao chiare konyora ekiriri chigokenderera inse yaye, ne chinyoni chikaba chikomenya ime ase chinsagia chiaye, na kera egetongwa kere moyo gekanyora endagera yaye korwao.

English: Each day one ox, six choice sheep, and some fowl were prepared for me, and once every ten days an abundance of all kinds of wine was provided. But I did not demand the food allotted to the governor, because the burden on the people was so heavy.
Kiswahili: Kila siku niliandaliwa maksai mmoja, kondoo sita wazuri, na kuku, na mvinyo wa kila aina kwa wingi kila baada ya siku kumi. Licha ya mambo haya yote, sikudai chakula kilichokuwa fungu la mtawala, kwa sababu madai yalikuwa mazito sana kwa watu hawa.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko endagera narenge korua neng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi chinoru isano nemo, amo ne chingoko; na kera rituko ria ikomi nigo narenge korua ebirandi ebinge biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, bire nedivai. Ase ebinto ebio bionsi tinarenge gosaba endagera eria abagaambi bagwenerete koegwa, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babogoretie egurube endito.

English: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
Kiswahili: Kujipamba ili kuvutia ni udanganyifu na uzuri unapita upesi, bali mwanamke anayemcha Bwana atasifiwa.
Ekegusii: Obonyakieni nigo bokong'ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyaare gotogigwa.

English: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
Kiswahili: “Alinyoosha mkono kutoka juu na kunishika; alinitoa kutoka kilindi cha maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amaange.

English: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
Kiswahili: Akaenda tena ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani mpaka mahali pale ambapo Yohana alikuwa akibatiza hapo awali, naye akakaa huko.
Ekegusii: Akagenda naende ng'umbu ya Yorodani goika aase aria Yohana arenge kobatisera ritang'ani, akabeera aroro.

English: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
Kiswahili: Alifanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, kama alivyofanya Yehoyakimu.
Ekegusii: Zedekia agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana buna onsi aria Yehoyakimu akorete.

English: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hela walikuwa: Serethi, Sohari, Ethnani,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.

English: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Kiswahili: Njia ya wenye haki ni kama nuru ya kwanza ya mapambazuko, ambayo hungʼaa zaidi na zaidi mpaka mchana mkamilifu.
Ekegusii: Korende enchera y'abanyene oboronge nigo enga buna amasase a mambia; ayio akogeenderera koraba goetania goika bwakia se.

English: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
Kiswahili: Kama ningezihesabu, zingekuwa nyingi kuliko mchanga. Niamkapo, bado niko pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Inse kobibara, nigo bire ebinge goetania omokenye. Ekero ’nkobooka, nigo ’ngendererete kobeera amo naye.

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: On the eighth day Gamaliel son of Pedahzur, the leader of the Manassites, drew near.
Kiswahili: Siku ya nane Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri, kiongozi wa watu wa Manase, alileta sadaka yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri bw’egesaku kia Manase, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

English: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh's word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
Kiswahili: Kwa neno la Bwana, mtu wa Mungu alifika Betheli kutoka Yuda wakati Yeroboamu alipokuwa amesimama kando ya madhabahu ili kutoa sadaka.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw'Omonene omonto o Nyasae akarua ase ense ya Yuda. Ere agacha Beteli ekero Yeroboamu ateneine ase egesasiimero gosamba ubani.

English: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.”
Kiswahili: Nitatuma moto juu ya Temani ambao utateketeza ngome za Bosra.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase omochie o Temani; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Bosira.” Amoni.

English: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For Yahweh and for Gideon!'”
Kiswahili: Wakati mimi na wale walio pamoja nami wote, tutakapopiga tarumbeta zetu, ninyi nanyi pigeni tarumbeta pande zote za kambi na mpige kelele, mseme, ‘Upanga wa Bwana na wa Gideoni.' ”
Ekegusii: Ekero inche amo n'abanto bonsi tore komo torabugie ebitureeri, nainwe mobugie ebitureeri biaino ase chinsemo chionsi chi'egetwori, erio moake eriogi rinene, moteebe: Ase Omonene na ase Gidioni!”

English: Aren't we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
Kiswahili: Je, yeye hatuhesabu sisi kama wageni? Sio kwamba ametuuza tu, bali ametumia hata na vile vilivyolipwa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Tatokorete buna abamenyi? Naki nigo atoonetie, naende akaria enibo eria yonsi.

English: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba Tito amekubali tu ombi letu, bali anakuja kwenu akiwa na shauku kuliko wakati mwingine, tena kwa hiari yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki igo abwatete ogosorora gwaito; kobua ayio, ere akamenta koba nomokia gocha ase more ase ogwancha kwaye omonyene.

English: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atalala na mwanamke, na kukawa na kutoka kwa shahawa, ni lazima wote waoge kwa maji, nao watakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Omonto onye orarire n'omokuungu, na omobekeire embusuro y'oroiboro, bonsi babere goika besibie emebere yabo namaache, nabarabwo nababe abatachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side— men much older than your father.
Kiswahili: Wale wenye mvi na wazee wako upande wetu, watu ambao ni wazee hata kuliko baba yako.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamerire chimbuche amo nabakoorire emiaka emenge nao bare aa amo naintwe, barabwo mbabuete iso ase emiaka.

English: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku saba itawapasa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu na kuitakasa na hivyo ndivyo watakavyoiweka wakfu.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokorera egesasiimero okobwatanigwa na kogechena, mogiatanane kebe egechenu.

English: The inhabitant won't say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

Kiswahili: Hili ndilo lililotokea wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Ahasuero, yule aliyetawala juu ya majimbo mia na ishirini na saba tangu Bara Hindi hadi Kushi.

English: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;
Kiswahili: nanyi kama mkimkunjulia mtu mwenye njaa nafsi zenu na kutosheleza mahitaji ya walioonewa, ndipo nuru yenu itakapongʼaa gizani, nao usiku wenu utakuwa kama adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: korakonye abare nenchara na oe oyochandegete eki'aremeire, rirorio omobaso oo nobare ase omosunte, na obotuko bwao mbobe buna mobaso gati.

English: the LORD had already spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.” And Isaiah did so, walking around naked and barefoot.
Kiswahili: wakati ule Bwana alisema kwa kinywa cha Isaya mwana wa Amozi. Akamwambia, “Vua nguo ya gunia kutoka mwilini mwako na viatu kutoka miguuni mwako.” Naye akafanya hivyo, akatembea huku na huko uchi, bila viatu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene agakwana na Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, akamoteebia: “Genda orusie egunia obegete ase omobere oo, na ebikoroto obegete ase amagoro ao.” Isaya agakora bo, akaba ogotaara getirianda, na tabegete ebikoroto.

English: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
Kiswahili: ili kuonyesha rehema kwa baba zetu na kukumbuka Agano lake takatifu,
Ekegusii: erinde abarorere amaabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.

English: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Toeni pamoja na hiyo mikate wana-kondoo saba, kila mmoja wa mwaka mmoja asiye na dosari, na fahali mchanga, na kondoo dume wawili. Watakuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto yenye harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amo nokoruegwa okwo morente ching’ondi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, na eeri ensae, ne chimingichi ibere, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase Omonene, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyuugwa okwo gochiikire amo. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.

English: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his Israelite brothers, whether he treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. So you must purge the evil from among you.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikamatwa akiiba yeyote miongoni mwa ndugu zake wa Waisraeli na kumtenda kama mtumwa au akimuuza, mwizi huyo ni lazima auawe. Nawe utaondoa uovu kutoka miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oibire Omoisraeli omwabo amokore buna omosomba, gose amoonie, omoibi oria goika aitwe akwe. Goika morusie obobe korwa ase more.

English: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ndani ya moyo hutoka mawazo mabaya, uuaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushahidi wa uongo na masingizio.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang’ana y’oborimo, na okorama.

English: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
Kiswahili: Simoni alipoona kuwa watu wanapokea Roho Mtakatifu mitume walipoweka mikono juu yao, akataka kuwapa fedha
Ekegusii: Ekero Simioni achia korora ng’a abanto nigo bakoegwa Omoika ase okobeekerwa amaboko nabatomwa, akabarentera chitaabu,

English: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
Kiswahili: kwamba uzao wake utaendelea milele, na kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu mbele zangu kama jua;
Ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.

English: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Ishmaeli, yaliyoorodheshwa kulingana na jinsi walivyozaliwa: Mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Ishmaeli ni Nebayothi, akafuatia Kedari, Adbeeli, Mibsamu,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana ba Isumaeli, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo: Nebayoti, nere omwana oye omotangi, na Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu,

English: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mwamba wao si kama Mwamba wetu, sawasawa na vile adui zetu wanavyokiri.
Ekegusii: Egetare kiabo tikeri buna Egetare giaito, nonya n’ababisa baito ’mbamanyete amang’ana ayio.

English: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akashuka ili auone mji na mnara ambao wanadamu waliokuwa wanaujenga.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agaika goocha inse, erinde arore omochie na omoorobiri oyio abana ba Mwanyabaanto konya baagachire.

English: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu ameruhusu watawaliwe na nguvu ya udanganyifu, ili waendelee kuamini uongo,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bw'echinguru, abakore begene ayare ay'oborimo,

English: His brother's name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
Kiswahili: Kaka yake aliitwa Yubali, aliyekuwa baba wa wote wapigao zeze na filimbi.
Ekegusii: Na momura omwabo nigo are korokwa Yubali; oyio nere sokoro y'abanto baria baare kobugia amakano na ebiroria.

English: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
Kiswahili: Huko Hekaluni aliwakuta watu wakiuza ngʼombe, kondoo na njiwa, nao wengine walikuwa wameketi mezani wakibadili fedha.
Ekegusii: Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.

English: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, hakika umenichakaza; umewaangamiza kabisa watu wa nyumbani mwangu wote.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.

English: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hamu walikuwa: Kushi, Misraimu, Putu na Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi na Misiri, Putu na Kaanani.

English: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
Kiswahili: Nikatazama, hapo mbele yangu palikuwa na wingu jeupe, na aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya hilo wingu alikuwa “kama Mwana wa Adamu” mwenye taji ya dhahabu kichwani mwake na mundu mkali mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio nkarigereria, nkarora riire rirabu, na igoro ase riire riria naikaranseteo oyomo ogwekaine omwana o Mwanyabaanto, orenge negutwa y’etaabu ase omotwe oye, na omoyio okogesa ase okoboko kwaye.

English: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayedharau mafundisho anajiletea maangamizi, bali yeye anayeheshimu agizo hupewa tuzo.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya Ring'ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng'eria y'obuya.

English: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao, mtaalamu wa sheria, akamuuliza swali ili kumjaribu, akisema,
Ekegusii: Oyomo ase barabwo, omonto bw'amachiiko, akamobooria ase okomoteema,

English: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu, naye akastawi, Yosefu akaishi nyumbani kwa bwana wake Mmisri.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, na ere akanyora ogosesenigwa. Yusufu akamenya ase enka y'omonene oye, oria Omomisiri.

English: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.
Kiswahili: Mtaila kama kitu kilicho kitakatifu sana; kila mwanaume ataila. Ni lazima mtaiheshimu kama takatifu.
Ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore ase more nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio n’ebinto ebichenu ase ore.

English: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wawe machukizo kwa falme zote za dunia kwa sababu ya kile alichofanya Manase mwana wa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ninkore amagambi onsi are ase ense aichanigwe na koondoka ase amang’ana arabanyore ase engencho y’obobe obwo Manase, mosinto bwa Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, akorete agwo Yerusalemu.

English: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
Kiswahili: Wekeni tumaini lenu katika nuru hiyo ili mpate kuwa wana wa nuru.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu aliondoka, akajificha wasimwone.
Ekegusii: Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b'omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa ase bare.

English: Then the king's servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.
Kiswahili: Kisha watumishi waliomhudumia mfalme walipendekeza, “Na ufanyike utafiti kwa ajili ya wanawali mabikira wazuri wa sura kwa ajili ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio abasomba abarenge gokorera omorwoti bakamoteebia, “Tiga abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni barigigwe barentwe asore, aye omorwoti.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Gadi walikuwa watu 45,650.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n'amagana atano nomo, namerongo etano (45,650).

English: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa na mikia yenye miiba ya kuumia kama nge. Nguvu yao ya kutesa watu kwa huo muda wa miezi mitano ilikuwa katika hiyo mikia yao.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo chiarenge nebimincha bire nemeburera buna ebi’ebiuge, na okobua kwabo kw’ogochanda Mwanyabaanto ase emetienyi etano nigo kwarenge ase ebimincha biabo.

English: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Reero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Aburaamu.

English: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farmlands around each of their cities or in any other city, men were designated by name to distribute a portion to every male among the priests and to every Levite listed by the genealogies.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu makuhani, wazao wa Aroni walioishi kwenye mashamba yaliyozunguka miji yao au katika miji mingine yoyote, watu walitajwa majina ili kumgawia kila mwanaume miongoni mwao na kwa wote waliokuwa katika orodha ya vizazi vya Walawi.
Ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abakuani b’ororeria rwa Aroni, abamenyete ase amaremo aetanaine emechie yabo, ase kera omochie, abanto gete bagachorwa na korikwa amarieta abo. Barabwo bakaba bagwatanana ebiegwa biria ase kera omonto omosacha, ase egati y’abakuani, na ase kera Omolawi origetwe ase omooroberio.

English: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini basi hukumkemea Yeremia Mwanathothi, aliyejifanya kama nabii miongoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Bono naki rende otaratogonyera Yeremia oyio okorwa Anatoti ogendererete kobaabaanera inwe?

English: He who had thrown out a multitude unburied had none to mourn for him. He didn't have any funeral at all and no place in the tomb of his ancestors.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyewafukuza watu wengi ambao hawakuzikwa hakuwa na mtu wa kuomboleza kwa ajili yake. Hakuwa na mazishi yoyote kabisa na hakuwa na nafasi katika kaburi la mababu zake.
Ekegusii: Yasoni konya oitire abanto abange na gotiga emebere yabo etatindekiri, bono ere agakwa atari na monto onde okomorera; na tatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye.

English: I will observe your statutes. Don't utterly forsake me. BETH
Kiswahili: Nitayatii maagizo yako; usiniache kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ninyigwere amachiiko ao; tobaisa gontiga.

English: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa kuwa mmefufuliwa pamoja na Kristo, yatafuteni yaliyo juu, Kristo alikoketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mwabokigwe ase obogima amo na Kristo, ase igo beka chinkoro chiaino ase ebinto bire igoro, aase Kristo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: in her virginity, lest she should be defiled and be with child in her father's house; when she has a husband, lest she should transgress; and when she is married, lest she should be barren.
Kiswahili: katika ubikira wake, asije akatiwa unajisi na kupata mimba katika nyumba ya baba yake; akiwa na mume, asije akafanya dhambi; na akiwa ameolewa, asije akawa tasa.
Ekegusii: Ekero are omoiseke, ise nigo akwoboa buna nigo ere arasarigwe, gose nabaisa konyora oborito ekero ere are ase enyomba yaye; naende ekero asookire ise nigo akwoboa buna nigo arabaisa koba omogomba.

English: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father's household.
Kiswahili: isipokuwa, hapo tutakapoingia katika nchi hii, utakuwa umefunga hii kamba nyekundu dirishani pale ulipotuteremshia na kama utakuwa umewaleta baba yako na mama yako, ndugu zako na jamaa yako yote ndani ya nyumba yako.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio togokoboria okore: Ekero torasoe ase ense eye, osibe engori eye embariri ase ekebao eke gwatoikeria. Osangererie gocha nyomba mwao iso, na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amo nabaanto bonsi b'enyomba ya iso.

English: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
Kiswahili: Kundi kubwa zaidi lipe urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kundi dogo zaidi lipewe urithi mdogo zaidi; kila kundi litapokea urithi wake kulingana na hesabu ya wale walioorodheshwa.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kere ekenene keegwe orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na egesaku kere egeke keegwe orogongo oroke robe omwando obo. Kera egesaku nakeegwe omwando oye koreng'ana nomobaro obo.

English: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
Kiswahili: Mwangwi wa kilio chao umefika hadi mpakani mwa Moabu, kilio chao cha huzuni kimefika hadi Eglaimu, maombolezo yao hadi Beer-Elimu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri'okorera kwabo riaichoire ase ense ya Moabu; ekerero ekio giaikire Egilaimu na Beeri‐Elimu.

English: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
Kiswahili: Sungura ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.

English: Who will listen to your proposal? The share of the one who went to battle will match the share of the one who stayed with the supplies. They will share alike.”
Kiswahili: Ni nani atasikiliza yale mnayosema? Fungu la mtu aliyekaa na vyombo litakuwa sawa na la yule aliyekwenda vitani. Wote watashiriki sawa.”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobaigwera ase amang’ana buna ayio? Yaya, buna abanto abwo bagendete korwana esegi bakoegwa ebisakorwa, naboigo nabwo batigarete magega korenda ebinto baraegwe. Nigo baragaberwe bareng’anie.”

English: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?
Kiswahili: Nimevua joho langu: je, ni lazima nivae tena? Nimenawa miguu yangu: je, ni lazima niichafue tena?
Ekegusii: Narusirie eanga, inee, inyebeeke naende? Nesibirie amagoro, inee, inyabeeke eubi naende?

English: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
Kiswahili: “Yuda atakuwa na sehemu moja, itapakana na nchi ya Reubeni kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Yuda keegwe orogongo rw'aye robebekane norwa Rubeni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
Kiswahili: Huvisukasuka vilindi kama sufuria kubwa ichemkayo, na kukoroga bahari kama chungu cha marhamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amaache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amaache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.

English: Later, King Belshazzar held a great feast for a thousand of his nobles, and he drank wine with them.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Belshaza alifanya karamu kubwa kwa ajili ya maelfu ya wakuu wake na akanywa mvinyo pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Belisasari agakora omoyega omonene, akarangeria abanto abanene koreng’ana elifu eyemo b’oborwoti bwaye, akaba okonywa edivai amo n’abanto abwo elifu.

English: May your soul rejoice in his mercy, and may you all not be put to shame in praising him.
Kiswahili: Nafsi zenu zifurahi katika rehema zake, nanyi nyote msione haya katika kumsifu.
Ekegusii: Tiga emioyo yaino egokere amaabera a Nyasae, gose tari timwenyoorera obosooku, na mono ekero mokomotogia Omonene Nyasae.

English: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwasimamisha Petro na Yohana katikati yao, wakawauliza, “Ni kwa uwezo gani au kwa jina la nani mmefanya jambo hili?”
Ekegusii: Bakababeka abatomwa batenene ase obosio bwabo, erio bakababoria “’ngaki mwanyara gokora aya? Ase kobua ki gose nase erieta riango mwarangeria?”

English: He added to them knowledge, and gave them a law of life for a heritage.
Kiswahili: Aliwaongezea maarifa, na akawapa sheria ya uzima kwa ajili ya urithi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akabaa bosio bwabo chisemi, na kobaa ebirage bi'obogima.

English: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaja baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Antiokia na Ikonio wakawashawishi wale watu, wakampiga Paulo kwa mawe, wakamburuta hadi nje ya mji, wakidhani amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y'omochie, bagakaga ng'a okuure,

English: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Makelothi na kupiga kambi huko Tahathi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Makeloti bakageenda bagaika Tahati, bagatoora aroro.

English: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msile mkate wowote, au nafaka iliyokaangwa au nafaka mpya, mpaka siku ile mtakayomletea Mungu wenu sadaka hii. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo, popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa koria okwama okwo okoyia: Ebigara ebibese, gose ebikarangire, gose ebiaroisigwe emegati, ekero motaraarentera Nyasae oino okoruegwa kwaino kw'ogotongora. Ogochika okwo nigo koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
Kiswahili: “Akasema na pawepo mkataba kati yangu na wewe, kama ulivyokuwepo kati ya baba yangu na baba yako. Tazama, nimekuletea zawadi ya fedha na dhahabu. Sasa vunja mkataba wako na Baasha mfalme wa Israeli ili aniondokee mimi.”
Ekegusii: “Tiga okobwatana kw'ogotianania kobe ase egati yane naye, buna kwarenge ase egati ya tata na iso. Rora nagotomeire ekeegwa gie chifeta ne chitaabu. Genda osarie okobwatana okwo kwao gwakorete na Baasa, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, erinde arue ase ense yane antigane.”

English: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa nimetaabika, nimeadhibiwa kila asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Omobaso boira nabeire nkonyora amaakwa, na kera emambia nabeire nkonyora egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.

English: Later, as Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces besieged Lachish, he sent his servants to Jerusalem with a message for King Hezekiah of Judah and all the people of Judah who were in Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Hatimaye Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru na majeshi yake yote walipokuwa wameuzunguka Lakishi, akawatuma maafisa wake kwenda Yerusalemu wakiwa na ujumbe huu kwa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda, na kwa watu wote wa Yuda waliokuwako humo, kusema:
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio, Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, oria onaaretie Lakisi amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi, agatoma abasomba baye Yerusalemu ase Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na ase Abayuda bonsi abwo barenge Yerusalemu, agateeba,

English: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah. David Serves Saul
Kiswahili: Basi Samweli akachukua ile pembe ya mafuta na kumtia mafuta mbele ya ndugu zake, kuanzia siku ile na kuendelea Roho wa Bwana akaja juu ya Daudi kwa nguvu. Kisha Samweli akaenda zake Rama. Daudi Katika Utumishi Kwa Sauli
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Samweli akaimokia orogunchara rore namaguta, na agwo ase amasio y’abamura bamwabo agaaka Daudi amaguta. Omoika bw’Omonene ogaacha igoro ase Daudi, na korwa rituko riria okabeera asare kogenderera. Erio Samweli akarua agwo, akairana Rama. Daudi ase enyomba ya Saulo

English: Amaziah asked the man of God, “What should I do about the hundred talents I have given to the army of Israel?” And the man of God replied, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”
Kiswahili: Amazia akamuuliza yule mtu wa Mungu, “Lakini itakuwaje kwa zile talanta 100 za fedha nilizolipa kwa ajili ya haya majeshi ya Israeli?” Yule mtu wa Mungu akajibu, “ Bwana aweza kukupa zaidi sana ya hizo.”
Ekegusii: Amasia akaboria omonto oria o Nyasae, “Ngento ki togokora ase chitalanta chiria rigana erimo naakanire abasikari b’Abaisraeli?” Omonto oria o Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Omonene nabwate okobua gokoa chinyinge mono goetania echio.”

English: And Baasha did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.
Kiswahili: Akatenda maovu machoni pa Bwana, akienenda katika njia za Yeroboamu na dhambi yake, ambayo alikuwa amesababisha Israeli kuitenda.
Ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu ase ogokora ebibe ebio bikagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.

English: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
Kiswahili: Ikawa baada ya jambo hili, Wamoabu na Waamoni, pamoja na baadhi ya Wameuni wakaja ili wapigane vita na Yehoshafati.
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y'ayio, Abamoabu na Abaamoni, na abanto bande bamenyete amo n'Abaamoni bagacha korwania Yehosafati esegi.

English: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi hatumo miongoni mwa hao wanaositasita na kuangamia, bali tuko miongoni mwa hao wenye imani na hivyo tunaokolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.

English: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
Kiswahili: Wawili ni afadhali kuliko mmoja, kwa sababu wana malipo mazuri kwa kazi yao:
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba babere kobua oyomo, ekiagera mbanyore eng’eria engiya ase emeremo yabo bagokora.

English: Then Yahweh's angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akamwamuru Gadi amwambie Daudi apande na kumjengea Bwana madhabahu kwenye sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Arauna Myebusi.
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw'Omonene agachiika Gadi ateebie Daudi ng'a agende atenenie egesasiimero ase Omonene agwo ase ekeooreri ki'Orinani, Omoyebusi.

English: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
Kiswahili: ili tuweze kuhubiri Injili sehemu zilizo mbali na maeneo yenu. Kwa maana hatutaki kujisifu kwa ajili ya kazi ambayo imekwisha kufanyika tayari katika eneo la mtu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio tonyare korandia enchiri ase chinse chire ng’umbu yaino, titwetogia ase emeremo yakorirwe ase ensemo y’omonto onde.

English: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Ethani Mwezrahi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kw'Etani Omoezara) Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

English: All this time you have not deserted your brothers, up to this very day, but have kept the charge given you by the LORD your God.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu sasa, hadi siku hii ya leo, hamkuwaacha ndugu zenu, bali ninyi mmetimiza ile kazi Bwana Mungu wenu aliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aya amange timwatigete Abaisraeli bamino goika reero iga. Mwarendire mono na koigwera ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abachigete mokore.

English: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
Kiswahili: "Lakini enenda zako hata mwisho; maana utapumzika na kusimama katika urithi wako mwisho wa siku."
Ekegusii: “Korende aye Danieli, genda goika engaki eyio y'omoerio eike, ekero orabe gotimogete, noche koboka onyore egetari kiao ase engaki y'omoerio bw'amatuko ayio.”

English: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
Kiswahili: Uniponye na watu watendao mabaya, uniokoe kutokana na wamwagao damu.
Ekegusii: Nkonye korwa ase abakori amabe; ntoorie korwa ase abaiteri amanyinga.

English: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Manase; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 52,700.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi'egesaku kia Manase. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ibere, na amagana atano abere (52,700).

English: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
Kiswahili: Pia Mose akamwambia Kora, “Enyi Walawi! Sasa nisikilizeni.
Ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana na Kora, agateeba, “Bono inwe Abalawi, igwa!

English: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Watu wote hutoa kwanza divai nzuri, kisha huleta ile divai hafifu wageni wakisha kunywa vya kutosha, lakini wewe umeiweka ile nzuri kupita zote mpaka sasa.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyuure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”

English: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Alipigana vita dhidi ya Wafilisti na kubomoa kuta za Gathi, Yabne na Ashdodi. Kisha akajenga upya miji karibu na Ashdodi na mahali pengine katikati ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Usia akagenda akarwania Abafirisiti esegi; agatagora orwaki rwa Gati, na orwa Yabune, na orw'Asidodi. Akaagacha naende emechie ase orogongo rw'Asidodi na aande onsi ase egati y'Abafilisti.

English: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.'
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa nimeuchagua Yerusalemu ili Jina langu lipate kuwamo humo, na nimemchagua Daudi kuwatawala watu wangu Israeli.'
Ekegusii: korende bono nachorire Yerusalemu, erinde erieta riane ribeere aroro, naende nachorire Daudi agambere abanto baane Abaisraeli.

English: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Basi Abramu akaondoa mahema yake, akaenda kuishi karibu na mialoni ya Mamre huko Hebroni, huko akamjengea Bwana madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akang'anyia eema yaye, agacha akamenya ebitutu bw'emete ekorokwa emialoni agwo Mamure, ang'e na Heburoni. Akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro.

English: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, mjalie mfalme aamue kwa haki yako, mwana wa mfalme kwa haki yako.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, kae omorwoti okobua gw’okogamba buna aye okogamba, na omwana bw’omorwoti agambe ase oboronge buna aye.

English: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
Kiswahili: Mikononi mwao watakuinua, ili usijikwae mguu wako kwenye jiwe.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

English: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakamlilia tena Bwana, naye akawapa mwokozi: Ehudi, mtu wa shoto, mwana wa Gera, Mbenyamini. Waisraeli wakatuma kwa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu ushuru kwa mkono wa Ehudi.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene ng'a ababoorie, nere akabaa omonto okobabooria. Omonto oria nere Ehudi, mosinto o Gera, bw'egesaku gia Benjamini. Ehudi nigo arenge omonyakebee. Abaisraeli bagatoma Ehudi koirera Egiloni, omorwoti bw'ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa bi'amasikani.

English: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanashangaa juu ya jambo hili, ghafula watu wawili waliokuwa wamevaa mavazi yanayongʼaa kama umeme wakasimama karibu nao.
Ekegusii: Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e ase bare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.

English: be careful not to be ensnared by their ways after they have been destroyed before you. Do not inquire about their gods, asking, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”
Kiswahili: na baada ya kuangamizwa mbele yenu, mwe waangalifu msijiingize katika tanzi kwa kuuliza habari za miungu yao, mkisema, “Je, mataifa haya hutumikiaje miungu yao? Nasi tutafanya vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: mwerende timobaisa gotegwa n’emeeto na kobwatia chingeencho chiabo banarete gokora. Timorigia komanya igoro ye’chinyasae chiabo na koboria: Naki ebisaku ebi biarenge gosasiima chinyasae chiabo? Naboigo naintwe tochisasiime.

English: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza Akishi, “Lakini mimi nimefanya nini? Je, umeona nini kibaya juu ya mtumishi wako tangu siku ile niliyokuja kwako hadi leo? Kwa nini nisirudi na kupigana na adui za bwana wangu mfalme?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akabooria Akisi: “Ngento ki nakorire? Korwa ekero inche, omosomba oo, nachete aa kogokorera, goika rituko ria reero, mbobe ki kwarorire ase 'nde bokogera tingenda korwania ababisa bao, aye omorwoti, omonene one?”

English: Fear the Lord with all your soul; and revere his priests.
Kiswahili: Mche Bwana kwa roho yako yote; na waheshimu makuhani wake.
Ekegusii: Moiroke Nyasae Omobui n'omoyo oo bwonsi; na kae abakuani bao amasikani.

English: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
Kiswahili: Kilio cha huzuni cha wafungwa kifike mbele zako; kwa nguvu za mkono wako hifadhi wale waliohukumiwa kufa.
Ekegusii: Tiga ekerero ki'abasibire geike ase obosio bwao; tooria abanto abwo banacheirwe ekiina bakwe, ekiagera aye nobwate okobua okonene.

English: Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake toka miisho ya dunia, ninyi mshukao chini baharini, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, enyi visiwa na wote wakaao ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo n’ebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!

English: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
Kiswahili: Amri hizi ninazokupa leo zitakuwa katika moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya 'nkobachiika rituko ria reero timobaisa koyeeba nonya ng'ake.

English: You are my brothers, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to restore the king?’
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni ndugu zangu, nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe. Kwa hiyo kwa nini mwe wa mwisho kumrudisha mfalme?’
Ekegusii: Inwe n’abanto baminto b’amanyinga ane ne chinyama chiane. Inaki rende morigetie koba ab’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omorwoti inka?

English: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
Kiswahili: Je, mfinyanzi hana haki ya kufinyanga kutoka bonge moja vyombo vya udongo, vingine kwa matumizi ya heshima na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida?
Ekegusii: Gose omokori chinyongo tari n’okobua igoro ase esike, ase ribomba ri’esike gokora egento ekemo eki’ogosikwa, na ekende kebe getari nogosikwa?

English: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.
Kiswahili: Ahazia akaenda vitani na Yoramu mwana wa Ahabu kupigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu huko Ramoth-Gileadi. Waaramu wakamjeruhi Yoramu.
Ekegusii: Ahasia akagenda amo na Yoramu, mosinto bw'Ahabu, korwania Hasaeli, omorwoti bw'Abasiiria, agwo Ramoti o Gileadi. Abasiiria bagaaka Yoramu chingoma.

English: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
Kiswahili: Kwenye chumba cha ghorofani walimokuwa wamekutania kulikuwa na taa nyingi.
Ekegusii: Nchiarengeo chitaaya chinyinge ase enyomba ya irongo aase twasangererekanete.

English: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, na timobaisa gokora emeremo ya kera rituko,

English: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume asiyetahiriwa, ambaye hajapata tohara ya mwilini, atatengwa na watu wake, amelivunja Agano langu.”
Ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otarokirie risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”

English: From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Hashumu: Matenai, Matata, Zabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremai, Manase na Shimei.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Hasumu; Matenai na Matata, Sabadi na Elifeleti, Yeremia na Manase, na Simei;

English: They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus. Preparing the Passover (Matthew 26:17–19; Luke 22:7–13)
Kiswahili: Walifurahi sana kusikia jambo hili na wakaahidi kumpa fedha. Hivyo yeye akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti. Yesu Ala Pasaka Na Wanafunzi Wake (Mathayo 26:17-25; Luka 22:7-14, 21-23; Yohana 13:21-30)
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chitaabu. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya. Yeso okoria Epasaka y’omoerio n’aborokigwa baye (Mat 26:17-30; Luk 22:7-23; Yoh 13:21-30; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)

English: As a door turns on its hinges, so the slacker turns on his bed.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mlango ugeukavyo kwenye bawaba zake, ndivyo mvivu ajigeuzavyo kitandani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.

English: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mipiko itaingizwa kwenye zile pete ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu inapobebwa.
Ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi'egesasiimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.

English: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.
Kiswahili: watu wa Anathothi 128
Ekegusii: abanto b'Anatoti: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128);

English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng'ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.

English: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akamchagua Sila na akaondoka baada ya ndugu kuwatakia neema ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila, na ekero abegeni bamobekeire amaboko, akaimoka akagenda.

English: In the very time of his deliverance, he awakens, and marvels that the fear is nothing.
Kiswahili: Wakati uleule wa ukombozi wake, anaamka, na kushangaa kwamba hofu si kitu.
Ekegusii: Ekero agotorigwa, obooka, oichana buna obwoba bwaye tibobwati ekeene.

English: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Amoni wakafanya fitina juu yake, nao wakamuulia kwake nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Abasomba b'Amoni bagakora omooroberio bw'okomoita, bakamoitera ase enyomba yaye ime.

English: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nitakufanya ukiwa milele, watu hawataishi katika miji yako. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninkoonchore ogenderere koba bosa botambe, na emechie yao tekomenywa naende. Erio nario moramanye ng'a ninche Omonene.

English: They had entered the house while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed, and having stabbed and killed him, they beheaded him, took his head, and traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wameingia ndani ya nyumba wakati alipokuwa amelala kitandani chumbani kwake. Baada ya kumchoma mkuki na kumuua, walikata kichwa chake. Wakiwa wamekichukua, walitembea usiku kucha kwa njia ya Araba.
