English: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
Kiswahili: Wale waliouawa kwa upanga ni bora kuliko wale wanaokufa njaa; wanateseka kwa njaa, wanatokomea kwa kukosa chakula kutoka shambani.
Ekegusii: Mbare negesio abwo bagokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro kobua abwo enchara egoita, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakogenderera korea na korea, ase okoborwa gw’okwama kw’emegondo.

English: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him. Christian Households (Ephesians 6:1–4)
Kiswahili: Lolote mfanyalo, ikiwa ni kwa neno au kwa tendo, fanyeni yote katika jina la Bwana Yesu, mkimshukuru Mungu Baba katika yeye. Kanuni Katika Madaraka Ya Nyumbani
Ekegusii: Na kera eki mogokora, ase amang’ana gose ase ogokora, mokore kera egento ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono goetera asare. Obogima bw’oboamate bw’obokristo

English: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.
Kiswahili: Baada ya taifa lote kutahiriwa, waliendelea kukaa kambini mpaka walipokuwa wamepona.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bakoorire kwarokigwa, abanto bonsi bakabeera aase abo ase egetwori goika bakagwena.

English: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.' “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.'
Kiswahili: unasema, ‘Sina hatia; Mungu hajanikasirikia.' Lakini nitakuhukumu kwa sababu unasema, ‘Mimi sijatenda dhambi.'
Ekegusii: “Nigo mogendererete goteeba: Intwe titori nokomocha, na ase ayio Omonene tari nendamwamu ase tore. Ekiagera mwakanire ng'a timokoreti ebibe, nimbanachere ekiina.

English: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawaambia waziwazi, “Lazaro amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akabateebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okuure.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaziah, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
Kiswahili: Kwa matukio mengine ya utawala wa Ahazia na yale aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Ahasia, na aya akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli.

English: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitamgawia sehemu miongoni mwa wakuu, naye atagawana nyara pamoja na wenye nguvu, kwa sababu aliyamimina maisha yake hadi mauti, naye alihesabiwa pamoja na wakosaji. Kwa kuwa alichukua dhambi za wengi, na kuwaombea wakosaji.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimwatananere abange babe egetari kiaye; ere naatanerwe ebisakorwa amo nabare ne chinguru, ekiagera aruete obogima bwaye agakwa, akabarwa buna noyomo bw’abasaria. Nigo abogoretie ebibe bi’abaanto abange, agasabera abasaria.

English: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock. The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Lile gari la kukokotwa lilikuja mpaka kwenye shamba la Yoshua wa Beth-Shemeshi, nalo likasimama kando ya mwamba mkubwa. Watu wakapasua mbao za lile gari la kukokotwa na kutoa dhabihu wale ngʼombe kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero egari eria yaigete ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi egatenenao, ase rigena rinene riarenge. Abanto bagaatia chibao chi’egari eria, erio bakarua chiombe chiria chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase Omonene.

English: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”
Kiswahili: Watumishi wake wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini unafanya hivi? Mtoto alipokuwa angali hai, ulifunga na kulia; lakini sasa mtoto amekufa, umeinuka na kula.”
Ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamoteebia, “Ing'ana ki eri gwakora? Ekero omwana arenge moyo okeng'ata na korera korende bono omwana gakuure, kwaimokire kwarageire.”

English: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yohana akajitahidi kumzuia, akimwambia, “Mimi ninahitaji kubatizwa na wewe, nawe waja kwangu nikubatize?”
Ekegusii: Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateeba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha ase 'nde?”

English: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with influences from the east; they are soothsayers like the Philistines; they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
Kiswahili: Umewatelekeza watu wako, nyumba ya Yakobo. Wamejaa ushirikina utokao Mashariki, wanapiga ramli kama Wafilisti na wanashikana mikono na wapagani.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwangire abanto bao, abwo bare ab’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, ekiagera barabwo baichoirwe ne chingencho chi’abaanto ba moocha, na nigo bagokora oboringoria buna obw’Abafilisti; boigo babwatanire nabaanto b’echinse chingeni.

English: This is what the LORD says: “As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed or the cushion of a couch.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kama vile mchungaji aokoavyo kinywani mwa simba vipande viwili tu vya mfupa wa mguu au kipande cha sikio, hivyo ndivyo Waisraeli watakavyookolewa, wale wakaao Samaria kwenye kingo za vitanda vyao, na katika Dameski kwenye viti vyao vya fahari.”
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Buna koreng’ana omorisia agotoria korwa ase omonwa bw’endo amagoro abere, gose egetabo ki’ogoto kw’eng’ondi eyio konya endo yarire, naboigo bake barataborigwe, abwo bamenyete Samaria baikaransete ase ebirogo ebiororo na ase emeito etubire nebitambaa bi’ariri.”

English: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, because you will become desolate forever,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: Hakuna jiwe litakalochukuliwa kutoka kwako kwa ajili ya kufanywa jiwe la pembeni, wala jiwe lolote kwa ajili ya msingi, kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Igena rinde tirikorusigwa asore ribe eri’ekoona, gose kobekwa ase oboroso, korende aye nosarigwe ogenderere koba ritongo kogenderera botambe.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin—
Kiswahili: ili kwamba utafute makosa yangu na kuichunguza dhambi yangu;
Ekegusii: goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?

English: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa nini wewe wamhukumu ndugu yako? Au kwa nini wewe unamdharau ndugu yako? Kwa kuwa sote tutasimama mbele ya kiti cha Mungu cha hukumu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, nase ki okogaambia oy’omino? Gose aye, nase ki ogochaaya oy’omino? Inaki intwe twensi inatoche gotenena bosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina kia Nyasae.

English: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
Kiswahili: na kama joto la jangwani. Wewe wanyamazisha makelele ya wageni; kama vile hari ipunguzwavyo na kivuli cha wingu, ndivyo wimbo wa wakatili unyamazishwavyo.
Ekegusii: na buna omobaso bw'eguru‐gura. Aye gwakiririe amariogi 'ababisa; buna omobaso omoororo ogokendigwa ne riire, naboigo namatera 'abaanto abwo abatindi arakendigwe.

English: come death, bloodshed, strife, sword, calamities, famine, suffering, and plague.
Kiswahili: kifo, umwagaji damu, ugomvi, upanga, misiba, njaa, mateso, na tauni.
Ekegusii: Amakweri kera engaki, ogoitera amanyinga, ogoitana neseegi, amakweri, enchara, emechaando na amarwaire.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nilimngoja Bwana kwa saburi, naye akaniinamia, akasikia kilio changu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nkaba imoganyete Omonene ase okoremereria, na ere akanyeonchorera akaigwa ekerero kiane.

English: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo, Kitabu cha Mose kilisomwa kwa sauti kuu, na watu wote wakasikia. Humo ilionekana imeandikwa kwamba hakuna Mwamoni wala Mmoabu atakayeruhusiwa katika kusanyiko la watu wa Mungu,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria abanto bagasomerwa amang'ana Korea ase Egetabu kia Musa, na ekanyorekana eriikire ng'a Abaamoni na Abamoabu tibakobarwa ase omosangererekano bw'abaanto ba Nyasae nonya ng'ake,

English: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo enyi wachungaji, sikieni neno la Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene:

English: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
Kiswahili: Wakati wakitoa maono ya uongo kwa ajili yako, wanapobashiri uongo kwa ajili yako, wanakuweka wewe kwenye shingo za watu wapotovu, wale walio waovu, wale ambao siku yao imewadia, wakati wa adhabu yao ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: “Nigo bakobarorera inwe amaroro y'oborimo, na kobaringoreria oborimo, bateeba ng'a monyare koba abamogotacha ebigoti bi'abakori amabe abwo batachenegeti, ekiagera rituko riabo riachire baraegwe egesusuro ki'omoerio ki'ebibe biabo.

English: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don't bring us over the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: Kama tumepata kibali mbele ya macho yako, nchi hii na ipewe watumishi wako kama milki yetu. Usitufanye tuvuke Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Naende bagateeba, “Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa korwa ase ore, tiga intwe, abasomba bao, toegwe ense eye ebe eyaito, korende tobaisa gotwambokia gochia ng'umbu ya Yorodani komenyao.”

English: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: “Farao, yeye pamoja na jeshi lake lote, atakapowaona atafarijiwa kwa ajili ya makundi yake yote ya wajeuri, wale waliouawa kwa upanga, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ekero Farao ararore abwo baitetwe, nigo areremie ase engencho y’emeganda yaye yonsi eyio yaitetwe nemioro.

English: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
Kiswahili: Ninyi vipofu wapumbavu! Ni kipi kilicho kikuu zaidi: ni ile dhahabu, au ni lile Hekalu linaloifanya hiyo dhahabu kuwa takatifu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkereki kere ekenene kobua: netaabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etaabu ebe enchenu?

English: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
Kiswahili: Efraimu ameonewa, amekanyagwa katika hukumu kwa kuwa amekusudia kufuatia sanamu.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu baregirwe na gotiringerwa inse ase ekiina, ekiagera beruete ase okobwatia emeroberio ya bosa.

English: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
Kiswahili: Aliagiza amri kwa Yakobo na akaweka sheria katika Israeli, ambazo aliwaamuru baba zetu wawafundishe watoto wao,
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abegete oborori bwaye ase abanto b'ororeria rwa Yakobo, na akaa Abaisraeli amachiiko, ayio achigete chisokoro chiaito chiorokererie abana babo.

English: Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them.”
Kiswahili: Warudishieni mara moja mashamba yao, mashamba yao ya mizabibu, mashamba yao ya mizeituni, na nyumba zao, pia riba yao mnayowatoza na sehemu ya fungu la mia la fedha, nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta.”
Ekegusii: Bono rituko ria reero bairanerie ebio bionsi baboreretigwe baakane: amaremo abo, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, edivai, ne chinyomba amo nebitoki bie chitaabu mwabeire mokoboria.”

English: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo hutakula tena watu wala kulifanya tena taifa lako lisiwe na watoto, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono tokogenderera koria abanto, gose goita abana b'egesaku kiao. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
Kiswahili: wakasema, “Enyi watu wa Galilaya, mbona mnasimama mkitazama juu angani? Huyu Yesu aliyechukuliwa kutoka kwenu kwenda Mbinguni, atarudi tena jinsi iyo hiyo mlivyomwona akienda zake Mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora: “Inwe abasacha ba Galili, nase ki moteneine morigereretie gochia igoro? Oyo Yeso, obogorigwe korwa as more kogenda igoro, naboigo naende arairane koreng'ana buna mwamorora akogenda igoro.”

English: Because of her, I will have immortality, and leave behind an eternal memory to those who come after me.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu yake, nitakuwa na kutokufa, na nitawaachia kumbukumbu ya milele wale wanaokuja baada yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'obong'aini nigo ndaegwe ogotakwa, na baria barache magega yane mbanginyore botambe.

English: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Bwana ameamuru kwamba wale wanaohubiri Injili wapate riziki yao kutokana na Injili.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene naboigo ochikiire ng'a baria bakorandia enchiri banyore ebibagwenerete korwa ase enchiri.

English: From Rehum the commander, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their associates—the judges and officials over Tripolis, Persia, Erech and Babylon, the Elamites of Susa,
Kiswahili: Rehumu afisa msimamizi na mwandishi Shimshai, pamoja na wenzao, yaani mahakimu na maafisa walio juu ya watu kuanzia Tripoli, Uajemi, Ereki na Babeli, Waelami wa Shushani,
Ekegusii: Erio Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na abande babwataine nabarabwo: abagaambi ebiina, na abagabana, na abanene b’oborwoti, na Abaayemi, na Abaereki, na Abaababeli, na Abasusa korwa ase ense y’Abaelamu,

English: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa umependezwa nami, nifundishe njia zako ili nipate kukujua, nami nizidi kupata kibali mbele zako. Kumbuka kuwa taifa hili ni watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire, onyorokie chinchera chiao, erinde inyare gokomanya na konyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende rigereria ng’a abanto b’egesaku eke nabaanto bao bare.”

English: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu anayevumilia wakati wa majaribu, kwa sababu akiisha kushinda hilo jaribio atapewa taji la uzima Mungu alilowaahidia wale wampendao.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria oremereretie ogoteemwa, ekiagera ekero aikire gwancherwa nanyore obogima buna egutwa y'obobui, obogima obwo Nyasae abarierete eira abwo bamwanchete.

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as Yahweh commanded.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Njoo madhabahuni ili utoe dhabihu yako ya sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, ufanye upatanisho kwa ajili yako mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya watu. Kisha utoe sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Suka gochia ang'e ase egesasiimero, na orue ekeng'wanso kiao ki'ebibe na eki'ogosaambwa, okore okobwatanigwa ase ore aye omonyene, na ase abanto, erinde mwaberwe. Naende orue ekeng'wanso ekio abanto barentire, na okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, buna Omonene achiigete.”

English: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kutambua makosa yake? Nisamehe makosa yangu nisiyoyajua.
Ekegusii: Ning'o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.

English: One evening David got up from his bed and strolled around on the roof of the palace. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing—a very beautiful woman.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja wakati wa jioni Daudi aliinuka kitandani mwake na kutembeatembea juu ya paa la jumba lake la kifalme. Kutokea kule kwenye paa, akamwona mwanamke akioga. Mwanamke huyo alikuwa mzuri sana wa sura,
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase rituko erimo chinsa chia mogoroba, Daudi akaimoka korwa borere bwaye, akariina kerama igoro, ase enyomba yaye y’oborwoti. Ekero areenge gotaarao, akarora omokungu ogwesibia, na omokungu oyio nigo arenge omonyakieni mono.

English: If he is presenting a lamb for his offering, he must present it before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kama akimtoa mwana-kondoo, atamleta mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onye okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye, erio ayerue ase obosio bwane.

English: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
Kiswahili: Mungu anatawala juu ya mataifa, Mungu ameketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kere egechenu.

English: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.
Kiswahili: kwa wewe napondaponda mwanaume na mwanamke, kwa wewe napondaponda mzee na kijana, kwa wewe napondaponda kijana wa kiume na mwanamwali,
Ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore abasacha na abakungu, ninsamunyore abanto abagotu na abake, ninsamunyore abamura na abaiseke;

English: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”
Ekegusii: Korende magega y'okobooka kw'ane, nimbatang'anere kogenda Galili.”

English: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ueni kabisa chochote kilicho ndani yenu cha asili ya kidunia: yaani uasherati, uchafu, tamaa mbaya, mawazo mabaya na ulafi, ambayo ndiyo ibada ya sanamu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo moite kende gionsi ekio kere ime yaino ekio kere egi’ense: obotomani, eubi, okorengereria okobe, okogania okobe, na obwegimeria, engencho yaye ogosasiima emegwekano.

English: Then He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones come to life?” “O Lord GOD,” I replied, “only You know.”
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Mwanadamu, mifupa hii yaweza kuishi?” Nikajibu, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, wewe peke yako wajua.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, amauga aya nanyare koba moyo?” Nkairaneria, nkamoteebia: “Aye Omonene, naye omanyete.”

English: you will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuja na ngurumo, tetemeko la ardhi, na kwa sauti kuu, atakuja na dhoruba, tufani na miali ya moto iteketezayo.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria ’omorero ogosamba.

English: The brothers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy remained in Berea.
Kiswahili: Mara hiyo, wale ndugu wakamsafirisha Paulo hadi pwani, lakini Sila na Timotheo wakabaki Beroya.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima abaminto baria bagatoma Paulo agende goika nyancha, korende Sila na Timotheo bagatigara aroro.

English: Raise a banner on a barren hilltop; call aloud to them. Wave your hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.
Kiswahili: Twekeni bendera juu ya mlima usio na kitu, wapazieni sauti, wapungieni mkono waingie katika malango ya wenye heshima.
Ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera igoro ase egetunwa getari na mete; aka eriogi rinene ase abasikari, basime namaboko basoe ase ebiita bi’abaanto abasike.

English: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msiutupe ujasiri wenu, kwa maana una thawabu kubwa mno.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.

English: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don't believe. The works that I do in my Father's name, these testify about me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimewaambia, lakini hamwamini. Mambo ninayoyatenda kwa jina la Baba yangu yananishuhudia.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.

English: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw'Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

English: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana alipoanza kuzungumza kupitia Hosea, Bwana alimwambia, “Nenda ukajitwalie mwanamke wa uzinzi na watoto wa uzinzi, kwa sababu nchi ina hatia ya uzinzi wa kupindukia kwa kumwacha Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Agwo ekero Omonene achagete gokwana goetera ase Hosea, Omonene akamoteebia iga: “Genda onyuome omokungu omotayayi, onyore abana b’obotayayi, ekiagera ense eye yantigire inche Omonene ase ogokora obotayayi obonene.”

English: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
Kiswahili: Yeye awafanyaye watu kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na hao ambao hufanywa watakatifu, wote hutoka katika jamaa moja. Hivyo Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo babwate ise oyomo. Nakio gekogera Yeso atari korora obosoku kobaroka abamwabo.

English: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
Kiswahili: na yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza, hana budi kuwa mtumwa wa wote.
Ekegusii: Na omonto orarigie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, nabe omosomba o bonsi.

English: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.
Kiswahili: Nahuzunika kwa ajili yako, Yonathani ndugu yangu, kwangu ulikuwa mpendwa sana. Upendo wako kwangu ulikuwa wa ajabu, wa ajabu zaidi kuliko ule wa wanawake.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yonathani ominto, nigo inde nomoichano omonene ase engencho yao, aye nigo konya ongogetie mono. Ase inde obwanchani bwao nigo bwarenge obonene kobua obwanchani bw'abakuungu.

English: The elders of the congregation are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD, and it shall be slaughtered before the LORD.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa jumuiya wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali aliye mbele za Bwana, naye fahali atachinjwa mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase obosio bwane abagaaka b’omoganda oria goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio, na ero enyenyerwe agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi mtesi alivyokudhihaki, jinsi watu wapumbavu walivyolitukana jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna ababisa bagendererete kogochecheria, na abatakoirogeti nigo bagendererete korama erieta riao.

English: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, yeyote miongoni mwenu akipotoka na kuicha kweli, naye akarejezwa na mtu mwingine,
Ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto onde oino oteanire korwa ase ekeene, na monto onde amoiranie,

English: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
Kiswahili: “Basi, baada ya kutokuwepo kwa miaka mingi nilikuja Yerusalemu ili kuwaletea watu wangu msaada kwa ajili ya maskini na kutoa dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Bono yaetire emiaka etai meke ngacha ndetere abanto b’egesaku kiane ebiegwa, naende indue chisadaka.

English: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya watu wako Israeli kuwa watu wako wewe mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee Bwana Mungu, umekuwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.

English: Behold, the Gentiles are assembled together against us to destroy us. You know what things they imagine against us.
Kiswahili: Tazama, mataifa wamekusanyika pamoja dhidi yetu ili kutuangamiza. Unajua wanachopanga dhidi yetu.
Ekegusii: Rora bono, abanto b'ebisaku basangererekanire batosirie; naye nomanyete emeroberio eyio emebe bakorire mamincha yaito.

English: They will speak among themselves repenting, and for distress of spirit they will groan, “This was he whom we used to hold in derision, as a parable of reproach.
Kiswahili: Watasema wao kwa wao wakitubu, na kwa huzuni ya roho wataugua, "Huyu ndiye tuliyemdhihaki, kama mfano wa lawama."
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbaangame nagweitia ase emioyo yabo bagoteeba,

English: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
Kiswahili: “Tazama, naja upesi! Amebarikiwa yeye ayashikaye maneno ya unabii wa kitabu hiki.”
Ekegusii: Rigereria, ninchiche bwango.” Nasesenirie ere oyorendete amang'ana 'obobani, ayarikire ase egetabu eke.

English: If you don't quickly prevent them, they will do greater things than these, and you won't be able to control them.
Kiswahili: Usipowazuia haraka, watafanya mambo makubwa kuliko haya, na hutaweza kuwadhibiti.
Ekegusii: Aye otakoreti bwango ase okobatanga rirorio barabwo inabakore amange naye tokonyara kobatanga.”

English: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ninajisifu katika Kristo Yesu, kwenye utumishi wangu kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Bono ninde n'engencho y'okweenenia ime ya Kristo Yeso ase emeremo y'ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikubali fidia yoyote ya kuokoa uhai wa muuaji ambaye anastahili kufa. Mtu huyo hakika lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oitire omonto onde moeneno takoegerwa aruerwe embooria. Omoiti oria onyorekanire n'okomocha kw'ogoita, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Utumishi wao wote ukiwa ni kuchukua au wa kufanya kazi nyingine, utafanyika chini ya maelekezo ya Aroni na wanawe. Mtawapangia kama wajibu wao yote watakayoyafanya.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye nabwo barachike Abagerisoni ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria, na onsi aya barakore; inwe mobatige batenenere ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria.

English: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa na uhakika wa mambo haya, nilitaka nije kwenu kwanza, ili mpate faida mara mbili.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera narenge nobomaene obo nkarigia gocha ase more agwo ritang’ani, erinde monyore ogosesenigwa ara kabere.

English: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia mfalme, “Taarifa niliyosikia kwenye nchi yangu mwenyewe kuhusu mafanikio na hekima yako ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Eting'ana eria egateebia omorwoti: “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y'emeremo yao, na obong'aini bwao, nechi'ekeene bori.

English: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, declare Yourself to be God.”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hatukupigi mawe kwa sababu ya mambo mema uliyotenda, bali ni kwa kuwa umekufuru. Wewe ingawa ni mwanadamu unajifanya kuwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng’a naye Nyasae.”

English: Fire, hail, famine, and death— all these are created for vengeance—
Kiswahili: Moto, mvua ya mawe, njaa, na kifo—haya yote yameumbwa kwa ajili ya kulipiza kisasi—
Ekegusii: Omorero, embura yamagena, enchara n'oborwaire; ebi bionsi nigo biatongetwe bibae Mwanyabaanto egesusuro.

English: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:
Kiswahili: Walikuwa njiani wakipanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Yesu alikuwa ametangulia. Wanafunzi wake walishangaa, nao watu waliowafuata walijawa na hofu. Yesu akawachukua tena wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia yatakayompata.
Ekegusii: Bakaba inchera, bagotiira kogenda Yerusalemu. Yeso nigo arenge obatang’aine, na barabwo bagaichana, na abamotunyanete bakairoka. Naende akaira baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobateebia ebirage bi’amang’ana agochia komonyoora,

English: “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites have consecrated to Me, so that they do not profane My holy name. I am the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe kushughulikia kwa uangalifu sadaka takatifu Waisraeli wanazoziweka wakfu kwangu, ili wasilinajisi Jina langu takatifu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Kwana na Aroni na abamura baye, obateebie ng’a barende na bakore amasikani ase ebinto ebichenu, biria Abaisraeli bagwaatanana ase ’nde, erio tibaabaisa korenta obosooku ase erieta riane richenu. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
Kiswahili: “Je, sheria zetu zinaturuhusu kumhukumu mtu kabla ya kumsikiliza na kufahamu alilotenda?”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ogochika gwaito nkonachera kore omonto ekiina ritang'ani totaramoigwa na komanya egiakora?”

English: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.
Kiswahili: Naye Yosefu na mama yake mtoto wakastaajabu kwa yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa kumhusu huyo mtoto.
Ekegusii: Ise na ng’ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.

English: at twilight, as the day was fading into the dark of the night.
Kiswahili: wakati wa machweo, jua likipungua nuru yake, giza la usiku lilipokuwa likiingia.
Ekegusii: mogoroba kobokomura‐mura, ekero ki’omosuunte bw’obotuko.

English: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
Kiswahili: Hutuma amri yake duniani, neno lake hukimbia kasi.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotoma amachiiko aye goocha ase ense, ne ring'ana riaye riaranda bwango.

English: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”
Kiswahili: Timotheo, linda kile kilichowekwa amana kwako. Epuka majadiliano yasiyo ya utauwa na mabishano ambayo kwa uongo huitwa elimu,
Ekegusii: Aye Timotheo, renda aya abekirwe ase ore. Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na korwa ase okoamererania ase aya akorokwa chisemi, korende nay’oborimo.

English: So then, it does not depend on man’s desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo haitegemei kutaka kwa mwanadamu au jitihada, bali hutegemea huruma ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, tari ng’a nigo ere ase ogwancha kw’omonto, gose nokw’oria ogokora omokia, korende nokw’oria okororera amaabera, nere Nyasae.

English: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi, Geueli mwana wa Maki.
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Geueli, mosinto o Maki.

English: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu aliwapa hawa watu kipawa kile kile alichotupa sisi tuliomwamini Bwana Yesu Kristo, mimi ni nani hata nifikirie kuwa ningeweza kumpinga Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye Nyasae obaeire barabwo ekeegwa keria keria atoete intwe, ekero twamwegenete Omenene oito Yeso Kristo, inche ninche ng'o, ndanyaare koamereria Nyasae?”

English: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.
Kiswahili: Watu wenye hekima na wasihiri waliletwa mbele yangu ili kusoma maandishi haya na kuniambia maana yake, lakini hawakuweza kunifafanulia.
Ekegusii: Bono abanto abang'aini na abarogi mbarentwa ase obosio bwane basome amariiko aya, naende banteebie engencho yaye, korende tibanyarete gonteebia engencho y'amang'ana aya.

English: You should have kept your feet from going bare and your throat from being thirsty. But you said, ‘It is hopeless! For I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.’
Kiswahili: Usikimbie hadi miguu yako iwe haina viatu, na koo lako liwe limekauka. Lakini ulisema, ‘Haina maana! Ninaipenda miungu ya kigeni, nami lazima niifuatie.’
Ekegusii: Renda amagoro aino, timobaisa koba motari nebikoroto, naende timobaisa koba nerang’o. Korende inwe nigo mogoteeba: Ayio namang’ana abosa; nigo twanchete chinyasae chingeni, na echio chioka nachio torabe tokobwatia. Abaisraeli mbagwenerete konyora egesusuro

English: If the clouds are full, they will pour out rain upon the earth; whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where it falls, there it will lie.
Kiswahili: Kama mawingu yamejaa maji, hunyesha mvua juu ya nchi. Kama mti ukianguka kuelekea kusini au kuelekea kaskazini, mahali ulipoangukia, hapo ndipo utakapolala.
Ekegusii: Amare gaichoire nembura, nigo embura eyio egotwa igoro ase ense, na omote koragwe ororie ensemo ya Irianyi gose eya sugusu, nigo oragenderere kobeera inse agwo ase ogwete.

English: But if he doesn't listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hatakusikiliza, nenda na mtu mwingine mmoja au wawili ili kila neno lithibitishwe kwa ushahidi wa mashahidi wawili au watatu.
Ekegusii: Korende atagotegerereti, ira omonto oyomo, gose babere, mogende asare mwensi, ng'a kera ring'ana rinyare gwancheranwa ase oborori bwa babere gose batato.

English: Though seeing many things, you do not keep watch. Though your ears are open, you do not hear.”
Kiswahili: Mmeona vitu vingi, lakini hamkuzingatia; masikio yenu yako wazi, lakini hamsikii chochote.”
Ekegusii: Omosomba one nigo akorora ebinto ebinge, korende tari kobirengereria ng’a nebi’engencho enene; nigo atinogete amato aye, korende tari koigwa.”

English: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
Kiswahili: Palikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe lililokuwa likilisha karibu kando ya kilima.
Ekegusii: Aria ase egetunwa ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche riare korisia.

English: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Kiswahili: Kwa mifano mingine mingi kama hii Yesu alinena nao neno lake, kwa kadiri walivyoweza kulielewa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaranderia abanto ring'ana riaye ase emebayeeno emenge ere buna eye; nigo arenge gokwana ring'ana ase bare, koreng'ana buna baare konyara koigwa,

English: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengenezea hayo madhabahu wavu wa shaba, na utengeneze pete za shaba kwenye kila moja ya hizo pembe nne za huo wavu.
Ekegusii: Okore boigo egechungi gi’etai na obeke chibonyi inye chie chitaai ase chikoona chiaye inye.

English: Others were saying, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our homes to get grain during the famine.”
Kiswahili: Wengine walikuwa wakisema, “Tunaweka rehani mashamba yetu, mashamba ya mizabibu, na nyumba zetu ili tupate nafaka wakati wa njaa.”
Ekegusii: Boigo abande bagateeba, “Intwe nkobeeka tore amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y’emesabibu, ne chinyomba chiaito, bionsi bibe intenenera; bono otoe endagera, ekiagera tore nenchara.”

English: Have regard for your name, for it continues with you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold.
Kiswahili: Liheshimu jina lako, maana linadumu nawe kwa muda mrefu kuliko hazina elfu moja kubwa za dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Aye oria erieta riao ri'esiko ekiagera rirorio inarigotigarere, inarimenye goetania emonga elifu eyemo y'echitaabu.

English: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
Kiswahili: Kabila la Gadi litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Gadi ni Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli.
Ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abagadi. Eliasafu, mosinto o Reueli, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, haki yenu isipozidi haki ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, kamwe hamtaingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, onye oboronge bwaino tibokobua obw'aborokia b'amariiko na Abafarisai, timogosoa nonya ng'ake ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

English: Even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father. The Second Prediction of the Passion (Matthew 17:22–23; Mark 9:30–32)
Kiswahili: Hata yule mtoto alipokuwa akija, yule pepo mchafu akamwangusha, akamtia kifafa. Lakini Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu amtoke, akamponya yule mtoto, na akamrudisha kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Agachia koba nkomochiera are ekerecha keria gekamoigusia na komoiyeria. Yeso agakania ekerecha keria, akagwenia omomura oria, akamoirania ase ise.

English: they blessed the Lord who acted marvelously for his own place. The temple, which a little before was full of terror and alarm, was filled with joy and gladness after the Almighty Lord appeared.
Kiswahili: Walimsifu Bwana aliyetenda kwa ajabu kwa ajili ya mahali pake. Hekalu, ambalo hapo awali lilikuwa limejaa hofu na hofu, lilijaa furaha na shangwe baada ya Bwana Mwenyezi kuonekana.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamotogia Omonene oyio okorete amakumia ase engencho y'amasikani ye Hekalu yaye. Bono agwo ase Hekalu abanto abwo baichanete bare n'obwoba bakagoka mono na gochengera ayio.

English: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
Kiswahili: Yeye naye aliwatamani Waashuru, watawala na majemadari, mashujaa waliovalia sare, wapandao farasi, wanaume vijana wote waliovutia.
Ekegusii: Akaba nokogania okobe ase abamura b'Abaasuri, abwo barenge abagaambi, na abachiiki, na abarwani b'esegi beboeranetie ebirwanero, na abariini be chibarasi. Bonsi nigo barenge abamura abaya b'ogosanerwa.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Baasha, along with his accomplishments and might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
Kiswahili: Kwa matukio mengine ya utawala wa Baasha, aliyoyafanya na mafanikio yake, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Baasa, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli.

English: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu alikuwa baba wa Isaki. Wana wa Isaki walikuwa: Esau na Israeli.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaibora Isaka. Abana abamura ba Isaka nabwo Esau na Israeli.

English: Some time later at Gob, there was another battle with the Philistines. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, kukawa na vita nyingine na Wafilisti, huko Gobu. Wakati huo Sibekai, Mhushathi, akamuua Safu, mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio esegi in’yareenge ase Abaisraeli n’Abafilisti aria Gobu, na Sibeekai Omohusa agaita Safu, oyomo bw’amamonto.

English: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
Kiswahili: Lakini wema na upendo wa Mungu Mwokozi wetu ulipofunuliwa,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero oboitongo na obwanchani bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito bwaorogetigwe,

English: When they didn't find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
Kiswahili: Lakini walipowakosa wakamburuta Yasoni na ndugu wengine mbele ya maafisa wa mji, wakipiga kelele: “Watu hawa ni wale walioupindua ulimwengu wamekuja huku,
Ekegusii: Ekero batabanyora, bagakurura Yasoni na abande baminto gochia ase abanene b'omochie, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba abaonchoranire ense baikire nonya naa,

English: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs. The Cities of Judah
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Naomba unifanyie jambo moja la hisani. Kwa kuwa umenipa ardhi huko Negebu, nipe pia chemchemi za maji.” Basi Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na za chini. Miji Ya Yuda
Ekegusii: Asika akairaneria, “Nekeegwa ntagete, ekiagera ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ong’e chinsoko chi’amaache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsoko chia rogoro amo nechia maate. Emechie y’Abayuda

English: Because the whole world before you is as a grain in a balance, and as a drop of dew that comes down upon the earth in the morning.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ulimwengu wote ulio mbele yako ni kama punje katika mizani, na kama tone la umande linaloshuka juu ya ardhi asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Ase ore ense engima nigo enga buna enyeke eyemo ase eratiri; nigo enga buna entonyi yerimi ria mambia.

English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
Kiswahili: na vito vya shohamu na vito vingine vya thamani vya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kile kifuko cha kifuani.
Ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande, akobekwa ase egesibao ki'Omokuani na ase egesembe kiaye.

English: “Micah the Moreshite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and told all the people of Judah that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.’
Kiswahili: “Mika Mmoreshethi alitoa unabii katika siku za Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda. Akawaambia watu wote wa Yuda, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “ ‘Sayuni italimwa kama shamba, Yerusalemu itakuwa lundo la kokoto, na kilima cha Hekalu kitakuwa kichuguu kilichofunikwa na vichaka.’
Ekegusii: “Ekero Hezekia arenge omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Mika korwa Mosereti nabaanete, agateebia Abayuda bonsi: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire: “Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo okoremwa Yerusalemu nobe ebinge chi’amaturi, na egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene nkebe egetunwa kie rinani.

English: Don't neglect the discourse of the wise. Be conversant with their proverbs; for from them you will learn discipline and how to serve great men.
Kiswahili: Usipuuze mazungumzo ya wenye hekima. Fahamu methali zao; maana kutoka kwao utajifunza nidhamu na jinsi ya kuwatumikia wakuu.
Ekegusii: Toibaisa gochaya emeroberio y'abanto abang'aini, korende bwenarie korwa ase emereng'anio yabo, erio nario oranyare gokorera abanene.

English: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
Kiswahili: naye atamfanyia fahali huyu kama alivyomfanyia yule fahali mwingine wa sadaka ya dhambi. Kwa njia hii kuhani atawafanyia watu upatanisho, nao watasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo arakore eeri eyio buna akorete eeri eria ye ritang'ani y'ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase bare, na barabwo nabaaberwe.

English: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
Kiswahili: wakitangaza, “ Bwana ni mkamilifu; yeye ni Mwamba wangu, na ndani yake hamna uovu.”
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akworokia ng’a Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere nere egetare kiane, na obokorekanu tibori ime yaye.

English: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
Kiswahili: lakini palikuwa bado makabila saba ya Israeli ambayo yalikuwa hayajapokea urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Korende ebisaku bitano na bibere mbiatigarete bitatananeretwe ensemo y'ense ebe omwando obo.

English: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Akalifunika kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na kulizungushia ukingo wa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Akayeooma netaabu echenire, ime na isiko, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Koraroisie chibao echio, oroisie emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: For he said, “Let's go beforehand to make peace with them, before he makes peace with Alexander against us;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana alisema, "Tutangulie kufanya amani nao, kabla hajafanya amani na Aleksanda dhidi yetu;"
Ekegusii: ere nigo asemeretie amonyoore na boigo koroisia omoroberio bw'omorembe amo na Abayahudi erio Alekisanda ataraika koroisia okobwatana nabwo mamincha yaye.

English: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men,
Kiswahili: Katika ngome ya Shushani Wayahudi waliua na kuangamiza wanaume 500.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase eburi ya Susa, Abayahudi bagaita abanto amagana atano, bakabasiria.

English: And Jeroboam appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat demons and calf idols he had made.
Kiswahili: Naye akawa amechagua makuhani wake mwenyewe kwa ajili ya mahali pa juu pa kuabudia sanamu za mbuzi na za ndama ambazo alikuwa ametengeneza.
Ekegusii: Agachora abakuani baye b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na ab’ebirecha, na ab’emegwekano ye chimori chiria aroisetie.

English: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”
Kiswahili: naam, hakika nimekujengea Hekalu zuri sana, mahali pako pa kuishi milele.”
Ekegusii: Bono nakoagacheire enyomba ebe obomenyo bwao, aase oramenye kogenderera botambe.”

English: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuwasha moto katikati ya ua na kuketi pamoja, Petro naye akaketi pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Bagachia gouta omorero egati y’egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.

English: Finding a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we boarded it and set sail.
Kiswahili: Hapo tukapata meli iliyokuwa inavuka kwenda Foinike tukapanda tukasafiri nayo.
Ekegusii: Tokanyoora emeeri eyeranyaare kwamboka goika Foiniki, tokariina emeeri eria, tokagenda.

English: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
Kiswahili: Humjalia mwanamke tasa kutulia nyumbani mwake, akiwa mama watoto mwenye furaha. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoa omokungu omogomba chinguru chi’okoibora, oba n’omogooko ase obomenyo bwaye. Omonene atogigwe!

English: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati lile wingu la moshi lilipoanza kupanda kutoka ule mji, Wabenyamini wakageuka na kuona moshi wa mji mzima unapaa juu angani.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero ekemanyererio keria kie rikundesi ri'erioki kiarorekanete korwa ase omochie oria, Ababenjamini bakarigereria magega, bagakumia korora omochie omogima okoyia, na erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.

English: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin. But caraway is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
Kiswahili: Iliki haipurwi kwa nyundo, wala gurudumu la gari halivingirishwi juu ya jira; iliki hupurwa kwa fimbo, na jira kwa ufito.
Ekegusii: Dili teri koorerwa nekeoorero gi’ekioma, gose komini teri koorwa namagoro e chigari, korende bionsi bibere nigo bigosusurerwa omote.

English: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain you; how much less this house that I have built!
Kiswahili: “Lakini kweli, je, Mungu atafanya makao duniani? Mbingu, hata mbingu zilizo juu sana, haziwezi kukutosha wewe. Sembuse Hekalu hili nililojenga!
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nekeene ng'a aye Nyasae nonyare komenya aa ase ense eye? Rora, igoro na igoro aare mono tekogoisana omenye, naki rende enyomba eye inche nakoagacheire eragoisane?

English: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa kama bundi wa jangwani, kama bundi kwenye magofu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inga buna etigere ere ase erooro, gose buna enyakweumia etigarete komenya aase amatuuri.

English: We will grant you many immunities and give you gifts.
Kiswahili: Tutakupa kinga nyingi na kukupa zawadi.
Ekegusii: Intwe intobaruuserie ebango enyinge na kobaa ogwanchererigwa ase ebinto ao ao.

English: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu akipanga na kumuua mwingine kwa makusudi, mwondoe katika madhabahu yangu na kumuua.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto ogoita oyomwabo mweno ase obong'ainereria, ere goika aitwe akwe, naisa gotamera egesasiimero kiane.

English: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.
Kiswahili: Maneno yatokayo kinywani mwa mtu mwenye hekima yana neema, bali mpumbavu huangamizwa na midomo yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana akorua ase omonto omong'aini nigo akogera bwanchwa, korende aya akorua ase ebikoba bi'omoriri nigo akomosiria.

English: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wa Israeli wakagawanyika katika makundi mawili, nusu wakamuunga mkono Tibni mwana wa Ginathi ili awe mfalme na nusu nyingine wakamuunga mkono Omri.
Ekegusii: Bono Abaisraeli bagaatananeka chinsemo ibere, ekeng'ese ki'abaanto bagatunyana Tibuni, mosinto o Ginati, baganetie komobeeka abe omorwoti, na ekeng'ese kende bagatunyana Omuri.

English: At that time all the people gathered together in the square before the Water Gate, and they asked Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.
Kiswahili: watu wote wakakusanyika kama mtu mmoja kwenye uwanja mbele ya Lango la Maji. Wakamwambia Ezra mwandishi alete Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mose, ambacho Bwana aliamuru kwa ajili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bonsi bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagasangererekana ase eraaro agwo bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, bagateebia Ezra, oria orenge omworokia bw’amachiiko, arente Egetabu ki’Amachiko, a Musa, ayio Omonene aruete ase Abaisraeli.

English: What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?
Kiswahili: Yanihusu nini kuwahukumu wale watu walio nje ya kanisa? Je, si mnapaswa kuwahukumu hao walio ndani?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ninche ngwenerete kogambia abare isiko? Na inwe timogwenereti kogambia abare ekanisa ime?

English: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
Kiswahili: “Hekalu nitakalolijenga litakuwa kubwa, kwa sababu Mungu wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu mingine yote.
Ekegusii: Enyomba inche ngochia koagacha nigo erabe enene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nomonene goetania chinyasae chinde chionsi.

English: In the morning his spirit was troubled, so he summoned all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi yake, alifadhaika akilini, hivyo akawaita waaguzi wote pamoja na watu wenye busara wa Misri. Walipokuja, Farao akawaeleza ndoto zake, lakini hakuna hata mmoja aliyeweza kumfasiria.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia mambia, akaba oichaanete, agatoma abanto barangerie abaringoria bonsi ba Misiri na abanto abang’aini bonsi abaarengeo. Farao akabateebia chindoto chiaye, korende onde tatogete ore konyara komoteebia engencho ye chindoto echio.

English: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
Kiswahili: Upendo huvumilia yote, huamini yote, hutumaini yote, hustahimili yote.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria onsi, bwegeena onsi, bosemeria onsi, bobogoria onsi.

English: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
Kiswahili: Mchana ulipokuwa umeendelea sana, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, nazo saa zimekwenda sana.
Ekegusii: Goika chinsa chinyinge chi'omobaso chigaeta, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, na bono riagorobire.

English: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers' households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh's covenant out of David's city, which is Zion.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mfalme Solomoni akawaita mbele zake huko Yerusalemu wazee wa Israeli, viongozi wote wa makabila na wakuu wa jamaa za Waisraeli, ili walilete Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka Sayuni, Mji wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria amo abagaaka b'Abaisraeli, na abatang'ani bonsi b'ebisaku biabo, na baria barenge abaraai be chiamate chi'Abaisraeli, bache ase obosio bwaye agwo Yerusalemu, erinde bagende Sayoni, Omochie o Daudi, kwoyia Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw'Omonene.

English: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
Kiswahili: Adui wanaonitesa ni wengi, lakini mimi sitaziacha sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Abagonchaanda na abare ababisa baane nigo bare abange, korende tinkogobera ase okorwa oborori bwao.

English: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,
Kiswahili: kama wakikugeukia kwa moyo wao wote na nafsi zao katika nchi ya adui zao ambao waliwachukua mateka, wakakuomba kuelekea nchi uliyowapa baba zao, kuelekea mji uliouchagua na Hekalu nililolijenga kwa ajili ya Jina lako;
Ekegusii: Onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria y'ababisa babo, baria baboosete, na aroro bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasiima erieta riao,

English: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
Kiswahili: Wanafundisha desturi ambazo sisi raiya wa Kirumi hatuwezi kuzikubali au kuzitimiza.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo bakworokereria chingencho chitari boronge ng'a tochianche gose gochienaria, ekiagera intwe n'Abarumi tore.”

English: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
Kiswahili: Yafungue macho yangu nipate kuona mambo ya ajabu katika sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Ndamokie amaiso, inyare korora amang’ana y’ogokumia y’amachiiko ao.

English: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.
Kiswahili: Mpe kwa ukarimu na ufanye hivyo bila kinyongo moyoni, ndipo kwa sababu ya hili Bwana Mungu wenu atakubariki katika kazi zako zote na kwa kila kitu utakachokiwekea mkono wako.
Ekegusii: Momoe ebinto ase ogwancha, na timoba ne'ribero ekero mokomoa. Ekero morarue igo, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabasesenie ase emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora.

English: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
Kiswahili: “Tena mmesikia walivyoambiwa watu wa zamani kwamba, ‘Usiape kwa uongo, bali timiza kiapo kile ulichofanya kwa Bwana.’
Ekegusii: Naende mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare mbateebetigwe: Totiana bosa, korende oikeranerie ase Omonene chiira chiao.

English: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa, to the women's house, to the custody of Hegai the king's eunuch, keeper of the women. Let cosmetics be given them;
Kiswahili: Mfalme na ateue maafisa katika kila jimbo la himaya yake kuwaleta hao wanawali wote wazuri wa sura katika nyumba ya wanawake katika ngome ya mji wa Shushani. Kisha wawekwe chini ya utunzaji wa Hegai, towashi wa mfalme, msimamizi wa wanawake; na wapewe matunzo yote ya urembo.
Ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, chora abateneneri ase chingongo chionsi chi'obogambi bwao obachike basangererie abaiseke abekungi abare abanyabieni, baabarente ase enyomba y'abakungu ere agwo ase eburi ya Susa. Barabwo babekwe inse y'oborendi bwa Hegai, omokoreri oria ogombaetigwe, oyio otenenerete abakungu bamenyete ase enyomba yao. Abaiseke abwo baegwe amaguta abo bakweaka.

English: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of fine leather. I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
Kiswahili: Nikakuvika vazi lililotariziwa na kukuvalisha viatu vya kamba vya ngozi. Nikakuvika nguo za kitani safi na kukufunika kwa mavazi ya thamani kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ngakobekera eanga eroisirie ere nebieni ao ao, ngakobekera na ebikoroto bie risankwa riterere ri’eng’iti ya rooche. Ngakoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani engiya, naende ngakobekera egietubo ki’ariri.

English: “As soon as I leave you,” Moses said, “I will pray to the LORD, so that tomorrow the swarms of flies will depart from Pharaoh and his officials and his people. But Pharaoh must not act deceitfully again by refusing to let the people go and sacrifice to the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Mose akajibu, “Mara tu nitakapoondoka, nitamwomba Bwana na kesho mainzi yataondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake. Hakikisha tu kwamba Farao hatatenda kwa udanganyifu tena kwa kutokuwaachia watu waende kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.”
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Bono buna nkorua asore nimosabe Omonene arusie chingi korwa asore aye Farao, na ase abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, ankio mambia. Korende aye Farao, tokora obong’ainereria naende, na kwanga koa abanto ribaga bagende baruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

English: Don't they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
Kiswahili: Je, si wao wanaolikufuru Jina lile lililo bora sana mliloitiwa?
Ekegusii: Tari barabwo abwo bakorama erieta erio rigiya mwarokirwe inwe?

English: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa kuwa tunajua kumcha Bwana, tunajitahidi kuwavuta wengine. Lakini Mungu anatufahamu dhahiri, nami natumaini kwamba tu dhahiri katika dhamiri zenu pia.
Ekegusii: Nabo gatwamanyire komoiroka Omonene, twateemire kong'usa abanto; korende twamanyekanire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na inche nasemeirie ng'a twamanyekanire ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaino ime boigo.

English: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukaendelea mashariki hadi Gath-Heferi na kufika Eth-Kasini, ukatokea Rimoni na kugeuka kuelekea Nea.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Gati‐Heferi na Eta‐Kasini, rokagenda gochia Rimoni, rokaonchoka gochia Nea.

English: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akainuka na akasujudu mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi, yaani Wahiti.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka, agatugama inse ase amasio ’Abahiti, abanto b’ense eria.

English: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mahali pa juu pa kuabudia hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa kafara na kufukiza uvumba huko. Yothamu akajenga upya Lango la Juu la Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agatigwa kobao; abanto bakagenderera korua ebing'wanso na gosambera ubani igoro y'aase agwo. Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki'enyomba y'Omonene.

English: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
Kiswahili: Njiani wakawa wanaulizana wao kwa wao, “Ni nani atakayetuvingirishia lile jiwe kutoka kwenye ingilio la kaburi?”
Ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning'o oranyare gototigereria rigena riria korwa ase egesieri ki'oboina?”

English: So Aaron told them, “Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.”
Kiswahili: Aroni akawajibu, “Vueni vipuli vya dhahabu ambavyo wake zenu, wana wenu na binti zenu wamevaa, mkaniletee.”
Ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitaabu bire ase amato ’abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”

English: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
Kiswahili: Mkono mtakatifu wa Bwana umefunuliwa machoni pa mataifa yote, nayo miisho yote ya dunia itaona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene oorokirie okoboko kwaye ogochenu ase amaiso ebisaku bionsi, ne chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense nchirore ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.

English: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Shalumu mwana wa Kore, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora, pamoja na mabawabu wenzake kutoka jamaa yake ya Kora waliwajibika kulinda malango ya Hema, kama vile baba zao walivyokuwa wamewajibika kulinda ingilio la Maskani ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Kore bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora, amo nabaanto bande b’eamate yaye, nabwo Abakora, nigo barenge abateneneri bokorenda ase Ebiita bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano, buna chisokoro chiabo chiarenge korenda ase egesoero ki’egetwori ki’Omonene.

English: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Moses, and He said, “Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well, and he is now on his way to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
Kiswahili: Ndipo hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Mose, akamwambia, “Vipi kuhusu ndugu yako, Aroni Mlawi? Ninajua yeye anaweza kuzungumza vizuri. Naye yuko tayari njiani kukulaki, na moyo wake utafurahi wakati atakapokuona.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu ekoberoroka ase Musa, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aroni momura omino, oria Omolawi, takaiyo? Nimanyete ng’a ere nere omonto omanyete gokwana buya. Naama! Ngocha are gokorotota; ere ekero arakorore nasasoke ase enkoro yaye.

English: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant speech promotes instruction.
Kiswahili: Wenye hekima moyoni huitwa wenye ufahamu, na maneno ya kupendeza huchochea mafundisho.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye narokwe omomanyi, ne chinkwana chingiya nigo chikomenta chiseemi.

English: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini basi walimu wa sheria husema kwamba ni lazima Eliya aje kwanza?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Nase ki rende aborokia b'amariiko bagoteeba ng'a negwenerete Elija ache ritang'ani?”

English: how he entered into God's house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
Kiswahili: Aliingia ndani ya nyumba ya Mungu, akaichukua na kuila ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, ambayo ni halali kuliwa na makuhani peke yao. Naye pia akawapa wenzake.”
Ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akabogoria na koria emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani boka, naende akaa abwo barenge amo nere?”

English: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji wa makimbilio) na Gezeri,
Ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie bw'obotamero ase ense y'Efraimu na Geseri,

English: “‘As the bad figs, which can't be eaten, they are so bad,' surely Yahweh says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama zilivyo zile tini dhaifu, ambazo ni mbovu mno zisizofaa kuliwa,' asema Bwana, ‘ndivyo nitakavyomtendea Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda, maafisa wake na mabaki wengine kutoka Yerusalemu, wawe wamebaki katika nchi hii, au wanaishi Misri.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Korende Zedekia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, amo nabanene b'oborwoti bwaye, na abanto ba Yerusalemu nigo baratigare ase ense eye, na baria bamenyete Misiri nimbakore babe buna amako ayio amabe atanyare koriegwa.

English: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.
Kiswahili: Ee upanga, kata upande wa kuume, kisha upande wa kushoto, mahali popote makali yako yatakapoelekezwa.
Ekegusii: Ebeeke ang'e oetere, orenge ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi, aande onsi ase obwoge bochigete.

English: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa ataolewa baada ya kuweka nadhiri au baada ya midomo yake kutamka ahadi fulani bila kufikiri akawa amejifunga hivyo,
Ekegusii: “Omoiseke oria onye onyuomirwe nomosaacha ritang'ani ataraikerania eira ariete, gose amang'ana akwanete ase ogotarengereria,

English: And there was great excitement throughout all the camp, for her coming was reported among the tents. They came and surrounded her as she stood outside Holofernes' tent, until they told him about her.
Kiswahili: Kukawa na msisimko mkubwa katika kambi yote, kwani kuja kwake kuliripotiwa miongoni mwa mahema. Walikuja na kumzunguka alipokuwa amesimama nje ya hema la Holoferne, hadi walipomwambia habari zake.
Ekegusii: Asa ekambi yonsi chinkuma chigaeta bwango egetwori ase egetwori igoro yogoocha kwa Yuditi. Ekero Yuditi ateneine isiko yegetwori kia Holoferne aganyete aariganigwe gosoa magega Holoferne gateebigwe amang'ana aye, abarwani abange ba Abaashuru bagaika na komoonchokana Yuditi.

English: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
Kiswahili: “Mara baada ya dhiki ya siku zile, “ ‘jua litatiwa giza, nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake; nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.'
Ekegusii: Korende bwango magega y'emechando y'amatuko aria, erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara, ne ching'enang'eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.

English: Let that man be as the cities which Yahweh overthrew, and didn't repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo na awe kama miji ile ambayo Bwana Mungu aliiangamiza bila huruma. Yeye na asikie maombolezo asubuhi na kilio cha vita adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio, tiga abe buna emechie eri'Omonene asiretie atari namaabera. Oyio tiga aigwe ebirero bi'obororo mambia, na amariogi'okogoswa mobaso gati,

English: For all this, none of them ever put on a crown, neither did they clothe themselves with purple, as a display of grandeur.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na haya yote, hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyewahi kuvaa taji, wala hawakujivika zambarau, kama onyesho la ukuu.
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo, tarenge Omoroma oyomo origetie gokiinia ekerogo kiaye ere omonyene gose kweboyia chianga chi'abarwoti chimonyinga ase ogwetang'anania.

English: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwaaga, akaenda zake mlimani peke yake kuomba. Jioni ilipofika, Yesu alikuwa huko peke yake.
Ekegusii: Na nyuma kaeire emeganda ribaga kogenda, akariina ebitunwa igoro ere bweka gochia gosaba. Riachia koba mogoroba akaba agwo bweka.

English: Every debt owed to the king, and the things that will be owed to the king from henceforth and for evermore, let them be remitted to you.
Kiswahili: Kila deni unalodaiwa mfalme, na vitu vitakavyodaiwa mfalme tangu sasa na hata milele, visamehewe kwako.
Ekegusii: Komenta nayio, amadeni onsi aria inwe mogosabwa gochia ase ekegancha kiomorwoti gose aria mwarenge gocha gosabwa ase amatuko a motwe nigo aratinyigwe erimo ase erimo.

English: Nevertheless, a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean, but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean.
Kiswahili: Lakini chemchemi au kisima, mahali pa kuchota maji, patakuwa safi, lakini yeyote atakayegusa moja ya mizoga hii ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Ensoko gose aase amaache akogachwa nabigenderere koba ebichenegete, korende ebinto binde bionsi ebiaao biise gokuna ching’iti echio chikwete mbibe ebitachenegeti.

English: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa kupitia yeye, kila mtu amwaminiye anahesabiwa haki kwa kila kitu ambacho asingeweza kuhesabiwa haki kwa sheria ya Mose.
Ekegusii: na asere kera oyomwegenire nigo akobarerwa oboronge ase amang’ana aria atakonyarekana kobarerwa oboronge ase amachiiko a Musa.

English: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
Kiswahili: Wenye kiburi wameficha mtego wa kuninasa, wametandaza kamba za wavu wao, wametega mitego kwenye njia yangu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu babeekire oboreba bobisi ase 'ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babeekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.

English: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you. The Lord’s Prayer (Luke 11:1–4)
Kiswahili: ili sadaka yako iwe ni siri. Ndipo Baba yako wa mbinguni, yeye aonaye sirini atakupa thawabu kwa wazi. Kuhusu Maombi (Luka 11:2-4)
Ekegusii: Obokonyi bwao bonyare koba bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane. Amegerio igoro y’ogosaba

English: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.
Kiswahili: Je, ujasiri wako utadumu au mikono yako itakuwa na nguvu siku hiyo nitakapokushughulikia? Mimi Bwana nimesema na nitalifanya.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ndarente egesusuro ase ore, Inee, nogenderere koba noboremu gose amaboko ao nabe ne chinguru? Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, goika in'yaikeranie.

English: When I lie down I think: ‘When will I get up?’ But the night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.
Kiswahili: Wakati nilalapo ninawaza, ‘Itachukua muda gani kabla sijaamka?’ Usiku huwa mrefu, nami najigeuzageuza hadi mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Ekero nararire nigo nkobooria: Indi bogocha gokia mboke? Obotuko bwatambeire mono. Agwo naba nkona‐kweonchaonchora bokia goika mambia.

English: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.
Kiswahili: “Sauli na Yonathani, maishani walipendwa na kuneemeka, na katika kifo hawakutengana. Walikuwa wepesi kuliko tai, walikuwa na nguvu kuliko simba.
Ekegusii: Saulo na Yonathani barenge abanchwa baito, barenge gotogokia. Ase obogima na ase amakweri tibaatananetwe. Barabwo nigo barenge abaango kobua ebiongo, nigo barenge ne chinguru kobua chindo.

English: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers—a land flowing with milk and honey.” Obey the LORD’s Commands
Kiswahili: Angalia chini kutoka mbinguni, maskani yako matakatifu, uwabariki watu wako Israeli pamoja na nchi uliyotupa kama ulivyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zetu, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali.” Fuata Maagizo Ya Bwana
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, ase Obomenyo bwao Obochenu bore, origererie, erinde otorore inse aa; osesenie abanto bao Abaisraeli, osesenie na ense eye gwatoeire buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira, ense entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke. Abanto ba Omonene omonyene

English: Suppose a man marries a woman, has relations with her, and comes to hate her,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atamwoa mke na, baada ya kufanya naye tendo la ndoa, akamchukia,
Ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu bamenyane, na magega y’ayio amwange,

English: On the second day the Israelites advanced against the Benjamites.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Waisraeli wakawakaribia Wabenyamini siku ya pili.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakageenda korwana n’Ababenjamini rituko ria kabere.

English: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Baasha akamuua Nadabu katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, naye Baasha akaingia mahali pake kuwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw'okogaamba gw'Asa, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, noro Baasa, akamoita, naende akaba okogaamba ribaga riaye.

English: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “Nimetenda dhambi. Lakini tafadhali niheshimu mbele ya wazee wa watu wangu na mbele ya Israeli; rudi pamoja nami, ili nipate kumwabudu Bwana Mungu wako.”
Ekegusii: Saulo agateeba, “Inche nakorire ebibe, korende bono insike ase amaiso 'abagaaka b'Abaanto baane, na ase Abaisraeli; irana amo nainche, erio ngende gosasiima Omonene, Nyasae oo.”

English: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
Kiswahili: Alipovunja ile lakiri ya nne, nikasikia sauti ya yule kiumbe wa nne mwenye uhai ikisema, “Njoo!”
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio gia kane, nkaigwa eriogi ri'eng'iti ya kane ere moyo ekobora, “Inchuo!”

English: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
Kiswahili: Siri hii ni kubwa, bali mimi nanena kuhusu Kristo na Kanisa.
Ekegusii: Obo nobobisi obonene; korende ngokwana nde amang’ana a Kristo na ekanisa.

English: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.
Kiswahili: Nitawaonyesha jinsi alivyo mtu yule anayekuja kwangu na kusikia maneno yangu na kuyatenda.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ogocha ase 'nde, na koigwa amang'ana aane, na koyakora, nimborokie buna are:

English: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
Kiswahili: Nataka ninyi mkumbuke maneno yaliyosemwa zamani na manabii watakatifu na ile amri ya Bwana na Mwokozi mliyopewa kupitia kwa mitume wenu.
Ekegusii: monyare koinyora amang’ana aria akwanetwe kare nababani abachenu, na ogochika kw’Omonene na Omotooria abarenterete goetera ase abatomwa baino.

English: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe hungekuwa na mamlaka yoyote juu yangu kama hungepewa kutoka juu. Kwa hiyo yeye aliyenitia mikononi mwako ana hatia ya dhambi iliyo kubwa zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”

English: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna tena Myahudi au Myunani, mtumwa au mtu huru, mwanaume wala mwanamke, maana nyote mmekuwa wamoja ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Aiga tari Omoyahudi gose Omogiriki, tari omosomba gose omosibore, tari omosacha gose omokungu, ekiagera inwe mwensi nigo more oyomo ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
Kiswahili: kila mmoja atolewe pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa pamoja na robo ya hini ya mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: Kera eyemo oyerue amo n'okoruegwa kw'endagera, ebimunu bibere bi'obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n'amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni egetuba ekemo.

English: Or if it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
Kiswahili: ikiwa ni mwanamke, weka thamani yake kwa shekeli thelathini.
Ekegusii: Onye n’omokuungu nigo riraabe chisekeli emerongo etato.

English: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn't anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Sikula chakula kizuri; nyama wala divai havikugusa midomo yangu; nami sikujipaka mafuta kamwe mpaka majuma matatu yalipotimia.
Ekegusii: Tinarenge koria endagera engiya, gose koria enyama, gose konywa edivai. Tinarenge kweaka amaguta nonya ng'ake ase chichuma chiria isato.

English: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo mtakapoinua huo mganda, lazima mtoe kwa Bwana dhabihu ya kuteketezwa kwa moto ya mwana-kondoo wa mwaka mmoja asiye na dosari,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riboa erio rigosungusigwa inamorue boigo emaanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa ase 'nde.

English: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamkemea, akamwambia, “Nyamaza kimya! Nawe umtoke!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Karwe ase omonto oyo!”

English: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakafanya shauri baya juu yake na kwa amri ya mfalme wakampiga kwa mawe mpaka akafa katika ukumbi wa Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende bagakora omooroberio bw'okomoita, na ase ogochika kw'omorwoti bakamoaka amagena ase eraaro y'enyomba y'Omonene goika agakwa.

English: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
