Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kuhusu mfalme wa Ashuru: “Hataingia katika mji huu wala hatapiga mshale hapa. Hatakuja mbele yake na ngao wala kupanga majeshi kuuzingira.
Ekegusii: “Ase igo, aya nar'Omonene agoteeba igoro y'omorwoti bw'Abaasuri: Ere tagocha ase omochie oyo, gose takoruta omogwe aroro; tagocha ase omochie oyo ne chinguba, gose takoagacha eburi bosio bwaye.

English: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
Kiswahili: ni afadhali yeye akuambie, “Njoo huku juu,” kuliko yeye kukuaibisha mbele ya mkuu. Kile ulichokiona kwa macho yako
Ekegusii: Nigo er'abe buya mono ekero orateebigwe, “Inchuo gocha aa”, kobua goseerigwa gochia goikaransa magega korwa ase ribaga ri'abaanto abasike.

English: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.
Kiswahili: Nitawatuma wageni Babeli kumpepeta na kuiharibu nchi yake; watampinga kila upande katika siku ya maafa yake.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri'emechando nintomere abanto ba Babiloni abairuri baabairure, batige ense yabo ebe bosa.

English: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na Sauli wakasimama bila kuwa na la kusema, kwa sababu walisikia sauti lakini hawakumwona aliyekuwa akizungumza.
Ekegusii: Abanto abagendete amo nere bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri; bakaigwa eriogi, korende tibarora monto.

English: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
Kiswahili: Niko pamoja nawe nami nitakulinda kila uendako na nitakurudisha katika nchi hii. Sitakuacha mpaka nitakapofanya hayo niliyokuahidi.”
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nimbe amo naye, ninkorende aande onsi ase orabe gokogenda, naende ninkoiranie gocha ase ense eye; naki tinkogotiga goika nagokoreire ayio nagoteebirie.”

English: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.
Kiswahili: Tukaambaa na pwani kwa shida, tukafika sehemu iitwayo Bandari Nzuri, karibu na mji wa Lasea.
Ekegusii: Togaeta ase obokong'u engegu ase engegu, togaika aase akorokwa Ebiambokero Ebiya. Ang'e nagwo norengeo omochie ore korokwa Lasaya.

English: He who gives glory to his mother is as one who lays up treasure.
Kiswahili: Amtukuzaye mama yake ni kama mtu awekaye hazina.
Ekegusii: na onye gosigete nyoko 'mbwegachere obotenenku obonge.

English: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
Kiswahili: Wamefanya mambo ya upotovu mbele zake; kwa aibu yao, wao si watoto wake tena, lakini ni kizazi kilicho kiovu na kilichopotoka.
Ekegusii: Barabwo basaririe ase Omonene, na bono tibagenderereti korokwa abana baye; nigo bare abanto b'obosooku, ekegori egesareku, naende egesiru.

English: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Enoshi, Sethi aliishi miaka 807, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y'okoiborwa kwa Enosu, Seti akamenya naende emiaka ende amagana atano na atato, na etano na ebere (807), akaba ise bw'abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Aroni na wanawe wataila ile nyama ya huyo kondoo dume pamoja na ile mikate iliyo kwenye hicho kikapu wakiwa hapo ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano, Aroni na abamura baye barie chinyama chi'emingichi eria amo nemegati ere ase egetonga ime.

English: Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.'”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Nitamtia Farao Hofra mfalme wa Misri mikononi mwa adui zake wanaoutafuta uhai wake, kama vile nilivyomtia Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda mikononi mwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, adui aliyekuwa akiutafuta uhai wake.' ”
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Nimbeke Farao Hofura, omorwoti o Misiri, ase amaboko 'ababisa baye, abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwaye, buna nabegete Zedekia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, oria orenge omobisa oye, na origetie komoita.”

English: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza pia vitanzi hamsini katika pazia mmoja, na vitanzi vingine hamsini kwenye pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine, nazo vitanzi vyote vikaelekeana.
Ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bigachikana.

English: The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.
Kiswahili: Hao watu walikwenda kukusanya, kisha waliisaga kwa mawe ya kusagia ya mkono au kuitwanga kwenye vinu. Waliipika vyunguni au kutengeneza maandazi. Ladha yake ilikuwa kama kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo barenge gosoka bayesangereria, naende bayesia ne chingena, gose bayeswaga ase chikonu. Erio baba bakoyeiyekera ase chinyongo na koyeroisia yaba emagaati. Igo yarenge gwansa buna amaandasi aroiseirie amaguta.

English: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
Kiswahili: Basi mtu yeyote anayejua jema limpasalo kutenda, lakini asilitende, mtu huyo anatenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, oyomanyete gokora amaya, ko tayakora, asare ere nebibe.

English: So the king commanded Ebed-melech the Cushite, “Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.”
Kiswahili: Basi mfalme akamwamuru Ebed-Meleki Mkushi, akisema, “Chukua watu thelathini kutoka hapa pamoja nawe, mkamtoe nabii Yeremia huko kwenye kisima kabla hajafa.”
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agachiika Ebedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, akamoteebia, “Ira abanto emerongo etato korwa aiga, ogende amo nabarabwo, na morusie Yeremia omobani korwa ase engoro ime, atarakwa.”

English: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
Kiswahili: Wala watu hawawashi taa na kuifunika kwa bakuli. Badala yake, huiweka kwenye kinara chake, nayo hutoa mwanga kwa kila mtu aliyemo ndani ya ile nyumba.
Ekegusii: Nonya n’abanto tibagotongia etaya na koyemumeka negetonga, korende nigo bakoyebeeka igoro ase egetangora, ebae oborabu bonsi abare nyomba ime.

English: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, yaani siku iliyofuata ile ya Maandalizi ya Sabato, viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakamwendea Pilato
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, erio riare rituko ri’Esabato, abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase Pilato,

English: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akalileta Sanduku ndani ya Maskani ya Mungu, akatundika pazia ili kulifunika Sanduku la Ushuhuda, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka esanduki eria ime y'obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y'egetambaa ase ogokenga esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: Thus they were haughty and committed abominations before Me. Therefore I removed them, as you have seen.
Kiswahili: Walijivuna na kufanya mambo ya machukizo sana mbele zangu. Kwa hiyo niliwakatilia mbali nami kama mlivyoona.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge abamwenu, na bakaba bagokora ay’okogechia ase obosio bwane, Ase ayio, ekero narooche amang’ana ayio, nigo nabarusetieo.

English: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitakufanyia jambo lile uliloomba, kwa sababu ninapendezwa nawe, nami ninakujua kwa jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Ninkore erio kwamboria, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane, na inche ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa.”

English: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.
Kiswahili: Walipanda na mifugo yao na mahema yao, mfano wa makundi ya nzige. Ilikuwa haiwezekani kuwahesabu watu na ngamia zao; wakavamia nchi ili kuiharibu.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge goocha amo ne chitugo chiabo ne chiema chiabo, nigo bareenge abange buna chingige. Omobaro obo torenge kobareka barabwo abanyene ne chingamia chiabo. Bagasoa ase ense eria, bakagania koyesaria kegima.

English: And after he had become the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Reu kumzaa Serugi, aliishi miaka 207, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Serugi, Reu gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na etano na ebere (207), akaibora abana abamura na abaiseke.

English: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
Kiswahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu; kwa siku saba utakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu kama nilivyokuagiza. Fanya jambo hili kwa wakati uliopangwa katika mwezi wa Abibu, ndio mwezi wa nne, kwa sababu katika mwezi huo ulitoka Misri. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele yangu mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bwa Abibu, omotienyi oyio mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri, Goika orende Rituko Rinene ri'Emegati etabekiri memera ase enchera eyio nagochigeete. Naboigo orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere buna nagochigeete. Na monto onde tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane namaboko amasa.

English: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
Kiswahili: Lisikieni hili, ninyi ambao mnawagandamiza wahitaji, na kuwaonea maskini wa nchi,
Ekegusii: Inwe aba mokourereria abaremeire na gosiria abataka bare ase ense, igwa amang'ana aya.

English: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
Kiswahili: Ingawa huleta huzuni, ataonyesha huruma, kwa kuwa upendo wake usiokoma ni mkuu.
Ekegusii: Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amaabera naende, ase engencho y'obwanchani bwaye obonene bwa botambe.

English: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya wanyama kwa ajili ya dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani walikuwa maksai ishirini na wanne, kondoo dume sitini, mbuzi dume wa mwaka mmoja sitini na wana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja sitini. Hizi ndizo zilikuwa sadaka zilizoletwa kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu baada ya kutiwa mafuta.
Ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe nigo chiabeete: Chieri emerongo ebere na inye, chimingichi emerongo etan’omo, chigoree emerongo etan’omo, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo emerongo etan’omo. Ebio nabio ebiegwa biaruetwe ekero egesasiimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta.

English: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.' Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, umelifunua hili kwa mtumishi wako, ukisema, ‘Nitakujengea nyumba.' Hivyo mtumishi wako amepata ujasiri kukuletea dua hii.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw'Emegaanda, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, kwang'orokeirie inche, omosomba oo, aya onsi, kogoteeba: Ninkoagaachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro y'ane kogosaba ogosaba oko.

English: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
Kiswahili: Atatendewa kama mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa, au kama mkazi wa muda katikati yako, naye atatumika mpaka Mwaka wa Yubile.
Ekegusii: Nabeere ase ore buna omonto orikire, na buna omomenyi oo, abe okogokorera goika ekero Omwaka bw'Omochengo oraike.

English: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
Kiswahili: Mungu aturehemu na kutubariki, na kutuangazia nuru za uso wake,
Ekegusii: Nyasae atororere amaabera, atosesenie, atoraberie obosio bwaye.

English: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.
Kiswahili: La hasha! Lile neno liko karibu sana nawe; liko kinywani mwako na ndani ya moyo wako ili uweze kulitii.
Ekegusii: Taibo! Ring’ana riria nigo rire ang’e nainwe ase emenwa yaino, na ase chinkoro chiaino, erinde monyaare korikora.

English: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wote pamoja na kuwaambia, “Mnafahamu kuwa watawala wa watu wa Mataifa huwatawala kwa nguvu, nao wenye vyeo huonyesha mamlaka yao.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabora, “Mwamanyire ng'a abagaambi b'Ebisaku bakogaambera abanto, na abanene babo nigo bare n'okobua igoro ase bare.

English: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Can’t you see for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?
Kiswahili: Jichunguzeni wenyewe mwone kama mnaishi katika imani. Jipimeni wenyewe. Je, hamtambui ya kuwa Yesu Kristo yumo ndani yenu? Kama sivyo, basi, mmeshindwa kufikia kipimo hicho!
Ekegusii: Erenge inwe abanyene emioyo yaino gose more ase okwegena; eteeme inwe abanyene. Gose timwemanyeti ng’a Yeso Kristo nare ime ase more? Onye taibo, rirorio mwangirwe!

English: And not only so, but while punishment of some sort will come upon the former, since they received as enemies those who were aliens;
Kiswahili: Na si hivyo tu, bali adhabu ya aina fulani itakuja juu ya wale wa kwanza, kwa kuwa waliwapokea kama maadui wale waliokuwa wageni;
Ekegusii: Ense ende yonsi etari kwarigania abageni nenyore egesususro,

English: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
Kiswahili: Lakini kufuatana na ahadi yake, sisi tunatazamia mbingu mpya na dunia mpya, ambayo haki hukaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende buna atorierete eira ntotengerete igoro enyia na ense enyia, ase ebio oboronge mboreo ime yabo.

English: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
Kiswahili: Ni nani mwenye hekima? Atayatambua mambo haya. Ni nani mwenye ufahamu? Huyu atayaelewa. Njia za Bwana ni adili; wenye haki huenda katika njia hizo, lakini waasi watajikwaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Oyore omong'aini, nere oramanye amang'ana aya; oyore nokomanya, nere orayarengererie. Chinchera chi'Omonene nigo chire chindonge, na abanyene oboronge nabwo baraetere aroro, korende abasaria nigo baragochwe bagwe ase chirochio.

English: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
Kiswahili: Hamjui kwamba ni afadhali mtu mmoja afe kwa ajili ya watu, kuliko taifa lote liangamie?”
Ekegusii: Gose timorengerereti ng'a mbuya omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y'abanto, erinde egesaku ekegima tigesira.”

English: Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity, declares the Lord GOD.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu waliwatumikia watu mbele ya sanamu zao na kuifanya nyumba ya Israeli ianguke kwenye dhambi, kwa hiyo nimeapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kwamba ni lazima wachukue matokeo ya dhambi yao, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera abakuani abwo batenenete ase amasio y’ abanto gokorera emegwekano yabo bagosasiima, na igo bakaba ekegocha ase Abaisraeli, bakagera barabwo bagakora ebibe, ase ayio inche Omonene natianire ng’a egesusuro ki’ogosaria kwabo goika kebairanere.

English: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
Kiswahili: Efa, suria wa Kalebu alikuwa mamaye Harani, Mosa na Gazezi. Harani alikuwa baba wa Gazezi.
Ekegusii: Boigo Efa, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Harani, na Moza, na Gasesi; na Harani boigo nabwate omomura orenge korokwa Gasesi.

English: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
Kiswahili: Huniokoa nikawa salama katika vita vilivyopangwa dhidi yangu, ingawa watu wengi hunipinga.
Ekegusii: Ere nantoorie, andende buya korwa ase esegi eyio nkorwana, ekiagera ababisa abange banyimokeire.

English: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: Watakuja wakitetemeka kama ndege wakitoka Misri, kama hua wakitoka Ashuru. Nitawakalisha katika nyumba zao,” asema Bwana. Dhambi Ya Israeli
Ekegusii: Mbairuruke buna chinyoni korwa Misiri, bache bakoiguswa, na buna amaruma korwa ase ense y’Asuri. Nimbabeeke bamenye ase chinka chiabo.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Abaisraeli amo Abayuda bakogaambigwa

English: He replied, “I also am a sovereign on the earth, who commands you to take up weapons and execute the king's business.” Nevertheless he didn't prevail to execute his cruel plan.
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Mimi pia ni mfalme duniani, ninayewaamuru kuchukua silaha na kutekeleza shughuli za mfalme.” Hata hivyo, hakufanikiwa kutekeleza mpango wake wa kikatili.
Ekegusii: Erio Nikanori akabateebia: “Inche ninche omonguru bw'ense, nabachikire moimokie ebirwanero biaino mokore keria omorwoti akobachika.” Nonya nigo Nikanori tanyarete goikerania omoroberio oye omobe.

English: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Bwana ameamuru kwamba wale wanaohubiri Injili wapate riziki yao kutokana na Injili.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene naboigo ochikiire ng’a baria bakorandia enchiri banyore ebibagwenerete korwa ase enchiri.

English: So Joab’s men, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, marched out of Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.
Kiswahili: Hivyo watu wa Yoabu, na Wakerethi na Wapelethi, pamoja na wapiganaji mashujaa wote wakaondoka chini ya uongozi wa Abishai. Wakatoka Yerusalemu ili kumfuata Sheba mwana wa Bikri.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto ba Yoabu, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti, ne chituoni chionsi, bagatunyana Abisai, bakarua Yerusalemu bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, bachie komobwata.

English: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Kiswahili: Wana simba wenye nguvu hutindikiwa na kuona njaa, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana hawatakosa kitu chochote kilicho chema.
Ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.

English: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye kichwa cha mwili, yaani kanisa, naye ndiye mwanzo na mzaliwa wa kwanza kutoka kwa wafu, ili yeye awe mkuu katika vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: Ere nomotwe bw'omobere, engencho yaye ekanisa; naende ere nomochakano na omoiborwa bw'eritang'ani korwa ase abakuure, erinde ere bweka abe omotang'ani ase bonsi.

English: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger settles in the lap of a fool.
Kiswahili: Usiwe mwepesi kukasirika rohoni mwako, kwa kuwa hasira hukaa kifuani mwa wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase okogechigwa, ekiagera okogechigwa nigo komenyete ase chinkoro chi’abariri.

English: “Behold, I am insignificant. How can I reply to You? I place my hand over my mouth.
Kiswahili: “Mimi sistahili kabisa: ninawezaje kukujibu wewe? Nauweka mkono wangu juu ya kinywa changu.
Ekegusii: “Naama! Inche ting’isaini kende, ngento ki ndanyare gokoiraneria? Natubire omonwa one nokoboko kwane.

English: She who is arrogant brings shame on father and husband. She will be despised by both of them.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke mwenye kiburi humletea baba na mume aibu. Atadharauliwa na wote wawili.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke ore n'echimbu chiimbe nigo akorentera ise gose omosacha oye obosooku, na nigo arasierererigwe na bosi babere.

English: Tobit said to her, “Don't worry, my sister. He will return safe and sound, and your eyes will see him.
Kiswahili: Tobiti akamwambia, “Usijali, dada yangu. Atarudi salama na mzima, na macho yako yatamwona.”
Ekegusii: ase engencho obogima obo Nyasae atoire nigo botoisaine.”

English: His blessing covered the dry land as a river and saturated it as a flood.
Kiswahili: Baraka yake iliifunika nchi kavu kama mto na kuijaza kama mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Ogosesenia kwaye nigo kogoichoria ense enyomo buna ase orooche na gochinyiyia buna chioro chia amaache.

English: Look, let me bring out my virgin daughter and the man’s concubine, and you can use them and do with them as you wish. But do not do such a vile thing to this man.”
Kiswahili: Tazameni, hapa yupo binti yangu ambaye ni bikira na suria wa huyu mtu. Nitawatoleeni hawa sasa, mkawatwae kwa nguvu na kuwafanyia lolote mtakalo. Lakini kwa mtu huyu msimfanyie jambo ovu hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Rora, nimbwate omoiseke one omwekungi, na omonto oyo n’abwate omokungu oye o sere‐sere, tiga ’mbasokie ase more bono. Mobakorere obonyaka buna moganetie, korende timobaisa gokorera omonto oyo egento buna ekio gi’okogeechia.”

English: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
Kiswahili: Wakawauliza, “Je, huyu ni mtoto wenu, ambaye mnasema alizaliwa kipofu? Imekuwaje basi sasa anaona?”
Ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteeba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”

English: or newly-created and unknown wild beasts, full of rage, either breathing out a blast of fiery breath, or belching out smoke, or flashing dreadful sparks from their eyes;
Kiswahili: au wanyama wa porini walioumbwa hivi karibuni na wasiojulikana, waliojaa hasira, ama wakitoa pumzi ya moto, au wakitoa moshi, au wakitoa cheche za kutisha kutoka machoni mwao;
Ekegusii: gose ching'iti chintindi mono echio chitanya kobao, gose ching'iti echio chikoeyana omoika bw'omorero, gose chiria chikoeyana erioki ririto chiria chigosaria, gose chikorusia amariga y'okoondokia.

English: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu alisema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agakwana, “Nakobaakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwababisire abare nobong’aini ne chisemi amang’ana aya, na kwayamaanoire ase abana abake.

English: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Kiswahili: ee nyumba ya Lawi, msifuni Bwana; ninyi mnaomcha, msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Lawi, togia Omonene! Nainwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie!

English: He who reveals secrets destroys trust, and will not find a close friend.
Kiswahili: Yeye afunuaye siri huharibu uaminifu, wala hatapata rafiki wa karibu.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorwa obobisi nigo ere agosiria obwegenwa bwonsi, na ase obogima bwaye bwonsi takonyoora omosaani omoganetie.

English: They will take their tents and flocks, their tent curtains and all their goods. They will take their camels for themselves. They will shout to them: ‘Terror is on every side!’
Kiswahili: Hema zao na makundi yao ya kondoo yatachukuliwa; vibanda vyao vitatwaliwa pamoja na mali zao zote na ngamia zao. Watu watawapigia kelele, ‘Hofu kuu iko kila upande!’
Ekegusii: Mosakore chiema chiabo na amaicho abo, na ebietubo bie chiema chiabo, na ebinto biabo bionsi; boigo moire chingamia chiabo. Morere igoro yabo, motebe: Obwoba nigo bore ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”
Kiswahili: Mataifa yatasikia juu ya aibu yako, kilio chako kitaijaza dunia. Shujaa mmoja atajikwaa juu ya mwingine, nao wataanguka chini pamoja.”
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ebisaku baigure amang'ana igoro y'obosooku bwaino, na ebirero biaino biaichoire ase ense, ekiagera omorwani etuoni ogochirwe na kogwa igoro ase etuoni ende. Bonsi bagwereranire amo.”

English: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
Kiswahili: Nina furaha kubwa katika Bwana kwamba hatimaye mmeanza upya kushughulika tena na maisha yangu. Kweli mmekuwa mkinifikiria lakini mlikuwa hamjapata nafasi ya kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Nagokire mono ase Omonene, ekiagera bono ase omoerio mwairanire ase ebirengererio biaino igoro y’okoremerwa kwane; nabo mwarenge kondengereria ritang’ani, korende timwanyora ribaga.

English: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.
Kiswahili: Inueni macho yenu mbinguni, mkaitazame dunia chini; mbingu zitatoweka kama moshi, dunia itachakaa kama vazi, na wakazi wake kufa kama mainzi. Bali wokovu wangu utadumu milele, haki yangu haitakoma kamwe.
Ekegusii: Imokia amaiso aino morigererie igoro, naende morigererie ense inse aa. Igoro chionsi nchisire buna erioki, na ense negote buna eanga. Abanto bamenyeteo nigo barakwe buna ebichuni, korende ogotooreka kwane nkogenderere kobao kare na kare, na oboronge bwane tibokoera nonya ng'ake.

English: King Antiochus was traveling through the upper countries; and he heard that in Elymais in Persia there was a city renowned for riches, for silver and gold,
Kiswahili: Mfalme Antioko alikuwa akisafiri katika nchi za juu, akasikia kwamba huko Elimaisi, katika Uajemi, kulikuwa na mji maarufu kwa utajiri, fedha na dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omorwoti Antioko o kane arenge goeta Mesopotamia ime yechingongo chi'ebitunwa akaigwa amang'ana yomochie bwe Elimaisi ase ense ya Abaperisi oyio okumete kegima ase obonda bwaye bw'echifeta ne etaabu.

English: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
Kiswahili: Watu kama hao ni mitume wa uongo, ni wafanyakazi wadanganyifu, wanaojigeuza waonekane kama mitume wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abwo nabatomwa b’oborimo, bagokora emeremo ase obong’ainereria, bakweonchora babe omogwekano bw’abatomwa ba Kristo.

English: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.” Egypt Cast into the Pit
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo ombolezo watakalomwimbia. Binti za mataifa wataliimba, kwa kuwa Misri na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri wataliimba, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: Ayio naro amagombo arabokigwe igoro ya Misiri. Abakungu b’ebisaku mbabokie amagombo igoro yaye, na igoro y’emeganda yaye yonsi. Nabo Omonene ateebire.” Ense y’abakuure

English: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: naye akamwomba kuhani mkuu ampe barua za kwenda kwenye masinagogi huko Dameski, ili akimkuta mtu yeyote wa Njia Ile, akiwa mwanaume au mwanamke, aweze kuwafunga na kuwaleta Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: akamobooria amoe amarube ariikire ase chisinagogi chia Damesiki, erinde onye okonyora abanto b’Enchera eye, abasacha gose abakungu, abasibe na kobarenta Yerusalemu.

English: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.

Ekegusii: amo ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere ase kera ebao.

English: But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things. The Burial of Jesus (Isaiah 53:9–12; Matthew 27:57–61; Mark 15:42–47; John 19:38–42)
Kiswahili: Lakini wale wote waliomfahamu, pamoja na wale wanawake waliokuwa wamemfuata kutoka Galilaya, walisimama kwa mbali wakiyatazama mambo haya. Maziko Ya Yesu (Mathayo 27:57-61; Marko 15:42-47; Yohana 19:38-42)
Ekegusii: Abasani baye bonsi na abakungu abamotunyanete korwa Galili, bagatenenera are, bakarora ayio. Ogotindekwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:57-61; Mar 15:42-47; Yoh 19:38-42)

English: and say to you, “Your way is good.” Then he will stand near you, to see what will happen to you.
Kiswahili: na kukuambia, “Njia yako ni njema.â€ Ndipo atasimama karibu nawe, aone kitakachokupata.
Ekegusii: Nabo ere arabaisa kogoteebia: “Bionsi mbuya bire”, erio atenene egeka korora riria rigokonyoora.

English: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Kiswahili: Mpe mtumishi wako furaha, kwa kuwa kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, ninainua nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Gokia omoyo one inche omosomba oo, ekiagera narentire omoyo one asore aye Omonene.

English: If they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink it, you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘You most certainly must drink it!
Kiswahili: Lakini kama wakikataa kupokea kikombe kutoka mikononi mwako na kunywa, waambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: Ni lazima mnywe!
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo kobaraange kobogoria egekombe ekio korwa ase okoboko kwao na konywa edivai eria, obateebie ng’a aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire: Goika moyenywe.

English: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people. There will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time, your people will be delivered—everyone who is found written in the book.
Kiswahili: "Wakati huo Mikaeli atasimama, mkuu mkuu, asimamaye upande wa wana wa watu wako; kutakuwa na wakati wa taabu, ambao haukuwapo tangu lilipoanza kuwapo taifa hata wakati uo huo; wakati huo watu wako wataokolewa - kila mtu atakayeonekana ameandikwa katika kitabu."
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio Mikaeli, omogambi oria omonene naoroke, atenenere abanto bao. Erio n'ebe engaki y'emechando emenene mono, eye etana koba rinde korwa ekero egesaku kia Mwanyabaanto giachaagete kobao goika ase engaki eyio. Korende ase engaki eyio, abanto bao mbatoorigwe, kera oyomo oyio erieta riaye riranyorekane ririikire ase egetabu eria.

English: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa Gileadi wakamwambia Yefta, “Lakini sasa tumegeuka kukuelekea wewe, ili uende pamoja nasi kupigana na Waamoni, nawe utakuwa kiongozi wetu juu ya watu wote wa Gileadi.”
Ekegusii: Abagaaka baria ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “Ayio naro agerire twakoiraneire bono: Ntorigetie aye ogende amo naintwe, otokoonye korwania Abaamoni, na obe omotang'ani oito, na oyo bw' abanto bonsi ba Gileadi.”

English: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?'
Kiswahili: “Mmesema vitu vigumu dhidi yangu,” asema Bwana. “Hata hivyo mnauliza, ‘Tumesema nini dhidi yako?'
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe mwakwanire amang'ana amakong'u igoro y'ane. Korende nigo mokoboria: Mang'ana ki amakong'u twakwanire igoro yao?

English: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: ninyi nanyi, kama mawe yaliyo hai, mnajengwa kuwa nyumba ya kiroho, ili mpate kuwa ukuhani mtakatifu, mkitoa dhabihu za kiroho zinazokubaliwa na Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamore buna amagena are moyo moagachwe, mobe enyomba y’Omoika mobe abakuani abachenu, morue ebing’wanso bi’omoika ebirancherwe ase Nyasae goetera ase Yeso Kristo.

English: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama hamkuwafukuza wenyeji wakaao katika nchi hiyo, wale mtakaowaruhusu wabaki watakuwa kama sindano kwenye macho yenu na miiba kwenu kila upande. Watawasumbua katika nchi mtakayoishi.
Ekegusii: Korende onye timogoseria ababiare b'ense eria barue ase more, rirorio baria moratige bamenye amo nainwe 'nababe buna chimbambo chinyoge chikobabeta amaiso aino, na buna amagwa akobabeta ase amakere aino; barabwo nababachaande ase ense eyio mogochia komenya.

English: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, “Belteshazzar, don't let the dream or the interpretation, trouble you.” Belteshazzar answered, “My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Danieli (aliyeitwa pia Belteshaza) alipofadhaika sana kwa muda, nayo mawazo yake yakamtia hofu. Basi mfalme akasema, “Belteshaza, usiruhusu ndoto wala maana yake kukutia hofu.” Belteshaza akamjibu, “Bwana wangu, laiti ndoto hii ingehusu adui zako, na maana yake iwahusu watesi wako!
Ekegusii: Erio Danieli, oyo orenge korokwa Beli‐Tesasari, agaichanigwa ase ekero egeke ase engencho y'amang'ana aria, na ebirengererio biaye bikamoichania. Omorwoti akamoteebia, “Beli‐Tesasari, chindoto echi na engencho yaye, tibigoichania.” Beli‐Tesasari akairaneria, akamoteebia, Omonene one, naki yare koba buya onye chindoto echi nchiaba igoro y'abwo bakogechete, na engencho yaye ebe igoro y'ababisa bao.

English: Then the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, killed thirty of their men, took their apparel, and gave their clothes to those who had solved the riddle. And burning with anger, Samson returned to his father’s house,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Roho wa Bwana akamjia Samsoni kwa nguvu. Akateremka mpaka Ashkeloni, akawaua watu waume thelathini miongoni mwa watu wa mji, akatwaa mali zao na nguo zao, akawapa watu wale waliofumbua kile kitendawili. Akiwa na hasira, akakwea kurudi nyumbani kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Na omoika bw’Omonene ogaacha igoro ya Samusoni, okamobeeka chinguru, na ere agatirimboka gochia Asikeloni, agaita abasacha b’omochie emerongo etato, agasakora ebinto biabo, akaira ne’chianga chiabo chi’omoyega, akaa abanto baria bateebete engencho y’omobayeno oria. Magega y’ayio akairana gochia ase ise ore n’ekeririanda ekenene.

English: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds and the Angels
Kiswahili: naye akamzaa mwanawe, kifungua mimba. Akamfunika nguo za kitoto na kumlaza katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe, kwa sababu hapakuwa na nafasi katika nyumba ya wageni. Wachungaji Na Malaika
Ekegusii: Akaibora omwana oye omoisia omotangi, akamobekera chianga chi’obwana, akamwareria ase orotuba chiombe chiare koriera, ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ase enyomba y’abageni. Abarisia na Abamalaika

English: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
Kiswahili: Sasa nimewekewa taji ya haki ambayo Bwana, mwamuzi wa haki, atanitunukia siku ile: wala si mimi tu, bali pia wote ambao wamengoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya nagacheirwe egutwa y'oboronge, eye Omonene, omogambi bw'oboronge, arang'e ase Rituko riria gose tari inche bweka arae, korende nabaanto bonsi abanchete okoorokigwa kwaye.

English: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yosia walikuwa: Yohanani mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Yehoyakimu mwanawe wa pili, wa tatu Sedekia, wa nne Shalumu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.

English: But if that nation I warned turns from its evil, then I will relent of the disaster I had planned to bring.
Kiswahili: ikiwa lile taifa nililolionya litatubia uovu wake, ndipo nitakapokuwa na huruma, wala sitawapiga kwa maafa niliyokuwa nimewakusudia.
Ekegusii: na abanto b’oborwoti obwo nakwanire amang’ana aane igoro ase bare, kobaraonchoke na batige ebibe biabo, na inche ning’onchoke ntige amabe aria nare gochia gokora ase bare.

English: Let him who escapes be devoured by raging fire. May those who harm your people find destruction.
Kiswahili: Atakayetoroka na aliwe na moto mkali. Wale wanaowadhuru watu wako na waangamie.
Ekegusii: basirie abaengereria, na kobatinyia ababisa.

English: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Noa walikuwa: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi. Wana Wa Yafethi
Ekegusii: Lameki akaibora Nuhu, na Nuhu akaibora Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.

English: Mattathias cried out in the city with a loud voice, saying, “Whoever is zealous for the law and maintains the covenant, let him follow me!”
Kiswahili: Matathia alipiga kelele mjini kwa sauti kubwa, akisema, “Yeyote mwenye bidii kwa ajili ya sheria na kuishika agano, na anifuate!”
Ekegusii: Erio Matathia agaeta ase egati yomochie ogoaka eriogi: “Kera omonto osigete richiiko ri'Omonene oito na okobwatia okobwatana kwaye ogochenu antunyane!”

English: “Shouldn't the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
Kiswahili: “Je, maneno haya yote yapite bila kujibiwa? Je, huyu mnenaji athibitishwe kuwa na haki?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Amang'ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang'ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?

English: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ilipofahamu kwamba Aroni amekufa, jamaa yote ya Kiisraeli wakamwomboleza kwa siku thelathini.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda bw'Abaisraeli orooche ng'a Aroni okuure bakamoreera ase engaki y'amatuko emerongo etato.

English: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa nikitazama, makerubi yakatanda mabawa yao na kuinuka kutoka ardhini, nao walipokuwa wakienda, yale magurudumu yakaenda pamoja nao. Wakasimama kwenye ingilio la lango la mashariki la nyumba ya Bwana, nao utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ukawa juu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio 'nkarora ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria bakorambora chimbaaba chiabo na koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba ekero bagendete, na amagoro aria naro akagenda amo nabarabwo. Bagatenena ase egesoero ki'egeita kia moocha kegochia ase enyomba y'Omonene, na obonene bwa Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli nigo bwarenge igoro yabo.

English: Then some of the leaders of the Ephraimites —Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—stood in opposition to those arriving from the war.
Kiswahili: Ndipo baadhi ya viongozi katika Efraimu, yaani, Azaria mwana wa Yehohanani, Berekia mwana wa Meshilemothi, Yehizkia mwana wa Shalumu na Amasa mwana wa Hadlai, wakakubaliana na huyo nabii, hivyo wakawapinga wale waliokuwa wanawasili kutoka vitani.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande abanene b’Abaefraimu: Asaria, mosinto o Yohanani, na Berekia mosinto o Mesilemoti, na Yehisikia, mosinto o Salumu, na Amasa, mosinto o Hadilai, bagatenena gokania abarwani baria barenge koirana korwa ase esegi,

English: These were some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Wale waliotoka Yuda, Benyamini, Efraimu na Manase ambao waliishi Yerusalemu walikuwa: Jamaa Za Yuda
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda, na orwa Benjamini, na orw’Efraimu, na orwa Manase, abwo bamenyete Yerusalemu nabwo aba.

English: Now David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
Kiswahili: Daudi akayaweka maneno haya moyoni naye akamwogopa sana Akishi mfalme wa Gathi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akayabeeka ase ebirengererio biaye, akairoka Akisi, omorwoti o Gati, mono.

English: While you kept it, didn't it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn't it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven't lied to men, but to God.”
Kiswahili: Je, kabla hujauza hicho kiwanja si kilikuwa mali yako? Hata baada ya kukiuza, fedha ulizopata si zilikuwa kwenye uwezo wako? Kwa nini basi umewaza hila hii moyoni mwako kufanya jambo kama hili? Wewe hukumwambia uongo mwanadamu bali Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Nyuma otaraonia omogondo oyo noyoo orenge; Na ekero oonetigwe chitaabu nechiao chiarenge. Nase ki kwarengereretie gokora ring'ana eri? Totebeti Mwanyabaanto oborimo, korende Nyasae.”

English: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn't see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
Kiswahili: Basi macho ya Israeli yalikuwa hayaoni vizuri kwa sababu ya uzee, naye aliona kwa shida. Kwa hiyo Yosefu akawaleta wanawe karibu na baba yake, Israeli akawabusu na akawakumbatia.
Ekegusii: Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y'obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabaagata na kobaboania.

English: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
Kiswahili: “Utakapowahesabu Waisraeli, kila mmoja lazima alipe kwa Bwana fidia kwa ajili ya nafsi yake wakati wa kuhesabiwa kwake. Ndipo hakutakuwa na pigo juu yao unapowahesabu.
Ekegusii: “Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibaabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.

English: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
Kiswahili: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita, na haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.
Ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, na amarieta abo naro aya: Asirikamu, na Bokeru, na Isumaeli, na Searia, na Obadia, na Hanani. Aba nabwo abana abamura b'Aseli.

English: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia wazi kwamba, yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Hekalu yupo hapa.
Ekegusii: Inche nabateebirie, nkere aiga egento ekenene kobua Hekalu.

English: The inward parts of a fool are like a broken vessel. He will hold no knowledge.
Kiswahili: Sehemu za ndani za mpumbavu ni kama chombo kilichovunjika. Hatakuwa na maarifa.
Ekegusii: Chisemi chio omonto omoriri nigo chinga buna egetaabo kebochogete, kende gionsi omonto oyio agosoma nigo kegoeta rioka getari kogoma, erinde giasira kegima: tari kobwata gento.

English: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mtu yeyote akinifuata hatatembea gizani kamwe, bali atakuwa na nuru ya uzima.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, “Inche nomobaso bw'ense; oyogontunyana takogenda ase omosunte, korende nabe nomobaso bw'obogima.”

English: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
Kiswahili: Zishikeni kwa uangalifu, kwa kuwa hii itaonyesha hekima na ufahamu wenu kwa mataifa, ambayo yatasikia kuhusu amri zote hizi, nao watasema, “Hakika taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.”
Ekegusii: Moyabwate na koyaigwera, ekiagera ayio naro araorokererie abanto b’ebisaku binde ng’a ’more n’obong’aini. Barabwo kobaraigwe amachiiko aya onsi mbateebe: Ekeene, abanto b’egesaku eke ekenene nigo bare abamanyi naende nabang’aini!

English: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Shangilieni katika Bwana na mfurahi, enyi wenye haki! Imbeni, nyote mlio wanyofu wa moyo!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene oboronge, mogokere Omonene na komochengera; inwe mwensi abamore ne chinkoro chindonge, aka eriogi nomogooko.

English: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
Kiswahili: Kwa wa Rehabia, kutoka kwa wanawe: Ishia alikuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Isia, omoteneneri korwa ase ororeria rwa Rehabia;

English: ‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’” Jerusalem Delivered from the Assyrians (2 Kings 19:35–37; 2 Chronicles 32:20–23)
Kiswahili: “Nitaulinda mji huu na kuuokoa, kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, na kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wangu!”
Ekegusii: Inche ning’egere omochie oyo na koyotooria ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”

English: Remember me, and look at me. Don't take vengeance on me for my sins and my ignorances, and the sins of my fathers who sinned before you.
Kiswahili: Nikumbuke, na uniangalie. Usinilipize kisasi kwa ajili ya dhambi zangu na ujinga wangu, na dhambi za baba zangu waliotenda dhambi kabla yako.
Ekegusii: Bono aye Omonene, ong'inyore na kondigereria, tobaisa kong'a egesusuro ase engencho yebibe biane gose ase amamocho chisokoro chiane chiakoreete.

English: Keep your path far from her; do not go near the door of her house,
Kiswahili: Njia zenu ziwe mbali naye, msiende karibu na mlango wa nyumba yake,
Ekegusii: Erende obeere aare korwa ase omokungu oyio; tobaisa goika ang’e negesieri ki’enyomba yaye.

English: For I have told you today, but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God in all He has sent me to tell you.
Kiswahili: Nimewaambieni leo, lakini bado ninyi hamtaki kumtii Bwana Mungu wenu katika yote aliyonituma niwaambie.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria reero inche nabateebirie amang’ana onsi Omonene antomete ng’a mbateebie, korende inwe mwangire komoigwera Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
Kiswahili: Kila akimbiaye asikiapo sauti ya hofu atatumbukia shimoni, naye yeyote apandaye kutoka shimoni, atanaswa kwenye mtego. Malango ya gharika ya mbinguni yamefunguliwa, misingi ya dunia inatikisika.
Ekegusii: Nebe ng'a oyogotama kaigure eriogi ri'okogosa nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima eyio nabwatwe nomoeto, ekiagera chitirisa chia igoro chiaigoirwe, oboroso bw'ense bwanyegerigwe.

English: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Basi, wewe mwanangu, uwe hodari katika neema iliyo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Gaaki, aye omwana one, obe ne chinguru ase obuya bore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron's sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;
Kiswahili: Akachinja maksai na kondoo dume kama sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya watu. Wanawe Aroni wakampa ile damu, naye akainyunyiza kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
Ekegusii: Akanyenya boigo eeri amo nemingichi, chikaba ebing'wanso bi'omorembe ase engencho y'abanto. Abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga 'ebing'wanso ebio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
Kiswahili: Aramu akamzaa Aminadabu, Aminadabu akamzaa Nashoni, Nashoni akamzaa Salmoni,
Ekegusii: na Aramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nashoni, na Nashoni akaibora Salimoni,

English: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa njia ya Yesu, tuzidi kumtolea Mungu dhabihu ya sifa, yaani matunda ya midomo inayolikiri Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw’emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.

English: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn't show them.
Kiswahili: Hezekia akawapokea wale wajumbe kwa furaha na kuwaonyesha vitu vile vilivyokuwa katika ghala zake: yaani fedha, dhahabu, vikolezo na mafuta safi, ghala la silaha lote, na kila kitu kilichokuwa katika hazina zake. Hapakuwa na kitu chochote katika jumba lake la kifalme au katika ufalme wake wote ambacho Hezekia hakuwaonyesha.
Ekegusii: Hezekia akabaroisia buya, erio akaborokia chimonga chiaye chionsi, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebinsari, na amaguta e rigori rinene, na ebirwanero biaye bionsi, na ebinto bionsi biagachire ase chinyomba chiaye. Tatigete gento kende gionsi ase enyomba yaye, gose ase chikungo chi'oborwoti bwaye, ataborogetie.

English: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
Kiswahili: Yethro akafurahishwa sana kusikia juu ya mambo yote mazuri Bwana aliyowatendea Waisraeli kuwaokoa kutoka mkono wa Wamisri.
Ekegusii: Ekero Jethiro aigwete amaya onsi Nyasae akorerete Abaisraeli ase okobatooria korwa ase amaboko 'Abamisiri akagoka mono,

English: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,
Kiswahili: Basi mkuu wa wanyweshaji akamweleza Yosefu ndoto yake. Akamwambia, “Katika ndoto yangu niliona mzabibu mbele yangu,
Ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw'ebinyugwa agateebia Yusufu okoroota kwaye, akabora: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche omosabibu ore ase obosio bwane,

English: There is life in the path of righteousness, but another path leads to death.
Kiswahili: Katika njia ya haki kuna uzima; katika mapito hayo kuna maisha ya milele.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera y’oboronge obogima ’mboreo, na amakweri tari gotooka ase boeto obwo.

English: In the letter he wrote: “Put Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle; then withdraw from him, so that he may be struck down and killed.”
Kiswahili: Ndani ya barua aliandika, “Mweke Uria mstari wa mbele mahali ambapo mapigano ni makali sana. Kisha wewe uondoke ili Uria aangushwe chini na kuuawa.”
Ekegusii: Ase riruube erio nigo ariigete iga: “Otang’anie Uria bosio bw’abarwani aase esegi ere entindi Erio morueo, momotige aroro aitwe akwe.”

English: They trusted him. Then he seized sixty men of them, and killed them in one day, according to the word which was written,
Kiswahili: Walimwamini. Kisha akawakamata watu sitini miongoni mwao, akawaua siku moja, kama ilivyoandikwa,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamwegena. Korende erio kegima akababwata abanto 60 ase egati yaabo na kobaita rituko erio erio, buna eriikire:

English: If we say that we haven't sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
Kiswahili: Kama tukisema hatukutenda dhambi, twamfanya yeye kuwa mwongo na neno lake halimo ndani yetu.
Ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng'a titokoreti ebibe, twakorire Nyasae koba omonyaborimo, gose ring'ana riaye tiriri ime yaito.

English: But Moses replied, “You must also provide us with sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the LORD our God.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akasema, “Huna budi kuturuhusu tuwe na dhabihu na sadaka za kuteketezwa za kutoa mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Yaya, goika otoe ching’iti togochia koruera Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebinde bi’okonyenywa.

English: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
Kiswahili: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni.”
Ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua, konya obaeire ekemanyererio, agateeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate.”

English: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengeneza upapi wenye upana wa nyanda nne, na ufanyie ule upapi ukingo wa dhahabu kuuzunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Erio obeke orosingo robe nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na oroetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me,
Kiswahili: Mliposikia sauti kutoka kwenye giza, mlima ulipokuwa ukiwaka moto, viongozi wenu wote wa makabila yenu na wazee wenu walinijia mimi.
Ekegusii: “Ekero egetunwa keria kiagendererete gwoka omorero, mokaigwa eriogi korwa ase egati‐gati y’omosunte oria, nainwe mwensi, abamore abatang’ani na abagaaka ase ebisaku biaino, mogaacha ase ’nde.

English: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Tera na kupiga kambi huko Mithka.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Tera, bakageenda bagaika Mitika, bagatoora aroro.

English: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
Kiswahili: bali Bwana huwacheka waovu, kwa sababu anajua siku yao inakuja.
Ekegusii: Omonene nasekerere omokori amabe, ekiagera aroche ng’a rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye ndichiche.

English: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
Kiswahili: Maono kuhusu Yuda na Yerusalemu ambayo Isaya mwana wa Amozi aliyaona wakati wa utawala wa Uzia, Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Aya namaroro Isaya, mosinto bw'Amosi, aroche igoro y'ense y'Abayuda na omochie o Yerusalemu ekero Usia, na Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, baarenge abarwoti ase ense y'Abayuda.

English: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
Kiswahili: “Nihurumieni, rafiki zangu, kuweni na huruma, kwa kuwa mkono wa Mungu umenipiga.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasani baane, ndorera amabeebe, ndorera amabeebe, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae kwang’akire!

English: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Naomi alirudi pamoja na Ruthu Mmoabu mkwe wake, nao wakafika Bethlehemu mwanzoni mwa kuvuna shayiri.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Naomi airanete korwa ase ense y'Abamoabu amo na Rutu, oria Omomoabu, moka momura oye. Barabwo bagaika Bethlehemu ekero abanto konya bachakire kogesa esairi.

English: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika mwingine, aliyekuwa na mamlaka juu ya moto, akatoka kwenye madhabahu, naye akamwita yule malaika mwenye mundu mkali kwa sauti kubwa, akisema, “Chukua mundu wako mkali ukakusanye vichala vya mizabibu ya dunia, maana zabibu zake zimeiva.”
Ekegusii: Erio korwa ase egesasiimero omomalaika onde agasoka, oyore nokobua igoro ase omorero, agakwana neriogi rinene, agateebia oyio orenge nomoyio okogesa, “Butora nomoyio oo okogesera, na gosangereria ebisago bi’amasabibu ’emesabibu y’ense, ekiagera amasabibu aye atobire.”

English: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Kiswahili: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,
Ekegusii: Ebali na Abimaeli, na Seba;

English: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,
Kiswahili: Iwapo mtu huyo hana jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa mali hiyo kwa ajili yake, lakini yeye mwenyewe akafanikiwa na kupata mali itoshayo kuikomboa,
Ekegusii: Omonto oria otabwati omonto omwabo oranyare komobooreria eria aoonetie, korende ere omonyene aise konyora enibo eisaine kobooria omwando oye,

English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sini, wakapiga kambi huko Dofka.
Ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sini, bakageenda bagaika Dofuka, bagatoora aroro.

English: After the king had burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
Kiswahili: Baada ya mfalme kuchoma kile kitabu kilichokuwa na yale maneno Baruku aliyokuwa ameyaandika kutoka kinywani mwa Yeremia, neno la Bwana lilimjia Yeremia likisema:
Ekegusii: Magega omorwoti gasambire egetabu eria yabwate amang’ana aya Baruku ariigete ekero Yeremia are koyakwana, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamoteebia,

English: Don't exalt yourself, lest you fall and bring dishonor upon your soul. The Lord will reveal your secrets and will cast you down in the midst of the congregation, because you didn't come to the fear of the Lord and your heart was full of deceit.
Kiswahili: Usijisifu, usije ukaanguka na kuleta aibu juu ya nafsi yako. Bwana atafichua siri zako na kukutupa chini katikati ya kusanyiko, kwa sababu hukumcha Bwana na moyo wako ulikuwa umejaa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwerori bosio bw'abaanto, renda omonwa oo.

English: Since I am already found guilty, why should I labor in vain?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nimeonekana mwenye hatia, kwa nini basi nitaabishwe bure?
Ekegusii: Inche goika mbarwe ng’a nomokori amabe inde. Nase ki rende ngwechanda nemeremo ere bosa?

English: Why does one day excel another, when all the light of every day in the year is from the sun?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini siku moja hupita nyingine, wakati mwanga wote wa kila siku katika mwaka unatoka kwenye jua?
Ekegusii: Ninki gekogera kera rituko rikororekana koba riao ko onsi nigo akonyoora omobaso obo korwa ase risase erimo?

English: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
Kiswahili: Zebadia, Aradi, Ederi,
Ekegusii: Sebadia na Aradi, na Ederi,

English: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you; that is why I am giving you this command today.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni kuwa ninyi mlikuwa watumwa huko Misri naye Bwana Mungu wenu aliwakomboa. Ndiyo sababu nimewapa agizo hili leo.
Ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a nainwe ’mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene Nyasae oino, akababooria korwa aroro. Ase engencho eyio nabachiikire amang’ana aya rituko ria reero.

English: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
Kiswahili: Ninakusifu kwa sababu nimeumbwa kwa namna ya ajabu na ya kutisha; kazi zako ni za ajabu, ninajua hayo kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Nigo 'nkogotogia, ekiagera natongetwe ase enchera y'ogokumia, na ey'ogoichania. Ogokora kwao nigo kore okuya kw'ogokumia! Igo nimanyete amang'ana ayio buya ase omoyo one.

English: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akatumika miaka saba ili kumpata Raheli, lakini ilionekana kwake kama siku chache tu kwa sababu ya upendo wake kwa Raheli.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akamokorera emiaka etano na ebere aegwe Raeli. Emiaka eyio ekarorekana asare buna namatuko makeigo, ekiagera nigo amwanchete Raeli mono.

English: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
Kiswahili: mafuriko yangalitugharikisha, maji mengi yangalitufunika,
Ekegusii: naende emerindo nigo yarenge goocha gotokorobanania, eooro nigo yarenge goocha goeta igoro yaito;

English: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh's house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into Yahweh's house into it.
Kiswahili: Yehoyada kuhani akachukua kisanduku na akatoboa tundu kwenye kifuniko chake. Akakiweka kando ya madhabahu upande wa kulia unapoingia hekaluni mwa Bwana. Makuhani waliolinda ingilio wakaweka ndani ya kisanduku fedha zote ambazo zililetwa katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Yehoyada Omokuani akarenta esanduki enkong'u akayebochora akabao ase ekemumeko kiaye, akayebeeka mbarabare y'egesasiimero ensemo y'okorio, ase abanto bare gosoera enyomba y'Omonene. Na abakuani baria barendete agwo ase egesieri ki'enyomba, akabeeka ime ase esanduki eria chitaabu chionsi chiarentetwe ase enyomba y'Omonene.

English: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile mtego unasavyo, ndivyo siku hiyo itakavyowapata wanadamu wote waishio katika uso wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Naki naboigo eranyaare goochera abanto bonsi abamenyete igoro ase ense yonsi.

English: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
Kiswahili: Kapu lako na chombo chako cha kukandia kitalaaniwa.
Ekegusii: “Neragererigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo n’ebituba biaino mogoseera obosie.

English: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God's service, continually doing this very thing.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii mnalipa kodi, kwa maana watawala ni watumishi wa Mungu, ambao hutumia muda wao wote kutawala.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio naende nakio mokoruera ebango, ekiagera abare n'okobua nigo bare abakoreri ba Nyasae, ase ogokora emeremo eyio eyio.

English: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God's Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Yohana, ndugu yenu ninayeshiriki pamoja nanyi mateso katika Yesu na katika ufalme na uvumilivu katika saburi, nilikuwa katika kisiwa cha Patmo kwa ajili ya neno la Mungu na ushuhuda wa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Inche Yohana, momura omino, na omobwatani amo nainwe ase emechando, na ase oborwoti, na ase okoremereria amo na Yeso, nigo narenge ase egesinka gekorokwa Patimo, ekiagera nigo narenge koraria ring'ana ria Nyasae na komobera Yeso kirori.

English: “So he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down, and break it in pieces.
Kiswahili: "Akasema, ‘Mnyama wa nne atakuwa ufalme wa nne duniani, ambao utakuwa tofauti na falme zote, nao utaila dunia yote, na kuikanyaga, na kuivunja vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro akwanete igoro y'eng'iti eria ya kane, agateeba: Oborwoti bwa kane mbobe ase ense, borobwo nigo borabe nogwatananekana korwa ase amarwoti ande onsi. Nigo borarie ense yonsi na koyetindachera inse, naende boyebutorane ebe ebing'ese.

English: So they glorified God in me.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamtukuza Mungu kwa sababu yangu.
Ekegusii: Bagatogia Nyasae ase engencho yane.

English: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nikasema, “Hekima ni bora kuliko nguvu.” Lakini hekima ya maskini imedharauliwa, wala hakuna anayesikiliza maneno yake.
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obong'aini nigo bore obuya mbobuete chinguru, nonya obong'aini bw'omonto oria omotaka bwachayetwe, na amang'ana aye tarenge koigwerwa.”

English: He who implanted the ear, won't he hear? He who formed the eye, won't he see?
Kiswahili: Je, aliyeweka sikio asisikie? Aliyeumba jicho asione?
Ekegusii: Inee! Oyo otongete amato, tari koigwa? Ere oyo otongete amaiso, tari korora?

English: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ingawa niliwaandikia, haikuwa kwa sababu ya huyo aliyekosa au huyo aliyekosewa. Lakini nilitaka ninyi wenyewe mwone, mbele za Mungu, jinsi mlivyojitoa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Nabo, nonya nabariikerete, tindigeti ase engencho yaye ere oyokorete bobe, gose tari ase engencho yaye ere oyokoreretwe bobe, korende ogwetigana kwaino ase tore konyare koorokigwa ase more ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama tuna chakula na mavazi, tutaridhika navyo.
Ekegusii: Gaaki, onye tore nendagera ne chianga, inatoisaneke n'ebinto ebio.

English: The rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD are wealth and honor and life.
Kiswahili: Unyenyekevu na kumcha Bwana huleta utajiri, heshima na uzima.
Ekegusii: Abare abaitongo bamoirogete Omonene nigo bakonyora obotenenku, na ogosikwa, na obogima.

English: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
Kiswahili: isipokuwa uwe umetukataa kabisa na umetukasirikia pasipo kipimo.
Ekegusii: Gose ngwatotangire kegima? Nigo ogendererete kogechigwa mono naintwe?

English: For this is what the LORD says concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who succeeded his father Josiah but has gone forth from this place: “He will never return,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kuhusu Shalumu mwana wa Yosia, aliyeingia mahali pa baba yake kuwa mfalme wa Yuda, lakini ameondoka mahali hapa: “Yeye kamwe hatarudi tena.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro ya Salumu, mosinto o Yosia, Salumu oria ogamberete Abayuda ribaga ria ise na akagenda agatiga aase aa: “Ere takoirana aiga nonya ng’ake,

English: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God's house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wakamwendea Hilkia kuhani mkuu na kumpa fedha ambazo zilikuwa zimeletwa ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana ambazo Walawi waliokuwa mabawabu walikuwa wamezikusanya kutoka kwa watu wa Manase, Efraimu na mabaki wote wa Israeli kutoka kwa watu wote wa Yuda na Benyamini na wakazi wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Bakairera Hilikia, Omokuani omonene, chitaabu echi konya chiarentirwe ase enyomba ya Nyasae, na chiria Abalawi na abarendi b'ebisieri basangereretie korwa ase Abamanase na Abaefraimu, na korwa ase abanto abatigari b'Abaisraeli, na korwa ase Abayuda na Ababenjamini bonsi, na korwa ase abanto ba Yerusalemu.

English: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke aliyeolewa amefungwa na sheria maadamu mumewe yu hai. Lakini mumewe akifa, basi mwanamke huyo yuko huru kuolewa na mume mwingine ampendaye, lakini lazima awe katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokungu nigo asibire ase omosacha oye ekero omosacha oye are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe; nanyare konyuomwa na monto onde bwensi oyo aranche, korende nase Omonene oka.

English: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers' house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers' houses among the thousands of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wakatuma pamoja naye watu kumi ambao ni viongozi, mmoja kwa kila kabila la Israeli, kila mmoja aliyekuwa kiongozi katika mgawanyiko wa jamaa miongoni mwa koo za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang'ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki'Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw'eamate ase egesaku kiaye.

English: Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watumwa wako wa kiume na wa kike watatoka katika mataifa yanayokuzunguka; kutoka kwao waweza kununua watumwa.
Ekegusii: Onye koganetie abasomba, abamura gose abaiseke, nabo oranyaare kobagora korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bibaetanaine inwe.

English: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king's presence.
Kiswahili: Taarifa hiyo ilipochunguzwa na kuonekana kuwa kweli, maafisa hao wawili waliangikwa juu ya miti ya kunyongea. Haya yote yaliandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu mbele ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Obotuki bogakorwa, na amang'ana akanyorekana ng'a namaene arenge; abanto baria babere bakabwatwa, bagatongwa ase chimbambo igoro. Amang'ana ayio akarikerwa ase obosio bw'omorwoti ase Egetabu ki'amang'ana arenge gokoreka.

English: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Kile kimtokacho mtu ndicho kimtiacho unajisi.
Ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.

English: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unisikie na kunihurumia, Ee Bwana, uwe msaada wangu.”
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amaabera! Omonene, inkonye!

English: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
Kiswahili: “Adui zetu wote wamefumbua vinywa vyao wazi dhidi yetu.
Ekegusii: “Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.

English: All this I tested by wisdom, saying, “I resolve to be wise.” But it was beyond me.
Kiswahili: Yote haya niliyajaribu kwa hekima, nikasema, “Nimeamua kuwa na hekima”: lakini hii ilikuwa nje ya uwezo wangu.
Ekegusii: Aya onsi ngateema koyaenekia ase enchera y’obong’aini, ngateeba, “Goika imbe nobong’aini.” Korende obong’aini obwo bokabeera aare korwa ase ’nde.

English: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
Kiswahili: Mtu maskini huomba kuhurumiwa bali tajiri hujibu kwa ukali.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omotaka agokwana nigo agosorora, korende omonda nigo akoiraneria ase obotindi.

English: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
Kiswahili: ya tatu Harimu, ya nne Seorimu,
Ekegusii: obwa gatato bokagwera Harimu, na obwa kane Seorimu;

English: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, wala si kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu tu, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhambi za ulimwengu wote.
Ekegusii: Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.

English: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
Kiswahili: Sethi aliishi jumla ya miaka 912, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Seti nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi na ebere (912), erio agakwa.

English: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Nipeni na mimi uwezo huu ili kila mtu nitakayeweka mikono yangu juu yake apate kupokea Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: agateeba: “Ing'a nainche okobua oko, ng'a kera omonto ndabeekere amaboko aane anyore Omoika Omochenu.”

English: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo sikiliza dua ya mtumishi wako na maombi yake kwa huruma, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Sikia kilio na dua ambayo mtumishi wako anaomba mbele zako siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo; oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, nkogosaba.

English: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
Kiswahili: Gaagaa kwa utungu, ee Binti Sayuni, kama mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa, kwa kuwa sasa ni lazima uuache mji ukapige kambi uwanjani. Utakwenda Babeli; huko utaokolewa. Huko Bwana atakukomboa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zako.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw'omokuungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babiloni, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko 'ababisa baino.

English: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: ‘Kwa kuwa wote mmekuwa takataka ya chuma, nitawakusanya Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya n'aro Omonene agoteeba: Ekiagera inwe mwensi mwabeire buna amabiria, rora nimbasangererie, 'mbarente ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu,

English: so that he detests his bread, and his soul loathes his favorite food.
Kiswahili: kiasi kwamba maisha yake yenyewe yanakataa chakula nayo nafsi yake ikakichukia kabisa hata chakula kizuri.
Ekegusii: Omoyo oye ogecha endagera, nonya endagera ere engiya mono.

English: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
Kiswahili: Paulo akashuka chini, akajitupa juu yake na kumkumbatia, akasema, “Msishtuke, uzima wake bado umo ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora: “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”

English: On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples. The nations will seek Him, and His place of rest will be glorious.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo, Shina la Yese atasimama kama bendera kwa ajili ya mataifa. Mataifa yatakusanyika kwake, na mahali pake pa kupumzikia patakuwa utukufu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Oyore Egesebo kie ritina ria Yese natenene abe ekemanyererio ase abanto; abanto b’ebisaku mbamorigie, na obomenyo bwaye mbobe nobonene obonge.

English: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
Kiswahili: Naye Baba mwenyewe ameshuhudia juu yangu. Hamjapata kamwe kuisikia sauti yake wala kuona umbo lake,
Ekegusii: Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori ase 'nde. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora

English: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kuhusu kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu: Tunajua kwamba “Sanamu si kitu chochote kabisa duniani,” na kwamba “Kuna Mungu mmoja tu.”
Ekegusii: Gaki ase amang'ana ay'okoria ebinto bikoruegwa ebing'wanso ase emegwekano y'ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng'a “omogwekano bw'ogosasimwa tai gento ase ense”, ekiagera twamanyire ng'a “Nyasae onde tari aande, otatiga oyomo bweka.”

English: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
Kiswahili: “Aroni atamtoa huyo fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka yake ya dhambi ili afanye upatanisho kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Ritang'ani arue eeri ebe ekeng'wanso ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b'enka yaye, erinde baaberwe.

English: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini mmegeuka mkaiacha njia, na kwa mafundisho yenu mmesababisha wengi kujikwaa. Mmevunja agano na Lawi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: “Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y'amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw'ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba.

English: This is what the LORD says: “What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me, and followed worthless idols, and became worthless themselves?
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “Je, baba zenu waliona kosa gani kwangu, hata wakatangatanga mbali nami hivyo? Walifuata sanamu zisizofaa, nao wenyewe wakawa hawafai.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Mbobe ki chisokoro chiaino chiaroche ase ’nde, erinde chigantiga, chikagenda gosasiima emegwekano ere bosa nabarabwo bakaba bosa?

English: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God's dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
Kiswahili: Nami nikasikia sauti kubwa kutoka kile kiti cha enzi ikisema, “Sasa makao ya Mungu ni pamoja na wanadamu, naye atakaa pamoja nao. Yeye atakuwa Mungu wao nao watakuwa watu wake, naye Mungu mwenyewe atakuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene rikorwa ase ekerogo keria ki'obonene rigoteeba, “Rora obomenyo bwa Nyasae nigo bore amo na Mwanyabaanto. Ere namenye amo nabarabwo, na barabwo nababe abanto baye, na Nyasae omonyene nabe amo nabarabwo.

English: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
Kiswahili: Chini ya mabawa yao katika pande zao nne walikuwa na mikono ya mwanadamu. Wote wanne walikuwa na nyuso na mabawa,
Ekegusii: Inse ye chimbaaba chiabo, ase chinsemo chiabo inye, nigo biabwate amaboko buna aya Mwanyabaanto. Amasio abo ne chimbaaba chiabo nigo biarenge iga:

English: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kumbukeni kwamba ninyi ambao hapo awali mlikuwa watu wa Mataifa kwa kuzaliwa na kuitwa “wasiotahiriwa” na wale wanaojiita “waliotahiriwa” (yaani tohara ifanyikayo katika mwili kwa mikono ya wanadamu),
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inyora buna mwareenge kare. Inwe abanto b’Ebisaku ase chingeencho chi’omobere mware korokwa abanto batarogeti na baria bakwaroka ase okwaroka kw’omobere kogokorwa n’amaboko.

English: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
Kiswahili: “Tumelichunguza hili, nalo ni kweli. Hivyo lisikie na ulitendee kazi.”
Ekegusii: “Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang'ana ayio; naro nay'ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang'ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”

English: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, alipokuwa Rumi, alinitafuta kwa bidii mpaka akanipata.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akanyoora.

English: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Sabato ilipomalizika, Maria Magdalene, Maria mama yake Yakobo, na Salome walinunua manukato ili wakaupake mwili wa Yesu.
