Kiswahili: Kenya's Push To Promote Traditional Food Is Good For Nutrition And Cultural Heritage
Ekegusii: Erango yogosegeta chindagera chia abakoro mbuya na koererani egekoro

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Kitui County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenerete oboremi bwa Kenya (KEPHIS) kigokomokia abanto bwa Kitui County buna ogoteba amache nigo gokinia oboremi bwa kare na kare.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Lamu County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bia Emasomo nigo bigoteba abasabi ase Lamu Kaonti gochia ase egetaseni gia ogotebwa emiaka egokwenera ase ogotebwa okwo.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Tana River County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Tana River kobwaterana korenda kuborirekana kia banyabiasara ase kia bokosha oboasioku.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns cassava farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawaonya wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Ekegusii: Ministiri ya Oboremi na Mienyamokirimbi yametendeza majembe na majembe a vyakula a viazi kwenye kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhusu ebiateko ya enyamokirimbi na kuyarekomenda mazoezi ya mafanikio makubwa kwa muda wa mafanikio.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Nakuru County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragire abamama ase ekaunti ya Nakuru gocha ase oborwari bwa abana ase rituko rierigirwe erio korenda obochari bwabana babo.

English: Free voter education app launched – scan QR code in your classroom today.
Kiswahili: Programu ya elimu ya mpiga kura bila malipo imezinduliwa – skani msimbo wa QR darasani mwako leo.
Ekegusii: Egekoreri kegosomia amasomo obegasaku bosa giachakirwe, eka ebicha koyonyora abwo ase enyomba yogosomera yesukuru.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Nandi County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: Ofis ya Rejisho ya Vipartamenti vya Siasa hukumbusha jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kujilazisha rishiki katika ofisi za kibinadamu ni bure, salama, na siri.

English: Canisius Kanangire Kenya's Agriculture and Livestock Development Cabinet Secretary Mthika Linturi in March 2023 asked Kenyans to feed on rice, sweet potatoes ..
Kiswahili: Canisius Kanangire Waziri wa Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo wa Kenya Mthika Linturi mnamo Machi 2023 aliwataka Wakenya kulisha mchele, viazi vitamu ..
Ekegusii: Goetera omorai Canisius Kanangire Kenya's Agriculture and Livestock Development Cabinet Secretary Mithika Linturi egetamo 2023 boria aba' Kenya koria endagera yomochere as obonge, amarabwoni, ...

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges tea growers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri y'Oborimi na Oboreri bw'Ebitungo nigo eragete abanyamwaka b'echayi ase Nakuru County gokora egechera chi'okogenderera gokomera ebitare nigo bagocha gokonya obwame bwe ritaka gokora amanyaka amaya ase omwaka ogwo.

English: Children exposed to smoke are more likely to develop asthma and respiratory infections.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaovuta moshi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata pumu na maambukizi ya njia ya upumuaji.
Ekegusii: Abana bakongusa amarioki nkonyora bare amarwaire ya amayaa na okoeyana

English: Provide first aid kits 2020.
Kiswahili: Kutoa vifaa vya misaada ya kwanza 2020.
Ekegusii: Kabe entongori enyamoreo 2020.

English: AFA urges farmers in Bungoma County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: AFA nogo egosorora abaremi ba Bungoma County ogokomera bisia okogesa korema amaroba riao keania omogoko bweriroba riao goika embura eyomo yogwekongia.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kajiado County.
Ekegusii: Gorogoro: Kenya Gazette itakorya goika ase ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese chi Kajiado ekaonti.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Isiolo County on soil conservation this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu uhifadhi wa udongo Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Eriango: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board kigokora ogotendeka abaremi ase Isiolo County igoro yoboremi bwa oborendi bw'egetaka ase omotienyi 12.

English: COMESA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kwale County this January.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale Januari hii.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo egwete oboore bwo gotema chimburi chio'oborua na chio'omonywa ase chimburi chiomogaka ase ekaonti ya Kwale ase omotienyi 1.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Busia County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebuare abananto Busia kwogo kwa ngoro yobokoreri bwabo ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto, giakwana kisiria, na kisindia.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Bomet County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi bokebago Bomet bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu komanyia eserikari bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotingia obokoreri.

English: Notice: IEBC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: IEBC nigo ekoborokia chitariki chiokorengwa ase amasukuru amakoro ase Murang'a County.

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased typhoid risk in Tana River County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Tana River na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Ekegusii: Obosemia bwobuto bwa abanto: Ekeombe keria gekorora endwari na gochigenderera (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo konyorete abanto igoro yoburembe bwa endwari ya typhoid ase Tana River County na gosemia abanto batakwanana na amache ayo atarerigwe nebiara.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos.
Ekegusii: Ekerenga: NDMA orure ogokurerwa ase okomentekana gwa ekerenga kiamangana abeene agotomwa gochia okoumerana chikaonti ya Machakos.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Baringo County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Baringo Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yobonyagitari eyio etari gochiara eya KEMRI erakorwa ase Baringo County ase omotienyi 5.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Nyandarua County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: IPOA yasororire abanainchi go Nyandarua kaonti ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache, tibatema goetanga amagoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Laikipia County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: ODPP yoborera enyore aaria Laikipia enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene yoborera okoborera okoborera na okoborera.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges wheat growers in Nyandarua County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya gie okorora obororo bwemera (KEPHIS) nigo korigiria abaremi bweengano ase Nyandarua County konyora obokonyi bwa koria ebinyoro bia fall armyworm kare goetera gokoresia dawa chiatoretwe na abasomi nigo barende konyora erigesa rinene ase omwaka oyu.

English: Clean the grain and dry it to a moisture content of 11-12%; soybeans above 13% moisture are likely to mould, and grain dried below 11% is likely to crack.
Kiswahili: Ondoa uchafu kwenye mbegu na ukaushe hadi unyevu ufike asilimia 11-12; soya zenye unyevu zaidi ya asilimia 13% huenda zikaoza, na ukikausha zaidi ya asilimia 11 mbegu zitapasuka.
Ekegusii: Kulima chakula na orwomo kwa nyuma ya 11-12%; mung beans zisizwa kwa nyuma ya 13% zina uwekeshwa na chakula kwa nyuma ya 11% ina uwekeshwa kuchoka.

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Kilifi County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerero: TVET ekeria abamenyi ba Kilifi County amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge bwabo.

English: SHA updates residents of Kiambu County on progress of the county integrated development plan this December.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Desemba.
Ekegusii: SHA yasegetire abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Kiambu kobwaterana ase omagenderero yekaonti yabo yosegeta esagati.

English: AFA urges pigs farmers in Mombasa County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Echama ya AFA yarure abaremi b'enguruwe ase Mombasa County konyora amang'ana ase chinyama chire oborwari ase ofisi ya abaveterinari eria eri habechi, konyora amang'ana ayio agochire ase oborwari bwa anthrax.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Kakamega County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe y’Omosaria yarure oboitaai abamenyi gotindeka ekaunti ya Kakamega kobwaterana korenda abamenyi kogima kweny abasigari kweny oboasioku.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises avocado producers in Kakamega County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walio na leseni kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bi'oboremi na obokoreri bwetugo nigo bigoteba abaremi b'emavocado ase Kakamega County gocha gokora amagori gabo ase abaguri baria bare na ebarua y'oborokeri mbere y'omwaka ogokonya rigesa.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Kenya Medical Association nekoririria abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi County batagokwa n'obororo bwa chinkaari, na bagetere namba ya simu ya bwerere ya oborwaire bwobwongo.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: Ekigo gia Kenya gia Okorokereria Ebisomo (KICD) kioraire chitariki chiokwerikia abanyere obokonyi bwa masomo ase chisukuru chiri Bungoma County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces outpatient services for residents of Garissa County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuanzia Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gia okorora chindwa na okobwata chindwa nigo koraaria obomanyi bwa okorwaria abanto abatararwarire ase abamenyi ba Garissa County gosekerera ase omotienyi 5.

English: NDMA urges residents of Isiolo County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NDMA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya isiolo korire amakora a omosiongoroko kwa omesiri gosira amidu omisimire omosiri gwekunyina.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: family planning counselling clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Amachoni goetera ase Kenya Medical Association: chikiriniki chiogoteba igoro yoboremi bwekaana chirakore chire kera omotienyi 8 ase chichitue chio oboroche bwa amagenderero ase Laikipia County.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this March.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai ya omosaria osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya laikipia kwerikia omorero ogwateka ebiateko ebitateka egetamo hii.

English: Millers and grain importers granted duty waivers for maize and rice have 7 days to provide proof of importation or risk losing their licenses No imports will be allowed after August 2023
Kiswahili: Wasagaji na waagizaji wa nafaka waliopewa msamaha wa ushuru wa mahindi na mchele wana siku 7 kutoa uthibitisho wa kuagizwa kutoka nje au hatari ya kupoteza leseni zao Hakuna uagizaji utakaoruhusiwa baada ya Agosti 2023.
Ekegusii: Echika ni mungi ni amabere ekebisi egetuma na obokorere. Akanani amatuko 7 atuokone as'amanywa obosio bwe bokurudia. Ekunywa ekebisi ni ekenya mashaka ritie riete 2023.

Kiswahili: Shule zilizoathiriwa na mafuriko hupokea Ksh 10m kila moja kwa ajili ya kazi za maji ya maji kuanza Jumatatu!
Ekegusii: Chisukuru chiria chire ase chingongo chikobeya amache chinyore chisiringi chimirioni 10 kera eyemo gokonya gwata emetaro, emeremo eye nigo egochaka etichi rimo!

English: Notice: OGP opens polling procedures centres in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Kuburudia: OGP okoigora chikorongo chia okuokorwa goika chitariki riete ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a trauma counselling forum in Kilifi County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ushauri nasaha wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KEMRI kigocha gokora omoroberio ogokomora abanto abare na obororo ase Kilifi County ase omotienyi 10. Abanto bonsi nigo baborigwe gocha.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Egesaku: KMTC okoigora ogosaba kwao chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara kwa Mombasa County.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Tana River County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: NDMA inao konya bari batarareirwe gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Tana River chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bobe abande (GBV) inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bobe ase enamba yesimi yogokonya 116 inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bobe ase enamba yesimi yogokonya 116.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs coffee farmers in Uasin Gishu County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nigo gikoboria abanyamwaka b'emwanyi ase Uasin Gishu County igoro yechingira chipeya chokorandia emwanyi chiochire omotienyi 7.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Nairobi County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Red Cross ya Kenya berekera egonde ase Nairobi County ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: FAO urges millet growers in Kiambu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawasihi wakulima wa millet katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kudhibiti wizi wa askari wa kuanguka mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: FAO igosha abiria milleti a Kiambu gindigwa kuyera amagoro kuhindigwa kuyera fall armyworm kwa wakati wa mwaka wa hii wa gindigwa wa kuyera amagoro

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to engage with the Kenya Denmark partnership to improve food safety and agricultural development
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushirikiana na ushirikiano wa Kenya Denmark ili kuboresha usalama wa chakula na maendeleo ya kilimo
Ekegusii: Abakoriria bwa Kenya banaoywa kuyegesha na uoro wa Kenya na Denmark kuyeyera endagera na kuyegesha kihurio cha kufanya matunda na mali

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nandi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) obasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya Nandi koegerera comiti eria yanka eusikaine nemeremo eyio omosiongoroko.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Meru County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokang'a abamama ase Meru County gochia ase ebitaro biokwibarira ebiroreire ase oboremi bwabo nigo bagokonywa komanya obomure bwoomwana obo.

English: Continue learning! Support schools in drought zones.
Kiswahili: Endelea kujifunza! Saidia shule zilizo katika maeneo ya ukame.
Ekegusii: Genderera gosoma! Konya chisukuru chiria chire ase chingongo chinyomo.

English: OGP reminds the public in Lamu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mapitio ya utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: OGP nyarigetie abanto aaria ekaonti ya Lamu yamoregete ebirengererio korua isiko buna erio komanya na gotanga chinchera abasae bagwesaria ebirengererio barabwo abanyene goetera eintaneti.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Lamu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Lamu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Obotuki bwobochenu: SHA (Social Health Authority) negochora igoro yoboremo bwoborwaire bwobofua (tuberculosis) ase Lamu County na gochora abanto gosegeta goikoresia chineti chiorosetwe dawa yechimbu chiro chionsi.

English: CDC calls on parents in Homa Bay County to have children under five screened for cholera during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa kipindupindu wakati wa ufikiaji wa Mei.
Ekegusii: CDC nigo egosaba abamama na abataata ase Homa Bay County kobateka abana abari ase emyaka etano gose egosekwa chindwara chia cholera ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 5.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kisumu County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekenyoro: KTDA egokora omoroberio bwokworokereria abaremi igoro yomwaka bwebitimbio ase abaremi ba Kisumu County omwaka oyu omotienyi 1.

English: CS Machogu advises parents to guide children in festive season.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwechisemi Machogu osemirie abaibori buna babwenerete korwa oborai ase abana babo chingaki chiemetimoko korwa esukuru nemeyega emenene.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased cholera risk in Trans Nzoia County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa kwobochenu: Kenya Red Cross nekorokia oboremo bwa chindwara chia cholera ase kaunti ya Trans Nzoia na gokaba abanto amang'ana okomanya abanto abange abakwenerwa goetera abakora bechibiro chiobochenu.

English: A malaria vaccine tested in Kenya gains WHO prequalification, costing as low as Sh300, becoming the world's second vaccine on the global prequalified list.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa nchini Kenya hupata kibali cha awali cha WHO, kwa gharama ya chini kama Sh300, na kuwa chanjo ya pili ulimwenguni kwenye orodha ya kimataifa ya kibali.
Ekegusii: Eriogo ria esindani y'ogotanga Esosera, riabeire rigotemwa ase Ense ya Kenya rianyarire goancherwa na goetigwa ase ekerengo egetang'ani na WHO. Nigo rikoonigwa sh.300, naende riabeire esindani ya kabere ase amariogo aria aetirigwe ase ekerengo ekio .

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Nyandarua County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board gokorera abanyamwaka ase Nyandarua County konyora engero yokomanya oborwaria bw'ebinyamwaka (fall armyworm) kare n'okogenderera gokoresia chidawa chireng'anirie mbere y'omwaka na omotienyi 7.

Kiswahili: Chama cha Wafanyabiashara wa Maembe nchini Kenya AKMT kinawakilisha wadau wa eneo la maembe na kusaidia wakulima katika kufikia masoko Jiunge sasa ili kuboresha ushiriki wako katika mnyororo wa thamani wa embe.

Kiswahili: KRA inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kericho Julai hii.

English: NPS alerts residents of Nyamira County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.

English: Cyclone Hidaya alert issued urging coastal residents to prepare for strong winds and floods.

English: DCI alerts residents of Kisii County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Mandera County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges rice growers in Kajiado County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches the county integrated development plan in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Vihiga.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Nyandarua County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.

English: State Department for TVET reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.

English: Leaving common bean roots in the soil after harvest adds an extra 20-60kg of nitrogen per hectare, available for the next crop - equivalent to 3/4-2 free bags of urea. With good agricultural practices, common bean can yield over 800kg per acre.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuna, mizizi ya maharage hubakia kwenye udongo na huongeza kilo 20-60 zaidi za nitrojeni kwenye udongo kwa hekta moja, ambayo itatumika kwa zao litakalofuata - sawa na mifuko 3/4-2 zaidi ya urea. Kwa kutumia mbinu sahihi za kilimo bora cha maharage, mavuno yanaweza kuwa zaidi ya kilo 800 kwa ekari.
Ekegusii: Kuokha omori ya magwandi ma egeka amaroba kubera gesa ina namba 20-60kg ya nitrogeni kwa hectare mo, yasiyo na kusanya kwa mahesabu ya mafuta ya kubera - ina namba ya 3/4-2 magetere ya urea ya kufunika. Na ebiya ya magwandi ma egeka, ina kusanya kubera gesa ya kubera kwa namba 800kg kwa acre mo.

English: OGP advises residents of Narok County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges coffee growers in Marsabit County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of pigs in Baringo County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.

Ekegusii: KEMRI negoetia abamama na ababa ase Busia County gochia nabana abari ase emiaka etano gosekerwa Rift Valley Fever ase omotienyi ogwa omotienyi 5.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMSA erangerete abanto bose ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County goyia amaboko na esabuni amo namache amayera obwango na obwango erio gokonya goikera oborwaire obo bwo gokonywa goikera.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) kioroire omonto omonene orenge na oboremi bw'ebirengererio ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County gochia ase chisesio chiokogokia abanto chitariki chi'erere ase oboremi bw'ebirengererio.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Nyamira County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa pesa za simu na inawashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: Nyamira County abamenyi agosegeta abamenyi komanyia eserekari bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotingia ebesa ebusia omoroberio omone bwense ogosegeta abanto komanyia eserikari.

English: Kiosks of Mombasa Covid 19: Testing kiosks without toutching is implemented in 6 elective counties in which there is no physical contact with the doctor and the patient. These kiosks test safely and with security, very fast and in plenty. These kiosks are build in this areas have become game changer
Ekegusii: Ebisa bia Mombasa Covid-19: Ebisa biogopimwa otari gokunwa nkoenanu bire ase amajimbo 6 y'obochori. Ebisa tibibwati gokunana konde gwonsi gati y'omonyagitari amo n'omorwaire. Ebisa ebi nigo bigoanchera ogopimwa kobwate oborendi naende kwa bwango na obonge. Ebisa ebi biroseiri ime y'ensemo eyio biarokirie obokoreri oboyia.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: AFA eragabie chimbeyo chiakawa chigendereretie gosekerwa abaremi ase Mombasa County ase omotienyi 11.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Trans Nzoia County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokang'a abamama ase Trans Nzoia County gochia ase ebitaro biokwibarira ebiroreire ase oboremi bwabo nigo bagokonywa komanya obomure bwoomwana obo.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for goats in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe biokonyora chindagera (Pest Control Products Board) nigo erararie ogotara echancho ya Newcastle ya bori bori ase chimburi ase Samburu County ase omotienyi 2.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Nyamira County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) yaboririe abamenyi giNyamira bono giasabire obokoreri goetera chinchera chindinge chia passport.

English: NPS urges the public in Kitui County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: NPS yasegetire abamenyi echi kaunti yaKitui korwa chiropoti mesaji yobwatekana kwaSIM-swap bokoru binde nobochori erio gotingia obokoreri ogotunya obokorwa chiropoti kengima.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Nairobi County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okorwata chindagera chio oborwaire bwa chinyamuchera (Pest Control Products Board) nigo korigia abanyamwaka ase Nairobi County gocha na kitambulisho kiao kia boka ase ogotebigwa okwo okwomwaka ogwo ogokwiza.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Baringo County to collect materials from the county education office to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kukusanya nyenzo kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kufikia maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yabwania endorero ya Baringo okogera ebinto ebikorerwa kwa ofisi yechisemi ya kaunti okobwatia komanya buna amasomo yegedichitari agoikeranigwa.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Nyesa: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu yaansire omoroberio  burukania abana bare noboremaru nabana bande ase chisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara kwomwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC) ase omoroberio bwokobarenga ase chisemi chiria chirengo ase Mombasa County.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Nakuru County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Ekegusii: NCPB eribokirie abanyamwaka ase Nakuru County igoro yomwaka ogwo ogokorwa ogwogoteba buna bakorwa ogotigwa chindui na oborwaria bwechimera.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Nyandarua County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: DPP obotambe ase ewizara yobotugi obaboririe abagambi komanyia abanto bonsi amagenderero yeserekari ase Nyandarua omorero ogwateka.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Uasin Gishu County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekiombe: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi oboroso ebisokire abakenya ba Uasin Gishu County kwa amariko gokorera kwa kibundu kya devolution.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Nyeri County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Egesaku giogoteba chindwara na ogokorera (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo gikobasoka abamenyi ba Nyeri County igoro yobwate bwo gokwoya amaboko ase oborongo bwomochie.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a September awareness campaign on tobacco control across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia abachiri ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) yaansire omoroberio bwokomanya abanto ase oborwanyi bwotabako ase omotienyi 9 kera ekaunti ya Nandi.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Nairobi County to enroll for tailoring and design training this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia TSC kioroire abasubati ase Nairobi County goika goitaba ogotenywa ase ogotuma chinguo na ogotara chinguo ase omotienyi 5.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Kajiado County to a free training on post-harvest handling this November.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egosegeta abaremi ba Kajiado County ase omoroberio obwogosomwa bwechiokora chie ebitoki nyuma yogocha ebitoki ebi ase omotienyi 11.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Garissa County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NDMA yarure okoboria ase abamenyi baborigwe Garissa County koba maiso erio gokoboria obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nyandarua County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri biokomanya amagara nigo bigokora omwango abanto ba Nyandarua County gochia ase oborori obwogosara amagara obwogotari chibesa nigo bwoyokonya gotanga oborwa bwa amayerwa araya gochaka.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Samburu County on progress of ward-level service delivery this January.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto amang'ana igoro yechikaonti chiabo ase ebinyoro, Samburu, eng’atiato.

English: Youth are encouraged to utilize online platforms to acquire skills for effective agribusiness Take action now to empower yourself in the agricultural sector
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kutumia majukwaa ya mtandaoni ili kupata ujuzi kwa ajili ya biashara bora ya kilimo Chukua hatua sasa ili kujiwezesha katika sekta ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Obosae bana gindigwa madaki e-matone kumwita amakosa kwa agribusiness Bonokera amakora bono kumwita amakosa kwa sekta ya kumwinda

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Marsabit County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya osabire abanto ba ekaunti ya Marsabit koegerera chinhera echi y'achichokorera okobwatanigwa abanto sim-swap fraud, ogotunya chinchogu okobwatanigwa abamenyi b'akosereko.

English: TVET calls on the community in Turkana County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: TVET b erekera egonde ase Turkana County komnyia obokonyi ase abana 116 gacha makendana mabwana.

English: Select a groundnut variety suited to your agro-ecological zone; in Nigeria, the Sahel, Sudan, and Northern and Southern Guinea savanna zones are the main groundnut-growing regions, so choose a variety adapted to your zone's maturity period and market preferences.
Kiswahili: Chagua aina ya karanga inayofaa kwa eneo lako la kilimo-ikolojia; nchini Nigeria, Sahel, Sudan, na maeneo ya savanna ya Kaskazini na Kusini mwa Guinea ndio maeneo makuu ya kukuza karanga, kwa hivyo chagua aina iliyobadilishwa kulingana na kipindi cha ukomavu wa eneo lako na mapendeleo ya soko.
Ekegusii: Chunywa chinchugu chenye rite marigiti wako na chenye rite rikanda rako, Nigeria ni nyingi marigiti chinchugu, Sahel, Sudan, na savanna ya Guinea Kaskazini na Kusini, kwa hivyo chunywa chinchugu chenye muda wa kujengwa na rite marigiti wako.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Narok County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Narok kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Ekegusii: EACC yaboririe entongori omoabaria buna bamenyete ime ya Narok koenekia nga koira bare ribaga erio koenekia ayabarigete boyia via SMS to 70000.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Nairobi County on conservation tillage this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Egechera: Bodi yechinono ya Kenya neigie abaremi ase Nairobi County ase oboremi bwo ogoteba omogondo ase omotienyi 8.

English: HELB urges residents of West Pokot County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia HELB nkororiria abamenyi ba West Pokot County gochia gosega obonyi bwa bursary mbere yatariki yogoika erio banyore obonyi bwa amasomo amakoro atari chibesa.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMRI ekoremereria abanto ase Tharaka-Nithi County igoro yobwate bwekomanya igoro yendwari ya oborwa bwe amachera ase obuya bwe chinyomba.

English: HELB advises applicants in Turkana County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: HELB egokora abasabi ase Turkana County gose barore ng'a barandikire mbere y'ebise biokosaba biterire ase okweng'ana okoroka.

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Makueni County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Kae chiyunifasiti chibesa gochisira korigia na konyora chisemi chinyia omonugunoobarema, okoraria korwa ebochieria chisukuru Makueni goting’igua oboikeranu bwamaagacho.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Taita-Taveta County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Gotema: NTSA gwanse obotikeranu kwebitabu biosoma kwabeire aria Taita-Taveta ekaunti kwa oktoba.

English: Farmers in Rift Valley and Western regions are encouraged to diversify by growing coffee alongside maize to enhance household income while ensuring food security
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Bonde la Ufa na mikoa ya Magharibi wamehimizwa kujikita katika kilimo cha kahawa pamoja na mahindi ili kuongeza kipato cha kaya huku wakihakikisha usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria ebate na Rift Valley ni amagurumia kuchagurumia chikagwa na egetuma kwa kujikoroga noma ya kuchoka kwa kumiriria endagera na kujikoroga kwa kumiriria ng'ombe

English: IEBC reminds residents of Bomet County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: IEBC yekorenda abamenyi bia Bomet bono giasabire obokoreri bweserikari giasabire abanto koeneki goetera chinchera chindinge.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Homa Bay County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: DCI yaboririe aboromokuru na aboshiria ekaunti ya Homa Bay okorwe kwokunyochia na okorwa chikoyi ase nyumba na kenchokera okong'a okusambisa madhinga yamarindwe.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nakuru County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorora na gochoka oborwaire nigo korigiririe abanto ba Nakuru County gochora bwa bima biabo biokwerenderera oborwaire erio banyare gochera obonyamokoro bwa oborwari bwa gosegeterwa.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kitui County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo katika msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kirengere abamenyi a Kitui County kubongere amagoro a ebiateko omorero.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of goats in Trans Nzoia County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Ekegusii: Etebwa: Ekeombe kia oborimi na echiobi (AFA) nigo kiregire ogotwarwa kwa chimburi ase Trans Nzoia County nigo kiregire gochia ase oborwari bwa Newcastle.

English: Notice: KTDA will open a tea collection centre in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KTDA neegue egesangio kiama ase Bomet County ase omotienyi 7.

English: NDMA urges the public in Embu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Embu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: NDMA baboririe abamenyi nchi Embu tobaisa okogaba enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ogotunya mabengi yao yoborikoboria SIM-swap.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Marsabit County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Ekegusii: KTDA eribokirie abanto ba Marsabit County buna oboremi obw'okonyora emechando y'ebimeri nigo bwonchoreria oboremi obuya ase chingaki chia kare.

English: KEMRI launches a December awareness campaign on safe water storage across Mandera County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo ekwate omoroberio bwogosomora abanto ase obwate bwa amache amaya ase omotienyi 12 ime ya Mandera County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Homa Bay County this March.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross nigo ekoremereria abanto ing'a ogosomwa kwa cyclosporiasis nigo konyorwa bwere ase chifakitory chionsi chia oborwaria ase Homa Bay County ase omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Nyeri County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya umakini wa kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ogokorwa: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie egonde korwa ebirengererio bwechimbere chieng'ombe ase Nyeri ekaunti ase engoromomi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Kajiado County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yobonyagitari eyio etari gochiara eya KEMRI erakorwa ase Kajiado County ase omotienyi 2.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Kitui County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yasegetire abasae Kitui County batarere abisi ere ange na IEBC yarikia nobochori erio gotingia oboteneneri.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Kiambu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Omosaria oboitaai b erekera egonde a Kiambu gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: AFA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Nandi County this May.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Nandi Mei hii.
Ekegusii: AFA yarure oborori bwogotema amarwaire a Newcastle ase chimbere ase ekaunti ya Nandi ase omotienyi 5.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya mama ya Mei.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia CDC kiorangerete abarengeti babana ase Kilifi County gochia gokwandika amakadi abana nabang'ina ase omwaka omotienyi 5 nigo ekerio kioborigori bwobochenu bwabang'ina nabana.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu zaidi cha IebC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: IEBC yasegetire abasae chikura Kisii County ngetarere chisekenderi IEBC yange na koerikia nobochori erio gotingia oboteneneri.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Garissa County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia FAO nigo kigoibokia abamenyi b'ebitungo ase Garissa County kobeka amang'ana ase ebisoro biabwo biabwate oborwa ase ofisi y'abaveterinari eria eri hakuhi na abwo, nigo barende konyora obokonyo bw'oborigari bw'ebitungo.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture Animal Industry and Fisheries MAAIF is creating a National Veterinary Medicine Authority to regulate veterinary medicine in Uganda Stakeholders are invited to participate in the ongoing engagement process
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo Sekta ya Wanyama na Uvuvi MAAIF inaunda Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Dawa ya Mifugo ili kudhibiti dawa za mifugo nchini Uganda Wadau wamealikwa kushiriki katika mchakato unaoendelea wa ushiriki.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi yeng’iti na amariogo MAAIF yarure yotonga okobwatanigwa bokobwatanigwa biamariogo beng’iti boganda. Abasangi basemigwe gosanga ebiro ebio okobwatera nabanto.

English: CDC reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia CDC nkoinyoria abanto bonsi ba Marsabit County ase obwate bwo okonyora obogima bwa chinyomba chiao goetera okobwate bwa obochio bwa chinyomba.

English: Notice: KNEC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KNEC yanyorete amange igoro yengaki yogoikerania abana ase amashure abasomi abange ase Vihiga County.

English: Daily activities plan for brain building
Kiswahili: Mpango wa utendaji wa kila siku wa kujenga ubongo
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’emeremo ya kera rituko y’ogoonchoreria afya y’obongo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Siaya County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwa Obong'aini - Egechama gia Obong'aini bw'abanto nigo korigiria abanto ba Siaya County kocheka okonyua amanyoro na esukari erio gotanga oborwari obo bwo gochaka.

English: HELB reminds schools in Kericho County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this November.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: HELB yasabire chisukuru gokong'ia emeroberio y'ogotanga okoambokerigwa ase chikaunti chia Kericho goikia November.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Ekegusii: NPS obegwara omotokoto na abanto ase ekaunti ya Mombasa okwara omorakera omorakera na etera chinchera chingiya arria ase chngongo chire neminano.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: Majamii wa Elgeyo-Marakwet yametumwa na Majamua ya Kabuna kuwajisikiliza kuhusu mapitio ya miaka kwa kutumia mlango wa ushauri wa serikali ya kaunti kwa mtandao wa kibinafsi

English: KNEC reminds parents in Murang'a County that school feeding programme registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: KNEC nigo ekoreibokia abamama na ababa ase Murang'a County buna ogochora abana ase omorengo ogokuria chisukuru nigo ogwanchire ase omotienyi 4.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kitui County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kitui na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Ekegusii: Eseriekari ya obokonyarekana: KEMRI bwarure ogokurera igoro yokonyarekana ya ebate Rift Valley Fever ne Kitui County, netang'aine abamenyi koerikia obokorera obokonyarekana bwose bwabwabu.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Isiolo County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Egisera yogoikerania oborwaire na ogokora (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo egokera abanto ba Isiolo County batagomera ase obororo bwa mona, na bagende bagere chisimunio chio oborwaire bwa mona chitarimo chigoro.

English: TVET encourages residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: TVET ogokora abanyoria ba Ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwa kubera kwa forum ya amasomo yobogesaku, bera tebia kwa kubera kwa omoroberio obochabu kwa buna chibesa chiechikanti.

English: CDC launches a May awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: CDC egwete omoroberio ogokonya abanto bamenye amange ase oborwaire bwobwong'aini bwe chinga ase omotienyi 5 ase Vihiga County.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete abantu ba Elgeyo-Marakwet baa chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto baa omoroberio ogekereka gokeani ogotakìa kwa ekaunti.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Nandi County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Nandi Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ngoke: NTSA naikorwania obokengeka igoro yamalisa kiajokera kia mokoro aaria ekaonti ya Nandi etureti ya kebaki.

English: Faulu Bank and USAID s KCDMS project will support 10 000 farmers with training on accessing loans and sustainable agriculture in 12 counties Participate in this opportunity to enhance your farming
Kiswahili: Benki ya Faulu na mradi wa USAID wa KCDMS utasaidia wakulima 10,000 kwa mafunzo ya kupata mikopo na kilimo endelevu katika kaunti 12 Shiriki katika fursa hii ili kuboresha kilimo chako.
Ekegusii: Faulu Engegu na USAID s KCDMS projekti kana kusokoa 10 000 aboremi na amorokererigua kuhusu kufika mali na oboremi yasiang'ori kwa 12 kaunti. Nyinyi kusanya kuhusu furaha yiyo kuhifadhi oboremi yenu

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nakuru County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia gochera na gokora amatemwa ase amarwairea (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo gokorokia abanto bori Nakuru County goika bagende ase ogosomwa kwa amagara okwa bwerere nario batange okonyarana kwa amarwairea ayo atangigwa.

English: CDC encourages residents of Kericho County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bose ba Kericho County ng'a tabakomanya obororo bwa chinsiri, na kobakong'a abanyanya babo abari ase obororo ng'a basare obokonyo.

English: Notice: COMESA will open an avocado collection centre in Meru County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Meru Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: COMESA erakonyora ekeombe gi'ogotera ebitunda ase Meru County ase omotienyi 3.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free safe water storage outreach in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokomanyia abanto: KEMSA egokora omoremo ogokonyera abanto buna bagabate amache ase oborendi ase Nakuru County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Washington Post highlighted unresolved disappearances tied to protest crackdowns, intensifying calls for investigative transparency.
Ekegusii: Abarai ba Washington Post mbaboretie igoro yabanto basira gose gokenganigwa ase engencho yokomiga baria bokorobererekana, eye yarangeirie okoboria ng'a obotuki bobe maiso marore.

English: Notice: OGP launches community-based development programmes in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Okorari: OGP gotuka oborendi goetera egonde yebinyoro goetra okoreta abarai nebiombe amo korora nga abanto bonsi mbuya bare kera ase bare kero Siaya yekaunti.

English: Notice: KALRO will open an avocado collection centre in Machakos County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Machakos Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya: KALRO egokonyora ekero giokogwata amapera ase Machakos County ase omotienyi 12.

English: Commission on administrative justice opens Garissa office; residents urged to report issues that need attention.
Kiswahili: Tume ya haki ya utawala yafungua ofisi ya Garissa; wakazi wahimizwa kuripoti masuala yanayohitaji kushughulikiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire chiobisi chiay3 ime ya garissa nakobria abamenyi gwesokia nakorigia obokoreri goetera komanyia chiobisi echio onsi ayare arengete obisi eyio.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a theft prevention campaign in Uasin Gishu County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani giaansire chikura yabo gokora ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase Uasin Gishu etureti ya kebaki.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobosirari bweindwa amo nokogwatanira (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nkogokwaniria abamama abari neindwa ase Nyamira County buna ogosaba obokonyi bweindwa nigo bware chigoti ase chisukuru chionsi chiogosomera.

English: Experts warn of protest‑related unrest; avoid high‑risk areas.
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wanaonya kuhusu machafuko yanayohusiana na maandamano; epuka maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abamanyi barure ogokurera igoro yemonanokorwa ase okorobererekana na emonano ebwatekaine; kabe are korwa ase ayio.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) egosaba omonto omonde orengete obororo bwobongo ase Homa Bay County gocha ase ogosomwa okwomogongo okwomwanya.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Embu County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Embu kuwasiliana na nambari ya msaada wa watoto 116.
Ekegusii: Efundu ya Vurisiti yoborigwa gosoka ase abaibori nabarimu ba Embu komnyia obokonyi ase abana 116.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Marsabit County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Marsabit gotumia ekeguru bia internetu kuwesemera chinekole kufite geria kubokorona bobe chibesa chieserikari.

English: Youths in villages have brgan farming with digital backround. Meet three youths from Asia who have discovered a new way of irrigating farms. Try goodnews A. IFAD..
Kiswahili: Vijana katika vijiji wana kilimo cha brgan na backround ya dijiti. Kutana na vijana watatu kutoka Asia ambao wamegundua njia mpya ya kumwagilia mashamba. Jaribu habari njema A. IFAD..
Ekegusii: Abasae bebinyoro baretire oboeremi ase ekegori eke kiegedichitari.Umerana abase batato bebinyoro aaria Asia abwo banyorire enchera enyia yogosiarera amche mogondo! Tema Amangana amayia Â· IFAD and...

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Kilifi County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokomanyia abang'ina abanyamwaka ase Kilifi County ng'a okonyora obwate bwo omong'ina orenge na amagenderero ase okwibarwa nigo obwate obwo bori bwerere ase chiofisi chionsi chieserikari.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Siaya County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMRI eribokire abakungu baria bari oborito ase Siaya County buna ogokonywa na abachumbe abanyabwate obwanchoni bwo gokonya abakungu korora abana nigo konyare gokorwa na bwerere ase chiofisi chiose chie eserekari.

English: Manage agricultural waste like food processing waste responsibly through composting, recycling, or safe disposal to minimize environmental impact.
Kiswahili: Dhibiti taka za kilimo kama vile taka za usindikaji wa chakula kwa uwajibikaji kupitia mboji, kuchakata tena au utupaji salama ili kupunguza athari za mazingira.
Ekegusii: Onchoreria ebogotigara korwa rigesa buna ebiemba gose amasaku koyaonchoreria boba obwoyo, ebinde kobionchoreria buna endagera yetugo ao ao na buna ogotuguta eubi korenda gose gokeania ogotiringa ebitoonchokanenete gose amasingira.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of West Pokot County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yeching'uru kiaboriri abamenyi ba West Pokot County goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo bera tebia nagokwanerana ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Mombasa County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Erituko riokomanyia abanto: Ekeombe giokorobererekana n'okorwaria chindwa (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo kigocha gokora omwaka ogokomanyia abanto igoro y'oborwari bwa haipatensheni (hypertension) ase obwate, ase Mombasa County ase omotienyi 9.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns rice farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ria amaguta ya Kenya (Kenya Dairy Board) rigocha amagenderero abanyamwaka b'omwera ase Murang'a County igoro y'ebinyamwaka biokonyona chimboga na gokora omotigo ogokorwa n'obwango.

English: Drought-affected families can access government relief food. Report hunger cases to the National Drought Management Authority.
Kiswahili: Familia zilizoathiriwa na ukame zinaweza kupata chakula cha msaada cha serikali. Ripoti visa vya njaa kwa Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame.
Ekegusii: Baria banyorirwe nomochando bweguragura enene nabo bakonyora endagera korwa eserikari.Karwe amang'ana igoro yabanto bare nchara gochia eserikari ensemo ya baria batenenerete ogokonya igoro yokorwa obokonyi chingaki chieguragura enene.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Bomet County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba uvunaji wa maji huboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekomiti y'ebiragiro by'okwomora ebisoro ebiroreire abanto ba Bomet County ng'a ogoteba amache nigo okong'onyora oboremi bw'omwaka omoce.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Bomet County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: KALRO yaragira abaremi bo Bomet goba na ikarata ya kisirikana ya kwenyamereirwe goto kwiga omoriberio ogori obosokani.

English: IPOA urges the public in Murang'a County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: IPOA ekeombe abamenyi koMurang'a giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kabosombe SIM-swap yamangana oborimo igoro yokobamanyia, kabogotunya obokoreri bweserikari kabogotunya.

English: High blood pressure in pregnancy can lead to preeclampsia. Regular check-ups are essential for early detection.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la damu kubwa wakati wa ujauzito linaweza kusababisha preeclampsia. Uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara ni muhimu kwa ugunduzi wa mapema.
Ekegusii: Amanyinga kominyoka mono kero omongina are mosigi nabo ekorenta oborwaire Koringorigwa botamba mbuya komanyiabkendabu

English: IEBC advises applicants in Baringo County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: IEBC egokora amagenderero abasabi ase Baringo County koba nabasabi bwo okwenerwa ase TVET gosegerera KUCCPS ase okwenerwa okwo okwagocha.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for revision guides for learners in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Ekegusii: Ikinywe: TVET okoigora kwa kubania kwa ebitabu ebiachano ase baria bagosoma amo Turkana County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Bungoma County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Bungoma koegerera mabwata ya kibweta na kusabirira mabwata ya kibweta ya abamenyi w'ebiateko omorero omorero ase amagoro.

English: Farmers in Uasin Gishu are encouraged to participate in National Farmers Day celebrations aimed at highlighting agricultural transformation
Kiswahili: Wakulima huko Uasin Gishu wamehimizwa kushiriki katika sherehe za Kitaifa za Siku ya Wakulima zinazolenga kuangazia mabadiliko ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria Uasin Gishu amabereka kubereka matumizi ya Amatuko ya Abakoriria mwa kumwita kuhusiana na mabegi ya kubereka chakula

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Embu County this August.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Embu Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC kiabwatanire goika ase ebikaranso bia amasomo chikura chikomanyia abanto erio komenta ase Embu riete.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a March awareness campaign on tobacco control across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Machi juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
