Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: KALRO erigie goigwera abaremi ase Bomet County igoro yoboremi bwo goikera ritaka ase omotienyi 6.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Tana River County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tana River kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: NPS baborigwe kobwaterana koenekia ng'a abamenyi na abarai korwa ekaunti ya Tana River bokobaga chikorwa chia okonyarekana okonene kwa endwari eye na kwa oborwaria.

English: Public launch of irrigated crop and fodder production in Naoros, where malnutrition cases among under-fives declined by 41% thanks to integrated agricultural-nutrition interventions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa uzalishaji wa mazao ya umwagiliaji na malisho ya mifugo huko Naoros, ambapo visa vya utapiamlo miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano vilipungua kwa 41% kutokana na hatua jumuishi za kilimo na lishe.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa ase abaremi komenta ebitoki ase oboremi ase okonyorokeria amache na chitugo aaria Naoros, ase okoria orachi kwarorekana ase abana inse yemiaka etano egakea ase 41% onye tari ogosoanana gwa okoragera okuya

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Marsabit County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Ekegusii: Oluchirio bwe Kenya osabire egonde a ekaunti ya Marsabit ogochaka igoro yabarendi (Nyumba Kumi) bwe kuboga ochokanaine.

English: NCPB urges pigs farmers in Nandi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za ugonjwa wa Newcastle zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: NCPB egosaba abaremi b'enguruwe ase Nandi County goika barete obwate bwo gotebia etugo yabo gochia ase chikaunti chindi chitarie na oborua bwo gochia, konyora amakuru y'amarwaire ya Newcastle.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Trans Nzoia County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomonene yomokoreri yomwana yosekera gochia abakoreri beserekari bwe Trans Nzoia kubwati amarago yokoroisia oboteneneri.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo bwe' komiti yebiama bia siasa yachakire oyera korwania okobaga ID ase ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Marsabit County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Kae chiyunifasiti chibesa osabire obosae ba ekaunti ya Marsabit koogereria amorokererigua ya okoragana na okoragania omonugunoobarema.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Kajiado County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Ekegancha ya Omosaria Oboitaai yarure okoboria ase abamenyi Kisii Kajiado koba maiso erio gokinia obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Wajir County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette yabooririe abasae entongori yogoaka chikura, abange buna Wajir County, ngetarere chisekenderi IEBC y'oboringoria.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for drought in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Chisemo: DCI kera chingaki kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria omorakera aaria Laikipia.

English: NPS warns residents of Kiambu County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: NPS yasemerie abamenyi e Kiambu County kochia erio gotingia obokoreri bokuru binde bionse bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura, yasemirie ng'a abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Samburu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (Kenya Dairy Board) nkorora kere nga abaremi bechinyama ase Samburu County bagwenerete gochia gochia amang'ana ase ofisi yobuveterinari eria eri hakuhi na abwo, nigo konyora oborendi bw'echinyama chiao.

English: Dairy farmers are encouraged to utilize the FarmTrek animal identification and traceability platform to connect with veterinary officials livestock authorities and financial services
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa wanahimizwa kutumia mfumo wa kitambulisho na ufuatiliaji wa wanyama wa FarmTrek ili kuungana na maafisa wa mifugo mamlaka ya mifugo na huduma za kifedha.
Ekegusii: Abaremi bwechikera baariganiigwe ase gindigwa omoreoberio o'FarmTrek komanya eng’iti, na komanya ase yarwete ngosambereria ore chiombe chinamba gose gochikera enyaberi, obureberi bwechikera na osindigwa.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Bungoma County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Ekegusii: TVET yaboriri abaibori nabarimu be'kaunti ya Bungoma kobeka boba ase obokonyi ase abana 116.

English: Moi referal hospital, conducted its firt surgery on brain surgey through radio stereotatic rays
Ekegusii: Enyagitari enene ya Moi, yakora okomanwa kwaye ogotangani goetra chinsase chia eredio kwa stereotactic ase omorwaire okansa yobongo

English: Protect your agricultural innovations and new varieties by understanding Intellectual Property (IP) rights like patents and plant breeders' rights.
Kiswahili: Linda ubunifu wako wa kilimo na aina mpya kwa kuelewa haki za Miliki (IP) kama vile hataza na haki za wafugaji wa mimea.
Ekegusii: Renda chingecho chia chioboremi amo na embusuri enyia ase okomanya buna okorenda obomanyi bwao (IP) oboronge buna boria bwokorosia egento ekeyia and oboronge bwogokeborana kwebimeri .

English: NTSA alerts residents of Kiambu County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NTSA yasemirie abamenyi a ekaonti ya Kiambu koerikia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) obokoreri bwa gikomere na gikomere.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Kwale County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Kwale wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Eserekari ya Omosaria ya Oboitaai baboririe abamenyi echi Kaunti ya Kwale tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio yobokoreri.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Kirinyaga County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) giokoringori abasikari babo Kirinyaga County goetera omwana wabo e gueng’i ekero kiemesekano kya esagati kya obokurumi bw’oborori.

English: A review detailed IPOA's achievements, challenges, and strategic direction and outlined next steps in police accountability reform.
Kiswahili: Mapitio yalielezea kwa kina mafanikio ya IPOA, changamoto, na mwelekeo wa kimkakati na kuainisha hatua zinazofuata katika mageuzi ya uwajibikaji wa polisi.
Ekegusii: Okorigereria keboyia ngwatebe geikaranu buna ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) giakorire buya, emechamndo ereo, amo nemeroberio yabeene yar koorokia ebitambokero bia motwe biogoikerania abasikari gotenera ebikotu biegasi yabo.

English: Agricultural products needs exemption from taxes and other excise duties that don̈t require markets..
Kiswahili: Bidhaa za kilimo zinahitaji kutolewa kodi na ushuru mwingine wa matumizi ambayo haihitaji masoko.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebi birorosirie korwa tibirusigwa ebange ende yonsi ase chibango chionsi chiria chireo boigo gokeania chibango chinde ase echiro ...

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns beans farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ebiro yechisemi yechitugo (Kenya Dairy Board) nigo egochengeria abaremi bechimboga ase Murang'a County igoro yechinyamuchera chigwete na gochera obwango ase oboremi.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba kere ogocha emo abachisekenderi bari Elgeyo-Marakwet ting’igua goetera ogosemia abana riete.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs tea farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Bodi ya Kenya ya mazi tebia abachai ba chai ba Nakuru ekaonti ya ekeyia marigiti oratange esagati ono.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kajiado County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kajiado County kwamba upatikanaji wa kumbukumbu za makazi salama zinapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: NDMA inayakorere bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Kajiado Gotende, eno omoko gosimi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe.

English: ODPP urges residents of Samburu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuwasiliana na msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: ODPP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya samburu kwerikia buna abogwabogwa bwa maboko yabo bera tebia gosira gwekaunti yabo yamagenderero.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Samburu County this January.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nekoribokia abanto bonsi buna okorora amarwaire ya Rift Valley Fever nigo kware ase chinchokoro chiomonyansi chiomogongo chiensi ase Samburu County ase omotienyi 1.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Nandi County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: IPOA yamanyia abamenyi bokebago Nandi bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu komanyia eserikari bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotingia obokoreri.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Kisii County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kisii koegerera chinchogu agasa gotumia chichiri kure kere gotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Siaya County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Siaya wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Ekegusii: Chikorongozi cha Kenya Red Cross chiremera wenyara ebesa yao yobobisi e Siaya County tosanga enemba yao ya M-Pesa ya PIN nonde bwensi okogaba enchera abange baibeirwe.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of West Pokot County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechinyagitari neebaganirie abamenyi ba West Pokot County konyora amangana amaya nga nyagitari yabo ere na obwate bwo gochia abaruari mbere yogocha gocha gosegerera obonyagitari bwo ogokonywa chibesa.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Narok County to prepare for possible road accidents this May.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok amaumuntia okobwatanigwa kubogekera igoro yemebasekano yepara kwa amaumuntia.

English: Youth Agenda launches a program to enhance youth participation in governance.
Ekegusii: Achenda yabasae yansire omoroberio bwogosegeta abasae gosanga na korwa ebirengererio ase obogambi.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross yerekera abamenyi ya Ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kwa egonde korwa kusokoria kwa mabwera kwa mabwera.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kirinyaga County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: DCI inao kwanera bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Kirinyaga, kwani ogokonya bari batarareirwe bese esukuru inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe bese esukuru.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokera abaremi ba Tharaka-Nithi County kora chindagera chiabo ase abaguri abare na echibali kio kora, erio konyora chibecha chire chinyinge ase chindagera chia chimboga na chibuto.

English: Announcement on health environment and and ballanced diet, good advice and services to reduce body congetion
Ekegusii: Okorari gwechinsemo chiobuya nechindagera ching'ikeranu, obosemi oboikeranu na obokoreri bwogokeani ogoichorerana kw'obongo ase ebitaseni ebinene

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Meru County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Meru Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo: NDMA gikinirie egonde omosiongoroko omosiekwa chipara esagati buekaunti Meru.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Echokorongo: DPP okoigora ekiriniki gia jenderi gia okonyora GBV gokonyora omotinyi ngotoka ya Samburu Abarwaire.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-citizen katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Kwao: e-Citizen okoigora ekeyia goitabwa neserikari giaito gia e-Citizen gokakamega bekaunti.

English: Proper post-harvest handling is crucial for maintaining quality of sweet potatoes. Learn best practices for sorting, grading, and initial storage.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji sahihi wa baada ya mavuno ni muhimu kwa kudumisha ubora wa viazi vitamu. Jifunze mbinu bora za kupanga, kuweka alama na uhifadhi wa awali.
Ekegusii: Enchera engiya yokesa na kogach rigesa nobwenencho ase okorenda oboikeranu bwamarabwoni ao. Egera igoro yengencho engiya yogochora amarabwoni, koyabera ebirengo na buna okoyagacha.

English: Connect with institutional buyers like hotels to supply your milk regularly Understand their quality quantity and delivery requirements
Kiswahili: Ungana na wanunuzi wa taasisi kama vile hoteli ili kusambaza maziwa yako mara kwa mara Elewa ubora wingi na mahitaji yao ya utoaji
Ekegusii: Rosia oboamate amo nabogori buma chioteri abwo ase oraire chingeni chiao gose amabere botambe. Manya buya nkerengo ki kiobuya bwechingeni gose amabere baganeti, nkerengo ki baganetie, na omoroberio bwokobaikeria ebinto ebio.

Kiswahili: Ksh 30,000 HELB mkopo wa kuhitimu iliyotolewa kuomba kupitia programu katika dakika 2!
Ekegusii: Chisiringi 30,000 ase anaba besekenderi HELB gokonya baria bagosoka, saba gotera omoroberio oyio okoira chitageka ibere chioka gosaba.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Mandera County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwa Oborigari bwakomire abanyabanto ase Mandera County gochia nabana abari ase emiaka etano gocherwa oborwari bwa meningitis ase ogotebwa kwa omotienyi 9.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Vihiga County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kibororie abamenyi korwa Vihiga kaonti ng'a babe maiso, tibatema goeta ase amache gose oroche rorew nomorindo bwamache amagoro yego.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kitui County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyora: KALRO ekorora omokutano ogokwenera okobeka oboremi bwa mbolea ase abaremi ba Kitui County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiama biasiasa yabwetesirie oyera yankosire obochiria okoreta amachiko yebirithi omwaro ni Bomet County.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Homa Bay County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria obosae boHoma Bay koria gochera kwa forum ya ekerogo ya kisabire amo ase amakora giasabire.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Migori County this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Migori Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu ngokinia kere nechingaki gekorwa chisemi chia abarimu goetera amasomo yobogesaku komanyia buna chibesa chiechikanti chiabo chigokora emeremo ya Migori okoberi ono.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Siaya County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Siaya Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete: Kenya Red Cross nigo egokora omwaka ogwo ogosima oborwa bwa sukari (diabetes) ase obwate bwa bwerere ase ekaunti ya Siaya ase omotienyi 11.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Kilifi County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna okonyora obokongu bwe chindagera (Pest Control Products Board) obooriri abanyamwaka ase Kilifi County gosimeka chindagera chio ogotara amabura nigo konyora ogokonya gosekeria ogotara kwa amabura na goikera obwate obororo bwa amabura araria akogenda akachaka.

English: HELB reminds schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this September.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: HELB yachakiri abana goetera ogokonya abechisekenderi go Elgeyo-Marakwet goetureti ya kebaki yating’igua.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Ekegusii: Okororie: KMTC okoigora omoroberio bwogosegeta okorosia amasomo abeene egedichitari ase abana bechisukuru chioboroso cha Homa Bay.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Ekegusii: Chere: NTSA kera chingaki kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria omorakera ase egasi ya Bomet.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open an avocado collection centre in Kisii County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board kigoire ekeombe giokonyora chiasavokado ase ekaunti ya Kisii ase omotienyi oyu ogwa omotienyi 4.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased cholera risk in Nyeri County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri na kushauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Obotunwa bwechisemi chioboroche: Eminisitiri yechisemi chioboroche - Ekitengo kioboroche bwokwibarana nigo konyora obotunwa bwechiara chiacholera chigoongera ase Nyeri County na gosegeta abanto bonsi gocha goikera obotunwa bwo goetwa ase ebitaro biari habe.

English: BBC aired evidence of coordinated brutality during Gen Z protests, identifying officers and urging prosecution of responsible commanders.
Kiswahili: BBC ilirusha ushahidi wa ukatili ulioratibiwa wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, ikitambua maafisa na kuhimiza kushtakiwa kwa makamanda waliohusika.
Ekegusii: Abamanyi amang'ana ba BBC mbagegete ase embeo obosaiti buna abasikari bare korasa abanto, gotumi chinguru goetania ekero giokorobererekana kwa abasae Gen Z, goteba abasikari bare gokora ayio na gosaba ng'a abanene ba abasikari baria bare korwa amachiko ng'a barase abanto basoerwe.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio okorigereria ebitara biokwomora ebitong'o (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kigoika amangana okorua kwomonyoro ogwobure bwa Newcastle ase etugo yeching'ombe ase Kwale County omwaka oyu omotienyi 2.

English: EACC reminds the public in Turkana County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) nkorosia kere nkere nabo Turkana gota omotimoko omuya ase chiafisi chia eserekari na koria amaaki ase chokorwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokorwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokorwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokorwania obokengeka.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a depression awareness forum in Lamu County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Ebitong'o biokorora chindwara na gochira chire gochia gosekeria omotangano gwokomanyia abanto igoro yoborwari bwo obororo (depression) ase ekaunti ya Lamu omwaka oyu omotienyi 10. Abanto bonsi mbarokire.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Nandi County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: Chung'ororo cha Kikundi Kikuu cha Mawasiliano ya Kijeshi kuna nandi tukite tukite kuhusu uchung'umo wa jinsia na kureporta matukio kwa chung'ororo cha jinsia kwa chikorongo cha polisi chenye karibu.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: Omoofisa bwemeroberio obogokorera omogavana ao ao ebirengererio biao‚ chinyagitari chionsi chieserikari aiga nka Kilifi, noria otenerete amaagacho, ogokonywa kobakonya gokinania omochando oyio bosa goetera chinkwana nomonyagitari konyora chinguru chiogokinana nebirengererio.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekobasoka abanto inga obokonyi bwogosira oboiboi bwa chindawa chiobochari nigo boriri ase chifasiliti chiobochari chia kaunti ase Nairobi County.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the Agri Preneurs Extension Model as discussed in the recent consultative workshop
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushirikiana na Agri Preneurs Extension Model kama ilivyojadiliwa katika warsha ya mashauriano ya hivi majuzi.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria na abakolwa kwa agribusiness kusindwa kuchereka na Agri Preneurs Extension Model kwa kuhari kwa mifumo yari y'okozekera kwa maraga

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of West Pokot County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragirie abanto bose bwa West Pokot Ekaunti batagaka goitwa nobosungu ase oboikoni, barenge gocha ase abasomi abatoe obotambe gochia goikora obonyabwate.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Embu County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw'obobwenia bwabanto bonsi (SHA) oboririe abamenyi ao kwerikia chinyagitari cha kubora kwerikia obobwenia bw'obokorwa bw'obosie aiga nka Embu.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Meru County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMSA eribokete abanto ba Meru County igoro y'obwate bwo ogoteka amache ase obororo ase obomure bwa chingo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Laikipia County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Laikipia County ase omotienyi 11.

English: DPP reminds the public in Narok County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: DPP yarure okoboria ase abamenyi baborigwe Narok koba maiso erio gokinia obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Omonya: Ekigo gia Kenya gia Korigia Ebisomo (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) nigo kigoigwete omorengo omoyia ogwobwanchani bwa ICT ase ekigo gia abakori ase Taita-Taveta County.

English: NCPB invites farmers in Kilifi County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this October.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: NCPB eretere abaremi ase Kilifi County ase amasomo atari gochia ase okoreka amang'ana amabere ase abaremi ase omotienyi 10.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Nyamira County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Ekegusii: Gazette ya Kenya yarure okoboria abanto ya Nyamira kaonti koba bonge amaswari ase ebikaranso bia okosanga nagokwanerana.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Embu County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross ogosegeta egonde Embu County komanyia amakora ase ababisa erio kobatumia ase chinchera chitabwenereti neringa rinene riokogosia gose goetera goaka esimi.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Homa Bay County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: DCI agasingerera abanto ase ebesa omotokoro ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta SIM-swap.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Vihiga County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: Omotuki omosaria oboitaai omorongoria abamenyi Vihiga omosegeta nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka SIM-swap agosegeta abamenyi koerikia eserekari yasemerie komanyia ebikoru binde bionsi bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Bungoma County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure okobwatanigwa egonde ya Bungoma okokurumi ase okoba asenogochengera kwerituko kenya yenyorerete obosibore erio rirachengerwe ase akaunti ya Bungoma ase engaki etang'ani November.

English: EACC reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: EACC nigo egosaba abanainchi bwekaonti Trans Nzoia ng'a babe goerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bwekenyoro gochia eserekari igoro ya mobasekano.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Bomet County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NTSA yasemirie abamenyi a Bomet koerikia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) nkworokereria ere igoro yasemerie obokoreri bwa obokoreri bwa egonde.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo kogoikera abanto ba Nyandarua County batagokonywa na obororo bwo omoyo na goika bagende ase chigongi chia ogotebigwa amang'ana ase oboremi bwa abanto bwo ogosabwa chibesa.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen obasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya Trans Nzoia gosimeka etocho momeka eminyanda ekiama kwa matundumadundo kwa kinyegetereri kwa ekimeme.

English: KNEC advises students in Kirinyaga County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: KNEC nkorora endorero e Kirinyaga County kere nga kudia ebinto biria endorero kure egera ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria endorero kure egera.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of West Pokot County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Pokot Magharibi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Ekegusii: e-citizen obaboririe abamenyi buekaunti ya west pokot kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua e-citizen obokoreri bene bweserekari.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Bungoma County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya samaki.
Ekegusii: Echumi enyamokirimbi bwobotebereria bakaenda abaremi ba' Bungoma kaunti korekana kwa koperasi yobokwana yororeka amagori magori kwa chinsue.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kilifi County starting this August.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuanzia Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia SHA (Social Health Authority) kigoikora gochia ase abamenyi ba Kilifi County obokonyi bwa dialisisi korwa omotienyi 8.

English: NDMA urges residents of Nakuru County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NDMA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya nakuru koegerera amakora ganyi omosiongoroko kubemereka eka otariri omosiongoroko.

English: TVET reminds schools in Bungoma County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Januari hii.
Ekegusii: TVET yaboriri oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru ase akaunti ya Bungoma ting’igua nyakwano ya eng’atiato.

English: HELB urges youth in Migori County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: HELB obasemirie obosae bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia buna egesaku chiobogesaku igoro ya amakora ase obokoreri bwabanto.

English: NTSA warns residents of Homa Bay County to prepare for possible drought this August.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: NTSA yateba abamenyi bekaunti ya Homa Bay koegerera omorakera omorera riete.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Nakuru County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) berekera egonde e Nakuru gwegongo gacha shirikwenya shikambe 116 nokogania agachuma a matumii.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Ekegusii: SHA omoye oyera obeene ogesire rigesa aria e-Citizen registration korwa Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: NDMA b erekera egonde a Elgeyo-Marakwet Ekaunti o bokera kwa igoro yogokorer abande bobe ase engencho yeki bare chisukuru na o bokera orembo ose ose omorobere.

English: If you are riding a bodaboda, make sure the driver has a helmet and a reflective jacket.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unaendesha bodaboda, hakikisha dereva ana kofia na koti la kuangazia.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki beka ehofia eri egokorende ekero kiomobasekano korinete epigipigi - ngokonya ere obogima!

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Baringo County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekebariri ya Kenya yerekera abanto bari Baringo County bokobwetera amakora amabere omosiongoroko goetera chifisi chiobomo bwechinse okobwaterana ase oboamo erio gokinana nechinchera chiobokebago.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Kirinyaga County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Ekegusii: Eriogi: KEMSA nigo ekwenerete ogoteba buna erire nigo rire na amarwaire ya dengue fever ase Kirinyaga County. Abanto bagoncherwa goika gokora oborwaro bwo goikwa chindano chionse chioragwete.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo gikoremereria abamama abanyabwate ase ekaunyi ya Nyamira buna ogopimwa kwabamama na abana banyuma y'ogochara nigo kware gochia bosa ase chifasiliti chionsi chiabanto.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Ekegusii: DPP yaboririe abamenyi koikera ogokonya gweserikari e Taita-Taveta goetera ebesa ekero kiemechando goetera esimi yao gikorera chinchera chiancheire gikireche gokonya gwaebesa.

English: The AgriBiz programme has selected 200 start ups and early stage agribusinesses for support Eligible agribusinesses should apply for future opportunities to benefit from the Kshs 22 2 billion funding
Kiswahili: Mpango wa AgriBiz umechagua waanzilishi 200 na wajasiriamali wa hatua za awali kwa usaidizi Biashara za kilimo zinazostahiki wanapaswa kutuma maombi kwa ajili ya fursa za siku zijazo za kufaidika na ufadhili wa Kshs 22 2 bilioni.
Ekegusii: Programu ya AgriBiz yamechagua mitandao 200 na vinywaji vya kibinafsi vya chakula kusaidia vinywaji vya chakula vyanavyo faida kuzindua pesa ya Kshs 22 2 mirioni vinywaji vya chakula vyanavyo faida vyanavyo gindigwa kwa fursa za zifuatazo kusaidia kuzindua pesa ya Kshs 22 2 mirioni

English: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
Kiswahili: Kuwezesha uthibitisho wa sababu mbili (2FA) kwa akaunti zote za benki na media ya kijamii.
Ekegusii: Eroserie 2FA (Chinchera ibera komnya buya) yonsi engegu nebiombo biokomanyia.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Vihiga County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokang'a abamama ase Vihiga County gochia ase ebitaro biokwibarira ebiroreire ase oboremi bwabo nigo bagokonywa komanya obomure bwoomwana obo.

English: If you fee unweel, have a cold, a cough or fever, please call 719 or text *719#
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una homa, kikohozi au homa, tafadhali piga simu 719 au tuma ujumbe *719#
Ekegusii: Onye koigwete bobe omobere, obwate rikuba gose ogokorora, gaki aka esimi gochia 719 gose otome riuko gochia *719#

English: NPS reminded officers to avoid misuse of force during protests and maintain professionalism.
Kiswahili: NPS iliwakumbusha maafisa kuepuka matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kudumisha weledi.
Ekegusii: Ekombe keria ekenene gia abasikari (NPS) kiainyoirie abobisa baye gotatumia chibunduki bobe chingaki chiokoroberekana na goikerania obokoreri emeremo obuya.

English: Notice: Universities Fund launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Ngera: Universities Fund yachakire omoroberio bw'arengete gotanga, gokwanerana na gokeania okomocherwa gose gochaya abana bande ase ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: KNEC reminds schools in Siaya County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this May.
Kiswahili: KNEC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KNEC ase okorari abachisekenderi ne Siaya kaunti kuting’igua ogosemia abechisekenderi na abana goetera amaumuntia.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Marsabit County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiama bia siasa obooririe abanto buna bategate Marsabit gochinkwana na choria chikurio obochoka, obochokwa, na obochokwa.

English: NDMA warns residents of Marsabit County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu ongezeko la kashfa za pesa za simu na inashauri umma wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: NDMA yasabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya marsabit kubereko enchera abange baibeirwe kwa ebesa gotingia obokoreri na yasemirie abamenyi tokoerikia erio gotingia obokoreri na tokoogaba korwa epini ya M-PESA yaogochia ase onde bwensi.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Ekegusii: Manyia: Chokoro chia Kenya chia Komunikesheni chakabera chingaki kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano yepara yekero yikuru ya Kwale.

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Trans Nzoia County on progress of ward-level service delivery this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomonene y'Auditor-General yasegetire abamenyi a Trans Nzoia okorwegwa kuobokoreri obuya kwa esagati esebu esebu

English: Speaker Wetang’ula Urges MPs to Uphold Integrity in IEBC Selection
Kiswahili: Spika Wetangula Awahimiza MEPs Kuhifadhi Uadilifu katika Uchaguzi wa IEBC
Ekegusii: omonogeri bwebunge enene Wetangula orure okoboria ase abachumbe koba namasikani amanene ase engaki barabe bagochora IEBC .

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Nakuru County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete abantu bwe Nakuru giabogoria yonsi amasakara yobokoreri bwechikaonti tonyoria emeroberio.

English: Promote rain-water harvesting for micro-irrigation to support kitchen gardening and crop production during the dry season.
Kiswahili: Kukuza uvunaji wa maji ya mvua kwa umwagiliaji mdogo ili kusaidia bustani ya jikoni na uzalishaji wa mazao wakati wa kiangazi.
Ekegusii: Pakisha embura kwa okogesa kwa mukono kwa kusaidia egeticha ya chakula na okogesa wa matunda wakati wa orwomo.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Kakamega County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiababoririe ase TVET koborigwa obosae bekaunti ya Kakamega kwerikia amakora ao gw'okorera ayechinse chia isiko erio gokonya obokoreri.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Samburu County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egosaba omonto omonene orenge na obochande bwobwongo ase Samburu County konyora obwateeri bwo'gochika omwaka oye orenge obochande bwo'gochaka obwateeri.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Nakuru County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Ekegusii: IEBC orure okoboria entongori ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura bamenyete ime ya Nakuru koenekia nga koira bare ribaga erio koenekia via SMS ku 70000.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Mombasa County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Januari.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nkoeboria abareeri abana ase Mombasa County gochia na abana babo ase ogokorwa ogokwanirwa ogokura ase ogokorwa kwa omotienyi 1 kw'obogwenia bw'abang'ina.

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Trans Nzoia County to enroll for electrical installation training this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bia State Department for Basic Education nigo bikogwata abasubati ase Trans Nzoia County goika goisoma obomanyi bwa electrical installation ase omotienyi 4.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Oboremi na Erio (AFA) nigo kogoibokia ababori b'ebitugo ase Tana River County gochia goaka amang'ana ase ofisi y'abaveterinari eria eri hakuhaku ase oborwaire bw'ebitugo biao erio goikera obokong'u bw'ebitugo.

English: Notice: IEBC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: Notice: IEBC keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) giaansire igoro yokorenda abana ase chisukuru Kirinyaga.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yebirime na oboreri bwechingombe nkogoteba abanyamwaka ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County barore okoregisita ase amasomo ayo atari gochia gochia ase amasomo ayo amayia yebirime.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges maize growers in Isiolo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bioboremi na obotugi bwechimbori bikorokia abaremi bamaembe ase Isiolo County gosemeria chigero chiemanyererio chiembo chiobusimeka mbere yomura erio gokong'ia ebitunwa ase omwaka ogu.

English: KNEC advises students in Kisumu County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: KNEC okorora endorero e Kisumu County kore kwegara ebinto biogosomera eke ofisi ya egentere ya county kore kwegara ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Nairobi County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross yasemerie abamenyi Nairobi County kochia nende nende omorero omokorera nechitangutangu omorero omokorera nechitangutangu yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri.

English: KEMRI launches a September awareness campaign on safe water storage across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo ekwate omoroberio bwogosomora abanto ase obwate bwa amache amaya ase omotienyi 9 ime ya Marsabit County.

English: Embakasi North MP urges IEBC to remove barriers to youth voting
Kiswahili: Bunge la Embakasi Kaskazini linahimiza IEBC kuondoa vizuizi vya kupiga kura kwa vijana
Ekegusii: Omobunge bwembakasi ya rogoro orure okoboria ase  IEBC korusia ebitango bionsi ase abasae goaka chikura.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya ngono inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: Oborire: DCI okoigora omoroberio bwochisemi obobogoria bwechindege goika bwango erio korwa obobobwenia as abarwaire besosera aaria ase ekaunti ya Nyamira.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Samburu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) b erekera egonde hwe Samburu County gianyoreire gwechifuniro chwekisomwa nokogania gwechifuniro chwekisomwa gacha chisomwa chwekisomwa.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Wajir County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Nofisi yomotenereri yachiko omonene yaariganirie abamenyi ekaunti ya Wajir okorwa ebirengererio biabo ase richiko riria rigendererete korosigwa igor yokoroberekana yomwaka yomwanyabanto yachakorwa omonugunoobarema.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Nyandarua County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS yasegetire obosae bo Nyandarua ekaonti korwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo erio gotingia amakora agokorobereria.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Machakos County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMSA erangerete abanto bose ba Machakos County goyia amaboko na esabuni amo namache amayera obwango na obwango erio gokonya goikera oborwaire obo bwo gokonywa goikera.

English: The African Union has adopted a 10 Year CAADP Strategy and Action Plan 2026 2035 to enhance agricultural transformation and food systems across Africa Stakeholders should prepare for upcoming initiatives and reforms
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Afrika umepitisha Mkakati wa Miaka 10 na Mpango Kazi wa CAADP 2026 2035 ili kuimarisha mageuzi ya kilimo na mifumo ya chakula katika bara la Afrika Wadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ajili ya mipango na mageuzi yajayo.
Ekegusii: Mwana Africa Union amakora gosoroma CAADP Strategy na Amakora Plan 2026 2035 nokogendereria oboikeranu bwendagera  goetera okobwatania kwegechidichitari na endagera bweria Africa. Baria bagosangereria rigega na korigia echiro amo na bwa abaonia be'chirchio bworosiigwe.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Ekegusii: Amanyiso a CDC: chikiriniki chia obotununi bwa amaka nigo chigokora chinsa chionsi chia omotienyi 4 ase chikiriniki chia oborwaro ebiitirwe ase Bomet County.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cholera risk in Marsabit County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Marsabit na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Ekegusii: Obotunwa bw'obonyagitari: CDC egotebia abanto igoro y'obokebago bw'echolera obwongerekene ase Marsabit County na gosaba abanto gochwa goikera amache ayo ayangirwe.

English: Sleeping under treated nets helps in preventing expectant mothers and their unborn babies from malaria infections
Ekegusii: Korara ime yechineti chisibirie namariogo yogoita chinkoromba nigo chikorenda abasubati bare barito na abana babo bataraiborwa korwa ase esosera.

English: DCI reminds residents of Bomet County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: DCI yaenekirie abakorirwe bia Bomet County okwerwa okorera aboibi bwechiombe ase okobwaterana nebitengo bia gacha gusiira bia gachiria.

English: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image
Kiswahili: Fikiria tiba au ushauri nasaha. Mtaalamu wa afya ya akili anaweza kutoa mikakati ya kukabiliana na unyanyapaa na kukusaidia kukuza taswira chanya ya wewe mwenyewe
Ekegusii: Rengereria obogwenia gose ogokwanerwa kw'obosemia. Omomanyi bw'oborwaria bw'obongo nabo akorwa chinchera chi'okorwania obokongu obo na gokonya kwemanya buya aye omonyene.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: Komanyia: NDMA okoigora egetengo kia beene ase Chinyagitari na Porisi nao amangana ogokorerwa bobe ase engencho yeki ore agokonyerwa ekaunti ya Kirinyaga.

English: KTDA urges millet growers in Nyandarua County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KTDA irata abaremi ba buboyi ya Nyandarua kwirora boa mbeere ebakurwi naki obwirikari bwakoka kugira bomarire obwirebwe obwatebereire.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Kiambu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Eriogi: COMESA erakabania chimbegu chiachibambara chie chinduma chie chibambara ase abaremi ba Kiambu County ase omotienyi 2.

English: OGP reminds the public in Migori County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: OGP ekoenekia abasikari aaria ekaonti ya Migori buna ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya gokeania choria porisi buna ekosia, ekosia, na ekosia.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Ekegusii: Okoigora kwa KMTC okoigora ekeyia omoroberio wa ICT ase omoroberio wa vocational ase ekaunti ya Nyeri.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Homa Bay County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokwaniria abanto bwa Homa Bay County buna ogotunza amabura nigo okongerera oboremi obuya bwa kare na kare.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces free medical camps for residents of Nairobi County starting this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gia Ogochera Oborwaire na Ogoitokera nigo konyorete buna eraba ne chinkambi chia oborwari chitaragwe ase abanto ba Nairobi County gosegerera ase omotienyi 7.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Echibarasa: NDMA egerire egonde ekegancha kerengereire komanyekana Samburu Abarwaire omonugunoobarema.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Laikipia County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Gindigwa via intaneti ntsa via e-Citizen portal ngegokonye koira esatifiketi yokoiborwa kwao ni Laikipia County.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Lamu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani b erekera egonde ki Lamu County korwa ebirengererio igoro yogokorer abande bobe ase engencho yeki bare chisukuru, na kubongera obochege mokorere omomura ase esukuru.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Vihiga County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia SHA (Social Health Authority) nkogwibokia abanto ase Vihiga County igoro yobwate bwo korigia oborwaria bwa sukari ase oboima bwo obomura bwa chingo chiaye.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Homa Bay County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen yaboririe abamenyi entongori ase baria berigetie buna Homa Bay County koenekia nga koira bare ribaga erio koenekia via SMS kwa 70000.

English: KICD urges youth in Laikipia County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: KICD yasegetire obosae Laikipia County korwa chiropoti kengima kobwatekana nobochori erio gotingia amakora.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Mandera County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe typhoid wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobochari - Ekitengo kiobochari bwabana nigo egosaba abasacha nabanyabanto ase Mandera County goika abana baria bare ase emiaka etano bagende bagosomigwa igoro yoborwaire bwa typhoid ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 11.
