Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa Fomu ya Nne lazima kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura kabla ya kuondoka shule kwa muongozo wa IEBC.
Ekegusii: Abana besekondari bekerasi kia inye goika babe berikire koba abbaki chikura batrarua esukuru

English: Council of Governors launches an app for devolution awareness.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro yeserikari yechikaonti .

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Makueni County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Makueni Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omonyene: KEMSA egakora ogosima oborwa bwa sukari ase obosa ase Makueni County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Meru County on agroforestry this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kilimo cha misitu Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyerero: KALRO egokorera abaremi amachiko ase Meru County igoro yoboremi bwechimiti (agroforestry) ase omotienyi 5.

English: KALRO urges rice growers in Bomet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawasihi wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Bomet kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO ogotebererigwa nereikari buna buna okorenda ebichuni biria bigosaria endagera, erio gotanga amokonde echingeti gindigwa amariogo ao ao okoyera amagoro hii.

English: New policy on standardized school infrastructure development to ensure quality learning environments.
Ekegusii: Richiko riyia igoro yamaagacho esukuru abwekaine goikerania aase agigiya abana bagosomera.

English: Seek help! Access counselors after protest disruptions.
Kiswahili: Tafuta msaada! Wasiliana na washauri baada ya vurugu za maandamano.
Ekegusii: Rigia ogokonywa! Kabe neribaga rigiya nomwarimu oo bwebirengererio kogokonya nyuma yeburaburu yokoandamana.

English: Notice: DPP launches a fraud prevention campaign in Nairobi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP azindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekenyori: DPP giaansire ekampeini ya kusia kumwona Nairobi County eng'atiato hii.

English: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1 hadi 5 wanapaswa kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuzuia maambukizi ya minyoo ambayo yanaweza kusababisha utapiamlo na ukuaji wa kudumaa.
Ekegusii: Abana b'omwaka 1 goika 5 mbagwenerete gosibigwa ebianda ase kera emetienyi etano n'omo, erio gotanga okoambokeria kw'ebianda ebio biranyare korenta enchara na ogotakina buya.

English: DPP urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP anawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Taita-Taveta kojikia buna abanyene ekombo ekijikia chinchogu chinye, gochona gochiokorwa gochiokorwa gochikia chinchogu chinye chinye.

English: KEMSA launches a May awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokonya omokono ase ogoteba abanto igoro yoborwaire bwa sukari ase omotienyi 5 goika ogoteba abanto ase ogosomwa ase Makueni County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Kiambu County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usafirishaji wa mifugo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi nembego yetugo egokweibokia abamenyi bwa Kiambu Kaunti buna ogotara amaterasi nkogesa oboremi bwa kare na kare.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani yasemirie abamenyi a Tharaka-Nithi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro, yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Judiciary budget upgrades will automate courts and speed up corruption case handling.
Kiswahili: Maboresho ya bajeti ya mahakama yataendesha mahakama kiotomatiki na kuharakisha ushughulikiaji wa kesi za ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Okogeswa chibesa ase obokoreri bwa koti mboikerania chikoti gokora emeremo yaye goetera etekinorochi ase obokoreri obuya Jkwangoi kogaba ebina biobokorekanu.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Narok County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii ya Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development egokora abanto ba Narok County goika bagende gochora ase ogosoma kwabakuru erio babone gochera ebitambokero biogochera abana chindagera ase amasomo.

English: NCPB announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this August.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: NCPB nigo erangerete ogotera esindani yoboreme bwe amagoro na amakanwa ase chimburi ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County ase omotienyi 8.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Samburu County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bia Obobwenia - Ekeombe gia Obobwenia bwa Abanto obasabire abareeri abana ase Samburu County goeta abana babo ase ogotarerwa ogokura ase egeku kia omotienyi 6 kia ogotebia obobwenia bwa abamama.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises milk producers in Lamu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo kegosaba abaremi bamate ase Lamu County gochia goikora oboremi bwa rigori ria chibei chiri ase oboremu mbere yechingaki chiorigesa.

English: HELB encourages residents of Nyeri County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: HELB obabwateranirie abamenyi ba kaunti ya Nyeri kobasaba kwebaterania amakwania gokwerikia buna bera tebia kwebaterania ase amagenderero amo nebirenga biekaonti.

English: Children's identities can be stolen for fraud. Parents should safeguard birth certificates and monitor credit reports.
Kiswahili: Utambulisho wa watoto unaweza kuibiwa kwa udanganyifu. Wazazi wanapaswa kulinda vyeti vya kuzaliwa na kufuatilia ripoti za mikopo.
Ekegusii: nabo ekonyarekana nga ebiband biabana bibwe gokorera obongainereria. Abaibori brende buya chisatificate chiokoiborwa chia abana babo no komongera buna chibesa chigosao chisimi chiabo.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: Egesaku: Okoigora ogosaba kwao chibesa chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara bochaberi mwa Kajiado.

English: Promote youth inclusion in decision-making; get involved in local governance.
Kiswahili: Kukuza ushirikishwaji wa vijana katika kufanya maamuzi; kushiriki katika utawala wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Segeta okobwaterana nabasae ase okorosia amachiko; sanga ase obogambi bwekenyoro.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Mombasa County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokibukia abamama abanyabwate ase Mombasa County inga okwenera okwanchwa kwabana nigo kuri obwanto ase chifasiliti chiensi chia gavamenti.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Machakos County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (Kenya Dairy Board) nkorora kere nga abaremi bechinyama ase Machakos County bagwenerete gochia gochia amang'ana ase ofisi yobuveterinari eria eri hakuhi na abwo, nigo konyora oborendi bw'echinyama chiao.

English: OGP warns public officers in Nairobi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP ng'okorwa abarendi boborendi bwenyoro bagesete okomanyania ase ekaonti ya Nairobi ng'a igoro yokorwa amaaki.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased dengue fever risk in Meru County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Meru na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Obotumi bwa obochenu bw'abainchi: CDC egochenirie ng'a nigo erari ogwate bw'omurwaro owa dengue ase Meru County na goboria abainchi gochia gokorwa oborwari ase echibitaro chire habe.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Migori County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Migori kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani obasemerie abakare abakorwa Migori kwerikia omorakera obokoreri bwa nyumba na mudogo kuburata omorakera omorokera.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Kwale County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya kahawa.
Ekegusii: KALRO yasegetire abacheni ba Kwale kaunti gokorera ribaga eri riabeene amagori magori agokwana chikagwa.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Wajir County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Wajir na kushauri umma kutafuta uchunguzi wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Omoitemo bwobuto bwe chinsara: Ministeri yobuto - Ekitengo kio obuto bwa abakungu nigo kigocha amang'ana okobwate obwango bwa oborwari bwa kifua (tuberculosis) ase Wajir County na kigocha abanto bonse gochia gokorwa ebitesti ase ebitaro ebirie habe na bo.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Kisumu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori biokomanya amachoni biarengire abamenyi ba Kisumu County gosega obosomi mbere yebiro biokorua erio gochera obosomi obo.

English: All medications should be kept out of reach to prevent accidental poisoning in children.
Kiswahili: Dawa zote zinapaswa kuwekwa mbali na watoto ili kuzuia sumu ya bahati mbaya.
Ekegusii: Amariogo onsi abekwe are na abana gotanga okonywega gotaganeirie

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Siaya County this November.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Siaya Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amatemwa KNEC nkokora kere ebikaranso bia ensemo yechisemi chiobogesaku buna engencho yoborigereria igoro yechibesa chieserikari ase obokoreri bwabanto bwa ombudsman mu Siaya County chiomotienyi 11.

English: KMTC urges parents and teachers in Mandera County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: KMTC ngoria abaibori nabarimu buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago komnyia obokonyi ase abana 116.

English: OGP warns public officers in Wajir County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: OGP gochia ase abakoreri beserekari buna enchera yense yakegambero erio togosoere nagokoura enibo eyio otabegete arabu amang'ana aye omokoreri omonene ase ekeombe giokorwania obokurumi ime yense.

English: OGP updates residents of Nairobi County on progress of county development projects this November.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Novemba.
Ekegusii: OGP yasegetire abamenyi ba Nairobi bwo'morai bwense na kobwaterania ng'a abamenyi ngokonyeka bare korwa ase amagenderero ao ao ngokobwabworia November.

English: The High Court has dismissed a petition against the Nzoia Sugar lease allowing West Kenya Sugar to proceed with its Ksh 5 7 billion investment
Kiswahili: Mahakama kuu imetupilia mbali ombi la kupinga ukodishaji wa Nzoia Sugar kuruhusu West Kenya Sugar kuendelea na uwekezaji wake wa Ksh 5 7 bilioni.
Ekegusii: Mwokozi wa Kioko kwa Nzoia amasabo yale yaliyekuwa na West Kenya Sugar kwa kufungua kwa kumaliza malengo yake ya kushirikisha kwa kasi ya Ksh 5.7 miliioni

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Isiolo County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yabooririe abasae Isiolo buekaunti batarere abisi ere ange na koerikia esatibigeti ya okoibora kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua obokoreri bene bweserekari.

English: We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask. Local production of masks and PPEs has began
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokobasemia abamenyi ense kobeka ebikoneri kekero bagosoa ase chimatatu, omonto nigo agosemigwa kobeka egekoneri/emaski. Oboroisia bw'ebinto biogwetanga bwachakire.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds voters in Mombasa County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura bamenyete ime ya Mombasa koenekia nga koira bare ribaga eri komanya ng'a SMS kwenye 70000 kwenye kiholekire yobochori.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Meru County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia abachiri bwa Kenya korigia abamenyi ba kaunti ya Meru gochia ase Huduma Centre eria eri hakiri gochia kobwate obonyamwamu bwo korwa ase obochenu bwa bosa.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches ward-level service delivery in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua utoaji wa huduma katika wilaya ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Ogochika: e-Citizen okoruegwa kwa obokoreri obuya wia maboko ma Uasin Gishu ekaonti.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Kericho County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Ekegusii: CDC egosaba abaremi ase Kericho County gochi ase ebitaseni bia obochari biria biri habe ase oboikoni bwa obochari bwa omotienyi 7.

English: Remove the freezing honey from the cloth using a spoon. Place the honey in a well-covered container.
Kiswahili: Ondoa asali inayoganda kwenye kitambaa kwa kutumia kijiko. Weka asali kwenye chombo kilichofunikwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Okorusia egeitubo yee gindigwa mokorosia mukono. Ase egeitubo egesima.

English: A quick entry and progressive digital technology has power to transform how peasant farmers receive and utilize information.
Kiswahili: Njia ya haraka na tekinolojia ya kidijitali yenye kuendelea ina uwezo wa kubadili jinsi wakulima wanavyopokea na kutumia habari.
Ekegusii: Gosoa bwango na kogendereria tekinorochia yegedichitari nere nechinguru chiokorenta ogoonchoreria chingencho buna abaremi abataka bakonyora na gotumia amang'ana ...

English: ODPP invites residents of Lamu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: ODPP obasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya lamu kwerikia chokorwego bwebirengererio ase kinyori cha mudate ya kubereka chikire okorwego.

English: Install CCTV in schools 2020.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha CCTV shuleni 2020.
Ekegusii: Beka chikamera chiria chikobwata ayagendererete (CCTV) ase esukuru 2020.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ekechero chikura giachikire ng'a chiyunifasiti chionsi chibe chisenta chiokorika abaaki chikura giTurkana kwaaba bokora bona.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya nagoetera Kenya Medical Association: chinchiniki chiokwibarira abana ase abasomi abanyabwate obwanchoni nigo chigakora ase ensemo yonsi ya omotienyi 3 ase chinchiniki chiogosomwa chiobusaeri ase Marsabit County.

English: KNEC advises students in West Pokot County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Ekegusii: KNEC yabwana endorero e West Pokot County gindigwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya gosoma oigoirwe ase omoroberio bwechisemi chigedichitari.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Kitui County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMRI erangerie abanto abamenyi ase Kitui County igoro yobwenero bwo gochia obochio bwo chinyomba ase oborongo bwo chinyomba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Kisii County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ministeri y'Oborimi na Oboreri bw'Ebitugo egokora egesomo ki'enchera nchaya ch'okwomwera chindagera ase abarima ba Kisii County ase omotienyi 2.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Isiolo County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Isiolo kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: DCI oboririe enyore ene choria enchera chiisiolo yekaunti karwe eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Murang'a County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Ekegusii: IPOA yamangana abamenyi bia Murang'a goeera ekenyori ekenyori kia kuburudia na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri na gosaba banainchi berende okobagera.

English: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry. For storage, keep tomatoes at 12C and 86-90% relative humidity - they spoil if kept below 10C for over 2 weeks, or below 5C for more than 6-8 days, but can last 2-3 weeks at 10C or above.
Kiswahili: Vuna nyanya asubuhi na mapema au jioni wakati joto ni karibu 20C na hali ya hewa ni kavu. Kwa kuhifadhi, weka nyanya kwa 12C na unyevu wa jamaa wa 86-90% - huharibika ikiwa zimehifadhiwa chini ya 10C kwa zaidi ya wiki 2, au chini ya 5C kwa zaidi ya siku 6-8, lakini zinaweza kudumu wiki 2-3 kwa 10C au zaidi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Murang'a County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported typhoid cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya matumbo vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia SHA (Social Health Authority) oboririe abamenyi ba Murang'a County konyora amang'ana ase oborwaire obo bwo typhoid obo bwakonyorekana, na goitaba ase abakonyi b'afya b'omochie.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Kisumu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia Kenya Red Cross yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire na Kisumu County koenekia amangana ebesa obokomokore, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia kubereko ebesa.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of poultry in Kiambu County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nigo eretigite ogotambuka kwa chinkoko ase Kiambu County goetera oborwa bwa lumpy skin disease.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Nairobi County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NDMA gacharia omomenyi o Nairobi gosemo na koraria koriba kwarwara gosiira gacha maene moke ni amanana.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera: DCI bokorwa obokurumi obwengencho ase omotuki omosiria omorobiria omoroboka bobwateranetie enibo ekaunti ya Siaya.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges goats farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa kwa visa vya kimeta.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwe Erimo na Oboreri bwe Ebitugo baboririe ababoreri b'emburi ase Kakamega County koboria ase ofisi y'oboreri bwe ebitugo erio konyora oboate bwe ebitugo biabo biaremerwe n'oborwari bwa anthrax.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Migori County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross nigo egokaiyia abamama abamonyi ase Migori County ng'a okorua kw'ebirio bi'obokonyi ase abana abato nigo kire bosa ase chifasiri chi'eserikari chionsi.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in West Pokot County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: Ekero ekeombe eke TVET ekorera abamenyi bo West Pokot County amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge bwabo.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Wajir County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'egetureti nigo egosaba omonto omonene oria okobwate oboremo bw'obochengereri ase Wajir County koba omokonyi ase omwaka oye oria okobwate oboremo erio asabe obokonyi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Busia County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board nigo korigiririe abaremi ba Busia County gochia ase ogotara chinchera chiogotindania chimboga na emegondo nigo konyora obuya bwobota bwomoto mbere yomwaka omotienyi 6 ogotara.

English: [Training Achievement] Over 91,000 teachers trained to deliver digital learning content as part of Digital Literacy Programme implementation
Ekegusii: [Ayaikereirwe ase okwegeria] Goetania abaarimu 91,000 baegerigwe buna bagochia gosomia chisemi chiegetekinorochia ase omoroberio bwokomanyia abana buna omoroberio ogikeranigwa

English: CDC urges residents of Samburu County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Ekegusii: CDC egosaba abamenyi ba Samburu County korosia oborimbi bwa chindano chionse chigochanwa konyora konyuma y'ogokura kw'ebinyinyi bia HIV/AIDS.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Isiolo County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo ekorwa ogosaba ogokora endorero yoborai amatindi ime yekaunti ya isiolo kwegoreria kwegoreria kwegora ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yabana baria batari kwenyara.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Kiambu County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) yabwirie abanto ba Kiambu County kwa abanto kwekwereria amang'ana nkobworire kwa emeremo eria eyio erigorie kwabu nkobworire kwa ekero ekwabu nkobworire.

English: Using a smartphone app, farmers can get a diagnosis of a crop disease and recommendations on what treatment to apply.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia programu ya smartphone, wakulima wanaweza kupata utambuzi wa ugonjwa wa mazao na mapendekezo juu ya matibabu gani ya kutumia.
Ekegusii: Kuokho okogesa kumwana, mifundi kumwana kuguva kusindika oboruaire na kurekodi gindigwa yake kuguva kuyagindigwa.

English: Latest publication A. ACAT 2025 has called on great investment in solutions of agriculture technology in Africa. A. Malawi farmers...
Kiswahili: Chapisho la hivi punde A. ACAT 2025 limetoa wito wa uwekezaji mkubwa katika suluhu za teknolojia ya kilimo barani Afrika. A. Wakulima wa Malawi...
Ekegusii: Latest Posts Â· ACAT 2025 cbasegetire kegima okobeka chinguru na kobwaterana ase oboremi nechisemi chiechidichitari buna enchera eyemo yokomesia oboremi aiga orogongo rwa Afrika Â· Malawi abaremi ...

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased measles risk in Busia County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Busia na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Ekegusii: Ogochera obomanyi bwekeene: Ekerechi gia Kenya Medical Association kigokurerwa ng'a oboremi bwechimisiri bwareng'ire aaria Busia County na kigosemia abanto goika bagie goikera oborua bwose obwobogwate bwa chindano.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Nakuru County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborigari bwa'banto ogoibokia abanto ba Nakuru County ase obwenero bwogotiga obonwa obuya ase oborogeri bw'enyomba.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Machakos County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: AFA eragabania embegu chiobusuma chiobusirwe obwanchoni ase abaremi aaria ekaonti ya Machakos ase omotienyi o omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches the county integrated development plan in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Chung'wan: Komishoni ya Adhini na Usimamizi (Ombudsman) imeanzisha mifumo ya maendeleo ya kaunti iliyowekwa kwa ujumla katika Kaunti ya Migori.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in West Pokot County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Januari.
Ekegusii: Chama cha Kiinyaa cha Mili chenya gindigwa amoyo ayo ayo ambura ake yao ogokomera eng’atiato

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Nyeri County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: omoroberio bw'obobwenia bwabanto bonsi (SHA) obasoroire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyeri kwerikia ebisinani bobe eka facility yabo ebisorio kwerikia ase oboririe obogwari bw'obokorori bw'obobwenia bwabanto bonsi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Mandera County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya watoto ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross kigokibuchia abanyabwate ase Mandera County ng'a okorua kwemichindani yabaana nigo kweri bwerere ase chinchera chionsi chieserekari.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Kericho County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yobokorera omotokoro na abanto bagotara Kericho bagokurera ase okokorera chinginya arria ase chngongo chire neminano.

English: AFA announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for cattle in Samburu County this April.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Samburu Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia AFA nigo koretie ogotanga ogosaa kwa anthrax ase etugo chinsara ase Samburu County ase omotienyi 4.

English: COMESA urges cassava growers in Kwale County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawasihi wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: COMESA amwita omorokera gusii amagoro hii amwita gosoroma mirogwa omorakera oyera mirongo

English: Line planting, is important even during weeding, weeding plants. According to farmers Guimba,tried to conduct line planting during planting season.
Kiswahili: Upandaji wa mstari, ni muhimu hata wakati wa kupalilia, mimea ya kupalilia. Kulingana na wakulima Guimba,alijaribu kufanya upandaji wa laini wakati wa msimu wa upandaji.
Ekegusii: Gosimeka ase omoroberio orambogete buya ngokonya ore ase oboremi bwamaboko, koburugera ebimeri. Koreng'ana na abaremi ba Guimba, bagatema gosimeka ase omorobiro ase okoiya na gosimeka chingaki chia motwe.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Baringo County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenererete obobure bwechisemi (SHA) kiorangerete abamenyi ba Baringo County goika barege ogokorana namache ayo abire gochaka oborwaire bwechisukuma (measles) obo bwarengire ase obonge.

English: COMESA announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for pigs in Trans Nzoia County this April.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: COMESA yarure ogokoraria oborwaria bwa anthrax bwa bosa ase chinguuru ime ya Trans Nzoia County ime ya omotienyi 4.

English: Keep emergency exits clearly marked and unobstructed in public buildings.
Kiswahili: Weka alama wazi za kutokea kwa dharura na bila kizuizi katika majengo ya umma.
Ekegusii: Erokeria buya aase okominchoreria elekero kiemebasekano ere na etbwati binto biranyare kogocha abanto kabagotama.

English: APS promptly evacuated a school following a bomb threat and initiated investigations while strengthening safety protocols.
Kiswahili: APS ilihamisha shule mara moja kufuatia tishio la bomu na kuanzisha uchunguzi huku ikiimarisha itifaki za usalama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) nkinganyetie abanto bwango gotanyorwa korwa esukuru nyuma yogosarera kwamang'ana kwogoakwa epombu na goansa obotuki ekero boigo bagesete oborendi.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: FAO nigo ekobasoka abanyene etugo ase Narok County goika gochera etugo chikaonti chinde buna batari na echibali erio gotanga afia yetugo.

English: KALRO warns sweet potatoes farmers in Homa Bay County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: KALRO nkogoteba abaremi banchibwate ase Homa Bay County igoro yoboremo bwebinyamo na goteba nigo bakwenerete gochia ase obokonyi bwangu.

English: KALRO urges sheep farmers in Siaya County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Ekegusii: KALRO egokumia abaremi b'echeya ase Siaya County goika bagate amakuru ase chinyama chierwarire ase ofisi y'obuveterinari erie hafi, konyora amakuru ayio agokwana igoro y'erwara ya lumpy skin disease.

English: KRA updates residents of Machakos County on progress of ward-level service delivery this May.
Kiswahili: KRA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KRA amabirengere abamenyi bekaonti ya Machakosyamanyirie ng'a ogkeania obokoreri obuya amaumuntia May.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of poultry in Kajiado County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Ekegusii: Eriogi: FAO yachikire okonyaka kw'ebinyoni ase Kajiado County nigo ekorwa n'oborwaire bwa foot and mouth.

English: Ministry of ICT updates the national digital competency framework for learners, teachers, and administrators.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inasasisha mfumo wa kitaifa wa ustadi wa digital kwa wanafunzi, walimu, na wasimamizi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) nkomanyia yoboikeranu  bwechisemi, ochusi nokwenyara kwabana babwate ase emeremo bare gosomera, teachers, na abateneneri.

English: Villages in baringo to fight with malaria through their local best practices and use of nets
Ekegusii: Ebinyoro ime ya Baringo korwania oborwaire bwa Esosera ase ogotumia ching'encho chiabo amo na chineti.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Nandi County that input on the county budget process is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiama bia siasa obooririe abamenyi ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi okwana amachiko abwenerete korosigwa, korika baria gotangasa ababui ebuagi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Migori County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Migori Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Migori County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Bungoma County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this September.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai ya omosaria yaboriri abamenyi be'kaunti ya Bungoma kobeka bosio okorwani kwa ebiateko ya omorero ase etureti ya kebaki.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Narok County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: Kenyaa Red Cross oseka abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok abwaterane komenta ogotumia chinchera chireo korwa okwemurunganania kwabo omosiongoroko.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Homa Bay County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekiongo: IEBC nkoinyoria abanainchi ba ekaunti ya Homabay koria chinyomba chiarigetwe kwa okorwa kwa devolution.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Taita-Taveta County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Gotema: Kenya Gazette gwanse gokoboria okoboria gochia ase obogaang a kwabeire aria ekaunti ya Taita-Taveta omonugunoobarema.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Homa Bay County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yechirio (AFA) egokorera abanyamwaka ase Homa Bay County goika barende gocha na kitambulisho kiao kia taifa ekero bakogenda ase ogotendwa okwo kwokorima okoragwe.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Nakuru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: ODPP yabooririe entongori yogoaka chikura batarere abisi ere ange na koerikia ekaonti ya Nakuru kuvisite kochakire ya IEBC.

English: IEBC launches digital voter education app – download now on Google Play.
Kiswahili: IEBC yazindua programu ya elimu ya wapiga kura kidijitali "pakua sasa" kwenye Google Play.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) gosomia abanto igoro yogoaka chikura goetera egedichitari, nyora ayio goetera Google Play.

English: KRA warns public officers in Nairobi County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: KRA gochia abakoreri beserekari bwe Nairobi gochoria choria yogochanda gose komosuna omonto kare eseri ya porisi buna amamocho yogotumia amadaraka abo bobe.

English: OGP urges residents of Makueni County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Makueni kwerikia buna na korosia ebitambokero bioborendi ya ekaunti kochindagera goetera amachiko yokoraria na korosia ebitambokero bioborendi ase chindagera ase chinsagia ao ao.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Ekegusii: Kwani: IPOA okoigora esimi ya okonyora obokonyi ase GBV buna abasikari bakogonkia kia Lamu.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Wilaya ya Lamu.
Ekegusii: Korongo: NPS okoigora okorwa obogambi bwa bosa chingaki chiemesangerekano emenene ekeene kiLamu.

English: Join campaigns promoting public health, sanitation, and safe school environments.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na kampeni za kuhamasisha afya ya umma, usafi wa mazingira, na mazingira salama ya shule.
Ekegusii: Soa na gosegeta chingencho chiobochenu bwebinyoro, ogwesibia amaboko, namasingira amaya ase chisukuru.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Isiolo County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya ua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya isiolo koegerera chinchogu chia projekti kwa kwebisite yekaunti yabo kubera tebia kwa nyanja ya ward yabo.

English: Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kampeni bandia za kibinadamu zinazotumia picha zilizoibiwa zimeripotiwa kwenye Twitter. Daima thibitisha wafadhili kupitia majukwaa yanayoaminika kama M-Changa au Msalaba Mwekundu Kenya.
Ekegusii: Chibicha chioborimo gotumia chibicha chiabanto bande baibete korigeria chibesa chiangirwe buna okogenda mamincha yerichiko ria twiter. Kera engaki chungusa abakorigia chibesa goetra chinchera chiegenire buna M-Changa gose Omosaraba Omobaririri) Red Cross Kenya.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Embu County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bia Emasomo nigo bigoteba abasabi ase Embu Kaonti gochia ase egetaseni gia ogotebwa emiaka egokwenera ase ogotebwa okwo.

English: OGP reminds voters in Nyandarua County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya usajili wa wapiga Kura.
Ekegusii: OGP ekeombe giechimbebe giechikura Nyandarua giechimbebe bogoria esatifiketi yokoiborwa yose gochaka ama pasipoto omotienyi obochori kiararirie obweriki bwa getenererete chikura.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyeri County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) egosaba omonto omonde orengete obororo bwobongo ase Nyeri County gocha ase ogosomwa okwomogongo okwomwanya.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Nyandarua County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS oriomboragia aboremi ba Nyandarua korora okwerekera eriaranyo ryokuraba ogotamara eria ryokurimisia omwena goto kigoro kiguhe ebiro bogoro bya birerebia bireraki.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Nyandarua County to register their children at the nearest public school under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Komisheni y'Abakora Omwimo gw'Abasomesa nigo egokera abana batari amasomoni ase Nyandarua County konyorera abana babo erina ase esukuru y'oboroso erie hakiri goetera ogokonywa kwa bursary.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Kilifi County to have children under five screened for cholera during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Julai.
Ekegusii: Ewizarà yamarwaire neyokorora amarwaire neyokorora nigo erachire abamama nababa ase Kilifi kaunti gochia nabana baria bare ase emiaka etano gosegeta bagachungurwe amarwaire yacholera ase omotaratara ogokorwa ase omotienyi 7.

English: If you use improved fallows (planting a cover crop/shrub to rest and restore land) to improve soil fertility, remember to replace the phosphorus removed when you cut the shrubs before you plant your next crop - add compost or manure, or for best results apply a phosphate fertilizer (such as DAP, SSP, TSP, or rock phosphate).
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatumia magugu yaliyoboreshwa (kupanda mazao ya kufunika/mimea ya miche ili kupumzika na kurudisha udongo) ili kuboresha uzazi wa udongo, kumbuka kuchukua nafasi ya fosforasi iliyotolewa unapokatua miche kabla ya kupanda mazao yako ya pili - ongeza mbolea au uchafu, au kwa matokeo bora tumia mbolea ya phosphate (kama vile DAP, SSP, TSP, au phosphate ya mwamba).
Ekegusii: Iki u gindigwa amoyo ya phosforo yale yali yagokomera amaroba, kumbuka ku gindigwa amoyo ya phosforo yale yali yasalia nende u ogokomera mifumo yake yake - gindigwa kompo kana mungu, kana iki uoyera chache gindigwa amoyo ya phosforo (kama DAP, SSP, TSP, kana phosforo ya mungu).

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kisii County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yasororire abanainchi ya Kisii County ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose orochi na morindo yamache amagoro yamache yamache yamache.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns coffee farmers in Mandera County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kioborimi nechiobi (AFA) nigo korigia abarima bakaawa ase Mandera County igoro yechindui chiebisia na korigia abarima gochia ase ogotaboka amang'ana aya nigo konyare goika.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Narok County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Erioti ya Oboremi na Erio (AFA) ere gobarigania abaremi ba Narok County gochia na enamba yabo y'okoremererwa ase oboremi nigo bare gochia ase amasomo y'oboremi ayio are gochoka.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Homa Bay County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Obotungwa bwa Obong'aini - Ekeombe gia Obong'aini bwa Abana n'abakungu kigocha gokora engama y'obong'aini bw'ebirengererio bi'abana b'erero aaria Homa Bay County ase omotienyi 2. Bonse nigo bagosabwa gocha.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Chisemo: NTSA kera na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano ase egasi kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka kwa Siaya.

English: OGP reminds residents of Busia County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia ambao huhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: OGP baboririe abamenyi a Busia kaunti gokorera ekaunti yebunge ywebamenyi goting’igua obokoreri bwebiombe.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Mandera County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: ODPP yoromokera aborotokorwa Mandera buna enchera yekorwa chikorobonge obokebago abosaria bwabogoko nobokengeka ase okogora chitenda chieserikari buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene.

English: Egesa Career Clinic: Egesa FM presenters conduct sensitization programme in Kisii Presenters urged residents urged to embrace technical courses
Kiswahili: Kliniki ya Kazi ya Egesa: Watangazaji wa Egesa FM waendesha programu ya uhamasishaji huko Kisii Watangazaji waliwasihi wakazi kukumbatia kozi za kiufundi
Ekegusii: obosemia bwobomanyi bwe'gesa: abararia begesa fm mbatwqre omoroberio bwobosemia bwobomanyi ase echera yogotiotereria abamenyi bagusii gosomera obobundi.

English: Coughing to a period of two weeks? Expentant mothers should should be tested for TB withiout delay
Ekegusii: Ogokorora ase emekubio ebere? Abangina bebwateranetie goika barengwe esese bwango kegima

English: A GAIN-led campaign in Mombasa that improves access to affordable fruits and vegetables in urban market zones.
Kiswahili: Kampeni inayoongozwa na GAIN huko Mombasa ambayo inaboresha upatikanaji wa matunda na mboga za bei nafuu katika maeneo ya soko la mijini.
Ekegusii: Ekampeni ikoraagwa na GAIN Mombasa igosegeta ogotoka kwa matunda na chinyeni chia rigori rike mbarabare yechiro

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises maize producers in Marsabit County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeongero kia Oboremi na Erio (AFA) nigo kigochaera abaremi bamaruma ase Marsabit County korigisitra na ekeongero kio oboremi keri na echetipeeti mbere yechiro chiokogesa.

English: Notice: TVET announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: TVET nigo egokora omonyo bw'enchera y'okogaba chibursary ase amasukuru ari ase Kitui County.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Kwale County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba maombi ya bure ya yaliyomo kwenye ujifunzaji wa dijiti hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Echumi riabeene Kwale egera endorero baria bare nokogania kwao ticha egesabo ry'echibesa ry'amasomo maria mare.

English: The US government’s freeze on foreign aid, especially through USAid has caused major disruptions in Kenya’s health sector, particularly in HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis programmes that heavily rely on donor support.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Marekani imefunga misaada ya kigeni, hasa kupitia USAid imesababisha mapungufu makubwa katika sekta ya afya ya Kenya, hasa katika programu za VVU, malaria, na kifua kikuu ambazo zinategemea sana msaada wa wafadhili.
Ekegusii: Gotenenia obokonyi gochia chinse chia isiko gw'Eserekali ya America mono goetera USAID kwaretire obotutukanu ase ensemo ya obochenu ase ense ya kenya,monomono ase emeroberio ya oborwaria Bwa Enyamoreo, Esese na Esosera,eyio egosemeria ase obokonyi obwo.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia KEMSA nigo korigia abanto bose bwa Uasin Gishu County gochia gokorwa amatemwa ase ebitaro biari habehi nabo buna oborwa bwa amanyira bwarete goikera.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Tana River County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaita watu wa Wilaya ya Tana River wazungumze dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: Omotero ya Omosaria yob erekera egonde ase ekaunti ya Tana River okorega kusomia igoro yogokorer abande bobe ase esukuru na okwera obochege cha omwene chisukuru.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Migori County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Migori. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KEMRI nigo ekoremereria okobua kwomoro owa malaria ase ekaunti ya Migori. Abamenyi nigo babwenerete koripoti chinsaki chiobono ase abakori bechinyagitari banchera.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Homa Bay County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie abachache ba Homa Bay County obororia bwabo bogokora korengana na omwana ombudsman.

English: KYPA partners with IEBC for youth parliamentarian voter registration in schools.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiabasae babunge (KYPA) kiabwatanire nekeombe keria ekenen getenenerete obchori IEBC korika abasae ase chisukuru nechokorechi buna abaaki chikura.

English: NPS urges residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: NPS osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya mandera kurekia amakora yogoakwa omosiongoroko kwa chipomu chimbebe chia kenya, kabe are nechimbebe, ogokurerwa igoro yogoakwa chipomu chimbebe chia kenya.

English: KEPHIS advises milk producers in Homa Bay County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egokana abanyamwaka b'amata ase Homa Bay County korigisita ase ekeombe ekeemanyiire mbere y'omwaka ogwo ogokwenera.

English: HELB invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this September.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: HELB okorari obosae bo Kiambu ekaunti gokwana amorokererigua y'emoreka etureti ya kebaki.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiombe biegesiasa orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura ya Kajiado koenekia nga koira bare ribaga erio koenekia ayabarigete boyia via SMS kwa 70000.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Kisumu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette nigo egosaba abanainchi a Kisumu kaunti ng'a babe gotingia obokoreri bwekenyoro gochia eserekari igoro ya mobasekano onde bwensi gochia gotingia obokoreri bwekenyoro goetera eserekari yekaonti.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Omonya: Obotongori bw'Emasomo nigo bogokora okoraria chitariki chi'okorengana ase amasomo amayia ay'esekondari atari gochiarwa chigoti ase chisukuru chio Samburu Kaonti.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Nya: EACC gitegerera na koboria amaswari ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto goikera nyarorekanete yebiria ya Migori.

English: Scientists have found that a mosquito species blamed for malaria transmission in eastern and southern Africa has developed resistance to a long-used insecticide in the region.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi wamegundua kwamba aina moja ya mbu ambayo inalaumiwa kwa kuambukiza malaria katika mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika imeanza kupinga dawa ya kuua wadudu inayotumiwa kwa muda mrefu katika eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: Abanasayansi banyorire ng'a eumbu ekoambokeria Esosera Africa ya mocha na irianyi, yatwarire okonara na korwania eriogo ria ogoita chiumbu erio riatumekire ase engaki entambe ase chinsemo echio.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokomanyia abang'ina abanyamwaka ase Tharaka-Nithi County ng'a okonyora obwate bwo omong'ina orenge na amagenderero ase okwibarwa nigo obwate obwo bori bwerere ase chiofisi chionsi chieserikari.

English: Use hot waters in preparing food for the child to prevent diarrhea
Ekegusii: Botambe kanywe àmache amorero koroseria chindàgera chia omwana gotanga ogosaa

English: Notice: KICD opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: KICD egabure omoroberio omoyia obwomokono gwemotokaa ase ekitara kiomokono ase Kitui County.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Busia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette yabooririe abasae entongori yogoaka chikura ase ekaunti ya Busia batarere abisi ere ange na IEBC yogoaka chikura.

English: DCI warns residents of Tana River County to prepare for possible road accidents this February.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandaa kwa ajali zinazowezekana za barabarani Februari hii.
Ekegusii: DCI yobaborire abamenyi batana river kwerikia buna bokonyeka bare omonugunoobarema.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Lamu County on terracing this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya terracing Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekerangerio: AFA eratoe abaremi ba Lamu County igoro yogoaka amaterasi ase omotienyi 5.

English: NPS urges residents of Nyeri County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: NPS yabasemirie abamenyi egoro Nyeri kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kwa kurenda korora bwango ogcha egoro terio kogonya kobanga.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Meru County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ministeri y'ebirengerio tebia abamenyi ba Meru ekaunti koborigwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo bera tebia ebirengerio biabo ebikorwa by'ebirengerio.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kisii County this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kisii Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Chama cha kisukuru chikwana emesangerekano yesukuru chiobogesaku buna engencho yoborigereria igoro yechibesa chieserikari ase obokoreri bwabanto omonugunoobarema ase Kisii.

English: State Department for TVET reminds youth in Vihiga County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bya State Department for TVET bikoribua abamura na abanyaroka ase Vihiga County buna obonyamwamu bwa HELB bura bwo konyora amariuni ase ogotebwa gochia obokoreri bwa catering na hospitality.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of sheep in Mandera County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: NCPB nigo ekanite okogenda kwa chimburi ase Mandera County nigo ekorwa n'oborwari bwa rabies.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kiambu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ogokorari: KRA egeikaranso giachakirie obogaang a igoro yeserikari yechikaonti ase ekaunti ya Kiambu eng’atiato.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Lamu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: NDMA yasororire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Lamu ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose oroche rorew nomorindo bwamache amagoro yamorindo bweny.

English: EACC urges residents of Kisii County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Kirinyaga County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs avocado farmers in Homa Bay County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nikigocha amang'ana ase abaremi b'emavocado ase Homa Bay County igoro y'emikono enyia y'oborendi bwa chinduka ase omotienyi 11.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Busia County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the April outreach.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bomet Januari hii.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Lamu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.

English: NPS warns residents of Kericho County to prepare for possible flooding this October.

English: IEBC advises students in Kitui County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.

Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Komunikesheni ya Kenya yeringana erio okobaga chumia ebesa ase ekaunti ya Tana River tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-PESA nonde bwensi korinde enchera ase chia okonyarekana okonene Kwa endwari eye.

Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.

Ekegusii: Programu ya FAO ya JFFLS ina amorokererigua ya kufanya matunda na shamba na ya kujifunza kuhitaji kazi kwa obosae wakigatiko maeneo ya kuvutia. Wabu wametaji wana gindigwa kwa kujitaji na kujifunza masoko.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Kajiado County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba kere ogocha chiabaramu bechisukuru Kajiado ting’igua oboikeranu bwamaagacho yasukuru machu April.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Wajir County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Ekegusii: NTSA getenenerete obokoreri obuya ase chibara ime yense na ebisa bi’obochenu ase abanto Wajir omotwe wokoboria ase ababoririe abagambi komanyia abanto bonsi amagenderero omorakera.

English: OGP reminds residents of Turkana County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: OGP erere amamenyi ya Turkana County okobwaterana na abarai babo ase ogotumia okorosia amachiko.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egosorora omonto omonene orenge ase oborwa bwobongo ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County goika ase ebituo biokogera obokonyi bwobongo bosa.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this January.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross eribokirie abanto ng'a ogopimwa kwa oborwaire bwa meningitis nigo kware ase chinchera chiomonyagetari chiomomwaka ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County ase omotienyi 1.

English: KNEC advises students in Siaya County to register early to secure allocation to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Ekegusii: KNEC yasemirie endorero bekaunti ya siaya kwerikia amanyekane nebigambero naende anyore obokonyi ao ao naende obokonyi ekiti gia ekikorere.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Baringo County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Baringo kojikira ekaunti yao ngegechakire bera tebia obokoreri bwechikaonti igoro yochinchogu.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Samburu County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria katika Kaunti ya Samburu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: Ekeombe gia abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) kiremerete amang'ana amabe agokwata abanto malaria ase Samburu County. Abanainchi bakureirwe gochia gokorwa ekegego kera chingaki ase ekero ekeafya ekiri habe.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) yachakire omoroberio bw'okobaga chiforamu chia obokoreri gwesokia ase ekaunti ya Tana River erinde korwania okomanyia chiforamu chia okomanyia obisi.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Narok County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomonene yebiama yebiama bia siasa okwakorire abamenyi korongo rwa Narok koba amaumuntia kwalego akegusii na ofunza akegusii akegusii wakorwa ebirengererio buna amaumuntia kwalego.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Ekegusii: Chisegi: HELB okoigora ebinto biakeene ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria abana baganetie gotoka ase a Trans Nzoia.

English: IEBC advises residents of Siaya County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: IEBC osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Siaya gindigwa intaneti via e-Citizen portal nende osabire ID ogosaba.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Mandera County on water harvesting this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya uvunaji wa maji Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo kiratue abanyamwaka ase Mandera County igoro yogocha amache ase omotienyi 4.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Marsabit County to a free training on fertiliser application this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nigo gokoroka abaremi ba Marsabit County ase amasomo atari gochara ase okomanya buna bagokora na chifetiraisa ase omotienyi 7.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Kakamega County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS erangerete abamenyi b'etugo ase Kakamega County konyora etugo yabo chindano ase chinchera chiregire erio gokonya etugo yabo goika obomure.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa sasa wanaweza kutuma maombi ya kusamehewa deni chini ya mpango mpya wa serikali Hakikisha ushirika wako unawasilisha madai kwa uaminifu ili kupata usaidizi wa Ksh 6 7 bilioni katika mikoa yote inayolima kahawa.
