Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kericho kuondoka kweny ekirigeti ey'ekaonti muatia tebia kubera kweny okorwegwa kuobokoreri echemo gwa mbari.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Ogochika korwa ase Obotungamiri bw'Obochari - Ekeombe gia Obochari bw'Abanyabwate: chichiniki chia ogokonywa abanyabwate mbere y'ogochara chigakora chinga omotienyi 7 ase chichitari chieretwe ase Nandi County.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kitui County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kitui kochereka amagoro ase chingaki chinyinge.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges wheat growers in Kitui County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutumia viwango vya mbolea vinavyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorora chindagera chiokorwanya ebisoro (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kegosaba abaremi bweengano aaria Kitui County goetera oboremi bwa chifutira chire ekeene mbere yechimvura korenda kogesa obioremi bwinji ase omwaka oyu.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kisii County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette osabire abamenyi bekaonti ya Kisii kwerikia buna amaswari ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto.

English: Fertilizer e vouchers for the Long Rain Season are now being distributed Farmers are encouraged to collect their vouchers promptly to ensure timely access to fertilizers
Kiswahili: Vocha za Mbolea za Msimu wa Mvua Mrefu sasa zinasambazwa Wakulima wanahimizwa kukusanya vocha zao mara moja ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa mbolea kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Amoyo na vouchere kwa amagoro embura makali bono ina toka Farmers ni amwetwa kuwetwa vouchere kwao kwa kufanywa kwa muda kwa kusindika amoyo kwa muda

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kufanya kazi kwa ajili ya huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakire oyera yobokorei bweserikari yepasipoto igoro yobokoreri bweserikari yechikaonti yekabafana Baringo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Meru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomogambi yomong'ore yasegetire entongori yogoaka chikura buekaunti Meru batarere abisi ere ange na IEBC yobokoreri kogenda.

English: COMESA warns millet farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo egochente abaremi b'obori ase Nakuru County igoro y'ebinyamunyama biokonyonia ebirime, na gochika ogokonya gochia goikera chitariki chitarerete.

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.
Kiswahili: Kenya miongoni mwa nchi 12 za Afrika kupata dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria ifikapo mwaka 2025, WHO inasema kipaumbele kitaelekezwa kwa nchi zenye uhitaji mkubwa zaidi.
Ekegusii: Kenya nigo ere gati ye'chinse 12 chia Afrika chiranyore chodosi chomilioni 18 chia chanjo ya Malaria goikera omwaka o 2025, WHI nigo egoteba egotang'ana koa chinse chiria chibwate okogania okonene.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Samburu County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Ekegusii: KEMRI yaboririe abamenyi ba Samburu County gosekerera gokoresia chineti chio oborendi bw'embu chire na dawa chiro chionsi konyora gochia ase ogokura kw'amang'ana amange ay'oborwari bwa HIV/AIDS.

English: Build drought resilience through practices like water harvesting, drought-tolerant crops (sweet potatoes), and strategic storage.
Kiswahili: Jenga ustahimilivu wa ukame kupitia mazoea kama vile kuvuna maji, mazao yanayostahimili ukame (viazi vitamu), na uhifadhi wa kimkakati.
Ekegusii: Etugeeke korwa eguragura goetera okwegera gotacha na kogacha amache, gosimeka ebimeri birwa bikoremereria eguragura buna (amarabwoni), na enchera engiya yokonyagacha.

English: KTDA urges coffee growers in Murang'a County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KTDA eragete abaremi b'ekahawa ase ekaunti ya Murang'a gosemeria chigero chia mbolea chigendererigwe mbere y'omura gochia goika oboremi bwaye bube obuya ase omwaka oyu.

English: Notice: HELB reminds citizens in Makueni County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: HELB ekorera abamenyi ba Makueni County amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge bwabo.

English: COMESA invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on fertiliser application this May.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Mei hii.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo eretire abaremi ba Nyandarua County ase ogotenywa kwa bwerere ase okogera ebitira ebi omotienyi 5.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Busia County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Busia Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Busia County ase omotienyi 7.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Kitui County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: KNEC egokang'a abana baria batari amasukuru ase Kitui County gochia gochireng'ana ase amasomo abakuru goetera chikalasi chie amasomo abakuru.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Nakuru County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: KMTC ogokora endorero baria bare nokogania Nakuru County kw'obogosaba egera chiria chirengete ticha soni.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kibororia egonde omosiongoroko Nairobi ekaonti esagati.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): family planning counselling clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo korigiite: ebitaro biogoteba abanto igoro yoboremi bwa chibata nigo bigokora chinsabato chionsi chia omotienyi 12 ase ebitaro biogokonyera abanto biria bitoretwe ase Nakuru County.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Samburu County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyia: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service eragabie embeba yamasaka eyaerigwe abaremi ase Samburu County ase omotienyi 5.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in West Pokot County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bi'Oborimi na Oboreri bwe Ching'iti nigo bikoribokia abareeri bwe ching'iti ase West Pokot County goika goikera amang'ana ase ofisi y'abaveterinari erio gokonyora obokonyi bwa bwango ase ching'iti chiao.

English: COMESA warns cassava farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia COMESA kigochania abanyamwaka bwa mogo ase Nakuru County igoro yebinyamwamu biokona ebisangio na korigiria ogokonywa kwa hano.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange remains under the Coffee Directorate s oversight the Capital Markets Authority is advised to refrain from licensing it as an auction
Kiswahili: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi limesalia chini ya usimamizi wa Kurugenzi ya Kahawa.
Ekegusii: Chikagwa ya Nairobi yikorongoa kweny Coffee Directorate Capital Markets Authority yikweme kuyatia nyakorongozo maro kama aukshon

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: DCI nigo yaechekirie omoroberio gwo okorwanika n'ebiateko bie dharura bia omorero ogochia gobochia ase Kaunti ya Laikipia.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a June awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Ekegusii: Egisera y'okorora na ogosubia chindwara nigo egwancha omwaka bwa omotienyi 6 bwo ogokonya abanto bamenye obuya bwo gokoroba chianja ase Kericho County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Uasin Gishu County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano homa ya dengue wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia okorora na okorwanirira oborwari nigo kaboririe abamama na ababa ase Uasin Gishu County gochia gosegeta abana baria bare ase emiaka etano gosegeta okororwa oborwari bwa dengue fever ase omotigo ogoetera omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: Nya: EACC itegeka amaswari ase ebirengererio bia abanto chiomotienyi 2 abwo ase chinyoba chiebikaranso biekaonti ya Kilifi.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Ekegusii: COMESA egokana abaremi ase Ekaunti ya Nakuru gokora obochanchani bw'ebimeri nigo barete obonyinge bw'amataka mbere y'omwaka bwa omotienyi 1.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Bungoma County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bw'Oboremi na Obokuria bw'Etugo nigo bogoibuchia abanto ba Bungoma County ng'a oboremi bw'ebinyamwamu nigo bogoongera obonyamwamu bw'oboremi ase engaki ende.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 5.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Samburu County this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekambani ya Pest Control Products Board nigo egosoka omwaka ogokorera chimbisi chioboria chiri Samburu County chibesa chio gotemwa oborwaire bwa anthrax chitariki chia omotienyi 10.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Ekegusii: Ngera: Bokoreri bweserikari TVET giatangasire chisekenderi chinguru ase ogokonya abana goetera abachisekenderi goetera Kajiado.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Narok County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this January.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Keombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenywa abanto bari Narok ekegokonya nagoita kwa ebiateko omorero ngo eng'atiato.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Turkana County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yemwitu yeku TVET yemwana omwana chisemi chire Turkana County ting’igua burukania abana bare noboremaru nabana bande ase eng’atiato.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Kisii County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: KNEC obabwateranirie abamenyi ba Kisii County kobatibia amagenderero gao nebirenga bera tebia ase amagenderero amo nebirenga biekaonti.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Nyandarua County to strengthen child protection in schools this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Bieserikari igoro TVET mbaorogetie esikole e Nyandarua ting’igua igoro yokorenda abana esikole ebuagi.

English: DCI urges residents of Nyandarua County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: DCI osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya nyandarua kwerikia buna omorai ekiama ya enyoro kiao omosiongoroko amid heightened attention to border security.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Turkana County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za samaki.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokonyia abaremi ase ekaunti ya Turkana gochiregista ase ebitongori biokogokonyana biabere biachirekeretwe nigo konyorekana amachiro amaya ase chinswi.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri yarure ogokurera ase okoigora ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto Communications Authority of Kenya nkorwa kere obokonyi bwa bosa chingaki chiemesangerekano emenene Kiambu.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Siaya County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen okabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Siaya gotokoria nyina ekaunti yabo ebobokororia enibo enyina yabo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwangeria abanto ng'a obokonyi bwogotanga okwiyita obo bwo bwerere nbo bwarete ase chifasiliti chie chiremo ase Kakamega County.

English: The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp
Kiswahili: Mahakama imepokea malalamiko kuhusu wito bandia wa mahakama unaotumwa kupitia barua pepe. Wito haujawasilishwa kielektroniki au kupitia WhatsApp.
Ekegusii: EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of West Pokot County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kirengiere abamenyi ase omoroberio wopokot ya sugusu kachapin obaboririe ase omorero ase chingaki chinyinge omagoro ya chingaki chikonya.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Turkana County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Turkana kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ebiro y'Oboroche (Ministry of Health) - Ekeombe gie Ebiro y'Oboroche bwa Abangina nigo gokororia omonto omonde orenge na oborwa bwe chinsongo ase Turkana County goetera e namba ya simu ya bwerere ya oborwa bwe chinsongo.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kwale County to prepare for possible flooding this August.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kibororie abamenyi ba Kwale birengereka kubirengereka kwa riete.

English: KALRO urges sorghum growers in Lamu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo erure ogokurera abanyabireti bamasaka aaria Lamu County gosegeta chimbegu chiomwaka chire chire chigokora buya ase ogokora amakungu nigo gokong'ia ebiara ase omwaka oyu.

English: Government issues advisory on animal feed quality to prevent aflatoxin contamination.
Kiswahili: Serikali hutoa ushauri juu ya ubora wa malisho ya wanyama ili kuzuia uchafuzi wa aflatoxin.
Ekegusii: Eserikari nigo ekorwa ogosemia igoro yechindagera chingiya chietugo erio gotanga amarwaire akoretwa nesumu korwa nokobosa gwechinyeke.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Kericho County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gokora oboremi bwa chindagera (Pest Control Products Board) nigo gikobasoka abarimi ba Kericho County igoro yomoberio ogoendeerereria ogwegeria oboremi bwa kera na kera goetera okomwaga amache.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds youth in Narok County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi nochusi oboroso emeremo abosae bo Narok County oko HELB emeremo rigiya riokorokereria amorokererigua okonye obokonye obokorwa.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omonyene: KEMSA egakora ogosima oborwa bwa sukari ase obosa ase Mombasa County ase omotienyi 11.

English: Annoucing lauch of National roadmap for nutrition interventions at county and national levels.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la ramani ya barabara ya kitaifa kwa ajili ya uingiliaji katika lishe katika wilaya na kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Okoraria omoroberio ase orogongo igoro yechindagera ase ekaunti naboigo ense yonsi

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Egekoro: IPOA okoigora esimi ya GBV ogoaka kobamanyia buna abasikari bakomocha ase emeremo yabo egokora emeremo amatuko onsi chinsa chionsi ase abakungu aaria Narok.

English: Ministry of Health announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Nandi County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bi'obochari bi'Eserikari y'Obonyang'anyi nigo ebitangazete ogotebwa kwa ebiara bi'okorwaria chimpio (dialysis) ase abanto b'omwaka Nandi goetera omotienyi 10.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Murang'a County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egosaba abarebi be abana aase Murang'a County gocha ase rituko ria klinik ria kera ririko ase ekampeini ya afya ya abamama ya omotienyi 6.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Ngochandeka: IEBC giaansire amachiko arengete gotanga, gokwanerana na gokeania okomocherwa gose gochaya abana bande arurwe ase chisuku chiesekenderi ya nse ya Migori.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Nairobi County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie abanyasi ba Nairobi County korengana kwa forum y'amasomo maiborera kubera bera tebia kwa kwegara kwa kubora kwa voter registration.

English: CDC reminds the public in Homa Bay County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: CDC eribokire abanto ba Homa Bay County buna ogosaria ogw'okoregisita SHA nigo kwareo ase chiesitashoni chireo.

English: NCPB warns millet farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: NCPB neegochora abaremi b'obori ase Uasin Gishu County igoro y'ebinyamunyama ebiroreire na gosegeta omoroberio bwo gokora chingaki.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera egonde a Wajir County ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na kereka chisukuru chikorera chisukuru chikorera chisukuru.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii Medical Association nigo egosaba abarendi babana ase Kisumu County konyandika amakadi abangina na abana ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 10 bwo ogokonyora obochenu bwabangina.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a fraud prevention campaign in Wajir County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Wajir Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Nabwete: Kenya Red Cross agokonya ekero kia gokorwa ritangani chingaki chimobasekano Wajir County egetamo March.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Nyamira County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Nyamira na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Omoreri bwobosemia bwobokoreri: CDC yabucha erio okorwania esosera ya enkoromba cyclosporiasis Nyamira County, yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia chineti chie'chiumbu chibekire eriogo koba koba.

English: Painted by civic clubs and local artists
Ekegusii: Abanyakenyoro bgokora emeremo yabo amo gokinia ekenyoro kiabo bang'ororirie chibicha igoro yebinyoro biabo nabanyagosori.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi a Busia County koerikia obokoreri bwa carjacking boborendi na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: Eripoti ya oboruaire bw'ekiama berekera abasemirie abamenyi bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia abana goetani motato kwerikia esese ase esagati ase obosemi.

English: EACC warns public officers in Nakuru County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: EACC aoriora abakuria ekaonti ya Nakuru kana kurendeleka kurendeleka.

English: NTSA warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: NTSA yasemirie abamenyi ya Elgeyo-Marakwet gose ebengi yao yobobisi ya PIN ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Ekegusii: TSC nigo egokora omwonyo abana batari amasukuru ase Kiambu County konyora obwate bwechisukuru mbere yechitariki yegokera ase ogotaba chibesa chiesukuru.

English: Kenya promotes livestock disease prevention programs.
Kiswahili: Kenya huendeleza mipango ya kuzuia magonjwa ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Kenya negendererete gosegeta omoroberio bwogotanga amarwaire etugo.

English: KMTC invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Juni hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC nkoetia abasubati ime ya Kiambu County gochia gosoma obokoreri bwa welding na fabrication omotienyi 6 eyi.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Ekegusii: Enyamwonyo: Eminisitiri yechisemi nigo agotangaza chitariki chiogochakia okorendika abana abasomi boprimari abatarari bogocha chinsomi chia Nyeri County.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kajiado County.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obchori (IEBC) giechimbebe oyera obweriki bwa oboriori bwa e-Citizen komenta Kajiado.

English: CDC encourages residents of Nyeri County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bose ba Nyeri County ng'a tabakomanya obororo bwa chinsiri, na kobakong'a abanyanya babo abari ase obororo ng'a basare obokonyo.

English: KALRO urges beans growers in Garissa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KALRO) nkorwa kobaboria abaremi b'ebihingwa ase Garissa County kobwatesia ebitabi bi'ebihingwa biria birengete gochira obocha bwa riuba nigo bigokonya kong'erera ebitoki ase risesa eri.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe kia maunibasiti nigo koretia amagita okwenera amachiko amabere ase amasukuru aya sekondari ase amasukuru are ase Samburu County.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Isiolo County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya baboririe abamenyi yekaunti ya Isiolo okoboria okuerikia erio goting’igua obokoreri gwekaunti yabo gosira eserekari.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Makueni County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokang'a abamama ase Makueni County goika bakaregista kadi y'oborwaria bw'omomama n'omwana nigo bakonyare gotanga oborwaria bw'abana babo.

English: Promote coding clubs 2024.
Kiswahili: Kukuza vilabu vya uandishi wa misimbo 2024.
Ekegusii: Segeta ebiombe bia'masomo ekombiuta 2024.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir mwezi Februari huu.
Ekegusii: Chungu: KALRO ito tomonugunoobarema tomondeka chikagwa chikamwitu kwa mifarmu mi Wajir

English: NPS calls on the community in Siaya County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: NPS b erekera egonde a Siaya gose gokorer abande ase esukuru na kereka ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru gochisukuru chikuru.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Laikipia County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Abarimu (TSC) nigo korigiria abasabi ase Laikipia County gochia ase ekitengo gia obokoreri bwa omwaka gose obokoreri bwa kera mbuya ase ogosaba okwaisa.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Siaya County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross ogosegeta egonde Siaya gose komanyia amakora ase ababisi gose goetera goaka esimi gose gokorikwa gosoa ebiombe biobosaria.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okorora na gokorera endwari (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo gikoretera abangina ase Kitui County ng'a okonyorera obotumi bwa okobwata chindagera chia okorua chiana nigo keri obere ase chinsitashoni chionsi chia eserikari.

English: NTSA urges the public in Homa Bay County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: NTSA yateba obwana bwa Homa Bay County toka okogaba enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ogotunya enchera abange baibeirwe ya SIM-swap.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Manyia: Chokoro chia Kenya chia Komunikesheni chakembea ase oranyanyare kominchoria korwa emechando  omwaka igoro yemebasekano yepara mu Vihiga County.

English: Train on leadership 2023.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kuhusu uongozi 2023.
Ekegusii: Somia igoro yoborai omwaka 2023.

English: Mark your calendar for Devolution Conference, a major gathering for stakeholders in the aquaculture sector to network and learn.
Kiswahili: Andika kalenda yako kwa ajili ya Kongamano la Devolution, ambalo ni mkusanyiko mkubwa kwa wadau katika sekta ya ukuzaji samaki ili wawasiliane na kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Beka ekeriorokererio ase ekarenda yao igoro yomiosangerekano bwokota obokoreri ang'e. oyio orarete baria bonsi amo baria bakobwaterna ase ensemo yoboremi buna bareranie na gosoma.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS nigo ekorenta abana batari amasukuru ase Lamu County goikara ime yechisemi chiabakuru goetera eprogramu yechindagera ase amasukuru.

English: KALRO invites farmers in West Pokot County to a free training on fertiliser application this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utumiaji wa mbolea Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo eretebie abaremi ba West Pokot County ase ogotenywa kwa bwerere igoro y'ogotebia oboboremi bwa mbolea omotienyi 9.

English: SHA invites residents of Baringo County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: SHA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya baringo kwerikia buna abanyene ekiama ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese , erio kwemanyia boronge igoro yamagenderero yeserekari y'ekaunti.

English: CDC encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bose ba Tharaka-Nithi County ng'a tabakomanya obororo bwa chinsiri, na kobakong'a abanyanya babo abari ase obororo ng'a basare obokonyo.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Meru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Egechera: Ebiombe bioboremi na chindagera (AFA) nigo bigokabera abaremi chimbeyo chie chibage chire nenchiketi ase Meru County ase omotienyi 7.

Kiswahili: 100% mabadiliko: kila darasa la 6 lazima kuripoti kwa JSS hakuna kukaa nyumbani!

English: Vines should be killed by uprooting or cutting at least 10 to 14 days before harvesting potatoes, to ensure that the skin of the tubers hardens.
Kiswahili: Mizabibu inapaswa kuuawa kwa kung'oa au kukata angalau siku 10 hadi 14 kabla ya kuvuna viazi, ili kuhakikisha kuwa ngozi ya mizizi inakuwa ngumu.
Ekegusii: Matete aya amekorwa na ogotegora au okobutora matatu ma 10 hadi 14 amatuko kabla ya okogesa nyamihano, ili kuhakikisha ukoko wa nyamihano unamaliza kuhudhuli.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Nyeri County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyeri gindigwa intaneti via e-Citizen portal nende osabire ID ogosaba.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kericho County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NTSA ngosemia abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Kericho koba osabire kochiokochia chinchogu kochiokochia gacha gotigara koba gosiira koegerera chinchogu.

English: The government will establish a milk price stabilizing fund through New KCC with Kshs 3 billion allocated to manage excess milk and stabilize prices
Kiswahili: Serikali itaanzisha hazina ya kuleta utulivu wa bei ya maziwa kupitia New KCC na Kshs 3 bilioni zitatengwa kudhibiti maziwa ya ziada na kuleta utulivu wa bei.
Ekegusii: Serikali itakayamba kuhusiana na kifedha cha kuhakikisha bei ya maziwa ni mara mara kwa KCC Mpya na amagori arobora arobora amalizwa ili kusaidia kudhibiti maziwa mengi na kuhakikisha bei yake ni mara mara

English: Always check depth before diving into water - neck injuries can be fatal.
Kiswahili: Daima angalia kina kabla ya kupiga mbizi ndani ya maji - majeraha ya shingo yanaweza kusababisha kifo.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki pima komanya obotambe bwamache otarasoa goaka ontimbu. - nabo oraumie bobe ebigoti.

English: Play is vital for a child's emotional, physical, and cognitive development.
Kiswahili: Kucheza ni muhimu kwa ukuaji wa kihisia, kimwili, na kiakili wa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Chigosori nechingiya ase ogokina kwa abana, kemobere nà gotingia obongo

English: AFA warns sorghum farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egokuria abanyamwaka bamasaka ase Kiambu County ase obwate bwebinyambare, na goboria gokora oboikari bwa chinguvu na chinguvu.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Tana River County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ewizara: KMTC yachakire abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Tana River amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges poultry farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Pest Control Products Board nigo korigia abaremi bechingoko ase Kakamega County komanyia ofisi y'abakong'i bechingoko eria eri habechi igoro y'amarwaire aya amabe ya rabies ayo ayarekeretwe.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Nairobi County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: Obonchaki bwe Enyancha (Ministry of Health) nigo bogosaba abanyabanto baria barerete abana ase Nairobi County goika ase chikiriniki chie chinsa chigendererete buna emetuko yomokono yobochari bwa abakungu ase omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na usanifu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: KUCCPS nigo egwateire eprogramu empya yobokori bwebitambaa na okobuna ebitambaa ase ekigo kiabokori (vocational centre) ase Mombasa County.

English: KRA reminds the public in Isiolo County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: KRA orure okoboria ase abamenyi gosira ekaunti ya isiolo na omotimoko omuya ase chiafisi chia eserekari ni omotimoko omuya, omotimoko omuya, na omotimoko omuya.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Machakos County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: ODPP orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura bamenyete ime ya Machakos ka SMS kwa 70000 kochia ase kwarorekanire aaria ensemo ya baria.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: Ekero ekeombe kwa Turkana giachakire abamenyi korwa oboronge bwabo bwamachiko.

English: KTDA warns wheat farmers in Kajiado County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kajiado County juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Ekegusii: KTDA enyamokirimbi ebiateko kwa mahindi kiaje Kajiado ekunyonyoreka na ekurekera namba yake kwa kufanya kufanyika kwa muda

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Nyamira County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Nakuru County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Nandi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mkondoni ili kupata yaliyomo kwenye ujifunzaji wa dijiti bila malipo.

English: Conduct safety audit using 2008 Manual by September 30.
Kiswahili: Fanya ukaguzi wa usalama kwa kutumia Mwongozo wa 2008 ifikapo Septemba 30.

English: HELB reminds youth in Kiambu County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: HELB egokwaniria abase ba Kiambu County buna obokonyi bwa HELB bwo gochia ase ogotenywa chinguo na ogotara nigo bwochi.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Nyamira County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Mombasa County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyora: SHA (Social Health Authority) ekoba negetiro kiokonyora obomanyi bwa abasubati ase oborwa bwo obwongo ase Mombasa County ase omotienyi 8. Abanto bonsi nigo baragwatwa amaboko.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyeri.

English: KNEC urges parents and teachers in Nandi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.

English: Do not apply substances to the cord. Keep it dry and clean until it falls off naturally.
Kiswahili: Usipake vitu kwenye kamba. Iweke kavu na safi hadi ianguke kiasili.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa goaka ebinto binde bionsi ase omogoyo. Onyebeke ebe enkamoku naende endabu goika egwe yoka.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Garissa County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Mandera County on agroforestry this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kilimo cha misitu Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Okari: Ebisareri bi'oborimi n'oboreri bw'etugo nibigo bikorere abarima ba Mandera County igoro y'oborimi bw'emiti ase omotienyi 6.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Ekegusii: KEMSA yasegetire abaturageti ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County gosekerera chineti chiokorwa n'emiti yokwita chinsu chiro chiro konyora oboremi bwa omurwaro ogwo dengue fever obwongererekete.

English: Farmers in mango producing counties are encouraged to adopt improved planting materials and enhance their skills to boost production and market access following the National Mango Conference
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika kaunti zinazozalisha miembe wamehimizwa kutumia nyenzo bora za upanzi na kuongeza ujuzi wao ili kukuza uzalishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kufuatia Kongamano la Kitaifa la Mango.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Tana River County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiyakire endorero ase ekaunti ya Tana River okotoma ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yabana baria batari kwenyara 2022 kuchakire ogosaba kwao onyore chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yao onyore.

English: KICD encourages residents of Laikipia County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: KICD agasaba abamenyi ba Laikipia ekaunti koborigwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo, bera tebia ebirengeererio biabo.

English: Notice: DCI launches a fraud prevention campaign in Vihiga County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": DCI giaansire ekampani yobokengeka ogokora obokengeka bwaye goetera Vihiga County esagati.

English: IEBC urges residents of Narok County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: IEBC osabire abamenyi bekaonti ya narok kogitegerera amaswari ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto na kogikera amang'ana igoro yosoma.

English: NPS alerts residents of Isiolo County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: NPS yasemirie abamenyi a Isiolo County koerikia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) nkworokereria ere igoro yasemerie obokoreri bwa nyama.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kilifi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiremire abamenyi e Kilifi kiobororie kubereka ebiateko ebochinkwana obokoreri ase amagoro yebiateko.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Ekegusii: NDMA yankiangete abamenyi bia Turkana goeera ekenyori kia abakorogo bia gosikiria gosikiria na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri okobagera matumaini bia gosikiria bia abakorogo bia gosikiria.

English: AFA advises farmers in Isiolo County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: AFA eragire abaremi aaria Isiolo County gochia na nomboro yabo y'okwerika ase oboremi erio gokwenera gokora ase amasomo amaya agokwiza.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kwale County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egosaba abaremi ase Kwale County gochia ase ogoteka chingencho chiogotara amache ase amakonde ayo nigo bakonyeke na ogotindana na chimbura chire gochaka gose gosekerera.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Nyamira County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya.
Ekegusii: NDMA yarure abamenyi a Nyamira egonde koba maiso erio egonde obokoreri obwasioku.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Machakos County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi na echio chiriokonywa (AFA) nigo egokora omonyo bwoboremi bwechimera chitarerete amakemikali ase abaremi ba Machakos County buna egechencho yomwaka bwa omotienyi 11 bwoogokora amabera okomanya okogenderera ase obororo bwechiheo.

English: DCI urges the community in Mandera County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Ekegusii: DCI gotanga egonde bao Mandera buna okobagera amangana ao abobisi gose ayengencho na monto ende bwensi goetera chinkwana ase esimi na abao ababwera.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Trans Nzoia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DCI nigo egosaba abamotisiti na abachenu ase Trans Nzoia yekaonti tibatema goeta ase amache gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache na komantia eserikari igoro ya mobasekano onde bwensi gochia amokoreri bweserikari ore ange nere gose goetera enamba ya morero yekaonti goetera eintaneti.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kisii County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nkiarobere: NTSA nkiaroberetie ogasanga egonde yao Kisii okobwaterana na banto bechingencho ao ao esagati.

English: KALRO advises fish producers in Kiambu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo egokora abaremi b'ebisaba ase Kiambu County gochia ase omosoko bw'abaremi ogochaka, mbere y'omwaka bw'okogesa.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) ime yaikaranso egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro yeserikari yechikaonti giachakirie obogaang a Wajir County omonugunoobarema.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Wajir County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya gochia abakoreri beserekari Wajir gotaka komanya obokeene na obomaiso marore ase ogotumia chibesa echio.

English: CDC reminds the public in Nandi County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia CDC kigokora abanto ba Nandi County komanya obwenge bwo gwocha amaboko ase oborongo bwe chinyomba.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiokorora ebiragiro biokorora ebisero (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kigoibokia abaremi ba Tharaka-Nithi County igoro yomogongo ogokorwa ogwogoteba buna barigese rigesa riabo.

English: DPP warns residents of Bungoma County to prepare for possible road accidents this November.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: DPP yamabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Bungoma yemebasekano yepara igoro yemebasekano yepara mu November yemebasekano yepara.

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Murang'a County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete obosae Murang'a County okogeria chisemi chiobogesaku igoro ya amakora achigakoro.

English: It is recommended that farmers cultivate improved tomato varieties with a longer shelf life.
Kiswahili: Inapendekezwa kuwa wakulima walime aina za nyanya zilizoboreshwa na maisha marefu ya rafu.
Ekegusii: Ere okere okotia maguzi a matunda a ngwete a oyera na kumwana kurekure

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Bomet County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.

Ekegusii: Ewizara yoborendi bwa oborwaro (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) eribokire abamwamu abari ase Bomet County inga okwenera obonyamwamu bwo okuria okomanya abana nigo bwo bwerere ase chifasiliti chiensi chiomwaka.

English: Ministry of Education distributes tablets equipped with preloaded curriculum content for youth in community learning centers.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkobaga ere ebikombiuta biakoboko bobekire amasomo onsi pi ase chinyomba chiogosomera chiebinyoro erio abasae basome.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Garissa County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kekere abantu abamanyia ase Garissa County ngoro choria yobokoreri bwechikaonti.

English: DCI calls on residents of Samburu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.

Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia CDC nigo gikoremereria abakungu baria bari n'emida ase Nyandarua County ng'a ogonyora obochunji bwa abana noboerere ase chifasiriti chiose chia geserikari.

English: Enhancing Agricultural Financing in Kayonza: SACCOs were introduced to the Agriculture Credit Assessment Tool through which cooperatives ...
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha Ufadhili wa Kilimo huko Kayonza: SACCOs zilianzishwa kwa Zana ya Tathmini ya Mikopo ya Kilimo ambayo vyama vya ushirika ...

English: NTSA urges residents of Homa Bay County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NTSA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya homa bay koegerera chinchogu omosiongoroko kurekia buna abanyene ekiama kia gokurerwa ogokurerwa igoro yogoakwa chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya.

English: Import export and transit of live animals and animal products in Uganda requires authorization from the Commissioner for Animal Health Ensure compliance with disease control guidelines
Kiswahili: Kuagiza nje na kusafirisha wanyama hai na bidhaa za wanyama nchini Uganda kunahitaji idhini kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Afya ya Wanyama Hakikisha uzingatiaji wa miongozo ya kudhibiti magonjwa.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Enyarora: KICD yanchuire omoroberio omoyia bw'chisemi chia ICT ase ekorechi chiobobundi ime ya Siaya County.

English: Notice from CDC: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
