Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo inakuza mchanganyiko wa mtama na mtama kama menyu ya majaribio katika kukabiliana na lishe zinazostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwa eserekali ngosegeta ere oboremi rwa obori na amaemba komentwa ase chindagera chia amatemwa korwana na ogoonchoka kwa erire

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Siaya County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekio okorora amabere n'ebinyamwamu (KEPHIS) nigo kigoibokia abaremi b'ebinyamwamu ase Siaya County kogecha gotwara ebinyamwamu biabo gochia ase chikaunti chinde batari na echitibika erio korigia obuya bw'ebinyamwamu.

English: KRA reminds voters in Lamu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria kere barigetie buna abaaki chikura mbuya ere getera SMS kwa 70000 kwa kinyo kwa nyoro yobochori.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Murang'a County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Biombe bieserikari igoro yamasomo oboroso b erekera egonde go Murang'a gacha amagancha ase gachia egera nchire nokogania okonene neribaga rigiya riemeremo.

English: KICD reminds youth in Mandera County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Ekegusii: KICD nigo egokora abasubati ase Mandera County buna obonyagwate bwa HELB bwo gochia ase amasomo y'okorua na okorora abageni nigo bori.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Wajir County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Gazeti ya Kenya okoboria ase baria buekaunti Wajir egokonye koira omogambi omonene obokoreri kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua obokoreri bene bweserekari.

English: TSC increases intern salary to Ksh 45,000 effective January.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) nkogesa kere omosara bwabarimu baria kiarigete bwechisingi 45,000 gochakera omotienyi omotang'ani.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of sheep in Laikipia County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Ekegusii: Amachiko: KTDA nigo eganirie okogenda kwa chimburi ase Laikipia County goetera oborwa bwe'chirabi.

English: ODPP advises residents of Homa Bay County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: ODPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Homa Bay bogoria yonsi amasakara yao buna ogosomia nyuma yechitariki ogokora emeremo yao buna ogosomia buya gochia (ID) nyuma yechitariki.

English: ODPP updates residents of Nyandarua County on progress of community-based development programmes this May.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Mei.
Ekegusii: ODPP yarure okoboria gochia ase egonde ya Nyandarua amaumuntia amaumuntia.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises horticultural produce producers in Nandi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo korigiririe abaremi b'ebitoki na ebituma ase Nandi County kora ebitoki biabo goetera abaguri baria bare na ebisiteti (licensed) mbere y'omwaka ogw'ogugesa.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in West Pokot County this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie okoboria obokwana bw'amasomo kwa endorero ebisakane kwa esikulu z'omwaka West Pokot eng'atiato.

English: Young parent may be scared or fear. Dialogue with community assistance groups can be of great help to delink those fears
Ekegusii: Abasubati abageni ase oboibori nabo bakonyora omoichano gose obwoba. Gokwanerwa okuya n'ebiombe bie obokonyi nabo kogokonya.

English: TVET reminds youth in Nyeri County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia TVET kigoibokia abasubati ase Nyeri County buna obonyinge bwa HELB bwarenge ase okorugwa amagenderero ase obumanyi bwa ICT.

English: Kenya is pushing forward with its international labour initiatives by sending 350 seasonal workers to the United Kingdom, despite the recent wave of violent protests that have rocked the former coloni...
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendeleza mipango yake ya kimataifa ya kazi kwa kutuma wafanyakazi 350 wa msimu nchini Uingereza, licha ya wimbi la hivi karibuni la maandamano yenye vurugu ambayo yamegonga koloni ya zamani...
Ekegusii: Kenya negenderete gosuka motwe nemeroberio yaye yobokoreri kimataifa ase ogotoma abakori emeremo 350 bechingaki  gochia United Kingdom, nonya chisegi na amaandamo ase ense eyio...

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Baringo County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: IPOA nigosaba abamotoli nobabanto bagotara Baringo County ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache, ng'abogendia obobe gochia igoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: IEBC invites youth in Kisumu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia IEBC nigo kogoita abasubati ase Kisumu County gochia korigisibwa ase ogotemwa bwe ogokora chigari (motor vehicle mechanics) ase omotienyi 7.

English: The government has imposed a raft of new drastic measures after cases of the new coronavirus in Kenya jumped to 15 in the last 72 hours. The new directives came after eight more people tested positive for COVID-19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeweka hatua kadhaa kali baada ya visa vya virusi vipya vya korona nchini Kenya kupanda hadi 15 katika saa 72 zilizopita. Maagizo hayo mapya yalikuja baada ya watu wengine wanane kupimwa na kupatikana na COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Eserekali yabekireebitambokero ekero ebinyinyi ebinyia bia Korona biamentekanete goika 15 ime ye'chinsa 72 chiaetire. Amachiko amayia nigo achete magega yabanto bande batano na batato gopimwa na konyorekana na COVID-19.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekoreibokia abanto aaria ekaonti ya Machakos igoro yobwenereti bw'ebirero ase obonyamu bw'echiika.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Meru County.
Ekegusii: Chinje: IPOA okoigora chitaa chokobaa oboraro nechinchera chiokobaonchoreria gochia obogime obuya buekaunti Meru.

English: Raise awareness about corruption effects to encourage ethical conduct among citizens
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa kuhusu athari za rushwa ili kuhimiza mwenendo wa kimaadili miongoni mwa raia
Ekegusii: Manya abanto obobe bwobokengeka erio koa abanto omoyo gokorera abande buya.

English: KTDA warns sweet potatoes farmers in Tana River County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: KTDA nkoaburia abanyamwaka bwechingwaci ase Tana River County igoro yechinyamunyi chigokora obwate na gosegeta okorua ase obwate obo nchera eyemo.

English: NTSA urges residents of Narok County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NTSA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok kojweterane na bokwemurunganania bokwemuruganania omosiongoroko.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bi'Oboroche - Ekitengo kioboroche bw'okwibarana nigo gikoremereria abanto buna oboikonyoro bw'ogosira oboibori bwe'ebinywanyi nigo bori ase obwanchani bwa chiofisi chioboroche ase Mandera County.

English: Farmers in Nyeri County are encouraged to consider maize as fodder for dairy cows as it has advantages over napier grass for silage making
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wanahimizwa kuzingatia mahindi kama lishe ya ng'ombe wa maziwa kwani yana faida zaidi ya nyasi ya napier kwa kutengeneza silage.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria mu Nyeri ni amwanywania kurekure egetuma kama chakabuti kwa ng'ombe kwa sababu yana fadhila zingine kwa kurekure mwenywa kumwa napier

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kajiado County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kajiado County kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: NDMA boririe abakenya baria choria enchera Kajiado komanyia igoro yabo gose goetera emerangu ya magega gochia eporisi steseni ya gender.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Mandera County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this March.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Machi hii.
Ekegusii: KALRO eretire abaremi ase Mandera County ase amasomo abosa ase enchera chinsya chogotirira chindagera ase omotienyi 3.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Nairobi County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji wa kisasa.
Ekegusii: NCPB yachakire abachuma ba Nairobi County kw'omoro gw'okworokererigua gw'oboremi bw'enchera ya bono ogw'okwegeria.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Kakamega County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itaendesha warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: KALRO ekorora okobwateka egesomo gia okorimira ase ebitara ase abarima ba Kakamega County ase omotienyi 4.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Makueni County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragire omonto oyio okorwa n'oborwaire bw'obwongo ase Makueni County goika gosegerera omoteti orengeirwe obuya.

English: You are suffering mentally? Drinking beer cannot give you any strength, it is a chemical that spoils a lot. feed your brain. Choose good cure, talk to the counsellor and join helpful clubs, and you can equally talk to us to get help
Ekegusii: Ochandegete ebirengererio? Konywa amarwa tikogokoa chinguru, neriogo rigosaria amang'ana mono. Chora okobwena okoronge, gamba na omosemia na kwebeka amo na ekeombe Kiogokonyana, boigo nabo ogokwana naintwe ase obokonyi

English: Notice: EACC launches county development projects in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Ekegusii: Omogoro: EACC erere omorero omochi okosia okosia o Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: TSC encourages residents of Laikipia County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorenda TSC yaboririe abamenyi ba Laikipia County koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire kwa obosombi bwabo, bera tebia igoro yamaonchorerio arengete ebiombe biabw'omobudismani.

English: Wash your hands with soap befior handling a baby to prevent diseases
Ekegusii: Sibia amaboko ao ase amache nesabuni otaràbwata omwana gotànga oborwaire

English: Do not apply any medication on the ambirical cord lining. Keep it clean and dry until it cures and drops itself.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa goaka ebinto binde bionsi ase omogoye bwororeria. Onyebeke ebe enkamoku naende endabu goika otonye bwoka.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Wajir County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Obongaki - Ekitengo kia Obongaki bwa Ogochiara nigo kiorokire omonto omonene orenge na obochenu bw'obongo ase ekaonti ya Wajir konyora omwaka omonene orenge na obochenu bw'obongo konyora obokonyo.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Mombasa County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yechingiru kiaboriri abamenyi ba Mombasa obabwateranirie amagenderero gati yeserikari chiechikaonti.

English: IPOA urges the public in Laikipia County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: IPOA akunyonyesha nyumba kwa mwananchi wa Laikipia kuogotunya malengo kwa njia za kisasa kabla ya kufanya chochore kususua mashauri yaliyotokana na mawazo ya kufungua ujumbe.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Machakos County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Machakos Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Amanyisibue: Ekambi y'oborwaria ey'erere eyakoretwe na KEMSA ekaba ase Machakos County ase omotienyi 8.

English: All deliveries should be conducted by skilled birth attendants at health facilities. This ensures safer births and immediate care in case of complications.
Kiswahili: Uzazi wote unapaswa kufanywa na wakunga wenye ujuzi katika vituo vya afya. Hii inahakikisha uzazi salama na huduma ya haraka iwapo kutatokea matatizo.
Ekegusii: Okoiborigwa kogwenerete gokoru na'bamanyi ase chinyagitari .Eye nigo ekoenekia okoiboirigwa okuya na obokonyi bwa bwango obokong'u boisa kobao

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free safe water storage outreach in Wajir County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Wajir Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Enyangi ya abanto: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragabania obokonyi bwogotera amache ase enchera engiya ase Wajir County omotienyi o omotienyi 5.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kajiado County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokang'a abamama ase Kajiado County goika bakaregista kadi y'oborwaria bw'omomama n'omwana nigo bakonyare gotanga oborwaria bw'abana babo.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Trans Nzoia County on water harvesting this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya uvunaji wa maji Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo kiratue abanyamwaka ase Trans Nzoia County igoro yogocha amache ase omotienyi 2.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Kisumu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: FAO okorera abagorwa egetuma bo Kisumu County gosoroma ebimeri bikoremereria egetuma ebituma omorakera oyera ebisuma amagoro ogwa.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Homa Bay County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie endorero eriochieni omwabo Homa Bay County ticha omoroberio bwamasomo bwabwabwabwa.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Nandi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: ODPP inyakurutia abamenyi ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi okerikia ero gotingia obokoreri na erio ting’igua obokoreri yamwo.

English: IEBC updates residents of Kisii County on progress of county development projects this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Agosti.
Ekegusii: IEBC obabwateranirie abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Kisii na kobasaba kwebwaterania ng'a amagenderero ase amabonyeke riete.

English: KTTC renamed to focus solely on training TVET instructors.
Kiswahili: KTTC jina upya ili kuzingatia tu mafunzo ya walimu TVET.
Ekegusii: Ekorechi yabarimu yobobundi KTTC yarokirwe erieta riyia erio korenga gosomia abatimu bechisemi chiobobundi  TVET chioka.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Bungoma County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma ape simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Communications Authority ya Kenya yaboriri yonje yochoria kwa obokonyi ase okonyora GBV esimi 1195 kwa obwango.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Kilifi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) b erekera egonde Kilifi gianchoreire gacha amagancha egera nokogania nokogania hwechifakitori omwaka bwamasomo.

English: Notice: KMTC launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: Okorari: KMTC inga ogokonya abana goetera ogosemia abechisekenderi nechisimi naboigo obosio ase obosio nechisimi ya Kilifi.

English: Youth Agenda trains youth to use tech for civic engagement.
Ekegusii: Achenda yabasae nkwegeria ere abasae gotumia tekinorochi gokwanerana nakobwaterana ase emeremo yebonyoro.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Ekeria omosaria oboitaai (DCI) nkiarogereretie buya chifaeri chiebina goikerania oboikeranu bwebinto bikworokia buna amagoso arenge ase enchera yamaiso marore ase obotuki bwebina, nkiarogereretie buya chifaeri chiebina goikerania oboikeranu bwebinto bikworokia buna abamenyi bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia buna abanyene ekiama.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Lamu County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ki'amasomo amange (Universities Fund) nigo korigiriria abanto ba Lamu County ng'a barendie abana babo ase esukuru y'ebitongwa eri hakiri erio babere n'omonyo ase obonyotokero bw'ebirasi.

English: EACC urges residents of Nyamira County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: EACC osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya nyamira kwerikia buna bera tebia kwechinchogu cha amagenderero cha gwekaunti.

English: EACC advises residents of Kisii County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: EACC osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kisii bogoria yonsi amasakara aogokora nyuma yechitariki gochia ogosomia buya gochia ID.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Isiolo County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS erarerete abana abatariri amasomoni ase Isiolo County goika barore abana babo ase esukuru yonsi eyio eri hakiri na nchera yokorieria abana amasomoni.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Kakamega County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Obotugi bwa Kenya nigo kigoibokia abanto be'kaunti ya Kakamega igo okorima okobwate amachiko kwoyia oboremi bwa igoro ase obore bwa kare.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Wajir County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragete abanyamwaka ase Wajir County kwerika ase ebitongori biokomera ebiemere erio konyora chibei chinchere chiobiara biokorima.

English: Council of Governors urges eligible citizens in Siaya County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto amang'ana igoro yechikaonti chiabo ase Siaya.

English: DPP urges the public in Nyeri County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Ekegusii: DPP ekeombe abamenyi koNyeri gikombe giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kabosombe obokoreri bweserikari, kabogotunya goenyereka oborimo igoro yokobamanyia obokebago goetera eintaneti.

English: Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) emphasizes the importance of TVET for youth employment.
Ekegusii: Abateneneri bechikorechi chiobobundi nochusi ao ao (TVETA) basegetire obuya bwamasomo ochusi ase abasae buna enchera eyemo yokwerika emeremo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Uasin Gishu County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure egonde bao Uasin Gishu goeera okobagera amangana ao abosirirwo gose ababwani goeera okobwatanigwa abanto okobwana.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Kericho County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo ekorera omwoko ogotanga Kericho ogotanga abanto bao kwa sibia amaboko nesabuni na amache amarabu ogotanga oborwaire bw'ebiro by'ogotanga.

English: Update health protocols 2021.
Kiswahili: Sasisha itifaki za afya 2021.
Ekegusii: Onchoreria emeroberio yobochenu omwaka 2021.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Isiolo County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Echumbe be Kenya oboririe abamenyi bawo Isiolo gosanga ebiro ebio nobokina mirembe.

English: Youth Agenda empowers counties with active youth councils.
Ekegusii: chenda yaasae nigo ekoa chikaonti chinguru goetra okobwaterana nabasae.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Nandi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Enyango: Ekeombe gia CDC nigo kigoika omoroberio obwoborwari obwomwene aaria Nandi County ase omotienyi 2.

English: IEBC urges residents of Wajir County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: IEBC egokaba abanto bose bwa Wajir County goika ase omoroberio bwokosomia abakure erio banyore obonyamu bwa omoroberio bwokuria amasomoni.

English: No child to repeat Grade 6 – automatic promotion to JSS enforced nationwide!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto wa kurudia Daraja la 6 – kupandishwa cheo kiotomatiki kwa JSS kunatekelezwa kote nchini!
Ekegusii: mwana onde tari orairorere egeredi gia 6 korende gosoa ebirasi biechisekenderi chia inse (JSS) yabebikwe chinguri Kenya engima!

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Nyeri County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this July.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Komachiko kwa'Abana abachia gokwanerana na gokeania okomocherwa gose gochaya abana bande arurwe ase chisuku chiesekenderi ya Nyeri eeio ting’igua gera arengete gotanga ase engoromomi ya july.

English: DPP reminds the public in Laikipia County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: DPP yarure okoboria ase abamenyi baborigwe Laikipia gieserekari koba maiso erio gokoboria obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Bungoma County on progress of community-based development programmes this June.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jamii mwezi Juni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobori nechimbebe yebiama biasiasa yebwatesirie egonde Bungoma ebuagi ebuagi na korwa ebirengererio buna amachiko abwenerete korosigwa na gotangasa ababui.

English: DCI reminds the public in Kiambu County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya.
Ekegusii: DCI yarure abamenyi ase Kiambu egonde koba maiso erio egonde obokoreri obwasioku.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Tana River County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bia Oborimi na Obotugo nibibukirie abarima ase Tana River County igoro yomokoro ogokorwa ogwogoteba abarima buna bakorwa oborimi bwegreenhouse.

English: Kenya aims for a 125 growth in the pig value chain by 2030 Farmers and investors are encouraged to explore opportunities in this rapidly growing sector
Kiswahili: Kenya inalenga ukuaji wa 125 katika mnyororo wa thamani wa nguruwe ifikapo 2030 Wakulima na wawekezaji wanahimizwa kutafuta fursa katika sekta hii inayokua kwa kasi.
Ekegusii: Kenya ina tuma agara 125 mu chakachaka cha ng'ombe chakachaka kwa 2030 Mifarmia na wambo wetu wame tuma kumira neka mu chakachaka chakachaka kwa kumweka kwa kumwega

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Nyandarua County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ria Pest Control Products Board rigoibokia ababori bwebitungo ase akaunti ya Nyandarua goika goikera amakuru amabe ase ebitungo biabo ase ofisi ya abaveterinari erio goikera obokonyi bwoboroche bwebitungo.

English: KNEC releases KCSE 2025 marking scheme early – download before leak!
Kiswahili: KNEC yatoa mpango wa kusahihisha KCSE 2025 mapema – pakua kabla ya kuvuja!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amatemwa KNEC nkorwa kere buna amatemwa esekenderi KCSE akomakigwa omwaka 2025, yonyore otaraminchoria gochia amaboko amabe!

English: KEPHIS urges sorghum growers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorora ebitoke (KEPHIS) nigo koria abaremi bamasama ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County kobwate oborengi bwa fall armyworm kare na kare bagotumia dawa chiremeretwe erio gokora amagero amaya omwaka.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Taita-Taveta County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omonyi: Eminisitiri y'obobwenia - Ekitengo k'obobwenia bw'abana na abagima nigo egokora omoroberio ogotebia abanto igoro y'oborwari bw'obwong'u (hypertension) ase obogere bwa Taita-Taveta County ase omotienyi 4.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekoreibokia abanto aaria ekaonti ya Uasin Gishu igoro yobwenereti bw'ebirero ase obonyamu bw'echiika.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Kirinyaga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Ongwanja wa State Department for TVET ororere abantukazi ba Kirinyaga County gokuza okorire bursary kugarara enyamanza okukora amasomo ga kusoma no kwandika abakuru.

English: KEMNAC urges greater Muslim representation in government after IEBC appointments.
Kiswahili: KEMNAC inahimiza uwakilishi mkubwa wa Waislamu katika serikali baada ya uteuzi wa IEBC.
Ekegusii: KEMNAC kiarure okoboria ase abaisilamu kobwatanigwa ase emeroberio yeserekari nyuma yogochorwa bene ase abateneneri  ba IEBC.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Murang'a County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Amanyisibue: Ekambi y'oborwaria ey'erere eyakoretwe na KEMSA ekaba ase Murang'a County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Embu County this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo wa matumbo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Embu Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri y'Obochari - Ekitengo kiobochari bw'abana n'abakungu nigo egokora omonyo abanto buna ogotukia oborwaire bwa typhoid nigo okorwa goetera obwate bwo obochari bwa gavamenti ase chinsitichini chiensi chi'obochari ase Embu County ase omotienyi 6.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County ase omotienyi 9.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi midia Taita-Taveta korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro kubonge obokoreri bweserikari giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kabonge ogotunya giasoreetia kibonye nyeke.

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ogutie ya Mwakiri Nyakatekate ni amabagweterete ababeri nka Elgeyo-Marakwet ekaunti ase obisite Huduma Centre lwe na karaktere ase okokwara esatibigeti ya okoibora.

English: Guidelines on improved post‑harvest storage to reduce maize losses.
Kiswahili: Miongozo kuhusu uhifadhi bora wa mahindi baada ya mavuno ili kupunguza upotevu wa mahindi.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio igoro buna ebwenerete kogesa na kopgacha rigesa riao erio gokeia ogsareka kwebituma biao.

English: Elgon Kenya and SMACHS Foundation have established a model farm and vertical gardens at Nyanjega School to support 4K Clubs promoting agribusiness among young students
Kiswahili: Elgon Kenya na SMACHS Foundation wameanzisha shamba la mfano na bustani wima katika Shule ya Nyanjega ili kusaidia Vilabu vya 4K vinavyokuza biashara ya kilimo miongoni mwa wanafunzi wachanga.
Ekegusii: Elgon Kenya na SMACHS Amaroso ameunda oboremi na egeticha za miguu ku Nyanjega Endorero kusokera 4K Klabu zinzingi kusokera agribusiness kwa endorero zinzingi

English: TVET advises students in Garissa County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Ekegusii: TVET ogokora endorero e Garissa County kogindigwa kwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiria chirengete amasomo yabana baria batari kwenyara.

English: OGP urges residents of Kisumu County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP nkorosia abanto bokisumu chokaonti baborigwe koenana amang'ana onsi arengete obokurumi ase ogoaka esimi yobokonyi EACC gokonya obogaang a gokemanyia na korwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokaonti.

English: DCI warns residents of Kisumu County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this February.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Februari hii.
Ekegusii: DCI osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kisumu kojikana kwa ebiateko omorero omonugunoobarema.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens the electoral calendar centres in Homa Bay County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Kuburudia: Huduma Kenya okoigora chikaunti chia okochi chia okochi ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay chitariki October.

English: Kitui County residents have been urged to take advantage of the projected El-Nino rains to plant more trees to increase the tree cover in the arid and semi-arid county.
Ekegusii: abamenyi ime yekaunti ya kitui baborigwe koimokia ribaga riogosimeka emete chingaki embura enyinge ya elnino ekageirw gochiangotwa. erio gokinia amanani ase chinseemo echio chieroro nonya nchira chibwate embura enke.

English: The National Biosafety Authority will host its 13th Annual Biosafety Conference in two and a half weeks to discuss GMOs and biotechnology safety All stakeholders are encouraged to participate
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usalama wa viumbe itakuwa mwenyeji wa Mkutano wake wa 13 wa Mwaka wa Usalama wa Kihai katika muda wa wiki mbili na nusu ili kujadili GMO na usalama wa teknolojia ya kibayoteknolojia Wadau wote wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Chuma cha chuma na nusu, Chama cha Uchumi wa Taifa itaendelea kwenye Mwanzo wa Miaka 13 wa Kuchambua Uchumi na Usalama wa Biokimia ili kuzungumza kuhusu Organizm zinazozungumzwa na usalama wa biokimia Yonsi yote yanaendelea kuhusiana na hii matumizi yanayohitaji kuhusu kujisikiza na kujali kuhusu matumizi hayo

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kiambu County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokwaniria abanto bose ase Kiambu County igoro yobwenerete bwa gokora obochio bwa nyomba nigo bwarete oborwaire obuya ase chinyomba chiabo.

English: KTDA advises coffee producers in Vihiga County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KTDA nigo egokumia abanyaboremi bwa kofi ase Vihiga County ng'a baregite na ekeina ekeerigwe nigo gokorwa mbere yegesira giokogera.

English: KTDA urges millet growers in Nandi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa millet katika Kaunti ya Nandi watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KTDA ekunyonyonya emaboko e Nandi gindigwa amoyo ayo ayo amagoro embura oyera amagoro ayo

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Samburu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Julai hii.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen nyarigetie ebirengererio korua isiko buna Samburu Abarwaire nyarigetie ebirengererio komanya na gotanga chinchera abasae bagwesaria ebirengererio barabwo abanyene goetera engoromomi.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto, Uasin Gishu, ting’igua igoro yobokoreri bwechikaonti.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Embu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Ekegusii: KTDA egokonya abaremi ba Embu County gotanga ebisasani bia fall armyworm kare na kare goetera okonyora ebitiba ebiarokirwe mbere yechingaki chiokomera chia omotienyi 4.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Garissa County this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkwegeria goika ase ebikaranso bia okomanyia abanto erio komenta abaaki chikura chikaonti Garissa omonugunoobarema.

English: TSC reminds schools in Kisumu County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this March.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Machi hii.
Ekegusii: TSC yekombe chisemi abechisekenderi aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu ting’igua oboronge bwa gosemia abana na basikari gochaya egetamo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nakuru County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egosegeta abanto ba Nakuru County tibakagwate obororo bwo obochenu bwobongo, na baganeire ase namba ya simu ya obogere yechikoni yobochenu bwobongo.

English: Save water! Teach students water conservation in drought-prone areas.
Kiswahili: Okoa maji! Wafundishe wanafunzi uhifadhi wa maji katika maeneo yanayokabiliwa na ukame.
Ekegusii: Gacha amache! Somia abana buna bakogacha amache chingaki chiegurargura ase chingongo chiria chinyomo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Trans Nzoia County to a free training on pest and disease management this July.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ria amachwa ria Kenya rigokwenera abanyamwaka ba Trans Nzoia County ase okorutwa amagenderero amabere ase okorora oborwaire na ebitunwa ebiro bia omotienyi 7.

English: TSC pays January –March 2026 salary in advance – check bank Dec 20!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) giakanire emesara yomotienyi omotangani noyogatato 2026 gotanyorwa, rigereria ebengo chitariki 20 ootienyi 12!

English: Notice: TVET opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: TVET nigo egwete omoroberio omoyia ogw'okwaka amagetsi ase ekigo kio obokoreri ime ya Baringo County.

English: FAO urges beans growers in Kwale County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: FAO egomana abarima ebihingwa bya binyu ku Kaunti ya Kwale kobete ogamio ebisimbo bingi birinda omokugoka kogoka omweya gatobore hamwe nogomanya oburemi bwabiyorera yiwete.

English: DPP urges the public in Garissa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Ekegusii: DPP baboririe abamenyi nchi Garissa kaunti tobaisa okogaba enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ogotunya enchera abange baibeirwe.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges pigs farmers in Narok County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board nigo korigiririe abanyamwaka b'enguruwe ase Narok County koripoti chinyama chire oborwa ase ofisi y'abanyagitari eri hakuhi, konyora amang'ana amange ase oborwa bwa Newcastle.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai yaOmosaria yerekera abanto mbasoka korwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago na kobeka oborendi ase omoroberio bwokogenderera.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Vihiga County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'egetureti nigo egosaba omonto omonene oria okobwate oboremo bw'obochengereri ase Vihiga County koba omokonyi ase omwaka oye oria okobwate oboremo erio asabe obokonyi.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ngeri: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kichakiri egonde korwa egwokia omorero ase chingaki chinyinge Elgeyo-Marakwet amaumuntia.

English: EACC reminds the public in Nakuru County that input on the county budget process is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba mchango juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Ekegusii: EACC aliwakoroma amaumuntia ekaonti ya Nakuru amaumuntia oratange amabudzeto ariiria ochakire aaria ekaonti ya Nakuru.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Nakuru County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: NPS omoriki ose ewizara yobotugi obaboririe abagambi komanyia abanto bonsi amagenderero yeserekari ekaonti ya Nakuru kureba abaririndara buna oratange amagenderero yaganyi yefurua.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Isiolo County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Ukuzaji wa Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Ekigo gia Kenya gia okomanya ebisomo (KICD) nigo korigia abana batari amasomoni ase Isiolo County kwerika abana babo ase esukuru y'omomura ere ang'e ase amasomo abakoro.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Siaya County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: IEBC yarure okoboria ase abanto Siaya yekaunti koba birori ase okoenekia oborendi ase bamenyete ase birengererio korwa ase abanto noike omoerio oye rituko ria chuma ewiki eye na April.

English: Outline of training programs for police and community defenders in Kisumu, Mombasa, Nakuru, prior to national elections
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa programu za mafunzo kwa polisi na watetezi wa jamii huko Kisumu, Mombasa, Nakuru, kabla ya uchaguzi wa kitaifa
Ekegusii: Ngwatora ere emeroberio yokwegeria as abasikari nabaegereri bebinyoro aaria Kisumu, Mombasa amo na' Nakuru ange nobochori obonene.

English: Basic first aid saves lives during disasters. Free training is available through St. John Ambulance and Kenya Red Cross.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya kwanza ya msingi huokoa maisha wakati wa majanga. Mafunzo ya bure yanapatikana kupitia St. John Ambulance na Kenya Red Cross.
Ekegusii: Ayabwenerete gokorwa ritangani chingaki chimobasekano.Okwegerigwa kwa bosa na St.John Ambulance and Kenya Red cross.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: FAO egokaba chimbeyo cheri cheemcheka ase abaremi ba Trans Nzoia County ase omotienyi 9 eno.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Laikipia County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Egetemo gia abanto: Ekeombe gia abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) kigocha korora abanto ase obosa igoro yoborwa bwa oborwa bwa amaguta (hypertension) aaria Laikipia County ase omotienyi 12.

English: What shall you do to give your accord your mental health a good time? Having conversation with people is the good starting point
Kiswahili: Unaweza kufanya nini ili uweze kuwa na wakati mzuri kwa ajili ya afya yako ya akili?
Ekegusii:
Ninki orakore koa afya y'obongo ribaga rigiya?
  Gotwara chinkwana igoro yaye nase agiya yogochakera.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches an August awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Agosti juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Medical Association nigo koraigora omwaka o omotienyi 8 ogokora omobere ogochanchera abanto igoro yoborwari bwa hypertension ase Makueni County.

English: CDC launches an April awareness campaign on safe water storage across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia CDC nigo kigwate chinchera chiokomanya abanto igoro yobuya bwa goika amache ase obokonyi bwa omotienyi 4 ase Nyamira County.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Vihiga County on progress of county development projects this May.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Mei.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana kiaigoreire amasomo yobogesaku komanyia buna chibesa chiechikanti Vihiga amaumuntia amaumuntia chigokora emeremo.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Kiambu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette yabooririe abasae entongori yogoaka chikura, abang' omotienyi oyo Kiambu County, ngetarere chisekenderi IEBC y'oboringoria.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Turkana County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kibororie abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro, kibororie abamenyi korwa choria chingaki chinyinge Turkana County berekera esimi ya okonyora GBV 1195.

English: KMTC urges youth in Kiambu County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: KMTC yasegetire obosae bo Kiambu County korwa chiropoti kengima kobwatekana nobochori erio gotingia amakora.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Ekegusii: IEBC egokwanireria abasubati aaria Kericho County ng'a obonyinge bwa HELB nareo ase abana baria bagosaka amasomo yogoaka na ogotunga ebikorechi.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Ekegusii: Chinga: IPOA gotanga ase oranyanyare kominchoria omorakera korwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: ODPP yamamiriria abakuru bwe Elgeyo-Marakwet ekaunti na omosuna omonto kare eseri ya porisi buna amamocho yogotumia amadaraka abo bobe, ekoenekia buna ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kwale County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekiremire abamenyi ba Kwale County gosimeka amagoro ya kereka ekombo.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Nya: SHA okoigora ekeyia obokwana obogwana ase ogotamera chingaki chiomobasekano ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Isiolo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutumia kiwango cha mbolea kilichopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Mei.
Ekegusii: Ministiri ya Oboremi na Mieno ya Kuchakachara kumwithe farmers e Isiolo County agindigwa amoyo akiyotokwa na amindu amasindika kabila ogokomera a Mei.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sweet potatoes growers in Machakos County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria kirengire oboremi bwa chindagera chia obokweri (Pest Control Products Board) giasabire abaremi ba chimbwarata ase Machakos County gotumia chifutira chirengire ase obwato bwayo mbere yomura gochia nigo konyora amabere amange ase omwaka ogwo.

English: CBC sensitization forums held in all counties.
Ekegusii: Okomanyia Chisemi chirengete okobua kwomwana (CBC) nchokorwe chikaonti 47 chionsi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Turkana County to a free training on pest and disease management this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwe Erimo ne Enyama ya Eserekali nigo roragete abanyamwaka ase Turkana County gochia ase okorugwa okobwate obuya ase ebiru na oborwaire bwe chinyama na chindagera ase omotienyi 11.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Wajir County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba wa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo kikoremereria abamenyi ba Wajir County nga okorenda amabura nigo okonyora oborimi bwa kare na kare.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Nyamira County to a free training on post-harvest handling this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bi'oboremi na oboreri bwe chinyama nigo bikobasemia abaremi ba Nyamira County gochia ase ogotenywa kwa bwerere okwomonyora chindagera chirete korwa oboremi (post-harvest handling) omotienyi 10.

English: Notice: HELB announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyora: HELB nigo egwateire chitariki chiokwiyandikisa ase amashure amanyene (free primary education) ase amashure ari Murang'a County.

English: Ensure safety! Protect refugee students in schools.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha usalama! Kulinda wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule.
Ekegusii: Kera omwana ngosoma are! Konya endorero ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo gosoa chisukuru.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Bungoma County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Ekegusii: Ogotebererigwa Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogokwana abachune ba Bungoma County korenda amokonde ase enchera ogindigwa amariogo ao ao ogokomera amagoro a April.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Trans Nzoia County on soil conservation this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KTDA nigo eregokora omotito bwabaremi ase Trans Nzoia County igoro yoboremi bwa gosegerera amabura ase omotienyi 7.

English: TVET calls on the community in Kwale County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: TVET b erekera egonde e Kwale goikerania aase agigiya abana bagosomera gacha chisukuru.

English: A digital program and technology inclusively with new discoveries in agriculture, can help realize yields...all of them...
Kiswahili: Programu ya digital na teknolojia pamoja na uvumbuzi mpya katika kilimo, inaweza kusaidia kufikia mavuno... wote wao...
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwegedichitari na tekinorochia amo na nobvoremi bwenchera enyia naboigo borakonye komenta rigesa. Bionsi ...

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Samburu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ebisarero bi'oboremi na oboreri bw'ebinyama biraburirie abaremi ba Samburu County goikera chinyomba chiogosangereria amache ase ebirima biabo erio gokonya ase ogotachana na ogotindoka kwa emvura.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Korwa: Huduma Kenya okoigora ekeyia gotema gwanse obotikeranu kwebitabu biosoma kwabeire aria Taita-Taveta.

English: Teach children safe road crossing techniques.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto mbinu salama za kuvuka barabara.
Ekegusii: Somia abana engencho engiya yogotamboka epara ase okorigereria moino na moino ataramboka.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Meru County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokumia abaremi ase Meru County gochia ase ogotara ebituma biokomwa (fall armyworm) kare na kare bagotumia emiti yechibesa yemeretwe mbere ya omotienyi 2, omotienyi ogosimeka.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Marsabit County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: FAO nigo ekobasoka abanyene etugo ase Marsabit County goika gochera etugo chikaonti chinde buna batari na echibali erio gotanga afia yetugo.

English: CDC launches a May awareness campaign on safe water storage across Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia CDC nigo koretie omwaka ogochora obwate bwa omotienyi 5 bwo gokonya abanto bamenye buna bagoika gobitia amache ase obwate obuya ase Isiolo County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Nyandarua County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Ekegusii: Bodi ya amata ya Kenya nigo ekoremeria abamenyi ba Nyandarua County buna oboremi bw'ebinyamwamu nigo bobwate obokonyo bw'okongera ebitunwa bi'omochie ase amagita amange.

English: To differentiate, farming using CSA has three pillars: increase yields progressively, profitable produce and build resilience.
Kiswahili: Ili kutofautisha, kilimo kwa kutumia CSA kina nguzo tatu: kuongeza mavuno hatua kwa hatua, mazao yenye faida na kujenga uthabiti.
Ekegusii: Ase ogoatanana, oboremi goetera CSA nigo borengete chisiro isato: kogesa rigesa ase enchera yokwegendereria nebitoki ebiya erio goikerania oboremi bwonchoreria as okonyora ebiitoki ebiya as abaremi na ogwetenenera.

English: CDC encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: CDC egokang'a abanto bose ba Nyandarua County ng'a tabakomanya obororo bwa chinsiri, na kobakong'a abanyanya babo abari ase obororo ng'a basare obokonyo.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yechingiru kiaboriri abamenyi ba Nyeri obabwateranirie amagenderero gati yeserikari chiechikaonti kwebwaterania ase amagenderero amo nebirenga biekaonti.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Migori County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia NCPB ngosaba abaremi aaria Migori County gochia ase oboremi bwa climate-smart obo bwo bwerere, nigo goteba abaremi okobwatekaniria na okogenda kwa mbura okwo kwarukire.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges cattle farmers in Nyandarua County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
